tei:div.tei:p: gleng brjod/༄༅༅// srid zhi'i 'dren mchog 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchog nas/ phyi lo 1959 nas 1999 bar btsan byol bod mi ser skya rgan gzhon rnams la 'phral yun gyi blang dor lam ston bka' slob rmongs mun sel ba'i sgron me dang / yid gdung sel ba'i bdud rtsi/ 'dod rgu 'grub pa'i nor bu lta bu shin tu rtsa che mtha' yas pa zhig stsa la ba'i khongs nas/ rgya che'i ser skya mang tshogs la bka' slob stsal ba khag khe gtsang phyogs bsdebs/ pod dang po/ 'di dag sku sger yig tshang gi bod yig sde tshan nas phyogs sgrig dang / skyid grong gra 'bar ru 'og skal bzang phun tshogs kyis /ma pu ṭar nang 'god 'jug gis deb gzugs par gzhi bskrun/rab byung bcu drug pa'i ci gas 'brug bod zla 1 tshes 14 nyin 7gong sa 7skya bas mgon chen po mchog gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang rtse pho brang po ta lar 7rgyal mchog sku phreng gong rim gyi gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus te mi lo drug cu tham pa 'khor ba dang / lcags stag bod zla 10 tshes 8 nyin 7gong sa mchog gis bod rgyal khab kyi lugs zung chab srid thugs khur bzhes nas mi lo lnga bcu tham pa 'khor bar bod 'bangs yongs nas bka' drin rjes

dran zhu ba'i dus tshigs khyad par can dang bstun te/ bod gzhung phyi dril las khungs nas par bskrun 'grems spel zhus pa lags na/ rgya che'i rang rigs ser skya mang tshogs rnams nas snying du bcangs 'os 7rgyal ba'i bka' slob dgongs don khag la slob sbyong nyams len tshul bzhin gnang ste/ rang rang 'di phyi'i bde thabs 'chug med sgrub pa dang chabs cig snga dus shar glinga.e sha ya'i nang snyan grags ldan pa'i rlabs chen bod rgyal khab dang / bod mi rigs/ zab cing rgya che'i chos dang rig gzhung bcas pa mi nyams dar rgyas yun gnas spongang ched lhag bsam blo rtsal zung 'brel gyis 'bad brtson che bskyed yong ba'i re skul bcas/bod rgyal lo 2127 rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags 'brug zla 5 tshes 23phyi lo 2000 zla 7 tshes 24 la//

dran zhu ba'i dus tshigs khyad par can dang bstun te/ bod gzhung phyi dril las khungs nas par bskrun 'grems spel zhus pa lags na/ rgya che'i rang rigs ser skya mang tshogs rnams nas snying du bcangs 'os 7rgyal ba'i bka' slob dgongs don khag la slob sbyong nyams len tshul bzhin gnang ste/ rang rang 'di phyi'i bde thabs 'chug med sgrub pa dang chabs cig snga dus shar glinga.e sha ya'i nang snyan grags ldan pa'i rlabs chen bod rgyal khab dang / bod mi rigs/ zab cing rgya che'i chos dang rig gzhung bcas pa mi nyams dar rgyas yun gnas spongang ched lhag bsam blo rtsal zung 'brel gyis 'bad brtson che bskyed yong ba'i re skul bcas/bod rgyal lo 2127 rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags 'brug zla 5 tshes 23phyi lo 2000 zla 7 tshes 24 la//
paṅge jame khubla/ —'jarme hū+o+oṃ khe+oṅge/mu si ba'i sa gnas su lam bzo bar tshi ba'i bka' slob/
bzhugs skar pho brang ske —— mdun bde yangs su bod rigs chig stong tsam la stsal ba'i bka' slob/
bzhugasasgaradug rgorme ra garnerme pa dang / bal yul sogs phyogs gzhan nas ched bcar bod mi dang /mon pa/ rgya gar ba bcas khyon mi grangs bodun brgya skor la stsal ba'i bka' slab/
dzña ram smre labazhugs sgar du bod mi ser skya pho mo nyis stong brgal bar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang stsal skabs sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad bka' slob/
dzña ram sa ṅge bzhugasasgar du gtan sdod mi mang sum stong tsam la sgrol dkarayid bzhin 'khor d+ku tshe dbangastsal skabs sngon 'gro'i gsung bshadabaka' slob/
dzña ram sa ṅge bzhugasasgar du gtan sdod mi mang sum stong tsam la sgrol dkarayid bzhin 'khor d+ku tshe dbangastsal skabs sngon 'gro'i gsung bshadabaka' slob/
rdor glinge ser thiri lharaden zhes pa'i thang chen du bod rigs mi mang khe gtsang du stsal ba'i bka' slob/
lugs zung bsam glinge dang / bde skyid slar gso'i gzhis chags ser skya mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/
lugs zung bsam glinge dang / bde skyid slar gso'i gzhis chags ser skya mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/

༄༅༅// spyi lo 1960 zla 2 tshes 3 nyin rdor gdan bod dgon dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling gi mkhan bla 'dus spyi nas ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin/7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas mnyam med tsong kha pa chen wa'i gsung yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i bshad 'khrid smin rgyas su stsal mjug bka' slob tu/da phan zla shas ring 'di lta'i chos 'chad spel bya rgyu ma byung yang da ring gnas phun sum tshogs pa bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong mngon par sangs rgyas pa dang / rgya ba'i gnas rdo rje gdan du/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rang min yang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa khyed rnam par/ chos phun sum tshogs pa rje'i gsung yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i bshad 'khrid mdor bsdus tsam 'bul rgyu byung ba 'dir ha cang dga' po byung / de gong spyi lo 1956 lor 'dir yong skabs lus brel po yod kyang / sems lhod po yod cing / da lam thengs gnyis pa 'dir slebs skabs lus la brel ba med kyang / sems brel tsam zhig yod pa red/ 'on kyang / zhi ba lhas/ gal te bcos su yod na ni/ /de 'a/ mi dga' ci zhig bya/ /gal te bcos su med na ni/ /de la mi dga' byas ci phan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems khral byas pas phan thogs med gshis tshang mas sems khral bya mi dgos/ des na tshang mas bsam blo rgya chen po dang gting zab po/ gu yangs po zhig gtong dgos/ bod kyi gra sa'i nang mkhan po dang / bla sprul/ gra rkyang sogs so so so so'i 'gro stangs shig yod kyang /da cha yul dang / gnas tshul/ dus tshod bcas rtsa ba nas 'gyur stabs sngar gyi spyod tshul kho nas mi 'grigs/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang gdul bya'i mos 1

blo dang bstun pa'i chos kyi phung po mang po zhig gsungs stabs yul dus dang bstun pa'i bsam blo rgya che zhig gtong dgos/ rang re bod kyi bstan pa'i spyi don chen po zhig sgrub pa la mi re gnyis kyi lhag bsam ci drag gis 'bad pas phan nus thon dka'/ de yang ngas mang po zhig byas khul zhus pa min/ ngas lta ci yang mi shes/ dper na/ mi re res 'degs mi nus pa'i ljid chen po'i dngos po zhig mi mang po'i nus shugs chig bsgril gyis 'degs nus pa ltar/mi tshang ma'i lhag bsam zong kha chig bsgril dgos pa ni shin tu nas gal che/nga tsho'i don gnad 'di bden pa zhig gi thog tu yod stabs bden mtha' gsal rgyu la nga rang yid ches yod/ de yang lhag bsam chig bsgril zhig la rag lus/de ltar lhag bsam chig bsgril de gzhi rtsar bzhag nas sger so so'i bya spyod ji ltar byed dgos zer na/ gra rigs kyi nang mkhan po sogs 'go 'khrid kyi rigs gcig dang / byings te gnyis yod/ spyir tshang mas bsam blo rgya chen po gtong dgos kyang / lhag par 'go 'khrid nas bsam blo rgya che tsam dang / mang tsam gtong dgos/ de (5nga 'go 'khrid gong ma rnams kyi bsam tshul dang / dmigs yul ji yin/ 'phral gyi byed stangs/ phugs kyi bsam tshul/ yul gyi gnas tshul la bstun na so so'i bya spyod gang dang gang byas na legs pa dang / ji 'dra zhig byas na ma 'grigs pa/ deng dus 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul ji yod sogs gang cir bsam zhib rgya che tsam zhig byas te rang gi byed phyogs bsam blo zab po gtong dgos/ dpe cha ba rnams nas kyang bod las mi zhan pa'i dpe cha hur brtson gyis blta dgos pa las/ yul dus gnas tshul la khag 'dogs byas 2

na mi 'grigs/ dpe cha 11gas mthun rkyen zhan yang rim pas 'grigs rgyu/ sngar rgya gar la sangs rgyas kyi chos dar 'phel chen po byung nas rim gyis si lon dang / 'bar ma/ tha'i lan sogs shar phyogs kyi sa khul mang po zhig la dar khyab byung yod kyang / dus da lta'i char lam gyi rim pa cha tshang la zab cing rgya che ba'i chos de bod la yod pa red/ de lta na'ang phyi'i rgyal khab khag nas bod kyi gnas tshul ji bzhin shes dka' zhing / 'ga' zhig nas gnas tshul ji bzhin ma shes par dpe deb kyang bris yod pa red/ dper na/ 'ga' zhig nas bod kyi chos la bla ma'i chos dang / rgya gar gyis chos la sangs rgyas kyi chos zer ba sogs dang / 'ga' zhig nas bon gyi chos ma rtsar bzhag ste de las byung ba'i chos shig yin par bsam pa skustegs bsam tshul mang yang rang re'i chos tshigs bcad gcig yan chad rgya gzhung la ma brten pa med cing / rje'i gsung la sogs pa rnams kyang rgya gzhung la brten pa sha stag yin stabs sngags kyi gsang ba rnams ma gshegegs tshang mas gsal por shod thub na legs/ khyodan pa'i tshos gzhi rang res dmar po gyon srol skor yang ngas 'di 'dra zhig brjod pa yin/ bod nang rnam kun gra chas kyi tshos gzhi dmar po dang / tshogs chos gal che'i skabs ser po gyon srol yod cing / de yang 'dzam gling nang gyon chas kyi tshos gzhi dkar shas che bas nyi ma'i tsha shugs 'gog nus che bas bsil ba dang / nag shas che bas nyi ma'i tsha shugs 'then nus che bas dro ba yod pa ltar dkar nag gnyis gra pas gyon mi chog stabs ser po la tos te dmar po nag shas che bas bod sa mtho grang zug che ba'i yul dus dang bstun te gyon pa yin 3

tshod brjod pa yin/ de yang 'dir slob gra'i dge rgan du 'gro mi'i gras yod stabs nges na phan khyad yong rgyu/ deng tshan rig mkhas pa tshos lus kyi yan lag dang / nying lag gi rtsa rgyus la brten nas mi yi bsam blo 'khor tshul gang 'tshams shes kyi yod kyang / dbang po dang ba dang / rten pa dbang shes/ yid shes kyi gnas tshul dang / shi 'phos nas ji ltar 'gyur ba'i gnas tshul rnams ji bzhin shes pa dka' zhing / skye ba phyi ma zhig yod pa la ni mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ de yang grub pa'i mtha' 'jig rten bkod pa po khas len pa dang / bdag rtag gcig rang dbang can du 'dod pa sogs de dag ni tshan rig mkhas pa tsho'i rig pa dang mi mthun/ rang re'i rten 'byung gi rnam gzhag 'di tshan rig mkhan tshor rgyab skyor du 'gro gi yod 'dugader brten nga cho'i chos kyi gnas tshul rnams rig lam tshad ma'i sgo nas go nus chen po zhig legs par shod thub na/ rang re'i chos 'di lung khug 'grog 'thoms glen pa rnams kyis ma gtogasasbul lung dar rgyas yode sa'i rig gsar mkhan tsho'i spyodayul min par lta ba'i gnas tshul sel thub/ rang re'i spyi tshogs 'gro stangs kyi cha nas rjes lus yin pa ni nges par khas len byed 'os pa las/sbas bskungs dgos don med/ 'on kyang 'dzam gling gzhan na med pa'i chos kyi shes yon ni ngoms 'os pa zhig red/ sngar rang re bod nang gcig pur 'chad nyan byed pa tsam las med kyang / da lta'i dus skabs 'di bzung ste 'dzam gling nang rang re'i chos kyi gnas lugs gsal po zhig bstan thub na shes yon can gyi mi rnams shugs kyis rang rer dga' zhen dang / brtse gdung yong thub/ de 4

ltar byung na rang re'i chos srid gnyis kur phan thogs yong rgyu/ da lta'i char slob gra'i mi 'gro bcu tsam yod pa da dung gang mang byung na snyam gshis tshang mas lhag bsam bzang pos khur len bya dgos/ yang de tsho'i nyer mkhor bod yig spyi dang / sum rtags sogs yi ge'i 'gro lugs legs po shes dgos/ de min rang res 'di ni mkhas pa chen lngas( zhes brjod sa des sa yig cig 'bri dgos byung mtshams mdzub thel rgyag nyen yod/ de tsho rang re nang khul la 'gal ba med kyang / phyi'i lta snang la skyon yod stabs tshang mas do snang bya dgos/da ring 'dir dge 'dun mang po med kyang 'di rnams brgyud rgya cher gsan rgyu yin stabs ngas do gal chen pos zhu rgyu gcig la/ deng dus rgya gar nang bod mi bros byol ba mang po zhig slebs yod pa de rnams yong sa ni lo stong phrag gi gong nas chos shin tu dar ba'i yul bod nas yong ba sha stag red/ der brten ser skya tshang ma'i kun spyod bzang po zhig dgos shing / lhag par bstan 'dzin dge 'dun rnams ni gzhan las ches cher lhag pa'i spyod tshul bzang po zhig cis kyang dgos pa las/ gzhan las 'khrug rtsod rgod pa dang / gzhan las ham pa che ba lta bu spyod tshul ngan pa byung na ni shin tu thabs sdug red/ tha ma rang nyid gcig pur blang dor cha tshang ma thub na yang / yul dus gnas tshul dang bstun te phyi'i snang ngor kun spyod 'dra chags tsam zhig dma' mthar byed dgos/ de tshul chos su 'gro yang tshul chos mkhas pa tshul khrims skye ba'i gzhir gsungs pa'ang yod/ deng rgya mi'i phyogs nas dril bsgrags su bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams nad mi theg pa med kyang sa zhing rgya che'i bdag po gra sa gra 5

tshang khag dang / bla brang khag nas tshul min mang dag byas lugs dril bsgrags rgya cher byed mus stabs 'ga' zhig nas de ltar min nam snyam du dogs pa'ang 'char srid/ des na gra rigs rnams mi mang byings dang 'dres dgos/ de yang gang byung min par 'dres rung thun mong gi cha gcig dang / 'dres su mi rung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i cha gnyis su phye dgos/ thun mong gi cha gang yin zer na/ mi mang 'khyer zhan rnams kyis spyod pa'i zas dang / de rnams sdod pa'i gnas khang / de rnams gnas pa'isda/la la sku(gas pa rnams mnyam du 'dres pa'am/ 'dra bar spyod thub dgos/ thun mong ma yin pa dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la sogs pa dang / dge tshul gyi blang dor khag /gzhan yang rgyun du gra chas nges par du gyon dgos pa la sogs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i so so'i srung sdom rnams ni nges par nan tan du bya dathoges/ de bzhin bla sprul dge bshes sogs kyang gra mang byings dang 'dres dgos/ de 'dra zhig byung na dkrog gtam dril bsgrags ji ltar byas kyang gnas tshul dngos yod kyis lan rgyag thub/ spyir dge 'dun tshul khrims ldan pa lta ci smos/ tshul khrims 'chal ba yin yang khyim pa las ches cher lhag pa ghi wang yod pa'i glang po che shi ba'i ro yin yang de glang po phal pa dang mi 'dra bar lhawang yod pa'i dpe bcas gsungs pa ltar yin yang / deng dus chos la dag snang byed mi shin tu nyung bas tshang mas rang rang gi spyod tshul la bag yod nan tan bya dgos/yang zhu rgyu gcig la/ ngas go thos su deng skabs spyir btang gnas tshul gang legs yod 'dug kyang / da dung sa rnying bka' dge sogs grub mtha' 6

khag gi chos lugs pa rnams dam gtsang chig sgril nges par du dgos gal che zhing / de yang dge lugs pa'i phyogs mang bas skyon cha yang de tsam mang ba yong rgyur/ dge phyogs nas skyon 'gog stangs 'dzin mang tsam byed thub na legs/ de ltar chos pa nang phan tshun dang / bod rigs mi mang nang khul bcas dam tshig chig bsgril bya rgyu shin tu gal che/ de la dgra phyogs nas dga' bsu mi zhu zhing / bzod pa yang mi bsgom pas bsam ngan nges par byed srid/de yang rang re rang dbang rgyal khab nang gnas par brten brdung gsod sogs byed mi thub kyang / rgyu dngos dang / gtam snyan po sogs kyis dngos shugs gang sa nas gnod skyon dang / dbyen sbyor byed rgyur brten/ rang res mig gnyis ka bed spyod kyis phyogs tshang mar blta ba dang / rna ba gnyis ka bed spyod kyis gnas tshul tshang ma nyan pa dang / phyugs las khyad zhugs pa'i yid bed rjodad kyis rang rigs kyi 'phral phyags dge skyon dang / gtam don khe gyong la brtag dpyad legs par bya dgos pa las/ gang byung g.yam rgyugs byas na skyon gnod yong rgyur sgo gang sa nas khro rig bsgrims te bag zon rtag tu bya dgos/de min dper na/ rtags gsal dka' sar sbyangs te sla sa gcig la snang chung lhod yangs byas nas yod skabs mi yong bsam sa zhig nas rtags gsal slebs skabs ngas sla sar sbyang rgyu ma byung zer sa med par rnyogs khra yong ba dang 'dra ba 63na/yang / rang re tshang mar da phan sdug po byung ma myong stabs 'u thug ngang thung byas na mi 'grigs/ rang rer chos srid gnyis ldan brjod srol yod pa 7

ltar mchog dman bar pa tshang mas lugs gnyis zung 'brel du spyod dgos/gra pa gzhon pa 'ga' shas nas thon skyed kyi las ka 'dra byed thub na'ang legs/gang yin zer na/ deng skabs rang re bod dang mi 'dra ba'i yul tha dad/ gnas tshul tha dad/ dus tshod tha dad bcas kyi gnas skabs red/ rjes su bod du phyir log rjes kyang yul tha dad ma gtogs/ tha dad rjes ma gnyis nges par yong rgyu las/ sngar nang bzhin gyi gnas tshul yong rgyu shin tu dka'/ bod don skor dmar po'i rgyal khab dgu tsam las/ de byings mnyam 'brel rgyal spyi'i tshogs khongs yod med la ma ltos par rgyal khab 70480 lhag nas rang rer sems shugs kyis rgyab skyor byed bzhin pa ma zad/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang / mi'i thabs shes la brten nas bden mtha' gsal bar yid ches yod na/ tshang mas bstan pa spyi don la lhag bsam chig bsgril gyis rang rang so so'i bya spyod thog brtag dpyad 'bad brtson lhur len gnang dgos/ rgya gar nang bod dgon re zung yod pa 'ga' shas de snga las drag tu phyin pa'ang yod pas dge 'dun nang khul thugs mthun po gnang rgyu gal chen sngong rdod/ zhes 3yur// // 8

༄༅༅// spyi lo 1960 zla 2 tshes 5 nyin rdor gdan mkhan zur ngag dbang bsam gtan can dang / gnya' nang bka' sgo bkra shis thun mong nas zhus ngor/rdor gdan byang chub shing gi nye drung du 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen pos 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i dbang chen dang spyan ras gzigs ngan song kun grol gyi rjes gnang bcas stsal mjug bka' slob tu/da ring bdag cag gi ston pa mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas bzang po 'dir/ rang cag bod mi mang tsam zhig 'du 'dzoms sar chos 'chad nyan byas pa dang / de'i nang nas theg chen gyi chos/ de'i nang nas gsang sngags kyi chos/ lhag par rang re gangs can pa dang las 'brel che ba'i lha mchog thugs rje chen po dge slong ma dpal mo lugs kyi dbang 'di 'dra 'chad nyan bya rgyu byung ba 'dir slob dpon rang ngos la yang bskal bzang snyam pa'i dga' po byung / lhag par rang re'i snying nas gces pa'i bsil ljongs mdzes shing brjid bag dang ldan pa'i rang yul de bzhag nas zla shas song ba'i da res nga chos ngad mi gang mang zhig mnyam 'dzoms ltod rdzod thog chos 'chad nyan bya rgyu byung ba 'dir ha cang dga' spro byung / khyod rang tsho yang dga' po yod shag rang re rnams phyogs gcig nas de ltar dga' po yod kyang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bsam na/ mi lo stong phrag sngon gyi chos rgyal tsho'i dus rabs nas chags pa'i nga tsho'i brtse zhing yid du 'ong ba'i rang yul skyid la nyams dga'i yul de da cha bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'jig la phyogs pa'i mun nag nyams nga'i gnas shig tu gyur cing / sha khrag gcig gyur gyi nga tsho'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams lus sems la drag cing rtsub pa'i mnar 9

gcod sdug bsngal ya nga bas nyin 'khyol yang mtshan mi 'khyol/ zhag 'khyol yang bdun phrag zla ba mi 'khyol bar gnas pa'i snang tshul bsams na ha cang blo pham chen 11 'dug 'on kyang rang cag nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos tshul las 'bras la bslu ba med pa yin tsang las kyi 'bras bu chud mi za bas sems can spyi mthun gyi las la bcos su med stabs blo pham byas pas mi phan la/ tshul de zhib par bsam na blo pham byed dgos don yang mi 'dug yin na yang nga tsho'i sha khrag gcig gyur mi dmangs rnams kyi don du sems khur chen po len dgos/khong tsho bshas lug bshan pa'i lag tu tshud pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal de 'drar gnas yod kyang / da dung yid zhum pa med par rigs zhen 'dor med kyis nga tsho rgya gar du slebs 'byor bros byol ba rnams la re ba chen pos blo gtad byed kyisku/da pas nga tsho 'dir 'khod rnams la dngos 'brel 'gan khur chen po zhig 'khri yod pas de don tshang mas sems khur re len dgos/ yang 'ga' zhig nas nga tshos sems khur chen pos dka' ngal ji tsam rgyab kyang / don gnad ha cangasku/ langs che drags pas phan thogs ngo snu stanan pa zhiga.eyong snyam pa dran srid pas de'i sgor ngas nan tan gyis brjod rgyur/ bod du sngar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba nas bzungs da bar bod mi'i brgya cha brgya bshad na ham pa cung zad che drags pa lta bu dang / de min bod mi phal mo ches chos mthun gyi 'tsho bar spyad pa las/ ha cang tshul min tha chad kyi las tshul byas med cing / nga sto rgya gar du 'byor nas da bar mthong thos kyi gnas tshul la brtag dpyad byas na yang rang dbang can gyi 'dzam gling mi mang nas nga tshor sems shugs dang rgyab skyor byed kyi yod pa 10

red/ des na bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang / las 'bras kyi bden mthu/mi yi thabs shes/ rgyu 'bras 'grub rung gi dus yun bcas la brten nas rang gi lung par chos srid kyi dpal yon la longs su spyod rgyu yong ba la yid ches dang thag gcod byed thub/ don 'grub mi thub bsam pa ni nor 'khrul yin/ bzang ngan gyi gnas tshul tshang ma rkyen la brten nas byung ba yin stabs rkyen gzhan zhig dang 'phrad dus nges par 'gyur 'gro ba las rtag brtan yong stangs med cing /mi la byung ba'i rkyen ngan sel mi thub pa zhigasku/da pa ma red/ chos byed pa'i skabs gang du'ang thog mar kun slong bcos tshul zab nan byed rgyu gal che ba bzhin/ srid phyogs nas kyang sems shugs bskyed rgyu 'di shin tu gal che/ spyir btang mi yi lus ngag bed spyod byed mkhan sems yin pas bya ba gang byed sems shugs la rag las pa red/ de yang 11da mi rtsam pa za mkhan/ ma ṇi bgrang mkhan/ chol kha gsum gyi khongs su ga༈rdzogs pa'i mi zhig yin phyin mtho dman drag zhan dang /chos lugs sogs kyi dbye ba med par bod spyi don gyi sems khur re dang / 'gan re nges par du 'khyer dgos/ de yang rtsa ba dam tshig chig bsgril byed dgos/spyir bla ma'i sku tshe brtan min slob ma'i dam tshig la rag las/ dge 'dun 'phel rgyas sku(nga min dge 'dun nang phan tshun gyi dam tshig la rag las/ mchog mthun dngos grub 'grub min spyi'i dam tshig dang / gcig gyur gyi 'bad brtson la rag las pa red/ yang 'ga' shas kyi bsam blor bod don 'di zla ba kha shas nang lta bur mgyogs myur 'grub na snyam pa dang / yong nges snyam pa yong srid/ re ba de 'dra zhig kun la yod mod/ de lta na'ang / ma 'ongs pa la go rim med pas 11

gcig byas na re don ltar yong srid kyang / gcig byasata dus yun de las ring tsam zhig 'gor srid pas re thag thung na 'phral gyi 'tsho ba yang khungs mi 'khyol ba'i dka' ngal yong nyen yod pas blo rgya bskyed de gusangs po bya dgos/ nga tshos dka' ngal chen po zhig dang / dus yun ring po zhig 'gor na'ang bzod snyam pa'i sra zhing mkhregs pa'i sems shugs kyis bosgom pa rim babo1da rgya rgyu'i bsam pa'i gra sgrig dang / 'bad brtson bya dgos/ nga tshor sngar byung ma myong ba'i dza drag mi bzad pa'i rkyen ngan dbang gis dka' tshegs chen po dang 'phrad kyang /phyin chad kyi gnas tshul rang re tshang ma skyid na skyid mnyam dang / sdug na sdug mnyam las/ mchog dman bar ma'i dbye ba sku(nga thabs gtan nas med/ des na gnas skabs kyi 'tsho thabs dang / phugs kyi spyi don gnyis kur bsam blo gtong dgos/ nga'i mthong snang la/ mi 'ga' zhig nas ha cang bsam blo ngang thung gis nyin sto nyin 'tshol lta bur phar tshur 'gro bskyod nges gtan med par byed pa 'di dag sa gnas gang 'os shig tu lhings 'jags kyis so so'i 'tsho thabs kyi bsam blo dgos nges shig ma btang tshe ha cang dka' ngal yong gi red/rang rer shesayon gyi tshad ldengs nges med par las don sgrub thabs med gshis bu phrug yod pa'i pha ma tshos bsam blo rgya che tsam btang ste bu phrug lo chung rnams slob sbyong du 'jug thabs dang / pho mo na gzhon rnams nas deng dus kyi shes yon spyi dang / bod yig dag cha/ bod kyi lo rgyus sogs la slob sbyongs do 'khur bya dgos/ dus tshod kyi gnas tshul dang bstun te ngas da lam gra rigs rnams la'ang bsam 'char tshig re zung zhu rgyu byung / de dag gi rgyu mtshan gang 12

yin zhe na/ da lam nga tshor byung ba'i rkyen ngan gyi gnod byed de rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i phyi 'byung ba'i gnod pa lta bu min par yul gru gzhan zhig nas byung ba red/de yang rgya che'i rgya rigs la khag med/ |(nga tsho ni nga cho'i sa babs sogs nas yun ring gi mdza' grogs red/ rgya gar yang de bzhin red/ de bzhin drang bden gyi 'dzam gling mi mang yongs rdzogs nga tsho'i grogs po yin/ rgya nag nang deng dus srid dbang sgyur mkhan dmar wa'i tshogs pa zhig yod pa de'i nang la'ang rgya che'i tang mi rnams la nga tshos lo shas ring gi mthong snang du/ 'khor ba'i nges med dang / ngoms med kyi sdug bsngal khyad par ba zhig gis mnar te rang dbang cung zad tsam bral nas yod pared/ des na nyon mongs shin tu rags pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i 'go 'khrid 'ga' shas nas chos dang / chos min gyi gnas lugs ma rtogs par bya spyod ha cang gi ma rungs pa byas pa red/ de dag la'ang khong khro byed don med cing dngos 'brel gyi snying rje ba'i yul zhig red/ de lta na'ang nga tshos drang bden khungs ldan gyi rtsod pa nges par byed dgos/ des na mgo bde dran 'khrul dang g.yo byus la goms pa che ba'i rgol ba de tshor kha gtad byed pa la glen pasasdu tshugs kyis don phan mi thogs pas rang nyid la shes bya yon tan gyi tshad ldengs nges shig nges par dgos pa red/ gal che ba zhig la dam tshig zong kha chig sgril byed gal shin tu che bas skya ser yul tsho 'dra min/ chos lugs 'dra min/ rim pa mi 'dra ba/ rgya gar nang 'byor snga rjes la sogs pa'i dbye ba de/ shes bya thams cad rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings su ro gcig pa ltar/don du bod mi gcig gyur dang dmigs yul gcig gyur yin stabs 'di skor 13

zab nan gyis dam tshig gcig gyur bya rgyu ha cang gal che/ da lta skyon cher med kyang da dung tshang mas khong zon ltod med ma byas tshe rang re'i rkyen ngan 'di lung pa phan tshun nas byung ba'i dgra'i phyogs shig yod pas dgra phyogs nas rang re'i chig bsgril la dga' bsu mi zhu zhing / bzod sgom yang mi byed par dngos shugs nas gnod skyel byed nges/ de yang mi gsod/ brdung brdeg tshig rtsub kyis byed thabs med pas rgyu dngos dang / dkrug shing gis gnod ci 'khyol bya rgyur brten ngas sngon zhus ltar rang re'i mig gnyis ka dang / rna ba gnyis ka/ phyugs las lhag pa'i yid bcas bed spyod kyis 'phral phugs gtam don khe gyong la brtag zhib khong zon bya dgos/ nga tsho chos lugs pa rnams da lta gang legs yod pa ltar da dung chig sgril dam zab bya dgos/ sa rnying bka' dge ji ltar yin yang grub mtha'i bshad srol tsam las gzhan phan 'o ma'i rgya mtsho ro gcig tu 'khyil te thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i thabs tshul gcig gyur yin stabs nga tsho ci'i phyir mi mthun/ dper na/ da lam ngas gnas bskor la balhadad skabs nang pa dang /lhan rdu/ ye shu sogs tshang ma'i lha khang mjal ba'i thog tshang ma dang gleng mol byas pa yin/ khong tshos 'khor 'das kyi rnam gzhag cig khas len pa de tsam nas yag 11 red/ nga tsho cesas khas len pa'i cha nas kyang gcig mthun byed 'os na/ rang re sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug dang / yul/ rigs/ sgrub bya/ dmigs yul gang nas ba/snyug gyur yin pa'i bod mi tshos nges par du dam tshig cig bsgril byed dgos/ ngas brjod pa rnams yi ge shes pa tshos brjed tho 'dra bris te tshang mas sems la bzhag na phan thogs yong rgyu/ dus tshod bzang por bslab bya brgya 14

nyan pa las/ deng dus bslab bya gcig nyan pa phan che/ da lam brtan bzhugs skabs 'dir 'khod bod rigs spyi mgrin nas blos blangs kyi gan rgya zhig phul 'byor byung ba'i nang dam tshig chig sgril byed rgyu'i brjod tshig shugs che bkod 'dug tshig de mthong dus ha cang dga' po byung na/ da dung mu mthud dam tshig lcags kyi gong bu de je sra je brtan du gtong dgos pa las/ ku re'i tshul du zhus na 'khyags pa'i gong bu lta bu min pa zhig dgos kyi red/ nga tsho'i bsam/ tshul dang / byed spyod rnams mang tshogs nas shes thub pa dang / mang tshogs kyi bsam tshul ji yod nga tshos shes rtogs thub pa byung na tshang mar phan khyad yong rgyur brten da lam ser skya mang po zhis 'dus skabs 'dir gong gi gnas tshul rnams ched du zhus pa yin na tshang mas lag len thebs pa gnang grogs zhes dang / mjug tu/ bar lam dus zing gis rkyen pas rang gzhan phyogs gnyis shar shi rmas kyi bya ba gang min thabs rdugs byung stabs ji ltar bskul ba bzhin bsngo smon zhig byed pa yin pas/ rang re chos pa'i khyad chos de bed spyod kyis rang gzhan 'das gson tshang mar sman pa'i thugs smon rgya gang che gnang skyong dang chabs cig /deng 'dir mdo sngags zung 'brel chos kyi gdams pa 'chad nyan bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsab 'dis mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i tshogs ci mchis pa rnams spyir rgyal bstan dar zhing 'gro kun bde ba/ lhag par bar de'i rkyen ngan duḥkha mi bzad pa'i mun pa'i chu 'dzin dang bral te bde skyid dge ba'i nyin byed dbang po gangs ljongs sa yi thig ler myur du 'char ba'i thugs smon zab nan gnang skyong zhu/ / //15

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1960 zla 5 tshes 12 nyin/ pan jab khul/ 'ja' mu rdzong khongs/ mu si ba'i sa gnas kyi nye 'gram zhig tu lam bzor yod pa'i btsan byol bod mi rnams la dgas khul thon khar 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas gong gsal bod mi tshor 'tshams 'dri lta rtogs dang sbrags btsan byol bu phrug bsdu bkong byed par gzhung zhabs ched gtong mdzad skabs bka' mngags gnang ba/rang re'i bod mi rnams tsha ba che sar sdod mi dgos pa'i ched sa yul bsil sar gnas skabs gzhis chags thub pa dgos skor rgya gar gzhung la rogs ram skyabs 'jug zhus pa ltar de don yong thabs su 'phral sel lam bzo dang bcas la dwags khul bskyod dgos la rang mi de tsho mnyam du yod pa'i phru gu rnams sa khad thag ring du mnyam 'khrid byed dgos pha ma bu phrug tshang ma dka' ngal che ba'i gnas la brten/ ngos nas 'dir dmigs bsal btsan byol bu phrug gso skyong khang zhig gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu de khongs 'jog nyar byas na yag po 'dug 'di ltar phru gu dang / pha ma tsho'i 'dod par phyin na/ gnas skabs pha ma bu phrug gnyis phyogs kyi dka' sdug sel thub pa dang / phugs su phru gu rnams rang mgo thon nges kyi 'gro stangs shes rgyu nyag cig thog bod chos ldan rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan dang / bod kyi mi rigs rang dbang rgyud 'dzin byed mkhan bod mi go chod pa sha stag byung ste/ ma 'ongs pa na/ kho tshos rang gi mes po dang / pha ma/ khu zhang / sring mo/ a ne+e/ gcen po/ gcen mo bcas kyi sha khrag dang / srog gi 'gro song gtong dgos byung ba'i gnas tshul 16

sdug po 'di dganam yang ma brjed pa'i sgo nas mi rabs gong ma'i bkren gsab thub rgyur nga rangayid ches yod/ de 'brel rgya gar sogs phyi rgyal khag gi gzhung dang / mi mang zhi bde la dga' ba rnams nas rang re bod pa sdug thog 'dir 'tsho skyob sogs kyi rogs ram gnang ba'i bkrin gsab rgyu yang khong tshos nam yang brjed kyi ma red bsam gyi 'dug 'on kyang 'di skor rtsa ba phru gu dang / pha ma tsho'i 'dod pa gtso bzung bya dgos/ zhes bka' mngags stsal // //17

ko༅༅// spyi lo 1960 zla 6 tshes 29 nyin/ ḍa la ha'o ser btsan byol bod mi ser skyayongs la spyan ras gzigs ngan song kun grol gyi rjes gnang dang / yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i bka' 'khrid stsal skabs sngon 'gro chos bshad stsal ba las/ snying bsdus zin thor bkod pa/ 1) ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos ni rig pa yang dag dang ldan pa kho na yin/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i thabs dam pa dang / rang re bod pa rnams la yod pa'i chos kyang 'di kho na yin pas/ 'di la nga tshos zhe thag pa nas dad pas 'bad dgos pa yin/sngar 'dzam gling tshan rig bzlos chos zer ba de dngos don dang 'gal bas tshan rig dang mi mthun tshul brjod yod kyang / deng sang tshan rig pa 'gas gnas tshul de las yongs su ldog ste tshan rig gi brtag zhib byed skabs sems can shi ba ni mar me shi ba dang mi mtshungs par sems can shi ba'i rjes su sems kyi rgyun zhig yod thag chod dang / de brtags nas shes par byed pa la chos kyi gnad don nam/ chos kyi rig pa'i 'gro lugs rtogs dgos zhes brjod mus yin 'dug des na bla ma dge bshes dang / dpe cha ba sogs nang pa'i chos kyi gnad don la sbyong myong ba tshos gzhung las gsungs pa'i rig pa yang dag rnams skye bo tha mal pa'i mthun snang gi chos la gtugs te chos ston dgos/deng skabs phyi mi gzhan dag la lam rim gyi gsung rgyun ji lta ba bzhin bshad na mi 'grigs/ ngos kyi bsam par/ dang po chos de yang dag pa yin pa'i rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas gsal bar ngo sprad/ pha rol pos chos la yid 18

ches byung na/ de nas chos nyams su len thabs lam rim bzhin brjod dboges par bsam gyi 'dugang tshos deng sang dus kyi gnas tshul dang bstun te gzhi bden pa gnyis/lam thabs shes gnyis/ 'bras bu sku gnyis te/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum/ phyi ma phyi ma snga ma snga mar brten nas 'byung bas rgyu med rang 'khrungs lta bu min zhing / gzhi bden gnyis kyang rig pa mthar thug mthun snang du gtugs te dam pa'i chos 'chad spel byed dgos/ chos kyi gnad don shod mkhas pa zhig byung na tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas phyi rgyal gyi mi rigs kyang nang chos la yid ches nges rnyed thub pa'i re ba yod/choges 11gas nas bsam na rang cesar rkyen ngan grogs shar gyi go skabs yag po zhig thob 'dug nga tshos go skabs 'di bed spyod kyis phyi rgyal la chos lugs rgya cher spel thub pa byed dgos/ phyi rgyal gyi mi brgya la chos bshad na/de khongs nas gcig gnyis la don dam gyi phan pa nges par yong srid/ gal te khong tshos don la yid ches kyis nyams su blangs pa ma byung yang / chos 'di rigs lam dang ldan par ngos 'dzin dgos pa zhig chags kyi red/ nga tshos phyi 'byung ba dang / nang lus shes pa dang bcas pa'i bkod pa'i 'gro lugs sogs gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar la dus bstun rigs pas brgyan te gsal por shod thub na des kyang deng sang chos yang dag tu ston par phan thogs chen po yod/deng sang 'ga' zhig gis bod kyi chos la bla ma'i chos dang / rgya gar 19

ches byung na/ de nas chos nyams su len thabs lam rim bzhin brjod dboges par bsam gyi 'dugang tshos deng sang dus kyi gnas tshul dang bstun te gzhi bden pa gnyis/lam thabs shes gnyis/ 'bras bu sku gnyis te/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum/ phyi ma phyi ma snga ma snga mar brten nas 'byung bas rgyu med rang 'khrungs lta bu min zhing / gzhi bden gnyis kyang rig pa mthar thug mthun snang du gtugs te dam pa'i chos 'chad spel byed dgos/ chos kyi gnad don shod mkhas pa zhig byung na tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas phyi rgyal gyi mi rigs kyang nang chos la yid ches nges rnyed thub pa'i re ba yod/choges 11gas nas bsam na rang cesar rkyen ngan grogs shar gyi go skabs yag po zhig thob 'dug nga tshos go skabs 'di bed spyod kyis phyi rgyal la chos lugs rgya cher spel thub pa byed dgos/ phyi rgyal gyi mi brgya la chos bshad na/de khongs nas gcig gnyis la don dam gyi phan pa nges par yong srid/ gal te khong tshos don la yid ches kyis nyams su blangs pa ma byung yang / chos 'di rigs lam dang ldan par ngos 'dzin dgos pa zhig chags kyi red/ nga tshos phyi 'byung ba dang / nang lus shes pa dang bcas pa'i bkod pa'i 'gro lugs sogs gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar la dus bstun rigs pas brgyan te gsal por shod thub na des kyang deng sang chos yang dag tu ston par phan thogs chen po yod/deng sang 'ga' zhig gis bod kyi chos la bla ma'i chos dang / rgya gar 19

gyi chos la sangs rgyas kyi chos zhes chos lugs gnyis su ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod 'dug nga rang tsho lung khug gi chos pa tshos chos kyi gnas lugs yang dag par ston thub na des nga rang tsho'i shes rig zab cing rlabs che ba yang mngon thub/nga tshos dam pa'i chos khyab 'phel gyi ched du thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprugs byas te gang sa nas gom pa spo gang thub byed dgos/ 'di ni bod pa spyi dang / lhag par chos kyi gnas lugs gsal por rtogs pa tsho'i las 'gan yin/ 'di yis bod kyi bstan pa chab srid la phan thogs gnad du 'khel ba sgrub thub pas/ khyed tsho'i thugs la nges par 'jog dgos/ rang gi 'dzin pa'i chos lugs phyi phyogs su phar spel ba ma zad/ deng skabs chos lugs gzhan dag gi gnad don yang tshur rtogs dgos pa yin/ de yang rnam 'grel nang chos lugs grub mtha' gzhan dag mang po zhig gsungs yod pa las/ ngos snga lo rgya gar khul gnas mjal du bskyod skabs grangs can pa'i shes bya nyer lnga'i 'dod tshul ming tshig 'ga' zhig go brda ma 'phrod pa ma gtogs phal cher sngar dang 'dra ba 'dug nga tshos chos lugs gzhan dag la 'gyur ba ji byung dang / 'gyur ba yong don ji yin/ deng gi 'gro lugs ji ltar yod pa dang / gzhan yang ye shu'i chos lugs/ kha che'i chos lugs/ sig gi chos lugs sogs kyi 'gro lugs nges par du shes dgos pa yin/deng skabs bod gcig pur chos dar rgyas yun gnas yong thabs byas pas mi 'grigs/ gzhan dag lung pa re zung la dar bas kyang mi 'grigs/'dzam gling yongs la chos kyi gnas lugs khyab spel thub pa zhig byed dgos/20

der brten da lta nas phyi nang gnyis ga'i chos kyi 'gro lugs shes pa dang / shod thub pa'i lhurto nas gzhan blo chos su phyogs thub pa byed dgos/ chos byed pa la lha sgrub zer ba lta bu bsdus la mi gsal ba min par/ rgyu mtshan yang dag gsal po 〈snan pa'i sgo nas chos la dad pa skye thabs gnad du 'khel ba zhig bya dgos/phyi rgyal gyi mis cesas khungs ldan yin min brtags te gzhi nas chos la yid ches dang / chos yang dag par ngos 'dzin thub thabs byed pa de gal gnad chen po 'dug pas de lugs dgongs par 'jags dgos/2) lus srog g.yo ba chu yi chu sbur bzhin/ myur du 'jig pas 'chi ba dran pa dang / zhes par 'grel bshad mdzad skabs/ 'chi ba las thar thabs gtan nas med/ des na phyi ma'i don du chos rnam par dag pa zhig byed dgos/de yang 'jig rten blos gtong dgos/ chos dang 'jig rten gnyis 'gal zla rang yin/ 'on kyang 'jig rten nag po nag rkyang dang / chos mthun gyi 'jig rten la khyad par yod/ rang re bod la yang lugs gnyis zung 'brel zhes mi rabs gong rim nas kha rgyun du yod pa tsam ma zad/ dngos su lag len bstar ba ltar/ deng dus dang / phyin chad ji srid nam gnas bar lugs gnyis zung 'brel zhes pa nyams med yun du gnas dgos nges yin/mtshams 'dir ngas tshig rnyog cung zad cig brjod 'dod byung / 'dir dge 'dun pa 'ga' zhig lag shes bzo las la ma zhugs thabs med byung ba 'di yang da lta'i gnas skabs su 'os par bsam gyi 'dug yin na yang lag shes la zhugs te khyim pa dang mnyam 'dres yin tshul gyis 'jig rten khyim pa'i 21

rjodad lam rnams nyams su blangs na rtsa ba nas mi 'grigs/ ngas blo pham shin tu che ba'i sgo nas zhu rgyu zhig la/ bar der dge 'dun pa kha shas dang / bla ma sprul sku 'ga' shas bab log byung ba'i gnas tshul thos pa 'di ni ngos rang ha cang lho pham chen po byung / da phyin gnas tshul 'di 'drar ma skungang ba zhig tshang mas dgongs pa yag po bzhes dgos/ ha cang dmigs bsal che drags na rnyogs khra che la dka' ngal mang ba'i kha sbyor bdun ldan khyad mtshar zhig gi rtogs pa rnyed mkhan mang du 'gro gi red/ nga tshos lta ba chad mtha' dang rtag mtha' gnyis ka dgag dathongs pa ltar/ rjodad pa yang rtag chad gnyis phyogs nas dgag dgos pa yin/ 'dir yod bod pa spyi dang / lhag par bla sprul dge 'dun pa tshos dgongs pa gzab gzab bzhes dgos/ da lta 'dir hob kyi lta snang la nga tsho 'di ltar 'dzoms nas 'dra chags po/ yin mdog khag po yod na yang / don dam bsam blo gtong dus nga rang tsho snying nas dga' zhen byed pa'i pha yul bod lung pa ni rgya dmar gyi lag tu tshud/ rang tshor snying nas brtse zhing byams pa'i pha ma spun nye/ bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams ni rgya dmar gyi bran g.yog tu gyur te bzod par dka' ba'i btsan dbang gdug rtsub chen po'i 'og tu sdug bsngal nyin 'khyol yang mtshan mi 'khyol ba myangs dang myong bzhin pa red/ de dang dus mtshungs bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yang ming tsam med pa bzo mus dang / nga rang tsho so so skyes sa'i lung pa skyid po de da cha gang 'dra zhig chags sku(da dam/ gnas tshul 'di tsho bsam ste da phan gyi bsam blo sdum sdum de 'dra btang na gtan nas mi 'grigs/22

rjodad lam rnams nyams su blangs na rtsa ba nas mi 'grigs/ ngas blo pham shin tu che ba'i sgo nas zhu rgyu zhig la/ bar der dge 'dun pa kha shas dang / bla ma sprul sku 'ga' shas bab log byung ba'i gnas tshul thos pa 'di ni ngos rang ha cang lho pham chen po byung / da phyin gnas tshul 'di 'drar ma skungang ba zhig tshang mas dgongs pa yag po bzhes dgos/ ha cang dmigs bsal che drags na rnyogs khra che la dka' ngal mang ba'i kha sbyor bdun ldan khyad mtshar zhig gi rtogs pa rnyed mkhan mang du 'gro gi red/ nga tshos lta ba chad mtha' dang rtag mtha' gnyis ka dgag dathongs pa ltar/ rjodad pa yang rtag chad gnyis phyogs nas dgag dgos pa yin/ 'dir yod bod pa spyi dang / lhag par bla sprul dge 'dun pa tshos dgongs pa gzab gzab bzhes dgos/ da lta 'dir hob kyi lta snang la nga tsho 'di ltar 'dzoms nas 'dra chags po/ yin mdog khag po yod na yang / don dam bsam blo gtong dus nga rang tsho snying nas dga' zhen byed pa'i pha yul bod lung pa ni rgya dmar gyi lag tu tshud/ rang tshor snying nas brtse zhing byams pa'i pha ma spun nye/ bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams ni rgya dmar gyi bran g.yog tu gyur te bzod par dka' ba'i btsan dbang gdug rtsub chen po'i 'og tu sdug bsngal nyin 'khyol yang mtshan mi 'khyol ba myangs dang myong bzhin pa red/ de dang dus mtshungs bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yang ming tsam med pa bzo mus dang / nga rang tsho so so skyes sa'i lung pa skyid po de da cha gang 'dra zhig chags sku(da dam/ gnas tshul 'di tsho bsam ste da phan gyi bsam blo sdum sdum de 'dra btang na gtan nas mi 'grigs/22

nga cho'i bden pa'i mtha' gsal rgyu nyag cig kyang / de la mi yis thabs shes byed dgos pa las rang bzhin rang byon lta bur yong mi srid/ nga tshos rtag tu nas bsam blo rgya che tsam dang / ring tsam btang nas thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprugs byed dgos/ dper na/ de sngon gdan sa'i mkhan po dge bshes yin yang rung / rgyud pa dang / rnam gra yin yang rung / rang rang so so'i khungs ded de lam gcig pu kho nar thad shar phyin kyang 'grigs la dge mtshan yang yod/ 'on kyang da lta'i gnas skabs 'dir sgo kun nas thabs sna tshogs shig lag len du bstar dgos/ 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gang gi thad nas yul dus gnas tshul la nges par du bstun dgos/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang skabs re rang bzhin yod pa dang / skabs re rang bzhin med par gsungs pa dang /lam 'og mar bud med bsten mi chog pa dang / lam gong mar bud med bsten dgos par gsungs pa sogs gnas tshul dngos yod dang bstun te bsam pa dang spyod pa mi 'dra ba dgos par gsungs pa ltar nges par du gnas tshul dang bstun te bsgyur bcos byed dgos/ 'on kyang rtsa ba chos dang 'gal min bsam zhib nan tasna gyis brtag dgos/ jo thon rngos bhi kra ma la shi lar gnas tshul gsar pa zhig byung skabs sde stod gsum nas bkag yod med dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang 'gal min bsam gros tshogs 'du byed pa'i lam srol yod gsungs pa/ ltar/ rang res kyang spyod pa gsar pa zhig byed dgos byung na de mtshams sde snod gsum las 'gal min dang / byang sems dang sngags kyi bcas pa las 'gal min bcas la bsam zhib gros bsdur nges par byed 23

dgos/ de bzhin gnas tshul la brten nas bsam blo gsar pa gtong ba dang /gom pa gsar pa zhig ma spos thu med yin rung / yul dus gnas tshul brjes par bsam ste rtsa ba'i rang lugs skyon med dkar gtsang gi cha de tsho rtsa brjes su song na gtan nas mi 'grigs/dge 'dun pa mang tsam zhig lam bzor phebs dgos byung ba de ni ha cang gi khag po yin 'dug kyang skabs 'dir ngos rang dga' po byung / dge 'dun pas dus bstun dgongs bzhes kyis dka' ngal 'dzems med gnang ba de yag po red bsam pa byung / ser mo ba slob gnyer la zhugs min sna tshogs shig yod stabs tshang ma mnyam 'dres su bzhugs rgyu dang / sa gnas gcig tu 'tsho 'dus su gnas rgyu sogs shin tu khag po red/ bod du bskal pa bzang po red/ dge 'dun pa tsho la dmigs bsal gyi dka' ngal gang yang med/ da cha bod du bzhugs skabs kyi bsam blor bsgyur bcos btang ste lam basbra'i las rogs su phebs thub pa de yag po red/ sbag sar sa skya dang / rnying ma/ dge lugs/ bka' brgyud pa bcas kyi bla sprul dge 'dun 'tsho gcig bzhugs thub pa dang / ḍa la ha'o ser rgyud grwa stod smad/ rnam grwa/ gzhan dag sngags phyogs kyi dge 'dun/ de min dge bshes dang / dpe cha ba khag gcig bcas sa gnas gcig tu bzhugs thub pa dang / de dag gi nang 'ga' shas lag shes bzo las su zhugs pa bcas yag po red bsam gyi 'dug nga tshos dus dang gnas tshul khag po'i skabs su rang gis dka' ngal 'dzems med byed dgos pa dang / de 'dra'i dka' ngal 'dzems med byed bzhin pa de bsngags 'os kyi 24

gnas su gyur pa zhig red/spyir btang 'dzam gling gi btsan byol ba tshang mas rang rang sa yul zhig tu gnas chags thabs sam/ gzhis chags thub thabs byed kyi sku(da pa ltar nga rang tsho bod pa btsan byol ba'i khongs nas so nam pa dang lag shes pa los yin/ de min yang sa zhing gi las ka byas te gzhis chags thub thabs gather+sha bor byed pa dang / gzhan dag gang 'tshams shig gis lag shes bzo las la zhugs te thonaskyed byas nas/ tshang mas rang gi lto gos rang gi las gas khungs 'khyol ba zhig byed pa dang / tshang ma lhing 'jags su sdod thu ba na/ de nas bod kyi bstan pa chab srid la zhabs 'degs phan nus thon pa sgrub thub/ lto gos gnas mal gdeng 'khel med na sems su ji tsam dran pa dang / kha nas ji tsam bshad kyang don la bsam thog don 'khel yong ba shin tu khag po red/snga 'phros 'di khul 'byor ba'i rang mi tshang ma gnas chags zhing 'jags shig byed thub na ngos kyang sems khral chung du song nas rang re'i spyi don la nus shugs sngar las thon pa zhig byed thub mi yongang ngam snyam pa 'dugaḍa la ha'o se'i lag shes bzo las kyi gnas tshul sngon nas go thos byung thog mdangs dgong grub 'bras ji yod dngos su mig mthong gsal rtogs byung gshis ngos rang dga' po byung ba ma zad/ spobs pa yang cung zad skyes byung / phyi nang kun nas bod pa gyong po/ blo stobs dang / rig rtsal chen po red zer ba dngos bden red bsam pa byung / 'dir bod mi'i lag shes las gra 'di ltar tshugs pa dang / dha ram sa lar nga tshos bod mi'i bu phrug gso skyong 25

khang zhig gsar du btsugs te/ der btsan byol rang mi lam bzo ba khag gi phru gu pho moste mang po bsdu 'gugs byas pa yin/ phru gu tsho thog ma 'byor skabs phal cher lus gcong po/ glen pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug yin na yang bdun re gnyis song nas phru gu de tsho me rtog la chu rgyab pa nang bzhin grung po/ snying rje po chags 'dug 'di skabs nga'i sems su spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul bya'i skye bo 'dem nor thebs mi 'dug bsam pa byung / de bzhin lam bzo khag la'ang mi rigs gzhan dag gi las mi dang / bod pa'i dbar las shugs che chung gi khyad par chen po byung 'dug tshul 'di dag la brten nas da cha nga'i sems kyi gting rang nas nga tsho bod rigs zer ba 'di don dam gyi gyong po red/ gang byas kyang ma 'byon pa dang / ma shes pa rtsa ba nas mi yong thag chod red snyam pa'i yid ches sngar las brtan pa zhig skyes byung /'dir khyod tshos lag shes bzo las phra tshugs gong 'phel du 'gro thabs la da dung mu mthud 'bad brtson byed dgos/ 'dir da lta thon skyed 'du 'god skor gyi gnas tshul gtan 'khel ba zhig mi 'dug 'di skor tshang ma bsam rgya ma chung ba dang / rlabs che tsam zhig byed dgos/ ngos kyi bsam 'char zhig la/ khyodad tshos thon skyed khe las byed phyogs skor mi gcig gam/ sger so so min par mnyam rub kyi thog nas spyi par phan pa dang / khe 'bab spyi thog tu yong ba zhig byed dgos/ spyi drod na sger 'khyags por lus mi shes/ des na tshang mas spyi bsam nas thon skyed khe las byed pa de rang gal che bar bsam gyi 'dug lag shes baXge las pa tshos thon skyed mnyam las kyi sgo nas spyi la 26

khe phan yong ba zhig byed dgos pa dang / lam bzo khag gi las mi rnams nas kyang 'ga' zhig gla dngul phran bu byung 'phral lam seng za khang du rgyugs pa dang /ja mngar tshod med 'thung ba sogs kyis stor rkyen byed kyi yod skad de 'dra'i dbang du ma song bar tshang mas pad sha gcig las med kyang gang byung bstor mi dgos par bsags te spyi bog tu phan thabs gang 'gro zhig byas na spyi sger gnyis kur ma rtsa tshugs thub pa'i dge mtshan chen po yod /gang ltar yang / tshang mas mnyam 'brel thog nas spyi sgor yongs la khe phan yong thabs kyi blo rgya che bskyed byed dgos/ dper na/ rgya nag khul mi mang la rang dbang dang longs spyod byed pa'i khe dbang spa tsam med pa de sdug po zhig red ma gtogs/ rtsa ba'i mnyam 'brel thon skyed skyo thad la nga tshos slob sbyong 'os pa zhig red/ de 'brel deng sang nga rang tsho'i khyim tshang lta bu rgya gar rgyal khab 'dir yang mnyam 'brel khe las rgya khyab tu khyab spel yod mus bcas mnyam 'brel gyi las don byed pa 'di la dge mtshan chen po zhig yod thag chod red/nga tshos rgya nag tu gung bran tang zer ba'i dmar po'i lam lugs ngan pa de la snying nas khong khro za dgos pa zhig chags yod kyang / rgya nag rgya che'i rgya rigs mi mang gi grub 'bras bzang po rnams la bsngags brjod slob sbyong byed 'os pa yin/ bstan dgra rgya dmar gyi phyi nang gnas lugs kyang nges par du rtogs dgos/ slob dpon chos kyis grags pas phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' la sbyangs brtson snyugs bsrings mdzad pa'i rnam thar nyams su blangs te/ nga 27

khe phan yong ba zhig byed dgos pa dang / lam bzo khag gi las mi rnams nas kyang 'ga' zhig gla dngul phran bu byung 'phral lam seng za khang du rgyugs pa dang /ja mngar tshod med 'thung ba sogs kyis stor rkyen byed kyi yod skad de 'dra'i dbang du ma song bar tshang mas pad sha gcig las med kyang gang byung bstor mi dgos par bsags te spyi bog tu phan thabs gang 'gro zhig byas na spyi sger gnyis kur ma rtsa tshugs thub pa'i dge mtshan chen po yod /gang ltar yang / tshang mas mnyam 'brel thog nas spyi sgor yongs la khe phan yong thabs kyi blo rgya che bskyed byed dgos/ dper na/ rgya nag khul mi mang la rang dbang dang longs spyod byed pa'i khe dbang spa tsam med pa de sdug po zhig red ma gtogs/ rtsa ba'i mnyam 'brel thon skyed skyo thad la nga tshos slob sbyong 'os pa zhig red/ de 'brel deng sang nga rang tsho'i khyim tshang lta bu rgya gar rgyal khab 'dir yang mnyam 'brel khe las rgya khyab tu khyab spel yod mus bcas mnyam 'brel gyi las don byed pa 'di la dge mtshan chen po zhig yod thag chod red/nga tshos rgya nag tu gung bran tang zer ba'i dmar po'i lam lugs ngan pa de la snying nas khong khro za dgos pa zhig chags yod kyang / rgya nag rgya che'i rgya rigs mi mang gi grub 'bras bzang po rnams la bsngags brjod slob sbyong byed 'os pa yin/ bstan dgra rgya dmar gyi phyi nang gnas lugs kyang nges par du rtogs dgos/ slob dpon chos kyis grags pas phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' la sbyangs brtson snyugs bsrings mdzad pa'i rnam thar nyams su blangs te/ nga 27

tshor su zhig gis sdug po btang ba dang / nga tshos su zhig la kha gtad gcog dgos pa/ thabs gang 'dra zhig la brten dgos pa sogs bya ba'i gnad thams cad shes thub pa zhig byed dgos/da lta 'dir thon skyed khe las mnyam 'brel gyi gleng mo phran bu byung zhing /'on kyang snying po thon skyed gong 'phel gtong ba la thon skyed kyi yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzhi rgya che tsam zhig dgos/ der brten da yod kyi yo byad yag tu gtong ba dang / rim pas 'phrul 'khor bed spyod kyis mnyam rub thon skyed byed thub na spyi phan khe las kyi bya ba rlabs che sgrub thub kyi red/ rgya gar ba'i las byed nas kyang 'di thad la bsam pa'i 'char gzhi yag po 'dug de rtsis studad tshos nus shugs che skyed byed dgos/'dir dge 'dun pa 'ga' zhig bzo las lag shes su zhugs pa dang /mthun rkyen 'jordoms min stabs kyis na bza' skya chas bzhes dbe|sa pa sku(gas byung yod kyang / don dam 'jig rten nag po'i dbang du ma song ba zhig nges par du mdzad dgos/ dus mtshungs bod du bzhugs skabs kyi dge 'dun pa yin phyin dmigs bsal dal la skyid pa'i snang ba de yang dgag dgos/ da phan bod du gang yod pa dang / da phan bod du gang byas pa de da cha rgya gar khul sku(nga thabs med/ yul khams gzhan dag la'ang gtan nas yong thabs med/phyin chad bod rang du'ang yong thabs med/ nga tshos don dam par bod rgyal khams rang tshugs thub pa'am/ rtsa ba'i gzhung dang / bod rgya che'i mi mang gi don du bsam blo rgya che tsam dang / bsam blo gsar pa zhig gtong dgos/28

phyogs gcig gi sger don gatho rwasgar bzung bas rtsa ba nas mi 'grigs/ 'grigs kyi red dam ma red/ khyed tshos dgongs pa yag po zhig bzhes dang /da phan bod kyi gnas tshul des nga rang tsho la don dam gyi gyong chen po rag pa ma red dam/ nga tsho'i mi ga tshad shi song / dgra bos nga tsho'i mi khri phrag mang po gsod thub pa'i rkyen rtsa ga la thug 'dug nga rang tsho sger gzhung chos bcas bod mi yongs rdzogs kyi phyi nang stod bcud gang la'ang lta khungs brten khungs gang yang med pa'i gnas tshul sdug po/ skyo 1/ 'gyod pa chen po 'di byung ba'i rkyen rtsa gang la thug 'dugarang re bod la chos yag po yod/ 'on kyang chos dang mnyam pa'i srid byus 'dzin skyong ji bzhin lag len du 'khel ba byung med/ srid kyi thad la nor 'khrul chen po byung yod/ lhag par 7rgyal ba sku 7gong ma dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs rjes nas bod rgyal khab gzhung dang / bod mi mang spyi don gyi las ka tshags tshud po zhig rtsa ba nas byung mi 'dug bar skabs kyi gnas tshul ni gang 'dra byung ba khyed tsho tshang ma'i dgongs par mnga' gsal red/ ngas 'dir gsal po zhus na/ gdan sa tsho'i khongs nas chos gzhis yin zer sa khang mi ser mang po zhig bdag tu bzung / des slob gnyer ba sogs dge 'dun dmangs la phan pa chen po yod khul gyis gzhung dang / mi mang su la'ang khe dbang ma sprad par dam por bzung ste 'dis bstan pa chab srid la zhabs 'degs sgrub kyi yod khul byed pa de yang nor 'khrul chen po yin pa ra mthong gi 'dug nor 'khrul red dam ma red/ snga lo bod sa phag zla 2 tshes 129

nyin mo nga rang tshos rgya dmar gyi btsan dbang 'og nas sger langs rang btsan bskyar len gyi las 'gul byas pa red/ de dus gdan sa tsho la chos gzhis stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs pa yod na yang bstan pa chab srid la phan thogs ga re byung song / de nas nyin shas rjes rtsa ba'i bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi chab srid la nyams nyes byung dus sger chos su la'ang rnam kun gyi khe dbang chen 1— de 'dug gam/ sgor chos tsho la dmigs bsal gyi lhags pa ga re byung song / rang re'i bod gzhung skabs der bod tshes brgyad dgu nas khyim mtshes rgya gar rgyal khab phyogs su bden rgyab 'tshol bar bros yong dgos byung / khyed snur do'i sang gnangs nas lam seng bros phebs dgos byung ba las/ sger chos kyi dmigs bsal khe dbang bzung nas bzhugs thabs ma byung ba red/ bstan pa stobs dang / dbang gis kyang 'dzin dgos pa ltar/ ris med bstan pa mchod sbyin gyi mnga' bdag bod gzhung stobs dbang gnyis med du gyur dus bstan 'dzin bla sprul dge 'dun gyi sde yang nyams nyes 'thor skyon du phyin dang 'gro bzhin pa da cha rang cag gzhung sger chos bcas tshang mar nyams myong dngos su byung zin pa yin/ da phyin bsam blo gsar pa zhig gi sgo nas bod du chos srid gnyis ka skyon med dar rgyas yong thabs shig byed dgos/ de yang skabs su babs pa zhig la phyi rgyal srid lugs khag gis chos srid dbang 'dzin ji ltar bya tshul rtogs par byas nas/ de dag rang re'i dngos byung nyams myong dang bsdebs thog nga tsho'i chos kyi srol bzang dang zung du sbrel te chos srid zung 'brel du skyong dgos/30

nga tshos da dung sngar lugs kho nar zhen pa'i bsam sbag dog pos chos gzhis dang / sger khag zer ba la sogs pa'i col chung ṅgi bya ba 'di rigs la mgo bo 'khor te bsdad na da lta'i dka' ngal sel rgyu shin tu nas khag la/phyin chad bod du log nas kyang khungs 'khyol mi thub par thag bcad chog pa yin/ yang nyin gcig tan tan bros 'gro dgos byed kyi red/ da res rgya gar gzhung mi mang dang bcas pas mi lo stong phrabaka sngon nas 'phags bod mdza' 'brel yod pa'i rogs ram la brten nas gros sa dang / sdod sa zhig byung ba red/ rtag par phan grogs 'di 'dra yong khag po red/ rjes su yang bskyar gros dgos byung na gang du bros/ nga tsho bod rigs tshang mas rang gi pha yul du bde bar 'khod rjes yang bskyar gros mi dgos pa zhig da lta nas bsam blo gtong dgos/ phyin chad bod du chos srid lugs gnyis kyi srol bzang de dar rgyas yun gnas yong ba zhig nges par du byed dgos/ yin na yang / da phan gyi lugs srol chos gzhis dang / sgor gzhis/ sde dpon mi drag mi ser dkyus ma zer ba la sogs pa'i rigs rtsa ba nas sgyur bcos byed dgos/ de yang rtsa ba bod rgyal khab stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas thabs dang / bod gzhung stobs dbang gnyis ldan du gyur thabs gzhi rtsar bzung dgos/ rgyal khab ste ba phra tshugs tshags tshud cig byung na/ sger chos mi mang dang bcas pa shugs kyis drod 'gro ba yin/ dper na/ 'bras spungs la chos gzhis rgya che thag cho da yod pa dang / de dag 'bras spungs dge 'dun bdun stong bdun brgya rang la 31

sha khu sha thim dngos gnas byungayod na khong tsho'i 'tsho ba rgyun gtan de las bzang ba tan tan yong srid/ 'on kyang don la ga 'dra yod min khyed tsho las sne rnams nas shes gsal ltar lan 'debs byed dgos/chos gzhis chos gzhis zer te 'gan lci mdog bshad pa ma gtogs/don snying shag tshang 'ga' zhig gam/ sger khag la bsgril yod pa sogs kyi skyon gnad mang po zhig ngos kyis snga sa nas mthong ba dang / gzhan yang dgos pa mang wa'i slad ched mngags legs bcos spyi tshogs gsar du btsugs payin/'on kyang rgya dmar gyi g.yo thabs btsan shugs che ba'am/ gang ltar nus pa thon pa zhig byung ma song / thog ma'i re ba dang / dmigs yul gyi gnad 'khel ba zhig byung ma song / rang re bod la ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas thabs dang / mi mang la bde skyid 'byung thabs kyi rtsa ba bod gzhung phra tshugs tshags tshud yong thabs la 'bad dgos pa las/ gzhung zhabs rdzig po dang / gyon gos mchor po/ gzhung gi mdzad sgo gra rgyas po dang brel zing che bas phan pa gang yang med/ gdan sa so sor cha mtshon na yang / bstan pa dar rgyas byung dang ma byung dge 'dun pa rnams kyi thos bsam slob gnyer dang / kun spyod la rag lus pa las/ grwa tshang khang tshan gyi sgo 'phyor rdzig los dang / gos rnying ma'i ka 'phan dang / gser zangs kyi rdzi par yag yos la rag lus pa min/ bar lam nga tsho'i gzhung 'di dngos gnas gser zangs kyi rdzi par rang byas 'dug mdor bsdus te bshad na/ da phan rang tshor nyams myong mang po zhig byung yod/ 'di dag sems la bzhag nas phyin chad bod chos ldan rgyal 32

sha khu sha thim dngos gnas byungayod na khong tsho'i 'tsho ba rgyun gtan de las bzang ba tan tan yong srid/ 'on kyang don la ga 'dra yod min khyed tsho las sne rnams nas shes gsal ltar lan 'debs byed dgos/chos gzhis chos gzhis zer te 'gan lci mdog bshad pa ma gtogs/don snying shag tshang 'ga' zhig gam/ sger khag la bsgril yod pa sogs kyi skyon gnad mang po zhig ngos kyis snga sa nas mthong ba dang / gzhan yang dgos pa mang wa'i slad ched mngags legs bcos spyi tshogs gsar du btsugs payin/'on kyang rgya dmar gyi g.yo thabs btsan shugs che ba'am/ gang ltar nus pa thon pa zhig byung ma song / thog ma'i re ba dang / dmigs yul gyi gnad 'khel ba zhig byung ma song / rang re bod la ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas thabs dang / mi mang la bde skyid 'byung thabs kyi rtsa ba bod gzhung phra tshugs tshags tshud yong thabs la 'bad dgos pa las/ gzhung zhabs rdzig po dang / gyon gos mchor po/ gzhung gi mdzad sgo gra rgyas po dang brel zing che bas phan pa gang yang med/ gdan sa so sor cha mtshon na yang / bstan pa dar rgyas byung dang ma byung dge 'dun pa rnams kyi thos bsam slob gnyer dang / kun spyod la rag lus pa las/ grwa tshang khang tshan gyi sgo 'phyor rdzig los dang / gos rnying ma'i ka 'phan dang / gser zangs kyi rdzi par yag yos la rag lus pa min/ bar lam nga tsho'i gzhung 'di dngos gnas gser zangs kyi rdzi par rang byas 'dug mdor bsdus te bshad na/ da phan rang tshor nyams myong mang po zhig byung yod/ 'di dag sems la bzhag nas phyin chad bod chos ldan rgyal 32

khab kyi bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab srid gdugs dkar yug gcig gi 'og tu/ 11da rigs skye bo smos ci/ sems can phal pa zhig yin yang /rang dbang bde skyid bzang po'i 'tsho bar ci dgar longs su spyod bzhin ngal gso rgyu sku da pa zhig da lta nas thabs shes byed dgos pa yin/ da phan thongad du srid don gyi shes tshad ma ldengs pa'i skyon byung ba lta bu zhig 'dug nga tsho rgya gar du sdod rgyun ring rgya gar gyi legs cha ldan pa'i srid dang / bcos bsgyur gyi las don la slob sbyong dang do snang byed dgos/ bod du rjes su mtha' gcig tu rgya gar gyi srid lugs gtsang ma lag len dgos pa med/ legs pa'i cha rnams rang gi sngar lugs bzang po dang bsdeb chog pa yin/ de lugs tshang mas sems bzhag byed dgos/ nga tshos mi re gnyis kyi bde skyid dang / mi re gnyis kyi dka' sdug gcig bur ma bsam par bsam rgya chen po dang / blo gu yangs po byed dgos/ nga tshos da phyin chad 'gyod pa mi yong ba zhig nges par byed dgos/ nga tshos sems sbug dog po dang / sdug bsngal chen pos rtag tu ngu bzhin bsdad pas phan pa med/ nga tsho bod pa tshang ma chos la dad pa byed mkhan sha stag yin pas dus rtag tu byams dang snying rje/ las 'bras bcas tshul bzhin yid la bzung ste/ rkyen ngan grogs su 'gyur ba sogs kyi blo sbyong thabs byed dgos/ lto 'grangs nyi ma drod tshe chos pa'i gzugs/ rkyen ngano thog tu babs tshe tha mal pa/ zer ba de 'dra min pa zhig cis kyang byed dgas/de ring 'dir ngos nas gnas lugs mang tsam zhig bshad pa khyed tshos 33

khab kyi bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab srid gdugs dkar yug gcig gi 'og tu/ 11da rigs skye bo smos ci/ sems can phal pa zhig yin yang /rang dbang bde skyid bzang po'i 'tsho bar ci dgar longs su spyod bzhin ngal gso rgyu sku da pa zhig da lta nas thabs shes byed dgos pa yin/ da phan thongad du srid don gyi shes tshad ma ldengs pa'i skyon byung ba lta bu zhig 'dug nga tsho rgya gar du sdod rgyun ring rgya gar gyi legs cha ldan pa'i srid dang / bcos bsgyur gyi las don la slob sbyong dang do snang byed dgos/ bod du rjes su mtha' gcig tu rgya gar gyi srid lugs gtsang ma lag len dgos pa med/ legs pa'i cha rnams rang gi sngar lugs bzang po dang bsdeb chog pa yin/ de lugs tshang mas sems bzhag byed dgos/ nga tshos mi re gnyis kyi bde skyid dang / mi re gnyis kyi dka' sdug gcig bur ma bsam par bsam rgya chen po dang / blo gu yangs po byed dgos/ nga tshos da phyin chad 'gyod pa mi yong ba zhig nges par byed dgos/ nga tshos sems sbug dog po dang / sdug bsngal chen pos rtag tu ngu bzhin bsdad pas phan pa med/ nga tsho bod pa tshang ma chos la dad pa byed mkhan sha stag yin pas dus rtag tu byams dang snying rje/ las 'bras bcas tshul bzhin yid la bzung ste/ rkyen ngan grogs su 'gyur ba sogs kyi blo sbyong thabs byed dgos/ lto 'grangs nyi ma drod tshe chos pa'i gzugs/ rkyen ngano thog tu babs tshe tha mal pa/ zer ba de 'dra min pa zhig cis kyang byed dgas/de ring 'dir ngos nas gnas lugs mang tsam zhig bshad pa khyed tshos 33

mig chu mang po gtong ba mjong nas nga yang sems pa skyo 01 byung / nga tsho mig chu dbang med shor dgos pa'i gnas tshul thabs sdug po ji tsam byung ba de tsam gyis sems shugs bskyed de snying nas 'bad brtson mi ltod pa zhig nges par du byed dgos/ de ring ngas 'dir zhus pa rnams khyed tshos brjed med lag len du 'khel ba mdzad rgyur ngos rang yid ches yod/ 7rgyal ba rin po che ḍa la ha'o ser phebs nas mang spro zhig gsung ni gsungs song zer ba lta bur ma song bar chos byas nas rgyud dul ba dang / gnad bsam ste don du 'khyol ba zhig byed dgos/ngos nas kyang de ring gi snang tshul 'di nam yang mi brjed pa byed kyi yin/ zhes bka' 455// //34

ra༅༅// spyi lo 1960 zla 7 tshes 1 nyi na/ ḍa la ha'o se'i bod mi ser skya mi mang spyi nas zhus ngor/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mchon chen pa mchog nas sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang bka' drin che thob rjes/ mi mang ser skya yongs la bka' slob stsal ba/1) deng sang nga rang tsho rgya gar khul slebs pa'i bod mi ser skya drag zhan pho mo tshang mar skabs babs mdun lam re gtan 'khel ba dang / lam de thog brtan por 'gro dgos/ da lta'i dus 'dir yang nge yeng nge'i dbang du song na mi 'grigs/ nges par du lding 'jags gtan chags pa zhig byed dgos/nga tsho bod rigs ni gzhan dang mi 'dra ba chos kyi bsam blo dang ldan pa yin/ nga tsho'i pha yul bod kyang chos dar ba'i lung pa zhig yin stabs thun mong ma yin pa'i lta bzo yod/ 'dzam gling yul gzhan gyi bde ba la ha las dgos don med/ dper na/ a mi ri ka dang / u ru su la sogs par srid dang /dpal 'byor dar rgyas che ba/ lhag para.a mi ri sha'i mi mang che ba rnams don dam rang dbang ldan la lto gos sdod khang sogs gang nas phun sum tshogs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dpal 'byor 'byung khungs kyang gdengs 'khel ba yod pa de lta na'ang 'ga' shas 'tsho gos gang ci nas legs po yod ba zhin du rang shi rgyag pa sogs kyi gnas tshul yong gi yod cing / de ni bsam blo'i bde ba btsal rnyed ma thub pas lan pa yin/ 'jig rten kho na ma gtogs/ chos kyi go ba ma rnyed pa'i skyon red/ chos pa rnams la ni phyi rol gyi bde ba med kyang /nang sems nyid bde bar gnas thub pa'i khe bzang yod/ tshe 'di la sems 35

bde rdzod du 'jogs thabs yod pa ma zad/ tshe phyi mar yang don gyi bde ba thob thabs yod/ tshang mas legs par bsam thub na 'di phyi gnyis /ra don dag chen po 'grub rgyu yod/rang re bod la ni snga rabs chos rgyal tsho'i sku dus nas chos srid lugs gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i goms srol bzang pos bod du chos ji ltar dar ba dang /srid kyi phyogs nas rgya gar dang / rgya nag yul du'ang dbang thang khyab pa'i lo rgyus 'dzam gling na grags nas yod/ bod ni chos srid lugs gnyis srol bzang gi lo rgyus rlabs che la gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i rgyal khab cig yin pa ma zad/bod yul sa rgya che la/ mtho sar gangs kyis mdzes pa/ dma' sar rtsi shing lo tog gang yang yod pa/ thon khungs bzang ba/ rang bzhin mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ rang tsho tshang ma'i sems chags pa/ sus kyang blos gtong ma phod pa'i lung pa skyid po/ phun sum tshogs po zhig red/ 'di la zhen khog mi byed mkhan bod mi su gcig kyang med/ nga tsho'i pha yul mthun rkyen 'dzoms wa de da lta thob thang rtsa ba nas med pa gzhan zhig gis btsan shugs kyis bdag tu bzung ste/ nga rang sto nang mi lte ba mang che ba ni kho tsho'i bran g.yog tu bcug ste mi spyod las 'das pa'i gdug rtsub chen po'i byed stangs kyis dud 'gro las kyang dkas sdug che ba'i ngal las la bkol ba dang / mang po zhig ni kho tsho'i mtshon cha dang / btsan po'i khrims 'og tu bsad dang gsod bzhin pa/ nga rang tsho gang 'tshams shig ni rang yul dang bral nas yod/ nga tsho 'di lta'i tshul du sdod thabs rtsa ba nas med/ da 'o na/ nga tshos gang byed dgos zer 36

na/ ngas sngon nas rim par bshad pa lta ra bod 'dir chos dang srid/ dpal 'byor gang gi thad nas rang btsan zhig len dgos pa de yin/ de ni nga tsho'i las 'gan yin/ nga tshos las 'gan 'di bsgrub 'os pa dang / nges par du bsgrub dgos pa/ bsgrub thub pa zhig yin/ deng sang 'dzam gling gang sar lung pa gang zhig la lung pa gzhan zhig gi mi rigs nas btsan 'dzul dang /lung pa de'i mi rigs kyi rang dbang la gnod pa'i bya ba bcas la ngo rgol gyis mi rigs sger langs kyi sems shugs dang las 'gul nyin re bzhin je rgyas je 'phel du 'gro mus dang / 'di la drang bden la dga' ba'i 'dzam gling mi mang nas rgyab skyor byed bzhin pa red/ der brten nga tshos kyang rang tsho bod rigs rang dbang rang btsan gyi mtha' ma'i bden pa'i rgyal kha ma thob bar sems shugs ma chags pa'i las don rgyun mthud de byed dgos pa ni gal gnad shin tu chen 11 zhig yin/khyed tshos bsam blo thongs dang / nga tshorwa 1da mi mang po rgya ga ra khul bros yong don yang rang gi srog 'go thon tsam gyi ched du ma yin/ tshang mas rang yul bod de rang dbang slar gso'i ched du sems shugs bskyed de dka' ngal la ma 'dzem par yong ba red/ der brten nga tshos lha sa nas yin yang rung /rang gi bod lung pa gang 'dra zhig nas 'di phyogs gom pa dang po spos yong skabs kyi sems shugs de brtan po/ zhig rgyu med pa/ ha cang gi mkhregs po/ gtor kyang 'thor mi thub pa zhig cig kyang byed dgos/ gnad don de bod rigs ser skya/ pho mo/ rgan gzhorme+on/ mtho dma'/ drag zhan tshang mas snying po sems 37

kyi gting nas rtag tu brjed med dran pa byed dgos/nga tshos bod rang btsan bskyar du len dgos zer ba 'di gnam gyi char pa sgug pa ltar bsdad pas mi phan/ dka' thub 'bad brtson rgyun bstud kyis sgrub dgos/ da lta nga sto thabs sdug gi gnas su gyar yod kyang / bod rang btsan lon thabs de bsgrub bya'i dam bca' snying por bzhag nas kha sa kha'i nyin bshad pa ltar chos kyi thog nas thabs sna tshogs byed pa dang / srid kyi thog nas thabs sna tshogs byed dgos/ de dag tshang ma ji bzhin lag len du bstar na don dam bod rang btsan la phan pa yin/ mtha' na khyod tshos khrus gtsang ma brgyab pa tsam yang bod rang dbang rang btsan la phan/ bod kyi bstan pa chab srid la phan gyi yod/ gang lags zer na rang gi lus khams bde ba dang /dbang po gsal ba/ phyi rgyar mi gzhan nam/ phyi rgyal gyi mi'i mthong snang du bod pa 'di dzor po btsog pa min pa/ grung po/ yin mdog kha por mthong nas rang tsho bod mir cha 'jog dang brtsi mthong chen po byed kyi red/ bod pa mi gcig yin yang ngo lag ma bkrus par bsdad na pha rol po'i mthong snang du bod pa 'di tshos rang btsan ji ltar lon/ mtha' na khrus kyang brgyab mi shes pa lta bu'i mthong snang byung ste rang tshor cha 'jog dang brtsi mthong mi byed pa'i nyen ga yod/ deng sang 'dzam gling gang sa nas rang tshor do snang chen po byed mus yin gshis tshang mas rtag tu nyal langs sgur gsum gang gi skabs su'ang bod rang dbang rang btsan/ bod bstan srid spyi don la phan gnod ji byed bsam blo nan tan gtong dgos/ ngos nas bltas na bod mi phru gu zhig gi spyod pa'i 38

kyi gting nas rtag tu brjed med dran pa byed dgos/nga tshos bod rang btsan bskyar du len dgos zer ba 'di gnam gyi char pa sgug pa ltar bsdad pas mi phan/ dka' thub 'bad brtson rgyun bstud kyis sgrub dgos/ da lta nga sto thabs sdug gi gnas su gyar yod kyang / bod rang btsan lon thabs de bsgrub bya'i dam bca' snying por bzhag nas kha sa kha'i nyin bshad pa ltar chos kyi thog nas thabs sna tshogs byed pa dang / srid kyi thog nas thabs sna tshogs byed dgos/ de dag tshang ma ji bzhin lag len du bstar na don dam bod rang btsan la phan pa yin/ mtha' na khyod tshos khrus gtsang ma brgyab pa tsam yang bod rang dbang rang btsan la phan/ bod kyi bstan pa chab srid la phan gyi yod/ gang lags zer na rang gi lus khams bde ba dang /dbang po gsal ba/ phyi rgyar mi gzhan nam/ phyi rgyal gyi mi'i mthong snang du bod pa 'di dzor po btsog pa min pa/ grung po/ yin mdog kha por mthong nas rang tsho bod mir cha 'jog dang brtsi mthong chen po byed kyi red/ bod pa mi gcig yin yang ngo lag ma bkrus par bsdad na pha rol po'i mthong snang du bod pa 'di tshos rang btsan ji ltar lon/ mtha' na khrus kyang brgyab mi shes pa lta bu'i mthong snang byung ste rang tshor cha 'jog dang brtsi mthong mi byed pa'i nyen ga yod/ deng sang 'dzam gling gang sa nas rang tshor do snang chen po byed mus yin gshis tshang mas rtag tu nyal langs sgur gsum gang gi skabs su'ang bod rang dbang rang btsan/ bod bstan srid spyi don la phan gnod ji byed bsam blo nan tan gtong dgos/ ngos nas bltas na bod mi phru gu zhig gi spyod pa'i 38

cha shas tsam gyis kyang bod rang btsan gyi don la phan gnod chen po 'brel gyi 'du ga pas de lugs tshang mas sems bcangs gzab gzab byed dgos/2) chos kyi stor gtso che ba phyag dpe gzigs mkhan rnams nas yang dag pa ston pa shākya thub pas gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'di rang gis 'dzin cing gzhan la rgya cher spel te 7rgyal bstan rin po che yun ring du dar khyab yong thabs sgo kun nas mdzad dgos/ kha sang zhus pa ltar/ de ring 'dir yang bskyar nan tan gyis zhu rgyur/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa 'dir mi rigs dang / sa khul/ pho/ mo/ ser skya sogs kyi dbye ba gang yang med/ gang gis kyang chos la gzhug chog pa dang / gsang sngags skor sogs dmigs bsal 'ga' re ma gtogs gang la'ang khyab spel chog pa yin/de nas dam pa'i chos la gzhug mkhan ni rang re bod rigs gcig pu min/ dam chos dar spel gyi yulayang rang re bod yul gcig pu min/ yun ring du gnas thabs bcas kyi rtsa ba'i 'gan khur yang nga tsho bod mi ser skya pho snun ze bas nang pa yongs la yod/ bod mi kun gyis gnas dus 'di lta bu'i tshul la legs par bsam ste/ rang re pha tshe bu rabs nas srog las gces par 'dzin pa/'di phyi rang gzhan thams cad la gtan du bde legs 'byung ba'i gzhi rtsagacig pu dam chos rin po che rang gis tshul bzhin du 'dzin pa la shin tu gzab dgos pa ma zad/ dus 'dir phyi rgyal du khyab spel thub pa'i go skabs bzang po'ang stong zad du mi 'gro ba zhig cis kyang mdzad dgos/ 'on kyang nga tshos chung rim nas ston pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i thabs la brten nas pha rol po'i yid chos 39

su phyogs thabs byed dgos/ mdor na rang re bod rigs byis pa yan gyi spyod tshul zhi dul khrims ldan dang / gtso che ba nang chos kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rig pa'i khungs dang ldan pa'i tshul gsal bar bstan pa'i sgo nas phyi rgyal mi rigs kyi yid dbang chos phyogs su 'gugs thabs byed dgos pa las/ nga tsho'i nang chos ni ha cang gi legs po zhig yin/ khyed kyis nang chos byed dgos zhes rang bzhin lkug pa.u tshugs kyi bya bas phan nus ci yang ston mi thub khar/des ni phan tshun gnyis gnod yong rgyu las med/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang chos bzhin rang gis mdzad pa dang / de bzhin gzhan la ston pa tsam las/ mtha' gcig tu dam pa'i chos la zhugs dbotos kyi btsan po mdzad med/de mtshungs dngul dngos kyis chos la bskul ma yang mdzad med/ ston pa rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzad spyod ngo mtshar can dag gis phyi nang skye bo'i yid dbang kun nas 'phrog ste rang bzhin dad gus mortos pa chen pos ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan par ngam ngam shugs kyis zhugs pa'i rnam thar bzhin/rang res kyang sngon byung ston pa'i mdzad pa bzang po rang gis lag len ci thub bkal te tshang mas spyod pa tshul mthun du gnas dgo sa pa ni deng skabs gal gnad chen 1rdzo/ gal gnad ha cang gi chen po yin/ rang cag thams cad kyis kun spyod rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas ston pa'i chosayang dag yin pa'i rtags dang /dge mtshan gsal bar ston dgos/ de ltar thub na pha rol pos thog ma do snang byed pa dang / bar du the tshom gyis brtag pa/ mthar yid ches kyis ma bskul dwang bas kun nas bslangs te dam pa'i chos la don gnyer byed pa 'ong nges/ de 40

ltar byung na spyir ma gyur sems can spyi don rgya cher sgrub thub pa dang / yang sgos rang tsho'i da rdzi dmigs yul gcig pu bod rang dbang rang btsan bskyar gso dang / chos srid lugs gnyis bzang po dar khyab yun gnas 'byung bar khyad gnad shin tu chen po yod/nga chos rang gi chos lugs kyi lta ba dang dam tshig brtan por bzung thogachos lugs gzhan dag la'ang brtsi bkur dang / sbyang brtson don gnyer byed dgos/ ngos rang snga lo rgya gar khul gnas mja la du bskyod skabs lhan rdi'i lha khang dang / ye shu'i chos khang sogs mjal te gzan 'bebs dang bcas gus 'dud zhus pa dang / chos pa 'ga' zhig dang chos kyi skor bgro gleng yang byas pa yin/ khong tsho'i chos yang dag yin min gang ltar yang / 'dzam gling 'dir chos la dad pa yod med bsdur skabs chos gang zhig la dad pa ldan pa de legs pa dang / chos de dag la rig pa'i 'gro lugs kyi legs cha'ang yod/nga tshos rang gi chos lugs kyi thun mong min pa'i khas len rigs gzhan la gdams par ngo tsha dang / zhum pa byed dgos gang yang med/ rang re'i chos ni rig pa yang dag gi khungs dang ldan pa yin/ 'on kyang rig lam gyi sgo sngon chad grwa sa'i nang brjod rgyun 'char can kho na bzung bsdad pas mi 'grigs/ rang res phyi nang snod bcud gang na sa zhib gsal khungs gtugs bya rgyu yod rung / pha rol po'i 'dod tshul ji yod nga tshos rtogs par byas te/de nas pha rol brjod babs kyi gnad dang bstun te rang lugs 'dod tshul gdams mkhas pa byung na gzhi nas pha rol po'i rna ba dang / yid la 'jug che 41

ba yong rgyu/ dper na/ stod kyi bkod pa chags stangs la rang tsho'i snga rabs nas gzhung las gsungs pa'i 'dod tshul dang mi 'dra bar/ deng 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyi mthong tshul la da lta rang cag gnas pa'i 'dzam gling 'di nyid kyi bkod pa ni sa zlum po hril hril zhig yin par 'dod/ yin na'ang 'di la nga tsho ya mtshan rgyu gang yang med/ ston pas kyang ri rab la sogs pa snang tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig gsungs yod/ mngon pa mdzod dang dus 'khor gnyis kyi gsung tshul mi 'dra ba ma zad/ gnam sa steng 'og go ldog tu gnas pa'i 'jig rten dag kyang yod ces gsungs yod/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten/ de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten/ zhes kyang gsungs sku(da pas/ phyag dpe gzigs mkhan tshos nges par du dathotongs pa rgya che tsam bzhes te/ rang lugs kyi gzhung gang yang rung ba zhig rtsa bar bzungs pa'i sgo nas skabs babs/ 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyi mthong tshul dang 'gal ba med pa'i khas len 'gro lugs shig 'tshol dgos pa yin/ de yang rtsa ba gzhung zhig gi dgongs par brten pa'i thog rigs pa yang dag gi khungs gsal bar ston thub pa zhig dgos pa las/ gzhung las 'di gsungs dang / mkhas pa gang zhig gi dgongs pa yin zer ba'i lung 'dren tsam la.u tshugs kyi thod pa bstan na pha rol wa'i rna bar 'jug po mi yong / rgyun du rang res rje rin po ce'i dgongs pa yin no zhes bshad nas zha 'bud byed pa dang 'brel de rang yin no zhes khas len byed na'ang / mi tshos de ltar mi byed/ des na rig lam kho na la brten rgyu ma gtogs med pas/ rang res dngos 'brel rang tshugs zin thub pa'i 42

ba yong rgyu/ dper na/ stod kyi bkod pa chags stangs la rang tsho'i snga rabs nas gzhung las gsungs pa'i 'dod tshul dang mi 'dra bar/ deng 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyi mthong tshul la da lta rang cag gnas pa'i 'dzam gling 'di nyid kyi bkod pa ni sa zlum po hril hril zhig yin par 'dod/ yin na'ang 'di la nga tsho ya mtshan rgyu gang yang med/ ston pas kyang ri rab la sogs pa snang tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig gsungs yod/ mngon pa mdzod dang dus 'khor gnyis kyi gsung tshul mi 'dra ba ma zad/ gnam sa steng 'og go ldog tu gnas pa'i 'jig rten dag kyang yod ces gsungs yod/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten/ de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten/ zhes kyang gsungs sku(da pas/ phyag dpe gzigs mkhan tshos nges par du dathotongs pa rgya che tsam bzhes te/ rang lugs kyi gzhung gang yang rung ba zhig rtsa bar bzungs pa'i sgo nas skabs babs/ 'dzam gling spyi yongs kyi mthong tshul dang 'gal ba med pa'i khas len 'gro lugs shig 'tshol dgos pa yin/ de yang rtsa ba gzhung zhig gi dgongs par brten pa'i thog rigs pa yang dag gi khungs gsal bar ston thub pa zhig dgos pa las/ gzhung las 'di gsungs dang / mkhas pa gang zhig gi dgongs pa yin zer ba'i lung 'dren tsam la.u tshugs kyi thod pa bstan na pha rol wa'i rna bar 'jug po mi yong / rgyun du rang res rje rin po ce'i dgongs pa yin no zhes bshad nas zha 'bud byed pa dang 'brel de rang yin no zhes khas len byed na'ang / mi tshos de ltar mi byed/ des na rig lam kho na la brten rgyu ma gtogs med pas/ rang res dngos 'brel rang tshugs zin thub pa'i 42

brjod stangs mkhas pa zhig byung na dus skabs 'di ra bstan pa la zhabs 'degs chen po 'grub par 'gyur bas de lugs khyed rnam pas blo dang rig rtsal 'gran pa'i thugs spobs skyed dgos/phyag dpe gzigs mkhan blo gsar rnams kyis hin rdi dang / dbyin ji'i skadayig kyang nges par du slob sbyong bya dgos/ da phan bod du ston pa sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo de rang rigs nang khul nas don rtogs nyams len thub pa tsam gyis 'grigs pa lta bu yin kyang / da skabs de 'dra min la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che ni bod tsam min par/ 'dzam gling rgyal khab yongs la dar khyab dgos pa dang / dar khyab byed 'os pa zhig yin/ dam pa'i chos kyi don zab mo yang dag pa 'di dag bod rigs gcig pu min par/ mar gyur sems can thams cad kyis nges par du rtogs dathoges pa zhig yin/ des na dpe cha ba tshos bod kyi 'gro lugs dang / bod du bsam blo'i 'khyer phyogs de kho na'i dbang du ma song bar dus bstun bsam rgya che bskyed kyis phyi rgyal khag tu ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i phra tshugs thabs la 'bad dgos/ 'di yang bod rang dbang rang btsan slar gso dang / lugs gnyis zung 'brel gyi srol bzang mi nyams gong 'phel 'byung thabs kyi don gnad gal che zhig yin/rang cag bod mi rigs gong rim nas dga' zhing brtsi bkur gces 'dzin byed pa'i chos srid lugs gnyis bzang po nyams med dar khyabayun gnas 'byung phyir bsam blo rgya che tsam dang / thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas ma 'ongs pa'i grabs gshom legs par byed dgos/ da nas nga tshos bod du grwa tshang yas mas 43

kyi yig cha mthun min tsam la'anga.u tshugs byed pa'i bsam sdug dog po de bzhag ste nang khul smos ci/ phyi rgyal chos lugs gzhan dag la'ang chos kyi 'brel ba rgya cher bya dgos/ skabs re rtsa ba'i khas len mi mthun pa yong rgyur de dus khyod dang / nga zhes brjod pas gtan nas mi 'grigs/ khas len mi mthun pa'i tshul ji tsam byung ba de tsam du grogs wa'i rnam 'gyur je bzang gi thog nas/da phan bod du rig pa'i 'gro stangs ji yod thog da dung rig rtsal gyis kha bsgyur te 'gro lugs gsar pa ston 'os rtsod bsdur bdar sha gcod dgos/khyed rnam pas yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / dbang lnga'i shes pa/ sems byung rgyu 'bras kyi 'gro lugs/ dbang shes/ yid shes kyi bya ba byed tshul lam/yul la 'jug tshul sogs la sbyong bdar rtsod bsdur zhib nan zhig mdzad dgos par bsam/ dper na/ gzhi me tog lta bu zhig thog mar mig gi dbang shes kyis ji ltar 'jal lugs/ yul dbang rnam shes gsum gyi 'brel ba'i skor/ skad cig gnyis pa na yid kyi shes pas 'jal lugs ji 'dra yin pa/ de so sor mtshungs ldan gyi tshor ba skyes stangs/ yid gzugs la 'jug bzhin pa'i skabs rna shes kyis sgra zhig thos kyang snang la ma nges par 'gro bas de skabs dbang shes de gnyis dang / yid shes kyi 'brel ba'i gnas stangs sogs 'di 'dra'i rigs la dngos yod kyi nyams myong dang bsdebs te gung 'grigs po zhig bshad na'ang dge mtshan chen po yod/deng phyi rgyal tshan rig pa tshos gzugs kyi gnas lugs phra ba rtogs kyang shes pa'i gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs pa dka' bas/ 'di ni chos kyi rig 44

pas sgrub dgos payin/ 'on kyang rang re chos pa tshos mngon pa sogs nas 'di ltar gsungs so zhes lung bgrangs pa tsam gyis mi 'grigs/ rig pas bsgrubs te mthun snang ba'i gnas tshul la gtugs nas khungs skyel dgos/rgya gar ba dang / phyi rgyal khag gi rogs ram la brten nas deng 'dir dpe cha ba tshos chos 'chad rtsod byed rgyu'i dus skabasa'ade thog tu khyed rnam pas blo rgya che tsam dang / blo rgya gsar pa zhig gis rig pa'i rtsal bton te dus bstun gyi chos yang dag par 'chad pa dang / rtso da pa la 'bad brtson gnang na dus rabs nyi shu pa'i skabs kyi dpe cha ba'i mtshan don mtshungs la/ nang pa'i chos ni rigs pa khungs dag dang ldan pa ngo 'phrod de/ pha rol pos rang cag bod rigs spyi dang / bye brag chos lugs slob gnyer ba rnams la brtsi mthong je cher 'gro rgyur bod kyi spyi don la'ang phan khyad shin tu che ba yod/ gzhan dag gi brjod tshul la/ rang res sngo ser dkar dmar sogs kha dog 'dra min sna tshogs —pa zhig mthong skabs/ de re re mthong ba'i nus pa rtsa yi byed pa las byung zer/ mi stong phrag gi nang nas gal te ljang khya mthong ba'i mig rtsa ma tshang ba des kha dog ljang khu nam mthong skabs ser po mthong ba sogs kyi gnas tshul yod zer/ dbang shes dbang po dngas ma la brten/ dbang po dngas ma de dbang rten khog pa la brten te yod pas rtsa gang zhig ma tshang ba na 'gyur ba yong srid/ de rigs la nga tshos bsam zhib rtsod bsdur nges par byed dgos/lus sems gnyis las lus mthong snang du yod pas rtogs sla zhing /sems kyi gnas lugs chos las rtogs pa 'di thad la rang res gzhung las 45
