gsungs tshul spyir btang tsam du bzhag pas mi 'grigs/ don du ji ltar sgrub tshul dang / gzhung dang / gzhan dag gi mthun snang dngos po'i dbar 'gal ba mchis min/ 'gal zla ji ltar sel thabs sogs la legs par bsam zhing ston mkhas pa zhig dgos/ skabs 'di dag la sngags kyi sgor nas rlung sems kyi 'gro lugs phran bu bsnan rgyu byung na phan thogs dge mtshan chen po yod/yang rig pa rgyun chad med pa'i gnad kyis skye ba snga phyi yod par 'grub lugs de gal che bas sna tshogs pa'i rigs pa'i lam nas ji ltar sgrub pa legs pa dang / mthun snang ba'i dngos por ji ltar gtugs na legs pa rtsod pas bdar sha bcad de gung 'grigs po 'chad thub pa bcas ni shin tu gal che bar mthong /rang re'i mchos kyi mthar thug pa'i lta ba'i skor zab cing gsal la yang dag pa yod mes/ deng 'tham gling tshan rig pas kyang rten 'byung khas len byed kyi yod/ go skabs 'di bzung ste rten 'byung gi rnam gzhag ci mang brjod dgos/ 'di ltar rigs mthun du gyur pas rang rer rogs sdon yang byung ba yin/ 'on kyang brjod lugs thad stong gzhi gang zag gi steng nas bshad na rnyogs phra che bas/ phyi chos bum pa lta bu gzhir bzung na kun gyis rtogs sla ba'am/ shes bde ba yin/ thog ma phyag dpe bzang ba'am/ rig rtsal che ba tshos gtan 'bebs kyi gzhi ma zhig btsal te zin thor bkod/ de dag dge bshes drag gras rnams nas zhib brtag rtsod bsdur gyis yig zin jog gtan 'bebs gnang dbesas/46

deng sang nga mos gnad yod kyi nang pa'i chos 'ga' zhig hin rdi dang /dbyin ji'i yi ger bsgyur dang sgyur bzhin pa yin/ khyed tshos gzhung dang mi 'gal bar rig pas sgrub pa'i 'dod tshul gsar pa phyogs bsgrig thub mtshams phyi rgyal gyi yi ger bsgyur chog 'di ltar byed thub na phyi rgyal du thon mkhan tsho la phan thogs lhag par che bas khyed rnam pas phyi bshol du ma song ba'i thog nas nyin gcig dgos pa'i dus der bton chog gi gra sgrig da lta nyid nas phyag len du 'khel ba zhu rgyu yin/ gang lags zer na/ mtshan nyid pas blo rtsal gyi rtsod bsdur gtan 'bebs mdzad pa'i yig cha gang yin khungs btsan gnad du 'khel ba yin/ dper na/ gad bdar zhib nan bgyi sa pa'i 'bras dkar zhing gtsang la/ shun pa dang / rdo phye med pa/ dri ngan dang bral bas bro ba che zhing / lto bar 'ju bde ba/ lus kyi stobs rgyas par sman pa ji bzhin dge mtshan khyad par can spoged/ mtshan nyid kyis gzhung la bdar sha ma bcad pa'i gzhung gi go ba bzang mdog rnam dpyod che mdog gi nyams dang ldan na yang za zir 'a cadal tsam las/ gtsang mar bsgrub thub pa shin tu dka' ba yin/dge bshes dpe 'khrid gnang mkhan rnams nas kyang rang gi gzhung lugs gzhi rtsar bzung ste/ rig pa gsar pa'i 'gro lugs kyi sgo nas blo gsar ba rnams kyi rig pa'i rtsal 'gran du 'jug 'os pa las/ blo gu dog a 'thas byas pas mi phan/ gzhon pas rigs pa'i lam nas brtag cing rtsod pas sgrub dgos/ bgres pas de la zhib brtag nan mthar mdzad de gnad dkrol/mthar bgres gazlogen tshang mas rigs pa tshad mas dpyad de gtan la 'bebs 47

deng sang nga mos gnad yod kyi nang pa'i chos 'ga' zhig hin rdi dang /dbyin ji'i yi ger bsgyur dang sgyur bzhin pa yin/ khyed tshos gzhung dang mi 'gal bar rig pas sgrub pa'i 'dod tshul gsar pa phyogs bsgrig thub mtshams phyi rgyal gyi yi ger bsgyur chog 'di ltar byed thub na phyi rgyal du thon mkhan tsho la phan thogs lhag par che bas khyed rnam pas phyi bshol du ma song ba'i thog nas nyin gcig dgos pa'i dus der bton chog gi gra sgrig da lta nyid nas phyag len du 'khel ba zhu rgyu yin/ gang lags zer na/ mtshan nyid pas blo rtsal gyi rtsod bsdur gtan 'bebs mdzad pa'i yig cha gang yin khungs btsan gnad du 'khel ba yin/ dper na/ gad bdar zhib nan bgyi sa pa'i 'bras dkar zhing gtsang la/ shun pa dang / rdo phye med pa/ dri ngan dang bral bas bro ba che zhing / lto bar 'ju bde ba/ lus kyi stobs rgyas par sman pa ji bzhin dge mtshan khyad par can spoged/ mtshan nyid kyis gzhung la bdar sha ma bcad pa'i gzhung gi go ba bzang mdog rnam dpyod che mdog gi nyams dang ldan na yang za zir 'a cadal tsam las/ gtsang mar bsgrub thub pa shin tu dka' ba yin/dge bshes dpe 'khrid gnang mkhan rnams nas kyang rang gi gzhung lugs gzhi rtsar bzung ste/ rig pa gsar pa'i 'gro lugs kyi sgo nas blo gsar ba rnams kyi rig pa'i rtsal 'gran du 'jug 'os pa las/ blo gu dog a 'thas byas pas mi phan/ gzhon pas rigs pa'i lam nas brtag cing rtsod pas sgrub dgos/ bgres pas de la zhib brtag nan mthar mdzad de gnad dkrol/mthar bgres gazlogen tshang mas rigs pa tshad mas dpyad de gtan la 'bebs 47

dgos/ gdan sa'i mkhan po las zur rnam pa'ang 'di dag lhan du rtsod grar zhugs te rig pa'i nying khu thon pa zhig tshang mas thugs khur che bzhes gnang dgos/yang / rgyud pa tshos kyang rgyun tshogs gal cher rtsis te rtsod grar the gtogs mi gnang ba'i rigs min par/ gal che go bstun gyis rtsod grar zhugs dgos/ spyir grwa sa'i chos gra'i nang mdo rkyang pa rtsod sbyangs byed pa yin na'ang /skabs 'di lta bur sngags rgyud sde gong 'og nas kyang lung rig gi rtsal 'gran dbe|sa/ dgos pa che bas mi rung ba min par sems/rtsod gra gong nas gong 'phel gyis thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i yang dag pa'i rigs pa gtan la 'bebs pa'i dus babs kyi las 'gan 'di gal gnad chen por brtsis te/ brtson shugs rgyun bstud snyugs bsrings kyis sgrub dbotos/ rgyud pa'i mkhan 11 mkhan tshab gnyis nas kyang 'gan khur bzhes te thams cad go bsdur mnyam nub gnang dgos/ de yang nyin ltar min rung 'grigs/ bdun phrag re'i nang lhan gros go bsdur thengs re tsam gnang dgos/dpal ldan zla ba grags pas lta ba'i skor rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang / 'jig rten tha snyad 'gal ba med pa zung 'brel du ston pa ltar/ gzhung dang / 'gal med mthun snang la 'jug pa'i rig pa'i 'gro lugs zab cing gsal ba zhig gtan 'bebs gnang rgyur khyed rnams tshang mas thugs khur zab bzhes cis kyang gnang rogs/ ngos rang dha ram sa lar phyir bskyod kyis khyed rnam pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'bras bzang myur du smin pa'i smon 'dun re sgug 48

dgos/ gdan sa'i mkhan po las zur rnam pa'ang 'di dag lhan du rtsod grar zhugs te rig pa'i nying khu thon pa zhig tshang mas thugs khur che bzhes gnang dgos/yang / rgyud pa tshos kyang rgyun tshogs gal cher rtsis te rtsod grar the gtogs mi gnang ba'i rigs min par/ gal che go bstun gyis rtsod grar zhugs dgos/ spyir grwa sa'i chos gra'i nang mdo rkyang pa rtsod sbyangs byed pa yin na'ang /skabs 'di lta bur sngags rgyud sde gong 'og nas kyang lung rig gi rtsal 'gran dbe|sa/ dgos pa che bas mi rung ba min par sems/rtsod gra gong nas gong 'phel gyis thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i yang dag pa'i rigs pa gtan la 'bebs pa'i dus babs kyi las 'gan 'di gal gnad chen por brtsis te/ brtson shugs rgyun bstud snyugs bsrings kyis sgrub dbotos/ rgyud pa'i mkhan 11 mkhan tshab gnyis nas kyang 'gan khur bzhes te thams cad go bsdur mnyam nub gnang dgos/ de yang nyin ltar min rung 'grigs/ bdun phrag re'i nang lhan gros go bsdur thengs re tsam gnang dgos/dpal ldan zla ba grags pas lta ba'i skor rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang / 'jig rten tha snyad 'gal ba med pa zung 'brel du ston pa ltar/ gzhung dang / 'gal med mthun snang la 'jug pa'i rig pa'i 'gro lugs zab cing gsal ba zhig gtan 'bebs gnang rgyur khyed rnams tshang mas thugs khur zab bzhes cis kyang gnang rogs/ ngos rang dha ram sa lar phyir bskyod kyis khyed rnam pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'bras bzang myur du smin pa'i smon 'dun re sgug 48

zhu rgyur de lugs kun gyi dgongs par 'jags dgos/rjes su khyed tshos grub 'bras gang thon pa de dag bod yig thog gtan 'bebs dgos pa lta ci smos/ lhan rdi dang / dbyin ji'i yi ge sogs su'ang bsgyur spel byed dgos/ de ltar thub na gzhi nas ḍa la ha'o ser bod kyi bla ma dge 'dun bzhugs yod pa dang / de dag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang / blo stobs rig rtsal/ gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i gnas tshul rnams gsal bar mngon te/ rgya dmar nas bla ma gra pa zhes ci yang mi shes pa'i za 'dre zer ba'i dkrog gtam shugs kyis 'gog pa dang / gzhan dag la'ang 'di lta'i log rtogs yod rigs rang bzhin dag sel du gyur nas/ 'dzam gling phyi nang kun nas mthong dang cha 'jog brtsi bkur yong rgyur ngos rang yid ches yod/ 'di ltar byung na bod rigs yongs la phan pa dang / 7rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag bod kyi bstan pa chab srid la phan pa yin/ snying po bod chos ldan rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan bskyar gsor don gyi phan pa chen po zhig 'grub pa yin/yang ngos nas gal che nan tan gyis zhu rgyur/ rang cag tsho'i nang gi rtogs pa ji yin sus kyang shes par dka'/ spyi'i spyod pa bzang ngan ni kun gyi mthong snang mngon gsal du yod par brten bod mi spyi dang / lhag par bla sprul dge 'dun pa rnams nas phyi'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa zhig mdzad rgyur thugs snang che skyed rgyun bsrings gnang dgos/ gong du zhus pa ltar/ dpe cha ba gzhon rigs rig rtsal che ba tshos lhan rdi dang / dbyin ji'i skad yig kyang zhor slob byed dgos/ de'i steng rim pas 49

sam skri ta'i skad yig slob sbyong byed gal/ dpe cha ba tshos gzhan gyi skad yig sbyangs te rjes su nang pa'i chos kyi gnad don phyi rgyal gyi yi gor bsgyur thub pa dang / chos lugs gzhan gyi rig pa'i gnad rnams bod yig tu bsgyur thub pa bcas la don gnyer gyis mig rgyangs ring por blta ba dang / blo rgya che bskyed byed dgos/ 'ga' zhig nas rang gi chos don ji bzhin rtogs na 'grigs pas phyi rgyal gyi skad yig slob pa'i dgos pa cher med bsam srid/ de ni bsam blo sbug srub dog pa'i skyon yin/ ston pa thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos cha tshang ba yang dag pa ni nga tshor yod pas bod gangs can pa'i skye bo rnams thar pa dngathams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob thabs tsam la mgo bo 'khor bas mi 'grigs/ 'di tsam gyis bstan pa rgyas shing yun ring du gnas par dka' ba da cha rang cag bod mi rnams kyi myong thog tu byung ba 'di ltar yin/da cha bod mi ser skya su 'dra yin rung / chos srid gang gi thad la rang mgo gang thon dang / rang phyogs gcig pya bsam pa'i blo sbug dog po de rigs rtsa ba nas sgong dgos shing / tshang mas nges par du blo rgya che tsam dang / spyi don sems shugs kyi nus pa che bskyed kyi ngang nas kha nas spyi brjod pa de bzhin don la spyi 'grub pa zhig cis kyang dgongs par 'jags dgos/3) kha sang ngos 'dir 'byor ba'i nyin mo der khams dang / a mdo'i bro gzhas dang / lha mo'i gzigs 'bul byung ba 'di la dga' po byung / gang yin zer na/ 'di la gnad chen po 'dug de sngon bod du yin na bro dang lha mo 'khrab pa de snang ba skyid skyid la brtsis kyang / 'dzam gling nang zlos gar zhes 50

lung pa so so'i bro dang / glu gar 'khrab pa'i thabs shes la brten nas yul so so'i mi rigs kyi sems shugs dang / shes rigablo stobs/ spyod tshul/ goms gshis sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gsal bar ston gyi yod/ 'dir khyed tshos bro dang / lha mo'i sgrig 'dzugs bzos pa 'di yag po byung 'dug ngos kyi sems su'ang zlos gar gyi sgrig 'dzags shig nges par du dgos par bsam gyi spongad/ ༄da res khyed tshos bro dang lha mo 'khrab pa de yag po 'dug da dung yar rgyas 'gro thabs byed dgos/ dper na/ phyi'i rnam 'gyur mdzes pa'am/ gang 'khrab pa de de bzhin rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin dgos/ phyi rgyal zlos gar ba tshos kyang da phan rang cho bod pa'i lha mo ji bzhin gang byung gad mo dgod pa dang /bzhad bgad rigs byed kyi mi 'dug de bzhin chas gos kyang 'a 'ub 'dus la ma 'dus de 'dra min par/ gang gyon pa de de bzhin 'jug po zhig dgos pa yin/ zlos gar de gang gnad chen po yin stabs nga tshos yar rgyas nges par du gtong dgos/ dper na/ nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi snying stobs dang /rig gzhung spyod tshul goms gshis sogs khyad chos ji yod 'dzam gling thog dril sgrags byed stangs yig thog rkyang pa ma yin par bod kyi zlos gar yag po zhig sgrig btsugs kyis de thog nas kyang bod kyi gnas tshul gsal po rtogs thub pa'i dril bsgrags chen po byed thub kyi red/'dir ngas shod rgyu zhig la/ da phan phyi rgyal gyi ri mo khag la bod pa zhes tshang ma lung khug 'grog pa sha stag yin pa lta bus bod mi stod hrang ba/51

g.yag dang / lug 'ded bzhin 'gro ba de 'dra ba mang che bas rang re bod kyi zlos gar ba sogs la'ang 'di lta'i skyon mi ཿnga ba zhig nges par byed dgos/tshang mas shes gsal bod mi tshang ma 'brog pa ma yin/ bod mi tshang ma rjes lus thebs pa ma yin/ bod du 'dzam gling gzhan gyi rjes zin pa'i 'tsho thabs dang / 'dzam gling gzhan gyi blo tshad ldan pa'i bod pa mang po yod/ nga tsho mi rigs kyi thad nas 'dzam gling gzhan la zhum dgos pa med/ 'dir khyed tsho'i da yod kyi bro gar skyid sdug khag khag 'di 'dra min par/ tshang ma gcig tu bsgril te sgrig 'dzugs che tsam zhig bzos/ de'i thog nas bod kyi yul phyogs dang / lung tshan 'dra min so so'i zlos gar 'khrab thub pa zhig dgos/ dper na/ a mdo bas dbus pa dang / gtsang pa'i glu gar 'khyab thub pa/ khams pas kyang de bzhin/ dbus pa gtsang pa sogs kyis kyang a mdo dang / khams khul sogs kyi glu gar 'khrab thub pa dang / de min stod pa dang / byang pa/ to pa sogs thode kyi lung tshan gzhan dag gi glu gar 'khrab thub pa byung na phan jogs che/ nga tshos gang byas kyang lung tshan dang / sa khul phyogs khag byed pa de skyon chen po 'dugatshang mas bsam bloyag po zhig thongs dang / nga cho tshenag rtsa gcig bsgril gyi thog nas bod rang dbang rang btsan yon thabs la 'bad brtson byas dang byed bzhin du da dung nga tsho dang / kho tsho ༄ra ba sogs kyi 'then 'khyer byed pa'i rnam rtog ngan pa de bslangs nas dgos pa dge mtshan ci yod/ da dung ched mngags nang kha mi shis pa bzo ba lta bu kho dbus pa/ nga gtsang pa/ khyod 52

khams pa/ mo.a mdo ba/ kho tsho sku drag nga tsho mi mang / zhwa sgab pa'i phyogs gtogs/ g.yu thog gi phyogs gtogs/ shar gyi shog khag nub kyi shog khag zer ba la sogs pa'i dkrog gtam mang po zhig bshad de tshang ma khrag 'khrug bzos nas gang yong / bod mi su yin rung bsam rgyu gcig ma gtogs gzhan rtsa ba nas yong shes stangs med/ da ni nga bod pa yin snyam pa'i bsam blo tan tan ma btang na shin tu ngo tsha ba dang / khrel gzhung gtan nas med pa zhig rang red/tshang mas bsam blo thongs dang / nga rang tsho sha khrag gcig pa'i nang mi khri phrag mang po rgya dmar nas bsad pa dang / rmas skyon btang ba/ de bzhin shi rkyen byung ba/ btson la bcug pa bcas kyi gdong la tshang mas yag po zhig ltos dang / nga tshos da lta bod du dmyal ba nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba zhigaci myong bzhin pa'i bod rgya che'i mi mang re re'i gdong la yag po zhig tos dang / khong tshos lus srog blos btang gis bstan pa dang / bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi zhabs 'degs zhus pa de'i bka' drin de nga tshos gsab dgos pa ma yin nam/bod chol kha gsum gyi khongs gtogs mi mang byings la shod dgos pa gang yang med/ tshang ma phyag 'tshal 'os pa dang / dga' ba'i gnas sha stag red/ spyir btang bod mi ser skya mtho dma' drag zhan pho mo thams cad yag po/ bsam pa dag pa sha stag red/ 'on kyang shes tshad mtho ba dang / las byed pa'i khongs gtogs re zung nas bstan pa 'go bshig byed pa mthong gi 'dug da dngos gnas bsam blo tan tan gtong dgos/ nga tshos bod rang dbang rang btsan 53

gyi don du srog dor ba rnams kyi ched du bsngo ba dang / smon lam rgyun du byed khul byas kyang / don ngo ma'i thog tu khong tsho 'das po'i bsam pa 'grub pa zhig byed dgos/ de da phan byas dang ma byas/ phyin chad byed dang mi byed khyed rnam pas dgongs pa nan tan zhig bzhes dgos/nga'i bsam par da lta'i gnas tshul 'di las sdug tu mi 'gro ba'i re ba yod/ nga tsho snga lo rgya gar du 'byor skabs zla ba kha shas rjes nas bod du log rgyu'i bsam blo gtong mkhan yang byung yod/ da cha 'di khul lo gcig song ba'i nyams myong nas nga tshos gnas tshul gsal po mthong gi yod pas sems shugs ma chag pa'i sgo nas kha gtad gcog dgos/ slar yang 'gal rkyen yong srid rung bya ba thams cad byed pa po kho nar rag lus pa yin/gong bshad ltar rgya che'i mi mang rnams shin tu legs/ de bzhin khur byed po mang che ba'ang bsam pa dag pa zhe gcig yin yang / 'ga' zhig gis blo chung 'dra min sna tshogs shig byed pa de ga 'dra zhig yin nam/ gnas tshul 'di ga 'dra zhig 'dug gam/nga tshos bod rang btsan bskyar du len dgos pa dang / bod gzhung 'di mtshan nyid tshang ba'i gzhung yin pa dang / bros byol du yong ba'i bod gzhung 'dis bod mi mang mu mthud 'go 'khrid byas te nga tsho nad kyi bden pa'i mtha' gsal thub pa'i re ba byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang byed stangs 'di 'dra yin na 'byon pa 'dug gam/ 'gro dgos pa'i lam du ma phyin par kha nas ci drag ci drag zer ba 'di yang dgod bro ba'i gnas shig red/ dper na/ dge bshes shig 54

gis nga bdun phrag gcig gi nang lha ram dam bca' 'jog rgyu dang 'brelasang rim mtho po zhig len gyi yin zhes brjod de/ de'i ring sho sbag sogs rnam g.yeng kho nar mgo bo 'khor bzhin bsdad pa dang 'dra/nga rang tsho rgya gar du gros yong dgos ma byung gong bod a mdo dang /khams khul rang rang sa khul so sor mi mang pos srog blos btang gi lhag bsam gzengs su thon pa mang po byung yod pa ma zad/ deng skabs kyang bod nang rgya dmar la mu mthud 'thab 'dzings byed bzhin pa yin 'dugabod mi mang byings che ba tshos ni 'di 'dra'i dka' las rgyag dang rgyag bzhin pa red/ nga tsho'i las byed pa 'ga' zhig mthong skabs blo pham chen po yong gi 'dug spyi don la gcig bsgril gyis phan nus thon pa las/ mi re gnyis kyis phan nus mngon mi thub/bod spyi don 'di'i 'bras bu bzang ngan ji yong las byed rang la rag lus pa yin/ bod ser skya mi mang tshang mas ngos la re ba chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ngos rang la gang ci'i nus pa med kyang / bod mi mang 'di lta bu'i dka' sdug chen po'i thog 'dir ngos nas 'go 'don dgos pa zhig sngon gyi las la bkod pa ltar ngos nas kyang 'di mur blos gtong thabs rtsa ba nas med/zla shas kyi sngon du sbag sar dpe cha ba'i ming 'dzin mkhan gnyis 'khrug 'dzings kyis grwa gcig rkyen bsad btang 'dug nga tshos mi thug tshad la kha ker ker byas nas skad cha shod rgyu zhig la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa blos thongs kyi mi 'dug bstan pa phra tshugs dar rgyas kyi ched du sbag sar dge 'dun 1500 tham pa dmigs bsal gyis 'jog dgosa.u nan dang 'bad brtson 55

chen po byas pa yin/ da cha gra pas mi bsad pa'i gnas tshul thabs sdug byung ba red/ 'di gang 'drayin nam/ phyi rgyal mi la gdong ga 'dra byas nas bstan dgos/ dpe ma srid pa'i ngo tsha po/ bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren/ ga tshad bshad kyang nyan rgyu med pa 'di 'dra gang yin nam/ de bzhin ḍa la ha'o se 'dir yang mi gsod res thug med rung / gzhu res thug pa'i gnas tshul thabs sdug yod 'dug da cha nga tshos sngon chad tshar ba la bya thabs med/ 'on kyang nges par du dran dgos pa zhig yin/ da phan gyi nyams myong la bslabs/ ma 'ongs par nyams len ma 'phyugs pa'i sgo nas phyin chad don tshang yong ba byed dgosangos nas kha sang bshad pa ltar/ khyed tsho rgan pas lhag bsam yangs pa'i sgo nas las gra la gzhug thub pa zhig dang / gzhon pa chosas chos srid kyi 'jug sgo rnam pa sna tshogasal sbyangs te sems shugs che la gtsang ba'i ngang nas bod bstan pa chab srid kyi zhabs 'degs zhu thub mkhan/ nga'i rogs pa byed thub pa'i re ba yod/ rang gis thub na chos srid kyi las 'a gan gang yang khur chog pa yin/ 'di la pho mo dang / rus mtho dman/ skyid sdug bzang ngan/ser mo ba dang skya bo ༄ra ba sogs kyi khyad par gang yang med/ lcags bzo ba yin yang rung / sprang po yin yang rung / bod rigs shig yin phyin lta spyod rnam par dag pa la shes yon phun sum tshogs pa'i mtshan nyid ldan na de la ngos nas 'go 'khrid du bsko gzhag byed rkyang yin/ 'di ni ngas mi ser rgyal khab kyi lugs la bltas pa min/ ngas ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin lag len bstar ba yin/ ston pas rigs rus gtso bo ma yin/ sgrub pa gtso bo yin 56

chen po byas pa yin/ da cha gra pas mi bsad pa'i gnas tshul thabs sdug byung ba red/ 'di gang 'drayin nam/ phyi rgyal mi la gdong ga 'dra byas nas bstan dgos/ dpe ma srid pa'i ngo tsha po/ bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren/ ga tshad bshad kyang nyan rgyu med pa 'di 'dra gang yin nam/ de bzhin ḍa la ha'o se 'dir yang mi gsod res thug med rung / gzhu res thug pa'i gnas tshul thabs sdug yod 'dug da cha nga tshos sngon chad tshar ba la bya thabs med/ 'on kyang nges par du dran dgos pa zhig yin/ da phan gyi nyams myong la bslabs/ ma 'ongs par nyams len ma 'phyugs pa'i sgo nas phyin chad don tshang yong ba byed dgosangos nas kha sang bshad pa ltar/ khyed tsho rgan pas lhag bsam yangs pa'i sgo nas las gra la gzhug thub pa zhig dang / gzhon pa chosas chos srid kyi 'jug sgo rnam pa sna tshogasal sbyangs te sems shugs che la gtsang ba'i ngang nas bod bstan pa chab srid kyi zhabs 'degs zhu thub mkhan/ nga'i rogs pa byed thub pa'i re ba yod/ rang gis thub na chos srid kyi las 'a gan gang yang khur chog pa yin/ 'di la pho mo dang / rus mtho dman/ skyid sdug bzang ngan/ser mo ba dang skya bo ༄ra ba sogs kyi khyad par gang yang med/ lcags bzo ba yin yang rung / sprang po yin yang rung / bod rigs shig yin phyin lta spyod rnam par dag pa la shes yon phun sum tshogs pa'i mtshan nyid ldan na de la ngos nas 'go 'khrid du bsko gzhag byed rkyang yin/ 'di ni ngas mi ser rgyal khab kyi lugs la bltas pa min/ ngas ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin lag len bstar ba yin/ ston pas rigs rus gtso bo ma yin/ sgrub pa gtso bo yin 56

zhes bka' stsal yod/ 7rgyal bas chos phyogs su 'di ltar gsungs pas na/ ngos nas srid phyogs su de bas kyang rigs rus mi gtso ba dang / las ka gtso ba zhig nges par du byas chog pa yin/ de rtsis tshang mas blo rgya che tsam dang /blo phyags ring tsam zhig nges par du byed dgos/ don med sems sbag dog po byas pas phan pa gang yang med/ de nas skad yig dang / lag shezlo sogs la slob sbyong hur brtson rgyun mthud du byas te/ dus tshod don med 'phrog brlag tu mi 'gro ba zhig nges par du byed dgos/bud med tshos kyang nang gi a ma kho na byed snyam pa'i bsam chung de rtsa ba nas spangs te/ ngas mi gzhan dang 'dra bar chos srid kyi las don la gzhug thub pa byed bsam pa'i blo stobs bskyed dgos/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang chos phyogs su so thar nas byas na bud med kyis dge slong sgrub chog pa'i thob thang yod cing / byang sems dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis rkar yang bud med gzhug mi chog pa'i dbye ba med/ gang ltar tshang mas bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi chab srid rgyas thabs la dus rtag tu khur brtson chen po byed dgos/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar gnas dang / mi mang bde bar 'khod phyir chos srid kyi 'du byed po gtso bo gzhung 'di rang yin/ gzhung 'di phra tshugs gtan gnas ma byung na snga lo nga tshor gang byung ba bzhin gzhung bde 'jags su ma gnas pa'i dus su sger la lta bzo gang yang med pa 'di byung / de lugs tshang mas gzhung don tshags tshud gong 'phel yong thabs kyi khur 'gan len dgos/ngas bsam spyod gang 'dra zhig gis gzhung gi zhabs 'degs zhu bsam pa byed 57

dbetas/yang / 'dir ngos nas phyin chad 'gyod rnyog mi 'byung ba'i ched du dmigs bsal gas/la bshad byed rgyu zhig la/ su yin yang rung / 7rgyal bstan chab srid dgung du 'degs pa'i lhag bsam rgya che gtan du nyams len brjed med byed dgos kyang / rang rang khur du babs pa ma yin pa'i byus med byus 'khri'i dkrog rkyen bzo ba de la ngos rang gting nas dga' po med/ de don thams cad kyi sems la bzhag nas rtsa ba'i dam bca' bod rang dbang rang btsan lon thabs kyi bsgrub bya phra mo nas bre gsog phul gsog byed dgos pa don gyi snying po yin/4) zlos gar skor zhib pa gong du bshad zin pa ltar gcig bsgril gyi sgrig 'dzugs shig chags thub pa byed dgos/ ser skya khyad med tshang mas las don rlabs che chung gang sgrub kyang gcig tu bsgril thabs gtso bor byed dgos/ hob ste bltas na gra pas lha mo 'khrab pa mi 'grigs par bsam pa yong srid/ 'di la spyir btang chos kyi thog nas dgag bya yod na yang / skabs 'dir dgos pa che bas skyon med/ dgag bya dang / dgos pa'i khyad par phye nas spangs blangs byed dgos pa 'di'i gnad kyis byang chub sems par gzhan don du lus ngag gi las bdun gnang yod/ 'ga' res chab bdag maces rgyan bya byed mang bas lha mo 'khrab kyi 'dug zer ba sogs kyi gnas tshul yong srid/spyi bye'i dbo(sa par dmigs pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te lha snum 'am/zlos gar/ gzhan dag lag shes bzo las skor dge 'dun pas skabs bstun 58

dang zhen gnang bar 'gal ba med / de lta na'ang / nges par bsam khra'i 'khyer 11 yag po zhig dbetas gal che ba yin/'dzam gling skye bo tshang mas rang lus rang gis 'degs thub pa byed mus ltar/ nga rang cho rwagud pas kyang tshang mas rang gi nus shugs gangayod bton te rang 'go thon thabs la 'bad brtson rgyun mar byed pa dang / phyogs gcig nas dkon mchog gi thugs rje/ phyogs gcig tu bslu med las 'bras kyi bden pa'i rgyab tu 'dzam gling gzu bor gnas pa'i 7rgyal khab dang mi mang gi rgyab skyor rogs ram thob ste/ mtha' ma'i rgyal kha nga rang tsho rang la thob rgyur ngos rang yid ches dang / gdengs stod yod/ mdor bsdus na/ yul dang / dus stod/ gnas tshul tshang ma brjes pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang res kyang rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba'i bsam blo gsar pa zhig btang ste gang dang gang gi thad la'ang sems shugs gang che byed dgos/ nges par du bsam rgya chen po byed dgos/de nas gal gnad che shos shig la/ nang khul phyogs zhen 'then 'khyer spangs te/ don gyi dam tshig gtsang ma zhig yong thabs nges par byed dgos/gong smros ltar/ nang gtsang ma dgos pas ma tshad/ phyi yang gtsang ma dgos/ngo lag nyin ltar 'khru ba dang / chu yang yang brgal/ gos hrul po zhig las med kyang bkrus te gtsang ma gyon/ sdod sa'i khang pa phyi nang gad phyis dag po byed pa/ de bzhin zas rnying pa min pa/ gsos pa dus thog so sor za ba dang /stod dang za btung gi rigs la sbrang bu mi 'khor ba byed dgos/ gang yin zer 59

na/ sbrang bu'i lus la dug dang nad yod pa dang / de 'brel 'bu'i rigs la'ang do snang chen po byed dgos/ bod dang mi 'dra bar 'bu'i nang dug can mang po yod/ gal te 'bu zhig la lag pa 'chang dgos byung na lam seng gtsang mar bkru dgos/ de nas zas tshod ran por za ba ma gtogs/ bod du ji bzhin gang byung rgyag tshad bzas na mi 'grigs/ nga tshos tsha yul du zas ljid po rgyags tshad bzas na lus la gnod pa las phan pa med/ za tshad nyung la zas dus mang tsam byas pa legs/ 'dir ngas nga tshor nyams myong byung ba zhig bshad na/ rang dzaḥgra lam bsang ba 'ga' shas nas gro zhib la sogs pa'i zas ljid po za tshod ma shes pa dang / rnying pa bzas pa'i rkyen gyis nad phog pa byung yod/ de rtsis khyed tshos gzab gzab byed dgos/ nga rang tshor bod rang dbang rang btsan skyar du yon thabs kyi sems shugs ji tsam yod kyang / lus po thang thang med na dka' las khag po red/ khyed tsho tshang mas gzugs por gces spras lhod med byed dgos pa ni gal gnad chen po zhig yin /nga tshos rang mi gcig kyang na mi dgos pa dang / shi mi dgos pa zhig nges par du byed dgos/ nga ni bod mi ga 'dra zhig la nad phog pa dang / shi ba'i gnas tshul mjong thos byung skabs snying la tsher ma zug pa lta bu bzod dka' ba dang / yid skyo blo pham ha cang gi chen po yong gi 'dug bod mi gcig shi yang bod spyi don la skyon du gyur song bsam pa'i phangs sems shin tu che ba 'dug rgyu mtshan ni da cha bod chol kha gsum gyi bod mi rigs gtsang mar gnas shing 'tsho thub pa ni nga tsho rgya gar dang / bal yul sogs su 'byor ba 'di tsam 60

na/ sbrang bu'i lus la dug dang nad yod pa dang / de 'brel 'bu'i rigs la'ang do snang chen po byed dgos/ bod dang mi 'dra bar 'bu'i nang dug can mang po yod/ gal te 'bu zhig la lag pa 'chang dgos byung na lam seng gtsang mar bkru dgos/ de nas zas tshod ran por za ba ma gtogs/ bod du ji bzhin gang byung rgyag tshad bzas na mi 'grigs/ nga tshos tsha yul du zas ljid po rgyags tshad bzas na lus la gnod pa las phan pa med/ za tshad nyung la zas dus mang tsam byas pa legs/ 'dir ngas nga tshor nyams myong byung ba zhig bshad na/ rang dzaḥgra lam bsang ba 'ga' shas nas gro zhib la sogs pa'i zas ljid po za tshod ma shes pa dang / rnying pa bzas pa'i rkyen gyis nad phog pa byung yod/ de rtsis khyed tshos gzab gzab byed dgos/ nga rang tshor bod rang dbang rang btsan skyar du yon thabs kyi sems shugs ji tsam yod kyang / lus po thang thang med na dka' las khag po red/ khyed tsho tshang mas gzugs por gces spras lhod med byed dgos pa ni gal gnad chen po zhig yin /nga tshos rang mi gcig kyang na mi dgos pa dang / shi mi dgos pa zhig nges par du byed dgos/ nga ni bod mi ga 'dra zhig la nad phog pa dang / shi ba'i gnas tshul mjong thos byung skabs snying la tsher ma zug pa lta bu bzod dka' ba dang / yid skyo blo pham ha cang gi chen po yong gi 'dug bod mi gcig shi yang bod spyi don la skyon du gyur song bsam pa'i phangs sems shin tu che ba 'dug rgyu mtshan ni da cha bod chol kha gsum gyi bod mi rigs gtsang mar gnas shing 'tsho thub pa ni nga tsho rgya gar dang / bal yul sogs su 'byor ba 'di tsam 60

red/ rang re'i gces pa'i phayul bod du rang rigs bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams ni rgya dmar gyis 'gro ba mi'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i gdug rtsub can gyi khrims dang / mtshon cha'i 'og tu bsad dang gsod bzhin pa/ bod mir dud 'gro'i 'du shes tsam med pa'i mnar gcod dang / bod rigs rtsa med bzo phyir bod mi pho mo'i skye sgo bkag pa sogs da phan 'dzam gling lo rgyus thog byung dka' ba'i dmyal ba gson po myong bzhin pa 'di mur rim pas bod du rang rigs rtsa stongs su 'gro nyen dang / rang yul du bod mi rigs gtsang mar gnas dka' ba'i dus 'dir rgya gar khul sogs su snga rjes 'byor bsdad rang mi su rung gcig shi na'ang shin tu phangs po'i gnas tshul zhig ma red dam/ khyed tsho tshang mas bsam blo yag po zhig thongs dang / bod du yod pa'i nga tsho sha khrag gcig pa'i bod rigs rgya che'i mi mang nas nga tshor re ba gang 'dra bcol gyi yod dam/ nga tshos yid gzab ma byas par tshang ma nad pa dang / mang po shi skyon byung na ci byed/ nga tshos sngon tshud nas ma byung sngon 'gog gis gang sar yid gzab byed dgos/ nga tshor dgra bos 'di lta bu'i byed stangs ngan pa byung ba snying gi dkyil du bzhag nas gzab gzab rgyun bstud du byed dgos/ rang tshor rgya dmar dgra bos 'di lta bu'i byed stangs ngan pa byung ba 'di ni 'byung 'gyur bod rigs mi rabs phru gu'i phru gu rnams kyi sems nas kyang brjed thabs med pa zhig red/'o na bod kyi theg pa chen po'i chos nas bshad pa dang 'gal01 zhe na min te /nga chos rgya nag rgya che'i mi mang la brtsi bkur byed pa ma zad/ ma'o tse tung dang /kra'usan la'i sogs dang / krang ciya dang / than kon san sogs kyang nga 61

tshos gces pa'i mar bltas te blos mi gtong ba dang de dag byang chub kyi lam du 'god pa'i sems nges par bskyed dgos/ de min nga tshor mnar gcod gtong mkhan gyi dgra bo su 'dra zhig yin yang thar pa'i lam du 'god thabs byed dgos/ de lta na'ang / nga d+ku bzod pa de pha rol dzo byed spyod dang 'brel ba yod/ gal srid bzod sgom zhi 'jam gcig bus pha rol po'i gdug rtsub zhi thabs med na/ pha rol por phyags kyi gshode pa las skyob ched lam gzhan zhig 'tshol ba bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khrungs rabs khongs ded dpon snying rje can gyis dgos pa'i slad mi nag mdung thung can bsgral bar mdzad pa ltar nga chos nges par pha rol po'i byed spyod dang bstun ste/ 'byung pos rgyud brlams pa'i skye tho de dag la phugs kyi phan bde bsgrub ched de dang 'tshams pa'i las sgrub par 'gal ba med khar/ nges par du sgrub dgos pa yin/ de min rkyen dang 'tshams par tshar mi gcod ces byang sems kyi nyes byas 'byung bar gsungs yod/ 'on kyang nga tshos ci byas dus rtag tu rgyu'i kun slong snying rjes zin pa zhig nges par du byed dgos/ngosanas de ring brjod rgyu 'di tsamayin/ de ring 'dir nga rang tsho bgad rgyu/ ngu rgyu/ khong khro za rgyu sogs kyi dus skabs shig byung ba 'di la nga rang dga' po byung / de ring nga rang tsho 'dir 'dzoms te skad cha rdzod tsam shod rgyu byung ba'i go skabs bzang po 'di ni rgya gar gzhung mi mang dang bcas pa dang / phyi rgyal gzhan dag gi rogs ram la brten nas byung ba yin pas nga tshos khong tsho'i bka' drin dran dgos/62

ngos nas kha nyin bshad pa dang / de ring bshad pa rnams khyed tsho'i blo la babs na yig sgog bkod de bsam zhib gros bsdur byas na 'grigs/ ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis blang dor gyi gnad dkrol ste/ bslab bya mdzad nas sems can rnams thar pa'i lam bzang por 'god par mdzad pa ltar/ ngos nas bod rigs yongs rdzogs kyi 'go 'khrid de skabs su babs pa 'dir chos srid bsam spyod kyi gnas lugs gang 'tshams bshad pa 'di dag khyed chos sems la bzhag nas lag len du 'khel thub na bod spyi don la phan khyad chen po zhig yod nges yin/rang re'i bden pa'i mtha' gsal rgyu la'ang nges pa ci yod/ bde sdug thams cad ltos grubayin stabs nga tshor rkyen slo bur zhig dang 'phrad pa'ang srid/dper na/ sa phag lo smon lam chen mo'i skabs su bskal pa bzang po gang 'dra byung / ngos rang yang bshes gnyen dam pa'i bkrin gyis bag chags chen po zhig 'jog rgyu byung / yin na'ang de nas bdun phrag gcig gnyis song nas gnas tshul ga 'dra zhig byung ba red/ rgya dmar gyis nga tshor 'di lta bu'i sdug po/ don dam gyi drag gnon 'di 'dra slo bur yong snyam pa ngos kyi yid la med/nga rang tsho blo bur rgya gar khul 'di 'drar slebs yong bsam pa med pa zhig la slo bur du yong dgos byung ba red/ de bzhin rkyen smo bur ba zhig 'phrad srid/nges pa ci yod/ 'on kyang nga rang tshos jo jo bka' gdams pa tsho'i gsung sgros su mig rgyang bsring / blo rgya skyed/ khong srang lhod/ gsungs pa bzhin mig rgyang thung ngu min par rgyang ring por bltas/ blo rgya cher bskyed/ yid tshab 63

tshub spangs te blo bag phebs pa'i sgo nas chos dang srid kyi bya gzhag sna tshogs shig bsam pa dang / sbyong ba/ goms su 'jug pa bcas kyi gnas skabs dang /mthar thug gi spyi don rlabs che tsam zhig sgrub par tshang mas snying rus bskyed dgos/ da ring ngos nas 'dir mngags gtam cung zad cig byas pa 'di'i nang la phal cher don dag ma tshang ba med/ 'on kyang 'dul ba mdor bsdus bzhin du spang blangs kyi ldog 'jug mdor bsdus blo nges thub pa dgos/ khyed tshos 'di'i rgya las 'das pa'i gtam dang thabs byus bltas na me tog 'dra ba/ myang na sbrang rtsi 'dra ba/ reg na dar gos 'dra ba zhig yod kyang de la lam seng yid phyogs blo gtod kyi thal char ma song ba zhig cis kyang byed dgos/ de ring khyed tsho 'og nas spang gis 'khyags/ steng nas nyi mas 'tshigs rung / yun ring po 'di ltar sdod thub pa 'di ni rang gi rigs la snying nas brtse dung dang / rus zhen bcos ma min pa yod pa'i rang gshis gsal por mngon pa red/ 'di la nga rang yang dga' spro chen po byung /lam 'dir khyed tshos brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan ma phul gong nas ngas sngon la khas len byas chog 'di ni zhib pa'i rgyu mtshan gong du bshad pa ltar dus dang gnas tshul khag po 'di lta bu'i skabs su nga rang tsho mgo dang lus po ya bral du 'gro thabs gtan nas med/ ya bral du phyin yong bsam pa'ang nga'i yid la mi 'dug ngos rang lo 26 ma son bar bod jongs bstan srid kyi thad la rang 'dod khengs pa zhig ye nas ma byung / pha yul nas chung ngu'i skabs 64

7rgyal sa lha sar 'byor/ yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin can rnams bsten te rig pa'i gzhung la sbyangs/ lo na son ma son mtshams nas dus 'gyur gyi 'go tshugs/ de nas lo dgu lhag tsam ring la chos kyi thog nas dbang bskur lung 'khrid sogs gang 'tshams shig bag zon ci che dang 'brel bya rgyu byung ba las/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lugs bzang rang dbang du 'dzin skyong spel ba'i shugs nus bskyed thabs gangayang ma byung / phyin chad bod kyi rgyal bstan chab srid skye 'gro mi mang dang bcas pa'i dga' bde nyams pa sor chud/ legs spel dar rgyas kyi gzhi rtsa ma tshugs bar ngos bstan 'dzin rgya tsho'i tshe la skyon e byed bsam pa'i re ba 'dug de rtsis khyod tsho nga'i don la sems khral med par blo yid bde por gnas chog pa yin// //65

de༅༅// spyi lo 1960 zla 7 tshes 2 nyin/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mchon chen po mchog lha ma cal mnga' sde/ cam pa rdzong khul cam pa rgyal sa'i sa khul lam las byed mi btsan byol bod mi ser skya pho mo chig stong skor la 'tshams 'dri gzigs skor du chibs bsgyur gyis mi mang yongs la 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i gzungs sngags yi ge drug ma'i ljags lung smin stsol bka' drin che thog dus bstun skabs babs blang dor gyi bka' slob stsal ba/'di khul lam bzo ba'i khongs su dge 'a dun pa'ang mang po 'dug phal cher lha sa sogs nas chos 'brel thob myong ba sha stag yin gyi red/ de ring 'dir rang re tshang ma mi rnying pa/ yul gsar pa zhig tu slebs nas lo gcig tsam song thog khyod tshos dka' las rgyag bzhin pa'i dus skabs 'di 'dra zhig la nga tsho thug 'phrad byung ba 'di ni ngos rang dga' spro chen po byung / khag po dang / skyo po'i skabs su rang mi gang 'dra zhig dang thug kyang sems pa dga' po yong ba ltar/ khyod tsho yang dga' tshor chen po zung ba'i rnam 'gyur gsal po mngon gyi 'dugade ring ngas 'dir khyod tshor skad cha tshig kha shas shig shod 'dod byung /deng skabs cam pa khul lam las su yod pa'i bod chol kha gsum gyi sa khul khag mi 'dra ba'i btsan byol bod mi ser skya pho mo tshang ma yul gcig tu gnas/las rigs gcig byed bzhin pa/ lto zas kyang gcig gyur za mus ltar/ 'di khul nga tsho'i 'phral phugs spyi don la tshang mas sems shugs ma chag pa'i sgo nas 'bad brtson rgyun bsrings dgos/ gangs ri 'di brgyud kyi rgyab phyogs 66

na yod pa'i rang tsho'i pha yul mdzes shing gces zhen chog pa'i bod kyi jongs de thob thang dang / dbang cha gang yang med pa zhig gis dmag 'thab drag po'i btsan dbang gis bzung nas/ der yod rang re'i bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams bshas lug bshan pa'i lag 'og tu tshud pa dang khyad med kyi 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal nyin dang / bdun phrag zla ba tsam min par/ lo hril po hril por myong bzhin pa yin rung / rgya che'i bod mi mang rnams la rgya dmar nas khrims gcod drag gnon ji tsam btang ba de tsam gyis khong tsho'i sems shugs je cher gyur nas 'thab 'dzing ngo rgol byed bzhin thog bod rgya che'i mi mang gi snying gi dum bu tsho gcig gis rgya gar khul bros 'byor nga rang tshor nyin mtshan dus drug tu snying nas re ba chen po byed mus kyi gnas tshul gsal po nges gtan go thos byung / de rtsis rang res/ kyang snying stobs ma nyams pa'i sgo nas sems shugs gcig tu bsgril te bshas lug rnams bshan pa'i lag nas thar thabs sam/ rang tsho'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams sdug bsngal zad mtha' med pa'i dmyal ba las skyob thub pa zhig cis kyang byed dgos/ de'i phyir du nga rang tsho tshang mas rang rang skabs babs kyi las 'gan dka' ngal che chung gang yin rung de dag legs par 'grub ched sgo gsum nus shugs che bskyed kyis bsam blo rgya che tsam dang / bden pa'i mtha' gsal te gzhis byes yongs kyi dmigs yul 'grub rgyur yid ches kyi blo rtsa brtan po zhig nges par du byed dgos/da lta nga tsho gtso bo rgya gar gzhung mi mang dang bcas pa dang / phyi rgyal khag gi mi mang tshogs pa khag sogs nas bden rgyab blosags ram la brten nas 67

lto gos kyi dka' nyen che ba med/ 'tham gling btsan byol ba phal cher rang rang gang du bros byol gyi yul der rang gi lag shes gang shes de bstun gyi thon skyed khe las la zhugs nas rang gi 'tsho thabs 'khyol ba byed dgos pa dang / de min gnas skabs skyob gso swā ba ring bzo las lag shes slob sbyong sogs phugs yul 'tsho phan gyi las rigs sna tshogs la sbyong bdar byas te de nas rim pas gzhis chags ra nga mgo thon thabs byed kyi yod 'dug 'di khul 'byor pa'i rang re bod pa mang che ba ni so nam zhing las byed mkhan grong gseb pa dang /gzhan dag dmug mi dang / dge 'dun pa mang ba las/ lag shes pa de tsam bros thar med pa dang / rgya gar skusgogs rgyal khab gzhan gyi skad yig shes pa'ang shin tu dkon stabs gnas skabs lam las ma byed mthu med dang / de nas rim pas sa zhing so nam gyi las ka byas te gzhis chags thub thabs kyi 'char gzhi yod pa dang / dge 'dun pa'i thad la'ang thog mar chos lugs ris med kyi bla sprul dge 'dun sum brgya tsam zhig sa gnas gang 'os su tshogs chos slob gnyer gnang ste bzhugs 'thus las med kyang / nga tshos thabs shes ci nus byas mthar rgya gar gzhung nas dgongs bzhes bla med thob pa dang / rgya gar mi mang dang / phyi rgyal mi mang tshogs pa khag bcas kyis skyob gso'i rogs ram shugs che byung ste/ deng sang sbag sar sa dge bka' rnying gi bla sprul dge 'dun chig stong lnga brgya tham pa thos bsam slob gnyer la brtson bzhin bzhugs chog pa dang / de bzhin ḍa la ha'o ser yang rgyud grwa smad stod kyis mtshon chos lugs khag gi bla sprul dge 'dun mang po chos spyod thos bsam sgom sgrub la 68

lto gos kyi dka' nyen che ba med/ 'tham gling btsan byol ba phal cher rang rang gang du bros byol gyi yul der rang gi lag shes gang shes de bstun gyi thon skyed khe las la zhugs nas rang gi 'tsho thabs 'khyol ba byed dgos pa dang / de min gnas skabs skyob gso swā ba ring bzo las lag shes slob sbyong sogs phugs yul 'tsho phan gyi las rigs sna tshogs la sbyong bdar byas te de nas rim pas gzhis chags ra nga mgo thon thabs byed kyi yod 'dug 'di khul 'byor pa'i rang re bod pa mang che ba ni so nam zhing las byed mkhan grong gseb pa dang /gzhan dag dmug mi dang / dge 'dun pa mang ba las/ lag shes pa de tsam bros thar med pa dang / rgya gar skusgogs rgyal khab gzhan gyi skad yig shes pa'ang shin tu dkon stabs gnas skabs lam las ma byed mthu med dang / de nas rim pas sa zhing so nam gyi las ka byas te gzhis chags thub thabs kyi 'char gzhi yod pa dang / dge 'dun pa'i thad la'ang thog mar chos lugs ris med kyi bla sprul dge 'dun sum brgya tsam zhig sa gnas gang 'os su tshogs chos slob gnyer gnang ste bzhugs 'thus las med kyang / nga tshos thabs shes ci nus byas mthar rgya gar gzhung nas dgongs bzhes bla med thob pa dang / rgya gar mi mang dang / phyi rgyal mi mang tshogs pa khag bcas kyis skyob gso'i rogs ram shugs che byung ste/ deng sang sbag sar sa dge bka' rnying gi bla sprul dge 'dun chig stong lnga brgya tham pa thos bsam slob gnyer la brtson bzhin bzhugs chog pa dang / de bzhin ḍa la ha'o ser yang rgyud grwa smad stod kyis mtshon chos lugs khag gi bla sprul dge 'dun mang po chos spyod thos bsam sgom sgrub la 68

'bad bzhin bzhugs chog pa byung yod/ deng dus 'dzam gling spyi'i chos srid 'gro lugs gang du bsam yang 'di ni rang re bod kyi chos pa tshor gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal zhig thob yod/ 'di la nga tshos chog shes dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'phros bsdad 'dir yod la sogs pa'i dge 'dun byings nas gnas skabs lam bzo'i las /ra hur brtson gyi thog nas rim pas gzhis chags thub thabs dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ thon skyed kyi las ka zhig byas nas rang 'tsho thub thabs kyi dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ khyed tsho'i dgongs par dge 'dun pa yin yang las ka 'di 'dra byed dgos ha cang gi thabs dag gang drag dgongs srid kyang / bsam pa'i gra sgrig sdug sa nas byed dgos pa/ri/ gal srid nga tsho phyir log ma thub pa'am/ bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul thabs /gas byung na ci byed/ rkang pa h+pho sa lag pas bzo dgos zer ba ltar/phyin chad dus yun ji tsam 'gor yang rang mgo thon te 'tsho ba'i khungs 'khyol ba zhig ma byas par/ da mus bsam blo thung thung kho nara.u tshugs rgyab ste bsdad na rang la phugs gyong rag pa dang / bod spyi don la'ang mi phan pa ma zad/ rgya gar gzhung mi mang dang bcas pa dang / phyi rgyal mi mang la'ang ngo tsha ba mi 'dug gam/ gnas skabs khyed tshos lam bas6) las ka yang nus shugs thon pa byung na 'dis kyang bod spyi don la phan thogs yod/ de bzhin khyed tsho mi mang spyi dang /lhag par dge 'dun pa tshos lung khug red bsam pa'i spyod pa gang byung mdzad na mi 'grigs/ bod pa phru gu zhig gi spyod pa bzang ngan yang bod kyi bstan pa 69

chab srid dang 'brel ba yod/ dper na/ dge 'dun pa tshos da ni gra pa'i ba zo yang mi 'dug khyim pa dang mnyam du 'dres nas sdod dboges bsam pa sogs kyi bsam blo khyad mtshar btang na gtan nas mi 'grigs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bo'i 'gan de dge 'dun pa tshang mar yod/ dge 'dun pa tshos rang nyid gnas tshul bzang ngan gang 'dra zhig tu gnas kyang / rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bslab khrims dang dam tshig tshul bzhin srung dgos/'jig rten khyim pa dang mnyam du gnas pa tsam gyis dge tshul slong gi sdom pa stong gi ma red/ rtsa ba rang gi bsam blo la rag las pa yin/yang ngas gal che nan tan gyis zhu rgyur/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes pa de bla ma dge bshes dang / dpe cha ba gcig pu la rag lus pa ma yin/ grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i dge 'dun pa tshang mar 'gan yod/ rang tsho bod rigs ser skya pho mo tshang mar 'gan yod/ de rtsis tshang mas nang gi sems rnam par dag pa dang / phyi'i spyod pa tshul mthun gyi sgo nas bod mi'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos dge mtshan can rnams 'dzin thub pa byed dgos/ de byung na phyi nang kun nas mthong dang brtsi 'jog che ru btang ste bod rang dbang rang btsan bskyar du lon thabs la bden pa'i rgyab skyor rogs ram shugs che ru 'gro gi red/ der brten tshang mas 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gang gi skabs su'ang yid gzab nan tan byed dgos/ gang dang gang la'ang lhod yangs snang med du ma song ba zhig nges par du byed dgos/sngon du go thos dang / bar der lam bzo khag la 'tshams 'dri lta rtog 70

chab srid dang 'brel ba yod/ dper na/ dge 'dun pa tshos da ni gra pa'i ba zo yang mi 'dug khyim pa dang mnyam du 'dres nas sdod dboges bsam pa sogs kyi bsam blo khyad mtshar btang na gtan nas mi 'grigs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bo'i 'gan de dge 'dun pa tshang mar yod/ dge 'dun pa tshos rang nyid gnas tshul bzang ngan gang 'dra zhig tu gnas kyang / rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bslab khrims dang dam tshig tshul bzhin srung dgos/'jig rten khyim pa dang mnyam du gnas pa tsam gyis dge tshul slong gi sdom pa stong gi ma red/ rtsa ba rang gi bsam blo la rag las pa yin/yang ngas gal che nan tan gyis zhu rgyur/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes pa de bla ma dge bshes dang / dpe cha ba gcig pu la rag lus pa ma yin/ grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i dge 'dun pa tshang mar 'gan yod/ rang tsho bod rigs ser skya pho mo tshang mar 'gan yod/ de rtsis tshang mas nang gi sems rnam par dag pa dang / phyi'i spyod pa tshul mthun gyi sgo nas bod mi'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos dge mtshan can rnams 'dzin thub pa byed dgos/ de byung na phyi nang kun nas mthong dang brtsi 'jog che ru btang ste bod rang dbang rang btsan bskyar du lon thabs la bden pa'i rgyab skyor rogs ram shugs che ru 'gro gi red/ der brten tshang mas 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gang gi skabs su'ang yid gzab nan tan byed dgos/ gang dang gang la'ang lhod yangs snang med du ma song ba zhig nges par du byed dgos/sngon du go thos dang / bar der lam bzo khag la 'tshams 'dri lta rtog 70

tu btang ba'i gzhung zhabs nas gnas/ lugs brjod gsal bcas 'dir khyod tsho tshang ma mthun bsgril che ba dang / las phyod che ba yod pa/ de 'brel khyod tsho 'go byings dang / rgya gar las byed khag gis bar mthun lam yag po yod 'dug pa 'di ni ngos rang ha cang gi blo bde dga' spro chen po byung / slad kyang khyod tsho khyim pa/ nga tsho grwa pa/ kho tsho chu bzhi sgang drug kho a mdo/ nga khams pa/ mo gtsang pa/ khyod dbus pa zer ba sogs mgo ma 'tshos don ma go'i bsam blo ya mtshan btang / skad cha khyad mtshar bshad/ phyogs zhen yin khul gyi blo chung phan btags rigs 'dir khyod tshor dmigs bsal shod dgos med rung / phyin chad gang sa nas 'di lta'i skyon mi yong ba zhig sems bzhag byed dgos/ 'ga' zhig nas ha lama.a mdo dang / khams pa zer dus bod pa min pa tsam gyi bsam blo gtong gi yod bzo 'dug 'di ni nor 'khrul red/ nor 'khrul ha cang gi chen po zhig red/ nga.a mdo sa skyes rdo skyes kyi mi zhig yin/ nga bod pa red dam ma red/ a mdo ba yin yang rung / khams pa yin yang rung / gtsang pa yin yang rung / dbus pa yin yang rung / gzhan dag bod lung pa gang gi mi yin yang rung / tshang ma bod pa red/ tshang ma bod rigs red/ tshang ma mi rigs gcig rang red ma gtogs/ gzhan gyi 'dres lhad yod pa'i mi rigs gang yang ma red/ tshang ma bod rgyal khab gcig gi nang la 'tshar longs byas/ tshang ma skyid sdug mnyam gcig tu myong mkhan sha stag red/ tshang ma'i dmigs yul gcig rang red/ tshang mas bod chol kha gsum 71

gyi mi mang thams cad gcig bsgril gyi thog nas bod 7rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan bskyar du lon pa la 'bad brtson byed bzhin du/ yang 'ga' zhig nas nang khul dbye 'byed kyi byed stangs thabs rdugs lag len bstar te rtsa ba'i dmigs yul bod rigs spyi don gyi bsam blo mi gtong ba 'di rigs kyi nang don ji bzhin mgo 'tshos kyi mi 'dug khyod tshos 'di'i thad la go ba yag po zhig chags thabs byed dgos/yang lam las byas pa'i gla dngul byung ba rnams lam seng bstor brlag tu ma btang bar nyar gsog byed dgos/ bod lta bu 'bal dus skabs su lcag grims ma byas kyang ci skyon/ da cha yul dus gnas tshul la bsam ste lcag po grim po byas nas spyi sger tshang mar phra tshugs thabs shig byed dgos/ dper na/ khyod tsho lto tshang zhig la cha bzhag kyang / mi gnyis gsum lto tshang gcig byed pa de so so dka' las khag po'i thog la 'gro song che ba sogs skyon yod/ ngos kyi sems par tshang ma to tshang bsgril te/ me shing rkang gcig las med kyang bsags nas spyi sar gang phan ci phan gyis spyi pa gzhi rgya tshe tsam de 'dra gsar du phra tshugs thub na 'phral phugs kyi dka' las dang / nyen ga chung du 'gro gi red bsam pa 'dug nga ni bod pa mi bcu tsam zhig mnyam bsgril gyi thab 'tsho gcig phra tshugs thub kyang ha cang dga' po yong ba 'dug de las mang ba byung na ni los kyang da ga' /de nas/ nga tsho gcig byas na yun ring sdod mi dgos par rang gi 7rgyal khab tu mkhyodags 1rdzo log rgyu yong shas che/ yin na yang / bod du 'o1ga nas 72

sngar rgyun gzhi bzhag sku nga thabs rtsa ba nas med/ gang sa ci thad nas bsgyur bcos 'gro dgos/ lhag par rang gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab srid 'jin skyong gi thad la bsgyur bcos che tsam zhig nges par du dgos pa yin/ de rtsis khyod tshos deng skabs 'di khul spyi don 'grub thabs la nus shugs che bskyed dgos pas ma tshad/ phyin chad bod bstan pa chab srid kyi don la'ang khur bsam che bskyed byed dgos/ 'di la pho mo dang / ser skya/ skyes rus/ lung tshan sogasokyi khyad par gtan nas med/ tshang mar 'gan dang dbang cha yod/ blo snyings la sems shugs ma chag pa zhig nges par du byed dgos/ nges par du bsam blo rnying pa dang / gu dwog po min par/ blo rgya che tsam byed dgos/zla gcig tsam gyi sngon nas nga tshos dha ram sa lar 11da mi btsan byol bu phrug gasku/ lhadang khang gsar btsugs la bdag nyar byas pa'i phru gu rnams kyang bu dang bu mo skyes rus dang lung tshan sogs kyi dbye ba gang yang med par tshang mar gso skyong slob gso gcig gyur du byed bzhin pa yin/ bu phrug gso skyong khang 'di khongs 'byor ba'i phru gu lo dgu son pa yan khag gcig ma su ri shes rig slob grar btang ba yin/ da dung yang lo dgu yan gyi bu phrug tsho chos srid gnyis phyogs nas slob gso thob ste bod pa'i mi ngo go chod cig 'byung ba'i ched du ma su ri shes rig slob gra de rang du rim gtong byed rgyu yin/ slob gra der yang slob phrug pho mo ser skya tshang ma gcig gyur gyi 'tsho skyong slob gasku byed pa ma gtogs/ khyad par dbye 'byed rigs rtsa ba nas med/ nga chos bu phrug gso skyong khang dang / ma su ri slob grar bsdu rub byas pa'i bod phrug rnams 73

ni phyin chad bod gzhung dang / 7rgyal ba rin po che'i thugs blos byings 'gol gnang sa zhig tu thag bcad de re ba chen po bcol gyi yod/ 'dir khyod tsho phru gu'i pha ma spun nye snur sems phral gtan nas byed mi dgos/snadir khyod tshor gong du bshad pa rnams sems la bzhag nas gzugs por gces spras gang zab byed dgos/ rtag tu gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten skor la tod yangs ma song ba byed dgos/ lhag par tsha ba'i yul du 'phrod bsten byed phyogs la snang chung shor na nad shin tu 'gos sla bas nges par gzab gzab byed dgos/ rjes su 'di khul dka' ngal byung rigs dang / gzhan dag lab 'os byung rigs khyod tsho'i 'go 'dzin gzhung zhabs brgyud nas ngos dang / bka' shag la gnas tshul gtong dgos/ nga tshos thabs shes gang yong byas dang byed bzhin ltar/ slad kyang mi mang gi dka' sdug sel thabs ci nus byed rgyu yin/'di ga'i mi mang 'go 'doms gzhung zhabs ser skya nas kyang yul dus gnas tshul la bsam zhib nan tan gyis dka' sdug ji ltar byung yang bzod thub pa zhig gi sems khur bskyed de/ rang rang gi byed sgo 'thus tshang gis gzhung zhabs kyi ming don mtshungs pa zhig byed dathosnes pa las/ 'ga' zhig gis nga gzhung zhabs yin/ yig rtsis shes pa lam baXge byed par btang / gnas tshul dang ma 'tshams pa'i las 'gan bskur nas don med dka' sbyong byed du 'jug gi 'dug bsam srid/ de 'dra bsam na nor ba yin/ gzhung zhabs yin phyin las ka chen po dang / 'jam las ma gshe(gas byas ma chog pa min/ gzhung zhabs zer ba des gzhung dang mi mang gi zhabs 'degs zhus te/ gzhung dang / 74

mi mang gi las don che chung gang yang khur du blangs te sgrub dgos pa yin/ gzhung dang / mi mang gi las don tshang ma chung sa nas tshags tshud pa zhig dbokhes/ che sar rub ste chung sar 'thus shor gyur na mi 'grigs/ pad shag zho gang do bsags te srang dang rdo tshad longs thabs byed pa ltar chung sar snang chung byas na mi 'grigs/ gzhung zhabs tshang mas rang rang skabs su babs pa'i las 'gan che chung dang / khag los gang yin rung de dag dga' 'dems zhan skyur med par mtha' 'khyongs su sgrub dgos pa yin pas de lugs sems la bar+shag nas gzhung zhabs kyi go chod pa zhig byed dgos/ 'di ga'i 'go 'doms gzhung zhabs sogs nas da phan byed sgo 'thus tshang byung 'dug da dung yang gong du bshad pa rnams sems la bzhag nas byas rjes thon pa zhig byed dgos/de ring 'dir nga tsho khyug tsam thug ste skad cha 'di 'dra shod rgyu byung ba dang / 'di khul rgya gar dasngo na rigs las byed dang / rgya gar mi mang bcas nas dga' bsu'i sne len 'di tsam byung bar rang tsho'i ngos nas gnas dus sdug po 'di la dpag pa'i yag po red/ da nga tsho 'di nas sa cha phran bu khad 'chus kyang / rtsa ba'i sems kyi gting nas khad 'chus song bsam mi dathongs/ gang yin zer na/ nga 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sems ni dus dang rnam pa kun du bod mi mang gang du gnas pa de dag re re dang mnyam du 'bral ba med par bsdad yod/bod mi mang skyid po byung dus nga'i sems kyang skyid por gnas pa dang /bod mi mang sdug po byung dus nga'i sems kyang sdug por gnas pa/ de bzhin 75

bod mi mang dga' ba'am/ skyo ba'i skabs su nga'i sems la'ang dga' skyo'i 'gyur ldog byung ste/ ngos dang bod mi mang lus sems gcig gyur lta bur gnas yod/ de tsam ma zad/ nga tsho yang yang thug rgyu'i go skabs kyang yong gi red/da nga tshos de ring 'dir/ tshig nyung la don zab pa'i chos 'chad nyan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang mchis pa 'dis/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang / khams gsum 'gro ba ma lus bde skyid zhi ba'i dpal la spyod pa/ sgos su rgya dmar gyi btsan 'og tu rang rigs mi mang khri phrag mang po'i srog khrag btang ba rnams gangs jongs bstan 'gror sman pa'i dge rtsar gyur nas/ bod spyi don gyi bden pa'i mar me yongs su gsal te/ nag phyogs rdzun pa'i mun chen kun nas 'joms pa'i thugs smon tshang mas mdzad par zhu/zhes 4skor// //76

ra༅༅// spyi pho 1960 zla 8 tshes 25 nyin/ dha ram sa lar gnas pa'i btsan byol bod mi mi grangs nyis brgya lnga bcu skor mchis pa rnams gnas skabs ring ku lu zhes pa'i sa gnas kyi nye mtshams su lam bzo'i las rtsol du thon khar stsal ba'i bka' slob/khyod tsho 'di gar 'byor te da phan du yun gang 'tshams shig gi ring la thag nyer bsdad par song gshis da cha khyod tsho sa gnas gzhan dag cig tu 'gro rgyur brten khyod tshor blo pham yong ba gzhir bcas shing / nged rang gi sems la'ang phran bu mi bde ba byung / 'on kyang de la skyon med/ khyod tsho 'di gar sngar rgyun gnas sdod dang / sa gnas gzhan du bskyod pa gnyis la khyad par med/ dper na/ thag ring ba sgang tog dang / 'bum sde la tshun du gnas pa'i bod mi yongs rdzogs kyi 'tsho bar blta rtogs sems khur byed rgyur rang ngos la nye ring gi khyad par gang yang med/ der brten khyod tsho sdod yul sa thag ring du song yang / nga'i sems kyi gting nas ring du btang mi yong ngas khyod tshor bod mi spyi mtshungs kyi blta rtogs sems khur rtag tu byed kyi red/ khyod tsho 'di gar da mus bsdad kyang ngos kyi sdod yul dang 'brel mtshungs babs kyi yang yang thug 'phrad yong rgyu tsam las/ gzhan gyi khe bzang che ba thob rgyu gang yang med/ chos phyogs kyi cha nas mtshon na'ang bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs la nye 'gyangs med/ gtso bo dad pa dang dam tshig rang la rag las pa red/da lta khyod tsho 'gro yul de ni gzhis chags gtan 'khel byed pa zhig ma yin/gzhis chags kyi sa yul gtan 'khel sku(nga ba'i thabs shes byed mus yin te 77

gang cir go bstun dgos stabs lam seng thag chod yong thabs mi 'dug dka' ngal 'di dag sel thabs la tshang mas hur brtson byas na nges par sel thub kyi red/ da lta'i gnas skabs su lam las sku(gas kyi las rtsol la zhugs dgos stabs dka' ngal che tsam yod kyang / blo sems zhum pa med par hur brtson dang 'brel sems pa skyid po byas te sdod dgos/ lto za shes la las ka byed mi thub zer ba lta bu ma yin par skabs su babs pa'i las 'gan ji 'dra zhig yin rung / rang rigs bod mi'i zhabs 'dren du ma song bar blo stobs cher bskyed kyis hur brtson byas te tha na lam bzo lta bu'i las don chung rtsag de tsho yang rgyal bstan chab srid sngar sor chud thabs kyi bya bar 'brel ba skusted pa zhig yin pas de don sems la 'jog dgos/ de tsam ma zad bod du lus pa'i rang rigs kyi thongad mi de rnams ni nga tsho dang gtan nas mi 'dra bar dgra wa'i btsan 'og tu tshud de nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam med par tha na skad cha tshig re gnyis cam shod stangs dang / gom pa spo stangs legs nyes lta bus kyang srog la bdo ba'i nyen kha'i ngang du gnas yod/ rang re rgya gar sa 11ga tu 'byor ba'i bod mi rnams lam las byed dathoges skusgogs kyi 'tsho thabs dka' ngal ji tsam che yang srog la bdo ba'i nyen kha'i blo g.yeng dngangs skrag de 'dra med par blo bde bag phebs kyis skyid por bsdad chog pa 'di la bsam blo btang ste dka' ngal khyad bsad bgyis te las shar hur brtson thog gla 'bab phran bu byung rigs kyang don med 'thor rkyen du ma btang bar slar gzhis/ chags kyi don du sman thabs byed dgos/ rang re'i bod kyi rang dbang rang btsan de 78

yang rang re bod mi rang gis thabs shes byas pa las 'byung ba ma gtogs/ rang bzhin gyis mi yong bas rgyu mtshan de'i phyir 'phral dang yun du las don sgrub mkhan gyi mi yi lus srog ring du 'tsho thabs byed rgyu de yang gal chen po red/der brten khyod chos 'phrod bsten gtsang sbra spyod lam yag po byas te lus la na tsha mi 'byung ba nges par byed dgos/ nga tsho'i bod mi gcig shi na'ang / nga tsho'i sems la phangs sems chen po dang / mi bde ba chen po yong gi 'dug pas khyod tshos gzab gzab byed dgos/khyod tsho'i dkyil du gra pa slob gnyer ba ji tsam yod dam zhes bka' 'dri mdzad par/ dpe cha ba bco lnga skor yod ces zhus par/ 'o na khyod phyo gnas skabs skya bo mi nag pa dang mnyam du lam las sogs byas te bskyod sdod dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig byung yod kyang blo pham yid zhum ma byas par rang gi rgyud la yod pa'i dge tshul slong gi bslab sdom sogs sdom pa dang / dam tshig rnams bcas pa'i mtshams la shes bzhin khyad gaskudzid ma yin par tshul bzhin du srung dgos pa las/ da ni nga tsho skya bo mi nag pa'i khrod du mnyam por sdod dgos gshis khyad par mi 'dug snyam ste gang byung byas na gtan nas mi 'grigs pas gra pa rang yin bsam ste tshul mthun du sdod dgos pas de don sems la 'jog dgos/khyod tsho mnyam du 'khrid rgyur bu phrug ji tsam yod dam zhes bka' 'dri mdzad song bar bu phrug chung ngu rnams ma gtogs de byings tshang ma 'di gar 'jog rgyu yin zhes zhus/ 'o na pha ma rnams dang mnyam du 'khrid rgyu'i bu phrug 79

rnams gces skyong zab nan byed dgos / bu phrug rnams ni phyin chad rang re'i yul lung dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ gzhung gi chab srid bcas nyams gso 'dzugs bskrun byed mkhan gyi dmigs yul ngo ma yin pas kho tshor bdag sprod yag po byed dgos/ kho tshor re ba shin tu chen po yod/yang / da lta 'dir yod kyi nang du bud med ji tsamayod dam zhes bka' 'dri mdzad song bar/ bud med drug bcu skor yod ces zhus par/ da 'o na ngas don med kyi ngo tsha dang / sba gsang lta bu ma byas par gsal por drang bshad byas na legs pa las/ sngar bzhin rang bzhin zom 'jog byas na skyon dang nor 'khrul ma gtogs dge mtshan med/ khyod tsho bud med rnams kyis rang gi mi rigs rgyud gtsang 'phel thabs kyi 'gan khur nges par byed dgos pa ni gal gnad shin tu chen po yin/ nang gses bza' tshang 'brel zin pa rnams ni smos ma dgos/ de min bza' tshang ma 'brel ba'i bud med rnams kyis rang rigs gtsang ma'i bu rgyud 'phel thabs byed pa las/ gang byung 'chal spyod byas pas mi 'grigs/ dper na/ ka li ka ta dang / ka lon sbug sogs su de sngon nas 'byor pa'i rang re'i bud med na gzhon 'ga' shas kyis bsam shes ma thongs par grogs ngan thabs rdugs kyis rkyen pas gang byung byas te sdod kyi yod tshod 'dug pa de ni rang nyid sger la'ang phan pa gtan nas med pa'i gtam don gnyis med kyi las ka thabs sdug cig red/ da cha khyod tshos mtshon pas bod mi bud med rnams nas tshul de las ldog ste rang gi lung pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 11gas nyams pa ga11 ba'i zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan gyi rigs 80

rgyud gtsang ma 'phel thabs byed dgos/ de min ma bod pa dang / pha mi rigs gzhan dag byas pa'i phru gu mang po skyes 'phel byung na mi rigs gtan brlag tu 'gro ba'i nyen ka yod/ de 'dra ma yin pa'i rang re bod mi nang tshags 'dus pa las byung ba'i rigs rgyud cig nges par dgos pas gnad don 'di dag la khyod chos snang chung ma byas par sems la yag po zhogs dgos/ ngas bstan bshigs kyis gang byung bshad pa min/ de ni 'dzam gling 'di'i nang gi chos ldan gyi mi rigs lo rgyus can zhig rtsabarlag tu 'gro ba'i dus rabs kyi yo langs 'di 'dra'i skabs dngos 'brel gyi gnad 'gag chen po red/ dper na/ sngar sang sa rgyas bcom lan 'das zhal bzhugs kyi dus sa theg chen bsan pa dar /rdo gi ri ca ///)khyab che yang / sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su theg chen gyi bstan pa shin tu nyag phra bar gyur pa'i skabs shig la/ dge bsnyen ma zhig gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig par snying nas ma bzod kyang / rang gi nus pas bstan pa gso mi nus par mthong nas khong gis da ni theg chen gyi bstan pa gso ba la smon lam gyi mthu smin pa'i rigs rgyud bzang po zhig 'byung dgos pa gal che bar mthong steyul zhig gi rgyal po dang 'dus pa las rgyal sras thogs med dang /bram ze zhig dang 'dus pa las slob dpon dbyig gnyen zhes yongs su grags pa de gnyis 'khrungs te khong gnyis nas bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa'i mthu las deng sang gi dus su'ang rang re brgal brtag baglo nga byed skabs dka' gnad dang 'phrad dus rgyal sras thogs med dang / mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir zhes khungs lung tshad mar 'dzin yul gyi skyes chen 81

dam pa de 'dra byung ba bzhin/ phyin chad rang re'i yul lung 'dzugs bskrun dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs/ bod rang dbang rang btsan gyi gtam 'go las mjug skyel mkhan ci zer ma 'ongs pa'i rigs rgyud 'phel thabs la do snang gis bsam blo dog sa nas btang na dge mtshan che/ rang re'i bod kyi rang btsan de yang gcig byas na dus myur ba nyid du yong shas che ste/gcig byas na de las ring tsam 'gor gyi red/ yang na da lta'i na gzhon bu phrug rnams kyi dus skabs yong ngam/ yang de'i rjes kyi bu phrug rnams kyi dus skabs su yong min 11gas nges pa med pas tshang mas sems thag thung thung ma byas par mig rgyangs ring por bltas te bu rgyud gtsang ma 'phel thabs dang /de dag la gso skyong byed rgyu 'di ni ha cang gal 'gangs chen po zhig la cha 'jog byed dgos/'dir yod mi mang rnams dka' ngal che ba'i dus skabs su khyod tsho 'go bye da bcu dpon sogs nas kyang gang cir blta rtogs khur bsam che skyed kyi sa tshang ma'i sems shugs ma chag pa byed dathoges/ de 'brel khyod tsho mi mang rnams kyang mthun lam rdog rtsa gcig bsgril byed pa ma gtogs/ nga tsho phag ri ba dang / nga tsho gzhan zhig yin zer ba lta bu'i phyogs 'then nye ring gi bsam tshul ring du dor te rang re bod mi tsho gcig pa yin/ skyid sdug legs nyes ji ltar byung rung gcig pa yin bsam pa'i kun slong bzang po 'khyer te phan tshun gcig phan gcig grogs byas te sdod dgos sogs bka' stsa la song bar/ 'go byed bcu dpon sogs sku mdun du yod pa rnams nas phyag 'tshal dang 'brel mi 82

mang rnams kyi lag gnyis thal mo sbyar te da cha nga tsho 7skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu khyed kyi drung nas sa gnas gzhan zhig tu 'phral sel lam bzo sogs la 'gro dgos kyang / da lta bka' slob ji ltar phebs pa bzhin/ nga tshos yid bzhin nor bu khyed kyi dgongs gzhi 'grub pa dang / yang sgos rang re bod ljongs chol kha gsum gyi mi rigs kyi mtshan shas su ma song bar 7skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu mchog nas da phan sku ngal khyad bsad kyis rlabs chen mdzad khur skyong bzhes kyis yang dag pa'i dbu 'khrid mdzad 'og tu gus 'bangs rnams nas gzhan dag gi gang byung zer rjes su ma 'brangs par las don skabs su gang babs dka' ngal khyad bsad hur bskyed zhus chog pa dang / 7skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu mchog nyid sku tshe zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan 1dugs gnang zhes nan tan chen pos gsol 'debs zhus par/ 7gong sa mchog nas/ de ga rang red/ nga rang skye 'chi rang dbang thob pa zhig ma yin yang /7rgyal mchog dge 'dun grub kyis sku tshe ring por bzhugs 'dug pa de bzhin nam/ de las ring tsam zhig sdod rgyu'i 'dun pa yod kyang / tshe yun du brtan dang mi brtan zer ba 'di yang rgyu rkyen rten 'brel zhig la nges par tos dgos/dper na/ nga rang la mtshon na bstan 'dzin rgya mchon zer ba a mdo ba'i phru gu phal pa zhig red/ 'on kyang las smon rten 'brel gyi mthu las khyod tshos nga la 7rgyal ba rin po che zhes brtsi mthong cha 'jog byed dgos pa zhig dang /ngas kyang bstan pa chab srid kyi khur 'gan rang nus kyis mi ldeng mi theg bzhin du len dgos pa zhig byung ba red/ der brten da lta'i gnas skabs su'ang tshang 83

mas dam tshig swār+shag rtsa chig bsgril gyis spyi don la khur 'gan mnyam len gcig mthun byung na nga'i tshe la'ang skyon yong mdog kha po ma red/ de 'dra ma yin par spyi don blos btang gis rang bzhin spyi zom du bzhag ste tshang ma chig bsgril ma byung na mi gcig gi tshe ring po bsdad de dka' las rgyab kyang / rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu la sa med stabs mi tshe ring por bsdad kya nga dge mtshan gang yang ma mthong bas lo mang ༄sad rgyu'i grab gshoms byas kyang dgos pa med/ gnas tshul de 'drar brten rang re bod rigs tshang mas rang 'dod phyogs lhung gi bsam tshul ring du dor te dam tshig chig bsgril gyis spyi don tshags tshud 'byung thabs rang gi nus pa ji yod bton te mnyam rub byas na de dang / ngos rang nas yun ring du sdod rgyu'i 'dun pa btang ba de gnyis rgyu rkyen rten 'brel zhig 'dzoms na bskal pa khri phrag zer ba de 'dra ni gang shes/ tshe ring tsam sdod rgyu'i 'dun pa yong cing / smon lam yang rgyab chog tshang ma dam tshig mthun na 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zer ba nga'i tshe la yang skyon yo nga gi ma red bsam pa 'dug pas de don khyod tsho tshang ma blo sems bde po byas nas sdod/ da ngas de ring brjong rgyu de tsam yin/ gang bshad pa rnams ma brjed par sems la zhogs/ bkra shis bde legs yod/ rjes su nga tsho yang yang 'phrad yong /zhes bka' 355// //84

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1962 zla 3 tshes 20 nyin rgya gar lho phyogs ma'i sor khul bod mi gzhis chags rnams la chos 'brel stsal mjug bka' slob/nga rang tsho so so'i lung pa dang bral te gzhan gyi yul gru zhig tu gyar dgos byung ba ni ha cang sems pham pa'i gnas shig red/ de yang nga rang chos nor 'khrul dbang gis byung ba zhig yin na de 'dra zhig yin mod kyang / de 'dra ma yin par nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug blos dkon mchog gsum la bkal/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches byas/ tha na srog chags grog sbur tshun la gnod 'tshe mi byed par yin lugs tshul mthun gyi sdod mkhan zhig la da cha thob thang bdag dbang rtsa ba nas med pa zhig gis btsan bzos byas pa 'dir blo pham che/ yin na yang nga tsho'i phyogs su bden pa yod pa dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa la ma thug pas chos srid kyi dpa' yon gsar du bzhad rgyur gdon mi za ba ma zad/ da phan dngos yod gnas tshul gang la bltas kyang lo re las lo re je bzang je legs su 'gro ba las/ je nyams je zhan du mi 'gro ba dang / deng gi skabs su bod don la rgyab skyor gang thad nas je mang du 'gro ba sogs kyis nga tsho'i 'dod don bden pa'i rgyal kha thob rgyur yid ches yod/ 'on kyang nga tsho mi rigs shig dang / yul gru zhig gi don gnad yin pas dus yun phran bu 'gor srid/ rtsa don chen po de dag da ring sang nyin tsam la yong mi thub kyang / mtha' ma'i rgyal kha 'thob rgyu nyag gcig red/ ngos nas kyang bod gangs can gyi bstan 'gro'i bde don la zhe brtso na gang yong byas par byas yud min yang / da phan 'grub tshod gang legs lta bu byung song / phyin 85

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1962 zla 3 tshes 20 nyin rgya gar lho phyogs ma'i sor khul bod mi gzhis chags rnams la chos 'brel stsal mjug bka' slob/nga rang tsho so so'i lung pa dang bral te gzhan gyi yul gru zhig tu gyar dgos byung ba ni ha cang sems pham pa'i gnas shig red/ de yang nga rang chos nor 'khrul dbang gis byung ba zhig yin na de 'dra zhig yin mod kyang / de 'dra ma yin par nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug blos dkon mchog gsum la bkal/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches byas/ tha na srog chags grog sbur tshun la gnod 'tshe mi byed par yin lugs tshul mthun gyi sdod mkhan zhig la da cha thob thang bdag dbang rtsa ba nas med pa zhig gis btsan bzos byas pa 'dir blo pham che/ yin na yang nga tsho'i phyogs su bden pa yod pa dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa la ma thug pas chos srid kyi dpa' yon gsar du bzhad rgyur gdon mi za ba ma zad/ da phan dngos yod gnas tshul gang la bltas kyang lo re las lo re je bzang je legs su 'gro ba las/ je nyams je zhan du mi 'gro ba dang / deng gi skabs su bod don la rgyab skyor gang thad nas je mang du 'gro ba sogs kyis nga tsho'i 'dod don bden pa'i rgyal kha thob rgyur yid ches yod/ 'on kyang nga tsho mi rigs shig dang / yul gru zhig gi don gnad yin pas dus yun phran bu 'gor srid/ rtsa don chen po de dag da ring sang nyin tsam la yong mi thub kyang / mtha' ma'i rgyal kha 'thob rgyu nyag gcig red/ ngos nas kyang bod gangs can gyi bstan 'gro'i bde don la zhe brtso na gang yong byas par byas yud min yang / da phan 'grub tshod gang legs lta bu byung song / phyin 85

chad bod jongs rang dbang skyar lon gyis skabs su chab srid kyi gnas stangs sngar nang bzhin yong thabs med/ nga tsho'i sngar gyi chab srid 'gro lugs nang legs nyes gnyis ka sku(da/ legs pa/'i cha la brten nas mi 'o( stong phrag 'ga' shas su mi rigs ma brlag par gnas thub pa dang / nyes pa'i cha la brten nas gnas tshul thabs rdugs 'di dag byung ba red/ phyin chad nga tshos legs cha rnams dang / lhag par du dam pa'i chos gtso bo dang gzhi rtsar bzungs te mi rnams zhi dul bag yod dang ldan pa'i spyod bzang zhig tu gnas dgos pa yin/gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs la'ang da lta skyon yod/ de yang legs su gtong dgos pa dang / cesas gzhis/ sger gzhis zer ba sogs la legs bcos mang tsam byas te snying po chos srid zung 'brel gyi 'gro phyogs bzang po zhig gis tshe 'di ga tsam min par 'di phyi gnyis yod 'dab chags gshog sgro zung ldan lta bu zhig dgos pa tshang ma'i sems la zhog dgos/ ngos nas ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro phyogs skor bsam gzhigs nges gtan byas pa'i rtsa khrims zin bris de dag la khyed tshos kyang bsam blo gtong dgos/ nga tsho lo lnga drug tsam nas bod du log thub rgyu'am/ yang na lo sum cu bzhi bcu tsam rgya gar lung par sdod dgos pa'ang srid/ gang ltar dus yun ji lta ra 'gor rung de bzhin du sdod thub pa'i las don la snying rus dang / 'bad brtson byed dgos/ dper na/ sdod yun lo bzhi bcu tsam gyi 'char gzhi bzhag rung / lo lnga drug tsam nas log thub pa byung na de 'phral log chog pa las mtha' gcig tu 'char gzhi ltar 'dir gtan 'jags su sdod dgos pa min/ rgya gar nang 'phral sel gyi las ga'i rigs 86

'tsho thabs nges gtan min pas khul 'dir mi grangs sum stong skor gzhis chags bya rgyu ha cang gal che ba yin zhing / sa gnas 'di dag rgyang thag ring yang 'dir mi grangs sum stong skor gzhis chags bya rgyu yin stabs/ ha cang do snang chen po byed kyi yod/ 'di dag sa cha'i snying lta bur song khyod tshos bsam blo rgya che tsam da nga / gting ring tsam gtong dgos/ phyin chad bod kyi 'gro stangs sngar lugs nang bzhin yong thabs med pas da lta nas bsam cho'i gom cha gong 'phel du gtong dgos/ gzhis chags kyi sa zhing ngam/ sdod khang gang ci rang nyid kyi yin snyam pa'i gces sbras dang / hur brtson gyi thon skyed la 'bad dgos shing / so nam gyi las rkar dka' las yod rung / nga tsho gzhan yul du yod pas dka' ngal bzod thub pa dgos/ dge 'dun pa tsho yang sa zhing gi phyag las gnang na yag po red/ dge 'dun mang po lam bzo'i las tar yang zhugs yod/ dper na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya'i rgyud stod dang bstun pa'i chos bstan pa ltar nga tshos kyang yul dus gnas skabs dang / dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la'ang bstun dgos pas grwa rigs tshos thon skyed nang zhugs dgos/ nga tshor dgra phyogs nas bshad pa'i je ngan je sdug gi bsnyon 'dzugs rnams dang / za 'dre lta bu'i mthong tshul ngan pa rnams dngos yod gnas tshul zhig gis sel dgos pa yin/ de bzhin rgya gar ba tshos kyang khyed tshos dka' las brgyab na legs por brtsi zhing / mthong snang du'ang 'jug po yong rgyu/ yang khyed tsho lus po bsra thang gi ched du gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten gyi skor la do gal che tsam bya dgos/ tsha ba'i nang lus dze gtsang ma dgos pa dang / gyon pa legs 87

po med kyang yang yang bkrus te gtsang ma bzo dgos/ de bzhin lto chas kyang rnying pa'i rigs zos na nad gzhi 'byung ba'i gzhiyin pas bag zon gang che byed dgos/khyed rang rgan gzhon tshang mas yon tan la sbyang brtson byed dgos/ sa skya legs bshad las/ rig pa nang par 'chi yang bslab/ /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / /skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len pa 'dra/ zhes nga tsho'i bstan bcos nang yod pa de bzhin du sbyang brtson byas te bsam pa'i gzhi rgya che ru gtong dgos/ gsar shog sogs klog nyan gyis bsam blo gting ring tsam gtong dgos/ nga tsho sngar rgya gar rgya nag zer ba thag ring du mthong yang da lta de lta'i thag ring min/ sngar bong 'ded pa zhig yin pa slad kyang bong 'ded kho na byed snyam pa ni ha cang gi nor 'khrul red/ ngos kyis sngon nas bshad pa bzhin bod gsar pa'i skabs sur 'os de la zhabs pad bsko gzhag byed rkyang las the tshom med ces bshad yod/ de dag lag len du bstar dgos pa zhi ga yin/ gso sbyong skabs mdo sus 'don thub pa des mkhan po byed rkyang las/ bla ma'i ming 'khur tsam gyis byed srol med/ dper na/ bla ma zhig dang / gsol dpon zhig yod na gsol da1ston gyis mdo bton thub pa'i tshe gsol dpon gyis mkhan 11 byed rkyang las/ nga bla ma yin zhes mkhan po byed pa'i grol med/ nga tshos phyi rgyal gyi lad zlos byas pa yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyis ji ltar gsungs pa ltar de bzhin du byed dgos/ dper na/ gso sbyong gi skabs su ngos nas mar phyag 'tshal dgos pa dang / khong tshos kyang yar phyag 'tshal dgos pa red/ mdo 'do na pa'i tshe khrir 'dzegs pa de yang 8 8

'don rgyu'i chos kyi che bar khri brtsegs pa las/ bla ma rang nyid la khri rgyab pa min/ rgya gar la mtshon na'ang de bzhin red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lo stong phrag sngon nas mang gtso gsungs yod pas de la dwogs 'drogs nam yang byed mi dgos/ yang sku(na tan med na dmangs gather+sha) gnas don ma rtogs pas go 'dzol yong nyen yod/ dper na/ bong 'ded mang po zhig la khyed rnams dmangs gtso yin zhes brjod go rim dang gnas tshul gang la'ang ma bstun par phar tshur rgyug pa gzhu res kho na byed srid/ yang 'ga' zhig nas dmangs gtso yin zhes mgo mjug gtan nas med pa ra zang zing byed pa de tsho ha cang nor 'khrul chen po yin/ nga tshos mtha' gnyis su ma lhung par dbu ma'i lam zhig bzungs dgos pa dang / byis pa rnams kyang yon tan la sbyang brtson byed par do 'khur dgos/ lus por yang 'phrod bsten gang gzab byed gal che/'di'i nang skra lcang lo yod pa rnams rang nyid bde po yod na.u tshugs mi byed/ 'on kyang tsha ba'i nang mgo po na ba las phan pa gang yanga.e sku(da snyam/sa zhing thon skyed las don la nus shugs 'don rgyu ha cang gal che ba dang / de yang mnyam 'brel byed pa gal che/ rgya dmar gyi rang dbang spu tsam med pa'i btsan gnon gyis mnyam 'brel de 'dra min par rang dbang dgos nges shig dang bcas mnyam 'brel byas te spyi pa tshags tshud zhig dgos pa yin/ spyi drod na sgor yang shugs kyi drod 'gro ba yin pas phyin chad kyang de lta'i goms cha dgos pa yin/ de bzhin mi grangs brgya skor lto tshang phyogs bsgril byas na 'gro gron chung la lto chas kyang dus thog so sor 'byor pa sogs kyi dge mtshan yod 89

pa dang / mi re res thab re 'dzin rgyu de dag 'gro gron che zhing lto chas dus 'byor med pa sogs kyi skyon cha yod/ rgya gar byang 'argyud du bod mi lam bzo ba tshos spyi thab bzungs te dge mtshan gang 'tshams byung yod/ 'go byed kyis mdzub ston byas pa'i 'og tshang mas dge mtshan ldan pa'i las don la dwang bas khur blangs hur brtson byas na gang legs yong rgyu dang / de min 'go byed nas mi re re bzhin lab dgos byung ba dang / de dag la'ang cha 'jog med par rang snang gang dran byas na sbo lug rgyu las gang yang mi yong / der brten spyi thab 'dzin rgyu yang dge mtshan che bas byed dgos pa yin/ phyogs mtshungs khyed rnams mthun lam gang zab kyis deng dkrogs gtam re zung yong gi 'dug pa de dag la mgo 'khor g.yam rgyugs min par rang tshugs su gnas dgos/ wade pa nang khul shog 'gril byed pa deng skabs drag tu phyin yod pa de yag po byung /snying po chol gsum bod rigs yongs rdzogs mthun lam rdog rtsa chig bsgril gyis bod rang dbang skyar gso'i las 'gul la 'bad brtson byed dgos/ de bzhin rgya gar gzhung gi las byed che phrar mthun lam gang zab byed dgos/ rgya gar gzhung dang mi mang nas nga tsho gnas tshul thabs rdugs 'di lta'i skabs su gang cir bka' drin chen po red/ nga tsho'i bde sdug la'ang thugs khur chen po gnang bzhin pa red/ nga tsho'i goms gshis dang / rnam 'gyur ma dor pa'i thog nas yul khrims la'ang brtsi srung dang len ma byas tshe blo pham chen po yong gi 'dug khyed tsho'i khong nas 'ga' res gzhis chags su yong khul gyis sto slong du 'gro gi yod tshod 'dug pas/ byed stangs de rigs kyis bod mi spyi la 90

gnod skyon yong gi red/ gong du brjod pa rnams sems bcangs kyis rjes su dril bsgrags sam/ las byed so sos ji zer la brtsi'ajog nyan sems byed dgos/da ring ngos rang bod mi skya ser pho mo mang po zhig dang mnyam 'dzoms bya rgyu byung ba 'dir dga' po byung / phyogs gcig nas bsam na bod nang gi spun zla tsho'i gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig gi thog tu gnas yod dam/ khong tsho lus ngag yid gsum la rang dbang phra mo tsam med par bkres skom yid dwags kyi gnas su mchis pa dang / rnam 'gyur bzang ngan phra mo tsam la'ang lus srog 'dor gyi yod pa red/ da phan rgyal bstan chab srid kyi don du bod mi khri phrag mang po'i lus srog rgya dmar nas 'phrog phrin pa re da/ da dung bod mi snying stobs can de tshos kha chems ji 'dra bzhag 'dug gam/ khong tsho gang gi don du srog dor ba yin nam/ khong tsho'i las mjug nga chos skyong dgos pa zhig red/ khyed tshos sems shugs cher bskyed kyis ngal ba phra 31 tsam la ma zhum par 'bad rtsol byas te slar rgan pa tsho kha 'don dge sbyor lus bde sems skyid du sdod thub pa dang / byis pa rnams nas slob sbyong la hur brtson chen pos da lta lung stong lta bu 'di dag rjes su yul ljongs mdzes sdug can zhig tu bsgyur thub pa'i 'bad brtson byed dgos/ bod lus spun zla tshos btsan dbang drag po'i 'og nas rgya dmar la ngo rgol byed pa dang / bsangs gsol byed pa sogs nga tshor re bcol gyis snying stobs zhum med yod pa de ni kho tsho gcig pu'i sgor don ma yin par bod rgyal bstan chab srid dang / rgya che'i mi mang gi don du yin pas khyed rnams nas kyang de bzhin sems 'jags bya dgos zhes 455// //91
