༄༅// spyi lo 1964 zla 2 tshes 28 nyin/ nye skor bod mi'i sdod sgar khag nas ser skya pho mo grangs 1030 skor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog mjal phyag ched bcar 'byor rnams pho brang sku mdun bde yangs nang 'dzoms 'dus mtshams gzim chung dbu g.yab gdeng cha'i steng nas rnam kun ltar zhal mjal thugs zhib bskyangs shing / de mjug bde yangs nang mi mang 'du 'dzoms kyi nye 'khris su chibs bsgyur gnang ste bka' slob stsal smin du/thog mar khyed tsho gang nas yong ba yin/ gzugs po bde thang yin nam sogs 'tshams 'dri bskyangs rjes/ da lam cho 'phrul dus chen 'di nyid bdag cag gi ston pas mu tig pa rnams cho 'phrul gyis pham par mdzad pa'i dus chen zhig yin/ de sngon bod la dus chen gyi dran gsor cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo tshugs te phyogs kun nas dga' mos 'du 'dzoms byed pa'i dus skabs de re zhig med pa lta bu chags rung / da ring nga tsho bod mi mang po zhig dus chen 'di'i skabs 'du 'dzoms byung ba 'dir dga' po byung / spyir btang bod pa tshos rang re nang pa'i chos lugs 'di gal chen po yin pa shes mus yin kyang /bsam khra'i nang gnad don snying wa ༄rtogs par byas te lag len don thog 'khel rgyu gal gnad che shos shig yin/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi khyad chos ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la blos bkal nas skyabs bcol te ma 'ongs pa na rang yang dge 'dun dkon mchog tu nges par 'grub srid/ 'dzam gling gi khyon 'dir chos lugs mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig yod na yang nang pa sangs 92

rgyas kyi chos lugs 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig yod/nga tsho nang pa'i chos la zhugs phyin mi dge bcu spangs nas dge bcu sgrub dgos pa yin/ de ltar nyams len ma byas tshe nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i zhabs 'dren chen po red/ rgya mis/ kyang / rkun ma dmar lnga dang / jag pa ser po/ yang na lam dkar nag gnyis su 'gro dgos zer ba ltar chos pa yin na mi dge bcu'i khrims bsrungs te chos kyi tshul khrims bsrung dgos pa dang / de sngon gdan sa gsum dang / dgon sde khag gi las sne 'ga' shas nas bstan pa dang / dge 'dun kha 'khyer gyis mi mang thog don med brdabs gsigs btang ba dang /phyogs mtshungs las 'gan yod rigs khag nas kyang rang thogen sgrub phyogs gzhir bzungs kyis dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab srid skyong phyogs dang / mi mang gi bde rtsa'i spyi don gal che ras su bor/ sger don la zhen 'dzin che bas da cha gnas tshul thabs sdug 'di lta bu chags shing / las don nor 'khrul de chos srid gnyis ga'i thog nas phyin pa red/ nor 'khrul de dag gis rkyen pas da bar nga tsho'i mi rigs grangs las 'das pa rgya dmar nas gsod pa'i cha rkyen du gyur pa dang / gsal por brjod na/ rgya mi kho rang tshos tho bkod nang gsal ltar na spyi lo 1956 zla 3 nas 1960 zla rdzo bar therdzod rigs grangs 77000 tsam bsad yod pa red/ de ma tshad btson khang nang du mug shi thebs pa dang / tsha grang dka' sbyong gis shi ba'ang grangs las 'das pa byung / 1956 lo'i bod zla dang po'i nang mdo stod li thang khul du 'u thug gis 'khrugs zing thog mar 'go tshugs/ de nas bzungs 195993

lo bar rgyun bstud zing 'khrug byed dgos shar/ nga tsho bod pa tshos mi srog gcod rgyu lta ci/ mdor na ra lug tsam bsad kyang yid brtse sems kyi gdung bas mi bzod pa'i rnam 'gyur shugs kyis thon pa dang / tshur ji tsam mi rigs pa byas kyang phar byams brtse dang / snying rje byed pa de rang re nang pa'i khyad chos zab mo zhig yin na yang / bod nang skudad pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tshos mi rigs rang dbang gi don du nyen kha chen po dang / dza drag gdug rtsub kyi 'og tu rang srog blos btang gi sgo nas da dung phar rgol mu mthud byed pa de dag nga tsho'i bsam blo'i nang du nges par rtogs par byed dgos/ bod rgya che'i mi mang tshos rang dbang gi don du nyen khar 'dzems med bzod sran chen pos dka' ngal du ma zhig dang len byas pa de dag nga tshos snying nas bsam bzhin du bod rgya che'i mi mang gi bde don sgrub rgyur nus shugs gang yod 'don dgos pa ni skabs su babs pa nga tsho byes 'byor cho'i las 'gan red/ rang dbang zhes pa ni shin tu rtsa 'gangs chen po zhig yin/ dper na/ nged la khyi zhig yod pa de khang pa'i nang du bcug pa'i skabs khyi de rang dbang med pa ci bya bral stabs mjug ma brla 'og tu bcug ste sdod pa dang / khang pa'i nang nas phyir bton mtshams mjug ma ker langs byed pa sogs rang dbang la dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug rang dbang zhes pa de 'dzam gling kun la grags shing tshang mas kyang ngo shes pa zhig yin/ dper na/ gnam gyi char pa mi tshang mas ngo shes ngos 'dzin byed pa ltar/ rang dbang de yang tshang mas 'dod la ngo yang shes pa zhig yin/nga tsho'i rang dbang de ni chos srid gnyis ldan 'di phyi gnyis shar phan pa'i rang 94

dbang chen po zhig yin/ rang dbang de ji tsam gal 'gangs chen po yin pa de tsam gyis nga tshor dka' ngal chen po yong gi red/ des na de 'dra'i rang dbang gi don du bod rgya che'i mi mang tsho'i sems shugs ji 'dra yod pa de bzhin du nga tso rang dbang lung par gnas pa'i byes 'byor tshos kyang phyar ba gru 'degs sems shugs ma chag pa'i sgo nas dka' ngal la bzod bsran gyis mi rigs rang dbang gi don du 'bad brtson byed dgos/ dka' las rgyab na grub 'bras thon gyi red/ lo ngo nyung shas shig nas nga sto gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms nges par yong thub kyi red/khyed tsho gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten yag po byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ khul 'dir 'byor ba'i bod mi mang che bod kyi lung khug 'brog sa nas 'byor pas gtsang sbrar do snang chung la gyon chas kyang lpag tshag sogs gyon pa dang / mi mdzes pa'i rgyan cha sogs 'dogs par brten rgya gar ba dang / phyi rgyal mi rigs nas rgyal sa lha sa'i mi mang tsho'i 'phrod bsten gyi gnas lugs ma mthong bar 'dir 'byor bod mi'i bya spyod mthong ste bod mi yongs rdzogs 'brog pa dang mtshungs shing lag tu per rgyugs thogs pa/ mdun du gnag phyugs ded mkhan gyi mi rigs shig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod 'dug nga tsho'i mi rigs tshang ma de ltar min/ dper na/ bod dbus khul gyi mi tsho gtsang sbra ldan la bya spyod kyang bzang po yod/ lha khul du grong gseb phan tshun nas 'grul mi 'byor rigs gyon chas dang pyod lam mi mdzes par brten de dag lha sa ba min pa lam seng ngo shes thub pa ltar nga tsho'i mi mang tshang ma de 'dra min/ 'on kyang bod mi lung 95

khug pa tshos dngos gnas gtsang sbra ji bzhin shes pa dkon/ khyod tshos sdod sgar nang du'ang phan tshun nang khul dge skyon bshad de gtsang sbra 'phrod brten gyi lam du zhugs rgyu deng skabs gnad gal chen sngag 'dug da dung gal gnad che ba zhig brjod rgyur/ khyod tsho sgrig 'dzugs nang la sdod dgos/ bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das nas kyang sgrig 'dzugs kyi lam ston mdzad de dge tshul slong rnams nas zla phyed ngo re bzhin gso sbyong gnang ste rang rang gi bslab khrims dang 'gal nyes byung min sogs dri rmed byed pa'i chos kyi tshogs 'du lta bu bskyang pa der dgos pa ldan pa rang dbang yod pa'i sgrig 'dzugs zhig yin zhing / rang dbang med pa rgya mi'i sgrig 'dzugs lta bu ma yin/ khyod tsho lam bzo 'am/ gzhis chags sogs sgrig 'dzugs yod pa'i nang la nges par sdod dgos/ de dag gi nang la bsdad na dge mtshan chen dzege mosgod/ gang yin zer na/ na 'das rkyen ngan byung ba'i skabs su phan tshun rogs ram byed pa dang /rgya che'i mi mang gi bde don sgrub rgyu sogs dgos pa ldan pa'i don gnad chen po yod/ bod pa bsam med dang / yang na rmongs pa/ yang na snying rul pa 'ga' shas kyis sgrig 'dzugs nang nas don te bros byol 'gro ba dang / zur las byed pa/ gnas skor sogs su 'gro khul gyis don snying gang byung du 'khyams te so sor lag dngul phran bu yod pa rnams bor stor zin mtshams phru gu sogs 'khrid de mang tshogs 'dus pa'i grong 'khyer ram/ de bzhin 'khor lo'i babs tshugs khag tu phyi rgyal mi snar slong bshed chen pos slong mo rgyag pa dang / lkog tu rkun ma rgyag pa sogs bya ngan thabs sdug ji snyed cig byas te rang re'i mi 96

rigs kyi mtshan shas dang / dmigs yul bden 'bras la gnod rkyen yong gi 'dug gnas tshul de dag rang rer sha zhen yod pa'i phyi rgyal mi snas mthong ste bod gzhung nas bod par blta rtogs mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan dang 'brel/ bdag po rgyag dgos pa'i gnas tshul ji snyed bcos min sha tsha'i thog nas brjod mkhan 'dug nga tshos bdag po rgyag gi yod kyang 'di tshos nyan gyi mi 'dug ces bshad na.e 'grigs/ de ltar bshad tshe bod mis bod par bshad kyang mi nyan pa'i gnas tshul de ngo tsha po'i rang bzhin red/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas khyod tsho nges par sgrig 'dzugs khongs su sdod dgos pa ni dgos pa mang po dang ldan pa zhig yin/ khyed tsho'i bsam blo'i gnas tshad kyang rim bzhin mtho ru btang ste gal che'i bde don sgrub thub tshe gang legs dang / de ltar min rung yi ge 'bri klog shes pa zhig byas te deng skabs yul dus kyi gsar gnas rnams so so'i bsam blo'i nang du nges pa byas/ gnas tshul rnams yi ge ma shes pa tshor slob ston gyis khong tsho'i bsam tshad mtho ru gtong thabs dang / mang tshogs kyi bde don sgrub thub thabs su 'bad brtson nges par byed gal chen po yin/ khyed rnams yag po gyis/ bkra shis bde legs yod/ ces bka' slob 3 55// / / 97

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1964 zla 9 tshes 28 nyin/ ma'e sor gzhis chags bod mi yongs rdzogs 'dus 'dzoms sar stsa la ba'i bka' slob/da res phran ma'e sor du 'byor pa'i skabs tshang mas dga' po'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas bsu ba byas pa dang / kha sa gzhis chags dang gnyis la lta skor skabs kyang de gong dang mi 'dra ba'i yar rgyas thog tshang ma'i sdod stangs bod kyi grong gseb gcig tu slebs pa lta bu'i snang ba 'char te dga' po byung bas tshang mar thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / rgya gar las byed pa rnams nas kyang gnas lugs shes ma shes kyi nor 'khrul ni su la yang yong rgyu las/ de min bod mir sha tsha dang / lhag bsam phan grogs chen po byed bzhin la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ da lta 'di gar gzhis chags 'go 'dzin dang / tshong khang gi 'gan 'khur ba/ shes rig skor bcas nas da phan las bsdoms snyan seng dang sbrags so so'i dka' ngal ji yod sel thabs kyi bsam 'char re 'dun bcas snyan seng zhus pa rnams legs po 'dug kyang / lag len skabs phyogs mang por sgo bstun dgos pas yongs rdzogs lam seng lag len thub min brjod pa dka'/ gang ltar nang srid dang / shes rig nas khur len thog rgya gar gzhung la 'brel ba byas te thag gcod dgos pa yin pas rim bzhin dka' ngal sel thabs yong rgyur tshang mas yid ches blo bder gnas dgos/de snga yang nga tsho skad cha byung don ltar/ nga tsho'i bod mi rnams gzhis chags bya rgyu dngu / de yang rang 'tsho thub pa bya rgyu'i bsam blo gtong dgos 98

pa ni shin tu gal chen po yin/ 'dzam gling 'di'i nang la btsan byol ba zhes pa nga tsho bod mi gcig pu min/ mi rigs mang po'i btsan byol ba yod/ srid don dang / 'byung ba'i gnod 'tshe la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis rang yul bral nas gzhan yul du gnas sdod byed dgos pa mang po byung yod kyang / de rnams la zla drug gam/ lo gcig tsam ring skyob gso'i rogs ram sprad de de nas rang rang so so rang 'tsho byed pa las lo mang skyob gso sprod pa'i lugs srol med/de rnams phyogs gcig nas rang rang shes yon gyi gnas tshad dbang gis khyad par yod kyang / gtso bo so so'i sems shugs dang / las rtsol la brten nas rang 'tsho thub pa red/ rang re bod mi rnams nas skyob gso blangs te da phan mi lo lnga tsam song yod/ khyed rang tshos sgo ra'i nang btab pa'i shing tog sdong po ji tsam longs 'dug gsar skyes bu phrug rnams ji tsam longs 'dug de tshor ltos dang / dus yun ring tsam zhig song ba'i rtags bstan gyi 'dug dus rtag tu skyob gso kho nar sngas bcol gyis sdod thabs gtan nas med/ gzhis chags tshor skyob gso rim pas nyung du gtong rtsis yod pa 'di bod mir sdug tu btang ba dang / 11da mir sha tsha byed mkhan nyung du phyin pa nam yang min/rgyun du skyob gso kho nar bsten rgyu bod du ngan lang shor ba'i sprang phrug lta bur rang nyid chud zos 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha che ba las/ dge mtshan gangayang med/ des na nges par rang 'tsho thub pa byed dgos/ rang 'tsho gdengs 'khel yong ba'i thabs lam bzang shos ni sa zhing thog gzhis chags bya rgyu 'di rang yin/ rang re bod mi'i nang 'tsho ba rang 'tshor sdod mkhan ji snyed yod/ dper na/ za 99

khang zin mkhan dang / bdal gla skyel mkhan/ drel gasku(ga rgyug mkhan sdudags zla re sgor 30440 tsam gyis 'tsho thabs byed mkhan yod kyang / de rnams rang 'tsho khungs brtan po zhig ma red/ dper na/ skyes pa des drel gaskusgog lta bur bskyod skabs lam bar rkyen ngan glo bur byung na de la lta rtogs byed mkhan su zhig yod/ bud med bu phrug gi 'tsho ba sus sbyor/ stabs legs kyis rang gi lus gzugs bde thang byung na zla re'i gla 'bab cig yong rgyu yod pa tsam las/rang la na tsha byung ba'am/ gang ltar las ka ma thub pa zhig byung na/ 'tsho ba de dag bral ba las thabs gzhan gang yang med/ gzhis chags nang lta bu yin na/ mi su la'ang na ba dang / rgas pa skusgod rung / na ba dang / rgas 'khogs la gyar nayang rtsa ba'i rang nyid kyi gnas yul gzhis chags rgya chen po zhig nang yod pa'i dbang gis rang nyid la dga' nye blo dkar 'dra yong rgyu dang / gal srid de 'dra med kyang / spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa des blta rtogs byed kyi red/ nad pa zhig yin rung legs nyes la ma ltos pa'i sman bcos shig byed rgyu dang / shi ba'i gnas tshul byung rung lta rtogs byed mkhan zhig yong gi red/ lar nas 'tsho ba'i mdun lam rtsa ba nas brtan po zhig red/ gzhan gyi skyob gso ma bsten par rang gi 'tsho thabs byed pa'i thabs shes bzang shos gzhis chags bya rgyu 'di rang yin/nga tsho btsan byol bod mi rnams ni lhag par du yang gnas tshul dmigs bsal can zhig yin/ gang yin zer na/ gong du brjod pa ltar/ spyir btang 'dzam gling 'dir btsan byol ba mang po zhig yod pa de rnams rang rang gi lto 100

gos 'grigs tsam zhig byung na dgos pa de gcig pus 'grub pa yin/ dper na/ tang ga ri dang / apha ri ka/ hong kong la yod pa'i rgya mi btsan byol ba la sogs pa rnams rang rang nang khyim zhig chags/ lto gos 'grigs tsam byung na/ de las lhag pa nga tsho lta bur/ rang nyid khungs 'khyol bas mi 'grigs par mi rigs gcig khungs 'acadal ba'i bsam sdus btang nas tshang ma mnyam rub sgrig 'dzugs 'dzin dgos pa 'di lta bu gang yang med/ khong tsho shin tu stabs bde spro yin/ dper na/ hang ga ri lta bur 1955456 lo ngo log byung nas btsan byol ba 'bum phrag mang po byung yod kyang / khong tshor zla ba 'ga' shas ring 'phral sel gyi gsog sgar lta bu bzos/ de nas mi so so rang rang las ka gang thob sar phyin pa red/ de dag skad yig dang / shes yon mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i khyad par phran bu byung yod kyang / gtso che shos mi rigs rtsa stong 'gro ba'i nyen ka las srung skyob byed dgos pa'i dmigs yul gang yang med stabs las ka las sla por mjug bsdoms byed thub pa byung ba red/ nga tsho de lta bu gtan nas ma yin/ nga tsho yang khong tsho ltar sgor so so'i 'tsho ba'i mdun lam ston pa kho na'i ched du yin na 1960 lo nas las 'bos btsugs sku da pas da mtshams nga tsho'i las mjug bsdog thub kyi red/ gang yin zer na/ rgya gar nang sa gnas gang yod sar bod mi bcu skor/ nyi shu skor/ lnga bcu/ brgya skor sogs rim gtong byas na/ lngardzog mar skad ma shes pa'i dka' ngal phran bu yong rgyu yang / rim bzhin za skad 'thung skad phran bu shes te yul skad go brda 'phrod 'gro gi red/ de ltar byas na rgya gar gzhung la yang rnyog khra chung 101

ba/ nga tsho bod mi tsho yang 'di 'dra'i yun ring sgug sdod byed ma dgos pa yong rgyu yang / gal te nga tshos lag len de 'dra zhig byas pa yin na/ nang khyim re re'i 'tsho ba'i mdun lam ston rgyu'i cha nas ma 'grigs pa med kyang / nga tshos rang gi mi rigs gcig srung skyob 'dzugs skrun bya dgos pa'i cha nas 'grigs thabs nam yang med/ gal srid nga tshos 1960 lo tsam nas bod mi khyim tshang re re 'am/ tsho nyung thog nas gzhis chags byas te rgya gar grong gseb pa mang po zhig gi khrod du bod mi bcu sgor ram/ nyung shas shig slebs yod na/ da gzod gyon chas sogs gang 'tshams shig yongs su brjes zin/ da dung lo 10 20 tsam song na phal cher 'dres te/ deng dus rgya gar byang brgyud khul rta mang zhes pa de snga bod mi 'di khul lhags pa'i rgyud 'dzar red zer ba 'di tsho lta bur 'gyur srid/ 1959 nas lo 40450 song mtshams/ mi tshos 1959 lo bod du zing 'khrug byung nas btsan byol bod mi mang po rgya gar du yong ba de tsho'i rgyud 'dzar 'di tsho red ces brjod dgos pa dang 'ga' zhig nas bod skad tshig re zung shes pa dang / mang bas mi shes pa byung na tshar ba red/ de ltar bod mi kha stor gyis gzhis chags byas na tshang mar las sla zhing / stabs bde po'i ngang las mjug bsdogs thub pa zhig yod kyang / nga tshos mi rigs gcig gi bsam blo gtong dgos pa'i dbang gis de 'dra byas na 'grigs thabs med pa red/ de'i gnas tshul khyed rang tsho tshang mas shes kyi red/ der brten nga tshos dka' ngal chen po zhig dang du blangs te rgya gar dbus gzhung la bod mi stong phrag re zung las mi nyung ba mnyam sdod 102

thub pa'i sa cha dgos lugs re 'dun bton/ 'grel bshad byas pa dang / rgya gar dbus gzhung nas kyang bod mi stong phrag re zung dang / khri re zung gi gdong la bltas pa yang ma yin par/ mi rabs nas mi rabs 'brel ba yod pa'i lung pa phan tshun dang / mi rigs phan tshun gyi gnas tshul zhig la thug yod stabs phugs rgyang ring wa'i dmig sa yul yod pa'i bsam blo btang yod/ srid blon dam pa sku gshegs 'jo war lal gta ru nas kyang shin tu sha tsha chen pos khur bzhes thog bod mi btsan byol ba rnams nges par du tshogs pa che tsam byas te gzhis chags bya rgyu legs po 'dug ces mnga' sde khag so sor srid blon rang gi mtshan thog nas yi ge gtong rgyu sogs khur 'gan chen po bzhes yod/de 'dra'i nyer len gyi gzhis chags sa khul che khag 'ga' shas byung yod/ kha sa skad cha ji byung ltar/ mi la chog shes med pas da dung sdug skad rgyag gi yod/ rang yul du yod dus kyang sdug skad rgyag gi yod na/ mi yul la sdug skad los rgyag sdug sa nas bltas na da dung gra ma 'grigs dang / dka' ngal mang po 'dug ste/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas bsam gzhigs byas na/ da phan nga tsho goms pa yar rgyas gang legs phyin yod/ 1960 nas bzungs gzhis chags bya dgos pa dang / de yang 'tsho khag chen po zhig mnyam sdod byed thub pa'i 'bad brtson da nga / 'char 'god byas/ de don lag len 'gol bzhin byas pa red/ 'di la gnad 'gag chen po yod/de ltar bod mi rgan pa rnams mnyam sdod kyi gzhis chags byas pa de bzhin du/ bu phrug tsho'i slob grar yang de bzhin bsam blo btang yod/ 'dzam 103

gling 'di'i steng rang gi 'tsho ba skyel thub tsam gyi dmigs yul gcig pu yin na/ nga tshos bod kyi slob gra zur du 'dzugs dgos don gang yang med/ ldi lir bod kyi slob gnyer tshogs pa yang 'dzugs dgos don med/ rgya gar nang slob gra mang po 'di tsam yod pas slob gra re re'i nang bod phrug gnyis gsum re bgos gtong byas na/ ha lam nyi ma gcig la thag gcod thub kyi red/ 'on kyang nga tshos de ltar byas na/ gong gi gnas tshul dang 'dra bar/ bod phrug rnams la spyir btang rang gi lto gos 'tshol thub pa'i yon tan zhig yong gi red ma gtogs/ nga choge gad mi rigs kyi rnam 'gyur ma brlag par 'dzin thub thabs med/ dper na/ lha sa nas btang ba'i bod phrug 'di khul lo bcu skor bsdad pa tsho yang / bod skad dang / bod yig ji bzhin ma shes/ spyod pa dang rnam 'gyur yang brjes 'gro gi 'dug nga tshos mi so so'i lto gos 'phyid tsam ma yin par mi rigs gcig gi bsam blo gshetong dgos pa yin tsang / gzhis chags rnams kyang 'tsho khag 'tsho khag tu byed pa dang / slob gra yang bod kyi slob gra zhig rang zur du 'dzugs dgos pa'i rtsa ba'i gnad don de ltar yin pas na/gzhis chags rnams 'aces khag chen po zhig tu mnyam rub bya rgyu de bas kyang gal chen po zhig chags yod/ gong du brjod pa'i 'tsho ba nyin sto nyin 'tshol gyis sdod mkhan rnams khong rang tsho'i dus skabs rdzogs rjes bu phrug tshor bdag sprod byed mkhan yang yong dka' bas mi thog gcig nas rtsa med rang yal du 'gro nyen yod stabs de'i cha nas kyang gzhis chags rub sdod bya rgyu 'dir gnad gal chen po yod pa de ltar yin/ gzhis chags sgrig 'dzugs 'di 'dra zhig tu bod 104

mi mang po zhig mnyam nub tu yod na/ mi rgan pa tsho lam seng bsam blo bsgyur brjes mi thub pas/ bod phrug tsho'i klad pa lam seng bsgyur brjes 'gro bde po yod pa rnams kyang bod mi mang po yod pa'i gzhis chags 'di 'dra zhig nang skyes/ 'di 'dra zhig nang 'tshar longs byas rjes khong tsho lo 15 20 skor zin mtshams lam phyogs gzhan nas bsam blo gtong dgos pa byung yang / khong tsho'e bsam blor rang gi mi rigs de'i tshos lta bu zhig brgyab zin pas na nyen ka chung ba yin/ phyogs gzhan nas brjod na/ nga tsho gzhan yul du lo brgya nyis brgya skor sdod dgos pa yong gi lta ma red/ gal te de ltar byung srid na/da lta nga tsho'i gzhis chags byed stangs kyi 'char rtsis yod pa 'di lta bu'i legs po zhig byung na/ lo nyis brgya skor 11nga yang / mi rigs rgya ma bod ma yin pa'i bod rigs gtsang ma zhig dang / shes rig yin rung rgya ma bod ma yin par bod kyi shes rig gtsang ma zhig sdod thub kyi red/ nga tshos bsam blo sdug sa nas btang na/ nga tshor dpe blta sa zhig yod/ i si ral zhes pa'i yul mi de rnams dpe ma srid pa'i gyong po zhig byung 'dug khong tsho'i yul du dmag chen gnyis pa'i rjes su ma gtogs rang btsan ma byung ba red/ de'i gong lo stong phrag lhag gi ring khong tsho'i mi rigs mnyam rub byed ma thub par 'dzam gling sa phyogs mang por kha 'thor du sdod dgos byung rung / khong tshos rang gi mi rigs dang / chos la gces spras ha las pa'i chen po zhig byas/ gnyen sgrig byed stangs sogs gang ci'i thad nas rang rigs la gces zhen shin tu chen po byas te/ mthar khong tsho'i yul du rang btsan gyi so skabs thob ma thag 105

sa phyogs mang por yod pa'i mi rigs rnams lam seng mnyam 'dzoms rub sdod byas pa red/ khong tsho'i yul yang chen po min/ ngas nges brtan mi shes kyang bod kyi lho kha dwags kong bsgril ba'i rgya khyon tsam las med kyang / deng sang khong tsho ha cang gra 'grigs po dang / gyong po chags yod/ 1956 lo su'e dza mtsho lam skor rnyog gleng yong skabs khong tshos ha cang gyong po byas yod/do snang yod mkhan tshos shes kyi red/ de tsho'i rigs la nga chos do snang byas te khong tshos lo stong phrag gi ring la rang gi mi rigs dang / chos la gces spras byed stangs de tsho la nga tshos mig dpe bltas nas slob sbyong byed dgos/ nga tshor de 'dra'i dka' las rgyag dgos pa dang / dus yun sgug dgos pa lta yong mi srid kyang / sdug sa nas bsam ste de tshor mig dpe byas te bsam blo gtong rgyu gal chen 11 'dug rgyu mtshan de 'dra la bltas na yang / gzhis chags 'di 'dra zhig bya rgyu gal chen po yod/ da phan lo shas ring gi gnas tshul da lta las bsdoms nang brjod pa ltar red/ nged rang yang da res dang po min par de sngon thengs gcig 'dir yong zin pas/ de'i bar ha lam sa cha brjes pa lta bu'i yar rgyas gang legs phyin 'dug sa cha brjes pa lta bu bzo rgyu las sla po min/ nga tshor rang 'gul gyi 'khor lo ni med/ sor mo lnga yod pa'i rang gi lag pa bed spyod byas/ dka' las brgyab nas byung ba yin pa ngas shes kyi yod/ dka' las khag wang nges par byung yod/ dka' las brgyab pa de tshos nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi snying stobs dang / bod mi rigs kyi ngal rtsol gyi nus pa mtshon thub pa yin pas ha cang gzi brjid chen po yin/ chos khas len mkhan 106

dang / mi len mkhan su yin rung / gnam 'di'i 'og tu ngal rtsol las rtsa ba che ba med par tshang mas khas len byed kyi yod/ yang / nga tsho'i ngal rtsol 'di dag don chung snying po med pa min/ nga tsho'i ngal rtsol 'di ni rang gi nang khyim bu phrug tsam gyi ched du min par mi rigs gcig 'dzugs bskrun gyi ched du yin pa dang / mi rigs kyi 'dzugs bskrun de yang srid rkyang pa'i don du min par chos srid zung 'brel zhig gi ched du yin/ bsam blo phu thag ring po zhig brgyud nas brjod na/ nga tshos ma'e sor gzhis chags 'dzugs skrun byed pa 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don dang / 'dzam gling 'di'i steng chos ldan gyi mi rigs gcig gi don du 'dzugs skrun byas pa yin/ der brten nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi thog nas bshad na/ kha sa gleng mol byung don ltar/ bde ba rnams ni dam pa'i chos nyams su blangs pa las 'byung ba yin pas/ nga tshos dka' las rgyag pa ni chos kyi don du brgyab pa yin/ mdor na/ nga tshos ma'e sor gzhis chags 'di la dka' las brgyab pa rnams brgyud nas sems can thams cad kyi don du yin pas/ dka' las brgyab pa 'di gzi brjid chen spro yin/ don 'bras rlabs chen yod pa dang / 'di phyi gnyis yod yin/ der brten da phan dka' las brgyab pa rnams la bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'thor 'os pa yin la/ da dung yang ma'e sor 'di gzhis chags tshugs snga shos yin zhing / sa cha sogs gang nas kyang phyags re chen po yod pas khyed tsho tshang mas shugs brgyab ste rang 'tsho legs po zhig bya thub pa'i 'bad brtson shugs bskyed bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug nga tsho'i mi mang rnams sems shugs chen po gang legs 107

yod kyang / 'ga' shas nas bsam shes ma thongs pa'am/ dka' ngal bzod ma thub pa gang ltar gzhis khyim nas dgos pa gzhan med par yul gyar du phyin pa byung med dam bsam pa 'dug kha sa lta skor skabs khang stong re zung yang mthong rgyu 'dug de rnams blo chung ba'i skyon las/ bsam blo sdug pa ma red/de 'dra yong mi shes/ gang ltar byed stangs de ni ha cang thabs sdug po byas 'dug nga tshos rang gi mi rnams la legs pa zhig byung na bsam nas dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis thabs shes byas nas lag len du 'khel ba'i skabs rang mi 'ga' shas nas gshis ka slog pa lta bu byed skabs blo pham chen po 'dug nga snu'i) bod mi rnams gzhis chags bya rgyur sems shugs shin tu chen po yod ces rgya gar gzhung la ngo mtho ma༄ge byas nas shod kyi yod kyang / rang mi tshos gzhis sgar du ma bsdad par thon 'gro ba'i skabs rgya gar gzhung la mgo sgur sgur byas nas sdod rgyu las brjod rgyu khag po 'dug gzhi rtsa mi brgya phrag mang po'i nang bsam blo ma 'khor mkhan re gnyis yong srid kyang / de lta bu byas na yag po ma red/ shin tu thabs sdug po red/ de 'dra'i skyon ma lhags pa nges par du byed dgos kyi 'dug de 'dra'i skyon lhags dus/ bar lam rogs ram byed mkhan mi gal che ba rgyal tshogs khongs skyabs bcol bar lta rtogs byed mkhan las khungs shig yod 'dug pa de'i las byed pa zhig yod pa khong de gong rgya gar du thengs gcig yong myong zhing / nye dus nga 'di phyogs yong khar thug 'phrad byung skabs 'phros mol du/ khong nas de snga rgya gar du yong skabs ma'e sor gzhis chags dang / o ri sa/ ma de'i par sde zhi bcas gzhis chags 108

khag la lta 〈(ra byas pa yin/ da cha khyodan gsal ྅ge zhu na/ gzhis chags khag nang bod mi chor gzhis chags byed rgyu'i sems shugs chen po mi 'dug zer gyi 'dug khong gis brjod pa brgya cha brgya bden 'dzin bya dgos pa min yang /khong la mthong tshul de 'dra zhig byung 'dug nga tsho phyogs mang spro zhig dang bstun nas las ka byed dgos pas bsam tshad 'grub rgyu khag 21 'dug ces brjod rgyu byung / ngas bden pa'i khungs skyel byed ma dgos par sa gnas rang la zhib tu bltas na/ sa cha phyi nang phyogeg pa 'di dag lag pas dka' las brgyab nas byung ba ma gtogs/ nga tshos rdul phran gyi nus shugs bed spyod byas med/ de ltar mang tshogs nas shugs bskyed byas kyang / re zung gi byed stangs la brten nas mthong tshul ngan pa de ltar yong gi 'dug pas phyin chad mthong tshul de rigs mi 'byung ba nges par ma byas na shin tu thabs sdug po 'dug skyon chen po 'dugayang mi de gas brjod gsal/ da phan bod mi tshos skyob gso la brten nas bsdad pa red/ da cha skyob gaskurdzo gang mgyogs bcad na legs pas/ rgya gar gzhung la yang bsam 'char gtong gi yin zer gyi 'dug de yang khong gis bsam blo sdug po byas nas bshad pa min yang / bod mi tshos las ka ma spyid par 'di mur bsdad na skyob gso zhig ni 'dug bsam pa byed kyi yod pa'i mthong tshul byung ba'i rkyen gyis skyob gso bcad na legs pa'i bsam tshul de byung ba red/nga tshos nang gi las kur yang hur brtson byed dgos la/ phyi ru rnam 'gyur bstan phyogs kyang gzab gzab bya gal chen 1sgo 'dug pas/ khyed tsho tshang mas gzhis chags 'oder sems shugs che skyed kyis hur thag bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug109

de rnams khyed rang mos blo la 'jags pa byed dgos/de nas kha sa skad cha ji byung ltar/ lam bzo khag gi gnas tshul rnams ni dka' ngal chen po'i ngang bsdad 'dug pa las/ las sla po nam yang med/de bzhin bsam blo rgya che sa nas btang na/ nga tsho'i chol gsum rode rigs gcig tu bsgril na phal cher grangs 'bor 'bum 70480 tsam yod kyi red/ de'i khongs nas rgya gar sogs khyim mtshes yul khag nang 'byor pa khri 748 las med pas/ rtsa ba'i nga tsho'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams ni rang yul bod du nga tshos mi 'dod pa byed pa'i dgra lag twa tshud nas lus yod/ khyim mtshes yul khag tu 'byor ba'i khongs nas kyang bal yul nangayod pa tshor mtshon na nga tshos brjod mi thub pa'i dka' sbyong nyen ga chen po zhig byung stabs rgya gar gzhung gi dgag cha yod med la ma ltos par nye dus sa mtshams nas sdig pa mig btsums kyis 'dzul nas dha ram sa lar 'byor pa yang byung song / khong tshos kha nas sdug skad brgyab pa tsam min par nga tshos gdong dang gdong gtugs nas lta dus khong tsho'i gdong mdog ser por gyur pa dang / lhag par bu phrug de rnams ni shin tu kha thabs skyo po/ bod du yi dwags kyi gzugs brnyan ri mor bris pa dang ha lam khyad med pa lta bu 'dug bal yul nang bod mi chig khri lhag tsam yod/khyed rang tshos go thos yod shag ltar bal yul nas bod mi mang po bod du phyir log byas 'dug khong tsho rang yul du log pa de phugs bzang ba gtan nas min kyang / tshur phyogs na togs shir 'gro ba'i dka' ngal zhig dang 'phrad/phar phyogs na rgya mis 'phral sel mgo skor bslu khrid byas te phar 'gro mkhan 110

tshor mgron khang med sar mawa1na khang brgyab/ 'bru rtsam med sar 'bru rtsam bsags/ ja drangs/ dga' bsu sne len byas/ phyir log yong ca/khan la srid gras gru yangs yod ces don tshan 'ga' shas yod pa'i yi ge bkrams/ de 'dra byas 'dug de yang rgya mi'i dmag dpon las byed chung rtsag gis byas pa min par bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig lhan khang dang / bod dmag khul khang zung 'brel gyis bkrams pa'i yig cha'i thog nas dril bsgrags byas te bod mi phyir log byed pa'i thabs shes mang po byed kyi 'dug der brten khong tsho rtsa ba'i bsam blo sdug pa min yang / 'u thug thabs zad kyis gnas skabs phyir log mi byed thabs med byung ba red/ de tsho'i gnas lugs kyang khyed tshos nges par shes dgos/ de bzhin du 'brug la mtshon yang / bod mi gsar 'byor sum stong lhag tsam yod pa gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul gang legs yod kyang / da dung dka' ngal mang po zhig yod pas 'brug nas yong mkhan chos rgya gar nang bod mi'i gnas stangs la yid smon chen po byed kyi 'dug de gong rgya thang la tsha ba che bas bod mi shi gi yod lugs go thos kyis 'brug nang bsdad pa da cha rgya gar nang gi yar rgyas kyi gnas lugs mthong thos yong dus 'brug nang sdod nyes byung zer mkhan yang 'dug de tsho'i gnas lugs kyang shes dgos kyi 'dugadon snying rang re'i pha yul na rgya dmar gyi btsan 'og tshud pa'i bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams las rang dbang khyim mtshes yul khag nang yod pa'i rang re bod mi khri 7 8 tsam yod pa 'di rnams kyi gnas stangs legs pa dang / rang dbang yul khag nang 'byor pa'i nang nas kyang rgya gar nang yod pa rnams shin 111

tu legs pa yod/ rgya gar du khri bzhi lnga tsam yod pa'i khongs nas kyang lam bzo dang / gzhis chags kyi gnas stangs bsdur na gzhis chags khag la yod pa 'di rnams legs pa yod/ gzhis chags gtso che shos ma'e sor dang / o ri sa/ ma rda'i par sde zhi/ zhe pha bcas la bod mi lnga stong tsam dang / lag shes pa'i gzhis chags phran bu bcas nyung shas las gzhis chags thub med/ de byings mang che ba lam bzor yod/ lam bzo khag ni ngas gong du brjod pa ltar dka' ngal chen po'i ngang bsdad yod/ de ltar bod mi rigs 'bum phrag 70480 skor yod pa'i nang la zhib rtsis zhig brgyab na/ gzhis chags la yod pa rnams ngo thog skyid po red/ bsam blo gtong shes na ngo thog skyid po red/nga tsho rang yul bral nas mi yul du bsdad yod stabs dka' ngal phran bu phran bu nges par yong gi red/ nga rang la yang de 'dra yong gi 'dug de snga 1956lo rgya gar du gnas skor la yong dus kyi gnas tshul gcig dang / de rjes 1959 lo rgya gar la btsan byol du yong dus gnas tshul gzhan gcig red/rtsa ba yong sa'i yul yang rgya gar 'di rang yin la/ yong mkhan nga rang yang mi gcig yin rung / gnas tshul mang po zhig la 'gyur ba chen po byung yod/skabs re 1956 lo'i snang ba 'char ba'i skabs lam seng bsam blo gtong skyor zhig byas te/ ya/ da cha nga tsho btsan byol ba yin/ 1956 lo rtsa ba rgya mi'i 'og tu bsdad nas dka' ngal chen po zhig yod de btsan byol ba'i ming thogs med/ 1959 lo rgya gar du 'byor dus rtsa ba rgya mi'i btsan gnon de'i 'og nas thar rung / rang yul bral ba'i btsan byol ba'i ming zhig thogs 112

yod/ de 'a dra'i bsam sdud gtong dus gzhi nas snying la na tsha gtong gi 'duga'on kyang nga tshos 'a di mur bsdad pas phan pa med stabs nga tsho dka' las shig brgyab/ bzod bsran byas nas 'bad brtsodan byed dgos/ nga tsho rang yul bral zin pas dka' las sku(nga rgyur thag snubad chod pa yin/ dka' las shig brgyab na bden pa'i mtha' gsal gyi red snyam du rang gis rang la blo spobs bskyed dgos pasku/nga gi 'dug gnas tshul de bod mi byings la'ang 'dra mtshungs yin/ de snga 1956 lo bod mi gnas skor ba mang po yong / de skabs chu tshod dang / smyug ga ther ma la sogs pa nyo cha mang po brgyab sku(da kyang 1959lo tshang ma skyo po sha stag red/ don snying nga tsho tshang ma btsan byol ba chags pa red/ dper na/ nged la rgya gar gzhung gi sku mgron yin zhes bka' drin chen po gnang skustod kyang / sku mgron ngo ma de btsan byol ba zhig red/ nga tshor rang gi lung pa ni med/ tshig gzhan nas bshad na/ nga tsho yul gyar ba dang /sprang po lta bu yin/ skyob gso zhes ming snyan po btags rung / don snying sprang po la lto gos sbyin pa lta bu yin pas/ shin tu skyo po red/ rgyu mtshan de 'drar brten nga tshos dka' las da res ma rgyag na ga dus rgyag nga tshos rang gi mi rigs 'dzugs skrun byed dgos la/ chos 'dzugs skrun byed dgos/ pha khyim 'dzugs skrun byed dgos/ dka' las yong gi red de/ khyed tshos da phan yang hur thag byas yod cing / da dung yang dka' ngal bzod sran byas nas hur thag nges par du bya rgyu gal chen nyuge 'dugartsa ba'i gzhis chags nang sgrig 'dzugs kyi rigs gang legs 'dug da 113

dung sgrig 'dzugs la gal cher 'dzin dgos/ rgya mi'i sgrig 'dzugs lta bu ni btsan gaphyogen shugs che'i 'og gnas sku da pas btsan gcerdzon gyi sgrig 'dzugs la legs rgyu gang yang med/ nga tsho'i sgrigs 'dzugs 'di dag ni btsan gnon gyi sgrig 'dzugs min par rang dbang ldan pa'i sgrig 'dzugs yin/ rang dbang ldan pa'i sgrig 'dzugs ni gal gnad chen por 'dzin dgos pa ma gtogs/ sgrig 'dzugs zhes brjod pa dang lam seng rna ba'i nang na zug skyes nas de thub stod byed mkhan lta bur go na de ni go ba log sgrub yin pa las/ go ba yang dag pa ma yin/ nga tshor sgrig 'dzugs med na/ mi rigs 'dzugs bskrun zhes pa shin tu khag po yin/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang nang pa sangs rgyas kyi cesas 'dzin pa dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde dgos pas na/ dge slong gcig bzos nas ma bzhag par/ dge 'dun bzhi grwa 'dus pa yan la dge 'dun du ming btags shing / gzhi gsum gyis mtshon pa'i dge 'dun gyi las su bya ba gang na ci yod pa thams cad dge 'dun gros bsdur thugs mthun nas thag bcad pa ma gtogs/ dge slong gcig la dbang cha sprad pa med/ de sgrig 'dzugs red/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar bcom ldan 'das ni 'gro la gcig tu phan pa'i dgongs pa las/ kho nga nas sems can la btsan gnon gtong ba'i dgongs pa med/ sgrig 'dzugs yod na des phan gyi yod stabs bcom ldan 'das kyis de ltar gnang yod na/ nga tshos chos srid zung 'brel gyi mi rigs shig 'dzu gas bskrun byed pa la nges par sgrig 'dzugs med na mi 'grigs pas sgrig 'dzugs la tshang mas dga' po byed dgos pa las/ sgrig 114

'dzugs rna bar 'gro mi 'dod pa byed mi rung /go bsdur byed pa'i skabs kha dang / zhal lta bu yong mi shes pas tshang mas rang rang gi bsam tshul gang yod gsal por shod dgos/ dper na/ nga tsho bzhugs mol snurags 'du zhig tshogs pa yin na/ 7rgyal ba rin po che zhes ngas gang bshad yang dag pa'i bka' dang / spyir btang mi zhig gi bshad pa der cha 'jog med pa lta bu yong mi shes/ go bsdur byed skabs sgor sgor gral la go rim med ces pa ltar sgor sgor byas nas go bsdur bya rgyu gal chen po yin/yang rtsa ba'i sgrig 'dzugs la 'go mjug yod dgos/ de yang drang zhing tshad pa zhig dgos pa las/ btsan dbang dang / 'bu ches chung zos lta bus mi 'grigs/ 'bu ches chung zos rigs la rtsa ba nas ngo rgol byed dgos/ mi rigs che chung gi 'bu ches chung zos dang / gral rim phan tshun 'bu ches chung zos/ chos lugs phan tshun 'bu ches chung zos/ bla slob bar lta bu gang la yang 'bu ches chung zos byas na ngo rgol byed dgos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang dgongs pa de ltar bzhes yod/ gang ltar chen pos chung ngur btsan gnon byed pa'i rigs la rtsa ba nas ngo rgol byed dgos/ 'on kyang ya rabs drang po'i sgrig 'dzugs dang 'brel ba'i 'go 'khrid pas 'go 'khrid/ nyan mkhan gyis nyan dgos pa'i gnas tshul de dag tshul dang mthun par bya dgos pa las rang dbang dang / mang gtso yod ces go ba log sgrub byas na mi 'grigs pas sgrig 'dzugs la rtsa ba chen por 'dzin rgyu 'di tshang mas snying la bcangs dgos/'di gar gzhis chags 'go byed pas kyang da phan hur thag byas yod 115

la da dung yang byed rgyur/ khyed tshos yid ches dang / cha 'jog byas chog gi red/ de bzhin sdod sgar gyi 'thus mi tsho yang khyed rang tsho mang mos kyi 'dems bsko byas payin pas/ khong tshor cha 'jog dang / nyan 'jog byed dgos/ gal srid dge skyon yod na/ mdun du bshad sbyang byed dgos pa las/ rgyab tu gang byung bshad na sgrig 'dzugs gtor bshig la 'gro gi red/ da dung gzhis chags nang brgya shog brgya dpon sogs rim pa bzhin bya spu gnon du yod pa rnams nas kyang / spyir btang 'dzam gling gi 'gro lugs ltar bshad na/ drang pos gzhung bsrang byed dgos la/ bod gangs can pa ltar na/ las rgyu 'bras dpang du bzhag nas 'gro dgos pas/ 'go khrid tshos kyang de bzhin du byed kyi red la byed kyang dgos pa yin/ de ltar 'go 'khrid pa de la khyed cho mang phyogs nas kyang nyan dgos la/ cha 'jog byed dgos/ yid ches bya dgos pa las/gang byung byas na las don ji 'dra zhig yin kyang 'thus shor 'gro rgyu las/ ji bzhin 'grub rgyu khag po red/ de tsho nges par du khyed tshos blo nges bya dgos/de nas 'di gar mnyam 'brel tshong khang yod/ 'di skor/ spyir deng dus 'dzam gling na spyi sa mnyam rub byed pa gcig dang / sger gyi khe phan 'ba' zhig spyod pa'i lugs gnyis yod/ dmar po'i lta ba'i nang mnyam 'brel la gtsigs su 'dzin pa yin/ ma rtsa'i yul khaga.a mi ri ka lta bur sgor gyi khe phan gathorwa ngar 'dzin pa'i lta ba zhig yod/ de gnyis /ra legs cha yang yod la skyon yang yod/ mtha' gcig tu mnyam 'brel 'ba' zhig ma gtogs sger gyi khe phan til 'bru tsam med pa bzos na/ dmar po'i lta ba'i nang thog mar 116

de 'dra zhigasku1da kyang / lag len dngos su 'gol ba'i skabs sger gyi khe phan rtsa med kyis spyi tshogs mnyam 'brel bya rgyu de mi rang yin stabs yong thub kyi med pa red/ u ru su'i nang mtshon na/ dmar por gyur nas lo 40 skor song ba de snga le nin dang / si ṭa lin la sogs pa yod skabs dam po yod kyang ma yin khob dang / khur zhi chob la sogs par rim bzhin rdzod yangs su phyin/ gu yangs su phyin yod/ bsam blo gu yangs po gtong gi yod red/gang yin zer na/ lo nas lo bstud lag len byed pa'i tshe sgor gyi khe phan rtsa ba nas med par spyi tshogs mnyam sdeb 'ba' zhig bya rgyu de mi'i bsam blor mi ran pa zhig yong gi yod pa red/ rgya nag la mtshon na/ mi mang spyi khang la sogs pa btsugs nas las 'gul shugs chen po zhig byas yod kyang da cha sgo lug pa red/ der brten nga tshos kyang mtha' gcig tu spyi tshogs mnyam sdeb kho na'i thog 'gro rgyur yang skyon zhig yod/yang mtha' gcig tu sgor gyi khe phan 'ba' zhig gi thog tu phyin nas mnyam 'brel gyi rigs rtsa ba nas ma dgos par bsam na de yang nor 'khrul red/ mnyam 'brel la yang dge mtshan shin tu chen po yod/ lhag par nga tshos mi rigs gcig gi 'dzugs skrun byed kyi yod pa dang / gnyis nas deng dus nga tshor dka' ngal yod pa'i dus tshod yin/ rang yul min par mi yul du slebs/ mi yul du yang 'tsho ba'i phra gzhi nas tshugs rgyu'i dus skabs yin pas/ mnyam 'brel bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug des na/ nga chos sger gyi khe phan yod la/ spyi tshogs mnyam 'brel gyi nus pa yang yod pa'i phyogs 117

gnyis sha'i legs cha len thub pa byung na/ ngas da gin brjod pa'is si ral zhes pa'i lung pa der yang gnyis ka yod lugs go thos byung / phyin chad bod la'ang nges par du mnyam 'brel gyi nus pa 'don pa dang / sger gyi khe phan la'ang shugs rgyag rgyu gnyis yod gcig byung na mi mang la bde skyid 'byung ba dang /rgyal khab tshags su tshud pa yong thub kyi med dam bsam pa 'dug der brten gzhis sgar 'di 'dra'i nang la yang da mus gnyis ka yod na legs po red/'ga' shas nas sger gyi khe phan gtso bzung byas nas mnyam 'brel la do snang chung skyon skurdzong gi med dam snyam/ de 'dra byas na nor 'khrul red/ mnyam 'brel byas na spyi'i khe phan ha cang rlabs chen po zhig 'byung ba yin pas nga tshos gnyis khyedags la bsam blo btang na yag po min nam snyam/ de cadan skad cha byung ba ltar mang po zhig nas las 'gul byas te to tshang bsgril ba byung yod pa red/ de tshor rang gi thab logs su zin pa lta bu'i rang 'dod ltar bya rgyu med par spyi thab la bstun dgos pa'i dka' ngal 'ga' zhig yod kyang / spyi'i 'gro gron che chung dang / las ku'i nus shugs sogs gang nas bltas kyang to tshang bsgril ba la dge mtshan mang poyod nges red/ de tshor yang do snang byed dgos/de snga a sar lta bus mnyam 'brel zhig btsugs/ lo rim song gis 'od je chung du phyin nas yal 'gro ba byas na mi legs/ phyin chad gzhis chags yongs rdzogs tshags su tshud/ rang rang la dngul dngos ldeng nges 'dum nges byung ba'i mtshams rang 'dod ltar byas rung khyad par med/ de las sla po yin/ da lta mi ldeng / mi 'dum zhes skad ngan rgyag bzhin pa'i skabs da dung 'gro gron 118

'phar ma btang na dgos pa gang yang med pas de tsho sems la nges pa bya dgos/de bzhin 'dir bde don tshogs pa zhig yod/ tshogs pa'i 'gro stangs 'di yang da lta'i skabs 'dir phan thogs yod la/ phyin chad bod du log nas kyang tshogs pa'i 'gro stangs bzo rgyu gal chen po min nam snyam/ phyogs gcig nas las ka yang byas/ phyogs gcig nas 'di tsho'i 'gro stangs gang 'dra zhig yod med slob sgrong do snang byas na phan thogs med dam snyam pa 'dug sgrig 'dzugs che chung la ma ltos par tshang mar mang tshogs nas slob sbyong bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug de nas glang sha la do snang bya rgyu'i skor la gong du skad cha byung ba ltar tshang mas do snang byed bzhin yod kyang / da dung phran bu klan ka yong gi med dam snyam pa 'dug nga tsho rgya gar nang mnga' sde zhig gi grong gseb tu bsdad yod pas yul mi tshos lha'i rigs lta bur dad pa dang / rtsi 'jog byed sa de sku gzims zhus na/ de ni nyen kha chen po yin/ legs po rtsa ba nas med/ de la tshang mas gzab gzab byas na ma garke(gas/ de la klan ka lhags na mi re zung bar dga' min dga' dogs byung ba lta bu min par mi rigs so so'i chos dang /shes rig gi 'brel ba yod pa'i rtsa don zhig yin stabs rgya che'i mi mang rang dang 'gal zlar 'gro rgyu'i nyen ga yod/ de la khyed rang tshos nges par du yid gzab byed dgos/ de la do snang chen po byed dgos/ de bzhin mnga' sde 'di'i nang chang rag lag len mi chog pa yin na yang / bod mi tsho rang yul dang bral/sems pa skyo po'i ngang / tsha ba'i nang las ka byed dgos stabs rang gi skom 119

chang phran bu spyod bed mi bya mthu med byung b.ra.a'o tsama.e yin/ de min mngon gsal dod po'i thog nas rang gis spyod pa dang / gzhan la sbyin pa/ tshong ba/ de yang rgya gar bar tshong sbyin sogs byas na shin tu skyon chen po yin pas gzab gzab bya dgos/nga tsho rgya gar gyiyul du gnasayod khas bod kyi kha dper yul chu btung nas yul khrims 'khur zhes pa ltar/ gong gi gnas tshul de tsho rgya gar ba'i yul srol yin pas yul khrims la rtsi bkur bya dgos pa las/ nga cho gengad mi yin pas rgya gar ba'i khrims lugs la brtsi mi dgos bsam na nor 'khrul red/de nas rgya gar yul mi tshor mthun sgril bya rgyu gal chen po yod/ mi bye brag pa mi re ngo re'i cha nas bod mir mthong chung khyad gsod byed mkhan nges par yong gi red de/ rtsa ba ni nga tshos rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul zhes 'bod pa ltar/ bod mi dge phrug dang / rgya gar nga tsho'i dge rgan lta bu yin/ bsam blo btang na/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bcom ldan 'das byung med na/ nga tsho'i bod da dung mun pa'i gling du sdod kyi red/ nga tsho mgo btegs btegs 'di byed mi thub/ de bzhin rgya gar rang dbang gi yul 'di bod dang lo stong phrag ring gi 'bre la ba yod pa'i nyer len gyis nga tsho btsan byol bar rgyar te mi yul du slebs pa'i tshe khyim mtshes rgyal khab 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra tsam gyis nga tshor bdag sprod dang / gces skyong byed pa 'di dag bka' drin chen po red/ bod mi tshang mas mis tshur byed stangs bzang ngan la ma ltos par nga rang tsho'i phar byed stangs kyi thad la/bod mi tsho tshul mthun snyom chung legs 120

po 'dug zer rgyu'i mthong tshulayod pa zhig nges par dgos kyi red/ des phyogs gcig nas 'phral sel la'ang dgos pa yod cing / phyags rgyang ring po'i cha nas kyang dgos pa chen po yod/ tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ ngas gnas tshul phran bu brjod na/ nga tsho bod kyi bde skyid dang / rgya gar gyi bed skyid gnyis mgo mjing sbrel nas bsdad yod/ rgya gar 'di lo nyis brgya lhag gi ring dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul 'og tu tshud nas stobs shugs chen po rgyas ma thub pa dang 1947 lo gzhi nas rang btsan byung ste yun ring ma song ba'i mur 1949450 bod du rkyen ngan byung nas bod phung pa red/ de dag gtso che shos bod pa rang gis lan yod kyang / rgya gar dpung stobs zhan pa'i rkyen gyis kyang nyer len byas yod pa red/ bod la 1951 nas bzung gnas tshul je sdug tu phyin nas da lta'i char rgya gar la yang 'di 'dra'i nyen ga chen po zhig chags yod/ rgya gar gyi 'bras zhing tsho'i nang dka' sdug chen po spyad/ nyin re.a na 'ga' shas kyis rang gi grod pa brgyangs nas sdod mkhan tshos dka' las brgyab nas bsags pa de da cha rgya gar byang rgyud sa mtshams su 'gro song sgor sa ya mang po 'gro gi yod/ bod la bde skyid dang / rang dbang zhig yod na rgya gar gyi byang rgyud la dmag mi dgos don med la/ 'gro song gtong dgos don med/ da cha bod kyi rang dbang nyams pa des rgya gar rang gi don la ha cang gnod rkyen chen por gyur yod/ der brten bod dang / rgya gar gyi bde skyid la 'brel ba chen po yod/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus la mtshon na/ rgya gar dpung stobs chung ba'i rkyen gyis bod phungs/ bod phungs pa des rgya gar la gnod 121

pa de bzhin du phyin chad bod yul legs po byung na rgya gar du skyid po yong nges yin/ gnas lugs de rgya gar gzhung dang / rgya gar mi mang gis gsal po shes kyi yod pa red/ rgya gar ba rnams bcom ldan 'das 'khrungs yul gyi mi shes ldan zhig yin pas nges par bod la phan pa'i bsam blo gtong rgyu yin par ngas thag gcod thub pa yin/ de snga rgya gar dpon rigs 'ga' re'i bsam tshul du 'dzam gling shar phyogs su stobs shugs che shos rgya nag dang / rgya gar yin/ de gnyis spyi tshogs kyi 'gro stangs tha dad yin kyang / rtsa don lnga gzhi bzhag gi lag pa sbrel thub na/ nub khyedags rgyal khab la mgo rgyug cig gzhu thub pa'i re ba byas kyang da cha de ltar ma byung / 1962 lo'i gnas tshul des 'char gzhi tshang ma 'khrugs pa red/ de 'dra'i bsam tshul phran bu yod mkhan tsho yang da cha klad pa gtsang mar bkrus te da cha bod la bde skyid ma byung na rgya gar la bde skyid mi yong bar kha gcig grags lta bur gyur yod/ rgya gar gyi bde skyid de bod kyi bde skyid la 'brel ba yod stabs/ bod kyi bde skyid des bod mi smos ci/ rgya gar la yang phan gyi yod pa red/ ngas thag gcod mi thub kyang nga rang gi bsam tshod byas na/ nga tsho'i sgrub bya ni bod kyi rang dbang yin/ da cha rgya gar gyis kyang bod rang dbang yong ba'i lam gcig gi thog tu rim pas yong gi med dam snyam/ de ni bsam blo'i stod dpag tsam las rgya gar gzhung gi bsam tshul 'di red ces ngas brjod pa min pas de 'drar ngos 'dzin byas na mi 'grigs/ da dung 1965466 tsam bar sgug na rim bzhin gsal po yong mdog kha po red/ der brten ma 'ongs pa'i char bod 122

kyi rang dbang yong bar gtso che shos bod mi rang gis 'bad brtson byed dgos kyang / phyi'i rkyen bzang shos rgya gar la thug pa lta bu yod/ 'ga' shas kyi bsam par nga tshora.a ri nas skyob gso mang po btang yod pasa.a ris bod rang btsan sprod thub mi yong ngam bsam na.a ris sprod mi thub/ gal che shos rgya gar rang la thug yod/ der brten rgya gar gyi mi shes ldan ya rabs tshos nga choge ngad mir zhe thag pa nas dga' po byas te nga tsho bu spun yin zer gyi yod pa red/ sha mdog dang / bzo dbyibs nas bu spun mi 'dra yang / lo rgyus kyi gnas lugs la gzhigs na nga tsho ngo thog bu spun yin/ nga tshos rgya gar la mthun 'brel gang gzab byed dgos/ las byed pa'i cha nas byas na/ nga tsho dha ram sa lar lung khyag grong gseb gzi brjid gang yang med kyang / dzña ram sa la dang / sdi lir 'brel ba mi dman tsam yod cing / rgya che'i mi mang nas kyang 'brel ba legs po zhig bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug de ni sger pa gcig gi don du brjod pa ma yin/ bod spyi'i don du rgya gar dang 'brel ba legs po dgos gal chen po red ces brjod pa yin pas yul mi rgya gar ba rlung lang mdog kha po tshor mthong chung khyad gsod ma byas par mthun 'brel legs po byed dgos/de nas bod don spyi'i gnas tshul skor brjod na 1959 lo nas da bar yar rgyas chen po phyin yod/ mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs nang bod don skor gros chod thengs gnyis bzhag yod pa'i gros chod dang po 'gro ba mi'i kun spyod thob thang skor dang / gnyis par rang thag rang gcod ces pa'i tshig gcig yod pa de gnad chen po yin pa red/ srid don mkhas pa tshos brjod tshul ltar 123

na/ rang btsan zhes pa dmar 'don brgyab pa lta bu dang / rang thag rang gcod ces par don gyi rang btsan tshang ba'i tshig gnad chen po zhig yin 'dug der brten rgyal tshogs nang la yang gang la gang 'tshams kyi rgyal kha thob yod pa dang /lhag par 'di lo ring min tshugs rgyu'i rgyal tshogs nang bod don skyar du zhu rtsis yod/ da phan rgya gar bar gnas su bsdad yod kyang / 'phral phyags bsam blo rgya che gtong dgos pa'i stabs kyis gros chod kyi tshig don rtsub po min pa zhig byung na 'di lo rgya gar gzhung gis rgyab skyor gnang rgyu'i khas len gtsang ma gnang byung / de stor nye dus gsar shog thog tu yang dril bsgrags byas yod pa red/ de tsho 'gyur ba chen po red/ bar skabasa.u ru sus mtshon pa'i dmar po'i rgyal khab tshos ngo rgol byas yod/ rgyal tshogs nang khong tsho'i bod don srid byus la lam seng 'gyur ba chen po yong min brjod mi thub kyang / rgya nag dang /ru su'i dbar gyi 'brel ba dza drag po'i thog tu slebs yod/ thog ma'i rtsod gzhi lta ba mi mthun pa las byung yang rim bzhin zla ba gcig song gnyis song mtshams gnas tshul gzhan du 'gyur te da cha khur zhi cob dang / maca dmi tung gi bar dngos su skyon 'dzugs byed res byung / nye char rgya nag gis ru sur skyon brjod byas par khur zhi ceb kyis lan 'debs byas pa zhig nang / rgya nag gong ma tshos nang sog dang / bod/ shing cang sogs dbang bsgyur byas lugs brjod pa dang / de bzhin ru su'i nang bod skor deb thon pa dang ༄/ yang / dbyin yul khul ru su'i deb kyi tshong khang nang ngas bris pa'i deb tshong giyod pa sogs gnas tshul mang po zhig la 'gyur ba yong gi yod pa red/ nub phyogs rgyal 124

na/ rang btsan zhes pa dmar 'don brgyab pa lta bu dang / rang thag rang gcod ces par don gyi rang btsan tshang ba'i tshig gnad chen po zhig yin 'dug der brten rgyal tshogs nang la yang gang la gang 'tshams kyi rgyal kha thob yod pa dang /lhag par 'di lo ring min tshugs rgyu'i rgyal tshogs nang bod don skyar du zhu rtsis yod/ da phan rgya gar bar gnas su bsdad yod kyang / 'phral phyags bsam blo rgya che gtong dgos pa'i stabs kyis gros chod kyi tshig don rtsub po min pa zhig byung na 'di lo rgya gar gzhung gis rgyab skyor gnang rgyu'i khas len gtsang ma gnang byung / de stor nye dus gsar shog thog tu yang dril bsgrags byas yod pa red/ de tsho 'gyur ba chen po red/ bar skabasa.u ru sus mtshon pa'i dmar po'i rgyal khab tshos ngo rgol byas yod/ rgyal tshogs nang khong tsho'i bod don srid byus la lam seng 'gyur ba chen po yong min brjod mi thub kyang / rgya nag dang /ru su'i dbar gyi 'brel ba dza drag po'i thog tu slebs yod/ thog ma'i rtsod gzhi lta ba mi mthun pa las byung yang rim bzhin zla ba gcig song gnyis song mtshams gnas tshul gzhan du 'gyur te da cha khur zhi cob dang / maca dmi tung gi bar dngos su skyon 'dzugs byed res byung / nye char rgya nag gis ru sur skyon brjod byas par khur zhi ceb kyis lan 'debs byas pa zhig nang / rgya nag gong ma tshos nang sog dang / bod/ shing cang sogs dbang bsgyur byas lugs brjod pa dang / de bzhin ru su'i nang bod skor deb thon pa dang ༄/ yang / dbyin yul khul ru su'i deb kyi tshong khang nang ngas bris pa'i deb tshong giyod pa sogs gnas tshul mang po zhig la 'gyur ba yong gi yod pa red/ nub phyogs rgyal 124

khab chos bod don la rgyab skyor byed bzhin pa dang / bar gnas rgyal khab mang po zhig rgyagar gzhung la blta bzhin yod pas rgya gar gzhung gis rgyab skyor byas na khong tso la yang 'gyur ba yong re yod/ ru su dang / sog po sogs nas rgyal tshogs nang nga tshor rgyab skyor byed min la ma ltos par nang gi bsam blo'i thog 'gyur ba byung yod/ de tsho chung chung namasang min zhing / de tsho nga tshos thabs shes byas nas bsgrub thub pa zhig ma yin/ de dag stes dbang stabs legs kyis byung ba'am/ chos phyogs nas bshad na/ bden pa'i mtha' gsal ba zhig yin/ 'tham gling 'di'i steng nga tsho sa 'og gi 'bu srin tsam las med kyang / bden pa'i rgyal kha chen po thob bzhinaspend/ de dag ni las rgyu 'bras yod pa'i rtags bstan pa yin/ gal te rgyu 'bras med na 'dzam gling 'di'i steng nga tsho lta bu'i lung pa chung chung mang poyod pa de rnams re ba rgyag yul med/der brten ngas bden pa rtsa ba chen po red ces de sngon nas brjod pa ltar da cha bden pa'i gzi byin che ru che ru 'gro gi 'dug rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul jog bod don 1959 lo las gnas tshad ha cang mtho ru phyin yod pa dang / rgya gar dang / nga tsho'i bar yang 1959 lo nas gzhi mgang legs yod kyang /skabs re srid don gyi lta stangs 'ga' shas mi mthun pa chags yod/ da cha rim bzhin thag je nyer 'gro bzhin pa red/gtso che shos bod rang dbang yong dang mi yong ni/ gzhis byes bod mi rnams kyi 'bad rtsol la rag lus yod pa dang / byes 'byor mi mang rnams nas kyang lhag bsam dang bcas dka' las brgyab dang rgyag mus red/ gzhis 125

lus bod rgya che'i mi mang la mtshon na/ ha cang sems shugs chen po yod pa dang / lo re nas lo re rgya mir mi dga' ba je cher 'gro bzhin pa red/ rgya nag nang khul la'ang dmar wa'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan rgan pa tsho'i bsam tshul dang /rgya nag gi gzhon nu tsho'i bsam tshul mi mthun par/ rgyab 'gal du 'gro gi yod pa ltar/ bod la ni de bas kyang yod/ rgya mis chab mdo dang / kong po rgya mda' khul la slob gra chung ba mang po btsugs 'dug gtso che shos rgya skad rgya yig yin pa ma zad/ dmar po'i lta ba ni gca rwa1ra slob bzhin pa red/ 'on kyang slob gra de 'i nang rang bzhin gyi bod rang dbang dang / bod mir dga' zhen byed pa/ rgya mir mi dga' ba'i bsam tshul shugs chen po zhig yod tshod 'dug de ni gnad gal shin tu chen po yin/ de tshor gzhigs na bod rang dbang sgrub pa la spyir gzhis byes bod rgya che'i mi mang dang / lhag par gzhon nu tsho'i bsam tshul ha cang thag nye ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ de ni nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i stobs shugs gtso bo de yin/ rgya mi'i slob grar phyin/ rgya mis slob sbyong sprad pa'i gzhon nu tshos rgya mir kha gtad gcog pa de ni rlabs chen bstod pa'i me tog 'thor 'os pa red/ bod kyi rang dbang yong sa'i rtsa ba'i stobs shugs bod rigs gzhon skyes tsho la thug yod pas gzhis lus gzhon skyes rnams ha cang yag po med dam snyam pa 'dugader brten lo shas nang byung ba'i 'gyur ba rnams bzang po byung ste/ re ba je che je cher 'gro bzhin pa red/ gcig byas na nga tsho'i rang dbang lo 2༷ 30 tsam 'gor srid/ gcig byas na lo 5 6 thog bod rang dbang 126

misku1nga ba'i nges pa med pas/ tshang mas sems shugs ma chag pa bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ yang / gzhis chags kyi gnas tshul tha dad yin/ rang dbang da ring byung na/ sang nyin gzhis chags bsdu gsog brgyab nas 'gro chog gi red ma gtogs/ rang dbang mgyogs po yong rgyur gzhis chags byed rin mi 'dug zer na nor 'khrul red/ de gnyis kyi dbye ba gsal po 'byed dgos/de nas tshang mas slob sbyong bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ tshang mas bod yig gi deb dang / gsar shog sogs la do snang byas/ gnas tshul mang po zhig go thos dang / gnas tshul mang por bsam gzhigs bya rgyu de gal chen po red/bu phrug sto slob grar 'gro gi yod pas nyin re bzhin yar rgyas 'gro rgyu yin yang /rgan pa chos slob sbyong la do snang bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug bod la lug rdzi byed mkhan lta bu'i rgas po zhig yin kyang / da cha srid don dang / dpal 'byor sogs la do snang bya dgos/ 'dzam gling 'di ji 'dra zhig yod pa dang / rgya gar ji 'dra zhig yod pa/ rgya gar nang mnga' sde ji tsam yod pa/ mnga' sde so so'i 'gro stangs/ mnga' sde dang / dbus gzhung gi bar la 'gro stangs gang 'dra yin pa sogs zhar dang zhor la do snang bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dugagang yin zer na/ mi la spongan tan med na las thosan bya rgyu shin tu khag po yin/gnyisanas 'dzam gling 'dir las don ji 'dra zhig yin yang mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor dang / stobs shugs med na las don 'grub pa dka'/ mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor yong ba la mang tshogs kyi bsam blor shes bya'i tshad gang 'tshams shig nges par du yod dgos pa las/ med na mi 'grigs/ gtso che shos shig la/127

ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi mkhrims zin bris shig yod pa de khyed rang tshos mthong yod/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod chos srid gnyis ldan du 'gro dgos shing / srid kyi ngo bo ni dmangs gatsho'i jog 'gro dgos/ gnas tshul de rigs go thos mang po ma byung ba'i mi rgan pa 'ga' zhig gi rna bar/ mang gtso shes brjod dus mi ser rgyal khab lta bu 'am/ yang na 'go mjug gang yang med pa zhig min nam snyam pa'i mthong tshul 'dra min yong srid kyang / de 'dra min/ mang gtso ma byas par thabs med la/ mi ser rgyal khab ma byas par thabs med/ rgyal tshogs nang yod pa'i rgyal khab brgya dang bcu grangs dang / med pa 'ga' shas bcas khyon 'dzam gling 'dir rgyal khab 120 lhag tsamayod pa nas/ spyir btang rgyal po'i ming tsam yod pa 'ga' shas yod pa/ dper na/ dbyin ji/rja pan sogs ming tsam gyi rgyal po las/ dbang cha gang yang med/ gsung bshad sogs kyang srid blon tshos bzos nas rgyal po 'dra chags po'i ngang sdod thub kyi yod pa red/ dbang cha rgyal pos 'dzin pa'i rgyal po ha cang nyung nyung yin/ bod la cha bzhag na/ chos rgyal gnya' khri nas bzung rgyal po yod pas bod rgyal po'i rgyal khab red/ glang dar gyi sras dus phyogs khag gnyis su gyes te/ de nas bzung rgyal rgyud kyis dbang cha 'dzin pa'i dus tshod rdzogs te lo stong phrag la nye ba song zin pa red/ de nas lung chung nang gi dpon chung 'ga' shas re byas te gnas/ de rjes sa skya nas bzungs bla mas chab srid bskyangs/phag gru dang / rin spungs pa sogs rim par byung / de rjes gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab srid 7gong sa lnga pa chen po nas dbu brnyes pa yin/ spyir 128

ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi mkhrims zin bris shig yod pa de khyed rang tshos mthong yod/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod chos srid gnyis ldan du 'gro dgos shing / srid kyi ngo bo ni dmangs gatsho'i jog 'gro dgos/ gnas tshul de rigs go thos mang po ma byung ba'i mi rgan pa 'ga' zhig gi rna bar/ mang gtso shes brjod dus mi ser rgyal khab lta bu 'am/ yang na 'go mjug gang yang med pa zhig min nam snyam pa'i mthong tshul 'dra min yong srid kyang / de 'dra min/ mang gtso ma byas par thabs med la/ mi ser rgyal khab ma byas par thabs med/ rgyal tshogs nang yod pa'i rgyal khab brgya dang bcu grangs dang / med pa 'ga' shas bcas khyon 'dzam gling 'dir rgyal khab 120 lhag tsamayod pa nas/ spyir btang rgyal po'i ming tsam yod pa 'ga' shas yod pa/ dper na/ dbyin ji/rja pan sogs ming tsam gyi rgyal po las/ dbang cha gang yang med/ gsung bshad sogs kyang srid blon tshos bzos nas rgyal po 'dra chags po'i ngang sdod thub kyi yod pa red/ dbang cha rgyal pos 'dzin pa'i rgyal po ha cang nyung nyung yin/ bod la cha bzhag na/ chos rgyal gnya' khri nas bzung rgyal po yod pas bod rgyal po'i rgyal khab red/ glang dar gyi sras dus phyogs khag gnyis su gyes te/ de nas bzung rgyal rgyud kyis dbang cha 'dzin pa'i dus tshod rdzogs te lo stong phrag la nye ba song zin pa red/ de nas lung chung nang gi dpon chung 'ga' shas re byas te gnas/ de rjes sa skya nas bzungs bla mas chab srid bskyangs/phag gru dang / rin spungs pa sogs rim par byung / de rjes gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab srid 7gong sa lnga pa chen po nas dbu brnyes pa yin/ spyir 128

btang ltar na/ nga tsho'i gzhung rgyal dbang sku phreng na rim gyis bskyangs pas bla ma gcig gis skyong ba yin/ 'on kyang rgyal dbang sku phreng rnams yong stangs ni/ dmangs phal pa'i bu phrug khrod nas yong ba las/ mi drag gam/ rgyu can zhig nas 'byung ba'i khyab pa med/ de'i yong stangs snying rje po yod kyang / ming 'dogs stangs sogs legs po ma byung bas ya mtshan zhig chags pa red/ lnga pa'i sku dus de'i skabs de'i dus kyi spyi rtsegs kyi gnas stangs dang bstun nas gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'grigs nges shig yod kyang / da cha spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs 'gyur zin pa la sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs kyi spyi tshogs gnas stangs dang bsnyun nas bzos pa'i gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs ma 'gyur bar bsdad pa des ra ma lug chags pa red/ dper na/ rang nyid bu phrug chung ngu'i skabs gyon pa'i gu thung de lo 30 lhag lon nas kyang de nga rang gi gu thung yin zhes gyon na ran thabs med cing bzhad gad kyi rgyu red/ de lta bur spyi tshogs 'phel 'grib kyi 'gyur ba chen spro phyin yod kyang gzhung sngar gyi de gar bsdad na ma ran par gyur pa red/ bod la de 'dra'i skyon byung yod/ bod kyi gnas lugs la rgyu mtshan zhib tshags wa'i thog nas rtog zhib mthil phyin pa byas na/ sa bdag ring lugs sdug shos de min yang / hob ste phyi rgyar mthong snang la pha gzhis bdag pos dbang cha zin pa lta bu'i mthong snang yong dus sa bdag gral rim dang / bkas bkod sger dbang brgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs yin pa lta bu dang /ches rjes lus red ces mi kha byung ba red/ nga tshor rjes lus gtan nas med pa min/ 'on kyang de 'dra'i skyon chen po ranga.e yin snyam/ nub phyogs pa 129

'ga' shas kyis kyang de ltar brjod mkhan byung / gang ltar legs nyes ji ltar brjod rung / bod la rul pa med pa min pas rul pa'i rigs phyin chad dor rgyu las 'os med/ der brten ma 'ongs par bod legs po zhig tu 'gro dgos na mang gtso byed rgyu shin tu gal che ba yin/ 7rgyal ba rin po cher mtshon na chos kyi thog nas byung ba zhig las/ pha mes bu brgyud kyis byung ba min/ rgyal ba rin po che la bza' zla dang bu phrug med/ 7rgyal ba rin po che bu brgyud 'dzin pa las byung ba yin na/ de rgyal po yin dgos kyang / de 'dra min par gra rkyang /langs na sgos dang / 'gyel na spos zer ba'i kha dpe ltar red/ de la nged rang sgobs payod/ rang la shesayon dang 'jon thang gang yang med kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su zhugs/ lung pa gcig gi 'go 'khrid byas/ nga la dgra yang med cing / gnyen yang med/ rang shi na 'di lhag song bsam pa'i sems phral yang med/ nus na sems can thams cad pha mar 〈(ma rgyu yin/ ma nus na ni de ga red/ de ni khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'jug gi gzi byin red/ bzod pa dka' thub dam pa bzod pa ni/ mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ zhes pa lta bu red/zas kyi tshod kyang rigs par bya/ bas mtha'i gnas su gnas par bya/ lhag pa'i sems la yang dag sbyar/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gzi byin chen po zhig yin pas 'grel bshad dgos pa mi 'dug gang ltar gzhung gi chab srid kyi las ka byed mkhan la dge slong 'os po red 130

bsam gyi 'dug 'ga' shas nas khyed rang 7rgyal ba rin po che'i ming 'dzin yin pas chos kyi las don byas/ srid don bzhag na legs tshul brjod mkhan byung / chos chos rkyang gi bsam blo btang na dngos 'brel red/ 'on kyang /nga rang gi nyams myong nas bsam na/ nga dge slong yin pa des gzhung la phan sgogs pa red bsam gyi 'dug khyim pa zhig yin na/ brgya cha bdun cu don lngas gzhung bsam byas rung nyi shu rtsa lngas rang gi bu phrug bud med kyi bsam blo gtong mdog kha po red/ nga la de 'dra gang yang med/ nga ma shi bar bod yul dang / bod rgya che'i mi mang la phan thogs gang thub sgrub/ nga shi song na de ga yin/ 'dir khos gra pa'i skad cha gang byung shod kyi 'dug dgongs na dgongs dag zhu rgyu yin/ nga'i kha la dam phrug med ces rgyun du shod kyi yod/ gtso che shos nga tsho'i mang tshogs dang / 'go 'khrid kyi bar gcig gis gcig la shes rtogs nges par dgos kyi 'dug khyed tshos 7rgyal ba rin po che'i gshis ka de ji 'dra zhig yod pa dang / ngas kyang mi mang gi bsam tshul ji yod shes dgos pa las/ sngar gyi sbug sbug byas nas ha las rgyu med/ ma gzhi yul dus dang / mi bye brag pa gcig la tos te snam tsam byas nas las don sgrub dgos pa yang yong gi red de/ spyir btang mang tshogs kyi 'go 'khrid bya dgos na/ mang tshogs kyis ja ngo shes dgos la/ ngas mang tshogs ngo shes dgos pa las/ ngas sbug sbug tu bsdad nas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i bsam blo dang gnas tshul gang 'dra yod pa rnams khyed chos ma shes shing / gdong yang legs po zhig ma mthong / sbug dang sbug ces brjod/ sbug legs po yin pa yang 131

ma shes/ sbug rul pa yin pa yang ma shes par/ mgo rul rna bas ma tshor zhes pa de yong gi 'dug dper na/ nga tsho sbug drags te chab mdo shor gyi yod kyang lha sar bka' shag thugs spro btang nas bsdad yod pa red/ nga phod mtha' 'gag de 'dra zhig la thug yod kyang / 'dir sngar lam yin zhes thugs spro tshugs/ thugs spro nyin ma re zung yang 'gyangs na mi 'grigs pa byas/ de tsho rul pa min na gang yin/ 'di 'phros bshad yin/ gang lta ra tshang ma gsal po byas na legs po red/ nga rang gi gshis kur mtshon na yang / nga 7rgyal ba rin po che yin zhes mtho nyams byed 'dod gang yang med/ nga ni grwa pa zhig red/ rtsam pa za mkhan gyi bod mi ni gcig pa rang yin/ khyed rang tsho ni bod mi mang red/ nga tshor skyid po zhig byung rung gcig pa yin/ sdug po zhig byung rung gcig pa yin pa las khyad par gang yang med/ 'on kyang spyi'i 'gro lugs kyi cha nas ngas 'go 'khrid yin zhes 'go 'khrid pa dang / khyed chos kyang nga tsho'i 'go 'khrid yin zhes cha 'jog dang yid ches byas na/ de la dga' po yod pa ma gtogs 7rgyal ba rin po che ces gnam gung la yod pa lta bu byed pa dang /ngas kyang mi mang zhes gsham 'og gcig tu yod pa lta bur bltas na/ nga rang yang skyid po mi 'dug khyed rang tshos kyang da lta'i char rmongs dad byas nas sdod kyi red de/ phyin chad cha 'jog dang yid ches byed kyi ma red/ nga tsho rang dang rang mnyam byas/ de nas 'jon pa zhig yod na 'go 'khrid/ mi 'jon na 'jog dgos/ nga tsho'i spyi tshogs rnying pa'i 'gro stangs la mtshon na/ gzhung zhabs la rtse skor dang / shod skor yod/ rtse skor tsho ni bong 'ded pa'i bu yin 132

rung bka' blon bla ma byas mi chog pa med/ de bzhin dga' ldan khri par mtshon na yang / dga' ldan khri la bdag po med/ ces kha dper yod pa de rang yin/de tsho dmangs gtso'i skad cha red/ shod skor la yang gzhung dmag byas/ de nas brgya ru sogs rim 'dzigs kyi phyin pa'ang yod/ yang / skyon gyi cha nas/zhabs pad lta bu'i bu tsho yon tan med kyang dpon du 'gyur ba dang / de'i 'og gi gnyer phyag mdzod sogs la yon tan yod kyang mi tshe der gnyer phyag mdzod de rang du sdod dgos pa sogs legs po min/ yon tan yod na sprang phrug gis kyang dpon po byas chog la/ yon tan med na rgyal sras yin kyang zur du 'gro rgyu las 'os med/de ltar da phan nga tsho'i gzhung gi 'gro stangs nang skyon mang po yod stabs phyin chad mang gtso 'am/ mi ser rgyal khab kyi 'gro stangs la ma phyin thabs med yin pa las/ bgrod lam gnyis pa zhig nam yang med/ da lta 'dzam gling 'dir rang btsan rgyal khab 120 skor yod pa'i thog da dung rang btsan thob rgyu 'ga' shas yod pa bcas rgyal khab 130 skor zhig byung ba yin na/ gzhan dag tshang ma mi ser rgyal khab byas nas/ nga tsho bod gcig pu rgyal po'i rgyal khab lta bu byas nas bsdad na gang 'dra zhig zhing gi red/ bya rog dkar po byung na nag po tshos rub nas gsod rgyu las 'os med pas yong thabs nam yang med/ lar nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mang gtso zhes chab srid thog bed spyod gnang med pa ma gtogs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa ni mang gtso rang yin/ dper na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas mi rgyas 133

'dul ba'i bstan pa gzhi gsum yod med la rag lus pa dang / 'dul bstan gzhi gsum yod med dge 'dun la rag lus par gsungs pa las/ dge slong la rag lus par gsungs med/ dge 'dun ni bzhi gra yan yin la/ dge slong ni gang zag gcig yin/ gcig la ltos te bzhi mang tshogs yin/ dper na/ nga 7rgyal ba rin po che byas rung / dge slong gcig gis gzhi gsum 'dzugs thabs med/ gyon gos thig ral can yin pa dang / a cor gnas bskor ba lta bu yin rung / dge slong gi sdom ldan bzhi gra zhig yod na 7rgyal ba rin po che med kyang gzhi gsum 'dzugs thub pa yin/ de ltar gzhi gsum de mang snurags kyis 'dzugs pa las/ mi gcig gis mi 'grigs pa'i gnas lugs des sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang dge 'dun mang tshogs kyis 'dzin dgos pa'i rtags bstan pa red/ de bzhin du 'dul ba'i khrims lugs 'gro stangs rnams kyang dge 'dun mang tshogs kyi thugs bstun dgos pa red/ deng dus lugs srol nub pa ma gtogs/ bya ba gsar pa zhig byung na/ lhan rdi brdungs/ dge 'dun tshogs/ da ring gi las don skor dri bshad byas/ gnas la blo mthun sogs byas/ mi zhig bsko dgos na'ang dge 'dun thugs mthun nas bsko ba sogs byed dgos/ mi 'di zhes bya ba las 'di 'dra zhig tu bskos na 'grigs dang mi 'grigs dge 'dun la dris nas bsko gzhag byed pa las/ nga mi gcig gi 'dod pa yin zhes zer sa med/ de dag gi 'gro lugs la gzhigs na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / mang gtso gnyis mi mthun pa'i 'gal zla gang yang med par bsam gyi 'dug 134

phyin chad bod kyi chab srid kyi ngo bo mang gtso legs po zhig gi thog tu 'gro dgos pas/ de'i ched du ngas gong du bshad pa ltar ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi rtsa khrims zhes dmangs gca'i rtsa khrims kyi zin bris shig khyab bsgrags byas yod/ de la gtso bo'i dgos pa gnyis yod/ dang po/ nga tshos bod don mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs nang zhu bskul byed skabs rgya dmar gyi phyogs nas bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs ni shin tu mun nag dang / rjes lus sdug po yin tshul/mgon khang nang gi spyan gzigs sogs la dpar brgyab ste bstan nas/ bod mi log spyod tshos mi lpags bshus lugs dang / yan lag gcod bregs byas lugs sogs dril bsgrags ngan pa ha cang mang po byed kyi yod/ nga tshos de 'dra byed rgyu ma byung / de bla ma yas kyis byas/ mas kyis byas zhes brjod na snying po gang yang med/ nga tshor sngon chad nor 'khrul gtan nas med pa min stabs nor 'khrul yod pa rnams ngos len byas/ nga tshor sngon chad nor 'khrul byung ba shes kyi yod stabs nga tshos ma 'ongs par nor 'khrul de dag dor ba'i 'gro lugs 'di 'dra zhig yin zhes bstan na/ de nas log spyod pa rgya mi yin nam/nga tsho yin 'dzam gling gi mi tshos shes kyi red/ kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi dgos pa gcig de yin/ gnyis pa/ ma 'ongs par bod rang btsan byung mtshams nga tsho gang 'dra byas nas log rgyu yin nam/ khyed rang de snga sdod sa'i shag chung der bsdad chog chog ga la yod/ sa cha tsam las sngar gyi ri khrod lta bu gar yod kyang brjod rgyu dka'/ des na nga tshos gzhi nas bsam gzhigs byas te 'tsho ba skyel dgos/ de rnams da lta nas gra sgrig cig ma byas na nga tsho za khang 135

'grul khang lta bu zhig gam/ rang gi nang khyim du bsdad chog chog gtan nas med/ gzhis lus bod mi mang rnams mu nas mnar nas yod pas nga tshos phar phran bu phan grogs byed rtsis bya dgos pa las/ tshur nga tshor zas chog btung chog bzo thub re nam yang med/ nga tsho thab gsar gzhis gsar byas nas 'gro rgyu'i bsam blo gtong dgos pa las/ de snga nang bzhin yong thabs med/ skabs der da lta rgya gar nang yod pa lta bu min par rang gi yul du slebs pa yin stabs mi rabs nas mi rabs sdod rtsis bya dgos shing / chos srid zung 'brel gyi gnas stangs thog lo stong phrag tsam ma byung rung / brgya phrag 'ga' shas sdod rgyu'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ der brten chos byed dge 'dun pa'i 'gro stangs/ sa zhing gi 'gro stangs/ mi mang gi 'gro stangs rnams bsam blo gtong dgos pa dang / mi mang gi bde skyid rnams gzhung la brten nas yong dgos pas gtso che shos 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul dang bstun nas gzhung gi 'gro stangs ji 'dra zhig bya rgyu yin min la bsam blo gtong dgos par brten gzhung gi sgrig gzhi rtsa khrims de bton nas gzhung gi 'gro stangs dang / sa zhing gi 'gro stangs/ slob sbyong skor sogs rtsa ba'i lam zhig bstan pa des tshang ma'i bas ma tsho'i nang 'gro lugs 'de 'dra zhig yin bsam pa'i go rtogs byung stabs de dang bstun pa'i byed stangs shig shes thub kyi red/ de min gzhung dang / rgyal khab gang yang min par rang bzhin mi mang po zhig mnyam tshogs phyir log byas te/ dpung su bzang dang / dpa' su che/ go lag bzang zhan gyis dbang sgyur byed pa de 'dra yong mi shes pas/ nga tshos sgrig 'dzugs lam lugs dang ldan 136

pa'i sgo nas rang yul 'dzin skyong byed dgos pas/ bod kyi rtsa khrims shig da lta nas bzo dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig de yin/da dung des ma tshad pa'i dgos pa gzhan dag kyang yod/ bod rgya che'i mi mang la macesan na rgan pa chor gnas tshul tha dad yin/ rgya mi'i slob grar sku1da pa'i bod phrug tshos rang gi mi rigs la dga' zhen byed kyi red/ stabs legs na chos la yang dad pa byed mdog kha po red ma gtogs/ khong tshos nga tsho'i spyi tshogs rnying pa'i 'gro stangs la dga' bsu zhu gi ma red/ de ni ngas thag gcod thub/ lo shas rjes rgya gar du yod pa'i bod phrug tshos kyang 'dza ma gling gi gnas tshul mang spro zhig shes pa'i mtshams spyi tshogs rnying par dga' po byed kyi ma red/ rgya gar nang bod phrug tshos kyang gnas lugs de 'dra byung na/ bod nang rgya mis slob sbyong sprad pa'i bod phrug tsho lta shin tu khag po yin/ khong tshos spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang yod pa'i legs cha rnams ni go thos gang yang mi thubaca la/ skyon dang nor 'khrul gang yod ni rgya mis phyi byugs nang blug gang yong ci yong byas te da cha spyi tshogs rnying pa 'i skad cha go ma thag par zhen pa log mkhan zhig bzos yod/ bod kyi kha dper/ tam ri bden g.yag zer ba ltar/ tam pa yin rung yang nas yang du de rang bshad na nam zhig shugs rkyen zhig thebs rgyu yod/ dper na/ khong tshos rgyun du rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru zhi kho na bshad stabs/ ma'o kru zhi rlabs chen zhig yin pa red bsam pa blo la shar grabs byed kyi 'dug nga rang sgor gyi ngos nas khong yag po yin/ bgres song /bag gro po/ skad cha shod mkhas po/ nyams myong yod pa/ dka' las rgyag 137

thub mkhan/ ngo thog mi mang rang dang mnyam du 'jor 'jag ma 'khur nas dka' las brgyab pa zhig red ma gtogs/ las sla po byas pa zhig ma red/legs cha mang po len rgyu yod pa zhig red/ ngas khong yang yang thug 'phrad byas/ skad cha mang po bshad pa'i skabs bslab bya mang po yong gi 'dug de dag ni nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyad chos shig kyang red/ spyir btang ma'o tse tung la dga' po byas/ snying rje byed pa las/ mtha' gcig tu maso dmi tung dgra yin zhes sdug po byed dgos don med/ 'on kyang / ma'o tse tung gis bod don thog 'dzin pa'i srid byus dang / spyod pa der nga tshos ngo rgol mthar phyin pa bya dgos/ ngas sdug pa zhig nas bshad na/ bod nang rgya mis slob sbyong sprad pa'i bod phrug de rnams kyi blo nga tshos 'gugs ma thub na skyon chen po yod/ dper na/ lo shas rjes 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul la 'gyur ba chen po byung / rgya mi'i shugs nyams/ nga tsho bod du log rgyu'i go skabs shig shar / mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi sku tshab lta bu bod du slebs/ rang thag rang gcod ces pa de lta bu'i thog 'os bsdu byed pa'i skabs shar/ nga tshos rnying srol bzung ste 'grel bshad legs po zhig kyang byed ma thub/ bod sdod mi mang rnams bsam blor yar rgyas phyin te khong tsho nga tsho'i phyogs su 'then 'gugs legs po ma thub na/ khong mos nga tsho rgya mi'i 'og sdod 'dod med cing / bod rang btsan dgos/rgya gar nang yod pa'i bod mi rnams kyang mi dgos/ nga tsho bod dmar po'i rgyal khab cig byed kyi yin zhes zer na/ 'di phyogs bod mi khri 748 yod pa rnams 'phel nas 'bum gcig tsam byung dbang byas kyang / bod sdod bod mi 138

'bum 70080 skor yod pa tshos thag gcod byas na/ 'bum gcig la bya thabs gang yang med/ de ltar yong mi srid pa min/ nga tshos bod du dpon po byed pa dang / dbang 'dzin byed phyir log gi yin zer ba min na yang / chos srid gnyis ldan zhes pa de bden pa da nga / yang dag pa'i lam zhig yin pas de 'dra'i lam de bod mi tshor bstan nas/ bod mi rnams mi rabs nas mi rabs bar chos srid gnyis ldan gyi 'tsho bar spyod thub pa byung na/ nga tshor dbang cha dgos don rtsa ba nas med/ bod mi tshor legs po byung na nga tsho'i re 'dod de gas rdzogs pa red/ de ltar bod rgya che'i mi mang spyi dang / lhag par rgya mis slob sbyong sprad pa'i bod phrug rnams kyi blo sna rang phyogs la 'khrid ma thub na nyen kha chen po yong gi red/ da lta'i char ni bod nang mi rgan pa tsho lta smos ci dgos/ gzhon pa tshos kyang nga tsho rgyal ba rin po che sgug gi yod ces kha gcig grags lta bu brjod kyi yod 'dug 'di ni ngas rang bstod brjod pa lta bu ma 'os tsam 'dug ste/ dngos don thog de 'dra rang yin 'dug nga la lta gzi brjid gang yang med kyang / ngas lhag bsam dkar po zhig 'khur nas srol legs po zhig rang yul du gtod thub pa byung na zhabs 'degs phran bu 'grub pa'i re ba zhig yod pa red/ da lta bod nang gnas tshul ha cang legs po yod pa 'di'i thog da dung dmangs gtso'i rtsa khrims lta bu'i lam ston legs po zhig byed thub na/ gzhis byes dgongs pa mnyam pa'i thog nas lam gcig gi thog 'gro thub kyi red bsam gyi 'dug de yang dgos pa chen po zhig yin/thog mar rtsa khrims snying don zhig bzos/ de rjes zin bris rgyas rnga/ zhig bzos 139

nas sdod sgar khag la 'grems spe la byas pa la phal che bas legs po 'dug ces dga' po byed bzhin pa ltar/ da dung yang de dag la do snang bya dgos/ nga tsho'i rtsa khrims de'i rtsa ba'i ma zin bod yig tu yod kyang de'i nang don gnas lugs phyi rgyal tshang mas gsal po shes dgos pa dang / 'gro lugs gzhan dag mang por bstun dgos pa sogs la brten nas dbyin yig gi ming tshig bod yig thog tshur bsgyur ba mang po yod pa dang / 'ga' zhig ni thog ma'i bod yig gi zin bris rang la gtan 'khel gyis rang 'jags bsdad pa yang yod/ 'on kyang bsgyur tshig 'ga' shas phran bu tho dargags bde min yod pa rnams lnga legs bcos byed mus yin pa rjes su par thon yong rgyur tshang mas do snang chen po bya dgos/ nga tsho'i ma 'ongs par 'gro lugs 'di 'dra zhig yin snyam du blo nges bya dgos pa gal gnad chen po 'dugad zhu rgyu gzhan dag med/ da ring 'dir khyed rang tsho nyi ma'i dkyil du khag po byung song bar dgongs dag thugs rje che/ bkra shis bde legs/zhes bka' 4skor// //140

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1964 zla 10 tshes 27 bod shing 'brug lha babs dus chen nyin bzhugs sgar pho brang gi sku mdun bde yangs su bod rigs chig stong tsam la spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen wa'i mjal kha gnang skabs stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring ni 7rgyal ba lha yul las babs pa'i dus chen yin/ rang re'i pha yul bod la yin na/ dus chen 'dir bod mi ser skya tshang mas gos bzang po gyon/ lag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs/ ngag nas bla ma lha yi gzungs sngags bgrangs/ mig gis byin rlabs can gyi sku gsung thugs rten rnams mjal/ yid kyis dge ba'i sems bzang po dang bcas smon lam 'debs shing chos sgrub pa'i dus skabs bzang po zhig yin yang / deng dus nga rang tsho gzhan yul du gyar nas yod stabs de 'dra'i skal ba bral ba red/ 'on kyang / chos sgrub pa zhes pa ni/ phyi'i lha khang zhig dang / sku gsung thugs rten zhig yod med la rag lus pa ma yin par/ nang gi bsam blo'i steng nas sgrub dgos pa yin/ dper na/ yul 'di lta bur gtsug lag khang dang / sku gsung thugs rten mjal yul med kyang / rang gi bsam blo gtong shes na/ chos gang du yang byas chog gi red/ de yang chos zhes pa ji 'dra zhig yin pa dang / de sgrub stangs ji ltar bya dgos pa shes rgyu ni shin tu gal chen po yin/ sngar rang re'i bod du mi mang phal che bas chos kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin ma shes kyang /chos zhes pa rtsa ba chen po yin pa dang / legs spro zhig yin par yid ches byas te chos la dad pa byed pa yin zhing / chos zhes pa ji 'dra zhig yin min dris 141

na/ lan 'debs rgyu khag po yin/ da cha sngar bskal bzang lugs bzang gi byed stangs des mi 'grigs par chos kyi gnas lugs ngo ma ji 'dra zhig yin pa ngo shes pa'i thog nas chos bsgrub dgos pa las/ chos kyi gnas lugs gang yang mi shes par ma ṇi lta bu mang du bgrangs rung / phan yon phran bu 'byung srid kyang des dgos don chen po 'grub mi thub/'dzam gling 'dir snga dusanas chos kyi rigs 'dra min mang po zhig byung yod/ de dag gi khongs nas 'ga' shas nub zin nas med la/ 'ga' shas da dung gnas bzhin yod/ chos lugs de dag tshang mar legs cha re yod/rang re bod du yod pa'i chos ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos yin la/ chos 'di'i legs cha'am/ rgyu mtshan ni chos lugs gzhan dag dang mi 'dra tsam zhig yod/ dper na/ sangs rgyas la dad pa byas na skyid po yong gi red/ ces pa lta bu ma yin par/ rgyu 'bras zhes pa zhig bshad yod/ rang nyid bde ba 'dod na/ bde ba de'i rgyu gang yin brtsad dpyad nas de sgrub dgos pa dang /sdug bsngal mi 'dod na de'i rgyu sgong ba la 'bad dgos/ dper na/ da ring char pa chen po zhig babs na/ rgyu des sang nyin gnam gshis grang ba 'byung ba dang / da ring nyi tshad che na/ des drod che ba 'byung ba sogs rjes su yong rgyu'i gnas tshul gang ci rgyu sngon song zhig la nges par bstun dgos pa yin/ bu phrug chung dus su yon tan sbyong ba de da ring kho la skyid po 'byung ched min par/ma 'ongs par kho'i mi tshe'i ring bde skyid 'byung ba'i rgyu sgrub pa yin/ de 'dra'i rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de ni/ chos nyid kyis gtan la phab pa'i rang bzhin 142
