gyi gnas lugs shig yin pa ma gtogs/ de sangs rgyas kyis bzos pa min zhing / sangs rgyas kyi nus pa las byung ba'ang min/ rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs sam/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul de la nga tshos nges par du bstun dgos pa las/ de las ldog ste dngos su gnam gshis grang mo yod bzhin du/ sems kyi bro po 'dug snyam du byas kyang / 'khyags pa 'gog mi thub la/ bsam tshul de tsam gyis phan mi thogs/ dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun pa'i lta ba zhig bzung ste nyams len byas na/ lam brtsad chod pa yin/ dad pa zhes pa gal che zhing / snungs zhes pa dbotos nges yin kyang / rigs pa rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa zhig med na zhib tu dpyad dus khungs 'khyol ba dka'/bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyi zhal nas/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ legs par brtag la nga yi bka'/ blang bar bya yi gus phyir min/ zhes bsregs bcad brdar ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas gser la brtag dpyad zhib tu byed pa de bzhin du/ ngas bstan pa'i chos 'di rnams kyangayang dag payin min rigs pa dang / rgyu mtshan mang po'i sgo nas brtag dpyad byas te bden par 'dug na nyams su len dgos pa las/ nga la gus pa tsam rgyu mtshan du byar mi rung zhes gsungs 'dug pa de ni/ bden payang dag dang ldan pa'i thobs pa chen po'i gsung yin te/ bcom ldan 'das byon nas mi lo 2500 lhag song ba'i rjes su 'phrul gyi rigs la bed spyod brtag dpyad byas te/ shing / me tog ri ra ba/ mi'i rigs/nyi zla/ gza' skar/ 'jig rten ril bu'i chags stangs dang / lo ji tsam 143

gnas pa dang / 'jig pa/ yang gsar du chags pa/ nyi ma 'di tsam min pa gzhan yang yod pa dang / skar tshogs dung phyur mang po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod pa la sogs pa lam rob tsam brjod thub kyi yod pa dang / de rnams ni dpe deb dang / yig char gsal ba tsam la yid ches byas pa min par mig brjen pas dngos su mthong ba'i gnas lugs shi ga red/ da lta'i sngon gyi lo bzhi stong nas/ stong tsam bar chos kyi ston pa ji snyed cig byung ba rnams nas rang rang gi bsam tshul ltar chos kyi lam sna tshogs pa bstan zhing / de dang mnyam du bcud kyi sems can 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs sems can rnams gang du gnas pa'i stod kyi 'jig rten chags tshul yang bshad yod/ skabs der rgyang shel dang / glog rlabs spyod pa'i 'phrul chas rigs gang yang med stabs mi rnams nas so so'i chos nas ji ltar bshad pa ltar la yid ches bya rgyu las thabs gzhan med kyang / deng sang rdzas 'phrul gyi thabs shes la brten nas dngos su shes thub kyi yod pa red/rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di tsam min par stong gsum gyi stong chen wa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / stong dang gnyis dang / rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud la sogs pa'i 'jig rten khams mtha' yas pa zhig sku da pa dang / de dag gi chags 'jig la sogs pa'i gnas lugs mang po zhig bshad yod/ deng dus chos khas mi len pa'i tshan rig mkhan chosas brtag dpyad byas te shes pa'i gnas lugs dang / chos lugs khag nas bshad pa'i gnas tshul rnams bsdur na/ rang re'i ston pa bcom ldan 'daso 144

kyis mdo sngags nas bshad pa'i gnas tshul rnams thag nye shos dang / rgyu mtshan mang shos su slebs kyi yod pa red/deng dus skra ser po'i mi ri gas chos la do snang byed mkhan chos spyir shar phyogs pa'i lta ba dang / de'i nang nas rgya gar gyi chos lugs khag de'i nang nas nang pa'i chos la do snang dang / brtag zhib byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig de 'dra zhig la thug gi yod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi gsungs pa'i chos de dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang mthun gyi yod pa'i rtags gsal po yod pa red/rgyu mtshan de 'drar brten/ mi su zhig bde ba 'dod na/ bde ba'i rgyu sgrub dgos pa dang / su zhig sdug bsngal mi 'dod na/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu spongs dgos pa las/ de las gzhan pa'i thabs dang / lam gzhan gang yang med/sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu dngos su smin zin na dog thabs dka' bas/ tshang mas bde sdug gi rgyu'i dus su lag len ma 'phyug pa bya rgyu shin tu gal che ba yin/khyed rang tshos rgyu 'bras zer ba 'di mi shes rgyu gang yang med/ go bder brjod na/ yag po byas na yag po dang / sdug po byas na sdug po 'byung / zer ba rang re'i kha rgyun la yod pa 'di rang yin/ de ltar chos nyid kyis gtan la phab pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di gzhi rtsar bzung nas/ sdig spong dge sgrub la 'bad dgos/ de yang dper na/ mi zhig khrom nas nyo cha rgyag par 'gro dgos na/ nyo rgyu'i dngos po de'i gnas lugs nges par shes dgos pa ltar/ sdig spong dge sgrub byed pa la yang dge sdig ngo shes rgyu gnad chen po 145

yin/ spyir dge sdig la rnam grangs mang po yod kyang / bsdoms su bsdu na/de las che long bsdus nas ni/ dge dang mi dge ci rigs par/ las kyi lam ni bcur gsungs so/ zhes pa ltar/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum/ ngag gi bzhi/yid kyi gsum ste tshang mas shes gsal bcu po 'di ni spong rgyu'i mi dge bcu yin la/ de dag spangs pa'i ldog zla bcu ni dge ba bcu yin/ nang pa dngos 'brel zhig byed 'dod na/ mi dge bcu spong gi nyams len mi byed mthu med yin zhing / de ni thog ma nyid nas shin tu gal chen po yin/su zhig gis dge sdig gi rgyu 'bras la lag len bkal na/ mi des chos nyams su blangs pa yin la/ chos la skyabs su song ba yang yin/ mi de'i bsam blo'i zhe phugs su dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang mthun pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag bzang po 'di 'dra zhig ston mkhan gyi sangs rgyas de'i mkhyen pa zab cing /mthu che ba'i yon tan mthong nas sangs rgyas la don dam gyi skyabs su 'dzin pa 'ong / de nas rang gi lam de dang mthun par zhugs mkhan tsho la yang don gyi lam sgrub pa'i grogs su shes nas/ dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba yang 'byung thub/ nga tsho ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i skyabs dngos ni chos yin la/ chos3 rgyu 'bras lag len byed pa kho na yin pas/ rgyu 'bras la lag len gang yang ma byas na/ lus la chos gos dmar ser gyon zhing / chos bshad ji 'dra zhig byas kyang / ne+e tso'i 'don pa lta bu las/ phan thogs gang yang med/ mi de ni chos pa lta ci/ nang pa'i gras su yang tshud mi thub/ sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun bcas ngo shes nas blo gtad/ skyabs bcol rgyu 146

'bras lag len du bkal na mi de nang pa spus dag cig tu gyur pas ma tshad/chos med pa'i yul ji 'dra zhig tu slebs kyang mi ya rabs kyi gral du tshud rgyur the snuram med/ rang gis rgyu 'bras lag len ma bkal na/ sangs rgyas nam mkha' gang mdun na bzhugs kyang phan thogs med/ rang nyid rang gi mgon yin gyi/ gzhan dag su zhig mgon du gyur/ zhes pa'i go don yang de yin pas 'di la 'bad dgos/ mi dge bcu sgong gi lag len 'di ni mtho ris dang /thar par bgrod pa'i skas kyi gdang bu dang po'i tshod de yin pas tshang mas de 'dra zhigaye thubalge shes blta dgos/ de ltar byung na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dar ba'i yul bod kha ba can du skyes pa'i dgos don tshang ba yin/nga tshos sngar skal bzang dus bzang gi skabs snang ba rtog med lta bus /rgyu mtshan ji bzhin mi shes kyang chos dad byed pa de tsam gyis mi 'grigs/ des ldeng gi mi 'dug des gnod kyi 'dug rang nyid nang pa zhig dang / chos pa zhig byed 'dod na/ cis kyang chos ngo shes pa bya dgos la/ mi dge bcu spong gi lag len nges par du bya dgos/ de ltar min par rang nyid nang par khas blangs nas spyod log sha stag byas na bod mi rigs tsam min par 'dzam gling nang pa yongs kyi zhabs 'dren byed kyi red/ mi dge bcu spong gi lag len mi thub na/ nga nang pa min brjod na legs shos red/ lam 'di gnyis las med pas de don tshang mas blo nges byed dgos/yang / nga stos bsam blo gtong dgos pa gzhan zhig ni/ deng dus nga tshor btsan byol ba zhes pa'i ming snyan po zhig thogs yod pa de ni don du rang 147

yul bral nas gzhan yul la sprang du 'khyar ba khyu zhig yin zhing / skyob gso zhes ming snyan po de yang don du sems bzang tshos sprang por sbyin pa btang ba lta bu yin pa las/ nga tshor thob thang yod pa dang / nga tshos 'ded gshed bya 'os pa zhig gtan nas min/ des na nga tshos skyob gso zhes pa'i ming tshig 'di bsub nas rang nyid rang 'tsho thub thabs shig nges par bya dgos/ dgos pa de'i ched du bod mi gzhis chags kyi thabs shes byas te spyi'i gzhung lam bstan pa 'dir tshang mas tshul mthun ya rabs kyi lugs dang bstun nas zhugs dgos/da phan lo shas ring nga tsho'i phyogs kyi don gnad gang 'tshams yar rgyas phyin yod kyang / chos phyogs la yang yar rgyas nges can zhig cis kyang gtong dgos pas/ bod mi mang tshogs nas chos kyi shes tshad nges can zhig yong thabs la 'bad dgos/ de tsho tshed rang tshos blo nges byed dgos/ bkra shis bde legs /tshang ma sems skyid po gyis/ zhes stsal// // 148

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1964 zla 11 tshes 24 nyin pan jab mnga' khul dha ris dang / ca ri sa/ dzña shod bcas par yod pa'i bod mi lam bzo ba dang /bzhugaso sgar dha sar gnas 'khod ser skya pho mo mi grangs chig stong skor la bka' slab 455 ba/thog mar 7gong sa mchog nas brgya dpon su yod ces bka' 'dri gnang bar/ rab rgyas nas brgya dpon thub bstan bkra shis dang / bkra chos/ tshe ring dbang 'dud/ blo bzang thar 'dod bcas bzhi yod zhus/ nga ku lu khul du phyin nas phyir 'khor mtshams yi ge ring po zhig btang yod pa 'byor byung ngam/ yi ge de tshang mas go ba byas te klog pa yin nam/ tshar ga tshod klog pa yin/ zhes bka' 'dri gnang bar/ tshar gcig klog pa yin zhus par tshar gcig gis ldeng gi ma red/ tshar mang wa ྅/ga nas don rnams shes pa byed dgos/kha sang do snang byung don lam spyi'i thog la skad cha bshad yod/ yi ge de 'go brgya tshang mas mi mang gis shes pa dang / don go ba zhig ma byas na gang yang phan gyi ma red/ khyed tsho la rgyab nas tshur 'byor nas las ka ma thob pa nyin ma ga tshod 'gor song ngam/ bka' 'dri bskyangs par nyin drug nas las ka thob byung zhus/ ma na lir me shor ba'i gras la khyod rang brgya shog su'i khongs nas bca' dngos ga tshod mer shor song zhes bka' 'dri mdzad par/ blo bzang thar 'dod nas gus khongs sgor khri gnyis me la shor/ de min brgya dpon rnams me shor gang yang byung ma song zhus/ de nga tsho byus nyes sgang la nyis brtsegs thabs sdug po byung ba red/ 'on kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pas las 149

'bras zer ba'i las red/ gzhan chos med pa zhig yin na kha ngu dang ma bral ba zhig yong rgyu yang / so so'i tshe sngon mas las bsags pa'i nyer len la brten nas byung ba red/ ma red dam/ nga tsho'i chos 'di gal chen po red/ khalosang yi ge btang don brgya shog dang / bcu shog so so nas tshar gnyis gsum klog de nas mtshams ma bzhag par yang yang klog nas shog bu nag po chags na chags ring chog pa red/ don dag rnams shes pa zhig dgos/ ngas yi ge btang rung khyod rang tshos go ༄dun ma shes pa byas/ sdod sgar gnyis tsam nas 'go ma 'tshos kyi gnas tshul thabs sdug byung med dam snyam pa'i do snang byung /rgyal ba rin 56tshes yi ge btang ni btang byung / de ga re yin nam nga tshos ni shes ma byung zer ba de 'dra min par/ yi ge'i don dag go nas sems 'jags yong ba zhig byed dgos/ mi mang rnams rub tsam gyis/ ngas skad cha zhig shod dgos/ sgrung shod dgos sam/ sngar gyi lo rgyus/ rkyen ngan gyi gnas tshul ga re shod dgos/da nga tshos sgrung dang / snang ba skyid pos sngar gyi lo rgyus shod pa'i dus tshod ma red/ nga tshos tshe 'di dang / phyi ma'i don dag cig bshad na shod mkhan gyis bshad rin chog pa dang / nyan mkhan nyan rin chog pa zhig red/ nga tsho bod pa la chos shig yod pa 'di ni nang pa'i chos yin/ zhogs snga langs kyis kha nas ma ṇi bgrangs shing / phyag mchod kha 'don sogs byas te lha khang gi rten gsum rnams mjal skabs mig spu zing zing byed kyi yod kyang / de dag gi dgos pa dang / rgyu mtshan ga re red ces dris na mgo 'phur 'phur btang ste 150

sdod dgos pa zhig chags kyi yod rung khag yod pa ma red/ ma bslabs pa'i nyer len la brten nas byung ba red/ dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan ma shes pa des de snga phan bod la chos srid gnyis ga'i thog nas skyon cha chen po byung yod/ kha 'don byed mkhan tshos dpe cha pang pa gang nyar/ sems gzhan du g.yengs te don ngo ma lag len mi byed pa dang / phyi chos pa'i gzugs brnyan yin pa la nang du chos kyi dri ma tsam kha rgyu med pa'i chos des phan mi thogs/ phyi logs 'dra chags chags tsam du song ste don ngo ma lag len du ma bkal ba'i dbang gis gnas tshul mang po'i thog tu pham nyes chen po phyin yod/ shes pa lag len du bkal/ ma shes na gzhan la dris te mtha' ngan drin chung du ma song ba zhig byed dgos/ nga tsho'i mi thog sngon mas las ka mang po nor 'khrul gyis mi thog 'di la dka' ngal chen po byung yod/ nga tsho ༄/da lung par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar khyab chen po yod kyang chos yag po ma shes/ shes pa de lag len yag po ma byung ba'i skyon chen po yod/ bod pa zhig gis chos pa zhig yin tshul byas kyang chos lag len du ma bstar na nang pa ma red/ chos shes pa byas/ de lag len du 'khel ba zhig dgos/ phyir 'dra chags po dar gos kyis g.yogs pa ltar byas pas phan pa med/ nga tsho bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'jug dge 'dun dang / khyim pa bcas chos pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam du ma song ba dgos/ de snga phan gyi 'gro stangs thog nas chos srid gnyis /ra dka' ngal chen po byung ba de nga rang tsho rang gis sel ba las/ mi gzhan gyis tsher ma bton pa nang bzhin yong rgyu med stabs/ nga rang tsho rang gi mi rigs kyis dka' las brgyab 151

ste 'bad sgrub byed dgos/ nga rang tshos byed rgyu de la chos kyi 'tsho ba dang / srid kyi 'tsho ba gnyis yod pa nas/ srid la shugs ston byed pa nang bzhin chos kyi thog la yang shugs ston chen po byed dgos/ kha nas bshad pa tsam la cha 'jog pa de 'dra min par/ nang pa sangs rgyas zer ba gang 'dra yin min gyi don dag shes shing tshang ba zhig dgos/ de ni bla ma dkon mchog gsum ngo shes nas mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims lag len du bkal na mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang pa red/ de min bla ma dang / rgyal po sogs su zhig yin rung mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khri/ mas lag len du ma bkal na nang pa ma red/ dper na/ ho thog thu zhig yin kyang bla ma ma red/ bsam blo'i nang skyabs 'gro med na bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus/ lus la chos gos snam sbyar gyon na'ang nang pa ma red/ de bzhin mi phal pa nas kyang kha nas ma ṇi bgrang pa sogs kha 'don dge sbyor byed kyang skyabs 'gro ngo shes de'i bslab bya lag len du ma bkal na nang pa ma red/ las 'bras ma srung na chos med/ chos lag len du ma bkal na sangs rgyas la yid ches med/ de'i stabs kyis dge 'dun la'ang skyabs su mi 'gro bas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro med pa dang / nang pa zhig byed 'dod na nang pa'i chos dngos gnas shes dgos pa dang / rgyu mtshan tshang ba'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum ngo shes dgos/ dkon mchog gsum ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog bcas yin/ dkon mchog gsum dang po nas yod pa zhig min par thog ma sems can phal pa zhig nas rim gyis rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyud la ldan pa'i 152

tshe 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dang / de'i rgyud kyi chos de chos dkon mchog de yang bzang du bzang du song ste mthar yon tan kun rdzogs/ skyon thams cad spangs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas bcas dkon mchog gsum byung ba yin/ de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzi brjid chen po yin/ gzhan ye shu ma shi ka dang /hin rdi'i chos la sogs par dkon mchog de dang po nas chags bsdad pa zhig tu 'dod/ nga tsho phal pas ji tsam dka' ngal gyis chos bsgrubs kyang lha'i rten tsam las dkon mchog gi go 'phang sgrub mi thub pa lta bu dang / de bzhin mu tig pa'i lta ba grangs can pa sku/gas kyis sangs rgyas zhes yar tsam zhig nas shing sna dang / me tog sogs bzos par 'dod pa dang / hin rdi'i chos la'ang 'jig rten bkod pa po tshangs par 'dod kyi yod pa red/ nang pa'i chos nas nga tsho mi phal pa yin rung so sos dka' las brgyab/ rang rgyud je bzang je bzang du btang na mthar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob rgyu yod par bshad pa 'dis nga tsho mi la spobs pa chen po zhig gnang yod pa red/ dper na da lta mdun du yod pa'i 'bu grog ma 'di da lta'i dus 'bu'i lus rten zhig yin yang 'di'i rgyud kyi bsam blo 'di spus dag tu dang / yag tu song ste nam zhig na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob rgyu yod/ da lta'i char nga dang grog ma'i sems la mtshon na nga'i sems de sangs rgyas kyi sar thag nye ba dang / grog ma'i sems de phran bu thag ring ba lta bu yod kyang grog ma 'dis ma 'ongs par 'phags pa'i lam chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs yong dus chos dkon mchog de 'dra'i yon tan rgyud la ldan pa de dge 'dun pa/ mthar skyon med cing yon tan yongs 153

su rdzogs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas dkon mchog thob pa yin/ de bzhin sgrub pa'i rgyu nga rang tsho tshang mar yod/ nga chos bla ma dkon mchog gsum phyi nas 'tshol mi dgos pa ma 'ongs par rang gis thob pa'i thabs su da lta'i char chos nyan/cho sa don nyams su len dgos/ rang gis thob byar gyur pa'i 'bras bu skyabs gsum po de khong rang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis bstan pas ston pa po/ bstan pa de bsgrub na skyabs dngos chos red/ da mang po bshad na rnyog gzhir 'gro bzo 'dug gang ltar skyabs dngos chos de yin stabs de tshad longs pa zhig sgrub dgos/ de'i rgyu thog mar so so skye bo phal pa nas yong dgos/ de dag yong rgyu'i rtsa ba mi dge bcu la skyon yod pa shes nas spangs/ skyon med pa dge ba bcu nyams sa blangs/ de 'dra byas nas nang pa'i chos spas dag po zhig byed chosing —ring dgos/ ngas bshad pa 'di tsho khyed rang tshos go khag po mkhregs po zhig tu mthong rgyu yang / don de shes dgos dus tshig mkhregs po zhig ma bshad thabs med red/ spyir go khag po min yang khyed rang tsho yon tan la sbyangs pa med pa'i dbang gis red/ der brten lo rgas kyang yi ge slob dgos/ nga la bla ma'i yon tan gang yang med kyang khyed tshos nga la dad pa zhig byas nas yong dus chos dang srid kyi jog nas bslab dgos kyi red/ de min ngas khyed tsho'i mgo la sha ru rngaṭa gdos bcas kyi lag pa zhig bzhag nas dngul dang kha btags len pa 'di bshu gzhog gtong mkhan lta bu byed kyi 'dug ngas bshad pa de sto khyed tsho'i sems la zhog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis khang pa'i nang bzhugs nas bka' bstan bcos rnams brtsams yod pa ma red/ dge 'dun 'du tshogs 154

skabs dang lam bar phebs kyin bka' slob gang gnang ba rnams zin thor bkod de bka' dang bstan bcos rnams byung ba red/ de bzhin khyed tsho 'dir dad pa zhig byas nas yong / ngas bshad pa rnams khyed rang tshos ma go/ ngas yi ge btang ba de yang khyed rang tshos klog nas shes pa ma byas na chos bshad/ yi ge bris na'ang rmi lam btang ba nang bzhin blo pham po red/ phyogs gnyis ka nas nor 'khrul red/ nga tshos nub phyogs pa'i skad yig ma shes na ngo tsha rgyu dang / spam shor rgyu gang yang mi 'dug bod pas bod yig ma shes na dngos gnas ngo tsha po red/ der brten ngas btang ba'i yi ge dang / dril bsgrags kyi yig cha sogs klog ste slob sbyong byed dgos/ khyed rang tshor ltos te nga phran bu kha bde ba yod pa 'di thog mara.a mdo'i yul du ma shes kyang / ngas ka kha nas bslabs te shes byung / da dung bslab rgyu dang shes rgyu mang po bsdad yod/bslabs na mi shes pa med/ khyed tshos nyin rer tshig re bslabs na tshig mang po dang / bdun re'i nang la'ang tshig re bslabs na zla ba gcig la gang 'tshams shes thub/ ngas rgyun du brjod pa bzhin nga tshos yi ge slob dgos/ yi ge shes pa/ khrus dang gtsang sbra shes pa bya dgos/ yi ge ma shes na rna bar lcags dong bcug nas bshad kyang go khag po yin/ ltos dang meg lo lhan jir btsog pa'i dri ma gang 'dra kha gi 'dug mi tshos bod pas gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten shes kyi mi 'dug ces bshad yong dus ngo tsha po dang / sems skyo po 'dug yon tan med na mang gtso gang 'dra byas nas lag len du bstar thub kyi red/ dper na/ deng skabasa.a phe ri ga'i mang gtso lag len du bstar nas nyin bdun tsam 155

nas mi bsad mang po byung yod pa red/ chos dang srid gang yang go rgyu med mkhan de 'dra mthong yong dus sems skyo po 'dug yon tan sbyong ba la mtha' gcig tu slob grar zhugs mi dgos/ rgan pa tshos rgyun du nas slob sbyong byed dgos/ dper na/ dgong dro gnyid chu tshod 8 tsam nyal gyi yod na de nas chu tshod 1 tsam bcag ste slob sbyong byas na 'grigs/ nga rang tshos de ring bshad pa de rnams sems la bzhag nas shes pa byed dgos/ rjes su nga tsho yang yang thug skabs de dus 'di 'dra yin bsam pa'i dran thub pa zhig dang / dngos gnas nang pa mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig byed dgos/ mchod 'bul byed kyi yod ces dngul gtor ba las chos de so sos byed dgos/ gcig byas na ngas sdig pa bsags pa yin 'gro/ chos byed rogs zhes sku yon sprad rgyu ma rag na/ so sos chos sgrub/ sangs rgyas kyis khyim pa dang / lkug pa sogs rigs rus kyi dbye ba phye med/ sgrub pa gtso bor gsungs yod/ mi la sku yon sprad pa las rang gis chos sgrub/ so 11sa dka' las rgyab nas bsags/ dgos dus la btang na legs/ nga 7rgyal ba rin po che zhes 'das bsngo dang gson bsngo mang po zhig 'byor te zhal 'debs bsdu mkhan lta bu zhig 'dug ngas mi re rer bsngo smon byed long yang mi 'dug byed shes kyi yang mi 'dug sems can thams cad la dmigs te bsngo smon gang shes rgyun du nas byed kyi yod/ bsngo rten 'bul 'byor byung ba rnams nas pad gcig kyang ngas rang mkhor spyad pa med/ tshang ma zhabs brtan dang / gzhis chags sogs la gtong gi yod/deng sang nga rang tshos dngul gtor nas skyid po byed rgyu'i dus tshod ma red/156

dka' las rgyag pa'i dus tshod yin stabs tshang mas bsri tshags byed dgos/lhag par lam bzo ba tshos gla dngul byung ba rnams lam seng gtor rkyang mi byed par bsri tshags ca ga yag po byed dgos/ nga tshos rgyun du kha rgyun dang / sems la 'jags dgos pa 'di phyi gnyis yod sgrub pa'i thabs chos srid zung 'brel de lhag bsam rnam dag dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis sgrub dgos/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes stsal// // 157

de༅༅// phyi lo 1964 zla 12 tshes 8 snga dro/ rgya gara.o ri sa/ can rdi gi ri bod mi gzhis chags sar gzhis chags pa dge 'dun grangs 150tsam dang / sngags 'chang grangs 60 tsam/ de min skye bo pho mo bcas khyon mi grangs 1400 skor 'du 'dzoms sar/ sgrol ma nyer gcig ma dang / lam rim bsdus don/ bsam lhun/ bar chad lam sel bcas kyi ljags lung zhus stsal skabs sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad bka' slob stsal ba/da ring bod mi gzhis chags che ba'i grasaso ri sa 'dir nga rang tsho tshang ma 'dzoms 'phrad byung bar dga' po byung / nga la bla ma'i ming zhig yod pa dang / gzhi rtsa khyed tshor rus zhen zhig yod pa red de/ 'on kyang gtso bor dad pa byas te chos don du gnyer nas yong ba red/ bla ma'i ming yod pa de dang / dad pa yod pa'i slob ma rnams 'dzoms pa'i skabs 'dir las su bya ba ni chos shod rgyu de yin/ chos 'chad nyan byed pa 'di lugs srol lta bur bzung nas byed pa min la/ gzhan gyis khral 'grel lta bu byas nas 'chad nyan byed pa yang min/ 'o na ji ltar yin snyam na chos 'chad mkhan gyi bla ma dang /dad ldan gyi slob ma 'phrad de rten 'brel 'dzoms pa'i tshe dga' spro dang bcas rang gis ngang gis chos 'chad nyan byed dgos pa zhig 'byung ba yin/ de ltar gzhan gyis btsan pos bskul ba dang / lugs srol bzung ba ma yin par khyed rang tshos kyang rang gi 'dod pas dwang du blangs te chos nyan du yong / ngas kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos mang po mi shes kyang / phran bu shes pa de nas tshig gcig gis phan rung phan pa rang yin stabs shod khul byas te de ring gi dus 158

su rang re chos 'chad nyan byed pa skabs su babs pa de ltar yin/ de la spyir rang re bod mi rnams 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing / lha dang bla ma'i gdan sa/ byin rlabs kyi 'od 'phro ba bod kha ba gangs can du skyes pa zhig yin/ rang tsho phyi dngos po'i 'dzugs skrun gyi cha nas phyug po min par dbul poyin/ nga tshor 'khor lo med cing / bgrod lam legs po med/ mdor na mu zi da nga / khab tsam yang legs po rang bzo mi shes kyang / nga tsho'i bsam blo'i nang phyug po yod/ shes rig gi tshad mjo po yin la/ sbru'i yar rgyas shugs chen po yod/ der brten bod kha ba gangs can du skyes pa'i mi la phyi khra khra zing zing gi thog nas dbul po yin yang / nang bsam blo'i thog nas spobs pa byas chog pa'i chos dang / shes rig gting zab mo zhig tan tan yod nges las med pa min/ chos dang shes rig gis dul mar gyur pa'i mi rigs shig nang nga sto skyes pa yin/ bod mi tshor chos shig yod pa de ni nang pa sangasku rgyas pa'i chos yin/ nga tsho tshang mas ston pa bka' drin can gyi mtshan nas smos pa'i skabs dang / rgya gar rdo je gdan lta bu bcom ldan 'das sku dngos kyis zhabs gcags pa'i gnas kyi mtshan tsam sgos na yang / dad gus chen pos lag thal mo sbyar/ bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi zhes brjod mus yin/ do bdag so gos nang pa'i chos kyi khungs dang / sgrub byed gnad 'gag dpyis phyin pa zhig shes min sna tshogs dang / mang che bas shes kyi med kyang / nga chos dad pa bya yul rtsa ba'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di shin tu bzang po dang / spus dag po/ dad pa byed rin chog pa zhig nges par du yod/ de gang 'dra zhig 159

red zer na/ nga tshos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes brjod pa'i chos 'di ni/ phyi nang gi chos gnyis su yod pa'i nang nas nang pa'i chos/ de la yang 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa sogs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mang po zhig yod pa'i nang nas rnam 'dren bzhi pa shakya thub pa'i bstan pa yin/ rnam 'dren stong gi nang na pad+ma dkar po ltar bsngags pa'i 7rgyal ba shakya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gzhan las ches cher lhag pa yin/ sangs rgyas nang phan tshun la spangs ༄rtogs macesag dman dang / gdul byar nye ring mdzad pa med kyang / gdul bya'i las smon rten 'brel gyi mthus da lta'i bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'di mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra tsam gyi spus dag po zhig yod pa red/ nga tsho tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ 'dir rab byung ngur smrig gi sde dang / sngags pa gos dkar gyi sde gnyis yod pa 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i gnad kyis de ltar byung ba yin/ de ltar nga tsho'i bstan pa 'di ni shin tu zab cing / shin tu rmad du byung ba/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i bstan pa zhig yin pas na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rnams phar tshad du bzhag ste/ nga tshos dmigs yul 'dzin sa ni bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang de yin/ de 'dra'i bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang de yang pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam la brten na bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi bar bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te mthar dzadas gzugs kyi sku gnyis 160

sgrub dgos pa yin kyang / nga tsho'i mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa 'di la chos sku dam pa dang / gzugs sku dam pa ste/ dam pa gnyis ldan gyi sku de yang dus tshod yun ring lo mang po dang / bskal pa mang por ltos ma dgos par dus yun thung ngu'i nang sgrub thub pa sogs bstan pa 'di ha cang gi mthu chen po dang / rlabs chen po zhig yin/ de ltar nga tshos chos gang gi sgor zhugs pa'i bstan pa 'di ni mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i bstan pa yin pas 'di 'dra dang mjal ba sngar ma byung la/ phyis kyang 'byung mi srid pa lta bu shin tu rtsa ba chen po/ shin tu zab pa/ shin tu rgya che ba zhig red/ de 'dra'i nyams su len rgyu'i chos shin tu spus dag po de dang / spyir btang brjod na/ chos nyams su len mkhan 11da kha ba gangs can du skyes pa'i mi zhig yin pas/ nyams su blang rgyu'i chos dang / nyams su len mkhan gyi rten gnyis ga'i cha nas rkyen legs po zhig 'dzoms yod/ 'o na gang gis lan yod dam snyam na/ nga tshos chos la do snang ma byas/ nyams su ma blangs/ brtson 'grus dang / don gnyer ma byas par/ rna bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa go ba tsam gyis tshim nas/ ne+e ce'i 'don pa lta bu'i ma ṇi tsam bgrangs/ de tsam la chog shes byas/ de tsam gyi thog tu skyid nyal byas nas bsdad pa yin stabs nga tsho'i chos zab mo zhig yod kyang zab mo'i don ma shes/ rgya chen po zhig yod kyang rgya chen po'i don ma shes/mdor na rim gyis mthar gtugs na/ bstan pa yang ngo ma shes/ chos kyang ngo ma shes/ ha lam bstan pa zer dus phyi rol du se rdzog rdzog gi sku zhig tu bsam/ nga lta bu chos gos snam sbyar gron pa zhig yod na de bstan pa 'dzin mkhan 161

red zer ba dang / sngags 'chang ral pa'i lcang lo chen po bcings pa zhig yod na de grub thob red zer ba lta bu sangs rgyas kyi bstan 'dzin dge 'dun de yang phyi'i rtags cha lugs tsam dang / grub thob de yang phyi'i rtags cha lugs tsam nas ma gtogs 'grel bshad rgyag mi thub pa lta bur song yod/ 'dul ba'i bstan pa ngo ma de ngo shes pa'i thog nas de 'dzin mkhan la bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu zhes ming 'dogs dgos pas na 'dul ba'i bstan pa ji 'dra zhig la zer ba dang / rtsa ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji 'dra zhig la zer ba nges par du shes dbotos/ lam rim pa gnyis la 11gas pa nang gi rtogs pa'i sku(na tan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhig gi thog nas grub pa'i dbang phyug gi ming zhig thogs dgos/de dag la 'jig rten phal gyi 'gran du mi bzod pa'i zab khyad bla na ma mchis pa zhigakugo da pa de cho'i nang gi zab khyad rnams nga tshos ma shes par/ phyi'i cha lugs tsam gyi jog nas ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa'i dus tshod cig tu slebs nas/ yod/ spyir btang sdug sa nas brjod na ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dag snang sbyong ba 'di ga tsam yang dga' mo yin gyi red de/ bsam blo zhib tu btang na/ 'di tsam gyis rtsa ba nas ldengs kyi mi 'dug nga chos chos ngo ma ngo ma shes pa'i skyon chen po 'dug sngar phan nga tshos bod kyi yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar shar yod/ ces shod kyi yang yod la bstan pa legs po dar yod/ 'on kyang rtsis zhi ba tshags gcig brgyab na/ bar skabs bstan pa dar lugs de phyi'i khra khra zing zing gi thog tu phyin 'dug gong du brjod pa ltar/ chos gos snam sbyar gyon pa bstan pa 'dzin mkhan dang / ral pa'i 162

lcang lo bcings na sngags 'chang yin pa lta bu/ mtshams khang nag khung zhig yod na sngags pa sdod sa dang / sgo 'phyor rdzig po dang / zangs kyi dzi par bkal yod na dgon pa legs po yin par bzungs/ da cha stabs legs nas nga sto btsan byol bar gyur pas sgo 'phyor rdzig po yang mi 'dug phar phyogs su chos gzhis mi ser rnams la dka' sdug che thag chod btang / tshur phyogs su grwa pa nyung shas shig gis gtsug lag khang 'dra chags po zhig bzos/ sbyin bdag su bzang la thob shor bzung / sbyin bdag byung dus rgya thug gtong sar rgya thug btang / mog mog gtong sar mog mog btang / phar rgya thug dkar yol 'ga' shas dang / mog mog 'ga' shas sprad nas/ tshur mang ja dang / sku 'gyed ston pa byung na bsam pa byas/ de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsam pa min/ grod khog gi bsam blo btang ba yin/ da dung nga'i sbyin bdag dang /kho'i sbyin bdag ces brjod dus rul 'gro gi yod/ yang sngags 'chang gcig gis 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'du 'dzi'i grong nas rgyang bsrings/ de kho na nyid dam/ dzadas nyid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i rang gi blo gnyis su med par 'dres pa'i thog nas/ zab khyad 'don mkhan zhig yod na/ rang lus grong khyer nang bsdad na yang de dben pa'i gan sa su don gyis gnas pa yin te/ de 'dra min par/ bsam blor rang gi ngo shes dang / slob ma sogs 'go 'don byed stangs dang / rang gi gtam dang lar rgya don du gnyer ba sogs byas na/ lus mtshams khang nag khung nang zla ba dang lo sbrel nas bsdad kyang rang nyid btson pa lta bur byas pa sdug gyong red ma 163

gtogs phan thogs gang yang med/ der brten nga chos chos ngo ma de ngo shes nas gzab gzab byas na/ ngas gong du brjod pa ltar bar lam bod kyi nang la yang phyi'i gtsug lag khang sogs 'dra chags po yod kyang / zhib tu gtugs na zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan du gyur yod/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor grub thob kyi cha lugs can rnams kyi khrod nas 'ga' shas ni sngar rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad cu zhes pa de dag dang / mtshan gyi skad grags tsam ma gtogs nang gi rtogs pa mnyam pa byung yod kyang / spyir btang rnams khag po yin/spus dag pa'i cha phyogs gcig nas bltas na/ sngar rgya gar gyi na len ḍa lta bu'i bshad sgrub kyis bstan pa 'dzin mkhan yod pa dper na/ se 'bras dga' gsum sogs la na len ḍa gnyis par 'bod pa ltar/ thos bsam slob gnyer dang / 'chad nyan gyi cha nas ha las pa zhig yod/ de bzhin du grub chen brgyad cu dang dpung pa bdar thub pa'i grub thob chen po yang byung yod kyang /phyogs gzhan zhig nas bltas na/ skyon mang po zhig yod par mthong gi 'dugang tsho'i bod lung par kha nas chos dang chos zhes shod mkhan mang po yod kyang /cesas shes mkhan nyung ba dang / rgya che'i mi mang nang la cesas shes mkhan ni shin tu nyung nyung yin/ dpe cha bltas te gzhung rgya chen po slob gnyer byed mkhan dang / yang gzhung gi mtha' rgya bcad pa min yang gdams ngag gnad du thig pa'i man ngag gi chu bo'i rgyun bzung nas/ zab don sgom mkhan dkon po yin pa lta bu mthong gi 'dug rtsa ba nga tsho'i yul la chos dar khyab chen po yod kyang /sha ra bas / sing skyur la phye btab pa bzhin/ kha la yam me bar song / gsungs 164

pa ltar/ kha la yam yam du phyin nas gting du tshod thub med stabs sngar phan nga tsho'i yul du rgyu 'bras rnyog mkhan byung yod/ sde dpon mi drag nang du yang rgyu 'bras rnyog mkhan mang po yod/ dgon pa gra tshang gi las sne'i nang la yang rgyu 'bras rnyog mkhan ji snyed yod/ stong rigs kyi nang la'ang las 'bras rnyog mkhan yod/ mdor na drag zhan bar ma tshang mas kha nas chos chos zer gyi yod kyang / lag len go ldog tu spyod pa byung yod/ de 'dra'i rkyen gyis nga cho bod yul dang bral ba red/ rang gi phun tshogs thams cad bskyal te mi yul du mgo ril ril du nyin re'i zas phogs tsam la bltas te sdod dgos pa'i bskyal mgo ril 'di chags pa red/ blo goms pa'i dbang gis nga tsho btsan byol ba yin zhes da dung spobs pa byas pa ma gtogs don la zhib tu bsam na/ nga tsho rang yul bral te mi yul du gyar ba'i yul gyar ba yin/ thabs rdugs red/1957458 lo nang bar skabs rgya sde'i khongs su tshud pa'i 'bri chu shar brgyud kyi bod sa khag dang / zi ling phyogs la bcos bsgyur thabs sdug de zin nas rang mi khams pas mdo ba drag zhan mang po lha sar yong / lha sa'i gling skor grong mthar sbra gur nang sdod dus de tsho yul gyar ba red ces brjod pa red/skabs der khong tsho zhi rang re bod yul nang khungs lung tshan gcig nas gcig tu spo dgos byung ba tsam zhig red/ da lta nga tsho'i dugatshod 'di ni ngo thog gzhan yul du gyar te don dam yul gyar ba chags yod/ bla ma dge bshes yin rung yul gyar ba yin/ grub thob cig yin rung yul gyar ba yin/ de bzhin mi mang dang / nga rang dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang bcas pa tshang ma yul 165

pa ltar/ kha la yam yam du phyin nas gting du tshod thub med stabs sngar phan nga tsho'i yul du rgyu 'bras rnyog mkhan byung yod/ sde dpon mi drag nang du yang rgyu 'bras rnyog mkhan mang po yod/ dgon pa gra tshang gi las sne'i nang la yang rgyu 'bras rnyog mkhan ji snyed yod/ stong rigs kyi nang la'ang las 'bras rnyog mkhan yod/ mdor na drag zhan bar ma tshang mas kha nas chos chos zer gyi yod kyang / lag len go ldog tu spyod pa byung yod/ de 'dra'i rkyen gyis nga cho bod yul dang bral ba red/ rang gi phun tshogs thams cad bskyal te mi yul du mgo ril ril du nyin re'i zas phogs tsam la bltas te sdod dgos pa'i bskyal mgo ril 'di chags pa red/ blo goms pa'i dbang gis nga tsho btsan byol ba yin zhes da dung spobs pa byas pa ma gtogs don la zhib tu bsam na/ nga tsho rang yul bral te mi yul du gyar ba'i yul gyar ba yin/ thabs rdugs red/1957458 lo nang bar skabs rgya sde'i khongs su tshud pa'i 'bri chu shar brgyud kyi bod sa khag dang / zi ling phyogs la bcos bsgyur thabs sdug de zin nas rang mi khams pas mdo ba drag zhan mang po lha sar yong / lha sa'i gling skor grong mthar sbra gur nang sdod dus de tsho yul gyar ba red ces brjod pa red/skabs der khong tsho zhi rang re bod yul nang khungs lung tshan gcig nas gcig tu spo dgos byung ba tsam zhig red/ da lta nga tsho'i dugatshod 'di ni ngo thog gzhan yul du gyar te don dam yul gyar ba chags yod/ bla ma dge bshes yin rung yul gyar ba yin/ grub thob cig yin rung yul gyar ba yin/ de bzhin mi mang dang / nga rang dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang bcas pa tshang ma yul 165

rgyar ba yin/ nga tsho rang yul bral te sems skyo po dang / thabs sdug por gyar yod/ da cha nga phyor nyin re bzhin du dka' ngal ga tshod 'dug phyogs gcig nas chos kyi bsam blo gcig gtong dgos la/ phyogs gcig nas sto gos kyi bsam blo zhig gtong dgos/ de yang nga sto gcig pu khungs 'khyol bas mi 'grigs par/ rang yul 'gyel sa nas langs thub pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ da lta nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di'i rto tshe 'phyid tsam gyis mi 'grigs par mi rabs rjes ma de'i bsam blo gtongadagos sngar nga tshos las ka legs po zhig byas yod na da tshod thabs sdug po 'di 'dra rangayong gi ma red de/ da cha phyis drags pa yin/ le lan thams cad gcig la gda'/ zhes pa ltar le lan gzhan la 'gel sa med/ rang gis las ngan pa bsags pa'i 'bras bu rang gi myong ba yin pas bya thabs gang yang med/ ngo sprod lta bu byas na de 'dra yin/nga tshor chos shin tu legs po zhigaci yod pa de lag len tshul bzhin ma bstar bar phyi'i 'dra chags po kho na'i thog tu phyin te las 'bras rnyog las 'bras rnyog na ni/ las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam mi khyab/ brtse ba'i bdag nyid canasang dud 'gror skye/ zhes pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa' tsho la yang de 'dra yong gi yod na/ nga tshorwa 1da kha ba gangs can spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing du skyes pa'i mi yin zhes las 'bras kyi sgrig khrims 'khur ma dgos pa'i dmigs bsal gtong mkhan suyang mi yong / de bzhin du rang gi chos dang /srid kyi lag len gra sgrig tshul bzhin du ma byas par bod lha dang bla ma'i gdan sayin zhes 'gro ba mi'i gnas yul min pa tsam du brjod/ dka' ngal zhig 166

byung dus mo re brgyab/ ngas sdug sa nas shod kyi yin/ nga tshor skyon yod pa rnams la mdzub mo btsugs na/ bla ma la yang sna tshogs yod pas/ mo thigs dang ma thigs som nyi yin/ gang ltar zhabs brtan zhig phab/ zhabs brtan re bsgrubs kyang / zhabs brtan bsgrubs pa de yang khungs dag po zhig med de/ rang gi lto tshe 'phyid thabs tsam las/ gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems zhes pa sogs khag po red/ de tsho phar bzhag cho ga de yang ji bzhin tshang ba zhig ma bton/ zhabs brtan sgrub mkhan tsho'i za 'thung gi rgyu cha spus dag pa zhig dang / gtor ma'i rgyu cha rnams sdug pa zhig bsdogs/ de 'dras zhabs brtan yong ba 'dug gam/ bsam blo gtong rgyu gang yang med par rnga brdungs/sbub dkrol/ rgya gling gang snyan zhig btang / de dag chos byed pa'i khul du byas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis wa ra ṇa sir thog mar chos gsungs pa nas rgya gar nang lo de tsam zhig bzhugs 'dug kyang / khong gi drung du rgya gling btang ba'i lo rgyus ngas mthong ma myong / de'i rjes su rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang /grub chen brgyad cu sogs byung yod pa khong tsho'i sked par rnga sbub rgya gling sogs btags med kyang khong tshos mchog gi dngos grub sgrub thub pa dang / rang gzhan don gnyis rgya cher sgrub thubakod pa red/ nga tshor ma cogs shig shig byed dgos pa'i rnga zhig dgos/ dung zhig kyang dgos/ rgya gling zhig kyang dgos/rgya gling gang snyan snyan dang / dung gang tsha tsha btang nas gral mtshams pa'i rna bar gtser sgra rgyag dgos pa btang nasang / don ngo thog lha'i nga rgyal dgos sar nga rgyal dang / gsal snang dgos sar gsal snang / de 'dra'i sngags 167

kyi rnal 'byor zab mo ma byung yang / byams pa dang snying rjes drangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems sgom pa dang / mthar de 'dra ma byung rung / skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum ngo shes pa'i skyabs 'gro rnam dag cig yod na/ skyabs 'gro kho na'i thog nas sngags bgrangs/ rnga brdungs byas pa yin na/ de ni ra ma lug lta bu chags pa red de phran bu phan re zhig yod srid/ de 'dra zhig kyang med stabs/ zhabs brtan dang zhabs brtan zhes mang po zhig bsgrubs kyang phan pa yong gi ma red la/ phan thogs kyang ma byung ba red/ dga' ldan pho brang pa'i khyab khongs la mtshon na/ rdzong gzhis so so nas gzhung 'bab ji byung rnams rdzong gzhis so so'i nang gi da gon khag tsho'i mchod rgyun thog mang po gtong gi yod pa red/ khong tsho ming snyan po bstan srid kyi zhabs rim du btags pa zhig dang / sgrub jo 'dra chags po zhig 'god kyi yod kyang / don snying ngo ma ji yod nga tsho tshang mes shes gsal red/ nga tshos hob ste bltas na/ rgya mis nga mo bskrad byung bsam pa zhig yod kyang / bsam khro zhib tu btang na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sgrub byed rnams yang dag pa yin dgos la/ yin thag chod red/ rgya mir khag 'dogs byed sa med/ nga rang tshos nor yod/ rtsa ba'i rgyu rnams nga rang tshos sgrub yod/ 'on kyang 'phral rkyen rgya mi dmar po'i byed las kyis nga tsho btsan byol du gyur nas sdug bsngal myong ba yin/ rtsa ba nga tsho'i lung pa 'phung la sbyor ba'i rgyu cha rnams nga rang tshoso bsgrubs/ nga rang tshos lan/ nga rang tshos ma 'grigs pas byung ba yin pas/ phyin chad kyang nga rang tsho so so gzab gzab bya rgyu de shin tu gal chen po yin/ ha cang gal chen po red/168

de ltar nga tshor chos legs po zhig yod kyang de ji bzhin ma shes pa'i skyon de lta bu lhags 'dug da per na/ dkon mchog zer ba gang yin/ de bzhin sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun zer ba ji 'dra zhig yin nam zhes dris na/ji bzhin lan 'debs bya rgyu khag po red/ nyan thos sde pa'i gzhung nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas tsam yang ngo ma shes/ chos ngo ma shes/ dge 'dun yang ngo ma shes/ de gsum ngo ma shes pa'i nang pa zhig chags/ de gsum ngo ma shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhig chags/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum ngo ma shes pa'i sngags pa zhig chags te/ bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren rtsa ba nas zhus pa red/ sngags pa'i gral du tshud ma tshud ni byang chub kyi sems gzhi mar bzhag smin byed dbang gis rgyud smin/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i 'jug sgo gnyis po legs par ldan pa zhig la sngags pa zer/ byang chub kyi sems ma mtha' bcos ma gang legs shig med na dbang ga la thob/ dbang ma thob na sngags pa'i gral la mi tshud/ dbang gral du bsdad pa tsam gyi dbang mi thob/de bzhin du byang chub kyi sems med na theg chen par mi tshud/ skyabs 'gro med na nang pa'i gral du ga la tshud/ dper na/ nged la phyi nas 7rgyal ba rin po che ming btags yod kyang / nga'i rgyud la skyabs 'gro med na/ nga nang pa ma red/ nga'i rgyud la skyabs 'gro yod na nang pa yin pa dang / nga'i rgyud la byang chub kyi sems shig skyes sku(nga na theg chen par gyur pa red ma garke(gas gzhan khag po yin/ ha cang khag po yin/ mdor na gong du brjod pa ltar ya gi'i mthon po rnams phar bzhag ste/ skyabs 'gro tsam yang ma shes pa'i skyon chen 169

po de ltar yod/ de bzhin du las 'bras la mtshon na/ mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims yong ba la thog mar mi dge bcu ngo shes dgos/ mi dge bcu ngo ma shes na mi dge bcu'i tshul khrims kyang khag po red/ mi dge bcu 'jog dgos na de ji bzhin nges pa yang khag po yin/ bsam blo zhig btang / dpyad pa zhig byed dus sems skyo po red/ rtsa ba nga rang tsho'i mi rigs 'di ha cang gi gzi brjid chen po yin yang / nga tshor ngoms rgyu nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di kho na las med pa dang de yang nor nyan pa ma shes pa yong dus sems skyo bo/ blo pham po zhig red/ 'dir bod nang gi byung ba zhig brjod na/ lha sa'i mi zhig gis lha sa'i nye skor gnas bla ma zhig la/ nga tshos ni grangs gsog tsam byas nas sdod rgyu las chos ji bzhin nyams len thub kyi mi 'dug khyed ni sgrub pa nyams len gnang ba ngo mtshar che zhes brjod par/ bla ma des/ drang srong mthu yis bden tshig 'grub gyur cig zer ba yin pas/ grangs ka song na de gas 'grigs kyi red ces brjod yod tshod 'dug de bzhin du/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ zhes pa la/ bdud gcig btul na bdud gnyis sangs rgyas 'gyur/ zhes 'grel bshad byed pa dang / yang mi zhig gis chos bshad mang po byed par/ zhog don yod mkhas grub yin nam gcig gis sangs rgyas dkon mchog de ji 'dra zhig yod dam zhes dri ba mdzad par/ mdzub mo gnam la btsugs te/ mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings shig na/ shel gyi khang pa'i nang du 'od 'tsher re bzhugs yod ces brjod pa'i lo rgyus yod/ zhib tu ma sbyangs na mi shes par khag kyang med/ de tshos lung chung 170

nang gi dpon chung lta bur chos bshad byas/ tshe dbang 'dra bskur na yang / rang nyid kyi kha thabs de 'dra zhig gi thog tu bsdad yod/ gcig byas na 'dir phag ri bayod 'gro/ bzhi pa zung 'jug don la ngo sprad pas/ zhes par bdun tshigs bzhi par zung 'jug tu ngo sprod byed tshul bshad pa dang / 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying por rab byung sdom pa tha ma lnga / zhes pa la/ dge slong thengs lnga skyar sgrub chog par 'grel bshad byas stod 'dug de dag la nga tshos bltas na nod ༷ swā lta bu yod kyang / zhib tu bsam na slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis gsungs pa de rang yin/ ston pa 'jig rten mig ni zum gyur cing / dpang gyur skye bo phal cher zad pa na/ de nyid ma mthong rang dgar gyur pa yi/ ngan rtog rnams kyis bstan pa 'di dkrugs so/ zhes dang / de'i rjes su/ de ltar thub pa dag gis bag yod gyis/ zhes slob dpon dbyig gnyen 'u thug nas gsung shor ba de ngo ma red/ de bzhin du rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtshos kyang / gangs can ri yis bskor ba'i zhing 'dir thub pa'i bstan srol gnas mod kyi/ chos byed phal cher tshul khrims gos bral gcer bur ngo tsha spangs nas ni/ khyim pa rnams la bsnyen cing ngor blta dam pas smad pa'i las la 'jugakye ma dam chos nyi ma'i 'od zer ri bo'i phrag tu nub la nye/ stobs dang ldan rnams rang 'dod lhur len phan tshun rtsod cing dma' la 'tshe/ dman pa rnams ni rtag tu 'khol zhing gyi na'i zas kyang rnyed par dka'/ mi bzad snyigs ma'i ngang tshul 'di 'drar 'phags pas btang snyoms mdzad lags na/ sngon gyi thugs dam de yis ci 'tshal 'bangs rnams su zhig skyabs la brten/ zhes gsung 171

de 'dra shor 'dug 'di dag ni bstan pa shin tu nyams kyi yod pa'i rtags red/gnas kyi bla ma lta bu'i ming bzung / gzhan dag 'dren mkhan yin mdog byas kyang rang gi kha thabs de 'dra zhig las med dus skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum ga la 'jog shes/ spobs pa dang / nga rgyal chen po zhig ni yod pa thag chod/ med na de ltar brjod mi thub/ nga rgyal gyi lhang bu la yon tan gyi chu mi chags zhes pa ltar yin pas/ chos ma shes pa'i skyon de lta bu 'dug gnas tshul de dag dpe mi srid pa'i thabs sdug po yin/ da lta ngas brjod pa 'di tsho ches snga mo byung ba yang ma yin/ nye char gyi byung ba mi gcig nas gnyis brgyud go thos byung ba zhig red/ de tsho gdams ngag lta bur go nas phan thogs yong gi 'dug gzhan la yang shod kyi yod/ da ring khyed tshor yang rgod bro bro dang /khungs skyel lta bur brjod pa yin/ gzhan dag 'dren par rlom pa'i mi de'i kha thabs de 'dra zhig la gyar na/ de la skyabs su 'dzin mkhan gyi mi de rnams lta ji ltar byed dgos/ yar 'dren byed mkhan gyi mi de'i kha thabs de 'dra zhig cilas med na/ gzhan dag tsho lta smos mi dgos pa yin/ shin tu thabs sdug po yin/ shin tu sems skyod nga red/ ka sbag khul du yang chos gnas kha shas kyis gshin po'i dge sgrub byed pa'i skabazlo/ thog mar snyan seng gi dung zhig btang / de nas brgya bzhi bton/ gtor ma bshams skabs dung rgya gling gtong gi 'dug ces go thos byung / de dag kyang chos kyi gnad ma shes pa'am/ shes kyang ma bsgrubs pa yin pa las/ legs rtags rang min pa red/ der brten/de snga bod nang chos kyi gnas stangs de kha nas yam yam la phyin pa las/ don 172

la zhib tshags dang / do snang ma byas pa des lan pa min nam bsam gyi 'dugade ltar chos ma shes pas phongs pa'i skyon de lta bu yod/gnyis nas chos shes kyang tshul bzhin ma bsgrubs pa'i skyon mang po yod/dper na/ nga lta bu khri steng du bzhag na ngas shod kyi red/ mang po mi shes kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam pa'i bka' drin la brten nas dpag tshod cig shes kyi red/ rgya gar paṇa grub tshos gang 'dra zhig gsung gi yod med/ de'i khungs ston pa bka' drin can gyis 'khor lo rim pa gsum pa bskor ba'i nang nas ji 'dra zhig la thug pa sogs mang po shod kyi red/ mi tshos kyang thal mo sbyar/dad pa 'dra yang byed mdog kha po red de/ dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung /zhes pa ltar/ rang gi rang la zhus dag btang ste/ rang gi mang po mi shes kyang /shes stod rnams chu tshod 24 ring lag len la 'gol gyi 'dug gam mi 'dug rang gis rang la dpang po byas te bltas na/ zhum pa skye ba zhig 'dug ma gtogs lag len legs po zhig 'gel thub kyi mi 'dug der brten gang zag khyad par can yong gi red de spyir btang nga dang nga 'dra ba rnams la rang la dpe blangs te bltas na khag po red/ spyir chos shes pa dka' la/ shes nas lag len 'gol ba de bas dka'/ der brten nga tsho tshang mas chos shes dgos kyi 'dug shes nas lag len du 'gol dgos kyi 'du ga snyam du do snang legs po dang / gzab gzab ma byas par bzang po bzang thal dang / bzang po g.yam rgyugs la phyin na rtsa ba nas yag po mi 'dug shin tu gal chen po 'dug173

de la spyir nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pas shin tu rgya che ba yin/ bka' bod skad du bsgyur zin pa rnams la cha bzhag na yang / bka' 'gyur zhes pod de tsam gyi mang po zhig yod/ de gcig pu'i don la yang mtha' dang mu med/ 'khor lo dang po'i skabs gsungs pa dang / 'khor lo bar pa'i skabs la gsungs pa/ 'khor lo tha ma'i skabs gsungs pa/ de dag kyang dgongs don 'dra min bcas yod pas/ nga cho nad mi phar bzhag rgya gar gyi mkhas pa tsho yin yang /sangs rgyas rang nyid kyi lung bstan pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po zhig gi rjes su 'brangs nas dgongs pa 'tshol dgos pa ma gtogs/ rang gi gya tshom du zhugs na drang nges kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin 'grel mi thub pa'i gsung zab mo dang / rgya chen po zhig yod pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed ni zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa 'grel bar lung bstan thob pa dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa rnams 'grel bar lung bstan thob pa 'phags pa thogs med gnyis yin pas khong gnyis sa gsum na nyi zla ltar grags pa yin/ de ltar 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis dbu ma pa dang /'phags pa thogs med kyis sems tsam pa rnam par rig pa'i shing rta'i srol legs par phye/ de dag re re la'ang slob dpon tsho'i bzhed pa 'dra min mang du yod/ spyi'i dbang du byas na/ nang pa la bye brag smra ba dang / mdo sde pa/sems tsam pa/ dbu ma ste grub mtha' bzhir bshad/ bcom ldan 'das kyi chos 'khor 'khor lo dang po'i skabs dbang po dman pa tshor gtso bor gsung 174

pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag ston pa la khungs byas nas bye mdo gnyis kyi bshad srol dang / sems tsam pa'i bzhed srol 'khor lo mtha' ma'i gsung la thug dbu ma pa'i bzhed srol ni/ 'khor lo bar pa'i skabs su gtso bor gsungs pa ste/ gang ltar grub mtha' bzhi ga bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyi dgongs pa yin/ der brten nang pa la zab mo lta ba'i cha nas gtso che ba'i phra rags kyi gnas tshul bzhi byung lugs de ltar yin/ de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung shin tu gting ring zhing / zab pa rgya che ba de dag rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po tshos kyang sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed cig la brten nas drang nges phye ste 'chad dgos pa de dag nga tsho lta bus 'chad thub rgyu shin tu khag po red/ 'on kyang de dag thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am/ thog mar gal che shos de gang yin nam/ mthun rkyen ji 'dra zhig tshang na nang par tshud kyiyod dam/ ji srid mthun rkyen de 'dra zhig ma tshang bar nang par mi tshud pa'i sgo dang po de gang yin nam zer na/ skyabs 'gro yin/ skyabs 'gro byed pa la gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul de ngo shes par byas te/ de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i blo zhig rang gi rgyud la tshang dgos pas na/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul lam/ skyabs de ngo shes pa bya rgyu shin tu gal che/ dpal ldan zla bas//sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la skyabs gsum bshad/ ye shu'i ma shi ku'i rjes 'brangs tsho'i 'dod pa ltar na/ dkon mchog gcig yod pa de 'jig rten bkod pa po yin zhing / thams cad dkon mchog des byas par 175

pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag ston pa la khungs byas nas bye mdo gnyis kyi bshad srol dang / sems tsam pa'i bzhed srol 'khor lo mtha' ma'i gsung la thug dbu ma pa'i bzhed srol ni/ 'khor lo bar pa'i skabs su gtso bor gsungs pa ste/ gang ltar grub mtha' bzhi ga bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyi dgongs pa yin/ der brten nang pa la zab mo lta ba'i cha nas gtso che ba'i phra rags kyi gnas tshul bzhi byung lugs de ltar yin/ de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung shin tu gting ring zhing / zab pa rgya che ba de dag rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po tshos kyang sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed cig la brten nas drang nges phye ste 'chad dgos pa de dag nga tsho lta bus 'chad thub rgyu shin tu khag po red/ 'on kyang de dag thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am/ thog mar gal che shos de gang yin nam/ mthun rkyen ji 'dra zhig tshang na nang par tshud kyiyod dam/ ji srid mthun rkyen de 'dra zhig ma tshang bar nang par mi tshud pa'i sgo dang po de gang yin nam zer na/ skyabs 'gro yin/ skyabs 'gro byed pa la gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul de ngo shes par byas te/ de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i blo zhig rang gi rgyud la tshang dgos pas na/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul lam/ skyabs de ngo shes pa bya rgyu shin tu gal che/ dpal ldan zla bas//sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la skyabs gsum bshad/ ye shu'i ma shi ku'i rjes 'brangs tsho'i 'dod pa ltar na/ dkon mchog gcig yod pa de 'jig rten bkod pa po yin zhing / thams cad dkon mchog des byas par 175

'dod cing / dkon mchog mang po min par gcig tu 'dod/ yang / mu stegs pa chad par smra ba'i grub mtha'i nang skyabs 'gro med/ rtag mtha' smra mkhan nang nas kha shas kyis thar pa skusted par bshad cing / gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad yod kyang / skyabs gsum 'dod pa med/ nga rang tsho nang pa la gong du bshad par ltar skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum yod/de ltar skyabs gsum du bshad pa de yang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pas bcad de bka' ral gri gnam g.yugs lta bur rang bzhin thol byung du gsungs pa lta bu ma yin ste/ de ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung 'dod med kyang de ltar gsungs dgos pa zhig chags yod pa red/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la dkon mchog gsum de ltar yod pas na/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang dngos yod kyi gnas tshul ji bzhin du gsungs pa yin/ de'i tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyasapas rtag dngos yin pa lta bu dkon mchog cig khas blangs/ de'i blo yi g.yo ba sngon du song ba la brten nas 'jig rten 'di 'dra zhig byung bar khas len pa ma yin/ mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas gsum pa'i skabs 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag 'dra min mang po bshad/ 'o na de 'dra'i 'jig rten gyi khams de rgyu las byung ba'am/ rgyu med las byung ba ji yin snyam du rtog dpyod byas pa na/ rgyu las byung bar shes/ rgyu de gang yin zhe na/ gnas bzhi pa'i skabs su/ las las 'jig rten sna tshogs skyes/ zhes rgyu las las byung bar bshad yod/ de 'dra'i las de sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs lta bu las byung ba'am/ dkon mchog lta bu zhig gi blo yi g.yo ba sngon du song ba la brten 176

nas glo bur thog babs lta bur byung ba e yin snyam na/ de ltar min par/ las ni nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba yin pas/ srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug ces brjod pa de ltar yin/ des na rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i 'dod tshul ni/ 'di garalo ri sa gzhis chags bya yul gyi gnas 'dis mtshon pa'i 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya dang / gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud ces pa dang / de yang 'jig rten gyi rdul grangs dang mnyam pa ji+o5ོda par gsungs/ sa'i stod kyi bkod pa de dag thams cad rang rang gi las kyi dbang gis byung / las de yang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ste/ tshig gzhan nas bshad na/ sems ma dul ba las byung / sems ma dul bas las bsags/ des gang du skye 'gyur gyi stod kyi bkod pa chags/ de nas der lus grub ste skyes/ lus rten de la tsha grang ngal dub kyi sdug bsngal rnams myong ba yin/ de lta bu'i 'char gzhi tshang ma las kyis bkod nas byung ba ma gtogs/sdug bsngal rnams glo bur thog babs byung ba ma yin la/ snod bcud kyi bkod pa rnams kyang / dbang phyug dang / tshangs pa la sogs pas 'di 'dra zhig byung na snyam pa'i khro yi g.yo ba sngon du song ba la brten nas byung ba yang ma yin/ las las 'jig rten sna tshogs skyes/ zhes pa ltar las kyi dbang gis byung ba yin/nga tsho sdod sa'i gnas 'dir mtshon na/ der lo bcu sdod mkhan zhig yin na/der lo bcu sdod rgyu'i las shig bsags yod pa dang / yang zla ba gcig sdod mkhan des zla ba gcig bsdad pa'i tshor ba nyams su (1nga rgyu'i las shig bsags pa yin/ gang zag bye brag pa 'ga' shas la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yong srid kyang 177

spyir btang bshad na/ nga tshos gang la yongs su spyod pa'i snod kyi bkod pa de grub pa la der skye mkhan mdor na grog sngar yan the ba'i sems can tshang ma'i spyi mthun gyi las shig gis grub yong gi rā/da pa red/ dper na/ bod mi chos o ri sa'i yul 'di nye dus longs su spyad na yang / de'i las ni stod 'di ma grub pa'i sngon te 'dzam gling 'di ma chags gong nas bsags zin payin/ dper na/ da ring lta bur mtshon rung / gnam gshis dro grang 'di lta bu dang / lhag rlung che chung 'di 'dra zhig la nga tsho mi 'di rnams sa gnas 'dir 'dzoms nas bde sdug gi tshor ba 'di 'dra zhig nyams su myong ba'i bdag 'bras 'di'i rgyu de yar ded na/ 'ga' shas 'dzam gling 'di ma chags gong nas dang / 'ga' shas rkyen slo bur bas byas te gang ltar nga tshos las bsags te zhal 'debs brgyab zin pa red/dge sdig gi 'bras bu khyad par ba 'ga' shas gnas dus phar tshur 'pho 'gyur yong srid/ las tshul bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa kho nas mkhyen/ zhes pa ltar las/ nga tshos brjod rgyu dka' yang / spyir btang brjod na de 'dra yin/ de ltar nga tshos skye ba mang po zhig gis sngon nas las kyi zhal 'debs brgyab/ thun mong spyi mthun gyi las des 'dzam gling 'di grub/sngar nga tsho'i skye ba dung phyur mang po'i gong nas bsags pa'i las kyis grub pa'i sa gnas 'di'i steng du da ring nga tsho 'dzoms pa yin/ mdun du shing sdong mthong ste 'dir shing sdong legs po zhig 'dug snyam du sems la bde ba'i snang ba shar ba de yang skye ba du ma'i sngon nas las bsags pa las byung ba yin la/ da lta 178

bya g.yab 'og tu rlung bsil bu rgyu ba 'di yang gong bzhin las bsags pa kho na las byung ba yin/ de lta bu'i go rim mang po zhig bsgrigs pa 'di thams cad dang / 'jig rten na bde sdug bzang ngan ci mchis pa thams cad glo bur thog babs byung ba ma yin la/ sangs rgyas kyis bzos pa'ang min/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi las kyi dbang gis byung ba 'ba' zhig yin/ las de rnams ni nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung / nyon mongs la rnam grangs mang po yod kyang /mdor bsdus na/ nga tshos rgyun du brjod mus nyon mongs dug gsum wa de rtsa ba yin/ de'i nang nas kyang rtsa ba ded na rmongs pa ma rig pa la thug pa yin te/ 'jig rten rgyud pa ji snyed pa/ de yi rtsa ba ma rig ste/ zhes pa ltar/ 'jig rten gyi rgud tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa kho na la thug pa yin/ dper na/ ngas me rtog yid du 'ong ba zhig mthong / de legs pa la bsam nas sred zhen chags pa drag po zhig skyes te kha nas de snying rje ba la brjod/ lag gis reg pa dang / dri sgom pa la sogs pa byas na lus ngag yid gsum gyis las bsags pa red/ las de dag nyon mongs chags pa drag wa des drangs/ nyon mongs chags pa drag po de yong stangs ni/ rtsa ba me tog la yid du 'ong ba'i cha cung zad tsam yod kyang / me tog de'i cha brgya cha brgya tham pa yongs rdzogs yid du 'ong ba zhig yin na/ mi thams cad kyis mthong ma thag yid du 'ong bar 'dzin dgos kyang / de mi 'dzin/ ngas yid shin tu 'ong bar mthong yang /gzhan gcig gis spam po zhig tu mthong srid/ spyir btang mi tshang ma legs pa la dga' po yod stabs de cha thams cad nas legs po yod na tshang mas 179

dga' po byed 'os pa la/ de ltar mi yong ba de dngos po'i gnas tshul rang la legs cha nyes cha gnyis ka yod pa'i rtags yin/ 'on kyang dga' po byed mkhan des legs cha cung zad yod pa de rang gi blos sgro btags nas ha cang che ru btang bas shin tu bzang po mthong / des ngan pa'i cha yod pa rnams zil gyis mnananas ma mngone pa lta bur gyur payin/ de la zhib rtsis byas na/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul du yod pa'i yid du 'ong ba'i tshad de las rang gi blos yid du 'ong bar 'dzin tshad ches lhag par bzung ba lta bu min nam snyam/ de ni nga'i bsam tshod yin/ dper na/ dngos yod gnas tshul la yid du 'ong ba brgya cha bcu skor zhigapend na/ rang gi bsam tshod la brgya cha brgya tham par bzung ba lta bu yin/ de ltar yid du 'ong ba'i cha cung zad yod pa de la rang gi blos ches shin tu yid du 'ong bar bzung ste ha cang sred zhen gyis chags pa drag po skyes pa'i lho do'i gzhi rtsa 'khrul pa zhig gi thog tu bzhag pa yin/ dngos wa'i gnas stod la yid du 'ong ba'i cha cung zad yod kyang / ches yid du 'ong ba zhig 'dug snyam du rang gi blos bzung ba'i tshad de tsam med pas 'khrul pa can nam/ hang zom zhig gi jog tu gnas yod pa red/ de yang yul bzang ngan ji 'dra zhig yin rung / rang bzhin gyis grub pa med kyang / nga tshor rang ngos nas grub pa ltar snang / snang ba ltar du zhen pa'i dbang gis byung / de ni/ lus dang lus dbang ji bzhin du/ gti mug kun la gnas gyur te/ de phyir nyon mongs thams cad kyang / gti mug bcom pas 'joms par 'gyur/ zhes ar+ya de wa'i dbu ma bzhi brgya par gsungs pa ltar/ yul gang zhig rang min 180

nam bsam gyi 'dug de bzhin du sdang ba la yang 'dra ste/ yul gang zhig la yid du mi 'ong ba'i cha cung zad cig yod kyang / rang rgyud la zhe sdang drag po skyes pa'i tshe blos sgro btags nas ches shin tu yid du mi 'ong bar bltas pa yin/ yang mi zhig la/ gcig gis 'di ni nga'i gnyen yin no zhes phyi nas byugs/ nang nas blud/ gang drag cig drag gis byams brtses skyong bar byed/mi gzhan gcig gis 'di ni nga'i dgra yin no zhes tha na tshig ngan pa zhig las ma byung yang brjod nas sdang bar byed/ yul mi gcig po de rang yin na yang /de la zhen chags yod pa'i mi des kho'i cha thams cad legs pa 'ba' zhig tu mthong ba dang / dgrar 'dzin mkhan des kho'i spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil bar yid du mi 'ong ba kho nar mthong ste gcig gis lha lta bur mthong zhing / gcig gis sdig pa ra tsa ltar mthong / khong gnyis kyis de ltar mthong yul mi de mi gcig pu de rang yin pa las lha lta bu yang med la/ sdig pa ra tsa lta bu yang med/ 'on kyang legs cha nyes cha cung zad re yod pa la so so'i bsam blos sgro btags nas shin tu chen po bzos te de ltar mthong ba yin/ dgra gnyen du lta yul gyi mi de chags sdang can gyi mi gnyis kyi mig sngar snang tsam nyid nas dgra gnyen du rang bzhin gyis grub pa ltar snang ba yin/ de ni chos rnams kyi rtsa ba'i gnas lugs phra mo de kho na nyid kyi don la rmongs pa'i dbang gis tha snyad kun rdzob kyi cha la bzang ngan gyi hang zom chen wa de 'drar gyur song ba min nam snyam/ rgyu mtshan de lta bur brten chags sdang gnyis po skye ba'i gzhi gnyi mug la thug nas yod pas/ nyon mongs thams cad gti mug la rag lus pa dang /181

gti mug dang mtshungs ldan du 'byung bar gsungs yod/ khungs 'di ni slob dpona.ar+ya de bo'i bzhed pa yin/ de bzhin du mgon po klu sgrub kyis kyang / ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/ de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod/ ngar 'dzin yod na yang las de/ las las kyang ni skye ba yin/ zhes phung po bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin ma zad kyi bar phung po la brten nas btags pa'i nga de la nga'o snyam pa'i ngar 'dzin skye bas gang zag gi bden 'dzin dog mi thub par gsungs pa de lta bu yin/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba mthar gtugs na rang rgyud kyi ma rig pa la thug yod/ de gong du lung drangs pa'i/ 'jig rten rgud pa ji snyed pa/de yi rtsa ba ma rig ste/ zhes pa ltar yin/ 'o na rgud tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa yin na/ ma rig pa de zad cing sgong ba'i thabs yod dam med/rtsa ba'i sems kyi rang gshis la ma rig pa'i bslad pa zhugs pa yin nam min zer na/ de ni mthar thug gi dri ba bkon sa ngo ma de yin/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba/ zhes pa ltar sems kyi gnas lugs phra sna() cha nas kyang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa yin la/ kun rdzob pa'i cha nas kyang sems kyi mthar thug pa'i rang gshis la dri ma'i bslad pa zhugs med pa red/ dper na/ sems grub tsam nas nyon mongs pa'i ngo bor grub pa de lta bu min/ ma rig pas mchoran pa'i nyon cesangs pa rnams 11ga ma med pa nas sems 'ga' zhig gi 'khor la lhan cig tu gnasasku1da kyang sems thams cad kyi 'khor du zhugs med/ rtsa ba'i gtso sems kyi rang bzhin nam/ rang gshis la zhugs pa ma yin par tha dad 'bral rung gi tshul du yod/ de ltar 'bral rung du yod 182

na/ 'bral thub bam mi thub zer na/ 'bral thub pa yin/ gang yin zer na/spyir btang nyon mongs rnams chags sdang 'di sde tshan gnyis su 'du ba dang /de bas rgyas tsam phye na/ srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug /ces drug dang / lta ba lnga dang / lta min lngar phye na bcur 'byed pa sogs rtsa ba dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnam grangs mang po yod kyang / chags sdang gnyis kyi khyab khongs su 'du/ de gnyis kyi gzhi bcol sa ni gti mug yin/ lcesgros rnams kyi gnas lugs de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i gti mug de la phyi'i gzugs sgra sogs bden par 'dzin pa'i gti mug sogs mang du yod kyang gtso bo ni rang rgyud du gtogs pa'i nga la bden par 'dzin pa'i gti mug 'di yin/ gang ltar ma rig pa de ma rtogs pa dang / log rtog gang yin snyam na/ log rtog yin/ de ni phyin ci log dang / nor 'khrul du song ba'i sems byung zhig yin/ de ltar ma rig pa de'i ngor chos rnams kyi gnas lugs rang dbang ba'i tshul gyis ma grub bzhin du rang dbang ba'i tshul gyis grub par snang / snang ba ltar du zhen nas yod pa la/rang dbang ba'i tshul gyis ma grub pa'i gnas lugs ngo ma de ngo sprod byas te nam zhig ngo 'phrod pa na/ 'khrul pa rang zhir 'gro ba yin/ le lan thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa mthar thug pa 'khrul pa de dang dmigs pa gcig la dmigs nas 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du zhugs pa'i shes rab nga tsho'i rgyud la skye rung yin pas/ de nam zhig skyes pa na/ dpal ldan chos grags kyi rnam 'grel du/'gribs dang phul byung brten pa kun/ mi mthun phyogs dang bcas nyid phyir/de goms pa las bdag 'gyur bas/ la lar zag pa zad par 'gyur/ zhes 183

gsungs pa ltar/ phyin ci ma log pa'i blo'i goms cha ji tsam yar 'phel ba'i tshod kyis blo phyin ciyog de mar chag 'gro ba yin/ dper na/ snang ba ji tsam che ba'i stod kyis mun pa je nyung du 'gro ba lta bu yin/ de yang skyon gyi rigs thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni blo 'khrul pa zhig gi jog tu bzhag yod pa dang / nam zhig 'khrul pa de ngo shes/ shes pa'i lha'i rgyun bskyangs te goms pa 'phel ba'i tshod kyis 'khrul pa'i cha rnams rim bzhin 'gag 'gro ba yin/ dbu ma bzhi brgya par/ 'di kun rang dbang med pa ste/ 'di zhes nye tshig sbyar nas/ mdor na rang nyid kyis mtshon pa'i dngos po thams cad rang dbang ba'i tshul gyis grub pa med par/ thams cad gnas lugs stong pa nyid chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig ste/ rang dbang ba'i tshul gyis grub pa med pa'i stong sang dgag bya bkag tsam de la chos dbyings zhes brjod pa red/ de ltar kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim yong stangs ni las kyi kun 'byung dang / de yong ba nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung / de'i rtsa ba ma rig pa la thug de ni gzhi 'jog sa 'khrul pa zhig yin pas/ nam zhig blo 'khrul par song stangs de shes par byas nas/ shes pa'i don de sgom pa las 'khrul pa 'gag pas na/ spel mar bstod pa las/ 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun/ rgyu med pa las 'ga' mi 'byung / 'bras gyur zug rngus bsun pa dag 'grub byed rgyu ni 'gog pa gces/ zhes pa ltar/'dus byas kyi chos thams cad rgyu med pa las 'bras bu byung ba ni 'ga' yang med pa'i chos nyid kyi khrims de gzhi la bzhag nas/ zug rngu zhes pa sdug bsngal te 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyis bsun gyi 'dug na/ de la mi dga' ba byas nas 184

bsdad pas phan pa med pas sdug bsngal de 'grub byed kyi rgyu 'gog par gces pa de gal che ba yin par gsungs/ de ltar 'khor ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal rnams 'gog pa la/ de 'grub byed kyi rgyu kun 'byung 'gog dgos par bshad na/ kun 'byung 'gog thabs ji lta bu snyam na/ 'jig rten rgud pa ji snyed pa/ deyi rtsa ba ma rig ste/ gang zhig mthong bas de dog pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bar gsungs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang dbang ba'i tshul gyi grub pa med pa'i rten 'byung gi don shes shing sgom pa'i sgo nas 'gog dgos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ 'di ni kun 'byung 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/'di ni 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ 'di ni lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ zhesawa ra ṇa sir 'khor lnga sde bzang po la chos kyi 'khor lo thog mar bskor ba'i tshe chos kyi bsdoms chen po 'di dag gsungs pa red/ 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i tshe kun shes po+o de na ya 'phags lam thob/ byings la sbyor lam sogs rim gyis thob pa'i lo rgyus yod pa de dag ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gsungs lugs shin tu ngo mtshar ba dang / nang pa'i chos kyi gzi byin bon pa zhig red/bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'di ni sdug bsngalayin/ 'di ni kun 'byung yin/ 'di ni 'gog pa yin/ 'di ni lam yin no zhes gsungs shing / de dag so sor 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes sbyar te gsungs pa ni/ khra'i tshad mthon por son pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyi gzigs ngor bden pas de ltar gsungs / 185

de'i rjes su sdug bsngal shes dgos pa yin la/ kun 'byung ni spong dgos/'gog pa mngon du bya dgos/ lam ni sgom dgos pa yin no zhes gsungs/ 'o na/ de rnams rang dbang ba'i tshul gyis grub pa yin nam snyam na min te/ sdug bsngal shes par bya ste shes par byar med/ kun 'byung sgong bar bya ste spong bar byar med/ 'gog pa mngon du bya ste mngon du byar med/ lam sgom par bya ste sgom par byar med/ ces gsungs/thog mar 'di sdug bsngal yin no zhes nan du gsungs shing / de nas sdug bsngal shes dgos so zhes nan po zhig gsungs yod kyang / mthar sdug bsngal shes dgos kyang / chos nyid kyi dbyings su sdug bsngal shes rgyu med par gsungs/ de ltar kun rdzob bden pa'i cha nas sdug bsngal yin pa dang /de shes dgos pa sku(gas tha snyad la gtsigs su bya dgos par gsungs nas chad mthar ma lhungs pa mdzad/ yang tha snyad 'ba' zhig la zhen ches nas bden par rlom na mi 'grigs par dgongs nas/ gnas lugs kyi ngang du shes par bya ba med ces shes rab snying por gzugs med/ sgra med sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gsungs nas rtag mthar ma lhungs pa mdzad/ de ltar bden bzhi gsungs pa de'i na/ ri bden pa gnyis kyang gsungs yod pas rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi sgrom ni bden bzhi dang / bden gnyis la brten nas slong dgos pa yin/ de'i bsdoms rgyal tshab byams pa mgon pos dpe dang sbyar te gsal por gsungs pa/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la/ bder gnas thob bya sman ni bsten par bya ba ltar/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin 186

lam/ shes bya spang bya rig par bya zhing bsten par bya/ zhes gsungs yod/de ltar 'khor bas bsdus pa'i chos rnams ni sdug bden dang / de 'grub byed ni kun 'byung yin/ sdug bsngal de zad dgos na kun 'byung spong dgos pa/ de rnams ni kun nas nyon sna(ngas cadags kyi gnas lugs rnams yin/ ji ltar sgong ba'i tshul ni rnam byang gi phyogs 'gog lam gnyis yin pas/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa zad rung yin pas sgong nus shing / de gtan nas spangs pa'i bral ba de la 'gog bden du ming btags pa yin/ 'gog bden de la nyon mongs sa thosan dang bcas pa spangs pa'i bral ba'am/ nyan rang gi byang chub zer yang rung / spyir btang thar pa zer yang rung / spyir btang myang 'das sam/ sdug kun nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi'i dbyings zhes bya/ yang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam ma zad/ shes bya'i sgrib pa yang zad pa'i bral ba mthar thug pa de ni chos sku'am/ 1du bo nyid sku'am/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das sam/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhes pa de yin/ de 'dra'i 'gog bden de nga chos thob byar bzung ste mngon du bya dgos/ de yang da ring sgom nas sang nyin 'gog bden thob mi thub pas lam la rim pa bzhin du slob dgos/ shes rab snying por/tabyathā ga te ga te pa ra ga te pa ra saṃ ga te tho rdi swaha/ zhes par/ song zhig song zhig pha rol du song zhig pha rol du yang sdog par song zhig byang chub tu gzhi tshugs zhes lam lnga dang sbyar te/ sa/sungs pa ni/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum nas dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa dang / sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ji ltar bshad pa bzhin rim pa rnams bshad de sbas don du 187

sa bcu lam lnga bstan te lam rim bgrod byed dgos par gsungs/ gong du/lam sgom par bya/ zhes tshig nyung zhig las gsungs med kyang / de'i nang la don shin tu rgya chen po zhig 'dus nas yod/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas spangs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa mi gnas pa'i myang 'das de nga tsho'i thob bya mthar thug pa de yin/ de 'ong ba la thog mar nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sa bon dang bcas pa gtan nas zad pa ma byung na/ shes sgrib sgong rgyu skad cha rgad po yin/ 'di zla ba'i lugs ltar bshad de/ don la'ang de rang yin/ de gnyis ka yong ba la/ chos nyid kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong ba'i 'phags lam gyi zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi mthu la bsten dgos/de yong ba la da ring chos nyid kyi don gtan nas mi shes pa de/ sang nyin gro bur mngon sum du rtogs pa gtan nas 'byung mi thub pas na/ sgom byung gis chos nyid rtogs pa sngon du 'gro dgos/ de yong ba la yang / tshogs rgya chen po'i grogs la brten dgos pas lam snga ma snga ma sngon du ma song na phyi ma phyi ma thob mi thub pa yin/ de ltar lam sgom par bya gsung ba'i tshe nga tsho las dang po'i gnas skabs su/ zab mo dang / rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa rnams thog mar ma thos pa thos par byas/ thos pa'i don la yang nas yang du bsam pa'i bsam byung gi shes rab bskyed/ don de rtse gcig tu sgom nas sgom byung gi shes rab bskyed nas rim pa bzhin du rang gi blo'i tshad je mtho je mthor btang nas 'gro dgos pa yin/ nga tshor byang chub kyi sems rnal ma zhig nam skyes pa na theg chen tshogs lam par 'gyur/ yang phyogs gcig nas zab mo'i don 188

la thos byung dang / bsam byung gi shes rab la brten nas goms tshad je mthor btang mthar chos nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel sgom byung gi shes rab nam skyes pa na theg chen sbyor lam par 'gyur/ da dung goms pa bsrings pas mthar chos nyid kyi don mngon sum du mthong ba na sa dang po thob pa dang / theg chen mthong lam par gyur/ de nas sgom spang thog mar sgong ba'i 'go tshugs pa nas sgom lam par song ste sa rnams rim gyis bgrod dgos pa yin/ de dag ni sangs rgyas pa'i chos bden pa bzhi gzhi la bzhag nas lam gyi ba1de tshul yin/des na nga tsho 'khor bar 'khor ba 'di dkon mchog gis byas pa min par rang gi sems ma dul ba'i las kyi dbang gis byas/ 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs kyang / sems ma dul ba dul ba byas/ ma zhi ba zhi bar byas/ chos kyi gnas lugs ma shes pa'i sems glen rmongs 'di spyang rig ldan pa bzos nas ma shes pa shes par byas/ ma mthong ba mthong ba ra bya dgos pa yin/ sems la bzo lta bzos nas sems ma dul ba dul bar bsgyur ba'i thabs de la chos zhes ming 'dogs byas pa yin/ chos dkon mchog ngo ma ni gong du bshad pa ltar 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos de dag yin yang / de'i sngon 'gro'i gzhi rten lta bu'i lam ma zhugs pa'i skabs nas bslab pa gsum la sogs pa'i dge ba'i yon tan de dag la yang chos su brjod chog pa yin/ mdor na mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims kyang chos yin/ skyabs dngos kyang de yin la de ni sman dang 'dra ba yin/ de ni med thabs med/ de 'dra'i chos dkon mchog med na rang nyid thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob rgyu spros 189

bral yin/ de 'dra'i chos de yang rang nyid tsog ger bsdad pa na nam zhig blo bur du rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi klong rdol nas yong thabs med pas/ ma shes pa shes par byed pa la/ gzhan las thos te shes dgos pas chos de ston mkhan zhig cis kyang dgos/ ston mkhan de yang gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag mtha' dag phyin ci ma log par ston thub pa dang / de yang / lam thams cad bskyed par bya/ lam thams cad shes par bya/ de dag gi lam gyi bya ba yang bya la/ zhes dang / don bzhin ston pa de la phyag 'tshal nas/ zhes bshad pa ltar/ don la ji ltar gnas pa rnams rang gis mngon du byas/ khong du chud/ skyes shes rdzogs gsum byas nas gzhan la ston pa zhig dgos pa ma gtogs/ gzhan dag gis 'di ltar brjod kyi 'dug ces zer rjes su 'brangs pa'i ston pa zhig gis mi 'grigs/ des na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi ston pa ni ston pa mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig yin/de ltar chos ni med thabs med la/ chos de ston mkhan yang sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig gis ma gtogs mi gang byung rang ga bas ston mi nus pa yang ji skad du/ spel mar bstod pa las/ srid gsum dbang bsgyur kun rmongs pa'i/ yang bran gyur kyang thar pa'i lam/ ston par khas 'che lbu ba yis/ rkang stegs 'cha' bar su zhig 'gong / zhes bshad pa ltar/ srid pa gsum la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba ste byed po kun slongs ni ma rig pa'i don te de yi gzhan dbang du song bas de'i bran gyi yang bran du 'gro mkhan zhig rang nyid yin bzhin du/ da dung gzhan la blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i ston pa por khas ches pa de 190

dag la su zhig gis yid rton par byed de mi byed la/ dper na shes ldan su zhig gis chu yi lgu ba la rkang stegs 'cha' bar mi byed pa bzhin/ zhes bshad pa yin/ 'o na ston pa ji lta bu zhig dgos snyam na/ gang zhig gzigs shing gsung ba yi/ mkhyen dang ston pa bla na med/ rgyal ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / gzigs shing 'doms pa de la 'dud/ ces gang zhig rang gis gzigs na mkhyen pa bla na med pa ni/ rten 'byung gi don 'di nyid yin la/ de rang gis mngon sum du gzigs/ gzigs pa ltar gzhan la phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i mkhyen pa dang ston pa bla na med pa de la bdag 'a dud do gsungs pa ltar/ skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun ldan/ don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni ston pa bla na med payin/ des na rang nyid sdug bsngal gyisayid bsun te/ sdug bsngal las grol bar 'dod na chos nyams su ma blangs par thabs med cing / chos la skyabs su ma song thabs med yin/ de 'dra'i chos rgya che gting zab de lta bu zhig nyams su len pa la ston pa bla na med pa zhig med thabs med pas ston pa sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro dgos/ de gnyis tshang rung / rang gis chos nyams su len pa'i tshe kha mig yar blta byed sa zhig med na mi 'grigs pas grogs dge 'dun dkon mchog dgos/ mdor na nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyas par/ sangs rgyas/ cesas/ dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum po med thabs med par 'dzin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/de ltar kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs dang / rnam byang gi phyogs gnyis nas bsam gzhigs byas na/ nang pas dkon mchothog gsum 'jog pa de gzhi 191

dngos po'i gnas tshod dang mthun zhing 'brel ba yod pa de bzhin du bshad pa ma gtogs/ rang bzhin gya tshom du dkon mchog gsum yod do zhes bshad pa ma yin/ dngos po'i gnas tshod rang la dkon mchog de gsum med na mi 'grigs pa zhig chags spongad pa yin/de 'dra'i dkon mchog gsum po de yang rang rgyud la tshang ba bya rgyu gtso bo yin/ da lta'i gnas skabs su nga tsho'i rgyud la dkon mchog gsum tshang med kyang / rang gis mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims nas bzung ste rim gyis lam bgrod nas/ mthar mthong lam bar chad med lam thob pa na/ lam bden mngon du gyur pa yin la/ rang rgyud la chos dkon mchog grub cing / rang nyid 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ngo mar gyur cing bar chad med lam des mthong spang gang yang rung ba zhig gis dngos gnyen byas te/ skad cig gnyis par/de spangs pa'i bral ba thob pa na/ rang rgyud la 'gog bden thob pas/ 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos dkon mchog de rang rgyud la thob pa yin/ de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag rang nyid 'phags par 'gyur/da dung zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i lam la rim gyis goms pa bsrings te/ mthar skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun ldan du gyur te rnam mkhyen gyi skad cig dang po thob ma thag rang nyid sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba yin/ de dus rang nyid la dge 'dun dkon mchog mthar thug pa de dang / chos dkon mchog/sangs rgyas dkon mchog gsum ga tshang nas yod/ de 'dra'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog de ni don dam par mthar thug pa'i skyabs yin/ de min lung gi chos 192

dang / nyan rang gi lam la sogs pa ni mthar thug gi skyabs ma yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ spangs phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir/ med phyir 'jig dang bcas pa'i phyir/ chos rnam gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ zhes do na dam pa'i skyabs ni sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig yin par bshad yod/rang nyid dkon mchog gsum ngo mar 'gyur rgyu de ni gal gnad che shos kyi rtsa don yin/ rtsa don 'di'i thog nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i zab khyad chen po 'don thub pa yin/ dper na/ ye shu ma shi rka'i chos lugs sogs la mtshon na/ mi mang por phan thogs yod pa'i gzhi rtsa yag po yin kyang / thog ma nyid nas dkon mchog rang grub cig chags/ nga tsho dus gtan du sems can kho nar gnas pa dang / nga tshos 'bad rtsol ji tsam byas kyang dkon mchogatu 'gyus rgyu med pa red/ dkon mchog gi rnam pa thams cad du yar tshad du bzhugs/—nga tsho sems can rnams rnam pa thams cad du mar tshad du bzhag pa red/ 'on kyang / nang pa rnams dang / de'i nang nas theg chen pa'i dbang du byas na de ltar ma yin ste/ da lta nga tsho sems can yin rung / mthar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas sangs rgyas rang dang khyad med par 'gyur thub pa yin/ de ltar yin pa yang spyod 'jug las/ bdag gis byang chub ga la zhes/ sgyid lug par ni mi bya ste/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ bden pa gsung bas bden 'di gsungs/ sbrang bu sha sbrang bung ba dang / de bzhin srin bur 193

dang / nyan rang gi lam la sogs pa ni mthar thug gi skyabs ma yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ spangs phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir/ med phyir 'jig dang bcas pa'i phyir/ chos rnam gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ zhes do na dam pa'i skyabs ni sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig yin par bshad yod/rang nyid dkon mchog gsum ngo mar 'gyur rgyu de ni gal gnad che shos kyi rtsa don yin/ rtsa don 'di'i thog nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i zab khyad chen po 'don thub pa yin/ dper na/ ye shu ma shi rka'i chos lugs sogs la mtshon na/ mi mang por phan thogs yod pa'i gzhi rtsa yag po yin kyang / thog ma nyid nas dkon mchog rang grub cig chags/ nga tsho dus gtan du sems can kho nar gnas pa dang / nga tshos 'bad rtsol ji tsam byas kyang dkon mchogatu 'gyus rgyu med pa red/ dkon mchog gi rnam pa thams cad du yar tshad du bzhugs/—nga tsho sems can rnams rnam pa thams cad du mar tshad du bzhag pa red/ 'on kyang / nang pa rnams dang / de'i nang nas theg chen pa'i dbang du byas na de ltar ma yin ste/ da lta nga tsho sems can yin rung / mthar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas sangs rgyas rang dang khyad med par 'gyur thub pa yin/ de ltar yin pa yang spyod 'jug las/ bdag gis byang chub ga la zhes/ sgyid lug par ni mi bya ste/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ bden pa gsung bas bden 'di gsungs/ sbrang bu sha sbrang bung ba dang / de bzhin srin bur 193
