gang gyur pa/ des kyang brtson pa'i stobs bskyed na/ byang chub thob dka' bla med thob/ ces sbrang bu dang sha sbrang bung ba la sogs pa rnams kyang rang gis brtson 'grus kyi stobs bskyed nas lam sgom na mthar 'tshang rgya thub par gsungs pa ltar/ nga rang tsho sems can rnams kyang 'tshang rgya thub pa dang / rang nyid sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu 'gyur thub pa 'di ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i zab khyad yin/ de la 'bras skyabs su brjod/ de 'dra'i 'bras skyabs sangs rgyas dang / chos/ dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams 'grub pa la/ jog mar da lta'i gnas skabs su nga tshos rnam 'dren bzhi pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas zin pa'i sangs rgyas tshor skyabs su song / de dag gi drung nas chos nyan te ma shes pa shes pa dang / ma mthong ba mthong bar byas te lam sgom nas rim gyis bgrod dgos/ rang las rgyud tha dad sangs rgyas de dag ni rgyu skyabs kyi sangs rgyas yin/ rang las rgyud tha dad pa'i slob pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams ni rgyu skyabs kyi dge 'dun dkon mchog de ltar slob mi slob pa'i 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan de dag ni rgyu skyabs kyi chos dkon mchog yin/ de ltar rgyu skyabs kyi dkon mchog gsum dang / 'bras skyabs kyi dkon mchog gsum yod pas/ rgyu skyabs kyi mchog gsum la rang gis skyabs su bzung /rgyu skyabs kyi sangs rgyas la chos nyan/ de dag gi rgyud kyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan dang / yon tan de dag dang ldan pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams la rang gis mig dpe byas te/ rim gyis ma 'ongs par rang gi rgyud la 'bras skyabs kyi chos dkon mchog dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog sangs rgyas 194

dkon mchog thob par bya dgos pa de ltar yin/ rgyu skyabs dang / 'bras skyabs kyi dkon mchog gsum gyi 'gro stangs gnas tshul de dag rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rtsa don gal che shos shig yin/de 'dra'i dkon mchog gsum ngo shes pa'i thog nas/ rang gi thob byar gyur pa'i dkon mchog gsum po de la rang gi thob byar shes pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'dzin cing / gang zag gzhan rgyud la yod pa'i dkon mchog gsum po de la/ nyes can kha drag la re ba lta bu'i tshod kyis skyabs su 'gro dgos/rgyud bla ma la sogs pa'i gzhung chen po rnams nas dkon mchog gsumagyi mtshan nyid rgya cher bshad pa rnams mtha' rgya chod pa ma shes kyang / mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis shes pa'i thog nas/ dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas yang dag tu 'dzin pa zhig nam byung ba na/ rang nyid nang par tshud pa yin/ gal te de 'dra'i dkon mchog ba/sum skyabs gnas yang dag tu khas len gyi med na/ nga lta bur chos gos snam sbyar gyon/ khri mthon po'i steng bsdad yod kyang nang pa ma yin/ des mngon shes ba shad kyang nang pa min la/ rdzu 'phrul bstan kyang nang pa min/ phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed tshul ltar yin/ngas gong du ka kor mang po zhig bshad pa rnams kyi rtsa don mdor bsdus na/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams ngo shes pa byas nas/ de rnams skyabs gnas yang dag pa red snyam du yid ches/ blos 'khel/ khas blangs pa na/ rang nyid nang par tshud pa yin zhing / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa'i sgo mo che der zhugs pa red/195

gong du bshad pa ltar dkon mchog gsum de shin tu gal che zhing / de'i nang nas kyang chos dkon mchog gal chen po yin/ 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos dkon mchog tshad mtho dze de dag 'grub pa'i rmang gzhi da lta nas sgrub dgos/dper na/ nga tshos phyin chad rang kha rang gso'i gzhis chags legs po zhig yong rgyu'i dmigs yul bzung nas/ 'dir gzhis chags byas pa 'dir da lta rang kha rang gso'i gdengs 'khel la ma 'khel zhig yod pas/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong la ma mthong lta bu'i sbyor lam gyi tshod tsam yin/ 'dir khang pa ma brgyab gong shing gcod bregs byed pa'i skabs ni tshogs lam lta bu yin/ shing gcod ma byas gong la gzhi nas sa cha 'di dag gtan 'gel byed pa dang / tshad thig len pa'i skabs lta bu ni/ las rgyu 'bras la sngas bcol te mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims srung ba/ de ni tshogs lam dang / sbyor lam thob bya'i gzhi rten lta bu yin/ mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims la yid ches pa de 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta bar brjod pa yin pas/ de gzhi la bzhag nas 'jig rten pa las 'das pa'i lta ba yong dgos pa ma gtogs/'jig rten pa'i lta ba ma shes shing / ma mthong / lag len du ma byas na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lta ba yong thabs med/ las 'bras dang / mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims shin tu gal chen po yin/ mi dge bcu'i tshul khrims srung ba la yang de dag ngo shes dgos pas/ lus kyi gsum/ ngag gi bzhi/ yid kyi gsum ste bcu po de yin/ de dag zhib bshad bya bar da ring dus khom mi 'dug shes mkhan yang mang po yod pas/ shes mkhan tshos ma shes pa tshor 196

gong du bshad pa ltar dkon mchog gsum de shin tu gal che zhing / de'i nang nas kyang chos dkon mchog gal chen po yin/ 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos dkon mchog tshad mtho dze de dag 'grub pa'i rmang gzhi da lta nas sgrub dgos/dper na/ nga tshos phyin chad rang kha rang gso'i gzhis chags legs po zhig yong rgyu'i dmigs yul bzung nas/ 'dir gzhis chags byas pa 'dir da lta rang kha rang gso'i gdengs 'khel la ma 'khel zhig yod pas/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong la ma mthong lta bu'i sbyor lam gyi tshod tsam yin/ 'dir khang pa ma brgyab gong shing gcod bregs byed pa'i skabs ni tshogs lam lta bu yin/ shing gcod ma byas gong la gzhi nas sa cha 'di dag gtan 'gel byed pa dang / tshad thig len pa'i skabs lta bu ni/ las rgyu 'bras la sngas bcol te mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims srung ba/ de ni tshogs lam dang / sbyor lam thob bya'i gzhi rten lta bu yin/ mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims la yid ches pa de 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta bar brjod pa yin pas/ de gzhi la bzhag nas 'jig rten pa las 'das pa'i lta ba yong dgos pa ma gtogs/'jig rten pa'i lta ba ma shes shing / ma mthong / lag len du ma byas na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lta ba yong thabs med/ las 'bras dang / mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims shin tu gal chen po yin/ mi dge bcu'i tshul khrims srung ba la yang de dag ngo shes dgos pas/ lus kyi gsum/ ngag gi bzhi/ yid kyi gsum ste bcu po de yin/ de dag zhib bshad bya bar da ring dus khom mi 'dug shes mkhan yang mang po yod pas/ shes mkhan tshos ma shes pa tshor 196

bshad/ ma shes pa chos shes mkhan tshor dris nas shes thabs byed dgos/ khyed rang so sos sbyong dgos/ da lta dpe cha'i mthun rkyen zhan yang rim bzhin mthun rkyen 'dzoms rgyur/ so sos shes par byas/ mthong bar byas/ rtogs par byed dgos/ da lta ngas brjod pa rnams ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos de 'dra zhig yin no zhes sgrom lta bu mtshon pa tsam zhig yin/ 'di'i nang legs bshad nyes bshad gang yang yong rgyur/ legs bshad yod na khyed chos nyams su blangs/ nyes bshad yod na 'dor rgyu de gal chen po yin/ slob dpon ar+ya de was gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ nyan po snod ces bya bar bshad/smra po yon tan rnams gzhan du/ mi 'gyur nyan pa po la'ang min/ des gsungs pa ltar/ legs bshad dang / nyes bshad 'byed pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa zhig med na mi 'grigs/ de ltar mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims ngo shes pa'i thog nas srog bsdos kyis srung thub pa zhig byung na/ nang pa spus dag zhig tu gyur pa yin/ ha lam de snga rang re'i bod du yod pa'i theg chen par khas 'ches mkhan zhig las lhag par gyur nas yong / bod du sa dge bka' rnying gi mkhas grub tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa nyams len byed mkhan ches mang po byung yod pa rnams ni gnas tshul tha dad yin/ de min spyir btang chos pa'i gzugs brnyan can/ chos min chos su brdzu ba de dag gis nam yang 'gran zla mi nus pa chags yod/ dkon mchog gsum ngo shes/ de skyabs gnas yang dag tu khas blangs/yid ches kyi dad pa blos 'gel zhig byas/ mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims ngo shes nas lag len srog bsdos su 'gel mkhan zhig byung na/ de ni nang pa 197

gsha' ma spus dag cig byung bas ma tshad/ yongs grags la'ang mi ya rabs su 'gyur thub/ 'dzam gling sa phyogs gang 'dra zhig tu phyin kyang ya rabs kyi gral du tshud thub/ bod mir skyon yod mkhan mang po yod kyang spyir btang brjod na/ deng skabs kyang phyi rgyal ba tshos bod mi rnams ni 'dzum dmul dmul/snang ba skyid mdog kha po/ ya rabs sha stag 'dug ces brjod mkhan yong gi yod pa 'di dag nga rang tsho pho rgod drags pas min nga tsho'i pha mes kyi chos kyi bag chags bzang 11 de skurdzod pa'i rtags yin/ bsam sdus) nang las rgyu 'bras dang / skye ba snga phyi/ bla ma dkon mchog zer ba sogs yod pa'i stabs kyis gra ma 'grigs chen po byung ste 'a chad 'u thug tu gyar na yang / las rgyu 'bras bsam nas blo bag spros pa des sems bag yangs mdog kha po 'di byung ba min nam snya ma/ da lta'i char chos kyi gnas lugs cung zad tsam las ma shes rung gnas tshul de ltar yong gi yod na chos legs po zhig shes na de bas kyang lhag pa yong nges yin/ blo dkon mchog la gtad/ lag len las 'bras la bkal na tshe 'dir mi ya rabs bzang po zhig tu gyur pas ma tshad/ skye ba phyi ma lha mi'i lus rten thob rgyur the tshom med/ nga la lta mngon shes med kyang / bskal pa grangs med par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas des de ltar gsungs pas na/ tshe 'dir mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims rnam dag bsrungs na phyi ma lha mi'i lus rten thob par gdengs 'khel ba red ces ngas khas len byed thub/ de la mo rgyag mi dgos la/ pra phab mi dgos/lha dang klu zhu mi dgos par bcom ldan 'das kyis thag bcad zin pa yin/ phyin 198

chad mi lus thob pa de yang gzugs bzang ba dang/ longs spyod phyug pa la sogs pa 'dod na/ mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims de'i thog tu bzod pa sgom pa dang / sbyin pa gtong ba la sogs pa kha ston rgyag dgos pa yin/de ltar nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi sgrom bslangs pa'i mtha' mar lag len gang la bya snyam na/ skyabs 'gro las 'bras gnyis la lag len tshul bzhin du 'gel dgos zhes ngas zhu don snying po de rang yin/ de rnams gzhi la bzhag ste 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du blo sbyong ba dang /sems can thams cad rang gi gnyen du bltas/ de dag sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i blo sogs yon tan gong ma rnams kyang rang gi blo tshod dang bstun nas rim gyis sbyong dgos pas de rnams khyed cag gi lho rngos gnang dgos/ de dag kun slong bcos tshul tsam du chos sdi/ming brgyad khri bzhi stong gi snying po'i bcud mdor bsdus su phyungs yod/ de rnaca/sa mkhyen mkhan tsho la ni gsal 'debs bskyar du zhus pa lta bu dang / ma shes mkhan tshor ma shes pa shes par bya ba'i don du zhus pa yin/ de yang da ring bas/ma tsam byas nas 'jog rgyu ma yin par da ring nas bzung ste rgyun du lag len la 'gol rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin pa ma gtogs da nang chos 'brel byas /khul gyis ngas kyang gang byung mang po zhig bshad/ khyed tsho yang 'og nas sas 'khyags/ steng nas nyi mas 'tshigs bzhin nyan pa tsam gyis phan thogs chen 11 med pas/ rgyun gyi spyod lam de gal chen po yin/ gong du rags tsam brjo da pa ltar/ nga tshos sngar phan gyi 'gro stangs 'dra chags po 199

des rtsa ba nas mi 'grigs/ des bslus te nga mo rang yul bral nas mi yul du gyar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snum zad kyi mar me lta bu 'di chags pa red/sngar phan yang dam pa gong ma tshos bslab bya mang po byas yod la/ lung bstan mang po brgyab yod/ dper na/ nye ba'i char sku phreng bcu gsum pas kyang bslab bya brgyab 'dug lung bstan gnang 'dug skabs der mig r+yā tshir tshir byas yod kyi red/ zhed snang 'dra yang byas yod kyi red de/ lag len du tshul bzhin ma bkal bas rang sa rang srung ma thub pa red/ tshang mas 'bad brtson gyis rang sa rang srung byas na lo brgya phrag bar chab 'bangs bde la 'kho/de pa yong lugs gsungs 'du ga kyang / nga rang tshos ko thag grod pa red/ r+sā rgas byed pa tshos kyang yag po ma byas/ chos byed pa'i ming rgyab 'khur ba rab tu byung ba rnams dang / sngags 'chang tshos kyang sangs mnyam por rgya btsun rten 'brel yod ces pa ltar/ ko thag mnyam por grod pa'i rten 'brel bsgri/gas yod/ da cha nga tshos sngar phan skyon byung ba rnams shes pa byas/ phyi'i ltar snang la 'jig rten chos brgyad lta bu'i 'dra chags chags tsam du ma song bar tshonazab gzab bya rgyu shin tu gal che/ de snga phan gyi 'gro stangs la/ chos zhes pa gzhung lta mkhan dang / dpe cha ba lta bus bslab rgyu yin pa las/ grong gse/ba pa dang nang gi a ma rgan mo tshos bslab rgyu min pa lta bu byas/ khong tshos myo pu ṇi zhig bgrangs nas bsdad chog pa lta bur 'dzin/ 'di stor lha sar yang /skad cha yong myong /khyod rang yi ge zhig slob/ dpe cha 'dra sbyongs zhes bshad rnga na/ da lo na 'di tsam son pas yi ge bslabs nas dgos pa e yod/ de bas ma ṇi bgrangs 200

na snyam/ zhes zer mkhan byung / yi ge shes te ma ṇi'i sngagen shes nas ma ṇi bgrangs pa dang / don ma shes par bgrangs pa la khyad chen po yod/ ma ṇi'i don gang yang mi shes pa'i kha la tshig kyang ma dag par/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūṃ hri/ zhes brjod de yi ge drug de yig bdun bzos/ da dung hri de yang ma dag pa red ces brjod pa de lta bu byas na phan thogs gang yang med pas/ phyin chad nga tsho tshang mas de rigs su ma song ba nges par du gzab gzab byed dgos/ ngas 'di ltar yang nas yang du zhu dgos pa 'di nga tsho'i blo la goms pa'i dbang gi lhod yangs byas dwogs kyis bshad pa yin/ dper na/ rgyun du gos dregs pa can gyon nas sdod mkhan de la dregs pa mang po yod kyang do snang gang yang med/ dregs pa'i dri ma yang tshor mi thub/ mis khyed rang khrus gyis zer na da dung nga gtsang ma yod ces phar lan 'debs byed/ de ni kho rang gi snang ba la dregs pa de goms pa'i dbang gis do snang ma byung ba yin/ do snang byung dus nag nog chung ngu zhig yin kyang mthong thub/ dper na/ zhi gnas sgom pa'i tshe yang / sems gnas dang gnyis skabs rnam rtog mang du 'gro ba lta bu 'byung / de dag rnam rtog mang du song ba ma yin par/ rnam rtog ngos bzung ba yin par gsungs pa ltar red/ nga tsho phung la sbyor ba'i sngar phan gyi gnas tshul rnams ngo ma 'phrod na de dag sel thabs mi yong bas na/ de rnams ngo sprod kyi ched du ngas skyon brjod mang po brjod don de ltar yin/ 'ga' shas kyi dgongs par kho grwa par sdang ba la/ chos byed mkhan la sdang po 'dug dgon pa grwa tshang la sdang po 'dug dgongs srid kyang / sdang po ma byed rang byed red/201

ma gzhi nga rang yang rab tu byung ba yin/ mgo la ral cog med pa ma gtogs sngags pa zhig kyang yin/ zhen sha tshas ma bzhag par nang khul skyon brjod byas par 'gal ba med/ gzhan dag zhig yin na mthong phyogs yong gi red/ de tsho zol med yin/ gdams ngag gi mchog mtshang thog tu 'bebs pa de yin/zhes pa ltar/ skyon gang yod thad kur brtsod na/ legs cha yod pa rnams lhags nas sdod kyi red/ de tsho dgongs 'jags gnang rogs/de nas 'dir lung 'ga' shas 'bul ba yin pas/ gong du zhus pa ltar mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad rang gi tshe 'di'i pha ma ltar rang la drin shin tu che ba 'ba' zhig yin pas/ de lta bu'i ma rgan sems can rnams thob bya mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i slad du/ rang nyid kyi gong du bshad pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi go 'phang de 'dra zhig ci nas kyang thob par bya'o snyam du byas/ de thob pa la chos nyams su len dgos/de la chos thos dgos pas/ ngas lung 'di nyan dgos snyam du byas nas gsan par zhu/ zhes dang / de nas phyag 'tshal sgrol ma nyer gcig dang / lam rim bsdus don/ bsam pa lhun grub/ bar chad lam sel bcas kyi ljags lung rnams rim bzhin du bstsal to// //202

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1964 zla 12 tshes 8 dgong dro.o ri sa gzhis chags bod mi rnams la bka' slob stsal ba/da lta 'di gar gzhis chags kyi 'go 'dzin tsho dang / de bzhin las byed/ mi mang bcas thun mong la brjod rgyur/ 'dir rtsa ba'i cha nas gzhis sgar gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar dus yun thung thung nang yar rgyas gang legs byung 'dug pas tshang mar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/da lta'i char nga tshos rig pa bsgrims sa gtso che shos ni/ chos srid phyogs mang po zhig gi thog nas gzhis chags 'di dag gal che shos dang / phugs re byed sa de yin/ rtsa ba bod kyi rang dbang la bden pa'i rgyal kha thob rgyu yid ches gdeng 'khel byas chog pa bar lam lo shas ring gang ci'i gnas tshul mang po zhig yar rgyas su phyin pa des bstan yod kyang / nga tshos gra sgrig byed stangs ni/ gnas tshul sdug shos de yong rgyur cha bzhag ste sngon 'gog gra sgrig bya rgyu gnad chen po yin stabs/ bod mi gzhis chags bya rgyur shugs rgyag stangs de ltar yin/ rgya gar nang sa cha mthun rkyen 'dzoms po thob dka' bar brten/ma'e sor dang / o ri sa lta bu sa khad 'chus na yang / mthun rkyen phran yod la chog shes bsten nas lam seng gzhis chags 'char 'god byas te/ ma'e sor dang / 'di ga o ri sa/ ma de'i par sde zhi/ a sam nang sa gnas re zung bcas sa zhing la brten nas gzhis chags byas pa dang / de min lag shes kyi thog nas gzhis chags bya yul gnyis gsum tsam bcas yod/de ltar gzhis chags thub pa de rnams thog ma'i dka' ngal khag sel 203

nas sa cha yang thob/ rim bzhin lhing 'jags byed pa'i skabs su slebs yod/da cha rim pa gnyis par nga tshos dka' ngal bzod bsran chen po zhig gi jog nas lo gcig gnyis kyi nang tshud la 'tsho ba rang 'tsho thub pa'i thabs shes 'bad brtson bya rgyu gal chen po 'dugagazhis chags rang 'tsho thubalge yong snyam pa'i bsam tshul 'dra min phran bu yong gi 'dug kyang / nga rang tshos gang yang ma byas par mthun rkyen yas mi 'dug mas mi 'dug brjod na mi 'grigs/ thog mar nga rang tshos thabs shes 'bad brtson gang na ci yod byed dgos/ thabs shes gang yong mtha' ma 'gag pa byas rung dngos yod kyi gnas tshul ngo ma'i thog nas 'a 'ub gtan nas ma 'dus pa byung na/ de bshad sa zhig kyang yong rgyu dang / bshad nas do na 'bras shig kyang yong mdog kha po red/ de shod sa zhig yin yang de la gnas lugs 'grel bshad byas na/ khag mi 'dug snyam pa'i yid ches skye thub kyi red ma gtogs/ thog ma nas ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa'i skad cha mang po bshad rung phyi nang gang sar mthong tshul mi bde ba 'dug phyi rgyal rogs ram byed mkhan la 'bod skul byed dgos kyang / bod mi tsho skyid lang du shor nas dka' las rgyag gi mi 'dug bsam pa'i mthong tshul yong grabs byed kyi 'dugadaper na/ rgya gar nang bod mi btsan byol ba slebs nas lo lnga lhag song yod kyang / da lta las bsdoms nang shog lte gcig hril po zas phogs sprod len sgor 'khod 'a dug da dung nga chos zas phogs mang nyung dang / bzang zhan skor bshad nas nga rngo+or thob thang yod pa lta bu ra rtsod gleng byed kyi yod pa red/ de 204

ni sdod sgar 'di gcig pu min par gzhan dag la'ang de bzhin red/ 'dzam gling 'di'i steng btsan byol ba nga tsho bod pa gcig pu ma gtogs med pa min/gang sa ga la btsan byol ba rigs 'dra min shin tu mang po yod/ de rnams dus yun thung thung zhig ring skyob gso rogs ram bsten te/ de nas skabs babs 'tsho ba'i mdun lam 'os pa ji 'dra zhig yod pa de bstan/ de'i thog phyin te rtag tu zas phogs skyob gsor bsten nas sdod mkhan nam yang med/ phyi rgyal rogs ram byed mkhan gyi mi 'ga' shas dang skad cha byung / bar lam bod mi tshor skyob gso rogs ram byas nas lo 'ga' shas phyin yod/ da cha bod mi las dza drag pa'i rogs ram byayul gzhan dag kyang mang po yod pa red/rogs ram gyi dngul 'bab rnams kyang rang bzhin khral 'gel byas pa lta bu ma yin par mi sger so sos rang mos dwang blangs kyis zhal 'debs sprad pa rnams tshogs pa chos bsdus nas btsan byol ba tshor bgo sprod byas pa red/ da cha zhal 'debs sprod mkhan tshos 'di las phyogs gzhan dag gal che ba 'dug snyam nas zhal 'debs phyogs gzhan la sprod 'dod byung na/ do bdag khong tsho gtso che ba ma gtogs/ nga tshos rtsod pa bya yul med/ 'di tsho'i 'gro lugs ma shes na/ 'ga' shas kyi bsam par nga tshor skyob gso'i thob thang yod pa dang / de yang rgyun chad med par yong rgyu yod pa lta bu'i bsam tshul yong gi med dam snyam pa 'dug pas de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma red/ bar lam phyi rgyal rogs ram byed mkhan gnad che ba 'ga' shas kyis brjod gsal/ da phan bod mi tshor rogs ram lo shas ring byas yod kyang / da cha bod mi tsho'i bsam par 'di 205

mur bsdad kyang zas gos 'grigs tsam ni 'dug snyam du sgyid lug ngan lang du shor nas rang gis ngal rtsol bya rgyu'i sems shugs la gnod skyon yong gi 'dug pas/ rgya gar gzhung la yang da mus zas phogs sprod rgyu rnams gcog 'then byed grogs zhes bsam 'char 'bul gyi yin zhes zer mkhan byung / de tsho nga tshor sha tsha med pa dang / drin chung byas pa ma red/ thog mar skad cha de go thos skabs ga re yin nam bsam pa yong gi 'dug kyang / de skor 'grel bshad zhib tu byed pa'i skabs de ni spyir btang 'dzam gling gi 'gro lugs rang yin pas khag med pa lta bu 'dug da cha nga tshos gzhis chags pa red ces tshig tsam brjod pa min par gzhis chags ming don mtshungs pa'i rang 'tsho byed thub pa bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug de yang tshang ma'i bsam blo'i nang nas gra sgrig byas te da cha nga tsho so sos dka' las brgyab/ so sos rang 'tsho byed rgyu skabs babs 'os 'gan yin snyam pa byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ da lta nang bzhin nyin ma gang phud byas nas bsdad na mi 'grigs/ 'ga' shas kyi bsam par gnas skabs 'di mur bsdad na ring min bod rang dbang yong shag la 'di khul 'dzugs skrun byas kyang dgos pa mi 'dug bsam pa byas na de nyen ga chen po yin/ de la skyon yod pas/ da cha nyin ma gcig yin na yang snga tsam rang 'tsho ༄da thub par sems thag bcad/ spro shugs bskyed dgos/ dka' ngal nges par yong gi red de 'bad brtson che bskyed kyis dka' ngal sel thabs bya dgos/ nga tshos nus pa gang yod byas kyang dngos yod gnas tshul la gtan nas mi 'grub pa zhig byung na/ de gnas tshul tha dad yin/ de la skad cha zhig 206

mur bsdad kyang zas gos 'grigs tsam ni 'dug snyam du sgyid lug ngan lang du shor nas rang gis ngal rtsol bya rgyu'i sems shugs la gnod skyon yong gi 'dug pas/ rgya gar gzhung la yang da mus zas phogs sprod rgyu rnams gcog 'then byed grogs zhes bsam 'char 'bul gyi yin zhes zer mkhan byung / de tsho nga tshor sha tsha med pa dang / drin chung byas pa ma red/ thog mar skad cha de go thos skabs ga re yin nam bsam pa yong gi 'dug kyang / de skor 'grel bshad zhib tu byed pa'i skabs de ni spyir btang 'dzam gling gi 'gro lugs rang yin pas khag med pa lta bu 'dug da cha nga tshos gzhis chags pa red ces tshig tsam brjod pa min par gzhis chags ming don mtshungs pa'i rang 'tsho byed thub pa bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug de yang tshang ma'i bsam blo'i nang nas gra sgrig byas te da cha nga tsho so sos dka' las brgyab/ so sos rang 'tsho byed rgyu skabs babs 'os 'gan yin snyam pa byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ da lta nang bzhin nyin ma gang phud byas nas bsdad na mi 'grigs/ 'ga' shas kyi bsam par gnas skabs 'di mur bsdad na ring min bod rang dbang yong shag la 'di khul 'dzugs skrun byas kyang dgos pa mi 'dug bsam pa byas na de nyen ga chen po yin/ de la skyon yod pas/ da cha nyin ma gcig yin na yang snga tsam rang 'tsho ༄da thub par sems thag bcad/ spro shugs bskyed dgos/ dka' ngal nges par yong gi red de 'bad brtson che bskyed kyis dka' ngal sel thabs bya dgos/ nga tshos nus pa gang yod byas kyang dngos yod gnas tshul la gtan nas mi 'grub pa zhig byung na/ de gnas tshul tha dad yin/ de la skad cha zhig 206

bshad kyang don 'bras yong rgyur yid ches yod/de nas tshang mas yon tan la do snang bya rgyu de yang gal chen po 'dugaspyir btang bod mi'i nang chos srid kyi shes yon gzhan phar bzhag bod rang gi yi ge shes mkhan yang nyung nyung yin/ gnas tshul 'di nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di gcig pu min par mi rabs mang po zhig gi ring 'thus shor chen po phyin 'dugargya gar nang bod mi btsan byol ba 'byor skabs gzhan gyi skad yig ma shes par ngo tsha dgos rgyu med kyang / rang gi yi ge yang ma shes pas shin tu thabs sdug por gyar 'dug spyir btang shesayon rnamasayi ge'i lam brgyud nas yong dgos pa las/ rtag tu kha bslabs byas nas sdod mi thub/ yi ge la rmongs pa'i skabs shes bya'i rnam grangs mang po zhig gi sgo 'gag nas 'gro ba yin/ 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul byings phar bzhag rgya gar nang mnga' sde ga tshod yod med kyang ma shes pa dang / dper na/ mi sa ma ri nas/ o ri sar yong ba'i tshe lam ji 'dra zhig brgyud pa dang / mnga' sde ji 'dra zhig brgyud nas yong ba yang ma shes par lus/ de snga bod la yang ha cang sbug srub dog por bsdad de rgya gar/rgya nag sog po zhes go thos yod tsam dang / bar lam dmag chen gnyis pa tsam nas bzung a ri sogs go thos yod tsam las/ gzhan dag gang yang go thos med par bsdad pa red/ de 'dra'i rkyen gyis da dung yang gnas tshul mang por do snang dang brtsad dpyod gang yang ma byas par nyin ma gang 'khyol lta bu kho nar mgo 'khor nas sdod kyi 'dug de ni shin tu skyon chen po yin/des nga tsho'i mi rigs yar rgyas la gnod kyi red/ der brten nga tshos ma shes 207

pa'i shes bya'i rnam grangs mang po zhig 'dzam gling 'dirayod pa rnams la do snang dang / shes rtogs thub pa bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ de snga bod la khungs 'khyol tsam byung yang da cha khungs 'khyol thabs med/ sdug sa nas byas na glen pa zhig dang / lkugs pa zhig yin rung kho rang khungs shig 'khyol gyi yod pa red de nga tshos de 'dra byas pas 'grigs thabs med/ deng sang 'dzam gling nang 'gro stangs ji 'dra yod pa ma shes na mi 'grigs/ nga tshos mi rigs gcig gi bsam blo gtong ba ma gtogs/ mi gcig gi bsam blo gtong mi rung / mi rigs gcig gi 'dzin skyong byed pa la shes bya med na ga la 'grigs/ dper na/ gzhis chags zhes tshig gnyis 11 brjod par dka' ngal med kyang / gzhis chags dngo sa su byed dus dka' ngal mang po dang 'phrad kyi 'dug/ de bzhin du/ bod rang btsan yin/ rgya 'og min/ nga tshor rang dbang dgos kyi yod ces kha nas shod dus las sla po yod kyang / nam zhig rang btsan thob ste rang gi dngos su rang dbang la longs spyod pa'i tshe rang la yon tan ldeng nges med na dka' ngal chen po yong nges yin/ rgya mi rang bzhin gyis phyir log byas/ nga tsho las sla por bod du slebs/ zas chog btung chog rdzod shig shig byas nas bsdad chog chog cig dang / sngar nang bzhin 'grog pas 'grog pa dang / zhing pas zhing pa/ grwa pas grwa pa byas te dgon pa'i nang bsdad chog chog cig yong gi red bsam mkhan med shag red/ de ltar yong thabs gtan nas med/ sngar gyi gnas stangs thog 'tho dgos stangs med/ 'dzam gling spyir btang gi mi rnams kyi gdan gral zin thub pa'i yon tan zhig nga tshor med na/ rang bzhin skugs 208

pa.u tshugs byas nas rang btsan thob pa yang dka' la/ gal te rang btsan thob kyang khungs 'khyol ba khag po yin/ dmag srid dpal 'byor sogs sgo mang po zhig gi thog nas rang yul rang mis 'dzin skyong byed thub pa dgos/ de rnams kyang yon tan gyi thog nas yong dgos pa las/ lhag bsam gcig pus yong thabs med la/ 'bad brtson snying rus gcig pus yong thabs med pas/tshang mas blo gros kyi rgya bskyed rgyu ha cang gi gal chen po 'dug phyin chad bod tsam ma zad rgya gar nang du yang / nga tshor yon tan med na ha cang khag po 'dugadaper na gzhis chags khag dang / lam bzo khag gi 'thus mi tshor macesan na yang / gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten byed sgo dang sgrig 'dzugs legs po dgos pa sogs phyogs mang po zhig nas lam ston byed bzhin yod kyang / skabs re ha lam dud 'gro zhig la bshad pa lta bu ma gtogs go rgyu tshor rgyu med payong grabs byed kyi 'dug ngos nas kyang kha na na 'bod bskul byas te 'di ltar byed dgos/'di 'dra bsam dgos zhes thengs mang brjod nas lo 'ga' shas phyin song / de dag tshang ma 'grub pa dka' yang / 'di tsam zhig nges par 'grub kyi red bsam pa tsho yang ma 'grub pa yong gi 'dug de rnams bod mi mang la dam tshig med pa yang min/ lhag bsam bor ba yang min/ ngan sgal byas pa yang min/ yon tan gyis phongs pa kho nas lan 'dug pas tshang mas shes bya yon tan la do snang bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug do snang byed stangs kyang / mtha' gcig tu yi ge kho na bris nas sdod pa de yang min/ yang 'ga' shas nas da slob grar 'gro rgyu'i lo tshad ni yol song / yon tan ji 'dra byas nas slob snyam srid kyang /209

rang gis do snang byas na shes bya'i rnam grangs ji snyed shes rgyu yod/ dper na/rang dbang dpar khang sogs nas bod yig gi gsar shog thon bzhin pa dang / skabs skabs dril bsgrags kyi yig cha dang / gzhan yang 'phrod bsten skor sogs deb chung rigs 'dra min gang 'tshams thon bzhin pa'i thog phyin chad kyang rgya bskyed rim thon yong rgyur/ de dag la do snang byas/ nyin re tshig re las min yang shes thabs byas/ bod kyi skor zhig yod na yud tsam am krong byas/ 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul zhig yod na snang med du 'jog pa 'di 'dra gtan nas mi 'grigs/ 'dzam gling nang rgyal khab ji 'dra yod pa dang /de rnams kyi 'gro stangs ji 'dra yin pa/ rgya gar nang gi gnas tshul ji ltar yod pa/ yar rgyas ji ltar 'gro gi yod pa sogs la do snang byas te shes thabs bya dgos/ shes bya skusgon tan mang po shes nas phyi'i spu mdog brjes pa lta bu dang / mig 'thol pa skye ba/ mgo che ru 'gro ba lta bu 'byung ba min yang / sngar rang gi gnas lugs mang po ma shes pa'i skabs lto gos 'tshol ba'i dus dka' ngal chen po sku(nga gi skustod kyang / gnas tshul phran bu shes pa'i tshe rang gis bsam blo btang nas thabs shes las sla por byed thub pa dang / rtag tu gzhan la dri gtugs byed ma dgos pa de lta bu yong rgyu yod/ rang gis 'di byas na legs/'di byas na mi legs snyam du dpyod thub pa'i tshe/ gong rim nas lam ston zhig byas rung lam seng go rtogs thub nas bshar bgrod thub pa yong gi red/de min sgo phyugs 'ded pa lta bu bya thabs med pas tshang mas shes yon la do snang bya rgyu gal che/ yi ge shes pa tshos ma shes pa tshor bslabs/ ma shes pa 210

chos kyang spam 'dod ma byas par sbyangs nas/ lo re zung rjes sdod skar nang yi ge ma shes pa med pa lta bur bsgyur thabs la tshang mas 'bad brtson chen po byed dgos/ ma 'ongs par nga tsho dmangs gtso'i lam du 'gro dgos/ gtso rgyu'i dmangs la yon tan med na sprul gdug mang po sa gnas gcig tu bzhag pa ltar gcig gis gcig la 'khrug 'dzings ma zin par ོ kyi red/ dmangs la yon tan med na dmangs gatsho'i rtsa khrims bzos kyang mchod gshoms nang bsgrigs nas 'jog rgyu las 'os med/ dmangs la yon tan gyi bsam tshad longs pa zhig byung na dmangs gatsho'i rtsa khrims gzhir bzung chos srid gnyis ldan 'di phyi gnyis yod kyi 'tsho ba la legs par spyod thub pas de'i sta gon bya rgyu gal chen po yin/de nas sgrig 'dzugs zhes pa 'di yang gal chen po yin/ las don gang la yang mi sgor so sos nus pa bton nas 'grub thub pa'i rigs shig dang / mi mang po'i nus pa mnyam rub thog nas bsgrub dgos pa'i rigs shig bcas yod/mi gcig gis sgrub thub pa'i las don rigs la 'gal ba med kyang / mi mang po'i nus pa gcig bsgril gyis bsgrubadagos pa'i rigs la sgrig 'dzugs dgos mkho chen po yod/ ma 'ongs par thod rang dbang gi gnad don thog sgrig 'dzugs gal chen po yin pa smos ma dgos kyang / 'phral sel gzhis chags sa gnas shig yar rgyas gtong ba la yang sgrig 'dzugs legs po zhig med du mi rung ba yin/ der brten brgya dpon bcu dpon la sogs pa rim pa bzhin yod pas/'go byed mkhan tshos kyang rang gi dga' min dga' phyogs ma yin par drang pos 211

gzhung bsrangs kyi lam du 'gro dgos la/ byings tshogs rnams nas kyang sgrig 'dzugs la brtsi bkur dang / dga' zhen bya dgos/ sgrig 'dzugs zhes pa 'di ni 'dzam gling gang sarayod pa zhigayin/ sgrig 'dzugs nas bkod bsgrigs byas pa las logs su rang shed 'then 'khyer byas tshe spyi don la gnod rkyenayong rgyur/ sgrig 'dzugs nas 'char gzhi bkod/ lam ston byas pa der dga' zhen dang bcas tshang mas shar bgrod byed thub pa nges par dgos/de ltar tshang mas gcig nas gzhis chags thog 'bad brtson gang yod kyis sems shugs bsgril rgyu dang / gnyis su tshang mas yon tan la do snang byed dgos rgyu/ gsum par sgrig 'dzugs la dga' zhen brtsibakur dang / nang khul dam tshig mthun po bya rgyu bcas gal chen po 'dug de min gzhan dag zhu rgyu gang yang med/ tshang mar bkra shis bde legs yod/ thugs rje che/ zhes bka' sding5// // 212

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1965 zla 1 tshes 28 nyin bzhugs sgar du gnyug mar gnas pa dang / bal yul sogs phyogs gzhan nas ched bcar bcas bod mi dang / mon pa/ rgya gar ba bcas khyon mi grangs 700 skor pho brang du mjal bcar thog stsal ba'i bka' slob/thog mar 7gong sa mchog nas/ sa gnas gang nas yong pa'i mi yod ces bka' 'dri mdzad par/ kha shas shig nas nga tsho bal yul nas yong ba yin zhes zhus par/ ti si lir slog khang las sar yod pa'i gras yin pas/ khag po byung ngam/ khyed rang tshor tan tan dka' ngal mang po byung yog red/ khag po yod pa de sngon ma nas shes gsal yang lam seng thabs shes sprod rgyu khag po red/ deng sang nga tsho tshang mar de snga phan bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus su byung ma myong ba'i khag po sdug po zhig byung yod/ sngar rje sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs bod du dbyin dmag dang / chu byi rgya dmag sogs bod du lhags 'byor byung yod rung / bod yongs rdzogs btsan 'og tu mnan pa'i thal cha chen po dang / bod rgya khyab tu rgya che'i mi mang spyi byings la btsan gnon da lta nang bzhin dka' ngal byung ma myong ba red/ deng sang 'phral sel gyi dka' ngal tsam ma zad/ bod mi rigs la sdang zug gis bod rtsa med gtong rgyu sogs srid don gyi thog dang / chos phyogs nas klad pa bkrus te dad pa rtsa 'gog gis chos zhes pa ming med du bzo rgyu'i dmigs yul bzung ste las 'gul byed pa 'di lta'i skabs la nga tshor khag po tan tan yod/ gtso che shos bod mi tshang mas da phan sems shugs ma chag par yod pa dang / da dung dka' ngal bzod bsran 213

gyis spyi don khur 'khyer ba'i sems shugs ma chag pa zhig dgos/ ngas rgyun du nas rang btsan yong gi red ces mgo bskor lta bur shod pa min/ bden pa gsal rgyu med pa dang / rang btsan thob rgyu med pa de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma red/'dzam gling nang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas yul gtso bo lta bu bod yin pa dang / ston pa'i bstan pa gnas yun yang sangs rgyas rang gis lo lnga stong gsungs yod pa nas yongs grags kyi brtsis tshul lo 2500 tsam dang /brtsi tshul gcig la lo 3000 tsam phyin yod/ de dbang du byas na'ang lo nyis stong tsam bsdad yod/ bden pa gsal rgyu dang / rgyal kha thob rgyu sangs rgyas kyi gsung nas bstan yod par brten rang btsan thob rgyur yid ches byas chog rang btsan yong rgyu'i ched bsam blo btang nas 'bad brtson byed dgos/de yang yon tan thog nas 'bad brtson byed dgos shing / phyin chad kyang yon tan gyi thog nas gang ci yar rgyas gtong dgos pa las/ de snga phan gyi khral pa bong bu 'ded bzhin nyin lto nyin 'tshol lta bus 'grigs rgyur bsams na de 'dra rtsa ba nas yong thabs med/ 'phral sel gyis bsam blo btang ste phugs skyon mi 'byung ba byed dgos/ da lta shin tu gal che ba ni yon tan la sbyangs brtson byed dgos/ sngon la bod yig 'bri klog sbyangs/ de nas dril bsgrags kyi yig cha khag dang / bod yig tshag par sogs la blta klog gis phyi nang gnas tshul tshang ma shes pa zhig dang / bsam blo gang yang gtong thub pa zhig dgos/da lta bsam blo 'khor dka' ba de ni yon tan la nyams myong med pa'i skyon red/der brten yon tan la shin tu do snang chen po byed dgos/214

gnyis par/ mthun sgril zhes pa de dgos/ de yang don che chung mang por 'gro ba yin/ dper na/ nyin gcig gi lto gos 'tshol rgyu'i tshun la'ang dgos/ kha nas bshad pa tsam gyis mi ldeng zhing kha bshad lag len du 'khel dgos/ chos thog nas dam tshig lar rgya chig sgril dgos/ kha bshad tsam gyi mthun sgril de 'gag rtsa gcig tu thug dus che sa nas bod chol kha gsum nang khul dbye 'byed dang / chung sa nas lto tshang la gyong btang ba/ nang pa'i chos lugs khag gi rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi chos gcig las med bzhin chos lugs phan tshun rtsod 'then/ dper na/ dge lugs dang rnying ma dbar phyi pa nang pa lta bu'i sdang 'dzin chen po byed pa de tsho ha cang gi thabs sdug po red/ chos lugs khag phyogs 'then gyis dgon pa phan tshun rtsod pa dang / dbus pa khams la slebs dus 'di tshos kha bde mgo bskor gtong gi red zer ba dang / khams pa dbus la slebs dus khams pa glen rtags 'di chos rgyag 'dre rgyag gi red sogs zer ba lta bu/ 1951 lo phan bod dbus gtsang khul nas go gnas yod pa'i las byed mang po phyogs su btang yang de dag nas za bed brdabs gsigs chen po byas pa dang / dmag sgar phan tshun sgo bskyod skabs kyang btsan pos brdabs gsigs tshod med btang bas dmag sgaraskusang skabs mi ser tshos chag sgo bslangs song / brdab gsigs gtong gi red bsam pa dang / de bzhin gzhung gi las byed tsho yong skabs kyang brdab gsigs nyis brtsegs byas song bsam pa'i zhed snang skye dgos pa zhig las/ 'go dmangs dbar mthun sgril byung med/ 'go dmangs bar mthun bsgril yag po byas te 'go 'khrid chos 215

mdzub ston byas/ mi dmangs nas de don lag len du 'khel ba zhig dgos pa yin/ nga cho'i de snga phan mthun sgril ma byung bas skyon chen po byung yod/ da dung yang mthun sgril ma byung na nyen ka chen po red/ da lta nga tsho rtsa ba mi yul du gyar yang sgrom ma zhig par mchod rten mgo mjug log kyang bang rim sked par gnas yod/ khyed tshos dha ram sa lar bod gzhung dang / bod nang du yod pa'i rang rigs de tshos rgya gar du yod pa'i bod gzhung dmangs zhes blo gtad bcol sa zhig byed kyi yod pa red/ chol kha gsum zer ba sngar med gsar byung zhig ma red/ chol gsum lag gdang dpung sbrel gyi thog tu bskyod dgos pa las khong tsho dang nga tsho zhes nang khul shog 'then zar zir byas na mi 'grigs/ de snga phan rgya sde dang bod sde zhes zer ba de nyen tshabs chen po yin/de ni bar lam rgya mi'i btsan 'og tu tshud par ming 'dogs sna tshogs byas pa las don du rgya sde min/ nga rang la cha bzhag na skyes yul a mdo red/ a mdo'i yul ni bod chos rgyal cho'i dus su sa mtshams srung 'gag tu btang ba'i dmag sgar g.yas ru dang g.yon ru zhes rtsa ba phan po khul nas phyin pa'i mi rgyud zhig yin / nga rgya nag tu bakhyodad skabs lam bar sa mi 11gas rgya bod kyi dbye mtshams gsal po 'dug bar der chos rgyal tsho'i gdung rgyud chad/ glang dar gyi rjes nas bod nang khul dpung gshed su che nas dbang bzung / gcig mgo gcig gnon byed pa'i skabs der rgya mis sa rtags rdo rtags yod bzhin btsan 'dzul ham zos byas/ bod dbus gzhung nas nus med lhod yangs lta bur shor ba red/ de sngon rgya mi'i btsan 'og tu tshud pa de tshos chos byed sa 216

mdzub ston byas/ mi dmangs nas de don lag len du 'khel ba zhig dgos pa yin/ nga cho'i de snga phan mthun sgril ma byung bas skyon chen po byung yod/ da dung yang mthun sgril ma byung na nyen ka chen po red/ da lta nga tsho rtsa ba mi yul du gyar yang sgrom ma zhig par mchod rten mgo mjug log kyang bang rim sked par gnas yod/ khyed tshos dha ram sa lar bod gzhung dang / bod nang du yod pa'i rang rigs de tshos rgya gar du yod pa'i bod gzhung dmangs zhes blo gtad bcol sa zhig byed kyi yod pa red/ chol kha gsum zer ba sngar med gsar byung zhig ma red/ chol gsum lag gdang dpung sbrel gyi thog tu bskyod dgos pa las khong tsho dang nga tsho zhes nang khul shog 'then zar zir byas na mi 'grigs/ de snga phan rgya sde dang bod sde zhes zer ba de nyen tshabs chen po yin/de ni bar lam rgya mi'i btsan 'og tu tshud par ming 'dogs sna tshogs byas pa las don du rgya sde min/ nga rang la cha bzhag na skyes yul a mdo red/ a mdo'i yul ni bod chos rgyal cho'i dus su sa mtshams srung 'gag tu btang ba'i dmag sgar g.yas ru dang g.yon ru zhes rtsa ba phan po khul nas phyin pa'i mi rgyud zhig yin / nga rgya nag tu bakhyodad skabs lam bar sa mi 11gas rgya bod kyi dbye mtshams gsal po 'dug bar der chos rgyal tsho'i gdung rgyud chad/ glang dar gyi rjes nas bod nang khul dpung gshed su che nas dbang bzung / gcig mgo gcig gnon byed pa'i skabs der rgya mis sa rtags rdo rtags yod bzhin btsan 'dzul ham zos byas/ bod dbus gzhung nas nus med lhod yangs lta bur shor ba red/ de sngon rgya mi'i btsan 'og tu tshud pa de tshos chos byed sa 216

bod dang / khrims srung dpon po rgya mi yin zer ba lta bu/ de snga rgya sde khul la rang btsan rag gi ma red zer ba de dag ni ha cang gi thabs sdug red/ chol kha gsum chig sgril gyi dka' ngal bzod thub pa zhig dgos/ sems shugs dang spobs pa med na gnam nas zags pa lta bu yong mi srid/bar lam rang mi kha shas nas rtsa ba go ming tang gi srid byus yin min ma nges kyang / go tang kha 'khyer rgyus nyos pa'i phogs zan yod pa de tshos rang skyon ngos len gyis phyin chad bzhag na yag shos red/ de min yongs grags go mi tang phyogs su phyin na 'grigs rgyu las/ bkag 'gog byed mkhan yong gi ma red/ rtsa ba go ming tang dang lag pa gtong res byed chog pa'i grogs po red/ yin na yang las don dang srid byus so sor khag khag yod/ grogs pos byed tshad drang bden dang / dgra bos byed tshad phan med kho na min/ dper na/ rgya gar ni nga tsho'i lo brgya phrag gong gi shin tu mdza' ba'i grogs po yin yang / rgya gar rgya gar dang / bod pa'i las don so sor yod/ pe cing gzhung gi byed stangs 'ga' shas nga tshos dpe len 'os pa yod/ der brten dgra gnyen mgon gsum ngo shes nor 'dzol ma song ba bya dgos/gsum pa/ kha tsha dgos gtugs gtso gal che shos rang 'tsho byed thub pa zhig dgos/ rgyun du nas gzhan la to slong ste sdod pa ni thabs skyo po red/kha nas 'tham gling rgyal spyir skad rgyag gin yod kyang rtag par mi la bsnyes te rang 'gul ma thub na che sa nas bod pas rang gi to gos thabs 'tshol ma thub pas rang btsan gang 'dra len bsam pa'i brnyas bcos dang / chung sa nas to 217

bod dang / khrims srung dpon po rgya mi yin zer ba lta bu/ de snga rgya sde khul la rang btsan rag gi ma red zer ba de dag ni ha cang gi thabs sdug red/ chol kha gsum chig sgril gyi dka' ngal bzod thub pa zhig dgos/ sems shugs dang spobs pa med na gnam nas zags pa lta bu yong mi srid/bar lam rang mi kha shas nas rtsa ba go ming tang gi srid byus yin min ma nges kyang / go tang kha 'khyer rgyus nyos pa'i phogs zan yod pa de tshos rang skyon ngos len gyis phyin chad bzhag na yag shos red/ de min yongs grags go mi tang phyogs su phyin na 'grigs rgyu las/ bkag 'gog byed mkhan yong gi ma red/ rtsa ba go ming tang dang lag pa gtong res byed chog pa'i grogs po red/ yin na yang las don dang srid byus so sor khag khag yod/ grogs pos byed tshad drang bden dang / dgra bos byed tshad phan med kho na min/ dper na/ rgya gar ni nga tsho'i lo brgya phrag gong gi shin tu mdza' ba'i grogs po yin yang / rgya gar rgya gar dang / bod pa'i las don so sor yod/ pe cing gzhung gi byed stangs 'ga' shas nga tshos dpe len 'os pa yod/ der brten dgra gnyen mgon gsum ngo shes nor 'dzol ma song ba bya dgos/gsum pa/ kha tsha dgos gtugs gtso gal che shos rang 'tsho byed thub pa zhig dgos/ rgyun du nas gzhan la to slong ste sdod pa ni thabs skyo po red/kha nas 'tham gling rgyal spyir skad rgyag gin yod kyang rtag par mi la bsnyes te rang 'gul ma thub na che sa nas bod pas rang gi to gos thabs 'tshol ma thub pas rang btsan gang 'dra len bsam pa'i brnyas bcos dang / chung sa nas to 217

gos tshun la dka' ngal yong rgyu/ phugs su gzhis chags kyi lam thog tu bskyod thub pa zhig dang / 'phral sgang lam las byed pa de'ang to slong pa min pa'i las gla'i thog nas so so'i lto gos so sos 'tshol thub pasag po yin par bsam gyi 'dug phyags su gzhis chags/ bzo las/ 'phral sgang lam las sogs nang srid las khungs nas go sgrig byed bzhin yod pa de thog shar bskyod bya dgos/sgrig btsugs la dwang zhen chen po byed dgos/ sgrig 'dzugs nang ma sdod mkhan de tsho rang dbang yin mdog kha po red/ nye char wa ra ṇa si khul bskyod skabs mi 'khyams 'ag/'a shas nas ham pa 'gro sar bcom 'phrog byas/ 'phrog ma thub par rku ma brkus/ 'ga' zhig sar zhum bu nang bzhin byas/ g.yo sgyu khram gsum byed ngan ci rigs kyis bod rigs spyi'i mtshan shas byed pa shin tu nas thabs sdug red/ nga rang tsho bod mi rigs 'di rlabs chen gyi mi rigs shig yin/ chos phyogs nas sam skri ta'i skad yig tu ji yod bod yig tu gtan la phab pa sogs dang / srid phyogs nas rgya nag rgyal po bros dgos pa'i dgra shugs che ba sogs lo rgyus mang por gsal yod/ 'on kyang snga mo'i rlabs chen de deng sang med na'ang rlabs chen gyi mi rigs yin pa'i lo rgyus yod pa de la brten nas spobs pa bskyed de rtsam pa za mkhan gcig pa'i bod rigs tshang mas bod bstan pa chab srid kyi thog tu sems shugs bskyed dgos/ nga shes rgya che ba med kyang ngas bshad pa rnams sems la bzhag ste lag len du 'khel ba zhig bya dgos/ gtso che sgrig 'dzugs la dga' po'i thog sgrig 'dzugs kyi lam phyogs de'i nang shar bskyod kyis mi rigs 'dzugs bskrun sogs gang cir 218

yar rgyas shugs nus thon pa zhig dgos/ nga rgyal ba rin po che zhes mi gcig gis 'byon tshad gang yang med kyang / ngas bshad pa dang mdzub ston byed pa'i rgyab dpung du khyed tshos langs na rgyal kha thob thub kyi red/ mi mang gi thog nas rgyab shig rgyab na khag po red/ 'go 'khrid chos bsam blo btang / kha nas bshad/ de don mi mang nas lag len du bkal na spyi don la nus shugs thon pa yong rgyu/ gong du don tshan gsum bshad pa de dag sems 'jags lag len bstar thub pa gyis/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes stsal// //219

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1965 zla 2 tshes 15 nyin dzña ram sa la bzhugs snar du/ 'brug dang / la dwags/ khu nu/ rgya gar ba/ bod rigs bcas dad mjal zhu mi ser skya pho mo mi grangs dgu brgya skor la stsal ba'i bka' slob/thog mar 'brug dang / khu nu khul gyi mi rigs la bka' 'dri gsung gleng dang 'brel rang re rnams rgyal khab dang mi rigs khag khag yin yang /chos kyi thog la skyabs 'gro bya mkhan gcig pa yin pas 'dir rub 'dzoms byung ba yag po red/ rang tsho'i sngon ma'i mi rigs rnams nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lam du phyin pa ltar da lta yang nang par bsdad pa de dngos 'brel gyi yag po red/ de yang kha nas ma ṇi bgrangs ba dang / phyag mchod/ gnas bskor byed pa sogs yag po yin yang de tsam gyis nang pa'i gral du mi tshud/ ston rgyu yod pa zhig dgos/ dper na/ deng skabs rgyal khab phan tshun gyi dbar la sa mtshams kyi dbye ba yod pa nang bzhin chos phyogs su'ang skyabs 'gro yod med nang pa yin min gyi sa mtshams yin/ de min don 'gag rtsa gcig la thug dus mi dge ba sna tshogs byas te skyabs 'gro brlag pa lta bur ma song bar bla ma dkon mchog gsum ngo shes nas lam de rang du 'gro thub pa dang / las 'bras la brtsi srung byed dgos/ las 'bras ni tshig gzhan zhig nas bshad na yag po byas na yag po/ sdug po byas na sdug po yong rgyu lta bu red/ hin rdu/ ye shu/ kha che sogs kyi chos lugs nang dkon mchog ni 'jig rten bkod pa po lta bur 'dod kyang / nang pa ni las kyi dbang gis phyi'i stod 'jig rten dang / nang gi bcud sems can grub pa las sus kyang ma bzos/ las nyon 220

dbang gis 'dzam gling byung ba 'di'i thog sdug bsngal gang las grol dgos na chu rtsa gangs la thug pa lta bu rtsa ba nyon mongs pa 'grog dgos pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi las 'bras gsungs pa de ni mchod gtor dang / gser dngul sogs kyi 'bul ba'i ched du min par/ ngas bshad pa bden pa yin min la brtags/bden pa yin na lag len byas chog gsungs yod/ de ni bden pa yod pa'i spobs pa dang bcas gsungs pa zhig yin/ dper na/ rgya mis phyi rgyal gyi rlung 'phrin nyan pa dang / tshags par blta ba sogs mi chog ces 'gog gi yod pa de ni rtsa ba rang la bden pa med pas bkag pa red/ rgya gar na dmigs bsal bkag dgos pa 'ga' zhig las/ de min yul lung gang gi rlung 'phrin tshags shog lta klog byed chog pa de ni rtsa ba bden pa yod pa'i dbang gis red/de bzhin sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang bden pa skurdzod pas bshad chog pa tsam ma zad/sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i nang pa'i chos dang / deng skabs kyi gnas tshul mthun gyi yod pa de la yid ches chog pa zhig red/ deng sang gzhi nas rnyed pa'i 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul rnams sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang /mgon po klu sgrub sogs nas lo ngo stong phrag gi gong mkhyen zin pa red/ de 'dra'i nang pa'i chos la gzi byin dang bro ba yod pa zhig red/ 'on kyang lag len yag po ma bstar na nyen ka chen po red/ gtso bo dkon mchog gsum ngo shes/ las 'bras la brtsi srung / mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims srung rgyu bcas shin tu gal che/ spyir btang dam tshig rdog rtsa chig sgril yang skabs babs kyi dgos gal che nges/ phyin chad bod rgya che'i mi mang la shes tshad kyang 221

gdeng 'khel ba zhig dgos/ de thog nas chos srid gnyis ka yar rgyas gtong dgos/ shes bya'i chu tshad nges can zhig med na 'phral sel skyabs 'gro las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag tshig go bde'i thog nas bshad kyang go ma thub pa'i skyon yod/de bzhin mang tshogs la yon tan med pa'i dbang gis mi kha bde ham pa tsha po zhig gis gang bshad pa der legs nyes dpyod ma thub bar 'o de rang red ces hol rgyugs byed pa de la ri bong cal 'dogs zer ba de red/ bar lam rgya gar nang de 'dra yong gi 'dug mi mang rtsa ba chen po red de legs nyes kyi blang dor dpyod thub pa dang / ljid yod pa zhig dgos pa las srin bal la phu rgyab pa nang bzhin 'khyer chog min pa zhig dgos/ na tsha dang rkyen ngan zhig yong skabs bla mar dngul dang 'bul ba phul ba des bla ma yag po yin na phran bu phan gyi yod na ma gtogs ha cang phan pa dka'/ de las lhag pa'i sangs rgyas/ chos dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su bzung / skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya las rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor ma nor ba byas na/ de phan thogs che bayin/ dper na/ bod rang btsan gnam nas gzag gi ma red/ de bzhin a ri sogs nas mi sprod/ so so rang nas sgrub dgos pa lta bu red/ gser phye'i nang la bye ma 'dres pa lta bu min par chos srid gang ci gtsang ma spus dag bya dgos sogs bka' slob stsal// //

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1965 zla 3 tshes 17 nyin/ dha ram sa la bzhugs snar pho brang du/ 'bras blo gling tre+e hor bka' 'gyur sprul sku sogs nas ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin bod mi ser skya pho mo nyis stong brgal bar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs sngags yig drug ma'i ljags lung bcas dgyes stsal skabs sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad bka' slob/da ring bod zla 1 tshes 15 'di ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyis cho 'phrul gyi mdzad pa ston pa'i dus chen rtsa che zhig red/ de snga rang re bod duyin na snga dro mig kha phye ma thag pa nas bsam pa dge ba dang / chos kyi bsam tsā zhig blo yul du 'char te mchod mjal du 'gro ba dang / mchod 'bul byed pa/ kha 'don byed pa sogs yod/ 'ga' shas gyon gos mchor po dang / 'ga' shas gyon gos babs 'bring / 'ga' shas nyam thag po/ 'ga' shas brel 'tshub 'tshub/ 'ga' shas dal po/ 'ga' shas phyug mdog kha po/'ga' shas dbul mdog kha po/ 'ga' shas bla me dge bshes lta bu/ 'ga' shas dpon rigs lta bu/ yang 'ga' shas zhing pa snyom chung lta bu dang / 'brog pa lta bu so so'i rnam pa dang / so so'i 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs mi 'dra ba yod na yang / tshang ma gcig tu mthun pa de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dga' zhen byed pa de yin/ lha sar cha bzhag na jo shaka rnam gnyis sogs la rang gis ngang gis dad pa byed pa de ni tshang mar thun mong du yod pa'i gcig gyur gyi chos sam/ gnas tshul zhig chags nas spongad/ 'on kyang da ni so 16) las 223

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1965 zla 3 tshes 17 nyin/ dha ram sa la bzhugs snar pho brang du/ 'bras blo gling tre+e hor bka' 'gyur sprul sku sogs nas ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin bod mi ser skya pho mo nyis stong brgal bar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs sngags yig drug ma'i ljags lung bcas dgyes stsal skabs sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad bka' slob/da ring bod zla 1 tshes 15 'di ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyis cho 'phrul gyi mdzad pa ston pa'i dus chen rtsa che zhig red/ de snga rang re bod duyin na snga dro mig kha phye ma thag pa nas bsam pa dge ba dang / chos kyi bsam tsā zhig blo yul du 'char te mchod mjal du 'gro ba dang / mchod 'bul byed pa/ kha 'don byed pa sogs yod/ 'ga' shas gyon gos mchor po dang / 'ga' shas gyon gos babs 'bring / 'ga' shas nyam thag po/ 'ga' shas brel 'tshub 'tshub/ 'ga' shas dal po/ 'ga' shas phyug mdog kha po/'ga' shas dbul mdog kha po/ 'ga' shas bla me dge bshes lta bu/ 'ga' shas dpon rigs lta bu/ yang 'ga' shas zhing pa snyom chung lta bu dang / 'brog pa lta bu so so'i rnam pa dang / so so'i 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs mi 'dra ba yod na yang / tshang ma gcig tu mthun pa de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dga' zhen byed pa de yin/ lha sar cha bzhag na jo shaka rnam gnyis sogs la rang gis ngang gis dad pa byed pa de ni tshang mar thun mong du yod pa'i gcig gyur gyi chos sam/ gnas tshul zhig chags nas spongad/ 'on kyang da ni so 16) las 223

kyi rnam smin thog tu babs pa'i skabs su mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das da lta dngos su bzhugs yod kyang / sems can gyi las la skyob tu med pa ltar/ bod gangs can gyi sems can spyi'i dkar min las kyi 'bras bu dus su smin te nga rang tsho rang yul bral nas mi yul du gyar/gdug rtsub can phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul mkhan gyi lag pa khrag 'gos pa'i nang du nga tsho'i bod rgya che'i mi mang stod bcud mtha' dag hril gyis tshud nas da cha rang re bod lung pa'i nang 'ga' shas las byed pa yin mdog dang / 'ga' shas btson pa lta bu/ 'ga' shas spyir btang ngal rtsol ba/ 'ga' shas dwang blangs dpe bzang can/ 'ga' shas yar thon can/ 'ga' shas log spyod pa lta bu'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba mang po zhig yod kyang / da ring gi dus tshod 'dir sngar tshang mar thun mong gcig gyur du yod pa'i chos kyi bag chags sad rgyu de'i tshab tu dngangs skrag gi gnas tshul kho na'i ngang nas mi thar bar gnas yod/ gung bran tang mi rgan po tshos kyang so lo'i skyon gang 'dra zhig gi thog nas yong grabs yod med shes kyi ma red ces de snga lha sar yod dus nas zer gyi yod pa ltar de ni dngos 'brel red/ las byed pa zhig yin yang hob ste bltas na/ 'tsho ba'i gnas tshad dga' mo yod pa lta bu dang / las khungs shig 'grims nas sdod pa lta bu zhig yod na yang / kho'i bsam blo'i zhe phugs na dngangs skrag chen po zhig yod/ spyi byings rnams ni de bas ji 'dra zhig byas yong snyam pa'i dngangs skrag ngang gnas rgyu smos med yin/ de 'dra'i dngangs skrag de gcig gyur gyi chos shig tu gyur nas gnas yod/ 'on kyang nga tsho byes kyiyul du 'khod 224

kyi rnam smin thog tu babs pa'i skabs su mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das da lta dngos su bzhugs yod kyang / sems can gyi las la skyob tu med pa ltar/ bod gangs can gyi sems can spyi'i dkar min las kyi 'bras bu dus su smin te nga rang tsho rang yul bral nas mi yul du gyar/gdug rtsub can phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul mkhan gyi lag pa khrag 'gos pa'i nang du nga tsho'i bod rgya che'i mi mang stod bcud mtha' dag hril gyis tshud nas da cha rang re bod lung pa'i nang 'ga' shas las byed pa yin mdog dang / 'ga' shas btson pa lta bu/ 'ga' shas spyir btang ngal rtsol ba/ 'ga' shas dwang blangs dpe bzang can/ 'ga' shas yar thon can/ 'ga' shas log spyod pa lta bu'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba mang po zhig yod kyang / da ring gi dus tshod 'dir sngar tshang mar thun mong gcig gyur du yod pa'i chos kyi bag chags sad rgyu de'i tshab tu dngangs skrag gi gnas tshul kho na'i ngang nas mi thar bar gnas yod/ gung bran tang mi rgan po tshos kyang so lo'i skyon gang 'dra zhig gi thog nas yong grabs yod med shes kyi ma red ces de snga lha sar yod dus nas zer gyi yod pa ltar de ni dngos 'brel red/ las byed pa zhig yin yang hob ste bltas na/ 'tsho ba'i gnas tshad dga' mo yod pa lta bu dang / las khungs shig 'grims nas sdod pa lta bu zhig yod na yang / kho'i bsam blo'i zhe phugs na dngangs skrag chen po zhig yod/ spyi byings rnams ni de bas ji 'dra zhig byas yong snyam pa'i dngangs skrag ngang gnas rgyu smos med yin/ de 'dra'i dngangs skrag de gcig gyur gyi chos shig tu gyur nas gnas yod/ 'on kyang nga tsho byes kyiyul du 'khod 224

pa'i mi mang la cha mtshon na/ ma gzhi rang yul na sa gzhan yul du gyar ba'i gnas tshul thabs sdug po zhig yod kyang / ser skya pho mo rgan byis su 'dra zhig yin rung / rang dbang zhes pa'i tshig gnyis po de'i go ༄dun rnams nga tshor tshang yod pa yin stabs/ rtsa ba'i dka' ngal mang po yod kyang de 'dra'i dngangs skrag gis nyin mtshan mi 'khyol bar sdod dgos pa dang / 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug ge spyod lam ji 'dra zhigayin rung / gzhan dbang stabs bstun kho na ma gtogs/rang dbang gtan nas med pa'i gnas tshul de 'dra yod pa ma red/ der brten da ring gi gnas skabs 'dir mtshon na yang / sus kyang 'dir 'du dgos/yong dgos zer mkhan med kyang / rang gi 'dod pas dwang du blangs te 'dir 'du 'dzoms byas pa red/ 'dir ser mo ba dang / skya bo dang / rgan pa dang /gzhon pa sogs mang po zhig 'dus pa rnams 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs mi 'dra ba dang / spyi tshogs kyi sde tshan mi 'dra ba yin na yang / tshang ma gcig gyur gyi dad pa zhig la brten nas 'dir 'du 'dzoms byas pa red/ 'di ra yong na de la bya dga' gzengs bstod sprod mkhan med la/ ma yong na yang de la 'phya smod bya mkhan su yang med/ rang dbang yin/ rang dbang zhes pa'i khe dbang bzang po de har po dang / tshon khra la sogs pa gang yang med kyang rang dbang zhes pa de yod na drang bden ya rabs rang 'dod kyi 'tsho bar ci dgar spyod thub pa byung / de 'dra'i rang dbang yod pa la brten nas dus chen 'dir mchor po dang / rdzig po gang yang med kyang / sems skyid po'i thog nas yar dkon mchog la dad pa dang / rang nyid kha 'don dge sbyor ji ltar byed kyang rang 'dod 225

ltar spyad chog pa yod pa yin pas rang dbang zhes pa de rtsa ba chen po yin/ da res dus chen 'di nga tshos so so'i lung par bya rgyu ma byung rung / gnas 'di 'dra zhig tu nga tsho 'du 'dzoms bya rgyu byung ba skal ba bzang po red snyam du dran gyi 'dugade la 'dzam gling 'di'i steng chos zhes pa zhig yod/ chos la 'dra min mang po yod/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar/ nang pa'i chos dang / phyi pa'i chos zhes phyi nang gnyis/ phyi pa'i chos la'ang rgya gar nang bcom ldan 'das ma byon gong gi chos kyang mang po yod pa dang / de rjes gsar du byung ba'i chos kyang mang po yod/ gang ltar deng dus 'dzam gling 'dir chos lugs mang po yod /spyir btang chos zhes pa ni/ nga tsho mi yi rigs kyis dngos su skyob thub pa dang /shes thub pa'i gnas tshul de min pa'i dka' ngal zhig byung ba na/ dper na/chu zhi ga rgyugs yong ba'am/ khyi spyon lta bu zhig 'phrad na/ de rang gis mthong ba dang / de las skyob pa'i thabs shes thub pa zhig yin stabs mi de'i bsam ho'i nang khyi skyon gyis thugs pa'i nyen kha yod snyam nas de las g.yol ba'i thabs byed rgyu dran pa yin/ yang khyug lta bu zhig brgyab ste gnas tshul de las g.yol du med pa dang / byed thabs med pa'i gnas tshul dza drag cig gro bur du byung ba yin na/ mi de'i bsam cho'i nang ngas 'di las g.yol/ 'di nas gros snyam pa'i thabs shes bral zhing / rang gi nus pas mi ldeng pa zhig tu gyur pa na skabs der de'i bsam blo'i nang rnam kun chos shes kyi yod dam med kyang rung /nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bag chags yod pa zhig yin na kha nas bla ma dkon 226

mchog ces zer ba dang / de min spyir btang gi mi rnams nas/ a ma/ a ma zhes rang gi.a ma yod dam med kyang skad 'bod de ltar byed pa yin/ a mas de las skyob mi thub kyang / de'i bsam blo'i nang rang gi nus pas de las skyob mi thub pa'i gnas tshul zhig dang 'phrad pa'i rkyen gyis rang gis ngang gis skyabs gzhan zhig 'tshol ba'i bsam blo 'khor ba yin/ spyir btang mi rnams chung ngu'i skabs nas brtse ba dang / dga' po bya yul de a ma yin stabasa.a ma yod med dang / phan thogs min la ma tos par kha nasa.a ma zhes 'bod pa de ltar yin/ der brten rang cag mi'i bsam blo'i nang / dka' ngal dang 'phrad dus de sel ba'i thabs shes byed thub pa yin na de la de bstun thabs shes byas pas chog par skad ngan de 'dra shor mi dgos kyang / thabs shes mi thub pa'i dka' ngal zhig dang 'phrad pa'i tshe rang gi ngang gis skyabs gong ma zhig 'tshol 'dod kyi bsam blo 'khor ba yin/ rgyu mtshan de 'drar brten nas chos zhes pa 'di byung ba yin pa red/chos zhes pa 'di mis dngos su thabs shes sprod pa'i gnas tshad las brgal ba'i gnas tshul zhig byung dus kha gtad gcog rgyu'i lag cha zhig red ma gtogis/ rang re spyir btang mis thabs shes sprod thub pa'i gzugs po bde po dang / rgyu nor 'byung thabs sogs mi tshe 'di'i gnas tshul zhig la chos bed spyod byed pa de nor ba yin/ sngar jo bo je la chos zhes pa ci yin bka' 'dri zhus par/ tshe phyi ma phan chad kyi bsam blo btang na de chos su 'gro ba yin/tshe 'di kho na'i ched du bsam blo btang na de chos min zhes gsungs 'dug mi 227

tshe 'di'i gnas tshul rnams ni mig gis mthong thub pa dang / gzhan la dpe blangs te thabs shes sprod rgyu sku da pas las sla po yin/ mi tshe phyi ma'i mtshams su slebs dus phyi mar thabs shes sprod rgyu phar bzhag phyi ma yod pa la yid ches rgyu kho na khag po yin/ yid ma ches pa de phyi ma med nas yid ma ches pa min ya/nga / phyi ma sku1da kyang de shes dka' ba'i dbang gis yid ma ches pa yin/dper na/ byung ma srid pa lta bu'i dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig byung na lam seng yid ches mi thub/ yid mi ches pa de dngos yod gnas tshul de ma byung ba'i dbang gis yid ma ches pa min yang / dngos yod gnas tshul de che drags te rang gi blo yul du ma shong pa'i dbang gis yid ma ches pa red/ der brten skye ba phyi mar yid ma ches pa de skye ba phyi ma med nas yid ma ches pa min/ skye ba phyi ma yod kyang skye ba phyi ma'i gnas stangs de nga tsho'i mi tshe 'di las ldog pa'i gnas tshul chen po zhig dang / gting ring po zhig yin pas de'i gnas lugs ma shes pa'i dbang gis yid ma ches pa red/ der brten chos zhes pa de ni spyir btang mi'i bsam blo'i nang glags mi kheg pa'i dka' ngal zhig dang 'phrad dus de la thabs shes sprod pa dang / de la kha gtad gcog byed de la chos zer ba yin pas chos de nga tshos gnas tshul de 'dra zhig gi thog la bed spyod bya dgos/spyir btang brjod na/ chos kyis mi tshe 'di 'bud thabs dang / mi tshe 'di'i kha dang / grod pa rgyang ba'i ched min/ dper na/ chos pa'i 'bag gyon nas rang gi 'tsho ba skyel thabs kyi bsam blo btang na/ ngo thog chos zer ba de bshu gzhog gtong byed yin thag chod red/ rgya mis bshad pa red la bshad pa de 228

bden pa yang yin/ der brten rkun ma dmar po dang jag pa ser po zhes zer ba red/ chos zhes/ bed spyod ji 'dra zhig gi thog la bya dgos pa ma shes par rang rang gi thod pa rgyong byed dang / rang gi mi tshe 'di nyid tsam skyel rgyu'i bsam blo btang nas chos pa yin zhes gra chas shig gyon/ ldo dril bzung na yang de chos pa ma yin/ de la rgya mis brjod dgos pa med/ lo stong phrag gi gong nas sangs rgyas rang gis gsungs yod la/ de'i rjes 'jug slob dpon chen po chos kyang phyi ma phan chad kyi don du song na chos yin/ tshe 'di kho na'i ched du song na chos min zhes thag bcad zin pa yin/ chos zhes pa'i gnas tshul de 'dra zhig red/ rang re bod du dar ba'i chos ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos yin/ spyir btang 'dzam gling 'dir chos mang po zhig yod pa so sor yon tan re dang / legs cha re yod kyang / de dag gi nang nas nang pa'i chos ni ha cangasag po red bsam gyi 'dug nga ni mi thebs chag cig yin/ yon tan med/ rgya chen po gang yang shes kyi med de/ rang gi shes tshod nas tshod dpag byas na nang pa'i chos ni ha cang gi bro ba chen po dang / gting ring po zhig min nam snyam/ lhag par gtso che shos la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di dad pa gcig pu min par rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas 'gro bzhin yod/ rgyu mtshan dang mthun po med pa zhig yin na sangs rgyas rang gis gsungs pa'i bka' zhig yin kyang drang don las nges don du 'jog mi thub par bka' de'i dgongs pa gzhan du bkral dgos pa yin/ der brten sangs rgyas rang gis gsungs pa'i bka' yin rung dngos yod gnas tshul dang ran gyi mi 'dug na/ sangs rgyas kyi 229

dgongs pa gzhan zhig la brten nas gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bkral dgos pa ma gtogs/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang ma ran kyang sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin zhes mtha' gcig tu bzung mi thub la bzung mi chog sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya dbang wa ṭa ba dang / 'bring ba/ dman pa sogs rigs 'dra min mang po zhis yod pas dbang non tshor gsung stangs gcig dang / de bzhin 'bring dman so sor ltos te gsung stangs 'dra min ji snyed yod pas de rnams la drang nges kyi dbye ba 'byed dgos/ mgon po klu sgrub dang / 'phags pa thogs med la sogs pa rnams sangs rgyas rang nyid kyis lung bstan nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' la drang nge sa dbye ba 'byed par gsungs yod/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' yod tshad rnams thad shar 'grel chog pa yin na drang nges phye dgos pa med la/ klu sgrub dang / thogs med sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan dgos pa med/ de ltar min par sangs rgyas kyi bka' rnams dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang sbrel/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gtso bor bzung dgos pa yin pas na bka' la drang nges gnyis byung ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyis ngas bshad pa rnams khyed tshos nyan dgos/ngas bshad pa la ma nyan na nor 'khrul yong gi red/ ngas bshad pa ji bzhin thad kur go ba len pa las de min go ba logs su blang mi chog ces gsungs pa med/ sangs rgyas kyis dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang / gdul bya'i khams dang / mos pa dang / bsam pa sogs dang sbrel nas thabs 'dra min sna tshogs shig gsungs pa rnams rjes 'jug pa so so'i ngos nas kyang / thog mar rang gi rgyud tshod ji yin shes par byas nas/ de nas rang gi rgyud tshod de dang 'tshams 230

dgongs pa gzhan zhig la brten nas gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bkral dgos pa ma gtogs/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang ma ran kyang sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin zhes mtha' gcig tu bzung mi thub la bzung mi chog sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya dbang wa ṭa ba dang / 'bring ba/ dman pa sogs rigs 'dra min mang po zhis yod pas dbang non tshor gsung stangs gcig dang / de bzhin 'bring dman so sor ltos te gsung stangs 'dra min ji snyed yod pas de rnams la drang nges kyi dbye ba 'byed dgos/ mgon po klu sgrub dang / 'phags pa thogs med la sogs pa rnams sangs rgyas rang nyid kyis lung bstan nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' la drang nge sa dbye ba 'byed par gsungs yod/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' yod tshad rnams thad shar 'grel chog pa yin na drang nges phye dgos pa med la/ klu sgrub dang / thogs med sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan dgos pa med/ de ltar min par sangs rgyas kyi bka' rnams dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang sbrel/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gtso bor bzung dgos pa yin pas na bka' la drang nges gnyis byung ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyis ngas bshad pa rnams khyed tshos nyan dgos/ngas bshad pa la ma nyan na nor 'khrul yong gi red/ ngas bshad pa ji bzhin thad kur go ba len pa las de min go ba logs su blang mi chog ces gsungs pa med/ sangs rgyas kyis dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang / gdul bya'i khams dang / mos pa dang / bsam pa sogs dang sbrel nas thabs 'dra min sna tshogs shig gsungs pa rnams rjes 'jug pa so so'i ngos nas kyang / thog mar rang gi rgyud tshod ji yin shes par byas nas/ de nas rang gi rgyud tshod de dang 'tshams 230

pa'i bka' nyams len byed shes pa dgos/ de yong ba la sangs rgyas kyi bka' drang nges so sor phye dgos par brten rjes 'jug gi slob dpon chen po tshos sangs rgyas kyi bka' la drang nges gnyis su phye nas 'grel brjod byas pa yin/'di tsam la bsam blo btang na yang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di zab po dang / shin tu drang po/ bden pa la sngas bcol mkhan zhig yin pa'i rtags de 'dra yod/ rang nyid la bden pa sngas bcol gyi spobs pa med na/ thog ma nas ham pa che tsam byas te ngas bshad pa 'di rnams 〈(da tshos ma nyan na skyed tsho skyid po yong gi ma red ces dang po nas bshad na ma gtogs nyen kha yod/ rang gi rjes 'jug par brtag dpyad bya rgyu'i go skabs sprad na khong tshos brtag dpyad kyis nam zhig khungs ma 'khyol ba'i gnas tshul byung na ston pa rang nyid nyams rgyu'i nyen kha yod stabs thog ma nas de 'dra zhig ma brjod thabs med red/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das ni bden pa la sngas bcol pa'i spobs pa rang la yod pa bzhin gzhan la brtag dpyad byed du bcug ste de nas chos nyams su len dgos par gsungs yod/ 'di 'dra zhig la cha mtshon na yang / nang pa'i chos gro ba chen po zhig min nam snyam/ mi 'ga' shas kyi bsam par/ dper na/1955 lo ngos rang ma'o tse tung mtha' ma'i mjal 'phrad skabs ma'o tse tung gis 'di 'dra gsung gi 'dug 'dir ma'o la zhe sa phran bu brjod kyi yod/ gang lags she na/ khong mi snyom chung khrod nas dka' las brgyab ste yong ba'i mi rgan nyams myong can zhig red/ khong gis chos zer ba de dug red/ chos kyis mi'i rigs la gnod pa las phan thogs gang yang med/ lhag par bod dang /231

sog po la chos kyi dug chen po zhig khyab yod pa red/ ces gsung gi 'dug de khong la khag med/ phyogs gcig nas ma'o tse tung gis brtag dpyang nan po zhig ma byas pa dang / gnyis nas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi lta ba gting zab po zhig yod pa de ma sbyangs ma shes pa yin stabs/ hob ste ma'o tse tung gi bsam cho'i mthong snang du/ chos zer ba rgyu mtshan gtan nas med pa dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang rtsa ba nas mi mthun pa/ sngar gyi mi las ka mi nyid mkhan/ bsam blo grung po yod pa zhig gis rang gi grod pa rgyong thabs dang /rang gi 'tsho ba skyel rgyu'i ched du grub mtha' brtsams/ gang ltar dgos pa chos byed mkhan rang nyid kyi don du gnas lugs mang po bshad/ de dag spyir btang gi mi rig pa yag po med pa tshor ham pa chen wa'i thog nas bshad na/ ngas gong du brjod pa ltar/ mi'i rigs kyi bsam khra'i nang skabs re/ a ma zhes 'bod pa'i gnas tshul yod pa de'i skabs zin nas/ sangs rgyas zhes pa dang / dkon mchogacasad ces mi bsam blo gting ring po gtong mi thub mkhan bsam tshad dma' wa'i rigs la de ltar brjod na/ khos rgyu mtshan la bsam blo ma btang bar yid ches byas/ phran bu na tsha sogs god chag byung ba'i tshe/ khyed rang gis byed stangs ma 'grigs pas lan/ da cha zhabs brtan 'di 'dra gyis/ zhabs brtan ngas ma gtogs sgrub mi shes zhes bshad/ kho la sgor mo bcu grangs shig las med kyang mi de'i sar skyel du yong gi red/ gnas tshul de rnams mthong ba tsam las/chos zhes pa ji 'dra zhig yin pa'i rtsa don rnams ma shes na khag mi 'dug ma'o tse tung gis kyang bsam khro de lta bu 'khor gyi yod pa red/ der brten spyir btang 232

gung bran tang mi tsho'i bsam khra'i nang du yang / chos zer ba de ni mi las ka byed thub mkhan rnams sgyid lug pa bzo rgyu'i thabs shes shig yin par bsam zhing de ltar brjod pa red/ de dag la hob ste bltas na le khag mi 'dug de rnams gang gis lan snyam na ma'o tse tung bsam blo sdug pa'i skyon min yang /ma shes pa'i skyon yin/ lhag par nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang / de'i nang nas theg chen gyi lta ba'i rnam gzhag mang po zhig yod cing / chos zer ba kha 'don dge sbyor byed pa tsam dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku bsgrigs te de la mchod 'bul byed pa tsam min par/ ngo thog sangs rgyas zhes pa de ji 'dra zhig yin/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam gyi gnas tshul ji 'dra zhig yin/ 'bras bu dang / lam de gnyis ka 'byung ba gzhi yi gnas tshul la thug yod pas gzhi yi gnas tshul de ji 'dra zhig yin pa sogs lta ba'i rnam gzhag de rnams ma shes pa'i dbang gis bsam cho de lta bu byung ba yin gyi red bsam gyi 'dug 'dzam gling 'dir chos gzhan dag mang po yod pa de rnams la yang rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig yod kyang / rim gyis mthar gtugs pa na/ ngas mang po mi shes kyang ye shu'i chos la mtshon na/ nga tsho'i mdun la yod pa'i shing sdong 'di rnams dkon mchog gis bzos par 'dod/ de bzhin sdod kyi bkod pa dang / nyi zla sogs dang / bcud kyi sems can rnams kyang dkon mchog gis bzos par 'dod de/ dper na/ nga tshos mig gis mthong thub pa'i dngos po rtsam pa lta bu'i 'byung stangs dris na/ 'bru yos su brjos/ de btags nas bzos lugs brjod thub/ 'bru de ji ltar byung zhes dris na/ ljang pa dang / myu gu 233

dang / sa bon las byung bar brjod/ de rnams rim gyis ded pa'i mtha' mar bsam blos thag gcod ma thub stabs dkon mchog gis bzos pa red ces 'dum bde po zhig mi brjod thabs med byung ba yin/ stod bcud kyi bkod pa yongs rdzogs dkon mchog gis bzos zhes brjod pa'i tshe 'grel bshad rgya chen po byed mi dgos par stabs bde po yin/ nyan mkhan gyi mi bsam blo gting ring po rang med pa zhig yin na de la yid ches skyes te dkon mchog la dad shugs che ru 'gro/ yid ches de'i nus pas skor ba gcig brgyab/ chu 'khor ltar chu shugs kyis skor ba zhig 'khor ba'i tshe gnyis pa gsum pa nas shugs je cher 'gro ba ltar/ gong gsal gnas lugs bshad par yid ches skyes pa des skor ba gcig rgyag dus rang nyid chos kyi gzi 'od cher song bar mngon pa dang / da dung bskyar du brjod dus nus pa che ru dang brtan du phyin nas/ deng sang 'dzam gling 'dir skor ba mang po rgyag bzhin pa yin/ de gnyis kur shugs ston 'debs pa'i phan thogs yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig gi thog nas de ltar phyin pa red/ de la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan zhig gis bltas na ma gzhi de dag legs po yin/ dkon mchog la yid ches byas/ dpag tshod kyis las rgyu 'bras shig brtsis nas rdzun ma shod/ rkun ma ma rku/ ya rabs bya dgos/ gzhan la phan sems bya dathostes zhes brjod pa de rnams legs po yin kyang / cadags gzhan zhig nas bsam blo btang na/ des mi'i bsam blo mnan gyi yod pa red/ gang yin zhe na/ dkon mchog gzhan zhig yin pa dang / mi rnams dkon mchog gis bzos pa zhig yin pa/ mi rnams nas 234

sgrub mi thub pa'i tshad mtho shos ni dkon mchog yin/ de la dad pa byas na dag pa'i zhing zhig tu skye thub brjod pa las/ rang re mi rnams nas dkon mchog byed thub pa'i spobs pa gang yang med/ dkon mchog des ji gsung ltar sgrub pa kho na ma gtogs dkon mchog la rtsod gling dang / brtag dpyad bya rgyu'i go skabs sprad med/ der brten nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bshad tshul dang bsdur na/ brtag dpyad byas mi chog pa dang / rtsod gleng mi chog pa/ dkon mchog nyid kyi bka' kho na la yid ches bya dgos/ dkon mchog gi bka' nyan rung mtha' ma'i thob bya dkon mchog gi drung dag zhing la skye thub pa de tsam las med stabs gnas tshul de rnams kyis mi'i bas ma wā mnan pa dang / spobs pa gcog gi yod pa red/ hin rdur mtshon na/ rgya gar nang hin rdu'i chos lugs mang po yod/ de rnams ma shi ga'i chos lugs dang mi 'dra ba'i gnas tshul mang po zhig spros te bshad nas skye ba mang po yod pa dang / rang gis kyang thar pa thob thub pa la sogs par brjod mkhan yod cing / de dag gis mi tshe 'di ga dkon mchog gis bskadad par khas mi len yang / gong ma gong ma'i mthar gtugs pa'i tshe mthar thug der 'jig rten bkod pa po zhig 'jog pa yin/ phyi rol pa'i grub mthar gsal ba'i bod dpe'i nang stod bcud tshangs pas bzos lugs gsal ba ltar deng sang yang de ltar brjod mkhan 'dug de rnams ma shi ku'i chos lugs dang mi 'dra ba'i rgya che zhing / gting zab tu phyin yod kyang /mthar 'jig rten bkod pa po zhig khas blang pas nang pa dang mi 'dra ba yin/'on kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ltar byas na/ snod kyi bkod pa dang /235

bcud kyi sems can rnams dkon mchog gis bzos pa min la/ gzhan sus kyang bzos pa min/ rang gi las kyis bzos pa yin/ las de ni rang rgyud la yod pa'i nyon mongs kyis bsags/ nyon mongs zhes pa ni rang sems ma dul ba bzo mkhan ma rabs kyi blo zhig yin/ dper na/ mi'i rigs dang /tha na 'bu srin zhig yin yang de'i rgyud la ya rabs kyi sems dang / ma rabs kyi sems po da/ de ni spyir btang tshang mas shes gsal yin/ chothos khas mi len pa'i gung bran tang mi zhig yin kyang ya rabs kyi sems dang / ma rabs kyi sems khas len byed kyi red/ mi su 'dra zhig la dris kyang ya rabs dang /ma rabs khas len byed kyi red/ de dkon mchog gis lung bstan dgos med par tshang mas shes gsal yin/ de 'dra'i ya rabs dang / ma rabs ji lta bu snyam na/ spyir btang byas na/ kun spyod gcig gis gzhan dag la dga' ba skye ba de ya rabs dang / gzhan sems la mi dga' ba skyes pa de ma rabs kyi spyod pa yin/ dper na/ mi skusas pa gcig dang / 'on pa gcig 'dzoms nas gcig la ja phor gang yod na/ de phyed bgos kyis mnyam du btung na gzhan dag de'i sems la dga' po yong gi red/ skugs pa'am 'on pa shin tu glen pa zhig yin yang sems la dga' ba skyes kyi red/ de 'dra'i gzhan sems la dga' ba skye ba'i spyod pa de ni ya rabs yin/ yang mi shugs che chung gnyis yod pa'i tshe shugs chung ba'i lag gi ja phor gang shugs che bas 'phrogs nas btung na/ de ma rabs yin/ des gzhan de'i sems la mi dga' ba skye ba yin/ dka' spyad gzhan des byas/ bed spyod gzhan dag cig gis byas na 236

bcud kyi sems can rnams dkon mchog gis bzos pa min la/ gzhan sus kyang bzos pa min/ rang gi las kyis bzos pa yin/ las de ni rang rgyud la yod pa'i nyon mongs kyis bsags/ nyon mongs zhes pa ni rang sems ma dul ba bzo mkhan ma rabs kyi blo zhig yin/ dper na/ mi'i rigs dang /tha na 'bu srin zhig yin yang de'i rgyud la ya rabs kyi sems dang / ma rabs kyi sems po da/ de ni spyir btang tshang mas shes gsal yin/ chothos khas mi len pa'i gung bran tang mi zhig yin kyang ya rabs kyi sems dang / ma rabs kyi sems khas len byed kyi red/ mi su 'dra zhig la dris kyang ya rabs dang /ma rabs khas len byed kyi red/ de dkon mchog gis lung bstan dgos med par tshang mas shes gsal yin/ de 'dra'i ya rabs dang / ma rabs ji lta bu snyam na/ spyir btang byas na/ kun spyod gcig gis gzhan dag la dga' ba skye ba de ya rabs dang / gzhan sems la mi dga' ba skyes pa de ma rabs kyi spyod pa yin/ dper na/ mi skusas pa gcig dang / 'on pa gcig 'dzoms nas gcig la ja phor gang yod na/ de phyed bgos kyis mnyam du btung na gzhan dag de'i sems la dga' po yong gi red/ skugs pa'am 'on pa shin tu glen pa zhig yin yang sems la dga' ba skyes kyi red/ de 'dra'i gzhan sems la dga' ba skye ba'i spyod pa de ni ya rabs yin/ yang mi shugs che chung gnyis yod pa'i tshe shugs chung ba'i lag gi ja phor gang shugs che bas 'phrogs nas btung na/ de ma rabs yin/ des gzhan de'i sems la mi dga' ba skye ba yin/ dka' spyad gzhan des byas/ bed spyod gzhan dag cig gis byas na 236

ma rabs yin/ de 'dra'i ya rabs dang / ma rabs kyi spyod pa de sangs rgyas dang / mkhas pas brjod ma dgos par bu phrug chung ngu zhig gis kyang rtogs thub/ bya spyod chung ngu gcig la'ang ya rabs dang / ma rabs kyi dbye ba phye ba ni nga tsho tshang ma'i mthun snang du grub pa dang / yongs su grags pa'i gnas tshul zhig red/ de 'dra'i ya rabs dang / ma rabs kyi spyod pa de glo bur du rgyu med par byung ba ma yin/ dper na/ glen pa de'i bsam par rang kha skom pa ji bzhin du gzhan de yang sgom gyi yod 'gro snyam nas ja bgo sha rgyag pa dang /gzhan des rang nyid ma gtogs gzhan gyi bsam blo brjed nas ja 'phrog pa yin na/ de gnyis rka'i lus kyi spyod pa bzang ngan gyi rnam 'gyur ma thon gong / bsam blo bzang ngan gnyis sngon du song nas yod/ de 'dra'i bsam blo ya rabs yod pa'i dbang gis ya rabs kyi spyod pa thon pa dang / bsam blo ma rabs kyi dbang gis ma rabs kyi spyod pa thon pa yin/ de ltar ma rabs kyi spyod pa 'dren pa'i bsam 17 de la chos phyogs nas bshad na/ nyon mongs zer zhing / bsam blo skyon can sdug pa de yin la/ ya rabs kyi bsam blo ni legs pa de yin/ de 'dra'i bsam 11 ya rabs ma rabs sam/ legs nyes de gnyis la brten nas lus ngag gi spyod pa bzang po dang / ngan pa gnyis thon pa dang / lus ngag gi spyod pa bzang po dang / ngan pa gnyis la brten nas rang la bde ba dang / sdug bsngal skye ba yin/ rang rang nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang bde sdug ji byung de 'dra'i bya spyod bzang ngan las byung ba ma zad/ rang re'i lus kyi phung po 'di yang de dag las byung ba yin/ lus 'di gang du gnas pa'i stod kyi bkod pa 'di yang 237

ma rabs yin/ de 'dra'i ya rabs dang / ma rabs kyi spyod pa de sangs rgyas dang / mkhas pas brjod ma dgos par bu phrug chung ngu zhig gis kyang rtogs thub/ bya spyod chung ngu gcig la'ang ya rabs dang / ma rabs kyi dbye ba phye ba ni nga tsho tshang ma'i mthun snang du grub pa dang / yongs su grags pa'i gnas tshul zhig red/ de 'dra'i ya rabs dang / ma rabs kyi spyod pa de glo bur du rgyu med par byung ba ma yin/ dper na/ glen pa de'i bsam par rang kha skom pa ji bzhin du gzhan de yang sgom gyi yod 'gro snyam nas ja bgo sha rgyag pa dang /gzhan des rang nyid ma gtogs gzhan gyi bsam blo brjed nas ja 'phrog pa yin na/ de gnyis rka'i lus kyi spyod pa bzang ngan gyi rnam 'gyur ma thon gong / bsam blo bzang ngan gnyis sngon du song nas yod/ de 'dra'i bsam blo ya rabs yod pa'i dbang gis ya rabs kyi spyod pa thon pa dang / bsam blo ma rabs kyi dbang gis ma rabs kyi spyod pa thon pa yin/ de ltar ma rabs kyi spyod pa 'dren pa'i bsam 17 de la chos phyogs nas bshad na/ nyon mongs zer zhing / bsam blo skyon can sdug pa de yin la/ ya rabs kyi bsam blo ni legs pa de yin/ de 'dra'i bsam 11 ya rabs ma rabs sam/ legs nyes de gnyis la brten nas lus ngag gi spyod pa bzang po dang / ngan pa gnyis thon pa dang / lus ngag gi spyod pa bzang po dang / ngan pa gnyis la brten nas rang la bde ba dang / sdug bsngal skye ba yin/ rang rang nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang bde sdug ji byung de 'dra'i bya spyod bzang ngan las byung ba ma zad/ rang re'i lus kyi phung po 'di yang de dag las byung ba yin/ lus 'di gang du gnas pa'i stod kyi bkod pa 'di yang 237

las de 'dra la brten nas byung ba yin/ der brten phyi stod kyi bkod pa dang /nang bcud kyi sems can gyi bde sdug bzang ngan dang bcas pa thams cad las kyi dbang gis byung ba yin/ spyir btang gi mi dang / 'bu srin zhig yin rung de 'dra'i las bzang ngan yong gzhi'i ya rabs dang / ma rabs kyi bsam blo de gnyis las/ ya rabs kyi bsam blo nyung zhing / ma rabs kyi bsam blo mang ba yin/ ma rabs kyi bsam 11 mang bas sems ma dul ba byung zhing / de las spyod pa ma rabs 'byung ba yin/ gnas lugs de 'dra zhig yin stabs deng dus 'dzam gling 'dir rgyal khab phan tshun dmag 'dren pa dang / mi phan tshun gri 'dzings byed pa/ tha na kha rtsod phran bu byung ba tshun chad bsam slo ma rabs des drangs pa yin/ rgya mis cadad du btsan 'dzul byas pa de yang rgya mi'i bsam blo ma rabs de las byung ba yin/ rang re wasted mi tshor gnas tshul thabs sdug po zhig byung ba 'di yang nga rang tshos las ngan pa bsags pa las byung zhing /las de yang bsam sdus ma rabs de las byung ba yin/ de dag thams cad bsam blo ma rabs dang / blo ma dul ba des drangs pa yin stabs de la dgongs nas sangs rgyas kyis/ sems dul ba ni bde ba yin/ sems ma dul ba sdug bsngal yin/ zhes gsungs yod/ sems ma rabs je nyung je nyung du btang / ya rabs je mang du btang na lus ngag gi spyod pa ya rabs ngang gis 'byung zhing /des rang nyid la bde skyid dang / mi gzhan la phan thogs 'byung thub pa yin/ des na/ sems dul na bde ba yong stangs de ltar yin/ sems ma dul bar rang nyid gcig pu bde ba byung na snyam pas spyod pa tshul min gang byung du zhugs 238
