na/ de sa rang nyid la sdug bsngal bskyed cing / pha rol po la'ang sdug bsngal bskyed pa yin/ der brten ma dul ba ni sdug bsngal yin zhes pa'i don de lta bu yin pa 'dra/ dul ma dul brtsi sa rang nyid la yin pas des na/ bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ zhes rang gi mgon rang nyid kyis bya dgos par gsungs pa ma garke(gas/ sems can gyi mgon sangs rgyas yin par gsungs pa med la/ dkon mchog yin par gsungs pa'ang med/ nga rang la mtshon na'ang / nga'i mgon nga rang yin/ rang gis hur thag byas na rang nyid skyid po 'byung ba dang / rang gis hur thag ma byas na rang nyid sdug po 'byung rgyu yin/ rang gis hur thag ji tsam byas kyang dkon mchog ma mnyes pa kho nas rang nyid skyid po miyong ba dang / ngas hur thag ma byas kyang dkon mchog dgyes pa 'ba' zhig gis nga rang skyid po 'byung ba de 'dra min/ de 'dra'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba'am rgyu 'bras rten 'byung gi gnas lugs de rnams dam ra wa'i lta ba 'dzin pa'i mi zhig la 'grel bshad legs po zhig byas na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dug red brjod mi shes/ de ltar brjod rgyu'i tshab la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba'i phyogs gcig dang / dmar po'i lta ba'i phyogs gcig mthun gyi 'dug ces brjod nyen yod/ mkhas pa 'ga' shas nas 'di ltar brjod mkhan 'dug maka se'i lta ba'i brjod tshul dang / nang pa'i lta ba'i brjod tshul phyogs 'ga' shas 'dra po yod/ dper na/ nga tshos mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ ces brjod pa'i mi rtag pa dang / bdag med pa sogs/ ma gzhi phra rags kyi khyad chen po yod shag kyang spyir btang 'ga' shas 'dra po yod tshod/239

'on te bed spyod byed stangs tha dad du phyin pa red ces brjod mkhan 'dugathog mar lta ba'i brjod tshul 'dra po zhig bshad nas/ gcig gis phyi ma phan chad kyi ched du byas pa red/ dmar po'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan chos phyi dngos po la phyag 'tshal ba las/ sems sam/ rnam rtog la phyag mi 'tshol bas/ dngos ga༅smra ba las/ sems gtso smra ba min par 'dod cing / dmar po kho rang chos shes kyi yod med ji ltar yang / nga tshos dngos gtso smra ba zhes pa'i don la bsam gzhigs byed skabs de'i don dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gtso bor smra ba zhig yin na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ni dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gtso bo smra ba zhig yin/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gatho rwa1ra smra ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ zhes gsungs pa yin/ nga'i bsam par/ dngos yong kyi gnas tshul mthar thug pa gtso bor smra mkhan ngo ma ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' 'di red bsam gyi 'dug rgyu mtshan dang gnas lugs de rnams la brten nas yang snying don dag ji 'dra zhig gi thog tu 'bab pa yin snyaman/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pas bcos pa min la/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'brangs tshos rang rang lto gos kyi ched du bzos pa'ang min par dngos yod kyi gnas tshul ngo sprod pa zhig yin/dngos yod kyi gnas tshul ji 'dra zhig yod pa de bzhin du bstan pa de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi rmang gzhi red/ der brten 'dzam gling 'dir chos lugs mang po yod pa 'dra 'dra'i nang nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i cho sa mi 'dra tsam zhig yod pa gsal po yin/ bod gangs can pa rnams skyes tsam nyid nas 24(3

nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dag snang dang / dga' po byed pa de ni dad pa dang / yid ches byed rin chog pa zhig red bsam gyi 'dug rang re chung ngu'i dus nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos spus dag po 'di 'dra zhig la dad pa bya rgyu'i go skabs byung ba 'di ni bsod nams chen po yin/ de ltar nga tshos byed pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di ni rgyu mtshan yod pa dang / dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang mthun pa'i spus dag po zhig yod pa so sos ma shes na sdug grong red ma gtogs/ shes na dngos gtso smra ba mthar thug pa de tsho dang mnyam du mjing pa bsgrengs nas sgrung rtsod byas chog pa zhig yod pas nga tsho blo bde po byas chog pa yin zhing / 'di la nor 'khrul byung mi 'dug bsam gyi 'dug rgyu mtshan de rnams la gzhi bzhag nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di tshad ma yin par legs po zhig sgrub ma thub pa dang / gzhi rtsa'i go ba legs po ma chags na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos ji 'dra zhig bshad kyang snying po med/de ni bye ma dang / 'khyags pa'i steng du khang pa brtsigs pa dang 'dra/ dper na/ da lta thob rgags bzang po med pa'i mi zhig nas nang pa'i ②ོsa la yid ches byas/ kha 'don dang / phyag 'tshal stor sbyong byed kyi yod kyang rjes su mi des bsam blo mang po zhig btang ba'i mthar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs dang / rgyu mtshan ngo ma de ma shes par/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / mdun du sku bsgrigs nas mchod 'bul byed pa la sogs pa de tsam zhig mthong nas yod pa'i skabs su nam zhig mi der/ de ni nor 'khrul red/ skye ba phyi ma med/tshe 'di kho na skyid po byung na de gas 'grigs pa yin/ de ltar yin pa deng dus 241

'dzam gling gi gnas lugs 'di ltar yin zhes gzhan zhig gis brjod pa na/khos da phan bsnyen pa dung phyur mang po song yod kyang nyi ma gcig la cam 'jog byed kyi red/ de ni kho la khag med/ khos gzhi gdan ma shes pas lan pa yin/de snga nga tsho bod kyi gnas stangs ni/ skal bzang lugs bzang zhes brjod rgyun yod pa de bzhin du bsdad pa red/ skal bzang lugs bzang du bsdad pa des phyogs gcig nas phan pa 'dra yod shas kyang / phyogs gcig nas drin chung du phyin yod/ skal bzang lugs bzang la bsdad pa des nga tsho bzang po g.yam rgyugs la phyin/ rtsig pa'i gzhi gdan legs po yod par gzhi bzhag ste hol rgyugs byas/ hol rgyugs byas pa'i rtags ji yod snyam na/ bod du yod dus cesas pa yin ma3rteg kha po zhig sku(da kyang / rgya gar ram/ rgya nag sogs la slebs dus chos pali rnam 'gyur rim bzhin yal nas 'gro ba de bzang po g.yam rgyu gas dang / hol rgyugs la phyin pa'i rtags bstan pa yin/ bod du yod dus bsam blo'i nang rtsig rmang brtan po zhig gding thub yod na/ mi yul du slebs nas rdul phran gyi rig gnas rnyed pa dang / zla ba'i khang bzang du bgrod pa/ deng dus 'dzam gling gi nang tshan rig gi gnas tshul mthar thug pa rnams ji tsam mthong thos byung ba'i tshod kyis bsam blo'i nang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la yid ches je brtan je brtan du 'gro ba las/ 'gyur ldog yong mi thub/rang re'i bla ma'am/ bslab rgan ji 'dra yin rung / bod du sgro zhag dod po de 'di phyogs slebs dus je sdug je sdug tu 'gro mkhan des kho la gzhi gdan gang yang med pa'i rtags bstan pa yin/ der brten rang res bod du bzang 242

'dzam gling gi gnas lugs 'di ltar yin zhes gzhan zhig gis brjod pa na/khos da phan bsnyen pa dung phyur mang po song yod kyang nyi ma gcig la cam 'jog byed kyi red/ de ni kho la khag med/ khos gzhi gdan ma shes pas lan pa yin/de snga nga tsho bod kyi gnas stangs ni/ skal bzang lugs bzang zhes brjod rgyun yod pa de bzhin du bsdad pa red/ skal bzang lugs bzang du bsdad pa des phyogs gcig nas phan pa 'dra yod shas kyang / phyogs gcig nas drin chung du phyin yod/ skal bzang lugs bzang la bsdad pa des nga tsho bzang po g.yam rgyugs la phyin/ rtsig pa'i gzhi gdan legs po yod par gzhi bzhag ste hol rgyugs byas/ hol rgyugs byas pa'i rtags ji yod snyam na/ bod du yod dus cesas pa yin ma3rteg kha po zhig sku(da kyang / rgya gar ram/ rgya nag sogs la slebs dus chos pali rnam 'gyur rim bzhin yal nas 'gro ba de bzang po g.yam rgyu gas dang / hol rgyugs la phyin pa'i rtags bstan pa yin/ bod du yod dus bsam blo'i nang rtsig rmang brtan po zhig gding thub yod na/ mi yul du slebs nas rdul phran gyi rig gnas rnyed pa dang / zla ba'i khang bzang du bgrod pa/ deng dus 'dzam gling gi nang tshan rig gi gnas tshul mthar thug pa rnams ji tsam mthong thos byung ba'i tshod kyis bsam blo'i nang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la yid ches je brtan je brtan du 'gro ba las/ 'gyur ldog yong mi thub/rang re'i bla ma'am/ bslab rgan ji 'dra yin rung / bod du sgro zhag dod po de 'di phyogs slebs dus je sdug je sdug tu 'gro mkhan des kho la gzhi gdan gang yang med pa'i rtags bstan pa yin/ der brten rang res bod du bzang 242

po g.yam rgyugs la phyin pa des drin chung byas 'dug gam/ hob ste bltas na/bla mar dad pa che mdog kha po/ bla ma tshos kyang gsung chos skabs nyams len byed stangs spyir btang tsam las/ skye ba snga phyi sgrub stangs dang / rtsa ba'i gzhi gdan gyi thog la shugs chen po ma gsungs par/ tshang ma nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin pa gzhi bzhag gis 'khrid pa des da cha 'phung yong gi 'dug 'on kyang sngon chad kyi gnas lugs tshar zin pa red/ da cha ji ltar bya dgos snyam na/ chos la yid ches skyes zin pa'i 'ogatu chos bshad 'khrid byed pa las sla po yin/nga tsho'i dam pa gong ma tshos gsung rab pu ti brgya phrag stong phrag mang po mdzad yod pas de dag la kha ston rgyag dgos pa gang yang med/ 'o na gang dgos zer na/ gzhi gdan rtsig rmang yag po gding dgos pa gal chen po 'dug nga tshor gzhi gdanartsig rmang gding rgyu med pa min yang / gzhi gdan gzhing ba la rigs pa'i lam dang / mthong chos kyi rgyu mtshan la brten nas 'gro dgos pa ma gtogs/ sangs rgyas kyis 'di ltar gsungs 'dug ces lung bgrangs pa tsam gyis mi 'grigs/ mgon po klu sgrub dang / rje rin po che/ mkhas mchog klong chen pa sogs su 'dra zhig gis gsungs 'dug brjod kyang phan mi thogs pas/ rigs pa dang rgyu mtshan gyi lam nas 'gro dgos/ sngar bod du bzang po g.yam la rgyugs pa'i skabs su skye ba snga phyi sgrub kyin bsdad na/ dgos nges kyi chos thad gar mi shod par 'di 'dra'i ka kor bshad de 'di na mu stegs pa ni med ces zer nyen yod kyang / rje rin po ches/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mu stegs pa yod rung med rung / nga tsho'i rgyud la mu stegs pa'i bas ma 243

blo nang bzhin gyi lta ngan kun btags med kyang / lhan skyes kyi bag chags shig yod pas/ 'di shes rgyu gal chen po red ces rnam 'grel la bsngags brjod mang po gnang 'dug der brten da ring 'dir yod mkhas pa khyed rnam pa brgyud mkhas pa gzhan dag snurar phran nas gzhen bskul zhu rgyur/ rang re'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la 'jug par go rim gnyis su phye nas/ dang por chos la yid mi ches pa de yid ches pa bzo rgyu dang / gnyis par chos la yid ches pa'i 'og tu nyams su len pa'i gnas lugs rnams ston rgyu/ nam zhig nang chos la yid ches zin pa'i rjes su nyams len byed stangs kyi skor la nga tshos dka' las rgyag dgos pa dang / de skor klad pa yung 'bru tsam dkrug dgos pa med/ dam pa rnams kyis mdzad zin pa spus dag la ldeng nges yod/ mi ldeng pa ji yin snyam na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la yid ches med pa'i mi zhig yid ches par 'gyur thabs su/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul mthar phyin pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chodzis nas bshad sku da pa de rnams 'grel bshad rgyag dgos/ de skor bstan bcos rtsom dgos sar bstan bcos brtsams/ 'grel bshad rgyag dgos sar 'grel bshad brgyab/ skad cha shod dgos sar skad cha bshad de 'di skor nan tan bya rgyu gal chen po 'dugang mos skye ba snga phyir bsam blo gtong rgyu gnad chen po yod/ gal te skye ba snga phyi med na ni shin tu las sla po yin/ skye ba snga phyi med na chos zhes pa dgos pa med/ gang yin zer na/ tshe 'di kho na'i bsam blo btang na chos med na skyid pa yin/ dper na/ spyir rmi lam rdzun pa yin pa shes bzhin du 244

blo nang bzhin gyi lta ngan kun btags med kyang / lhan skyes kyi bag chags shig yod pas/ 'di shes rgyu gal chen po red ces rnam 'grel la bsngags brjod mang po gnang 'dug der brten da ring 'dir yod mkhas pa khyed rnam pa brgyud mkhas pa gzhan dag snurar phran nas gzhen bskul zhu rgyur/ rang re'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la 'jug par go rim gnyis su phye nas/ dang por chos la yid mi ches pa de yid ches pa bzo rgyu dang / gnyis par chos la yid ches pa'i 'og tu nyams su len pa'i gnas lugs rnams ston rgyu/ nam zhig nang chos la yid ches zin pa'i rjes su nyams len byed stangs kyi skor la nga tshos dka' las rgyag dgos pa dang / de skor klad pa yung 'bru tsam dkrug dgos pa med/ dam pa rnams kyis mdzad zin pa spus dag la ldeng nges yod/ mi ldeng pa ji yin snyam na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la yid ches med pa'i mi zhig yid ches par 'gyur thabs su/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul mthar phyin pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chodzis nas bshad sku da pa de rnams 'grel bshad rgyag dgos/ de skor bstan bcos rtsom dgos sar bstan bcos brtsams/ 'grel bshad rgyag dgos sar 'grel bshad brgyab/ skad cha shod dgos sar skad cha bshad de 'di skor nan tan bya rgyu gal chen po 'dugang mos skye ba snga phyir bsam blo gtong rgyu gnad chen po yod/ gal te skye ba snga phyi med na ni shin tu las sla po yin/ skye ba snga phyi med na chos zhes pa dgos pa med/ gang yin zer na/ tshe 'di kho na'i bsam blo btang na chos med na skyid pa yin/ dper na/ spyir rmi lam rdzun pa yin pa shes bzhin du 244

rmi lam ngan pa de'i 'phen shugs kyis nyin mo sems ma skyid pa 'byung ba dang /rmi lam bzang po zhig rmis na de rdzun pa yin rung gnyid sad dus dga' lhang lhang 'byung ba yin/ skye ba snga phyi med na/ sangs rgyas dang / chos/ dge 'dun med la/ nang pa'i chos rtsa ba nas rdzun du 'gyur ba dang / rdzun yin pa'i chos shig ma byas na legs/ gal te chos de byas na bsam blo'i nang skye ba snga phyi dang / las rgyu 'bras/ ngan song sogs mang po zhig dran pa des/ 'di byas na.e 'grigs/ 'di byas kyangarme 'grigs snyams pa'i bsam blor rnam rtog mang po shar te mi skyid pa 'byung ba yin/ tshe phyi ma med na/ tshe 'di kho na'i bsam blo las gtong ma dgos stabs mthong ba rnams byas/ ma mthong ba rnams bzhag na las sla shos dang / skyid shosayin/ de ltar chos la yid ches mkhan dang / mi ches mkhan gyi bsam blo bsdur na/ chos la yid mi ches mkhan gyi bsam blo 'khos snyoms pa yod shas che yang / de 'dra min pa skye ba snga phyi yod pa dang / yod pas ma tshad skye ba la mtha' med/ skye ba snga phyi yod phyin de dag la bsam na/ skye ba 'di ji tsam ring yang lo brgya skor lhag khag po yin/ ches mtho na nyis brgya thub 'gro/ tshe 'dir dka' ngal ji 'dra zhig yod kyang nga tshos mthong thub pa zhig yin/ tshe phyi ma yod ni yod/ de'i bde sdug la bsam blo btang na/ da lta'i mi tshe 'di'i skyid sdug gis ldeng thub pa med la/ 'dis thabs shes sprod thub pa med stabs chos zhes pa gal chen por gyur lugs de ltar yin/ rang cag rnams la lus sems gnyis re yod/ lus la rgyusku1da pa bzhin 245

du sems la yang rgyu yod dgos/ sems la rgyu yod pa tsam la yang ha las rgyu ci med par/ dper na/ phyi'i 'byung ba bzhi la sogs pa las sems skyes pa yong srid snyam na de 'dra yang min/ sems kyi rgyu la sems kyi rigs mthun gyi rgyu zhig yod dgos pa sogs tshad ma rnam 'grel la sogs pa'i dpe cha'i nang mang po bshad yod pa ltar des na sems la thog ma med pa rigs pas sgrub thub pa yin zhing / de nas de ltar sems kyi rgyun yod pa dang / skye ba snga phyi yod na/ sems ma dul ba dul ba bzo rgyu yod dam med/ sems gtsang ma bzo thub dang mi thub zer na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs nas sems gtsang ma bzo thub par 'dod/ phyi rol pa hin rdu'i grub mtha' 'ga' shas nas sems gtsang ma bzo mi thub ces brjod mkhan yang yod/ sems gtsang ma bzo thub kyi yod pa de gzhi la bzhag nas thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa de 'grub cing / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa yod tsa na/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog byung ba yin/ gnas tshul de dag la brten nas rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di ha cang spus dag po dang / rlabs chen yin pas tshang mas blo bde po'i thog nas nyams su len rgyu gal chen po yin/ nyams su len lugs ji ltar yin snyam na/ ngas gong du brjod pa ltar/ sngar phan rang re'i gnas stangs ltar bzang po g.yam rgyugs byas na nor 'khrul yin/ chos pa zhig byed na/ chos pa legs po zhig chos pa ming don mtshungs pa/ chos pa mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug rang re rab tu byung ba zhig yin na ni/ rab 246

byung pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rjes su zhugs pa tsam du ma zad/ ston pa bka' drin can sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam pa can kho rang gis mdzad pa'i kun spyod kyi rjes su zhugs te skra bcad lus bsgyur ba sogs byas nas sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khesar nang ma'i gral la tshud pa yin pas rab tu byung ba tshos nges par de la dpag pa'i kun spyod bzang po zhig ci nas dgos pa ma gtogs/ dkyil 'khor nang ma'i gral la tshud pa des rang gi to gos bzang du phyin na snyam pa la sogs pa'i dmigs yul bzung ste spyod pa tha chad du song na shin tu nor 'khrul yin/ gra pa zer ba las sla po min/ gra pa ni gal chen 1rdzo dang / 'gan chen po yin/ nga chos rab byung yin pa chos hur thag byed gal chen po yin la/ rab tu 'byung rgyu tshos kyang bsam blo tan tan gtong dgos/ gra pa byed rgyu rang dbang yin pa las btsan dbang byed mkhan su yang med pas/ dang po nas bsam blo tan tan btang ste nam zhig gra pa byas zin pa'i 'og tu spus dag po bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ de snga'i bod kyi gnas tshul ltar thog mar 'dra chags po zhig la rjes su sdug tu sdug tu phyin na yag po mi 'dug der brten sangs rgyas kyi rjes su zhugs pa'i ser mo ba tshos ming don mtshungs pa'i spus dag po zhig cis kyang bya dgos/ de bzhin skya bo tshor mtshon na yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rjes su zhugs min dang / nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud min ni skyabs 'gro yod med kyis 'byed pa ma gtogs/ lha khang du phyin pa tsam dang / thal mo sbyar ba/ phreng ba thogs pa tsam gyis nang par tshud pa min/ thal sbyor dang phreng ba 'dzin rgyu spre'ur bslabs na yang shes/ chos 247

zhes pa bsam blo'i nang yod dgos pa las/ chos gos kyi logs su chos med stabs bsam blo'i nang chos kyi tshad longs na ni chos pa yin la/ bsam blo'i nang chos kyi tshad ma mtha' zhig ma longs na chos pa min/ der brten nang par tshud mi tshud ngo ma skyabs 'gro yod med la thug skyabs su 'gro ba la/ skyabs yul sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog /ces gsum yod pa de rnams ngo shes pa'i thog nas skyabs 'gro byed dgos/ re zung la dmigs bsal yod na ma gtogs/ spyir btang tshang mas dkon mchog ngo ma shes na skyabs 'gro bya rgyu khag po red/ dkon mchog ngo shes dgos na/ dkon mchog gi gnas lugs ji 'dra zhig yin pa legs par shes pa'i thog nas skyabs su 'gro dgos/ dkon mchog ngo shes nas skyabs 'gro byed mkhan des chos dkon mchog layid ches byed cing / chos dkon mchog skyabs dngos yin pa yang shes thub/ de shes na las rgyu 'bras la rtsa ba chen por shugs ma thub kyis 'dzin gyi red/ da lta nga rang sto lta bu kha nas dkon mchog dkon mchog ces brjod kyiyod kyang / las 'bras la lag len legs po rang 'gel thub kyi med pa de gting nas dkon mchog la yid ches po rang med pa'i rtags yin/ dkon mchog ngo shes shing / gting nas yid ches yod na las 'bras lag len ma bstar thabs med yin/ nyi ma sdu rwa1 byung ba'i tshe dang / rang gi grod pa la thug dus dkon mchog mar drangs/ de min spyir btang gnas tshul gzhan dang 'phrad dus las 'bras lag len ji bzhin mi bstar ba de dkon mchog brjed 'gro giyod pa'i rtags yin/ de ni dkon 248

mchog 'phyar ngom byed pa tsam las/ bsam khra'i nang dkon mchog gam/ chos ngos zin po med pa'i rtags bstan pa yin/ der brten jo bo bka' gdams pa tshos/ skyabs 'gro dang / las 'bras gal chen poyin lugs nan tan gsungs yod la/ yinayang thag chod red/ lcags khab len gyis lcags rigs bzung zhing / rtsa nyig sogs dor ba ltar/ skyabs 'gro las 'bras kyi gnas lugs 'di dang bstun na nang pa yin min gyi rnam dbye ngang gis 'byed pa yin te/ nang pa yin pa rnams de'i nang hril gyis tshud pa dang / nang pa min na phyi logs su 7rgyal ba rin po che yin yang phan pa med/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i shes rgyud dang / skyabs 'gro las 'bras kha bral du phyin 'dug na 7rgyal ba rin po che nang pa ma yin/ de ltar nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud mi tshud ni skyabs 'gro las 'bras yod med kyis byed pas 'di gal chen po yod/ de lta na/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog bcas dkon mchog gsum ngo shes pa'i thog nas skyabs 'gro bya dgos/ sangs rgyas ni skyabs ston pa po las skyabs dngos min/ ngas gong du brjod pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi las 'gan ni/ blang dor gyi gnad ston rgyu de yin/ bden pa 'di yin/ rdzun pa 'di yin/ blo dul na bde ba dang / ma dul na sdug bsngal 'byung / rang gis legs po byas na rang nyid bde ba 'byung ba dang / rang gis legs po ma byas na rang la bde ba 'byung mi thub ces lam bstan pa yin/sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa'i lam de'i thog nga rang tshos phyin/ rang gi mgon rang nyid yin pa shes pa'i thog nas rang gis ya rabs byas/ hur thag byas/ —249

rang nyid da lta ma dul ba de dul ba'i ched du 'bad brtson byas te bsam blo'i nang blo dge ba legs po zhig skyes pa na/ chos dkon mchog gi skya rengs shar yong ba yin zhing / de dus chos kyi 'go tshugs pa yin/ rang rgyud la yod pa'i dge ba'i spas tshad je mtho je mthor phyin te nam zhig chos dkon mchog ngo ma zhig tu 'char ba dang / de dus rang nyid dge 'dun dkon mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ rang nyid dge 'dun dkon mchog tu gyur pa'i tshad da dung je mtho je mthor phyin te/ nam zhig skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun ldan du gyur pa na/ rang nyid sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu 'gyur thub pa yin/ de ltar rang nyid sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu dngos su 'gyur rgyu rtsa ba chen por 'dzin dgos pa ma gtogs/ dus rtag tu mdun na sangs rgyas kyi sku zhig bzhag ste de la gsol ba 'debs pa kho na bya rgyu ma yin/ de ltar sangs rgyas skyabs ston pa po tsam dang / chos skyabs dngos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis chos nyams su ma blangs na rang cag sdug bsngal las grol mi thub/ der brten rnam kun skad cha yong mus ltar/ rang re bod spyi don yin yang rung / sger so so'i don yin yang rung / de'i tshod du zhabs brtan sgrub pa de ni tshogs gsog pa'i ched du yin/ tshogs gsog la rang gis bsam blo gtong ba de rlabs che bayin/ tshogs gzhan dag la gsog tu bcug bde skyid rang la yong rgyu'i re ba byas na de 'dra yong mi thub/ rang res bod du zhabs brtan sgrub/ brgya mchod dang / stong mchod phul ba de la dpag tshod kyis dge mtshan yong rgyu yod kyang ha cang ha las rgyu med/ legs shos ni rang nyid so sos tshogs bsags/ so sos sgrib pa 250

sbyangs te/ rang nyid kyis chos bya rgyu de shin tu gal chen po yin/ dper na/bka' 'gyur pod brgya brgal ba 'di dag gi nang la gzhan zhig gis stong mchod 'bul rgyu dang / gzhan zhig gis zhabs brtan byed dgos pa'i skor tshig gcig kyang med/ de dag ni rang gi rgyud ma dul ba 'dul stangs skor gsungs pa sha stag yin/ gang zag 'ga' zhig dang / gnas tshul dmigs bsal can la phan thogs yong rgyu yod kyang / gtso che shos ni rang nyid so sos blang dor bya rgyu de dag gal che ba yin/ ga la srid rang gis ma byas rung / gzhan la re ltos byas pas 'grigs kyi yod na nga tshos dge 'dun tha malapa zhig la re ltos bya dgos med/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis zhabs brtan sgrub mi shes pa mi srid cing / khong tshos zhabs brtan bsgrubs nas nga tsho snga mo nas 'khor ba las grol tshod yin yang / khong tshos bsgrubs pas nga tshor phan gyi med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nga tsho da dung 'khor bar 'khyams te gnas dgos byung ba yin/slob pa dang mri slob pa'i lam la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po de dag gis 7zhabs brtan bsgrubs nas ma phan na/ rang re tha mal pa sku sku(na za thub tsam gyis zhabs brtan bsgrubs nas phan rgyu khag po yin pas/ gtso che shos ni/zhabs brtan sgrub pa dang / tshogs gsog ji ltar yin rung rang nyid so sos 'bad brtson bya rgyu shin tu gnad chen po yin/ rang cag bod mi re re'i rgyud la dge ba sna re skyes thub na/ de zhabs brtan yin la/ chogs gsog kyang yin/ des bod spyi don la'ang phan gyi red/ rgyu mtshan de ltar yin pas nga tsho tshang mas rang rang so sos sems khur 'bad brtson bya rgyu gal che ba yin/251

de ltar dkon mchog gsum ngo shes pa'i thog nas skyabs su song ba'i rjes la las 'bras lag len du 'grel dgos/ de ni mdor bsdu na mi dge bcu spong ba de yin/ de la mi dge bcu ni/ lus kyi sgo nas srog gcod dang /ma byin len/ log g.yem/ ngag gi sgo nas rdzun dang / phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ngag 'khyal/ yid kyi sgo nas brnab sems dang / gnod sems/ log lta ste de bcu yin pas de rnams kyi 'dor len bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ rgyun du gleng mol yong bzhin pa ltar/ nang pa zhig yin na/ mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims lag len 'gol dboges/ mi dge bcu 1steng gi tshul khrims lag len 'gel mi thub na nang pa min zhes bathedad na legs shos red/ nang pa yang yin la/mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims lag len yang ma bkal na zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan du 'gyur bas ma tshad/ gzhan gyi mig ltos la'ang gnod rkyen byed/ rang la'ang drin chung du 'gro gi red/ de ni shes bzhin khyad du gsod pa zhes pa de yin/ mi dge bcu ༄rtong gi tshul khrims srung ma thub mkhan cholas nang pa min zhes brjod na rdzun du mi 'gyur ba yin/ nang pa byed dgos zer mkhan su yang med/ nam zhig nang pa byas pa'i tshe nges par nang pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba dgos/mtshan nyid tshang ba ni las 'bras lag len byed pa de yin/ 'o na lag len de ga dus byed dgos snyam na/ da lta rang nas byas chog pa yin te/ dper na/ rang gi gral mtshes pas gos legs po zhig gyon pa mthong nas 'di legs pa la/ 'di bdag gir gyur cig snyam pa lta bu'i brnab sems shig skyes byung na skad cig de ma thag ngas brnab sems byed mi rung snyam du sems ma rung 252

ba de skye ma bcug par bkag na/ de ga chos lag len du bkal ba yin pa ma gtogs/ ngas bla ma'i sa nas chos go byung bas da nyams len byed du 'gro gi yin zhes dog khres shig 'khur nas phyin rung don dag gang yang med/ chos byed du ri'i logs su 'gro ma dgos/ gang zag 'ga' shas la gnas tshul dmigs bsal yin pa ma gtogs/ spyir btang de ltar min/ chos zhes pa ni da lta 'di gar sdod mus 'di ga rang nas byed thub/ de ni bsam blo'i gtong phyogs gcigayin pas da lta nyid nas 'phral ma 'phral thung gis lag len 'gel rgyu gal chen poyin / de ltar lag len bkal na chos byed mi thub pa nam yang min/ nga tshos da lta mi lus shig thob nas yod/ mi lus 'di yang spyir btang mi lus dang mi 'dra tsam zhigayin/ lus rten 'di'i steng nas chos bya rgyu yang da lta da lta lag len bkal nas ma 'gyangs pa bya gal chen po yin/ gang yin zer na/ rang rer 'chi ba yong rgyu gtan 'khel ba dang / 'chi ba nam yong cha ma mchis pa yin/ gong du lam rob brjod pa las/ sgrub byed zhib pa bkod med kyang / skye ba snga phyi yod thag chod yin pas/ 'chi ba byung ste skye ba phyi mar chas pa'i mtshams su/ spun nye 'khor yod kyang mi phan la/ bza' mi bu phrug yod kyang phan pa med/ rgyu dngos po yod kyang phan pa med do/ bod kyi bla ma tsho'i gsung rgyun du/ rgyal po rgyal gzhis bzhag nas 'gro/ sprang wa bor ka bzhag nas 'gro zhes gsungs pa ltar mi tshang che chung ji 'dra yin yang / shi ba'i dus su rang nyid gcig pur 'gro rgyu las spun bu phrug kyang 'khrid sa med/rgyu dngos po yod kyang 'khyer sa med/ dbul phongs sprang po zhig yin na 'ang /253

dbul phongs la dngos po nyung shas shig las med kyang de yang 'khyer sa med/rnam kun nga rang tsho tshang ma blo khog che mdog kha po yod kyang / 'chi ba thog tu babs pa'i skabs su de'i ngo gdong la bltas na/ ha cang khag po yin/ rnam kun chos la yid ma ches mkhan zhig yin kyang skabs der kho'i bsam blo'i nang chu 'khol ba lta bu zhig tan tan yod kyi red bsam gyi 'dug gang yin zer na/ rnam kun dza drag gi gnas tshul dang ma 'phrad pas gang drag ci drag la thug med/ dbugs 'byung rngub re zung gi dus yun las med pa'i dza drag gi mtshams su slebs dus tshod thigs rgyu khag po yin/ khos rnam kun skye ba snga phyi med ces brjod pa de/ skye ba snga phyi med pa mngon sum tshad mas nges nas de ltar bshad pa min zhing / khos skye ba phyi ma ma mthong bas de ltar brjod pa yin/ der brten kho'i blo ngor skye ba snga phyi med pa'i rgyu mtshan mthong ba'i sgo nas nges pa rnyed pa'i yid ches gtsang ma gang yang med/ khos ma shes pa las/ med pa'i rgyu mtshan mthong ba min/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul la brten nas dza drag gi mthar slebs dus bsam blo chu 'khol ba lta bu zhig 'khor rgyur thag chod pa yin/ skabs der bsam blo chu 'khol ba lta bu zhig 'khor rung dus stod rdzogs zin te phyis drags pas bya thabs gang yang med/ der brten da lta nas nga tshos bsam blo gtong rgyu de gal chen po red/ des na da nas brtsis pa'i lo brgya tshun la nga tsho tshang ma 'chi bar ni nges/ dper na/ 'dir lo gnyis son pa'i bu phrug cig yod na yang kho pa lo skyon son mtshams sdod rgyu khag po yin/ da lta 'dir chos shod mkhan 7rgyal ba rin po che dang / nyan mkhan khyod cag tshang 254

ma lo brgya song na phal cher rdzogs zin gyi red/ sa gnas 'di'i shing sdong rgan po rnams med par gyur/ shing sdong chung ngu rnams chen por gyur/ de dus mi chos sngar 'dir tā la'i bla ma zhes pa zhig bsdad pa red ces gleng rgyu tsam yong shas che/ da lta 'dir yod kyi mi rnams mtshan tho zhig bkod de bzhag na de dus rdzogs zin pa thag chod/ de ltar lo brgya tshun la nga tsho shi rgyu yin pa thag chod pa yin/ shi phan chad kyi gnas tshul la nga chos gdeng 'khel ba yod na/ chos 'chad nyan byed dgos med/ shi phan chad la gang 'dra zhig yong gi yod med gdeng 'khel gyi mi 'dug na chos bya rgyu gal gnad chen po yin/ de ltar lo brgya tshun la 'chi bar nges/ nam 'chi nges pa med pa yin te/ dper na/ da lta nga tsho'i bsam cho'i nang sang nyin yas byed/ mas byed bsam pa zhig yod kyang sang nyin sdod rgyur brgya cha brgya tham pa'i gdeng khela.e thub zer na/ da lta gzugs po bde po yin/ skyon gang yang med/ phal cher sang nyin sdod kyi red snyam pa'i rang gi re ba dang / tshod dpag byas pa tsam las/ gdeng 'khel rgyu khag po red/ rgyu mtshan de 'dra la brten nas chos sgrub pa de yang sang bya gnangs bya'i ngang du ma lus pa bya dgos gsungs pa yin/'di las 'phros te gnas tshul phran bu zhig brjod 'dod byung / spyir btang 'chi ba nam yong cha med yin pas/ nged rang slob dpon la cha bzhag na/ da ring chos shod kyi yod kyang / sang nyin 'chi ba yong min cha mi rtogs/'on kyang spyir btang mis tshod rtsis byed pa ltar ngas kyang tshod rtsis shig byas 255

pa yin na/ ngas 1/na ma nas bshad pa ltar/ 7rgyal mchog dge 'dun grub pa dgung lo brgyad cu gya grangs shig bzhugs yod pas de tsam zhig sdoda.e thub snyam pa'i smon lam 'debs kyi yod la/ 'phen pa yang gtong gi yod/ 'on kyang de ltar sdod thub dang mi thub ni gnas tshul tha dad yin/ ngas re ba byas tshad 'grub mi thub cing / 'phen pa btang tshad kyang 'grub mi thub/ de la phyi nang gi rten 'brel mang po zhig 'grigs dgos kyi red/ chos dang ma 'brel ba'i spyir btang gi gnas tshul nas bshad kyang rten 'brel 'grigs dgos/ lhag par chos dang 'brel ba'i gnas tshul nas bshad kyang rten 'brel mang po zhig 'grigs dgos/ ngas rten 'brel zer ba 'di thob go sa'i gsar mjal dang /chang bza' rgyag pa lta bu'i skabs kyi rten 'brel de min/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes pa 'di la brten nas 'di 'byung / 'di la brten nas 'di 'grub ces pa'i rten 'brel de la zer bayin/ de 'dra'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gnas tshul de bzang ngan gyi rgyu 'bras gang 'dra zhig la yang yong rgyu yin pas/ nged chor tshang mas gzab gzab byed rgyu de gal chen po yin/ ma gzhi nga'i mi tshe ji tsam sdod mi sdod kyis phan nus chen po gang yang med/ nga mi gcig yin cing / de yang thebs chag cig red/ ngas ma mdzad mdzad bshad pa min/nga las mkhas pa dang 'jon pa mang po yod/ 'on kyang da phan ngas rgyal ba rin po che'i ming 'khur te lam lta bu gcig tu zhugs nas yod/ khyed rang chos kyang phyed tsam rmongs dad dang / phyed tsam rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas yid ches byed pa 'di goms nas bsdad yod/ de ltar yid ches goms pa'i gnas tshul 256

pa yin na/ ngas 1/na ma nas bshad pa ltar/ 7rgyal mchog dge 'dun grub pa dgung lo brgyad cu gya grangs shig bzhugs yod pas de tsam zhig sdoda.e thub snyam pa'i smon lam 'debs kyi yod la/ 'phen pa yang gtong gi yod/ 'on kyang de ltar sdod thub dang mi thub ni gnas tshul tha dad yin/ ngas re ba byas tshad 'grub mi thub cing / 'phen pa btang tshad kyang 'grub mi thub/ de la phyi nang gi rten 'brel mang po zhig 'grigs dgos kyi red/ chos dang ma 'brel ba'i spyir btang gi gnas tshul nas bshad kyang rten 'brel 'grigs dgos/ lhag par chos dang 'brel ba'i gnas tshul nas bshad kyang rten 'brel mang po zhig 'grigs dgos/ ngas rten 'brel zer ba 'di thob go sa'i gsar mjal dang /chang bza' rgyag pa lta bu'i skabs kyi rten 'brel de min/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes pa 'di la brten nas 'di 'byung / 'di la brten nas 'di 'grub ces pa'i rten 'brel de la zer bayin/ de 'dra'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gnas tshul de bzang ngan gyi rgyu 'bras gang 'dra zhig la yang yong rgyu yin pas/ nged chor tshang mas gzab gzab byed rgyu de gal chen po yin/ ma gzhi nga'i mi tshe ji tsam sdod mi sdod kyis phan nus chen po gang yang med/ nga mi gcig yin cing / de yang thebs chag cig red/ ngas ma mdzad mdzad bshad pa min/nga las mkhas pa dang 'jon pa mang po yod/ 'on kyang da phan ngas rgyal ba rin po che'i ming 'khur te lam lta bu gcig tu zhugs nas yod/ khyed rang chos kyang phyed tsam rmongs dad dang / phyed tsam rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas yid ches byed pa 'di goms nas bsdad yod/ de ltar yid ches goms pa'i gnas tshul 256

des gcig byas na phan thogs phran bu 'dra yod shas che/ skad cha tshig don gcig bshad pa 'dra 'dra yin na yang ngas bshad pa dang / mi gzhan gyis bshad par phan slebs khyad par yong srid kyi red/ de ni nga pho rgod drags pas byung ba min yang / khyed rang chos yid ches yod pa'i rkyen gyis phan thogs byung ba yin/de ltar nga'i mi tshe 'dis bod spyi la phan thogs shig yod pa yin na/ ngas 'di ltar brjod pa 'os po rang mi 'dug kyang / nga che rung dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / chung rung dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yin pas de la 'phar chag byung dogs gang yang med/ ngas gang dran pa de bshad par 'gal ba mi 'dug ngas de snga nas dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i kha la dam phrug med brjod pa de da ring yang bskyar lab kyi yin/ lhag don da ring chos khri'i steng nas bshad pa yin pas/ nga'i bsam thor dge slong thebs chag cig yin bsam pa las/ 7rgyal ba rin 11 che yin bsam nas shod kyi med/ 11da snur nyan mkhan chos kyang dge slong zhig gis bshad song bsam pa byed dgos/ ngas gang dran pa de shod kyi yin/ de'i nang legs cha dang / nyes cha gnyis ka71nga srid/ khyed chos nyes cha rnams dor/ legs cha rnams blang dgos/ nga'i tshe 'di yang rten 'brel ltos grub cig yin pas de'i 'brel ba sde tshan gsum yong gi red snyam/gcig nga rang la 'brel ba yod/ gang yin zer na/ nga'i mi tshe 'di rang nyid gcig pu'i ched du min par mi rigs gcig dang 'brel ba yod pa lta bu yin/yang na gong gsal mi rigs gcig gi 'brel ba'am/ yang na/ chos kyi thog nas bla slob bam/ gdul bya lta bu'i 'brel ba zhig yod pa ma gtogs/ nga 257

gcig pu'i don min/ nga gcig pu'i don yin na/ nga'i bsod nams gcig pu dang / las gcig pu'i dbang gis 'phel 'grib 'gro gi red de/ de 'dra zhig min par/ nga tsho tshang ma dang 'brel ba yod pa yin stabs/ nga la da lta rang dbang med kyang phran bu khyad par yong res ngas 'phen pa ring po zhig btang na yang / tshang ma'i jog nas legs po zhig ma byung na 'gyur ba yong srid kyi red/ der brten skya ming lha mo don grub dang / chos ming bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zhes 'bod pa'i mi thebs chag cig yin yang / rang gi las dang smon lam dbang gis 7rgyale ba rin po che'i ming zhig jogs nas yod pas/ ngas ming don mtshungs pa zhig dang / gzhan dag ma byung rung bod mi tshor gang phan zhig ma byas na/ bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos 7rgyal ba rin po che byed rgyu'i mthun rkyen ma tshang ba red/ bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho rang ngos nas mthun rkyen ma tshang na rgyal ba rin po che'i gral du sdod mi thub/ de ni gnas tshul gzhan dag gi mthun rkyen ma tshang ba min yang / rang ngos nas ma 'jon pa yin pas/ de 'dra'i rkyen gyis kyang nga'i tshe la 'gyur ba yong srid kyi red/ der brten nga rang gi spyod pa'i ngos nas kyang nga'i tshe la 'brel ba yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug de sde tshan gcig yin/gnyis par/ nga tsho mi tshang gcig min zhing / bla brang gcig tsam yang ma yin par/ mi rigs gcig gi rtsa don yin/ mi rigs gcig gi don sgrub pa la thun mong ngam/ spyi tshogs kyi nus pa zhig dgos/ mi sgor so so'i nus pa rnams gcig tu bsdoms pa'i spyi gzhung zhig dgos pa de la nga tshos dga' 258

ldan pho brang zhes btags yod pa 'di ni 7gong sa lnga pa nas 'go tshugs pa yin/da lta dga' ldan pho brang de bod kyi yul du gnas ma thub kyang / 'dzam gling 'di'i steng bsdad yod/ dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab srid skyong stangs la 'gyur ba mang po 'gro dgos/ gang yin zer na/ dga' ldan pho brang pa thog ma tshugs pa'i skabs kyi 'dzam gling gnas tshul dang / da lta'i 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul bar la 'gyur ba dpag tu med pa phyin yod/ de dus rgya gar dang / rgya nagayu rob/ shar dkyil bcas kyi gnas stangs gzhan zhig tu bsdad yod pa de da cha bsgyur bcos mang po phyin yod kyang / bod la de dus kyi bod gzhung de rang bsgyur bcos ma phyin par bsdad cing / yul gzhan ga sa ga la gsar brje'i rba rlabs 'khrug pa'i skabs yin/ spyir btang gsar brje zer ba legs po yin/ dga' dzege bya cadas pa zhig yin kyang nang gses dbye ba 'byed thub pa dgos/ rgya mis ming btags pa'i gsar brje de dang / spyir btang gi gsar brje gnyis la khyad par yod/ dper na/ rgya gar gyi ga sar brje'i 'gro stangs gcig yod cing / rgya nag gi gsar brje'i 'gro stangs gcig yod/ pha ran sir byung ba'i gsar brje de nas dus rabs gsar pa'i 'go tshugs te de'i don tha dad cig yin pas/ 'ga' shas kyis ma shes par/ gsar brje'i ming bos ma thag tu gsar brje yin tshad ma 'grigs pa lta bu dang / yang 'ga' shas kyis gsar brje yin tshad legs po lta bur 'dzin kyang / gsar brje'i nang legs nyes gang yang sku(da pas nga tshos rnam dbye legs par phye nas lan 'debs bya dgos pa yin/ mdor na yul re re'i nang gi gsar brje la'ang rnam 'gyur 259

mi 'dra ba mang po yod/ 'on kyang spyir btang gsar brje zer ba dga' po bya 'os pa de ni dpyid kyi dpal yonye rgyas pa ltar 'dzam gling ga sa ga la 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa de ni rang bzhin gyi chos nyid red/ 'dzam gling 'dir yul so so dang / dus skabs so so'i gsar brje'i ngo bo mi 'dra ba yod na yang / spyir btang gsar brje la 'dzam gling gang sar dga' mos byed pa'i gnas tshul zhig yin bzhin du/ nga tsho lugs srol rnying pa'i jog 'gro gi yin zhes brjod mi srid la/ brjod kyang phan thogs med/ rgya dmar nas btsan rgyal ring lugs pas rang nyid shi sa'i sa dong 'bru ba red zer ba de lta bu chags kyi red/ 'dzam gling gang sar gsar brje'i me tog bzhad bzhin du nga chos rnying pa'i lam du 'gro gi yin zhes zer na/ de ni rang shi rgyag pa'i gnas tshul zhig red/ der brten nga tshos nges par gsar brje'i lam du 'gro dgos pa las/ rnying pa'i lam du 'gro mi srid la 'gro yang mi thub/ der brten dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chab srid skyong stangs la 'gyur ba yong gi red/ 'gyur ba de bod rgya che'i mi mang dang bstan pa la sha zhen byas/ deng dus kyi gnas tshul dang mthun pa byas nas 'gyur ba 'gro gi yod pa ma gtogs/ nga tshos sdug po byas nas 'gyur ba 'gro gi med pa'i gnas tshul de dbye ba phye dgos pa yin/ phyin chad bod nang 'gro stangs ni nga tshos ma 'ongs pa'i rtsa khrims shig bzos yod pa de gzhir bzhag gis 'gro gi red/ lar nas phyin chad bod kyi 'gro stangs gtso bo ni/ gzhis lus rgya che'i bod mi mang gis thag gcod byed pa ma gtogs/ byes 'byor bod mi stong phrag bdun cu lhag tsam gyis thag gcod byed mi thub la/ khong tshos kyang nges 260

par ya rabs drang bden gyis gsar brjer dga' mos byed kyi red snyam/ bod yongs rdzogs gcig tu sgril ba'i rgya che'i mi mang gi grangs 'bor 'bum bdun cu brgyad cu tsam yod pas de'i nang stong phrag bdun cu tsam gyis nus pa sgon mi thub/ de 'dra'i bod kyi gzhung de 'dzin skyong byed mkhan las byed pa mang po zhig dang 'brel nas yod pa las/ dam phrug gcig dang khang stong gcig la med/ gzhung de tos nas grub pa zhig yin gshis las byed sogs mang po zhig 'dus pa'i tshogs pa zhig la btags payin pas gzhung gi chab srid kyi 'phrin las pa'am/ las byed pa rnams gal chen po 'dug gal srid gzhung zhabs las byed pa rnams nas las don tshags su ma tshud pa dang / nga tsho'i bsam tshul ltar sgrub ma thub pa byung na/ ma shes pa dang / bsgrubs nas ma 'grub pa'i gnas tshul tha dad yin/ ma shes rmongs pas sgrib pa yong gi red de de la'ang khyad par zhig yod/ nga tsho skyes pa'i skabs nas shes pa zhig dang / skyes pa'i skabs nas rmongs pa med pa yong mi thub kyang / skyes dus nas rmongs pa mi shes pa yod pa de rim pas sel gyin sel gyin byas te mthar ma shes pa'i rmongs pa de sel dgos pa yin/ der brten ma shes rmongs pa sel thabs 'bad brtson mthar phyin pa byas rung / cis kyang thabs shes med par da dung ma shes rmongs pas bsgribs te nor 'khrul byung bayin na/ de ma shes rmongs sgrib dngos gnas yin yang / blo'i zhe phugs rang nas ma shes pa shes thabs dang / rmongs pa sel ba'i thabs shes 'bad brtson gang yang ma byas par khur med du bzhag ste/de'i 'bras bur ma shes/ rmongs bsgribs kyi nor 'khrul zhig byung na de'i gnas 261

tshul tha dad cig yin/ de ni brtag dpyad 'bad brtson dang / slob sbyong gang yang ma byas par nyid lug gis bsdad pa la brten nas byung ba zhig las/ 'bad brtson slob sbyong byas nas sel ma thub pa'i rmongs pa zhig ma yin/ gang ltar tshang mas ngo kog med par 'bad brtson rnam dag byas te spyi la gces pa'i las don sgrub dgos/ de nas dam tshig mthun po dgos/ des kyang mi 'grigs pas hur brtson yod dgos/ zon sha stag byas te 'ekhums nas bsdad na dam tshig mthun po yong yong pa red de/ nga chos rang skyon spangs te yar thon 'gro e thub lta ba'i hur brtson med na mi 'grigs/ dam tshig mthun la/ hur brtson ldan pa/ ngo lkog mtshungs pa byung na/ de mthun rkyen gnyis pa yin/yang de gnyis gcig pus kyang mi 'grigs/ las byed nang khongs dngos su ma zhugs pa'i rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi dam tshig mthun po bya rgyu de gal chen po mthong gi 'dug de yang mthun rkyen gcig yin gyi red/ da dung nyis zlos su bshad na/ spyir btang chos skad la dam tshig la rgya dang / phal skad la mthun sgril gong bu gcig gyur zer ba 'di gal chen po 'dug tshang mas kha nas dam tshig gzong kha chig sgril zhes shod kyi yod kyang / gtso bo lag len la de bzhin 'gro rgyu gal chen po yin/ kha nas bshad/ yi gor bris ji ltar byas kyang lag len la ma bkal na 'grigs kyi mi 'dug che sa mi rigs phan tshun dang / nged tsho mi rigs gcig la yang chol kha phan tshun zer ba/ lung tshan so so/ sde tshan so so sogs kyi dbye ba ma phye bar tshang ma bod rigs gcig gyur gyi bsam blo gtong rgyu 'di gal chen po 'dug chol kha gsum zhes tha snyad 262

byas pa'i sde tshan gsum po 'di chig sgril bya rgyu gal chen po yin pa tshang mas shes gsal yin yang / gsal skyor byas na/ da lta nga tsho btsan byol ba'i gnas skabs su gal chen po yin pas ma tshad/ phyin chad chos srid gnyis ldan gyi bod rang dbang byung ba'i skabs su yang ha cang gi gal chen po yin/ nga tsho chig sgril ma byung na/ nga tsho'i nus pa sil bur 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ deng dus 'dzam gling nang ko ris dang / rdzi nam lta bu lto byang dum bu gnyis dang / 'jar ma ni lta bu shar nub dum bu gnyis su gyur nas yod/ de'i lag rjes la yul de'i nang 'khon 'khrug sha stag ma gtogs gang yang med/ yul dum bu gnyis su gyur dus spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs mi 'dra ba dang / srid kyi 'gro stangs mi 'dra bar gyur/ zla bsgril rgyu'i bsam blo yod kyang spyi tshogs dang / srid kyi 'gro stangs tha dad yin dus gcig gi 'dod pa gcig la mi 'tshams par gyur/ 'jar ma ni la mtshon na/ shar ma dmar po'i lugs dang / nub ma rang dbang dmangs gatsho'i lugs srol 'dzin pa yin/ shar nub bsgril ba'i mtshams nub ma'i bsam par shar ma yang nub ma nang bzhin byung na bsam pa dang / shar ma'i bsam par nub ma yang shar ma nang bzhin byung na bsam gyi yod pa red/ bod la yang de 'dra'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul mi mthun pa dang / srid kyi lta ba mi mthun pa zhig chags na/ de'i grub 'bras la nang khul mi mthun pa dang / gsod res gtong rgyu zhig yong gi red/ dper na/ wi ti nam gyi nang la deng sang mi ga tshod shi gi 'dug gam/ sog po la mtshon na/phyi sog rang btsan byung / nang sog rang btsan ma thob par rgya nag gi 'og tu 263

tshud/ sog po phyi nang gnyis kyi bsam par sog po zla bsgril thub pa'i bsam blo yod pa red/ de ltar byung na sog po'i stobs shugs la phan gyi red de/ sngar gyi go skabs bzang po zhig chud zos su phyin pas da cha nang sog rgya mi'i gdug rtsub can gyi lag pa'i nang tshud stabs sgril thub pa khag po yin/ nang sog gi nang la sog po dang / rgya mi byas na rgya mi mang ba yod tshod 'dug de ltar nang sog gi nang sog rigs je nyung dang / rgya rigs je mang du 'gro gi yod stabs phyin chad re ba bral ba'i mtshams su slebs yod/ de bzhin du/ phyin chad bod rang btsan byung rung / bod nang khul du nang gses rang btsan gnyis sam/ gsum lta bu zhig byung ba yin na/ wi ti nam rdzo byang lta bu zhig yong rgyu'i rtags mtshan gsal po yod/ yang / bod kyi sa gnas gang 'tshams shig la rang btsan byung / gang 'tshams shig rgya khongs su tshud de gnas pa yin na/ phyi sog dang / nang sog 'dra ba zhig yong gi red/ phyi sog dang nang sog zer ba'i ming de yang rgya mis btags pa las/ sog pos btags pa ma yin/ de ni ming 'dogs lugs rang nas shin tu gsal po yod/ rgya nag phyogs la nye bar nang dang / gzhan der phyi zhes btags yod/ ming gnyis btags shing / dum bu gnyis su bgos pa'i mtha' ma'i 'bras bur rgya nag gis sog po yongs rdzogs bzung ma thub kyang / nang ma de bzung nas bsdad pa yin/ de bzhin bod la yang phyi nang gnyis su btags yod/ da lta'i char bod yongs rdzogs bzung yod kyang / nam zhig bod phyi nang yongs rdzogs lag tu zin ma thub par/ phyi sog ltar bod phyi ma rang btsan byung na/ bod nang 264

ma de da dung 'dzin rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi yod pa red/ de ltar gzhan dag la dpe bltas nas rang thog tu mtshon thub pa yin/ rgya mi'i rgya bskyed kyi bsam cho de gung bran tang gcig pya min/ rgya'i mi rigs rang gi bsam blor de 'dra zhig yod pa red/ de ngas rang dgar brjod pa min/ rgya nag gi rgyal rabs lo rgyus la brtag zhib lo mang byed mkhan gyi mkhas pa tshos rgya mi'i rang bzhin gyi bsam blor rgya skyed la dga' po yod lugs brjod kyi 'dug gnas tshul de 'drar brten bod gcig la bod phyi nang gnyis zhes pa'i ming 'dogs byed pa dang / yang / bod ces pa spyi'i ming yin pa la/ sgos ming du bzung nas bod dang / khams/ a mdo/ zhes dbye 'byed byas yod/ de deng sang rgya mis bed spyod shugs chen po byed bzhin pa yin/ rgya mis rang re gangs ljongs mdo stod smad phud pa'i bod sar shi'i tsang zhes 'bod/ khams la shi'i khang dang / a mdo la ching had ces ming tha dad btags/ dper na/ bgrod lam la yang / khams bod rlangs 'khor 'gro lam dang / mtsho bod rlangs 'khor 'gro lam zhes ming 'dogs byas yod/ mtsho sngon dang / bod dum bu gnyis su phye ste/ de'i lam la mtsho bod rlangs 'khor 'gro lam zhes btags/khams dang / bod gnyis su phye ste de'i lam la khams bod rlangs 'khor 'gro lam zhes ming 'dogs byas yod pa de dag la bsam blo mang po zhig gtong rgyu yod pa red/ rgya mis shi'i tsang zhes zer ba'i sa mtshams la yang skabs re chab mdo yang khams phyogs su ngos bzung ste rgya mda' nas/ yas mas dbye ba 'byed pa dang / de min 'bri chu phan tshun nas dbye 'byed byed kyi yod/ 'bri 265

chu phan dang dar mdo tshun gyi sa cha rnams kyang thog ma nas rgya mi'i khongs su bdag pa gang yang min rung / rgya mis btsan zos byas te lo mang ring bzung ba red/ a mdo khul la mtshon na yang / sngar chos rgyal tsho'i dus skabs bod khongs bston med yin pa/ mkhas grub rin po ches mdzad pa'i rje'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs nang du yang gsal po yod/ tshang mas shes gsal/rje rin po che'i sku dus su bod nang gi lung pa rnams dpung su bzang gi 'gran bsdur byed pa tsam las/ bod rgyal yongs kyi gnas tshul gleng 'phros gang yang med pas mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung sgros nang bod rgyal yongs kyi gnas tshul gleng smros yong dgos don med kyang / gnas tshul de drang po dang / bden pa zhig yin stabs rje rin po che'i 'khrungs yul stor gsung skabs sngar bod chos 7rgyal tsho'i chab 'bangs su gtogs pa zhes rje rin po che'i 'khrungs yul a mdo bod sde yin par bshad pa de drang bden gyi gnas lugs brjod pa zhig las/ skabs der rgya mi'i gleng rtsod dang / mkhas grub rin po cher srid don gyi 'dres lhad med pa gsal po yin/ srid don 'dres lhad gang yang med pa'i bla ma zhig gis de ltar gsungs yod pa sogs don snyings mdo yang rtsa ba'i bod 7rgyal khab chen po gcig dang kha bral thabs med pa'i dum bu zhig red ma gtogs/ a mdo dang / khams zhes pa bod dang tha dad rtsa ba nas min/ 'on kyang bsam blo'i nang bag chags zhig gnas te khams bod kyi dbye ba 'byed pa dang / lhag par 'bri chu phan tshun gyi dbye ba de bsam cho'i nang bsdad de 'ga' res nga tsho'i chos kyi gtugs sa lha sa yin kyang / srid kyi dpon po rgya mi yin 266

snyam du rgya sde bod sde zhes dbye 'byed byed pa'i bsam tshul mi 'dzin pa'i nges pa med pas/ tshang mas bsam khro zhib tu gtong rgyu gal chen po yin/ bsam blo'i nang bag chags ngan pa byung na de'i skabs zin nas dkrug shing gi thabs byus byas te bod rang btsan yong gi ma red zer ba dang / rang btsan byung rung bar skabs rgya sde'i khongs su tshud pa rnams rang btsan yong gi ma red ces brtsod srid kyi red/ de 'dra byung na/ 'ga' shas nas rgya mgo mtho na rgya dang / bod mgo mtho na bod mi lta bur bsam khra'i nang mi bde ba chags yong gi red/ deng sang bod kyi rtsa ba'i gnas tshul la 'dzam gli nga phyogs mang po nas do snang byed pa'i dus tshod yin/ dus tshod 'di'i skabs nga tshos shugs rgyag ma thub na/dper na/ dmag chen gnyis pa thag chod la nye ba'i mtshams chen po gsum gyi tshogs 'du tshogs pa'i skabs phyi sog skor gleng 'phros byung yod/ de dus sog po phyi nang bar 'brel ba dam po zhig byung ste sog po phyi nang bsgril rgyu'i nus pa chen po zhig 'don rgyu byung yod na/ skabs bzang po zhig yin stod red de da cha sog po phyi nang sgril 'dod yod kyang khag po chags yod/ de bzhin du nga tshos kyang da lta bod rang btsan brtson len byed pa'i dus skabs 'dir nus shugs gcig tu bsgril nas lam legs po zhig la 'gro thub na/ bod dngabod chen po gcig tu sgril ba'i rang btsan thob rgyu'i re ba yod/ gnas dus 'dir 'thus shor song ste 'bri chu phan tshun lta bu'i gnas tshul du song na/ bod phyi ma rang btsan thob rung / bod nang ma rnams rgya mi'i tshe g.yog tu tshud kyi red/da lta dus stod dang go skabs bzang po yod pa'i skabs su chud zos btang na/267

phyin chad re ba rgyag rgyu khag po yin pas da lta nas tshang mas bsam blo gtong rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ nga tshor dka' ngal yong gi red de zhum pa spangs/snying stobs ma chung ba'i thog dmigs yul gsal por bzung nas shugs rgyag ma thub na nyen kha yod/ gong bshad de 'dra'i srid don gyi dbye 'byed byed pa de dam tshig mi mthun pa'i gtso rkyen sdug shos shig red/ kha nas chol gsum dam tshig chig sgril zhes ji ltar bshad rung ma bshad rung / bsam cho'i nang rin gong yang tig sgrig rgyu lta bu zhig lhags na skyon chen po red/ da phan lo drug ring yar rgyas gang 'tshams phyin yod kyang / da dung bag chags ngan pa'i rjes shul lhag ste 'gal rkyen yong gi 'dug da dung gsal por shes dgos pa zhig la deng sang rgya nag la gzhung gnyis chags yod/ skam sa chen po dbang sgyur byed mkhan pe cing gzhung des dmar po'i lugs srol 'dzin pa dang / tha'i rten gzhung des rang dbang mang gtso'i lugs srol 'dzin bzhin yod/ de gnyis rtsa ba'i lugs srol tha dad yin/ bod la mtshon na yang / sa mtshams kyi gnas tshul tsam ma gtogs/ go'oming tang dbus gzhung dang bod thad gar dmag 'thab byung med/ gung bran gyis thad kur btsan 'dzul thabs sdug po byas yod stabs de gnyis la khyad par chen po yod pas de 'dra'i gnas tshul thog nas bsam na tha'i yi gzhung de nga tsho'i grogs po red/ 'on kyang / go'o ming tang gi rtsa ba'i bod don thog srid byus 'dzin stangs de pe cin dang gcig pa yin pa las khyad par med/ bod rgya nag gi cha shas yin zhes brjod mus red/ srid byus de ni go'o ming tang gi sku tshab tshos mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs nang la'ang 268

gsal por bstan yod/ skam sa chen po bcings bkrol zin pa'i 'og tu gzhi nas bod la rang thag rang gcod kyi go skabs sprod kyi yin zhes pa'i srid byus de dag kyang mi bde ba zhig red/ gzhan dag phar bzhag phyi rgyal du yod pa'i rgya mi'i slob phrug zhig gi bsam blor yang bod rgya nag gi cha shas yin zer ba de shugs rgyag bzhin pa red/ nye char sa ra na thar 'dzam gling nang pa'i chos tshogs su bskyod skabs tha'i wan nas yong ba'i chos tshogs kyi 'thus mi 'ga' shas 'dug pa khong tshos nged rang 'phrad 'dod byed pa ltar thug 'phrad byung zhing /'phros mol skabs 'dir phebs khyed tsho dang / nga tsho yul tha dad yin la/ mi rigs tha dad kyang yin/ 'on kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad pa yod pa gcig gyur yin pa dang / khyed tshos dad pa byas nas yong bar dga' po byung zhes gsal por bshad pa yin/ khong tshos tha'i wan yar rgyas phyin pa'i skor deb gcig sprad byung ba skabs der brel bas lta khoms ma byung / 'dir 'byor nas lta dus de'i nang bod rgya nag gi cha shas yin tshul shugs chen po bris 'dugatha'i wan nas rnam dpyod gtong rgyu yod na skam sa chen po'i nang btang na shin tu 'os 'tshams red de/ de la 'a 'ub mi 'dus par sdod bzhin bod phyogs la khungs med kyi spobs pa 'dzin gyi 'dug khungs 'brel gyi spobs pa gal chen po yin kyang / khungs med kyi thobs pa byed pa nor 'khrul red/ kho tshos da dung bod zin 'dod kyi bsam blo gtong gi 'dug rtsa ba go'o ming tang gi srid gzhung de nga tsho'i grogs po red/ nga tsho'i dbar sngar dmag 'khrug zhe 'khon rigs med kyang / bod don gyi srid byus 'dzin stangs thad la nor 'khrul can 269

du lta rgyu red/ bod don gyi srid byus la pe cing dang / tha'i spa'i lta tshul gcig gyur red/ pe cing gzhung gis rgya nag nang mi mang spyi khang btsugs pa dang /mdun mchongs chen po rgyag pa sogs la nga tshos skyon brjod byed kyi med la byed pa'i 'os babs kyang med/ 'on kyang pe cing gis bod don srid byus der 'bu ches chung zos byas byung zhes skyon brjod byed mus yin/ bod don srid byus thog pe cing la nga tshos skyon 'dzugs byas pa de bzhin du go'o ming tang la'ang gcig pa byed dgos pa zhig red/ gang yin zer na/ tshur byed stangs la khyad par med stabs phar byed stangs la'ang khyad par yong mi shes/ rtsa ba tha'e bon de spre cing dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod pas de dag la brten nas rdzod yangs su 'gro ba yong srid/ de ni gnas tshul tha dad yin/ grogs po ni grogs po yin/ 'on kyang bsam blo gtan gtan zhig gtong dgos/ tshang mas shes gsal ltar 'dzam gling 'dir/ gcig la nyam thag po byung na/ gcig gis gcig la rogs byed rgyu ni spyir btang gi 'gro stangs shig yin la/ 'os pa yang yin/ 'on kyang rogs ram de dag 'gro ba mi'i brtse sems ngang nas byed dgos pa las/ ngan g.yo bslu brid kyi ched du byas na nor 'khrul red/gcig nas tshang mas shes gsal gyi skad char sbug sbug byed dgos don med cing / gnyis nas dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bshad par 'gal ba med/rgya gar nang 'dzam gling gang sa nas skyob gso yong gi yod pa dang / tha'i wan nas kyang yong gi yod pa red/ yin na'ang yong stangs mi 'dra ba zhig yong gi 'dug skyon zhig med na de ltar yong don med/ nga tshor rogs ram byed mkhan 270

tshang mas dbus skyob gso brgyud nas 'khon thogs med parayong bzhin pa zhig la/ tshang ma'i 'gro sar ma phyin par khug kyog cig nas yong ba de skyon zhig/ yod pa'i rtags red/ skyon med na rang gnong byas nas de ltar sbas dgos don med/ 'dzam gling tshogs pa khag dang / sger so so/ gzhung khag sogs rogs ram byed mkhan rnams la spyi pa'i lam zhig yod pa der btang na ma 'grigs pa gang yang med/ gnas lugs de tsho tshang mas gsal po shes na ma gtogs skyon yod/ mi 'u thug na dngul la dga' po byed kyi red de/ bod la chu log lta bu zhig byung nas nga tsho mi yul du gyar ba min/ nga tshor rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gnod pa byung nas btsan byol du gyar ba yin na/ sus rogs ram byas kyang blangs na 'grigs/ srid don gyi bsam blo gtong dgos pa med/ nga tsho srid don gyi gnas tshul la brten nas btsan byol bar gyar ba ma gtogs/nga tshor 'byung ba'i gnod pa byung ba min/ yang bod la to gos ma ldeng par gyar ba'ang min/ rgya mis srid don gyi btsan gnon byas pa ma bzod par btsan byol du gyar ba red/ phyogs gzhan nas brjod na/ gcig tu mi rigs kyi thob thang la btsan gnon byung ba ma 'dod pa yin la/ gnyis nas bod rang dbang rang btsan zhes pa de 'dod nas mi yul du slebs pa yin/ nga tsho rtsa ba'i yong stangs srid don gyi gnas tshul dang / rang dbang gi don la gzhan yul du gyar ba yin stabs srid don dang rang dbang gi don la do snang byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ de brjed du bcug na mi 'grigs/ nga tshos rgya mi gung bran gyis btsan gnon btang ba ma bzod par yong nas srid don rang dbang rang 271

btsan don gnyer byed bzhin du/ rgya mi gzhan dag gcig gis khyed rang tsho dngul 'di bzas nas rgya mi'i 'og tu bsdad na yag po red ces brjod byung na de la nyan 'jog byed rgyu'i bsam blo 'khor ba ha cang nor 'khrul zhig byas pa red/ gnas tshul de tsho gsal po shes dgos kyi 'dug ngas de sngon bshad pa ltar/ dngul gcig pu'i bsam blo btang na nga tsho gung bran 'og nas bros dgos don e yod/ rgya gung bran drin can pha ma red/ dngul rda yang char pa babs babs red/ ces zer ba ltar dngul rda yang gis 'grigs na gung bran pha ma chags yod/ 'on kyang pha ma rtsub drags nas nga tsho bros dgos byung ba red/ der brten dngul gcig pus mi 'grigs/ da cha nga tsho'i bod mi khri phrag 'bum phrag gis bod rang dbang don du srog blos btang dang gtong bzhin yod pa'i skabs nga tsho phyi rgyal du 'byor pa chos so so'i grod pa tsam gyi don du bod rang dbang gi gzi byin de nyams su bcug na shin tu nor 'khrul red/ thabs sdug po dang ngo tsha po red/ der brten gnas tshul de tsho dbye ba legs po 'byed rgyu gal chen po 'dug de tsho 'phros bshad yin/da cha nga tsho dam tshig rdog rtsa chig sgril byed dgos/ de tshor do snang byed dgos kyi med dam bsam gyi 'dug gang ltar de tsho shes pa byas te/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gi rjodad lam ga dus yin yang lag len du 'khel ba bya rgyu gal chen po red/ de ltar rgya che'i mang tshogs nas kyang dam tshig gong bu chig sgril byas te spyi'i gzhung lam du shar bgrod byed thub pa zhig dang / de bzhin las byed pa rnams nas kyang spyi don bsgrub bya gzi 'od dang ldan pa'i lam phyogs 272

'di'i thog dka' ngal dang / 'gal rkyen ji byung sel bzod thub pa/ rang ngos nas kyang bod rgya che'i mi mang dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan par phan thabs phran bu las ma byung rung 7rgyal ba rin po che'i ming don mtshungs pa'i hur thag byed thub pa bcas sde tshan gsum gyi thog nas rten 'brel legs po zhig 'dzoms thub pa byung na/ nga'i tshe la 'gal rkyen yong gi ma red snyam pa'i gdeng 'khel zhing / yid ches kyi 'dug 'di ltar tshang mas blor nges pa bya dgos/yang gnad 'gag chen po mi 'dug ste phran bu brjod na/ mi'i 'phen pa zhes pa 'di gnad chen po yin zhing / mi'i sems pham du mi 'jug pa de gal chen po yin/ mi'i sems pham na 'phen pa thung du 'gro ba'i nyen kha skudad/'phen pa thung du phyin na/ dper na/ nga the bas spyir mi su zhig yin rung so sor rang dbang med kyang 'phen pa'i shugs kyi khyad cig yod/ 'phen pa la phyogs gzhan nas bshad na sems shugs zer ba de yin/ mi rgas 11 'am/ nad par sman pa sogs kyis zhib 'jug skabs da lta rang 'chi rgyu las med zer mkhan kho ma shi bar yun ring du sdod mkhan yong gi 'dug pa dang / 'ga' shas na tsha chung ngu las med na'ang lam seng shi ba de tsho sems shugs che chung gi khyad yin/ sngon ma de'i bsam blor chags pa'am/ yang na khong khro drag pos bzung ste/ dper na/ dmag sar 'ga' shas rma rmas chen po byung ste brgyal 'gro 'os pa tsam yod kyang / kho da dung rang 'tsho bzung nas yong gi yod pa de tsho lus kyi gnas tshul 'or lhungs zin rung / sems kyi 'phen shugs ma chag pa'i dbang gis zin pa dang / da dung bzhad gad lta bur brjod na/ de 273

snga gung thang rin po che'i sku dus su dge bshes shi la khad cig zhag la chags nas dbugs gtan nas ma phyin par bsdad pa la/ gung thang rin po ches kho'i gnas tshul dang bstun te dga' ldan la zhag legs po yod ces gsungs ma thag kho rang shi ba'i lo rgyus shod srol yong / gang ltar skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i skyes bu dam pa smos ci dgos/ spyir btang rang re tha mal pa yin rung / nga sdod dgos/ nga'i mi tshe ldeng pa bya dgos snyam pa'i sems shugs sam/ 'phen pa yod na rten 'brel zhig 'grigs kyi yod pa red/ de ltar min par mi'i blo gcig pham/ gnyis pham nas da ni phan thogs gang yang mi 'dug bsam pa na/ khekhos gri me mdas rang shi rgyag pa min yang / sems shugs chag pa yin stabs nyen kha zhig yong gi yod tshod red/ nga tsho tshang mas hur thag byas na yag po min nam bsam gyi 'dugagang ltar de 'dra'i 'chi ba mi rtag pa la nga tshos yang tig ji tsam bsgrigs kyang lo brgyad cu dgu bcu lhag sdod thabs med/ de nas nga tsho tshang ma 'gro rgyu yin stabs chos byed pa gal che zhing / de yang sang bya gnangs byar ma lus pa zhig bya dgos/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du song ba'i thog mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims tsam zhig la mgo 'khor nas bsdad pas mi 'grigs/de ni 'phral sel gnas skabs kyi don tsam yin/ rtsa ba rang rgyud la yod pa'i sems ma dul ba'i skyon de rtsa med bzo ma thub na/ mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims lag len bkal ba des sdug bsngal che ba rnams gnas skabs bka' 'gyangs zhus pa lta bu las phugs phan mi thub/ dper na/ srog gcod dang /274

ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod spangs shing / sbyin pa btang ba lta bus phyi ma mi lus thob pa dang / tshe ring ba/ 'byor pa che ba lta bur gyur nas/ ngan song dang / tshe thung ba sogs bka' 'gyangs zhus kyang / yang bskyar mi tshe rjes ma de ji 'dra zhig tu 'gyur min rtogs mi thub/ mi tshe der da res bzhin mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims shig srung thub na lta legs kyang / de min phan pa dka'/ des na/ rang rgyud la yod pa'i sems ma dul ba de'i rtsa ba med pa bzo rgyu de gal chen po yin/ nam zhig de'i rtsab med pa bzo thub na/ de nas bzung ma dul ba gtan med du phyin te brtan po chags pa yin/ chu lta bur lo ltar rags gsos rgyag pa dang / chu rtsa rang nas bkag pa de gnyis kyi khyad par lta bu yin/ lo re'i rags gsos des lo re'i chu log kheg tsam 'byung yang / lo ltar rags gsos rgyag dgos pa dang / chu rtsa de med pa bzo ba la thog mar 'gro song che yang / de bkag pa'i rjes la lo ltar rags gsos rgyag mi dgos pa de bzhin du mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims kyang 'phral sel gnas skabs kyi don tsamayin/ gatho rwa1 rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs ma rig pa sogs med pa bzo dgos/ de tsho gnying ring po yin/ de med pa bzo ba la mi dge bcu sgong gi tshul khrims gzhi rtsar bzhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ shes rab kyi bslab pa ste bslab pa gsum la slob dgos/da dung tshad mtho po'i bsam blo btang na/ bslab gsum nyams su blangs te rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs gtan nas spangs pa zhig byung rung / des rang nyid gcig pu 'khor ba las thar tsam zhig las de lhag rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 275

mthar phyin pa byung med/ des na rang res de las lhag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa gal che/ de ltar na nga chos dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ de'i nang nas kyang theg pa chen po mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i bstan pa 'di 'dra zhig dang mjal/ theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa'i dus skabs 'dir phyi ma ngan song las grol te mngon mtho lha mi'i lus rten tsam thob na snyam pa dang / rang nyid gcig pu 'khor ba las thar na bsam pa de tsam ma yin par/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las sgrol bar bya/ de'i ched du ngas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa zhig ci nas byed dgos snyam pa'i kun slong bcos dgos shing / de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la'ang byams pa dang / snying rjes drangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che la so ci thebs shig byed pa'i thog nas theg pa chen po mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i lam la slob dgos/ de 'dra'i lam la slob pa la'ang mi tshes ldang dgos pas de'i ched du tshe dbang thab mo 'di zhu snyam pa'i kun slong kun spyod kyi rim pa legs par gsal btab ste gsan dgos/ zhes sogs bka' stsal rjes sgrol dkar gyi tshe dbang dang / gzungs sngags yig drug gi ljags lung bka' drin stsal// //276

mthar phyin pa byung med/ des na rang res de las lhag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa gal che/ de ltar na nga chos dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ de'i nang nas kyang theg pa chen po mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i bstan pa 'di 'dra zhig dang mjal/ theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa'i dus skabs 'dir phyi ma ngan song las grol te mngon mtho lha mi'i lus rten tsam thob na snyam pa dang / rang nyid gcig pu 'khor ba las thar na bsam pa de tsam ma yin par/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las sgrol bar bya/ de'i ched du ngas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa zhig ci nas byed dgos snyam pa'i kun slong bcos dgos shing / de 'dra'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la'ang byams pa dang / snying rjes drangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che la so ci thebs shig byed pa'i thog nas theg pa chen po mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i lam la slob dgos/ de 'dra'i lam la slob pa la'ang mi tshes ldang dgos pas de'i ched du tshe dbang thab mo 'di zhu snyam pa'i kun slong kun spyod kyi rim pa legs par gsal btab ste gsan dgos/ zhes sogs bka' stsal rjes sgrol dkar gyi tshe dbang dang / gzungs sngags yig drug gi ljags lung bka' drin stsal// //276

ra༅༅// spyi lo 1965 zla 4 tshes 11 snga dro'i chu tshod 9 thog nye dus sku phywa'i skor bod mi sdod sgar khag gi 'thus mi ser skya pho mo mi grangs 175bcar 'dzoms rnams rang khungs so sor thon mjal skabs bka' slob stsal ba bar lam sku phywa'i skor la rgya gar nang khul bod miyod sa'i sa gnas phal cher nas 'thus mi khag dwang blang gis 'dzoms/ nyin shas ring phar tshur gros mol go bsdur byas/ yig cha 'dra bzo bkod byas yod pa de dag gis nga tsho'i mthun sgril dang / spyi'i gzhung lam la shar bskyod bya rgyu'i las don thog shugs ston thebs te don phan yong rgyu'i re ba yod/da res khyed rang tsho 'dir 'dzoms/ 7rgyal ba rin po che mjal byung zer rgyu yod tsam zhig la phan thogs de tsam med/ der brten/gnas lugs phran bu bshad res btang na dge mtshan che/ da lta'i dus skabs 'dir nga tsho'i mi rigs dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don dag chen cade nag sgrub pa'i skabs yin/ nga tsho'i mi rigs/ chos dang shes rig bcas pa rtsa brlag tu 'gro ba dang / de gzhi nas phra tshugs thub pa ji yong gi sa mtshams lta bur slebs yod pa'i las don shin tu chen po de 'dra zhig sgrub pa la/ 'go 'khrid byed mkhan nged rang dang / de bzhin las byed pa bcas nas 'char 'god 'bad rtsol ji ltar byas kyang / rgya che'i mi mang nas gcig rgyab gcig gnon gyi rgyab skyor nus pa thon pa zhig ma byung na mi 'grigs/ dper na/ dha ram sa lar 'go khrid kyi las khungs yod pa de'i bsam tshul rnams sa gnas gzhan khag la yod 277

pa'i rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams kyis nges par du gsal por shes dgos pa dang /shes pa'i jog nas gcig rgyab gcig gnon byung na nus pa chen po thon thub pa yin/ bod kyi gtam dper/ mgo mjing bral thabs med zer ba ltar/ 'go 'khrid pa dang mang tshogs kyi nus pa nam yang mi 'bral ba bya dgos/sa gnas khag mang gi 'thus mi mang spro zhig da ring 'dir ma bskul dwang blang gis 'dzoms pa'i skabs 'dir / nga tsho'i 'phral phugs kyi bsam blo gtong stangs dang / byed sgo rnams rags rim zhig brjod de khyed rang tshos nga tsho'i 'phral phugs kyi bsam blo dang / 'gro stangs 'di 'dra zhig yin pa 'dra snyam du gnas lugs de dag shes rtogs byung na khyed rang sa gnas so so'i 'go khrid pa tsho'i bsam blo'i nang shes tshad ji tsam mtho ba de tsam gyis de la de brten gyi mang tshogs la slob ston dang / skul slong bya rgyur phan nus che ba yong rgyu yin stabs da ring gnas lugs phran bu brjod na bsam pa byung /da dung 'brel brjod gzhan zhig byas na/ nga tsho ni dge mtshan dang gzi brjid chen po yod pa'i mang gtso'i lam du bskyod bzhin pa yin/ lam der 'gro ba la mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i nang 'phral phyags kyi 'gro stangs rnams shes rtogs thub pa bya rgyu gal che ba las/ mi 'ga' shas shig nas mang chogs rnams dud 'gro khyu 'ded lta bu bya thabs med/ mang tshogs la legs nyes rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi shes tshad ldeng pa zhig nges par du dgos/ gnyis nas/ 'go khrid pas las don sgrub pa'i tshe de'i dge skyon rnams mang tshogs la gsal bshad byas te mang tshogs nas gnas lugs shes su bcug de nas 278

zhen skul gyis sgrub dgo1/ pa las/ mang tshogs nas gnas lugs gang yang ma shes par 'go khrid pas skul 'ded byas pa kho nas 'grub pa dka'/ dus tshod rnying pa'i skabs su 'dzam gling gang sar 'gro lugs de ltar yin kyang / deng dus bsgyur bcos 'gro ba'i skabs yin pa dang / lhag par ma 'ongs par nga tsho gnas tshul gzhan dag zhig gi jog 'gro dgos pas na/ 'go khrid pas bya ba gang 'dra zhig brtsams rung / de'i bsam tshul 'di yin/ dgos pa 'di dang / dge mtshan 'di yod ces mang tshogs la gnas lugs bshad/ mang tshogs kyis de mgo 'tshos/ bsam blor go ba chags/ bsam blo'i nang nas zhen skul thebs pa zhig byung mtshams las don ji 'dra zhig sgrub kyang tshags su tshud pa dang / dmigs sar 'khyol bayong thub pa yin/ der brten 'go khrid pas mang tshogs la gnas lugs bshad/ mang tshogs nas kyang gnas lugs shes pa'i thog nas gcig gyur du 'gro thub pa bya dgos pa las 'go khrid pa'i bsam tshul dang / mang tshogs thag ring po byas na mi 'grigs/ de snga 7skyabs mgon sbug ces brjod pa ltar sbug tu bsdad pa red/ rgya che'i mang tshogs snyom chung rnams dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la 'tsho ba gang 'dra zhig skyel gyi yod pa dang / 'go 'khrid pa'i bsam tshul gang 'dra zhig yod med ma shes pa'i gnas tshul byung ba des 'go dmangs dbar ring thung shor ba dang / dogs pa rnam rtog rnams byung ba red/ de ni bod gcig pu min par 'dzam gling gzhan la'ang de 'dra byung yod/ des na 'go 'khrid mkhan dang / 'khrid bya'i mang tshogs mnyam du 'dres/ 'go 'khrid pa'i bsam tshul 'di dang / dmigs 279

zhen skul gyis sgrub dgo1/ pa las/ mang tshogs nas gnas lugs gang yang ma shes par 'go khrid pas skul 'ded byas pa kho nas 'grub pa dka'/ dus tshod rnying pa'i skabs su 'dzam gling gang sar 'gro lugs de ltar yin kyang / deng dus bsgyur bcos 'gro ba'i skabs yin pa dang / lhag par ma 'ongs par nga tsho gnas tshul gzhan dag zhig gi jog 'gro dgos pas na/ 'go khrid pas bya ba gang 'dra zhig brtsams rung / de'i bsam tshul 'di yin/ dgos pa 'di dang / dge mtshan 'di yod ces mang tshogs la gnas lugs bshad/ mang tshogs kyis de mgo 'tshos/ bsam blor go ba chags/ bsam blo'i nang nas zhen skul thebs pa zhig byung mtshams las don ji 'dra zhig sgrub kyang tshags su tshud pa dang / dmigs sar 'khyol bayong thub pa yin/ der brten 'go khrid pas mang tshogs la gnas lugs bshad/ mang tshogs nas kyang gnas lugs shes pa'i thog nas gcig gyur du 'gro thub pa bya dgos pa las 'go khrid pa'i bsam tshul dang / mang tshogs thag ring po byas na mi 'grigs/ de snga 7skyabs mgon sbug ces brjod pa ltar sbug tu bsdad pa red/ rgya che'i mang tshogs snyom chung rnams dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la 'tsho ba gang 'dra zhig skyel gyi yod pa dang / 'go 'khrid pa'i bsam tshul gang 'dra zhig yod med ma shes pa'i gnas tshul byung ba des 'go dmangs dbar ring thung shor ba dang / dogs pa rnam rtog rnams byung ba red/ de ni bod gcig pu min par 'dzam gling gzhan la'ang de 'dra byung yod/ des na 'go 'khrid mkhan dang / 'khrid bya'i mang tshogs mnyam du 'dres/ 'go 'khrid pa'i bsam tshul 'di dang / dmigs 279

yul 'di yin/ byed stangs 'di yin zhes gsal por brjod/ mang tshogs nas kyang 'di legs/ 'di mi legs snyam du rtog dpyod byas/ de nas mi der snyid ches blos 'gel byasan mi des mang tshogs kyi 'go 'khrid thub rgyu dang /mi mang gis yid ches blos 'gel cha 'jog ma byas na mi des 'go 'khrid byed mi thub/ mi mang gis cha 'jog yid ches yong ba la gdong lngong nas pa tsam gyis mi phan pas rang gi bsam blo gang yod shes dgos pas/ de la gnas lugs gsal por brjod dgos pa yin/'ga' shas kyi dgongs par/ ngas 'dir langs nas skad cha shod par phran bu ma bde ba lta bu yod na de la 'gal ba med/ nga'i nus pas ldeng gi yod med mi shes kyang da lta'i gnas skabs 'dir ngas 'go khrid byed kyi yod stabs nga'i bsam tshul dang / dzña ram sa la'i 'go khrid las khungs kyi bsam tshul gang yod snyan sgron zhu ba'i tshul du brjod rgyu 'di skabs babs kyi las 'gan red/ nga tsho'i bsam tshul rnams khyed rang tshos shes/ lho dpes byung na rjes la las don zhig bkod sgrig byung ba'i tshe 'di'i 'gro stangs 'di yin/ 'di la gnad 'di 'dra zhig yod snyam du dran nas de bzhin du sgrub rgyur phan thogs yong rgyu yin stabs da ring gang ci'i gnas tshul shes rtogs kyi don du gnas lugs phran bu bshad/ tshogs 'du lta bu byas na bsam pa yin/dang por/ tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar/ nga tshos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes rtsa ba chen por 'dzin gyi yod pa red/ bstan pa 'di rtsa ba chen po yin thag chod yin/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum gang 'dra zhig bya dgos kyang byas te/280

nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel bya rgyu gal chen po red/ spyir btang brjod na/ deng dus 'dzam gling 'dir mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spus dag po ni rang re bod gangs can par ma gtogs med pa lta bu yin/ nga tsho'i gces nor gzhan la ngoms rgyu gcig yod pa ni de 'dra'i chos dang / de dang 'brel ba'i shes rig gting zab 'di rang yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'am/ chos 'di dag dar rgyas gong 'phel du gtong dgos pa rtsa don ngo ma de yin/ yar rgyas gtong stangs ji 'dra zhig bya rgyu yin nam snyam na/ sngar phan bod la bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed skabs kyi gnas stangs de dang / da lta'i gnas tshul la 'gyur ba byung yod/ phyin chad kyang bod kyi gnas tshul sngar gyi der gnas rgyu min stabs/ nga tshos bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed stangs kyang dngos yod gnas tshul ngo ma dang bstun pa'i thog nas bya dgos/ yul gyi dngosayod gnas tshul 'gyur bzhin payin na'ang /nga m+mu byed stangs sngar gyi de kho nar sdug sgom rgyab ste bsdad na mi 'grigs/des phan thogs phran bu 'byung yang / spyi yongs mang tshogs la rlabs chen po'i phan thogs 'byung ba dka'/ des na chos kyi 'gan khur grwa rigs nyung shas shig la 'khri ba lta bu ma yin par/ chos la dad mos yod pa'i mang tshogs tshang ma'i bsam cho'i nang chos kyi gnad 'gag rnams slob ston bya rgyur shugs snon byed dgos pa gal chen por mthong gi 'dug nga tsho'i ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs gtso che shos slob gra'i nang nas yong rgyu yin stabs slob gra'i nang yod pa'i bu phrug chung ngu tsho'i bsam cho'i nang chos kyi slob ston bya dgos/ de yang / de 281

nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel bya rgyu gal chen po red/ spyir btang brjod na/ deng dus 'dzam gling 'dir mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spus dag po ni rang re bod gangs can par ma gtogs med pa lta bu yin/ nga tsho'i gces nor gzhan la ngoms rgyu gcig yod pa ni de 'dra'i chos dang / de dang 'brel ba'i shes rig gting zab 'di rang yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'am/ chos 'di dag dar rgyas gong 'phel du gtong dgos pa rtsa don ngo ma de yin/ yar rgyas gtong stangs ji 'dra zhig bya rgyu yin nam snyam na/ sngar phan bod la bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed skabs kyi gnas stangs de dang / da lta'i gnas tshul la 'gyur ba byung yod/ phyin chad kyang bod kyi gnas tshul sngar gyi der gnas rgyu min stabs/ nga tshos bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed stangs kyang dngos yod gnas tshul ngo ma dang bstun pa'i thog nas bya dgos/ yul gyi dngosayod gnas tshul 'gyur bzhin payin na'ang /nga m+mu byed stangs sngar gyi de kho nar sdug sgom rgyab ste bsdad na mi 'grigs/des phan thogs phran bu 'byung yang / spyi yongs mang tshogs la rlabs chen po'i phan thogs 'byung ba dka'/ des na chos kyi 'gan khur grwa rigs nyung shas shig la 'khri ba lta bu ma yin par/ chos la dad mos yod pa'i mang tshogs tshang ma'i bsam cho'i nang chos kyi gnad 'gag rnams slob ston bya rgyur shugs snon byed dgos pa gal chen por mthong gi 'dug nga tsho'i ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs gtso che shos slob gra'i nang nas yong rgyu yin stabs slob gra'i nang yod pa'i bu phrug chung ngu tsho'i bsam cho'i nang chos kyi slob ston bya dgos/ de yang / de 281

snga bod kyi 'gro lugs ltar bu phrug chung dus nas dgon par bzhag ste dgon pa de'i nang gi mi tshe skyel stangs de gcig pu las/ 'dzam bu gling gi gnas tshul dang / nye skor rgya dkar nag gi gnas tshul/ mdor na bod rang gi yul sde yas mas dang / rgya che'i mi mang gi gnas tshul tsam yang shes snathogs ma thub pa/ dper na/ yi ge yang ji bzhin mi shes pa'i gnas tshul des nus pa ldeng mi thub par brten / da cha rang re'i bu phrug chung ngu tshor chos kyi slob gso byed pa dang chabs cig deng dus 'dzam gling gi gnas lugs rnams kyang shes thub pa zhig byas te de gnyis zung 'brel du 'gro thub pa byed dgos la byed thub kyi red bsam gyi 'dug de ltar byung na chos la dad pa de yang lam seng g.yo 'gul gtong mi thub pa'i brtan po zhig yong gi red/ rgyu mtshan de lta bu la brten nas/ slob gra khag la chos kyi slob sbyong sprod rgyu de gal chen por rtsis te thog mar slob gra khag so sor chos dge bzhag yod pa dang / da dung de la shugs snon rgyag dgos pa yin stabs phyin chad 11ba gra khag gi dge rgan rnams sa dge bka' rnying ris med kyi gzhung chen po la slob gnyer byas pa'i ser mo ba'i khongs nas 'gro thub pa byung na/ dge rgan rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su zhugs/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste dge tshul slong gi sdom ldan yin pas/ de la dpag pa'i kun spyod cig yong rgyu dang / gzhung la sbyangs pa yod pa'i dbang gis chos/ zhes brjod pa'i tshe yang de la 'grel bshad byed thub pa yong rgyur brten/ dge rgan rnams slob gnyer zin pa'i khongs nas 'gro thabs skor la bsam gzhigs byas dang byed mus de ltar yin/282

nga tsho'i mi rabs rjes ma bu phrug 'di rnams lo dus nges can zhig ring slob gra'i nang slob gnyer gyi 'tsho bar spyad de gnas rgyu dang / slob gra bon pa'i dus mtshams su chos kyi mtho rim slob sbyong byed 'dod yod pa rnams rang mos kyi bya rgyu dang / byings rnams kyang chos srid gnyis ldan gyi bsam blo legs po zhig yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug de rnams ma 'ongs pa'i bsam tshul yin/da lta'i char chos kyi slob sbyong byed dang byed mus dge 'dun gyi sde rnams 'tsho thabs skor nga tsho'i dka' ngal che shos shig yin/ gang yin zer na/ deng dus 'dzam gling 'dir/ chos zhes pa ni rang gi 'dod pas dwang du blangs nas byas par ngos bzung bas/ chos byed dge 'dun pa'i mthun rkyen skor gleng 'phros byas na/ mi 'dod rnam 'gyur dang mkhregs bzung byed mkhan mang po zhig phyi rgyal dang / rgya gar nang khul la'ang yong mus red/ nga tshos phyogs gzhan nas bsam blo zhig ma btang na da mus kyis khungs 'khyol thabs med pa chags par brten gzhi rim dang / 'bring rim gyi slob gra khag nas slob gnyer thon zin pa'i rjes su/ chos kyi slob gnyer bya yul da yod nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi slob gnyer byed sa'i chos sgar chen po rnams ches mtho'i mtho rim slob gra'i rnam pa zhig tu bsgyur thub na/ dge mtshan chen po zhig mthong ste/ deng skabs las don de 'bad sgrub bya mus yin/da ring 'dir mkhas pa bla sprul mang po rābs yod stabs gong gi gnas tshul las 'phros pa'i gleng mol phran bu zhus na/ nga tsho'i chos srung skyob bya rgyu shin tu gal che ba dang / byed stangs la khyad cig med dam snyam/ sngar phan 283

thod la chos dar ba'i skabs yul gyi gnas stangs de ji 'dra zhig yin nam snyam na/ yul gyi spyi tshogs gnas stangs de zhing bran lam lugs dang / sa bdag gi gnas stangs thog gnas yod/ yul gyi spyi tshogs gnas stangs zhing bran lam lugs su gnas pa des/ chos dang / chos byed stangs la skyon byung med kyang / chos byed gra rigs tsho'i 'tsho ba spyod stangs dang / lhag par bla ma che khag tsho'i 'tsho ba spyod stangs nang zhing bran lam lugs phran bu 'dres med dam bsam gyi 'dug de ji 'dra zhig yin nam snyam na/ dper na/ dgon pa tshor chos gzhis yod/ de dag yul gyi nang sgor la dbang ba'i sa zhing med bzhin du dgon pa gcig pur sa zhing byung ba min/ yul gyi nang sger la dbang ba'i sa zhing yod pa'i dbang gis dgon khag tshor yang de bzhin byung ba yin/ phyin chad sa zhing rnams gzhung la dbang ba ma gtogs sgor la dbang rgyu min stabs dgon khag tshor yang sa zhing yong shes stangs med/ yul gyi sa zhing gnas stangs spyi tshogs rnying pa'am/ sa bdag dang / zhing bran lta bu'i 'gro stangs shig chags pa'i dbang gis dgon pa'i 'gro stangs kyang de 'dra zhig byung ba min nam bsam gyi 'dugang tsho bod gcig pu min par 'dzam gling gang sa'i 'gro lugs la lta dgos/ dper na/ yu rab pha ran si'i nang dang / u ru su'i nang / nga tsho'i khyim mtshes rgya gar yul nang 'gro stangs gang 'dra zhig byung yod dam/yul gyi nang dbang che ba de la sa zhing rgya che ba dang / rgyu nor longs spyod mang ba'i gnas tshul zhig yod/ mi dmigs bsal ba 'ga' re'i ngos nas bsam 284

na/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po tsho'i nang byang chub sems dpa' mang po byung yod pa dang / bod dang / rgya nag sogs la'ang de bzhin byung yod kyang / spyir btang gidabang du bsgo na/ mi la nyon mongs dug gsumayod phyin chad rang la dga' po dang / gces 'dzin byed pa shugs kyis 'byung / de'i dbang gis yul gyi rgyal po tshos mi mang gi bde sdug la lta rtogs ji tsam byas kyang / rang gi bde skyid dang longs spyod kyi bsam blo zhig nges par du yong gi red/ rang gi rgyu nor longs spyod spel rgyu'i bsam blos yul gyi dbang 'dzin byas pa yin/ rgyal po'i gnas stangs de 'dra zhig dang dus mnyam du yod pa'i bla ma chen po rnams phan tshun mchod yon du 'brel ba'i tshe bla ma rang ngos kyi bsam blor skyon med pa zhig yin na'ang / bla ma'i nye 'khor la yod pa rnams la rim pas shan zhugs pa'am/ yul nangayod pa'i sa bdag gi byed stangs kyi dri ma lta bu zhig 'gos mchedayong gi med dam bsam gyi 'dug bcom ldan 'das rang gis 'dul ba'i nang bka' gnang ba'i gnas tshul la byas na/ dge slong rnams rgyal blon khag dang rgyang tsam zhig dgos pa lta bu zhig 'dug kyang / dbang dang 'byor pa 'dod pa'i mi tshos de dag dang nang nye byas te gcig phan gcig grogs byas pas bla ma'i gnas tshul la sa bdag tsho'i spyod tshul 'dres lhad byung yod pa gsal po yod/ 'gro lugs de tsho bod gcig pu min par rgya gar nang gi bla ma chen po tshor yang dpe lta sa yod/ da dung pha ran si dang / u ru sur shin tu gsal po yod/ u ru su dkar po'i dus kyi rgyal po tsho dang / skabs de'i bla ma chen po cho'i bar dmigs bsal gyi 'brel ba zhig chags/ rgyal po nyams 285
