pa'i tshe bla ma rjes 'brang bcas pa tsho yang nyams/ de bzhin pha ran sir yang gsar brje jog mar byung ste pha ran si'i rgyal po mgo rting slog pa'i tshe bla ma chosang spyi tshogs nang pham rgyud chen po bzos pa red/ bod kyi bla ma sems dpa' chen po tsho ni rang las gzhan gces par 'dzin mkhan yin pas gong gi gnas tshul dang mi 'dra yang / bla ma tshang ma de 'dra sha stag yin brjod mi thub cing / lhag don bla ma'i nye sgor ba tsho'i gnas tshul ni tha dad yin pas/ de tsho'i thog skyon phran bu med dam snyam/ thag nye sar nga rang tsho'i dran thog la rwa sgreng rgyal thog dang / stag brag rgyal thog skabs gnas tshul 'dra min mang po byung yod/ dper na/ se ra dang / gzhung gnyis dmag ga re'i don la thug pa red/ byes gra tshang nas gzhung la rgyab gtod byas pa dang / bstan par rgyab gtod byas pa min yang / bla ma'i zhabs 'bring tsho mi mthun pa dang /bla brang phan tshun mi mthun pa byung / bla brang gcig gis gzhung gi srid dbang bzung stabs de dag phan tshun 'dresanas gnas tshul de ltar byung ba red/ gnas tshul de tsho gzhan dag gi skyon min par spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs la brten nas skyon byung ba min nam snyam pa 'dugasangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong byed pa dge 'dun gyi sde la rag lus pa dang / de yang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams sku tshe brtan cing / mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa la rag lus pa de rnams dngos 'brel yin/ de dag gi don du tshang mas bsam gzhigs byed mus red/ 'on kyang ci mdzad legs mthong gi bsam tshul thal ches drags te rdzod yangs shor na/ nga tsho'i mi thog 'dir 286

pa'i tshe bla ma rjes 'brang bcas pa tsho yang nyams/ de bzhin pha ran sir yang gsar brje jog mar byung ste pha ran si'i rgyal po mgo rting slog pa'i tshe bla ma chosang spyi tshogs nang pham rgyud chen po bzos pa red/ bod kyi bla ma sems dpa' chen po tsho ni rang las gzhan gces par 'dzin mkhan yin pas gong gi gnas tshul dang mi 'dra yang / bla ma tshang ma de 'dra sha stag yin brjod mi thub cing / lhag don bla ma'i nye sgor ba tsho'i gnas tshul ni tha dad yin pas/ de tsho'i thog skyon phran bu med dam snyam/ thag nye sar nga rang tsho'i dran thog la rwa sgreng rgyal thog dang / stag brag rgyal thog skabs gnas tshul 'dra min mang po byung yod/ dper na/ se ra dang / gzhung gnyis dmag ga re'i don la thug pa red/ byes gra tshang nas gzhung la rgyab gtod byas pa dang / bstan par rgyab gtod byas pa min yang / bla ma'i zhabs 'bring tsho mi mthun pa dang /bla brang phan tshun mi mthun pa byung / bla brang gcig gis gzhung gi srid dbang bzung stabs de dag phan tshun 'dresanas gnas tshul de ltar byung ba red/ gnas tshul de tsho gzhan dag gi skyon min par spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs la brten nas skyon byung ba min nam snyam pa 'dugasangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong byed pa dge 'dun gyi sde la rag lus pa dang / de yang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams sku tshe brtan cing / mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa la rag lus pa de rnams dngos 'brel yin/ de dag gi don du tshang mas bsam gzhigs byed mus red/ 'on kyang ci mdzad legs mthong gi bsam tshul thal ches drags te rdzod yangs shor na/ nga tsho'i mi thog 'dir 286

'grigs kyang / mi rabs rjes ma tshos kyang nga tsho nang bzhin ci mdzad legs mthong gi bsam blo sha stag gtong mi thub cing / gtong mi srid/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul la brten nas 'gyur ba byung na gnas tshul tshabs chen por 'gyur nyen yod pas 'di skor gnas lugs phran bu zhus na snyam pa dang / lhag par zhu mkhan yang nga rang la babs 'os yod pa lta bu 'dug mi gzhan zhig gis brjod na bla ma la phrag dog sdang 'dzin byed lugs zer srid/ nged rang bla ma yin pa'i khul la brten bla ma'i rang mtshang bla mas rig pa dang / nged rang nas kyang 'tsho ba de lta bur spyad yod/ phyogs gcig nas bsam na dge mtshan 'dra yod nges kyang / phyogs gzhan cig nas bsams na 7rgyal ba rin po che'i 'tsho ba la yang zhing bran lam lugs 'dres pa'i 'tsho ba zhig yod nges yin/ rang gi nyams myong gi thog nas skyon mthong ba yin stabs skyon de dag brjod pa'i skabs babs nged rang la yod par bsam gyi 'dug bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod dang / bla ma'i zhabs 'bring sder gtogs dang bcas pa'i gnas tshul tha dad yin pas/ ci mdzad legs mthong thal ches pa'i skor bsam blo legs zab gtong dgos/ nga tsho rgya gar du 'byor nas mi lo drug tsam song /dha ram sa lar mtshon na bsgyur bcos mang po 'gro bzhin pa yin/ nga tsho byed byed mang nas bsgyur bcos byas pa min/ nga tsho 'go khrid las khungs yin pa'i dbang gis 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul phyogs mang por rtogs zhib byed bzhin yod la/ de ltar ma byas rang byas la thug yod/ 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul dang bstun nas nga tsho'i dri ma rnams gzhan gyis tshur ma bkrus gong rang ngos 287

nas 'khru rgyu'i bsam blo mi gtong thabs med yin pa ltar/ bsam blo gtong gi yod/ de yang mi 'dod bzhin du min par dga' bzhin spro bzhin du byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang da dung rgya gar nang gnas tshul de tshang mas gsal po ma mkhyen pa'i dbang gis rnam 'gyur ston stangs dang / skad cha shod stangs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas thabs yin pa lta bu zhig la don du mi sgor 'ga' zhig gi khe phan ched 'gro ba lta bu dang / mi de ga'i bsam blo'i nang nga'i khe phan ched yin bsam pa zhig med na yang / don gyi 'gro stangs de 'dra zhig chags pa'i gnas tshul yong srid kyi med dam bsam pa 'dug dper na/ bla ma zhes rgyal po chung chung zhig gi rnam 'gyur lta bu yod pa 'di tsho/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi nga tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs de dang ran gyi yod na yang / gnas tshul de gal srid zhing bran lam lugs dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin na/ phyin chad zhing bran lam lugs bsgyur bcos 'gro ba'i tshe gnas tshul de dag mi ran par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ der brten nga tsho'i chos byedadage 'dun spyi dang / de'i nang nas bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen tsho'i 'gro stangs kyi nang zhing bran lam lugs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul 'dres yod med brtag dpyad byas te gal srid 'dres yod na dga' bzhin spro bzhin du dbye ba 'byed dgos/ bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum la med mirung ba'i gzhi rtsa ngo thog de gang yin pa dang / zhing bran lam lugs yod pa'i skabs su bya thabs des bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum la phan gyi yod na yang / da cha zhing bran lam lugs med pa'i tshe bya thabs des bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel bar phan gnod ji byed dbye ba gsal po phye ba'i lam 288

thog tu 'gro ma thub na/ nam zhig sngar pha ran sir gsar brje byung ba'i skabs chos byed bla ma rnams mgo rting log pa lta bu yong nyen yod/ de 'dra byung na bla dge so so mi re zung dang / sder gtogs bcas par dka' ngal byung bar 'gal ba gang yang med kyang / dri ma med pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di nyid la nyam chag 'gro gzhir song na gtan nas mi 'os pas de rtsis bsam blo gtong dgos/ dper na/ ngas skyon brjod byas pa min yang / 'di lta bu yong gi 'dug bcom ldan 'das kyi 'dul ba'i khrims lugs nang rang nyid lo nyi shu ma lon par dge slong sgrub mi chog pa dang / gzhan la dge slong gi sdom pa sbyin pa la rang nyid dge slong bsgrubs nas lo bcu song ba zhig dgos par gsungs yod kyang / skabs re bod nang bsnyen par rdzogs nas ma mtha' lo lnga dang phyed lhag ma song gong nas gzhan la sdom pa sbyin pa'i gnas tshul byung yod/ rgyal dbang sku 'phreng nang la'ang de 'dra zhig byung tshod 'dus gnas tshul de ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bcas pa la 'di ltar yod kyang / bla ma 'di chen spro yin pas dmigs bsal bya dgos zhes bcom ldan 'das kyi bcas pa las/ bla ma gal che bar bzung ba yin/ skabs de'i bla ma der dmigs bsal btang chog pa zhig yin du chug kyang / de'i ming bzung ba'i bla ma rjes ma der yang sku gong ma'i mdzad lam 'di lta buyin pas 'di bzhin bya dgos zhes brjod na/ bla ma rjes ma de sku gong ma dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa zhig yod na lta legs kyang / de ltar med na mi 'tshams par gyur tshar ba red/ so so thar pa'i mdor spo nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs na sdom pa mi skye la/ sdom pa sbyin mkhan 28nye

la'ang nyes pa yod par gsal por gsungs yod kyang / dgon pa 'ga' shas nang bla ma che khag la khri pa re 'khor lta bu 'khel skabs bla ma dgung lo 15416tsam yin rung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub rkyang dang / sdom pa sbyin rkyang byed srol yod tshod red/ dus skabs gcig gi bla ma de bdag nyid chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'khel ba'i sku tshe der dgung lo nyi shur ma son kyang / tshe rabs nas tshe rabs rab tu byung bas 'cham gos brjes pa lta bu las/ nang gi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan yod yod pa yin pas 'grigs su rung yang / de dag sngar lam du song nas sku phreng dang po thun mong ma yin pa'i gnas tshul de sku phreng rjes ma tshang mar rgyas 'gebs kyis de bzhin chog par 'dzin pa'am/ yang na/ rgyal ba rin po che yin na/ da ring bsnyen par rdzogs nas sang nyin sdom pa sbyin chog pa lta bu byung na mi 'grigs/ gang 'tshams nas 7rgyal ba rin po che ni spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul yin/ spyan ras gzigs la btsun pa zhes brjod pa dge slong gi sdom pa yod par 'dod pa yin pas/ dge slong nyis brtsegs ma bsgrubs kyang 'grigs par brjod thub/ gang mtshams nas mdangs skyes kyi rgyal ba rin po ches kyang da ring dge slong gi sdom pa sbyin du rung ba lta bur brjod na/ ches shin tu thal 'gro ba yin/ de ltar thal cha chen po'i rigs spangs nas lag len legs 11 ma byas na/ dzadas khas mi len mkhan smos ci/nang pa nang khul 'dul khrims la byang ba zhig gis dri ba bkon byung na/ spyir btang dmigs bsal mi 'dra ba dang / gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa yin tshul tsam brjod na las/ de min lan 'debs dka' bar 'gyur nges yin/ sangs 290

rgyas kyi mdzad pa rnam thar la gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab patsede nges yin kyang /thun mong ma yin pa'i gnas tshul zhig de'i phyogs na'ang med pa'i mi rnams la dpar bkab byed mi thub/ gnas tshul de gras ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bcas pa'i khrims de las/ bla ma de'i thob go sa dbang che ba byung ba yin/ mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i nang de tshor mi bde ba mang po mi 'byung ba ni bla ma chung ngu'i dus nas de bdag nyid chen po ga nga min zhig yin lugs brjod pa red/ de la'ang nang 'gal yod de/ bla ma la bslab dgos kyi yod kyang phyogs gzhan nas bla ma de kun mkhyen yin par brjod/ de 'dra'i 'gal 'du mang po zhig yod bzhin du/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / thun mong snang ngo la sogs pa'i skad cha mang po zhig bsres te mdzub mo 'dzugs sa med pa zhig bzos pa red/nga tshor legs cha dang yon tan yod pa rnams nyi shar sbar mos mi khebs zer ba ltar gzhan gyis rim shes thub rgyu yang / nga tshor skyon yod pa rnams la gzhan gyis mdzub mo ma btsugs gong nga rang tsho nang khul nas legs bcos byas na legs shos la brten ngas skyon gangaspend rnams zhus payin/ go ba bzhes stangs ma nor ba gnang dgos/ gong zhus bzhin/ zhing bran lam lugs dang / bla ma chen po tsho'i 'tsho ba spyod stangs 'dres nas lag gdang dpung sbrel byas pa'i nyer len gyis gnas tshul de dag byung ba min nam snyam pas de dag dbye ba phye dgos kyi 'dug bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed rgyu gal che yang / byed stangs la gnas tshul mang po zhig gi thog nas bsam gzhigs legs po bya dgos pa las/ sngar gyi byed stangs kho na mi nyams gong 'phel byas pas 'grigs 291

par bsam mi rung / de rnams gnas tshul gcig yin/gnyis par/ nga tsho'i pha mes kyi nor bu dang 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos srung skyob byed pa dang chabs cig chos 'di nga tsho'i mi rigs gcig kho na'i nang gnas pa ma yin par phyogs gang sar khyab spel gyi gra sgrig bya rgyu dus la babs par mthong gi 'dug nga tsho'i bla ma gzhon pa tsho slob gnyer byed 'phro bzhag nas phyi rgyal du 'gro ba dang / las don gzhan dag byed dgos pa byung yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs nang gses la'ang sing ga la/ tha'i lan/ wi ṭi nam/ rgya gar/ 'bar ma sogs par yod pa'i nang nas chos cha tshang zhing rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i spus dag po de bod la ma gtogs med pa lta dzu yin/ de dag bod mis bzos pa min par rgya gar nas dar ba zhig yin/ sngar rgya gar du chos 'di rang yod kyang bar skabs nyams pa dang / rgya gar nas bod du dar ba rnams ma nyams par srung skyob rgyun bskyangs te da bar gnas pa red/ bod du yod pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di nang chos gzhan las zab pas 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa de rang red ces mi mang pos do snang byed pa'i dus tshod 'di 'dra zhig la slebs yod pa'i go skabs 'di zin nas nga chos las ka phran bu byed thub na bsam pa dang / phyogs gzhan nas brjod na/ dmar po'i lta ba la mtshon na rgyal khab phan tshun dbye ba ma phye bar rgyal mtshams ris med ring lugs zhes brjod de rgya nag dmar pos rgya gar nang dang / 'dzam gling gang sar dmar po'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan yod tshad la g.yo 'gul gtong thabs 292

byed bde lta bu yin/ nga tsho'i nang pa sangs rgyas kyi chos nas sems can thams cad kyi don du zer ba las/ bod rigs gcig bu'i don du zer ba min zhing /'dzam gling 'di gcig pu ma yin par/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad ces brjod pa yin pas/ nga tsho'i dmigs yul ngo ma rgyal mtshams ris med ring lugs lta bu yin kyang / nga tshos slobs pa zhum nas chos 'di bod rigs nang khul du nyar rgyu tsam dang / bod rigs gcig pu'i rgyu nor yin pa lta bu'i 'du shes kyis shod dgos sa dang / bstan dgos sar thabs shes ldeng nges byed ma thub/ da lta phan bod la nga tshos phan tshun 'brel mtshams bcad nas bsdad pa des nga tshor gyong byung yod/ da cha dus skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu slebs yod pas nga tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos spus dag po 'di dag gzhan la ston rgyu'i skor rgyal mtshams ris med ring lugs kyi bsam tshul 'dzin rgyu gal chen po min nam bsam pa 'dug da ring 'dir khyed rnam pa 'ga' shas phebs yod/ kha sang chos 'brel skabs kyang zhu rgyu byung ba ltar/ nga tshos chos shod dgos pa dang / shod stangs kyang lung 'dren tsam min par rig pa'i sgrub byed 'ba' zhig bkod dgos/ don snying chos shod dgos sar shod pa / nga /bstan bcos brtsams dgos sar bstan bcos brtsams/ 'grel bshad byed dgos sar 'grel bshad bya rgyu sogs gal chen po 'dug pas de skor da ring yang bskyar gzhin skul zhu rgyu yin/zhor 'phros su don dag gzhan zhig zhus na/ nga rang tsho bod la dpe cha ha cang 'bor chen po yod/ de rnams chos dang 'brel ba yod pa sha stag dang /293

yang na bla ma'i ming yod pa lta bu'i gnas tshul la brten nas brtsams pa lta bu las/ chos dang 'brel ba med pa'i spyir btang gi bstan bcos rtsom spel la do snang chen po ma byas pa'i dbang gis/ dper na/ deng sang bu phrug tshor klog deb kyi dgos mkho yang ldeng gi mi 'dug chos kyi skor rnams ni mkhregs drags te lam seng go rtogs ma thub/ de min bla ma'i rnam thar 'dra klog na ma gtogs med/ nga ②ོ bod par de 'dra'i rigs rtsom rgyu med pa dang / rtsom mi thub pa min yang / do snang ma byas par ltod yangs su bzhag pa'i skyon yin pas/ mkhas pa tshos de tsho'i rigs la'ang dgongs pa bzhes te chos gcig bu mayin par spyir btang gi gnas tshul rigs 'bri rtsom gnang dgos/ dper na/ nye char gzhon nu zla med kyi dpe cha dpar 'debs kyis bkram par bu phyug tshos dga' po byed kyi 'dug de bzhin du bar skabs bod kyi gnas tshul dang /rgya mi'i btsan 'dzul skor/ 'di phyogs yong rkyen sogs nga rang tsho rgan pa tsho'i blo la nges yod pas do snang ma byung yang / nga tsho'i mi rabs rjes ma tshor yi ge zhig 'jog ma thub na khong chos ji bzhin shes pa dka' bas rang rang gi blo nges yod pa'i lo rgyus rnams dran thog gsal thog tu bri rtsom gnang na legs po 'dug 'di tsho'i skor chos don dang / shes rig las khungs sogs nas skul ma zhu rgyu dang / 'os babs kyi mthun rkyen sbyor rgyu yang yong rgyur/ 'di 'dra'i bstan bcos rtsom rgyur do snang bya rgyu gal chen po mthong gi 'dug phyogs gzhan nas zhus na/ mi rabs rjes ma tshos gnas lugs ma shes pa rnams shes thub pa dang / bsam blor blo bskyed yar rgyas yong ba'i ched du bstan b.lo 294

gang mang brtsams na phan thogs chen po yong gi red bsam pa 'dug de rnams ni chos kyi skor yar rgyas gtong lugs bsam tshul snying po nyung bsdus zhus pa yin/gsum par/ shes rig skorayin/ rgya gar gzhung nas ha cang thugs khur che bzhes gnang ste slob gra khag la bu phrug drug stong skor bdag sprod slob sbyong byed bzhin yod pa de dag lo shas nang thob pa'i rgyal kha chen po zhig yin/slob gra de dag gi 'gro sta)/ngas ji 'dra zhig yin nam snyam na/ nga tsho'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi bsam blo rnams slob gra'i nang slob sbyong sprod pa yin/ de yang /deng dus 'dzam gling 'dir yod pa'i rig gsar gyi shes bya'i rnam grangs gtso che ba rnams slob sbyong byed pa dang chabs cig tu/ nga rang tsho'i mi rigs kyi chos dang / shes rig tsam ma zad/ nga tsho'i goms gshis bzang po rnams kyang 'jags thub pa'i slob sbyong byas te don snying chos srid sgro gshog zung ldan 'byung thabs la 'bad brtson byed bzhin pa yin/ da cha dka' ngal gang yod dam snyam na/ nga tshos slob gra 'dzugs ma thub pa'i dka' ngal las rgyal kha thob ste slob grwa btsugs zin na yang / da cha slob gra btsugs zin pa rnams sprus dag tu gtong rgyur 'bad rtsol thub mkhan shes yon can yong thabs byed bzhin yod/ de gal chen po zhig 'dug nga tsho btsan byol bar gnas pa'i ring bu phrug rnams nas shes bya'i rnam grangs mang po zhig shes pa'i mtshams kho tshos snag shog kho na'i las don bya rgyu'i bsam tshul byung na bu phrug gang 'tshams shig las byed pa'i khongs tshud zhugs thub rgyu yang / byings rnams gzhan du kha 'thor 295

'gro rgyur de ltar phyin na phan thogs ma byung ba yin/ 'dir 'grel bshad phran bu byas na/ nga tshos gzhis chags la shugs ston byed bzhin yod pa de da lta'i mi rnams kyi 'tsho thabs tsam min par/ phyin chad nga tsho gzhan yul du mi thog re gnyis shig sdod dgos byung tshe nga tsho'i chos dang / shes rig /mdor na mi rigs dang bcas pa rnams srung skyob byed pa'i ched du yin/ de dag srung skyob gtso na gzhis chags khag tu byed pa las/ dzña ram sa la lta bu'am/ bod mi kha 'jor du gnas pa tshos srung skyob de ltar byed mi thub/ da lta gzhis chags nangayod pa'i mi thog 'di'i rjes su mi thog gzhan zhig nges par yong dgos/da lta'i gzhis chags pa tsho rang nyid shes yon dman pa'i dbang gis 'jor dang /sbyag ma 'khur nas las rtsol mi byed rang byed yin kyang / slob gra khag nas bon yong mkhan tsho ngal rtsol thub pa'i shes yon can zhig ma byung bar shes yon gcig pur sngas bcol bya mkhan zhig tu gyur na/ shes yon yod stabs rang gi to gos kyi thabs shes ni byed thub/ ngal rtsol la mi dga' bayin pas gnas tshul nyen kha can du 'gyur nges la brten/ slob gra khag gi slob phrug rnams chos srid gnyis ldan dang / ngal rtsol la brten pa'i shes yon can zhig yong thub pa'i bsam rtsis bzung ste 'bad brtson byed bzhin yod/ de nas 'phros te zhu rgyur/ shes yon slob sbyong zhes pa slob grar 'gro mkhan gyi lo chung tsho gcig bur 'khri ba lta bu min/ shes yon slob sbyong zhes pa slob sbyong bya rgyu ni ser skya pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mar 'khri ba zhig yin/ rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi shes yon bsam tshad mtho ru gtong ma thub na ha cang dka' ngal dang / skyon chen poyong 296

gi 'dug pas khyed rang tsho so sos do snang byed dgos pa dang / khyed tsho brgyud nas rang rang 'brel yod tsho la yang zhen bskul byas te sngar ma shes pa rnams gsar du shes thabs kyi 'bad brtson bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug shes rig gi bsdoms de 'dra zhig yin/ bzhi par srid don gyi gnas tshul skor yin/ srid don gyi gnas tshul 'di dag rtsa ba'i gnad don chen po zhig yin stabs 'phral 'phral 'jog bzo thon rgyu dka' yang / bar lam lo drug ring yar rgyas gang legs phyin yod pa dang / rgyal spyi'i nang bod don skor ma brlag pa'i thog sos hril hril du gnas yod/ lhag par 1962 lo rgya dkar nag bar dngos su dmag 'khrug byung ba nas bzu ngas/ bod don skor gson shugs che ru phyin yod/ de bzhin rgya gar nang la'ang 'gyur ba chen po byung ste rtsa ba'i bod don thog mthar thug gi srid byus 'dzin stangs nga tsho dang / rgya gar gzhung thag nye po chags yod/da dung nga tshos sgyid lug dang / zhum pa spangs pa'i thabs shes legs po zhig byed thub na/ nges par du don 'bras bzang po zhig 'grub pa'i re ba yod/ da phan rgyal kha gang legs thob yod kyang / des ldeng thabs med pas da dung 'bad brtson shugs bskyed bya dgos/ bod don sgor la bden pa nga tsho'i phyogs su yod pa ltar/ gnas tshul bzang po zhig gi thog nas bden par rgyal kha thob rgyur yid ches gtsang ma byas chog pa yin na'ang / yong stangs ji 'dra zhig dang / dus tshod gang 'dra zhig la yong zer na/ de gting ring po yin pas lam seng gsal por brjod pa dka'/ gcig byas na lo lnga drug297

gi 'dug pas khyed rang tsho so sos do snang byed dgos pa dang / khyed tsho brgyud nas rang rang 'brel yod tsho la yang zhen bskul byas te sngar ma shes pa rnams gsar du shes thabs kyi 'bad brtson bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug shes rig gi bsdoms de 'dra zhig yin/ bzhi par srid don gyi gnas tshul skor yin/ srid don gyi gnas tshul 'di dag rtsa ba'i gnad don chen po zhig yin stabs 'phral 'phral 'jog bzo thon rgyu dka' yang / bar lam lo drug ring yar rgyas gang legs phyin yod pa dang / rgyal spyi'i nang bod don skor ma brlag pa'i thog sos hril hril du gnas yod/ lhag par 1962 lo rgya dkar nag bar dngos su dmag 'khrug byung ba nas bzu ngas/ bod don skor gson shugs che ru phyin yod/ de bzhin rgya gar nang la'ang 'gyur ba chen po byung ste rtsa ba'i bod don thog mthar thug gi srid byus 'dzin stangs nga tsho dang / rgya gar gzhung thag nye po chags yod/da dung nga tshos sgyid lug dang / zhum pa spangs pa'i thabs shes legs po zhig byed thub na/ nges par du don 'bras bzang po zhig 'grub pa'i re ba yod/ da phan rgyal kha gang legs thob yod kyang / des ldeng thabs med pas da dung 'bad brtson shugs bskyed bya dgos/ bod don sgor la bden pa nga tsho'i phyogs su yod pa ltar/ gnas tshul bzang po zhig gi thog nas bden par rgyal kha thob rgyur yid ches gtsang ma byas chog pa yin na'ang / yong stangs ji 'dra zhig dang / dus tshod gang 'dra zhig la yong zer na/ de gting ring po yin pas lam seng gsal por brjod pa dka'/ gcig byas na lo lnga drug297

yang na bcu skor/ bzhi bcu skor/ brgya skor ji 'dra zhig 'gor min nges pa med/ gnas tshul 'gyur ba ji 'dra zhig gi thog nas yong gi yod med kyang brjod rgyu khag po red/ 'on kyang / nga tsho'i gra sgrig byed stangs thad gcig byas na 'di 'dra zhig gi thog nas 'gyur ba yong srid/ yang na 'di 'dra zhig la'ang yong srid snyam pa'i gra sgrig bya dgos pas/ nga tshos zhi rgyas dbang drag gi slob sbyong sde tshan mang po zhig byed bzhin pa de rnams rtsa ba'i bod kyi srid don gnas tshul dang 'brel ba yod pa sha stag yin/ slo bur gyi 'gyur ba ji 'dra zhig spongang min cha mi snangags/ dper na/ deng sang bi ṭi nam gyi gnas tshul dza drag po 'di 'dra zhig yod/ gcig byas na/ rgya nag dngas ri thad kur dmag thug rgyu'i nyen kha yang yod/ de 'dra zhig byung na/ u ru su dang / rgya nag gi 'brel ba gang 'dra zhig tu 'gyur yong / ru su dang / rgya gar gyi 'brel ba gang 'dra zhig tu 'gyur yong / sgo lo ril ba lta bur srid don gyi gnas tshul ji 'dra zhig tu 'gyur min brjod mi thub/ des na nga tsho bod don gyi rgyal kha yang rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul mang po zhig dang sbrel nas 'gro dgos pa las bod gcig pur zur du 'gro stangs shig ma 'ongs par yong mi srid pa min yang da lta'i skabs 'dir khag po yin/ der brten nga tsho'i bod don rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul dang 'brel dgos pas na rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul la do snang byas/ rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul gyi 'gros dang bstun te thabs shes bya dgos / gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig byung na 'di byas/ 'di 'dra byung na 'di ltar bya snyam du gra sgrig phyogs gang sa nas 'gyod pa med pa zhig bya dgos/ dper na/ sgo lo rtsed 298

mkhan chos sgo lo phyogs gar yong nges pa med pa phyogs tshang mar ang sar gyi sdod pa ltar/ nga tshos kyang da lta phan la sde tshan khag mang po zhig nang sa bon lta bu btab nas yod/ da dung rgya gar gzhung dang nga tsho'i dbar 'brel ba legs po yod stabs lo re nas lo rer je legs su 'gro ba'i re ba yod/lnga pa/ de nas kha tsha dgos gtugs gal che shos shig ni/ nang srid khongs nas lta rtogs byed pa'i gzhis chags skor 'di yin/ 'di ni 'phral snang dza drag che zhing / phugs rgyang ring po'i cha nas 'di las gal che ba med pa lta bu yin/ da lta phan la 'di sgor 'bad rtsol gang yong byas yod kyang sgo mang po zhig la bstun dgos pas lam seng grub 'bras 'di byung zhes ston rgyu khag po red/ 'on kyang mu mthud 'bad rtsol byas na grub 'bras legs po yong rgyur yid ches yod/ mang tshogs nas kyang gzhis chags 'di gal chen po yin par cha 'jog byed dgos pa dang / gzhis chags nang slebs skabs rang khyim gyi 'du shes bya dgos/ lo gcig gnyi sa gong gi gnas tshul dang mi 'dra bar deng sang lam bzo khag la yod pa'i bod mi tshos gzhis chags la 'gro 'dod chen po byed kyi 'dug pa de dag la dga' po yod/ de tsho legs po red/ gzhis chags nang slebs pa'i rjes su skyob gso zas phogs nyin gcig las min yang snga tsam len ma dgos pa gtso bzung bya dgos pa las/ rang 'tsho rang byung gis yong re byas te rang gis 'bad rtsol ma byas na nyen kha chen po yin/ da phan rogs ram byed mkhan 'ga' zhig gi mthong tshul la bod mi gzhis chags pa chos las rtsol shugs skyed mi byed pa'i mthong tshul byung yod/ bod mis 299

las ka ma byas pa minayang / rang re'i bodasbul nang ha cang sos dal gyi gnas stangs yod pa'i mig ltos 'jags pa lta bus las don 'thus shor 'gro gi'adi pa red/ des na gzhis chags pa tshos dka' ngal 'dzems med sems shugs chen pos hur brtson bya dgos/ da lta'i char sa zhing thog gzhis chags khag lnga tsam yod pa rnams 'gyangs mthar lo gnyis nang tshud rang 'tsho thub pa'i re ba dang 'bad brtson bya mus yin/da lta lam bakhro'i thog yod pa rnams dka' ngal che zhing / lhag par nye dus nas bza' bca'i nyo thang 'phar/ gla cha ma 'phar ba sogs kyi dka' ngal chen po zhig 'dug gzhan gyis las ji bskul dang / gla ji sprad lta bu ma yin par/ nga rang tshos lam bakhra'i ru khag ru khag lta bu bzos te yong 'bab 'phar ston yong thabs 'dra bya rgyu med dam snyam pas 'di skor nang srid nas bsam blo gtong mus yin/ gang ltar gzhis chags sogs la da lta yal ga lo 'dab rgyas med kyang / da phan lo shas ring rtsa ba lta bu legs tshugs yod pas rim pas legs po yong gi red bsam pa 'dugad phan nga tshos bsam blo gtong stangs dang / las ka byed stangs gong du zhus pa'i lam de 'dra zhig thog tu 'gro gi yod/ 'on kyang dmigs yul rgya chen po de rnams 'grub dang mi 'grub ni/ ngas da phan lan mang brjod pa ltar rang gi 'bad rtsol byas te rang nyid kyi bde skyid sgrub dgos pa ma gtogs/ rang gis nyal nas bsdad de bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'grub pa khag po yin/ don dag che chung gang 'dra zhig yin kyang 'grub dang mi 'grub 300

mi'i 'bad brtson rang la rag lus pa yin pas nga tsho tshang mas 'bad brtson shugs che bya rgyu gal chen po red/ de yang rtsa don chen po'i rigs nyin ma re zung dang / zla ba re zung 'bad brtson byas nas 'grub mi thub cing / da cha dka' las brgyab kyang 'grub rgyu mi 'dug snyam nas skyid lug byas na nam yang mi 'grigs pas lo nas lo bstud 'bad brtson bya dgos/ mdor na mi rigs gcig dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don la thug pa yin pas mi rabs nas mi rabs bstud nas dka' las rgyag dgos na yang / rgyag rin chog pa dang /rgyag 'os pa yin pas tshang mas 'bad brtson bya dgos pa ma gtogs/ lo re gnyis nasayid thang chad de bsdad na nam yang 'grigs thabs med/ der brten tshang mas ngas mi nus mi thub snyam pa'i skyid lug dang / zhum pa gtan nas spangs/ mi'i rigs kyis sgrub rgyu'i bya ba zhig yin phyin nga tshos nges par du sgrub thub kyi red snyam du cho'i spobs pa bskyed/ dka' ngal ji 'dra zhig byung rung dwang du blang na don dag gang yang nges par du 'grub thub/ de yong ba la yang tshang ma dam tshig mthun po zhig byung na/ phan tshun blo rogs gros rogs dang / phan tshun blo bag spros rogs byas te/ 'di yang nga tsho'i grogs po yin/'di yang nga tsho'i blo mthun yin snyam pa byung na legs po yong rgyu las/ dam tshig lar rgya gcig gyur legs po ma byung bar 'di yang gang 'dra yin nam/ de yang gang 'dra yin nam snyam ste/ blos 'khel la ma 'khel tsho bu byung na/ 'bad rtsol byed bsam mkhan tsho yang yid thang chad gzhir 'gro rgyur tshang mas dam tshig mthun po bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po 'dug de rnams zhib cha zhu ma dgos 301

pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ lung tshan phan tshun shog 'then byed pa dang /de bzhin phyi'i rtags dang / tha snyad 'dogs tshul tsam las khyad med pa'i grub mtha' nang khul la ha lam phyi nang thug pa lta bu'i 'then 'khyer byed pa sogs nyen kha chen po yin pas/ tshang mas dam tshig la gnod gzhi'i las don chung chung zhig yin rung mi 'byung ba gtso 'don byas na legs po 'dug gzhi rtsa da phan lo shas ring yar rgyas gang legs phyin yod kyang / da dung tshang mas gzab gzab gnang thub na gang legs sku nga rgyu/ dam tshig mthun nyuge de yang gong zhus bzhin/ lung tshan dang / grub mtha'i bar la byed dgos pas ma tshad/ mang tshogs dang las byed pa'i dbar/ mang tshogs dang 'go 'khrid bar la'ang bya dgos/ phan tshun gyi gnas lugs gsal po shes thub pa byung na/ 'go 'khrid pa'i mdzub ston byas pa'i tshe mang tshogs nas shar bgrod byed thub pa yong rgyu/bya ba gang 'dra zhig sgrub pa la yang sgrig 'dzugs dang ldan pa dgos gal chen po yin/ sgrig 'dzugs kyi nus pa mthar thug pa ni gzhung yin pas/ rang gi gzhung la dga' zhen dang / brtsi bkur chen po bya dgos/ da lta'i skabs su mi'i srog dbugs chad la khad lta bu'i dus skabs yin pas gnas tshul gsal po ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis mthong tshul mthun min phran bu byung ba rgyu mtshan du byas te bsam blo'i nang yid ma bde ba byas na mi legs pas/ rtsa ba'i spyi gzhung la dga' zhen byas nas de'i las don thog mang tshogs nas gcig rgyab gcig gcasan gyi rgyab khyodar byas na las don nus pa chen sngoge thon sku(nga rgyu dang /302

chos phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can gzhan gyi zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan las sems can gyi dpon po yin snyam pa'i 'du shes med pa ltar/ las byed pa rnams kyang mang tshogs kyi zhabs phyi zhu mkhan las/ mang tshogs kyi dpon po nam yang min/ nga las byed pa yin pas 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra tsam gyi to gos legs pa zhig dgos snyam pa dang / mang tshogs la gnya' gnon bshu gzhog gtong rgyu'i bsam tshul bzung na shin tu nor 'khrul red/ de 'dra'i rigs byung na nor 'khrul byed mkhan gyi do bdag de rang la mdzub mo btsugs te skyon brjod byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ spyi sgom la ngan smras byed pa dang / dha ram sa la'i las byed pa tsho zhes brjod na/ tshang ma de rigs min pas blo pham yong gi red/ de 'drar ma song ba dbye gsal chod po bya dgos/ mi mang dang / las byed/ 'go 'khrid tshang mas phan tshun bsam tshul shes rtogs legs 11 bya dgos/ bsam tshul shes rtogs byung na yid ches skye ba dang / phan tshun thag ring po byas nas bsdad na deng skabs dus tshod 'dir dkrug shing gi rigs rnam pa sna tshogs yong srid pa yin pas de tsho'i rigs la tshang mas dgongs pa zab bzhes gnang rogs gnang /da phan skad cha thengs mang byung ba ltar/ las byed pa la yang nor 'khrul nges par du yong gi red/ de rigs byung ba'i tshe sbug bsdams nas ma bsdad par thad shar skyon sel bya dgos/ 'dir mi mang gi 'thus mi gtan 'dzugs byed pa'i las 'gan gtso bo yang / phyogs gcig nas gzhung gi las khungs khag gi las don byed stangs la lta rtogs byas te gnas tshul rnams rgya che'i mang 303

tshogs la brjod rgyu dang / gnyis nas mang tshogs kyi dka' ngal sel rgyu rnams smos ci/ legs che'i bsam 'char ji yod dang / skyon dang nor 'khrul sel dgos pa'i bsam tshul ji yod las khungs so sor gsal 'debs mtshams sbyor lta bu byed pa'i ched du yin gshis/ da phan grub 'bras phran bu thon yod kyang /da dung thog ma'i bsam rtsis ltar 'grub thub min sna phyogs byung yod pas/ da phyin yang skyon dang nor 'khrul sel 'os pa gangaskudad sbas nas ma bzhag par thad kur 'don thub pa byung na/ chu la chu bzhag zer ba nges par yong gi red/da phan gang legs yod kyang da dung yang shugs stonatan zab byas te sel 'jug phra mo tsam yang mi yong ba'i khur brtson gnang rogs/de nas mjug bsdoms su zhu rgyur/ da res khyed rang rnams sku sdi'i skor yin zhes 'dzoms pa red/ yang sku phywa dang / zhabs brtan la bsnyad btags nas zhal 'debs bsdu ba dang / don med kyi brdabs gsigs bzo ba/ las ga ma byas par nyin mang po za 'du byas nas bsdad na nga dga' po gang yang med/ de rigs ma byed/ gatho rwa1 nang gi 7zhabs rim gong du bshad pa'i gnas tshul rnams sems la bzhag lam phyogs de rnams gzhi rtsar bzung nas spyi don legs po zhig bsgrubs te bod la bde skyid dang / bstan pa rgyas pa byung na nga la dgos rgyu de rang yin/ de min nga'i 'dod pa sgrub pa'i don du gzab gzab ji ltar byas kyang ngos la 'dod pa gzhan ni gang yang med/ nga mi chung chung dge slong thebs chag bod kyi gtam dpe la langs na spos dang /'gyel na sgos zer ba de rang yin la ngos 'dzin yang de 'dra rang byed kyi yod/304

nga rgyal po dang / rje dpon rigs gang yang min/ nga la yon tan dang / 'jon thang gang yang med kyang / nga shin tu stabs bde po yin pa des rang gi sgo gsum nus pa gang yod de bstan pa chab srid dang / bod rgya che'i mi mang gi zhabs phyi zhu rgyur 'don thub kyi red bsam pa'i yid ches yod/ gal te nged rang 'don pha gzhis kyi bdag po 'am/ bza' mi bu phrug dang 'brel ba zhig yin na rang gi nus pa brgya cha brgya tham pa yongs rdzogs bod spyi don la gtong mi thub/ gang yin zer na/ rang gi bza' mi bu phrug la bsam blo gtong dgos kyi red/ las byed ser skya'i nang la'ang gnas tshul de dang cha mthun yong gi 'dug nga dga' po yod pa ni bod spyi don legs po sgrub rgyu de rang yin/ de min mdun du sprel lad 'khrab/ skad cha mkhas po snyan po bshad na/ gting nas bsun snang skye ba las dga' po gang yang med pas de rtsis tshang mas spyi don sgrub byar khur brtson che bskyed gnang rogs gnang / gzhan dag da ring zhu rgyu gang yang med/khyed rang tsho gzhan dag dgongs 'char gsung mkhan yod na gsung na 'grigs/(zhes bka' gnang nas zhabs stegs steng bzhugs 'jags grub pa dang / bka' blon rnam panas so so'i dgongs 'char gsal 'debs gnang / de rjes phyoges 'dus mi mang gi 'thus mi rnams nas rang rang gi sdod sgar mi mang gis nan mngags ltar/ gtso bor 7skyabs mgon chen po zhabs pad brtan pa'i skyabs 'jug gnang dgos pa dang / mi mang nas rang don rang gces bka' gsung spyi sgrub cis kyang zhus chog pa zhes snyan seng zhus// //)305

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1965 zla 6 tshes 26 nyin/ 'bras ljongs khul sdod bod mi rnams nas brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul du bcar mir sgrol dkar tshe dbang stsal skabs kyi bka' slob/da ring 'bras ljongs nas 'byor pa'i 'thus mi tsho'i zhu mos ltar tshe sbyin sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang byed pa yin/ 'di ni chos kyi bya ba yin pas thog mar chos zhes pa ji 'dra zhig yin pa shes pa gal che/ de la chos ston mkhan gyi ston pa shes dgos/ rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa mngon sum du gzigs pas mkhyen pa bla na med pa dang / dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po mnga' bas brtse ba bla na med pa/ lus can skyob pa'i dus las skad cig kyang mi g.yel bas nus mthu bla na med pa mnga' ba yin/ de yang rmongs dad tsam ma yin par rig pa yang dag gi lam nas nges pa drangs te ston pa tshad mar nges pa na/ des bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos kyang khungs dag yid ches kyi gnas su 'gyur thub/ chos de yang so sos sgrub pa lag len ma bkal na mi phan pa/dper na/ rang la 'bras tshal sogs bza' bca'i rgyu cha sne 'dzoms yod rung /rang gis de dag g.yos sbyor byas te longs su ma spyad na togs pa la mi phan pa lta bu yin pas chos lag len du bstar dgos/ de yang jog mar skyabs 'gro rnam dag bya/ de nas nyon mongs pa'i dgras tshur 'joms pa 'gog pa'i rang srung gi tshod lta bu mi dge bcu sgong sogs tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang /dpung gsog pa lta bu sems kyi nus pa mthu can du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 306

bslab pa/ dpung dmag la mtshon cha 'grems pa lta bu'i shes rab kyi bslab pa bcas par nyams su blangs te 'khor ba'i rtsab ma rig bag chags dang bcas pa'i g.yul las rgyal bar bya/ des kyang mi cesag par/ ma rgan sems can rnams 'khor ba dang / ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la mi bzod pa'i zhing rje chen pos drangasate rgyal sras byang chub sems pa'i spyod pa phyin drug dang /bsdu bzhi sogs la bslab nas myur ba nyid du thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang cis kyang sgrub par bya/ de'i ched du dal rten 'di ring du 'tsho ba'i slad du tshe dbang zab mo zhu snyam pa'i kun slong bcos ma tshun gsal btab ste gsan dgos zhes dang / de nas dngos gzhi tshe sbyin sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe dbang gi rim pa rnams rgyas par stsal grub pa dang / mdo lugs kyi 7zhabs brtan bstar 'bul zhus// //307

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1965 zla 7 tshes 6 7sku'i 'khrungs skar gyi dus chen nyin mi mang mjal bcar thog stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring 'dir dad pa dang dam tshig ldan pa'i ser skya rnams la zhu rgyur/nga'i lo sgang tshang brtsis nas lo sum cu tham pa phyin pa'i skyes skar dus tshes kyi thog tu khyed rang tsho tshang mas bsangs gsol dang / mchog gsum gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba'i nga thug pa 'di ha cang dga' po byung / skyed rang cho tshang mar nga bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sger gyi ming thog nas thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu yin/da lta nas brtsis pa'i lo sum cu tham pa'i gong phyi lo 1935 zla 7tshes 6 de ring gi zhogs pa der nga skyes pa yin pa red/ nga zhing pa snyom chung zhig gi nang du skyes nas/ de nas da lta'i bar du lo 30 phyin 'dugaphyogs gcig nas bsam blo btang na lo 30 zer ba de mang po gang yang ma red/ nyung nyung red/ yin na yang ngos rang gi thog tu 'di'i ring dar rgud dam/ skyid sdug mang po zhig myong yod/ lo lnga tsam gyi mtshams la skyes sa'i lung pa nas yar yong ste nga rang cho ༷/da kyi rgyal sar 'khod/ de nas lo kha shas kyi ring la dpe cha bltas/ ngas nyid la ma spyid byas/ phru gu thebs chag cig byas nas nor nyan pa zhig bltas yod pa ma red/ de nas lo bco lnga bcu drug gi mtshams la slebs yong dus 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la rgyal khab che ba de chos kyang zhed snang dang do snang byed dgos pa'i khyim mtshes chen po de'i thog nas gnas tshul khyad mtshar spro zhig byung ste nga rang tsho'i lung par thabs sdug 308

po yong rgyu'i ltas ngan gyi 'go tshugs/ pho nyi shu rtsa grangs kyi bar du dus tshod de 'dra'i ngang bskyal ba dang / 1959 lo gnas tshul ha cang thabs sdug po dngos su byung nas rang gi lung pa dang bral/ mi'i yul du gyar te lo 25 tsam nas da lta bar du btsan byol ba zhes so so'i lung pa 'di yin brten khungs med pa zhig tu gyar te bsdad yod pa red/ lo sum cu tham pa de'i ring la bsam blo zhig btang dus dus tshod thabs sdug po mang po zhig brgyud de phyin 'duga'on kyang nga rang tshor las rgyu 'bras zhes pa zhig brtsi rgyu yod pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi thog nas bshad na ni bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chu ba kyi sems zhes rtag par bshad rgyupe'od pa de'i don shes pa byas na so so khag po dang / gnas tshul dka' ngal gang 'dra zhig yod pa yin na'ang rtsa ba gzhan phan nam/gzhan gyi khe phan dang 'brel ba'i don dag cig yin na/ de la gang ltar yang mtha' bzang po zhig yod pa red bsam nas yid ches/ blos bkal/ dus da lta yin rung 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang spyir btang gi mi tshos hob ste bltas pa yin na nga rang tsho rwa1da kyi gnas tshul de deng sang ha lam re ba med pa lta bu zhig gi snang la slebs te bsdadayod pa red/ yin nayang las rgyu 'bras dang / bden pa zhes pa zhig yod payin stabs tan tan bden pa'i rgyal kha de nges par gsal gyi red bsam pa'i yid ches gtsang ma zhig yod dang yod mus red/ yid ches de gzhi la bzhag nas tshang mas hur thag dang / rang ngos la cha bzhag na da lta bar du hur thag byas pa yin la/ da dung yang lo 30 phan chad kyi dka' ngal byung ba de dag skyon dang / dka' ngal la ma bltas par/ de rgyan du bltas/309

de so so'i nyams myong du bltas/ de rang gi slob sbyong du bltas/ de gzhi la bzhag nas lo 30 tshun chad yong rgyu'i dus yun ring sngar las lhag pa'i 'bad brtson dang / sngar las lhag pa'i dka' ngal dwang len gyis don dag yang snying dngos su bod rgya che'i mi mang 'di dag dang / brgyud nas sems can yongs su rdzogs par phan thub pa'i ched du smon lam rgyag gi yod la/ 'bad brtson yang byed kyi yod/ nga'i skyes skar gyi dus chen ni nga sgor gyi gnas tshul zhig yin stabs 'di thog ngos rang sger gyi bsam tshul dang / nga rang sgor gyi gnas tshul lhang tsam zhus pa yin/ yang bskyar khyed tsho tshang mar/ da ring nga'i skyes skar gyi dus chen thog tu khyed rang tsho tshang mas mchog gsum gsel 'debs dang 'brel ba'i bsangs gsol gnang ste/ lha rgyal 'then pa sogs la dga' sems 'phel ba'i ngang nas bkra shis bde legs dang / thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ zhes stsal// / /310

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1965 zla 10 tshes 2 nyin 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas ma'e sor gzhis chags su 'tshams 'dri gzigs bsgor bskyangs skabs gzhis chags don gcod khang du chibs bsgyu ra thog don gcod ngo las dang / sgar 'thus/ brgya dpon khag slob dge khag bcas mi grangs sum cu skor dang lhan du bzhugs mol lhan tshogs bskyangs pa'i sar gnang ba'i gsung mol bka' slob/da ring dus seng 'dir nga tsho bzhugs mol tshogs 'du lta bu zhig byas na bsam pa byung / 'dir khyed rang tshos bsam tshul ji yod bshad na 'grigs/nga tsho'i gzhis chags 'di dag gal chen po zhig chags yod/ kha sang skad cha byung ba bzhin gzhis chags 'di'i thog tshang mas hur thag byas nas grub 'bras gang legs thon pa la da ring yang bskyar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ dus tshod lo zla sbrel nas sgrub dgos pa'i las don 'char gzhi chen po'i rigs la tshang mas chig sgril gyi nus pa bton nas sgrub rgyu gal chen po yin/ thog mar las don thag gcod ma byas gong 'go 'khrid pas nang khul du go bsdur ji 'dra zhig byed dgos kyang bya dgos/ go bsdur nan tan byas nas thag bcad zin pa'i las don sgrub pa'i skabs tshang mas nus shugs gcig sgril gyis shar bgrod byed pa ma gtogs/ phar kyog tshur kyog byas na las don 'grub pa'i nus pa la skyon yong gi red/ der brten thag gcod ma byas gong sgor sgor gral la gral 'go med ces pa ltar rang rang gi bsam 'char gang yod kyang 'di shod rgyu lus song bsam pa med pa zhig shod dgos/ go bsdur byed skabs dge 'don 311

skyon bsrangs byed rgyu gang yod byas te mtha' ma thag bcad zin pa'i mtshams su tshang mas shar bskyod bya rgyu de gal chen po 'dug pas snga loyang skad cha byung la/ da ring yang bskyar bskul lcag byas pa yin/ 'go byed mkhan gnyis nas da phan hur thag byas yod la da dung yang rang gis ma shes pa'i skyon ni yong rgyu las/ de min hur thag bya rgyur khyed rang spyi byings tshos kyang sngar bzhin hur thag byed dgos/da lta 'dir ngas brjod 'dod yod pa ni nga rang tsho tshang mas sems la 'jog dgos pa'i gnad don skor la skad cha zhig bshad na dge mtshan phran bu mi sku1nga ngam snyam pa byung /so nam 'phrul las su bsgyur nas 'phral phugs kyi ngal ba sel dgos/nga rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ nga tsho'i gzhis chags 'di ni so nam zhing las la brten pa'i zhing pa zhig yin/ 'dzam gling gang 'dra zhig la yin rung so nam zhing las ni shin tu gal chen po yin/ mi'i rigs la lto gos gal chen po yin cing / lto zas kyi rigs mang che ba rnams sa zhing la brten nas yong dgos/ zhing pa rnams la rang rang gi skal thob sa cha rnams ni nor bu lta bu yin/ zhing pa tshos kyang rang rang gi to zas za khomasku/da med tsam du sa zhing nang dka' las brgyab/ sa zhing la nor bu'i 'du shes bzhag nas gces spras byed kyi yod pa red la/ byed 'os pa'ang red/ de ltar dga' zhen byed yul sa cha sbar mthil tsam las med kyang / de dag la thabs shes gang 'dra zhig sprod dgos kyang sprad de don snying sa zhing de nas khe 'bab gang mang zhig 312

yong thabs bya rgyu shin tu gal chen po red/ deng dus 'dzam gling yul lung mang por thon skyed bzang du 'gro bzhin yod pa red/ thon skyed bzang du 'gro ba de dag rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gnas tshul drag tu phyin pa dang / char chu bzang du phyin pa ma yin kyang / mi yi thabs shes byed stangs bzang du phyin pa red/dper na/ sngar 'bru 'bo gang thon pa'i sa zhing zhig yod na/ de la thabs shes mang du btang / thabs shes zab tu btang ste thon skyed sngar las mang ba yong thabs byas pa red/ de 'dra'i thabs shes byed stangs bzang du gtong thabs gang yin snyam na 'phrul 'khor sogs bed spyod byed pa de yin/ 'phrul 'khor bed spyod byas na/ zhing pa so so'i lus kyi dka' dub chung du dang / las ka rlabs che ru 'gro ba yin/ dper na/ sa cha rgya chen po yod na/ bed spyod legs po byed ma thub na phan thogs chen po 'byung mi thub/ rgyal khab 'ga' shas sa rgya shin tu chen po sku(da na yang sa stong mang po lus yod/ rgya gar nang rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor yar rgyas chen po ma phyin pa'i dbang gis da lta zhing pa'i gnas stangs tshad dma' po zhig tu gnas yod/ da dung glang gog ded nas thabs shes byed srol rnying pa kho na las ma byas stabs/ thon skyed yong 'bab kyang snga dus kyi kho na las 'byung mi thub/ deng dus 'phrul las yar rgyas phyin pa'i lung pa mang po sa rgya chung yang / 'phrul 'khor sogs bed spyod byas te sa char thabs shes zab po zhig sprad pa'i dbang gis thon skyed bzang po bzo thub kyi yod pa red/ des na nye stor rgya gar gyi zhing pa tshor mig dpe bltas nas chog shes byed pa dang / bod kyi so nam byed stangs kyi bag chags bzung nas 313

thabs shes byed stangs sngar lugs kho nar bsdad na/ thon skyed kyang de la dpag pa zhig las 'byung mi thub pas/ thon skyed yar rgyas ched du deng dus 'dzam gling gi 'gro lugs ltar 'phrul 'khor bed spyod bya rgyu gal chen po yin pa so nam slob ston pas kyang zer ba ltar/ nga tshos bltas na yang de ltar yin par mthong gi 'dug rgya gar nang ke ra la lta bu'i sa rgya chung la mi mang po yod pa'i sa gnas khag la ma gtogs so nam pa byings la nga tsho lta bu min par mi rer sa cha.o gar re las lhag pa med dam/ nga tshor mi lnga re yod pa'i khyim tshang re la gang zer yang sa chas kur lnga re las med stabs de nas thon skyed gang mang yong thabs bya rgyu kha tsha dgos gtugs lta bu yin/ nga tshos 'phrul 'khor bed spyod byas pa yin na/ deng dus nga tshor dmigs bsal gyi dus skabs legs po zhig 'khel te rogs ram byed mkhan yod pa'i skabs red/ rogs ram byed mkhanayod pa'i go skabs 'di bzung nas nga tshos bsam tho gtithug thog ma bsdad par/ blo rgya che tsam byasanas phugs phan gyi rogs ram len rgyu gal chen poyin/nye char lu ti 1dang skad cha byung skabs 'phrul 'khor bed spyod bya rgyu'i skor gzhis sgar 'ga' shas nang bsam tshul 'dra min med dam snyam pa'i blo dogs 'dug ces zer 'dug pa gal srid de ltarayod na 'phrul 'khor ped spyod bya rgyur the tsho ma rnam rtog ma byas par dang len byas na legs po min nam snyam/'phrul 'khor la'ang rim pa mang po zhig yong gi red/ thog mar smros 1 lu nyi ni su si'i mi rigs so nam las rigs mkhas pa bod mi'i gzhis chags khag gi so nam slob ston pa yin/314

las 'phrul 'khor gyis byed pa dang / de nas son 'debs dang / btsas ma rnga ba/ rtsa 'bru dbye 'byed sogs 'phrul 'khor gyis byed pa'i rim pa mang po zhig yod stabs da lta'i char nga tshos rim pa ji tsam byed thub min tshod dpag dka' yang / ma 'ongs par zhing las yongs rdzogs 'phrul 'khor du bsgyur rgyu'i bsam blo nges par gtong dgos/ de ltar byed thub na las don yongs rdzogs 'phrul 'khor gyis byas par brten phyogs gcig nas dus tshod mang po zhig lhag pa dang / mi'i ngal rtsol gyi nus shugs mang po zhig kyang lhag gi red/phyogs gzhan zhig nas bal las dang / shing bzo/ dkrug pa sogs lag shes byed mkhan phran bu da lta nas yod mus 'di tsho'i rigs yar rgyas btang nas bzo las stabs bde'i las ka sna tshogs byed thub pa zhig byung ste zhing las dang /bzo las mnyam sbrags su spyod thub rgyu dang / da dung de thog phyugs las 'go 'dzugs byed mus 'di dag dang bcas bzo zhing 'grog gsum cha tshang ba'i thon skyed legs po zhig byed thub kyi red/ de ltar byas na nges par du nga tsho'i 'cho ba bzang po zhig dang / gdengs 'khel ba zhig yong thub pa'i re ba chen po 'dugayang / las don dngos su lag len byed pa'i skabs lo rtog rigs 'ga' shas spyir btang gi 'khor los 'debs bsdu byed mi thub pa'ang yong srid kyang / nga tsho'i to zas kyi rgyu 'gro tshang ma rang gi sa zhing kho na'i thog nas thon dgos pa'i bsam tshul 'dzin mi dgos pas/ rang gi sa cha la skabs bstun gyi khe slebs gang che'i lo tog 'debs las byas/ to zas kyi rgyu 'gro gzhan nas nyo rgyu'i bsam blo btang na 'grigs/315

'di yang 'go 'dzugs sa gzhis sgar 'di'i nang gi thon skyed phyi phyong dang / dgos mkhe༄ ta sgrub la dmigs pa'i mnyam sbrel tshong khang yod mus 'di dag yar rgyas btang na dka' tshegs gang yang med/ gathos nga sa zhing de dag khe slebs gang cher bed spyod bya rgyu gnad chen po red/ der brten sonam 'phrul 'khor can du bsgyur rgyur 'bad brtson byadagos/ de ltar nga m+mu so nam 'phrul 'khor can du bsgyur ba la dgos pa gzhanasang yod/ da lta nga tsho rgan pa'i mi rabs deng dus kyi shes yon med pas las don gzhan dag la brten nas to gos 'tshol thabs mi thub pa'i mi rabs 'di'i rjes su yong mkhan bod phrug rnams la nga chos deng skabs slob sbyong sgrod bzhin yod pa de dag gi don du blo g.yeng che shos shig yod/ khong tsho nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di lta bu ma yin par shes yon gang la gang 'tshams shig yong rgyu yin stabs lto gos 'tshol rgyu'i thabs shes sgo gang sa nas byed thub mkhan zhig yong gi red/ da lta nga tsho'i so nam byed stangs sngar ltar rjes lus kyi ngal rtsol mang po byed dgos la/ thon skyed chen po med pa 'di 'dra zhig gi gzhis chags sar khong tshos rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu khag po yong gi red/ nga tshos khong tshor slob ston bya rgyu las btsan po byed mi thub/phyogs gcig nas slob ston byed dgos kyang / phyogs gcig tu khong cho ༄du bdag so so'i bsam khra'i nang spro ba skyed thub pa'i dge mtshan zhig ma mthong na/ bslab bya byas pa gcig pus nus pa thon pa dka'/ nga tsho'i gzhis chags 'di deng dus dang mthun pa'i 'phrul 'khor can gyi zhing las shig tu bsgyur thub pa yin na/ mi rabs rjes ma tshos kyang mu mthud mjug skyong bya rgyur the tshom med/ rgyu mtshan 316

de'i cha nas kyang nga tshos 'phrul 'khor bed spyod bya rgyu gal chen po 'dugagal srid nga tshos de ltar byed ma thub pa dang / bod phrug tshos gzhis chags 'di'i mjug skyong byed ma thub pa yin na/ gnas tshul shin tu dka' ngal chen por 'gyur nges yin/ nga tsho rgan pa'i mi rabs 'di rdzogs pa'i rjes la bu phrug tshos rang rangayon tan gang la de 'tshams re shes/ so so'i to gos 'tsho ba'i mdun lam re btsal nas kha 'thor du phyin na rim bzhin nga tsho'i gzhis chags 'dir rgya gar ba gcig 'dres/ gnyis 'dres/ nam zhig rgya gar ba'i so nam grong sde zhig tu 'gyur nges yin/ de ltar gyur na/ nga tsho'i gzhis chags 'di bzhin chos dang / shes rig mi rigs dang bcas pa srung skyob byed pa'i bsti gnas yin zhes brjod bzhin pa 'di'i snying po gtor ba red/ de 'dra byas na da lta'i mi rabs lam bzo tsam las to gos 'tshol thabs gzhan mi thub pa'i rgan rabs tsho'i mi tshe skyel sa zhig byung ba ma gtogs/ nga tsho'i chos dang / shes rig mi rigs dang bcas pa srung skyob byed pa'i bsti gnas de chags ma thub pa red/ gal te bod rang dbang 'phral myur ma byung ba'i dbang du btang na nga tsho'i chos dang / shes rig mi rigs dang bcas srung skyob byed pa'i bsti gnas shig lo nas lo dang / mi thog nas mi thog sbrel te 'dzugs pa dang / mu mthud mjug skyong byed dgos pa yin pas rgyu mtshan de'i cha nas kyang gnas tshul 'di gal chen po 'dugang tshos so nam 'phrul 'khor la brten nas byas pa yin na de 'brel thon skyed gang legs yong thub kyang / de yang tshad gzhi nges can zhig las 'byung 317

mi thub pas/ da dung yong 'bab kha ston yong ba'i ched du bzo las yar rgyas gtong ba dang / 'grog las legs po byed thub na/ thon skyed dang yong 'bab bzang nges shig 'byung thub kyi red/ de ltar byung na/ da lta 'dir bod mi sum stong tham pa gzhis chags kyi 'char gzhi yin pa 'di dag gi dgos mkho mi ldeng ba'i dka' ngal sel thub pas ma tshad/ da dung 'di'i nang bod mi mang tsam sdod thub pa/ mang tsam la las ka yong thub pa/ mang tsam 'di'i nang 'tsho thub pa bcas byung na phan thogs chen po yong nges/ der brten da lta'i mi sum stong 'di dag rang kha rang gso thub tsam byung na de gas 'grigs song snyam pa'i bsam rtsis ma bzung bar bsam blo gzhi rgya che tsam gtong dgos/ de 'dra'i dmigs yul bsgrub pa la lam phyogs mang po zhig nas thabs shes sprod dgos pa las/ sa zhing gcig bus 'grub rgyu khag po yin pas lam phyogs de 'dra zhig la nga tshos nges par du 'gro dgos/rgya gar yul mir da mus mthun 'brel dang zhing las dpe ston thub pa byed dgos/ nga tshos so nam 'phrul 'khor can du bsgyur ba dang / lag shes sam/ stabs bde'i bzo las sne mang 'dzugs pa sogs byas te nga tsho'i gzhis chags 'di'i thon skyed dang / dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshad mtho tsam byung ba yin na/ nye skor rgya gar ba'i grong gseb pa tshos mi dga' ba byed min dang /mthong tshul ji 'dra zhig yong rgyu'i skor nye dus rdzong khag gi spyi khyab pa dang skad cha byung bar khong nas bod mi rnams kyis rang khungs nas thabs shes sprad de deng dus kyi so nam par bsgyur te 'tsho ba'i gnas tshad legs po byung na rgya gar 318

ba'i so nam pa tshos mi dga' ba mi byed pas ma tshad/ da dung de la mig dpe bltas nasayar rgyas 'gro rgyur phan thogs yong gi red ces brjod kyi 'dug rgya gar so nam pa tsho dang / nga tsho'i dbar da phan yang 'brel ba gang legs yod thog da dung gnas tshul de tsho sems la bzhag ste phan tshun 'brel ba yag po byed dgos/ nga chos las ka legs po byas nas rgya gar grong gseb par mig dpe ston thub pa zhig dang / ma'e sor gzhung la bsun po bzo ma dgos pa'i khar/ da dung spyi 'gre'i gzhung khral rnams 'bul thub pa byung na 'di khul bod mi mang tsam rjod rgyur dgag pa byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gangayang yong mi shes/ der brten nga chos da dung sa cha mang tsam thob rgyu'i re ba med pa min pas de rtsis kyis bsam blo rgya che tsam gtong dgos/yang bsam tshul gcig la/ de 'dra'i gzhi rgya chen wa'i 'char gzhi dang /bsam tshul de lo nas lo bstud nas sgrub dgos pa las/ lo gcig gnyis nang yongs rdzogs sgrub mi thub/ de la lo lnga drug gam/ bcu skor 'gor srid/gal te lo lnga drug nang tshud bod rang btsan byung ba yin na nga tshos dka' las brgyab kyang snying po mi 'dug snyam na/ de la blo g.yeng byed dgos don med/nga tsho de sngon nas skad cha mang po byung ba bzhin/ nga tshos sa gnas 'dir thon skyed 'dzugs bskrun gyi las don gang thub nus shugs bsgril nas byas te/ deng dus dang mthun pa'i so nam pa yin pa la/ bzo las rnam grangs mang po yod pa/ de bzhin sman khang dang / slob gra sogs yod pa'i grong gseb legs po ha lam sdum ra'am/ dga' tshal lta bu phun sum tshogs pa blos gtong mi phod 319

tsam zhig byung na yang / phun tshogs de rnams nga tshos sgobs pa chen po'i thog nas ma'e sor gzhung dang / 'di ga'i grong gseb pa tshor zhal 'debs sam/legs skyes lta bur phul na/ nga tshor gtam don gnyis yod yong gi red/ da lta nga tshor yul lung med pa'i mi red ces brjod bzhin yod na'ang / nga tshos de 'dra zhig byed thub na dpal dang gzi brjid chen wa'i gnas tshulayong rgyu las/ de la ngo tsha dgos pa gang yang med la/ 'gyod pa skyes dgos pa de bas med/las zhor slob sbyong byas te blo rgya bskyed dgos/ phyogasagazhan du nga chos 'phrul 'khor bed spyod byas na mi'i bsam blor yar rgyas dang / 'gyur ba yong gi red/ las zhor slob sbyong byed pa 'di yang bsam blo yar rgyas dang / rgya che ru gtong thabs yin/ dper na/ bong 'ded pa zhig yin na des bong bu'i gnas tshul las gzhan gang yang mi shes pa lta bu kho nar bsdad na thabs shes dang / lag len mang po byed rgyu spros bral red/ der brten rgan 'khogs chos bod yig slob dgos zer ba dang / rgas yol tshos kyang slob sbyong byed dgos/sang nyin shi rgyu yin yang da ring slob sbyong bya dgos zer ba de'i dgos pa rgyu mtshan gathorwa nga bsam blo rgya skyed dang / gu yangs po yong thabs yin/ spyir btang bshad na/ 'phrul 'khor gyi las ka byed mkhan bzo pa rnams zhing pa'i bsam blo las phran bu gu yangs ba dang grung ba yod pas/ zhing las 'phrul 'khor can du bsgyur na slob sgrong gi cha nas kyang nga tsho'i bsam slo gu yang du dang /bsam blo'i gnas tshad mtho ru 'tho rngos yin/ yang bod rang dbang mgyogs myur byung nas mi rgan pa rnams bod du 'phral myur log rgyu'i go skabs byung tshe/320

gcig nas 'phral sel 'tsho thabs thon skyed kyi ched du yin yang / gnyis su slob sbyong zhig thob zin pas phyin chad bod du yang 'phrul 'khor bed spyod lag len byas chog cig yong gi red/wad la rang dbang byung na 'phrul 'khor gyi rigs rogs ram byed mkhan mang po yong nges yin pas/ lag len byed mkhan gyi mis ma phongs na/ 'khor los mi phongs pa yong rgyu nges can yin/ de dus khyed rang rgan pa tshor slob gra 'grims pa'i lag khyer ston rgyu med kyang / ma'e sor gzhis chags nang dka' las brgyab pa'i nyams myong gi thog nas 'khor lo bde shar shar gtong thub pa zhig byung na/ rang gi yul du lag shes kyi nus pa'i zhabs 'degs phul chog chog yong gi red/ da dung glang gog rang la bsnyes nas bsdad na/ bod du slebs nas kyang mdzo rgan zhig rang ci thob byed rgyu chags kyi red/ mdun du yid du 'ong la spyod bed che ba'i 'khor lo zhig byung na yang / ltad mo bltas nas sdod rgyu las med gshis da lta nas 'khor lor goms 'dris byung na rjes su btang chog yong rgyu yin pas de 'dra'i cha nas kyang dge mtshan chen po yod/gang ltar nga tsho'i so nam byed stangs 'phrul 'khor la brten rgyu dang / bzo las sna tshogs 'dzugs rgyu/ phyugs las 'dzugs rgyu bcas de gsum mnyam bsdebs byed thub na/ 'phral phugs gang cir dge mtshan chen po yong nges red/yang / nga tshor de snga dka' ngal chen po yod pa'i skabs lto tshang dang /zhing las mnyam 'brel byas na khe phan che ba med dam zhes bsam 'char bltasnen pa dang / de bzhin mnyam las thog lag len shugs sdon bya sa yod/ 'on 321

gcig nas 'phral sel 'tsho thabs thon skyed kyi ched du yin yang / gnyis su slob sbyong zhig thob zin pas phyin chad bod du yang 'phrul 'khor bed spyod lag len byas chog cig yong gi red/wad la rang dbang byung na 'phrul 'khor gyi rigs rogs ram byed mkhan mang po yong nges yin pas/ lag len byed mkhan gyi mis ma phongs na/ 'khor los mi phongs pa yong rgyu nges can yin/ de dus khyed rang rgan pa tshor slob gra 'grims pa'i lag khyer ston rgyu med kyang / ma'e sor gzhis chags nang dka' las brgyab pa'i nyams myong gi thog nas 'khor lo bde shar shar gtong thub pa zhig byung na/ rang gi yul du lag shes kyi nus pa'i zhabs 'degs phul chog chog yong gi red/ da dung glang gog rang la bsnyes nas bsdad na/ bod du slebs nas kyang mdzo rgan zhig rang ci thob byed rgyu chags kyi red/ mdun du yid du 'ong la spyod bed che ba'i 'khor lo zhig byung na yang / ltad mo bltas nas sdod rgyu las med gshis da lta nas 'khor lor goms 'dris byung na rjes su btang chog yong rgyu yin pas de 'dra'i cha nas kyang dge mtshan chen po yod/gang ltar nga tsho'i so nam byed stangs 'phrul 'khor la brten rgyu dang / bzo las sna tshogs 'dzugs rgyu/ phyugs las 'dzugs rgyu bcas de gsum mnyam bsdebs byed thub na/ 'phral phugs gang cir dge mtshan chen po yong nges red/yang / nga tshor de snga dka' ngal chen po yod pa'i skabs lto tshang dang /zhing las mnyam 'brel byas na khe phan che ba med dam zhes bsam 'char bltasnen pa dang / de bzhin mnyam las thog lag len shugs sdon bya sa yod/ 'on 321

kyang lo rim song mtshams dngosaskudad kyi gnas tshul thog nas dka' ngal gzhan dag dang 'phrad pa'i tshe gnas tshul de dang bstun nas mnyam las bzhag nas sgor 'dzin byas pa'ang byung yod/ mnyam las ma byas na mi chog ces khrims lugs lta bur 'dzin dgos pa min par rang dbang yod/ deng skabs phag ri ba'i to shog gcig da dung mnyam las byed mus ltar byung song zhib rtsis byas na mnyam las la dge mtshan yod kyang / sgor 'dzin byed mkhan tshorayang rang don rang gces kyi sha tsha che ba'i byed stangs kyi dge mtshan dpag stod cig thon gyi yod pa red/ der brten phyin chad bod la'ang za mnyam 'thung mnyam dang /las don sha tsha gcig bsgril gyis byed 'dod yod mkhan mang po yong rgyur de tsho'i rigs rang 'dod ltar mnyam las bya rgyu dang / yang / rang rang thab tsho logs su zin/ las ka logs su byed 'dod yod mkhan zhig kyang yong rgyur/des mtshon sger 'dzin khe dbang 'os 'tshams rigs kyang rang 'dod ltar byed rgyu yong dgos nges can red/ da lta'i gnas skabs su gzhis chags nang 'gro lugs gnyis ka yod pas de bzhin byas na legs po min nam snyam/ dka' ngal che ba'i tshe mnyam las la dgos pa dge mtshan yod kyang / mi so so'i bsam blo'i nang spyi la sha zhen slebs ma thub tshe skyid lug dang / par khag tshur dkris byed pa'i go skabs che shos shig yong gi yod pa red/ ming mnyam las btags kyang dngos yod gnas tshul thog las ka 'thus shor 'gro gzhi de lta bu byung tshe sger 'dzin byas kyang legs/zhing bdag dang / zhing bran 'gro lugs sngon 'gog mthar bskyel byed 322

dgos/ de nas tshang mas cho rwarngos bya dgos pa zhig la/ nga tshos gong du bshad pa'i bya thabs de rnams lag len byas na 'tsho ba nges par je legs su 'gro thub kyi red/ 'tsho ba'i gnas tshad drag tu phyin pa'i mtshams su gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig yong srid/ thog mar las rtsol thog mi hrag los dang / de nas rim bzhin mi'i bsam blo grung los byung / de gnyis bsdebs pa'i 'bras bur mi tshang gcig la thon skyed phran bu legs pa dang / gzhan zhig la thon skyed dman pa'i cha mi sgoms pa zhig yong gi red/ da lta'i char de 'dra'i cha mi snyoms pa cung zad tsam las med kyang / de la do snang byed ma thub na nam zhig skyonayong nyen yod/ dper na/ mi cha hrag la therted pa des las ka shugs chen 11 byed thub pa yin stabs thon skyed bzang ba byung / mi cha zhan pa der thon skyed chung ba'i khar sa cha yongs rdzogs rang gis 'debs skyong ma thub pa'i dka' ngal byung / mi hrag pa dang bsam blo grung ba des skabs de zin nas khyim tshang mi cha zhan pa der rogs ram byas te de'i sa zhing gang 'tshams rang gis 'debs 'dzin byas te de la khe 'bab babs mtshungs shig sprad nas rogs ram byas pa red/ thog ma'i 'go 'dzugs stangs de ni drang bden dang / rogs ram shin tu legs po zhig red/ 'on kyang de rjes mi grung ba de'i bsam wā rim pa bzhin du 'gyur te gzhan la rogs ram ched du rang gis 'debs las byas pa'i sa cha de rang nyid sgor gyi yin pa'i 'du shes skye ba dang / nam zhig mi gzhan dag de khyim sto ma zin pa na sa cha de rnams rang nyid kyis yongs su bdag 'dzin byas/ de ltar rim bzhin sa cha mang du mang du phyin/ rgya gar nang de 'dra'i 'gro stangs med na ni legs/ gal te yod na de 323

la dogs zon byed dgos/ sa cha mang ba des thon skyed bzang ba 'byung dus shugs ma thub kyis zas gos dpal 'byor bzang ba 'byung / zhing pa 'khos zhan tshos 'byor ldan de la yang nas yang du ma re thabs med byung du sa/ bod la byed pa ltar bu yon gtong len dang / gte ma 'jog len sogs byas/ khe skyed kyang lnga drug 'gro zer ba sogs 'jal sprod byas/ de rnams bod du thog mar so nam zhing pa dar ba'i dus skabs nas byung ba min yang / de rjes rim bzhin byung ba yin/ de 'dra byung na sa cha che ba der dpal 'byor gyi cha nas dbang dang nus pa che ba zhig shugs kyis chags/ 'khos zhan tshos de la re 41sa bya dgos stabs sa zhing rgya che ba des gzhan dag la thog mar zhing las la gla sgrig byed kyang / de nas rim pa bzhin gla sgrig gi rnam pa je chung du phyin nas bran g.yog bskul 'ded byed pa lta bur gyur/ de ltar byas na nga tsho'i ma'e sor gzhis chags 'di rim bzhin zhing bran lam lugs su 'gyur ba'i nyen ga yod/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul de la nga tshos nges par yid 'jog bya dgos/ rang re'i bod la snga dus nas zhing bran lam lugs shig dar nas yod/ 'on kyang zhing bdag yongs rdzogs nag po yug gcig la btang nas log spyod pa red ces rgya mis zer ba de lta bu gtan nas min/ zhing bran dang / zhing bdag gi bar 'brel ba ches bzang po pha ma bu tsha lta bu'i 'brel ba yod pa'ang yod 'dug 'on kyang spyir btang brjod na /zhing bdag zhing bran dang / sa bdag gi nus pa mthar thug pa rigs rgyud kyis 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sogs kyi dus tshod yol zin pas de dag rgya dmar nas zer ba ltar ro langs rgyag thabs med/ snga mo de'i tshe de'i dus de dag la dge mtshan 324

re zung yod shag kyang / da cha dus tshod 'gyur te 'gro lugs de dag la skyon yod pas phyin chad de ltar yong thabs med/ 'ga' shas nas ngas rgya mi'i skad cha shod kyi 'dug snyam du dran srid kyang / rgya mi'i skad cha min/ 'di ni 'dzam gling spyi'i 'gro lugs shig red/ bod du zhing bran gyi lam lugs yod pa der rang re mang che bas skyon du mthong gi yod kyang / 'ga' shas rang gi snang ba dag nas snang med du lus srid/ da cha rgya mis nga tsho'i skyon phran bu zhig yod pa der kha snon ri rab tsam brgyab nas nga tshor skyon 'dzugs byed bzhin yod/ gang ltar 'gro stangs der skyon yod pa las dge mtshan gang yang med/ 'on kyang skyon de yong stangs ni rim bzhin byung ba zhig las glo bur du byung ba min/ dper na/rgad po tshos shes gsal bzhin lo 20 son pa zhig do nub nyal te sang nyin lang dus lo 90 tsam son pa lta bur 'gyur mi srid kyang / skra gnyer re re bzhin gcig skyes gnyis skyes kyis nam zhig mgo dkar po gyur/ gdong gnyer mas khengs dus do snang byung ba las/ bsdebs gcig glo bur du byung ba min/de bzhin nga tsho'i zhing pa'i 'gro stangs thog la yang do snang nges gtan ma byas na/thog mar rogs ram yin mdog dang / sha tsha che mdog gi gnas tshul de nam zhig gnas tshul thabs sdug tu 'gyur na mi 'grigs/ ma 'ongs par nga cho dad duyang zhing bran lam lugs su rtsa ba nas 'gro mi shes/ gzhung sger chos gsum zer ba'ang yong mi shes/ bod spyi la dbang ba'i gzhung zhig ma gtogs/ sngar gyi sger dpon yong mi chog la/ chos gzhis kyang yong mi chog de 'dra'i gnas tshul byung na dgag cha mi byed thabs med yin/ rjes su chen po chags zin 325

na zhing bdag la'ang blo pham 'byung zhing / zhing bran tsho dang zhing bdag gi bar la yang 'gal zla chen po yong nyen yod/ der brten da lta nga tshos rgya gar du gzhis chags byed pa'i skabs 'di nas bzung gnas tshul de'i phyogs la mi 'gyur ba'i do snang bya dgos/ rang gis ngal rtsol byas nas rang gi lto gos thabs rtsol bya dgos/ de ltar byas nas nyin re sgor 15 tsam 'gro song gtong thub mkhan zhig dang / nyin re a na re las spyod mi thub mkhan gcig byung rung 'gal ba med la/ yang dag pa yin/ rang rang la thob thang yod nges shig longs su spyad pa red/ de ltar min par dka' las mi gzhan zhig gis brgyab/ dka' las rgyag mkhan tshor nyin rera.a na re las med pa dang / mi gzhan dag des nyin re sgor 15 re bed spyod byas na de thabs sdug red /gal te gnas tshul de 'dra zhig chags zin pa yin na nga snuras bzo bcos ma byas thabs med yin/ bzo bcos byed pa la dka' rnyog 'gal zla mang po yong rgyur brten nga tshos snga sa nas de ltar mi 'byung ba'i ched du dwogs zon do snang dang /yid gzab nges par du byed dgos/nga tsho'i gzhis chags 'di ma'e sor mnga' sde 'di'i sa zhing khrims lugs ltar 'gro dgos pas mnga' sde'i sa zhing 'gro lugs nang de 'dra'i ya yud kyi gnas tshul yong nyen med pa yin na smos med/ de ltar 'byung nyen yod pa zhig yin na nga tshos de skor mkhas pa zhig bsten/ ched du lta rtogs byed mkhan sgrig 'dzugs shig btsugs/ nga tsho'i dngos yod kyi gnas stangs kyi dge skyon gnad 'gag la zhib 'jug byas/ rgya gar gyi zhing pa'i 'gro lugs la'ang bltas nas/ dgos 326

nges byung na nga tshos nang khrims lta bu zhig bzos na snyam du dran gyi 'dug ngas sa zhing gi 'gro lugs mi shes pas da ring 'di dang 'di zhes brjod rgyu med kyang /nga chos bsam tshul 'di 'dra zhig 'dzin dgos kyi med dam snyams/da ring nga tsho nang khul dang / ltod ltod byung skabs bshad na/ dka' las mi mang po zhig gis brgyab/ rnam dpyod mi gcig gis btang na bzod thabs med pa zhig rang bzhin gyis 'byung ba yin/ dper na/ nga tshos rgya gar gzhung nas zas phogs sprod kyi yod kyang nga tshos lo khor yug tu dka' las brgyab/ thon skyed byung ba'i lo tog rnams rgya gar las byed pas blangs te khyon 'bor 'di byung dang / bed spyod 'di byas tsam ma brjod pa'i tshe sems nang ma skyid pa lta bu zhig yong srid pa de bzhin du/ zhing bran tshos snga dro nam langs nas dgong dro sa srod bar dka' las rgyab ste zhing bdag drag pa zhig byung na kha mkhas po zhig shod srid/ sdug pa zhig byung na brdung brdegs dang sbrags nas btsan bskul byed/ zhing bran tshos rang lus kyi nus shugs gang yod bton pa'i khe 'bab rnams zhing bdag tshos blangs/ zhing bran chos rang re bod kyi brjod srol ltar snying rje sbar tshod lta bu cung zad re sprod pa yin/ 'di skor nga las mang ba khyed rang tshos shes gsal red/ gong du bshad pa ltar zhing bdag tshang ma de 'dra min yang / sdug pa tsho shin tu thabs sdug po yod nges yin/ de 'dra'i 'gro lugs rnams ches snga dus kyi spyi tshogs rjes lus kyi gnas stangs shig yin pa las legs po gang yang min/ da dung mi rtsa mi khungs ded de 'u thug dus gra pa byed dgos pa'i lugs srol yod/ gang ltar yang phyin chad bod 327

rang dbang byung ba'i mtshams su sngar gyi gnas tshul sdug po de tsho'i rigs rtsa ba nyid nas yong thabs med/ mi gang yang mi shes mkhan zhig yin na ma gtogs/ gnas lugs shes mkhan tshos de la dga' bsu til 'bru tsam yang mi zhu nges can yin/ lhag par deng dus bod nang rgya mis slob sbyong sprad pa'i bod mi gzhon nu rnams rang rigs dang / rang yul la dga' zhen chen po yod kyang / bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i gnas stangs la zhen pa log nas yod/ kho tshos bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying par dge mtshan phran yod rnams ni shes mi thub cing /skyon yod pa rnams la kha ston dang bcas rgya mis khong tsho'i klad par phyi byugs nang blugs byas yod stabs skyon gyi rigs la dga' zhen gtan nas byed mi srid /de bzhin du deng skabs rgya gar nang nga tshos slob sbyong sprod bzhin pa'i bod phrug rnams kyis kyang deng dus 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul gang 'tshams shig shes mtshams lugs rnying skyon can la dga' thabs med/ da lta nga tsho sa zhing bed spyod byed bzhin yod stabs de 'dra'i skyon cha ma lhags pa bya rgyu gal chen po yin/khyed rang 'go byed tshos gnas tshul de rnams rang rang gi bsam blor nges pa byas/ de la do snang byas te/ ched du tshogs 'du bsdu bskong ma dgos par zhar dang zhor la rang khongs kyi mi chos skad cha bshad/ 'brel bshad byas na gnas tshul ngan pa khyab gdal mi 'gro bar phan thogs yong gi red/ gzhis chags nang 'khyer 'khos thabs shes bzang lu+os phran bu yod stabs de che ru che ru phyin nas nam zhig gnas tshul sdug chag rigs shar na mi 'grigs/ gcig byas na khyed rang brgya dpon tsho'i nang la yod 'gro/ rang la brgya dpon gyi ming 328

snyan po zhig yod stabs gzhan dag la bshu gzhog phran bu phran bu byed mkhan yod 'gro/ tha na pad gcig las ma byung yang bshu gzhog byed mkhan yod 'gro/brgya dpon tsho'i nang de 'dra yod dam/ de 'dra yod na rjes la 'thab 'dzings bzed dgos byas yong / a tsi rtsed mo byas/nga tshos mang gtso spus dag gi sgo nas rang dbang gi yul du bsdad pa'i don go chod pa byed dgos/ gang ltar/ nga tshos ma'e sor gzhis chags 'di bzhin lam bzang po zhi ga la 'khrid thub na bzo zhi nga 'brog gsum tshang ba'i gnas tshul legs po zhig yod/ dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi cha nas deng dus dang mthun pa'i 'chor bar spyod thub pa dang / mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i nang chos srid gnyis ldan gyi lta ba yod pa/ de 'dra'i lag rjes su 'di phyi gnyis yod yong thub pa/ de'i thog la nga tsho'i thun mong goms srol dang / shes rig mi rigs dang bcas pa srung skyob byed thub pa yong gi red/dper na/ rgya mis nye char bod rang skyong btsugs lugs brjod bzhin pa red/ de skabs pe cing nas yong ba'i sku tshab tshogs pa zer ba'i gtso bo des brjod gsal la rgya gar nang yul gyar phyin pa'i bod mi rnams ga dus phyir log byas kyang dga' bsu yod/ ces brjod pa de ni de sngon nas brjod mus shig red/ de'i thog tshig 'phar snon zhig yod pa ni/ bod du phyir log nas lta tsam byas rjes sdod 'dod med na da dung phyir 'gro chog gi red/ ces bshad 'dug phar phyin nas tshur gtong gi yod med mi shes kyang / skad cha de nga tshos brjod 'os —pa zhig red/ nga tshor rang btsan 'phral myur byung na gang legs 329

kyang / gal te rang btsan re zhig ma byung bar cha bzhag yo bcu sgor gyi rjes la 'dzam gling la 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung / rgya dkar nag gi 'brel ba legs po zhig byung ba yin na/ nga tshos 'dzam bu gling la ston 'pher ba zhig dgos kyi red/ ma'e sor gzhis chags 'di dag bod mi sum stong tham pa'i grod pa gcig pu'i don du rtsa ba nas ma yin/ bod spyi pa'i don du yin zhes ngas de snga nas brjod mus yin/ tshul ji ltar yin nam zhe na/ dpal 'byor yongs spyod kyi cha dang / shes yon bsam blo'i cha gang nas kyang bod du rgya dmar gung bran gyi 'og tu yod pa tsho las ches lhag pa zhig ma byung na yang ma chad pa zhig nges par du dgos kyi red/ de byung na de'i thog tu nga tshor 'phar du rang dbang yod pa yin stabs mi su 'dra zhig yin kyang 'di 'dems kyi red/ da lta rgya mis lta skor la shog ces bzo gra sogs 'ga' shas ston rgyu yin kyang de rnams bed spyod rgya mis byed bzhin yod/ nga tshos ngo thog don dam par bod mi rang gis longs su khyodi rgyu yod pa'i gzhis chags legs po zhig done rgyu byung na yag po ma red dam/ bod nang yod pa'i bod mi tsho dang / rgya gar rang dbang gi yul nang bzod sran chen po'i thog nas dka' ngal khyad gsod byed mkhan gyi bod mi rnams su bzang su skyid gung bran gyis slob sbyong sprad pa'i bod mi gzhon nu tsho yang rgya gar nang yong rgyu'i go skabs byung na khong tshos kyang mthong gi red/nga tshos dka' las brgyab pa'i grub 'bras rnams khong tshor bstan nas khong tsho'i mig la chu zhag 'khor ba zhig bzo dgos pa las/ khong tsho rang dbang gi yul du bsdad de kha thabs 'di 'dra zhig las mi 'dug snyam pa zhig mthong na zhabs 330

'dren red/ khong tsho rgya gar rang dbang gi yul du gnyid nyal nas bsdad 'dug zer ba zhig chags na nga tsho dngos gnas ngo tsha ba'i rang bzhin zhig ma red dam/phyin chad go skabs bzang po zhig byung nas/ bod nang la'ang mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs kyi sku tshab lta bu lta skor du bskyod thub pa byung ba'i tshe/ rgya gar nang gi bod mi'i gnas tshul ni tshang mas mthong gsal yin/ bod nang ngo thog yar rgyas 'dzugs bskrun legs pa byung ste/ bod rgya che'i mi mang gi bde skyid khe phan bod nang bzang ba zhig dngos su yod pa yin na gang 'dra zhig chags kyi re da dam/ dus skabs de 'dra zhig yong rgyu thag ring po yin yang / gal te byung na nga tshos 'gran bsdur 'pher ba zhig byed snyam pa'i khog rtsis dang sgobs pa skyed rgyu gal chen po yin/ bsam blo'i nang chos srid gnyis ldan yod pa/spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs mang gtso rang dbang yin pa/ thon skyed dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs deng dus dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba'i gnas tshad bzang po yod pa/ sgrig 'dzugs kyi gnas stangs thad gzhis chags 'di nang 'dzin skyong las khungs lta bu'i tshogs pa zhig 'dzugs dgos/ tshogs pa de'i mi 'gro rnams gzhis chags 'di'i nang gi mi mang tshos rang mos kyi 'os bsdu byas te/ dper na/ dzña sa dbus gzhung lta bur cha bzhag nas de nas sku tshab lta bu zhig dgos mkho yod na las de min gzhis chags 'di ga rang nas 'os bsdu'i thog nas byung ba zhig yin na srid don gyi jog nas mang gtso chags bsdad yod/ de 'dra zhig byung ba yin na phyogs mang po nas dge mtshan ha cang chen po yod/ dper na/ 'di'i nang sman khang dang / slob gra/ thon skyed kyi 'dzugs bskrun gzhan 331

dag bcas gang 'dra zhig yin na yang 'dzin skyong las khungs de ga'i thog nas bsam blo btang / go bsdur byas/ 'char gzhi bkod/ thag bcad nas las ka byas chog gi red/ rang btsan gyi las khungs shig byung na/ phyogs gcig nas da lta gzhis chags byas te sdod pa'i ring la yang las ka 'phral 'phral thag gcod thub pa'i thog la/ las ka de dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang ran pa zhig yong thub kyi red/ de ni gzhis sgar dang gnyis so so nas 'os bsdu byed pa sogs gang ltar mang gatsho'i 'gro stangs shig yod dgos/ de yang mang gtso yag po zhig yong ba la mang phyogs la shes yon dgos pa yin/ yon tan med na mang gtso yag po yong shes stangs med/ da lta nga tshos bod pa nyung shas tshang mas las zhor slob sbyong gis mtshon shes yon la do snang byed mus su yod pas nga tsho mi nyung nyung spus dag po zhig chags srid pa yin stabs/ bsam blo btang nas so so'i sgrig 'dzugs rim pa'i thog nas nga rang tsho'i mang gatho'i 'gro stangs yag po zhig byung ba yin na/ rgyal khab yar rgyas phyin pa'i lung pa chung chung de tsho'i nang la yod pa ltar/ tshang ma so so rang skyong byas nas rdzong chung chung zhig yin yang de rang skyong byas/ sud dza lan ter cha bzhag na dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul yag po yod tshod/ dper na/ nga tsho'i gzhis sgar dang po rang skyong gcig dang / gnyis pa rang skyong gcig gsum pa rang skyong gcig lta bu so so'i nang rang skyong re dang / 'di dag tshang ma gcig tu gnas pa'i spyi thog la 'dzin skyong las khungs mtho shos gcig btsugs/ de nas gzhis sgar dang po'i nang yar rgyas ji tsam gtong dgos kyi yod na yang de'i nang gi nus 332

pas ldeng tshod cig kho rang tshos bsam blo btang / gros bsdur byas/ 'char gzhi bkod de thag bcad nas/ de'i nus pas ma sdeng pa de de'i gong rim thun mong gi 'dzin skyong las khungs mjo shos nas byed pa bcas yong ma thub pa gang yang med/ mi nyung nyung spus dag po zhig gi thog la sgrig 'dzugs kyang spus dag po zhig chags thub nges yin/ de 'dra byung ba yin na/ deng dus kyi 'dzam gling 'di nang tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor longs spyod dang / srid/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs tshad mtho por slebs yod pa'i rgyal khab de tsho nang bzhin chags thub pa yin/ de 'dra zhig byung dus bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gsung ba de ngo ma chags nas mang gtso ha cang gi spas dag po zhig yong thub kyi red/ gzhis skar dang po'i 'go 'dzin de gzhi~X sgar dang po rang nyid yin pa dang / gzhi sa sgar 'di dag yongs rdzogs kyi 'go 'dzin ni tshang ma spyi 'dus kyi gzhis skar 'di yin pas so so'i dpon po so sos dang /so so'i 'char gzhi 'god mkhan so so yin/ de 'dra byung na bsam blo'i nang la bde skyid dang / spobs pa slebs thub/ de 'dra zhig byung ba yin na 'gran bsdur byed thub/ dper na/ rgya mis bod nang rang skyong ljongs zhes ming btags pa'i las khungs kyi sgrig 'dzugs de'i 'og nas mang gtso gang 'dra zhig byed thub kyi red dam/ nga rang tsho rgya gar du yod pa tshos dang jog btsan byol ba'i ming zhig 'khyer nas lo nas lo bstud dka' ngal khyad du bsad de bdar sha bcad pa'i mtha' mar nga tsho mang gtso gang 'dra zhig tshugs yod med 'gran bsdur byed thub pa yin/ gnyis nas phyin chad nga chor ngad rang dbang byung ba'i mtshams 333

la'ang sgrig 'dzugs gnas stangs de nges par du bod nang la dgos nges yin pas nga tshos sgrig 'dzugs legs po 'di dag 'di nas lung pa spos pa ji bzhin bod nang bzhag chog chog yong gi red/ nga tsho bod la chol kha gsum gcig tu sgril ba'i tshogs 'du che mo dang / de'i thog dbus gzhung / de'i 'og sa khul so so dang / rdzong so so'i gzhung chags nas/ gang ltar sa khul so so'i nang la rang skyong gi gzhung re chags dus 'thus ma shor ba/ tshags tshud po zhig yong thub kyi red/ der brten nga tshos slob sbyong sprod thub pa dang / dpe mtshon byed thub pa'i re ba dang go skabs yod/ de lta'i gnas tshul yong dus gong du bshad pa bzhin deng dus dang mthun pa'i so nam zhing las/ 'brog las/bzo las dang / spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs thog la'ang rang gis ngal rtsol byas nas rang nyid 'tsho thub pa zhig dgos/ zhing bdag ces yar tsam du yod pa dang / zhing bran zhes mar tsam du yod pa lta bu de 'dra min pa zhig dgos kyi red/spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba 'khos snyoms pa'i gnas tshul de sngar chos rgyal tsho'i dus su bod la dbul phyug lan gsum snyoms pa yin zhes gsungs yod de 'khos snyoms te sdod ma thub pa red/ de gang gis ma 'grigs pa yin nam snyam na bsod nams che chung gi thog nas byung ba yin zhes gsungs yod pa red la/ yin thag chod cig red/ yin na yang dus kyi dbang gis spyi tshogs sgrig 'dzugs kyi gnas tshul thog nas kyang khyad par med dam snyam/ nga'i bsam tshod la/ dper na/ chos rgyal gyi skabs su dbul phyug lan gsum stoms 334

pa yin na yang / snyoms nas de gar bzhag pa ma gtogs de'i rjes la stangs 'dzin byasa.e yod/ gcig byas na stangs 'dzin byas med dam/ gnyis nas rgyal po'i gnas tshul red/ nga tsho bod kyi chos rgyal tsho dngos 'brel 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa yin yang rung / byin gyis brlabs pa yin na'ang rung / de'i tshe de'i dus kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs la ran zhing 'tshams pa dang / phyag bya ba'i yul du gyur pa zhig red de/ yin na yang de dus kyi spyi tshogs kyi rgyal po yin pa las deng skabs kyi gnas tshul 'di 'dra ma red/ der brten gzhung gzhung zer na'ang rgyal pos skyong ba'i gnas tshul yin/ de ni lo chig stong gong gi gnas tshul zhig yin stabs 'dzam gling gang sar 'di 'dra red ma gtogs nga tsho bod gcig pu rjes lus thebs pa'i gnas tshul zhig ma red/ skabs de'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi gnas tshul de'i nyer len gyis dbul phyug lan gsum las lhag pa'i lan brgya tham pa snyoms na yang khungs 'khyol thabs med pa red/ nga tsho da lta'i gnas skabs la cha bzhag na dbul phyug lan gcig snyoms pa lta bu red/ sus snyoms pa red zer na rgya mi dmar pos snyoms pa red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba chags bsdad yod/ kha shas la.am phrag tu phor pa 'khyer rgyu yod med tsam dang / 'ga' shas la gser gyi tshigs khebs 'dra dang / chu tshod 'dra 'khyer rgyu yod med kyi khyad par tsam yod na ma gtogs tshang ma snyoms yod pa red/ nga rang tsho so sos bsags pa'i las kyi dbang gis gang ltar gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig chags yod/ da cha nga mos spyi tshogs kyi sgrig 'dzugs gnas stangs legs po zhig bzo thub pa 335

yin na/ mi la dbul phyug tan tan yong gi red de/ ha cang bar khyad chen po'i dbul phyug ma snyoms pa de yag po min/ dpe mtshon lta bur skyo shos la sgor bcu grangs las med pa dang / phyug shos la sgor 'bum tsam gyi he bag sku(da na yang / ma 〉(sa tsam yin na/ skyod shos la 〈(ra re gnyis las med mkhan dang / phyug shos der sgor dung phyur mang po yod pa'i he bag yod na nam yang mi 'grigs/ tshang ma mi yin pa ni gcig pa red/ der brten 'di 'dra'i khyad par chen po 'gro ba ni ha cang gi thabs sdug red/ de 'dra'i khyad par 'gro dus lung pa'i nang la'ang gnas tshul khag po yong gi red/ ma 'ongs pa na nga cho bod la gang 'dra zhig byed kyi red zer na/ 'di 'dra'i he bag chen po zhig gtan nas 'grigs kyi ma red/ dbul phyug ces pa yong rgyur nges na'ang / dbul phyug de phran bu'i khyad par yod pa tsam zhig ma gtogs gnam sa 'dzol ba lta bu byung na rtsa ba nas yag po ma red/ des na nga tshos da lta nas dpal 'byor gyi thog nas yin yang rung / srid kyi thog la yin na'ang rung / sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog la yin yang rung gang ltar tshang ma'i cha nas nga tshos spus dag po legs po zhig yong thabs byed dgos/da yang dbul phyug lan gsum snyoms pa red zer ba de skor 'di 'dra zhig dran gyi 'dug nga tsho mi'i bsam sdu'i nang la dbul phyug lan gsum snyoms nas kyang 'khos ma snyoms pa de rang rang bsod nams kyi byas pa red ces brjod kyi red/ de tan tan red/ yin na yang bsod nams zhes pa de so sos 'bad brtson byas nas bsags dgos pa yin/ dper na/ nga tsho'i chos kyi thog la 336
