cha bzhag na/ mi zhig shes rab med par chos phyogs kyi slob gnyer ha cang skyo po yod pa yin na/ de la khyed bsod nams kyis de las ma grub pa red ces bskyur 'jog byed kyi med khar/ da dung khyod kyi nyams len dang / bsags sbyang byas nas ga le ga ler yar bskyed thub pa byed dgos zhes thabs shes byed kyi yod pa dang / yang spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul la cha bzhag na/ mi zhig skyo po chags na.a kha khyed rang gi bsod nams kyis ma grub pa red ces bskyur rkyang byas te yar rgyas gtong thabs ma byas na mi 'grigs/ don la 'di gnyis ka gcig pa red/ gnyis ka 'bad brtson byas nas yar rgyas 'gro rgyu yod pa zhig yin pas/ chos rgyal tshos dbul phyug lan gsum snyoms nas kyang 'a|(sa ma snyoms pa yin dus/ de'i lan la bsod nams kyis ma grub pa yin stabs byed thabs yod pa ma red ces spyid lug ste bsdad na ga nas 'grigs/ da gang byed dgos snyam na/ sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog nas mjug skyong byed dgos/ nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs de btsan po'i thog nas min par rang dbang dang / mang mos kyi thog nas yong gi red/ de 'dra red dam ma red/ ngos nas de 'dra zhig dran gyi 'dug de khyed rang tsho'i sems la nges pa byed rogs/mis byas nas ma 'grub pa gang yang med par bsam dgos/ mtha' don/ tshang mas da lta phan la hur thag byas pa red la/ da dung yang snying stobs ma zhum pa'i sgo nas bsam khra'i spobs pa bskyed de nga tshos byed thub pa dang / nga chos sgrub thub bsam pa'i blo stobs bskyed dgos/ dper na/ nga rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal 1959 dang 60 'ong do tsho'i nang gang yang med kyang nga 337

cha bzhag na/ mi zhig shes rab med par chos phyogs kyi slob gnyer ha cang skyo po yod pa yin na/ de la khyed bsod nams kyis de las ma grub pa red ces bskyur 'jog byed kyi med khar/ da dung khyod kyi nyams len dang / bsags sbyang byas nas ga le ga ler yar bskyed thub pa byed dgos zhes thabs shes byed kyi yod pa dang / yang spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul la cha bzhag na/ mi zhig skyo po chags na.a kha khyed rang gi bsod nams kyis ma grub pa red ces bskyur rkyang byas te yar rgyas gtong thabs ma byas na mi 'grigs/ don la 'di gnyis ka gcig pa red/ gnyis ka 'bad brtson byas nas yar rgyas 'gro rgyu yod pa zhig yin pas/ chos rgyal tshos dbul phyug lan gsum snyoms nas kyang 'a|(sa ma snyoms pa yin dus/ de'i lan la bsod nams kyis ma grub pa yin stabs byed thabs yod pa ma red ces spyid lug ste bsdad na ga nas 'grigs/ da gang byed dgos snyam na/ sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog nas mjug skyong byed dgos/ nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs de btsan po'i thog nas min par rang dbang dang / mang mos kyi thog nas yong gi red/ de 'dra red dam ma red/ ngos nas de 'dra zhig dran gyi 'dug de khyed rang tsho'i sems la nges pa byed rogs/mis byas nas ma 'grub pa gang yang med par bsam dgos/ mtha' don/ tshang mas da lta phan la hur thag byas pa red la/ da dung yang snying stobs ma zhum pa'i sgo nas bsam khra'i spobs pa bskyed de nga tshos byed thub pa dang / nga chos sgrub thub bsam pa'i blo stobs bskyed dgos/ dper na/ nga rang tsho tshang mas shes gsal 1959 dang 60 'ong do tsho'i nang gang yang med kyang nga 337

tsho mis thabs shes sprad nas da cha 'di tsam zhig chags yod/ nga tshos da lta 'dzugs bskrun yod pa 'di rnams ma gdan gzhi ma lta bu byas nas ma 'ongs par da dung mthun rkyen 'di las mang du dang / zab tu gtong dgos/ da lta rten gzhi zhig byung ba yin stabs des rkyen mthun rkyen mang du dang / zab tu 'gro thub pa yin/ der brten nga tshos sgrub ma thub pa rtsa ba nas med/ gtso bo khyed rang tshos spobs pa chen po'i thog nas sngar las lhag pa'i 'bad brtson dang shugs ston brgyab nas gal che shos sgrub thub kyi red bsam pa zhig dgos/nga tsho mis byas nas ma 'grub pa gang yang med bsam pa byed rgyu 'di ha cang gal gnad chen po yin/ nga tsho da lta btsan byol ba'i spobs pa kho na'i thog tu bsdad nas grod khog rgyags tsam zhig byung na 'di ga tsam zhig red/ da 7rgyal ba rin po che'i thugs rje bka' drin gyisa.ang ki dang po red ces bsdad na ha cang gti thug gi bsam blo red/ nga'i thugs rje lta ga nas yin/ gang ltar nga rang tsho tshang mas 'bad brtson byas pa'i grub 'bras red/ da dung nga tshos 'bad brtson mang tsam byas na grub 'bras kyang mang tsam thob kyi red/ nga tshos 'bad brtson mang tsam byas na grub 'bras mang tsam yong ba'i gnas tshul 'di gcig nas 'dir yod pa'i bod pa tsho gcig pu'i don dang / gnyis nas so so'i mi tshe gcig pu'i don du ma red/ nga tsho chos dang 'brel nas yod pa red/ dper na/ spyod 'jug nang la/ bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bsti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig ces gsungs pa de rnam kun smon lam rgyag gi yod pa ltar brgyud nas ded na rtsa ba de chos dang 'brel ba'i mi rigs 'dzin skyong 338

gi thabs su'ang 'gro ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas thabs kyi bya ba la 'gro ba ni brjod mi dgos/ der brten khyed rang tsho mi stong phrag gnyis gsum gyi rang kha rang gso bya rgyu tsam yin na/ de ni don dag chung chung zhig ma red dam/ khyed rang tsho bsam blo zhig thongs dang / so so sgor gyi don dag la chog shes byed rgyu gal chen po yin yang / nga tsho'i spyi pa'i las ka red/ mi rigs dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bya ba gal chen po zhig yin stabs chog mi shes pa dang / ngoms pa med pa'i jog nas yar rgyas 'gro thub pa zhig bsam blo gtong rgyu de gal gnad ha cang chen po red/ de 'grub thub kyi red bsam pa zhig khyed chos yid ches gtsang ma byed dgos/ ngas gong du yang bshad pa ltar nga tsho'i bsam blo'i nang gra sgrig byed rgyu de ji tsam gyi rgya che ba dang / ji tsam gyi rgyang ring ba zhig byung ba yin na/ ma lan ma 'gyod pa zhig yong gi red/dang po nas bsam blo sbag srub dog po zhig gi sgang la bsdad na/ mjug tu 'grod pa skye ba dang / ṭ+wāṃ pham byed dgos pa zhig yong srid pa yin/ de rtsis khyed rang tshos spobs pa chen po zhig gi thog nas blo rgyang ring po zhig gi bsam blo gtong rgyu de ha cang gal chen po yin/ da tshang mas hur thag gnang shog ces bka' 455// //339

ra༅༅// spyi lo 1966 zla 2 tshes 25 bod me rta gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi tshes 3 zhogs pa dha sa'i mi mang la bka' slob stsal ba/nga rang tsho da lta mi'i lung par bsdad yod pa 'di'i thog nas bod rgyal khab rang btsan bskyar du yon pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyal kha thob rgyur the tshom gang yang med/ ngos nas brjod myong ba ltar dus kyi 'gyur ba la nges pa gtan nas med stabs gcig byas na lo gnyis gsum nang bod du log rgyu yong 'gro/ gcig byas na lo bco lnga nyi shu'i bar sgug dgos pa'ang byas 'gro/ gang ltar dus yun de'i ring tshang mas rang 'tsho thub thabs sam/ rang gi rkang pas rang gi lus 'degs thub pa zhig nges par byed dgos/ de'i ched du gzhis chags sa zhing 'debs las la sogs pa'i gzhi rgya che ba'i spyi 'asnu re las rigs nang zhugs thub pa dang / de 'brel rgya gar nang shel la ha'o se dang / rdor gling / dzña sa bud med mnyam las sogs lag shes bzo gra khag nang la'ang zhugs te spyi sgor tshang ma'i 'tsho thabs la shugs ston rgyag dgos/ sger 'tsho'i gdengs thub yod mkhan phud/ de min rgas 'khogs rnams ni rgas gso khang khag nang tshud dang tshud bzhin yod pa red/ nga tshos rtag tu gzhan la brten sdod mi dgos par/ gang sa nas rang nyid rang mgo thon pa zhig cis kyang byed dgos/ de ltar ma thub na da dung sdug po ji yong cha ma rtogs pas/ de rtsis tshang mas rang gi nus shugs bskyed de gzab rgyu gang yod gzab dgos pa de gal chen po 'dugabar lam ngos nas mjal kha'i skabs srung mdud sprod kyi med de/ de ring lo gsar thog khyed tshor srung mdud thengs gcig 'bul gyi yin/ ngos 340

kyi mthong snang la phal che btas srung mdud la srung ba'i 'du shes med par/ rgyan cha yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi 'dug sung mdud che na dga' ba dang / chung na mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur yang yong gi med dam/ phreng ba'ang dge ba grangs gsog gi nyer dpyad du ma bsam par/ rgyan char brtsis te rgyas spros byed pa sogs la mgo lha 'khor te sdod kyi 'dug gzhi nas don dam gyi srung ba ni ston pa sangs rgyas kyi chos dri ma med pa skyabs 'gro las 'bras la yid ches dang 'brel ba'i mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims tshul bzhin srung ba rtsa che de med par/ phyi'i srung ba rgyan char 'du shes byed pa 'di 'dras srung thub rgyu khag po red/ de ra brten rang re bod mi nang pa sangs rgyas pa tshos mi bslu ba'i mchog nang gi srung ba de legs spro zhig yong thub pa byed dgos/ bod nang rgya mis chos snub bzhin yod pa de rtsis kyis nga tshos 'di nas yang dag pa'i chos nyams len gong spel thub pa zhig byed dgos/ de ltar byed dang mi byed khyed tsho rang rang so so la rag lus yod/ tshang mas rtag tu mthun lam dam tshig rdog rtsa gcig sgril zer bzhin pa 'di dag kha nas bshad pa tsam zhig gis mi 'grigs/ mi mthun pa yong skabs gcig gis gcig la bzod 'khur thub pa bya rgyu de gal gnad chen po red/ phyogs tshang mas bzod bsran chen po byas na/ de nas don dam dam tshig rdog rtsa gcig tu sgril ba zhig yong thub kyi red/ ngos nas rgyun du nan tan chen pos brjod bzhin pa ltar/ gtso bo tshang ma dam tshig mthun po byed dgos/ zhes 355// // 341

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1967 zla 2 tshes 16 nyin dzña ram sa la bzhugs snar du gtan sdod mi mang sogs dad can khag nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ ro me lug cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes 5 snga dro ser skya sum stong tsam la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor le'i tshe dbang zab mo spyi stsal sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad stsal ba/de yang ji skad du/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ nga rang tsho ma shi tshun chad kyi 'gro stangs rnams nga tshos mig gis mthong thub pa dang / so so'i ngos nas bsam blo btang ste thabs shes byed thub pa zhig dang / so so rang nyid nas ma thub ma nus par thabs shes gzhan brten byed dgos pa gnyis yod/ spyir btang tha na 'bu srin tshun chad tshang mas mig gis mthong rgyu yod pa'i cha nas so so'i sdug bsngal sel ba dang / bde ba sgrub rgyu de 'bu grog ma tshun gyis byed kyi yod kyang /rang gi nus pas ma ldeng pa'i mtshams la nus pa gzhan la brten dgos kyi yod pa red/ mi zhes pa ni ming 'dogs sa'i gzhi phung po lnga tshogs pa'i steng la mi zhes btags pa yin/ mi'i lus dang sems sogs kha phral nas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ nga tsho mi'i lus ni tshe re re bzhin brjes kyi yod rung / lus de la brten pa'i rnam shes de mi tshe gcig gi gnas tshul min par tshe rabs mang spro zhig brgyud nas yonge gi yod pa de shes thub dgos/ der brten nga tshos mig khra sgor sgor 'di ma btsums pa'i bar dngos su mthong pa'i gnas tshul de gcig pu yin na thabs shes rags pa phal pa gcig la brten nas rang gis kyang 'bad rtsol byed thub pa dang / rogs kyang sgrig rgyuyod/ 'on kyang mig de zum tshar ba'i mjug 342

tu mi tshe rjes ma der thabs shes gang yod snyam na/ so so'i bsam lha'i thog la bzo bcos brgyab/ so so'i bsam blo'i thog nas lag rjes shig 'jog dgos pa las/ 'di thog mi gzhan dag gis thabs shes byed rgyu med la/ de bzhin rgyu dngos pos kyang thabs shes byed rgyu med/ snying po mi tshe 'di'i ring gi rgyu nor gnyen grogs tshang mas ko thag slod ba'i nyin mo de slebs pa yin/ de bzhin mi tshe 'di la bed spyod byed pa'i shes bya yon tan gyi tshad mtho po ga stod yod kyang des kyang gang yang mi phan/ tshe phyi ma zhig yod pa de'i skabs la gang gis phan gyi red brjod na/ rang gis las bzang po zhig bsags nas yod na las bzang i rjes su 'brangs nas 'bras bu bde ba dang / las ngan pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'bras bu sdug bsngalayong rgyu yin tsang / so so'i bsam sdu'i thog las rabs kyi nus pa'am/ ya rabs kyi bya gzhag bya ba bzang po byas pa'i nus pa de so sdu/'i rgyud thog tu yod na des phan pa yin/ de yang tshig gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ de 'dra'i bya ba bzang po'am/ nus pa bzang po/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du phan thogs mkhan de chos yin/ des na nga tsho'i gal che shos kyi gnyen gyi mchog dang / rogs byed pa'i dpung rogs kyang de rang yin stabs so so'i sgo gsum gyi spyod pa ya rabs dang / chos lag len du 'khel ba byed dgos/ de 'dra yong ba la'ang / blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i ston pa po ma byung na rang gi ngang gis shes rgyu khag po red/ ston pa po de yang / gang dang yang dag ldan pa'i thub rnams rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyud la mnga' ba'i stobs kyis 343

shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad sgrib med du mkhyen/ rang gis ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pa de dag gzhan la ji lta ba bzhin du ston nus pa'i ston pa bla na med pa zhig dgos/ de lta'i ston pa bla na med pa gcig gis nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas 'joms nus nges kyi thabs tshang la ma nor ba bstan pa de la dam pa'i chos zhes brjod/ de 'dra ba'i chos nyams su len mkhan so so'i kha mig yar lta byed sa de la grogs dge 'dun bcas de gsum ni rang gi nam zhag gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub rgyu'i skyabs dang / dpung rogasayin pasan/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ zhes gsungs pa yin/ da lta yod bzhin pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mtshon pa'i skyabs gsum de rgyu skyabs yin/ de 'dra'i sangs rgyas skyabs su bzungs/ de'i gdams ngag nyan te nyams su blangs/ grogs dge 'dun rnams la kha mig yar blta byas te 'gog lam gyi chos dkon mchog ngo ma de rang rgyud la skyes thub pa byung na 'bras skyabs kyi chos dkon mchog de thob pa dang / 'gog lam thobayong dus rang nyid 'phags pa'i dge 'dun du gyur/ de yang rgyun je bzang je bzang du song nas mthar nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa gtan nas bcom pa'i tshe rang nyid sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu gyur pa yin/ de 'dra ba'i 'bras skyabs kyi dkon mchog gsum po de rang gi thob byar 'dzin pa dang / da lta'i dkon mchog gsum po de la rgyu skyabs su brtses pa'i sgo nas skyabs su bzungs te sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub byar bzhag nas de'i ched du so sos 'bad brtson zhig byed kyi yin na/nyon sgrib spangs tsam gyi thar pa'i go 'phang dang / de bzhin mngon mtho'i phun tshogs zer 344

ba de sto zhor la 'grub pa yin/ de lta na nga tsho mi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ de'itang nas mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i bstan pa dang mjal nas chos byas na byed rin chog pa zhig yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i skyabs gsum po de ngo shes pa byas te skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya'i gca rwa1 las 'bras kyi lag len tshul bzhin du 'gel dgos/ de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi dge ba bcu sgong ba'i dge ba bcu zhes dge sdig blang dor gyi 'gag bsdoms chen po 'di gsungs pa yin/ des na mi dge ba bcu ngo shes pa byas te thams cad sgong thub na thams cad spangs/ thams cad spong mi thub kyang sna re nas sgong gang thub byas/ de yang mi tsher spong thub pa byung na rab/ gal te de 'dra sgong mi thub na yang lo dang / zla ba/ zhag po tshun chad sgong rgyu'i 'bad rtsol byed kyi yin na/ dngos 'brel las 'bras la yid ches kyi sdig sgong dge sgrub kyi spang blang dngos su lag len bkal ba yin/ nga tshos chos byed stangs ma shes na de las thabs sdug pa med pas chos shes pa byed dgos/ yang shes nas nyams len mi byed pa de ni shin tu thabs sdug po red/ dper na/ dpe cha bltas/ phran bu shes mkhan zhig yin yang / kha nas sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun gyi gnas tshul bshad rgyu yod mkhan/ so so'i lag len thog tu rjes gang yang bstan rgyu med pa de shin tu skyod po yin/ ma shes pa ni ma shes pa red/ shes mkhan gyis lag len ma bstar ba de thabs sdug po red/ rtsa ba'i chos byed 'os pa dang byed dgos pa yin/ nga tsho lha/da du skyes pa dang / bod du nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos yod pa/ nga tsho'i pha mes kyi chos de nang pa yin stabs nang pa byed dgos 345

lab pa min/ so so'i thog la phan thogs yod med bsam blo gtong dgos payin/rang nyid bde ba 'dod/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa yin phyin chad la nang pa'i chos byed dgos/ de yang spyid lug le d+ku dbang du ma song ba byed dgos/ nga tsho rgya gar du slebs nas lo brgyad tsam 'gro gi yod/ khyed rang tsho dha ram sa lar gtan 'jags sdod mkhan tshor mtshon nasangayang chos go gi yod pa dang / ngas kyang bshad kyi lho rung / dngos 'brel lo brgyad kyi ring la khyed rang i brgyud la nyams su blangs nas rtogs pa'i yon tan ga re skyes 'dug ngas mi la phar bshad dang shod bzhin yang / nga'i rgyud la tshogs lam gyi yon tan yang skyes mi 'dug sbyor lam dang / mthong lam/ sgom lam sogs ni gang nas skyes/yin na yang de la 'bad brtson byed dgos pa dang / byed 'os pa zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ring yang ngas mid pa na na bshad/ khyed rang tshos rkub 'khyags 'khyags nyan dgos pa 'dir 'gyod pa gang yang mi 'dug bshad pa des rgya chen po mi phan na'ang gang la gang 'tshams phan thub pa zhig ma byung na thabs skyo 11 rdod/ma gzhi chos nyams su len rgyu de khag po yin/ 'on kyang khag po red bsam ste ma bzhag par/ 'bad brtson do snang byas na/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes gong ma tshos gsungs pa bzhin/ /lo brgya la mi skye snyam pa yang / 'dus byas so na mi gnas pas nam zhig la skye ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ chos byed pa la so so'i khra'i slobs pa bskyed nas rgyun mthud de nyams su blangasata bde nas bde bar 'gro ba zhes pa de yong thub/ da res nga tsho dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob nas 'khor ba'i 'dam khrod yod pa'i sems can 'dra 'dra'i nang nas nga tsho 346

lab pa min/ so so'i thog la phan thogs yod med bsam blo gtong dgos payin/rang nyid bde ba 'dod/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa yin phyin chad la nang pa'i chos byed dgos/ de yang spyid lug le d+ku dbang du ma song ba byed dgos/ nga tsho rgya gar du slebs nas lo brgyad tsam 'gro gi yod/ khyed rang tsho dha ram sa lar gtan 'jags sdod mkhan tshor mtshon nasangayang chos go gi yod pa dang / ngas kyang bshad kyi lho rung / dngos 'brel lo brgyad kyi ring la khyed rang i brgyud la nyams su blangs nas rtogs pa'i yon tan ga re skyes 'dug ngas mi la phar bshad dang shod bzhin yang / nga'i rgyud la tshogs lam gyi yon tan yang skyes mi 'dug sbyor lam dang / mthong lam/ sgom lam sogs ni gang nas skyes/yin na yang de la 'bad brtson byed dgos pa dang / byed 'os pa zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ring yang ngas mid pa na na bshad/ khyed rang tshos rkub 'khyags 'khyags nyan dgos pa 'dir 'gyod pa gang yang mi 'dug bshad pa des rgya chen po mi phan na'ang gang la gang 'tshams phan thub pa zhig ma byung na thabs skyo 11 rdod/ma gzhi chos nyams su len rgyu de khag po yin/ 'on kyang khag po red bsam ste ma bzhag par/ 'bad brtson do snang byas na/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes gong ma tshos gsungs pa bzhin/ /lo brgya la mi skye snyam pa yang / 'dus byas so na mi gnas pas nam zhig la skye ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ chos byed pa la so so'i khra'i slobs pa bskyed nas rgyun mthud de nyams su blangasata bde nas bde bar 'gro ba zhes pa de yong thub/ da res nga tsho dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob nas 'khor ba'i 'dam khrod yod pa'i sems can 'dra 'dra'i nang nas nga tsho 346

mngon mtho'i phun tshogs shig rnyed de bde ba'i sar bsdad yod/ de'i thog tu mig mang gi rde'u sgo stangs lta bu ma nor ba sgo thub na da lta bde ba'i sa 'di nas ma 'ongs pa na bde ba'i sa zhig la 'gro thub pa'i re ba yod pa dang / dal 'byor gyi rten bzanga.ang ki ma 'khrugs par rim pas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob thub pa'i re ba yod pa red/ des na 'bad brtson byed rgyu shin tu gal che/ de lta bu'i chos nyams su blangs te spyir btang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas de dag gis thar pa'i go 'phang thob yod kyang / nga tsho ྅ga pa chen skra'i chos dang mjal te thar pa tsam las lhag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub thub pa dang / de yang yun ring po dang / dka' tshegs chen po mi dgos par sgrub thub pa'i chos shig mjal ba'i skabs 'dir/ thabs khyad par ba 'di tsam yod bzhin du bsgrub bya de theg pa dman pa'i myang 'das tsam zhig la mgo 'khor nas bsdad na gyong chen po yin stabs so sos blo'i sgobs pa bskyed nas thar pa tsam min par thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa byed kyi yin snyam pa'i sems shugs bskyed dgos/ de 'dra ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa la'ang gtso bo pha rol du phyinapa drug dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub dgos/ de yang sbyin sogs kyi spyod pa rnamasasangs rgyas kyi rgyu la dbang med du 'gro thub pa dang rlabs che ba/ stobs che ba zhig 'byung ba ni byang chub kyi semasarin po che las yong dgos/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skyes pa zhig byung na de nasdo bzung ste dge ba'i rtsa ba ji 'dra zhigayinasang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu la 'gro thub pa dang /347

dge ba chung chung zhig yin yang sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i phan yon 'byung ba bcas yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che la slob dgos/ byang chub kyi sems rin po ce la slob pa layang da ring sgom na da ring lam seng rtogs pa skye mi thub/ snying rus byas nas lo dang zla ba sbrel nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che la blo sbyong dgos/ theg pa chen po'i chos rgya che mu med pa'i lam gyi rim pa de 'dra zhig la slob pa la yang theg pa chen wa'i chos nyams su len pa'i rten khyad par can da lta nga tshos thob nas yod pa'i dal rten 'di yun du gnas thub pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ de ni rang gi ngos nas srog gcod sgong ba/ gzhan srog gcod la nye ba srog blu tshe thar gtong ba sogs kyis thabs byed dgos shing /de ring 'dir skabs su babs pa gsang sngags kyi chos tshe dbang gi cho ga la brten nas tshe bsring ba'i thabs byed rgyu yin pas/ khyed rang rnams nas dgos pa rang gzhan sems can thams cad mthar thug bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i phyir du ngas tshe dbang zab mo 'di zhu bsam pa'i kun slong kun spyod kyi rim pa rnams legs par gsal btab pa'i sgo nas gsan par mdzad dgos pa yin/gnas khang 'di nyid kyang tha mal pa 'di lta bu ma yin pa bcom ldan 'das ma tshe sbyinayid bzhin 'khor lo'iye shes kyi rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas dngosayin snyam pa/ bla ma yang tha mal pa 'di lta bu ma yin par bcom ldan 'das ma tshe sbyin ye shes 'khor lo/ mdun gyi gtor ma 'di dag kyang tshe sbyin ye shes 'a khor lo dngos gnas rang bzhugs yod snyam pa byas te gsan dgos/ zhes sogs bka' stsal rjes tshe dbang gi rim pa rnams smin rgyas bka' drin bskyangs/ de rjes slar 348

yang bka' slob stsal phebs su/ bar lam bod nang gnas tshul ngan pa je zhan je sdug tu song ste mtha' mar na ning phyi lo 1966 lo'i nang rgya mi'i bsod nams zad pa'i rtags je gsal du phyin nas mthar srung dmag dmar wa yer ba'i thog nas zang zing mang po byas pa red/ bod nang sku gsung thugs rten mang che ba snga sa nas rtsa med bzos tshar 'dug kyang / gtsug lag khang dang / se 'bras sogs nang phyi mir mig ston byed ched nyung shas shig bzhag yod pa red/ 'on kyang snga lo dbyar dus nas bzung srung dmag dmar po'i las 'gul smyo mchongs kyis sku gsung thugs rten gtor bshig rtsa med bzos pa'i gras nas 'phags pa rang byung lnga ldan gyi sku'i tshal bu zhig nga tsho bod mi mang gi sems shugs snying dongs kyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du gdan drangs thub pa byung zhing / da ring 'di gar 'phags pa'i zhal gnyis phebs te yod stabs rten khyad par can 'di'i drung du tshogs gsog gsol 'debs bya dgos/ gzhi rtsa bod cho 'phrul zla ba 'di'i tshes 8 nas bco lnga'i bar du nga tsho'i bod mi'i sgar sayongs rdzogs nas bsod nams gsog rgyu byung na legs po mi yong ngam snyam ste sgar sa khag tshang mar gnas tshul btang zin pa ltar/ 'di ga dha ram sa lar yang tshes 8 nas tshes 15 bar spyi rim zhig sgrub rgyu byung na legs/ bar lam nas chos 'brel dgos 'dun byed mkhan mang tsam zhig byung yod pa dang / stabs gcig don gnyis kyis de ring 'di ga mor ṭi mol hol du sngon la chos 'brel zhig byas te de nas nga tsho tshang mas spyi rim sgrub rgyu yin/ spyi rim gyi 'don pa'aphags bstod dang / sgrol ma sogs 'don rgyu yin pas 'don pa blo la med pa'i rigs kyis 349

de'i ring ma ṇi bgrangs na 'grigs/ sngon ma nas skad cha byung don ltar/ nga tshos mig gis mthong thub pa'i cha nas/ las ka dang thabs shes kyis rgya mir 'gran bsdur byed kyiyod pa dang /mig gis mthong ma thub pa'i cha nas bsod nams kyi dpung su bzang lta dgos pa yin/ de snga phan la nga tsho'i bsod nams kyi mthu dman pa lta bu zhig dang /rgya mi'i phyogs la bsod nams kyi mthu che ba lta bu chags yod/ yin na yang da cha bsod nams kyi 'gran bsdur byas na byed rin yod pas phal cher pham rgyal chags thub pa'i dus skabs su slebs yod/ nga tshos de'i tshod kyis da dung zhe tod du ma song ba byas te bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/ ngas chos 'brel gyi skabs la zhu rgyu byung ba bzhin/ dge ba rlabs che rung gang 'dra zhig 'grub min rtsa ba kun slong gi thog la rag las pas kun slong bzang pos rtsis zin pa byas te nga tshos spyi rim sgrub pa'i skabs la ma ṇi hur thag bton pa dang / smon lam legs po brgyab pa yin na/ da lta nga tsho'i mthong snang du yode pa'i khra khra sil sil gyis bod rang btsan sgrub pa'i las 'gul gang yang byed kyi med kyang / don la nga tshos bsod nams kyi mthu bskyed kyiyod pas phan thogs chen po yong rgyur tshang mas dgongs pa de lta bu bzhes dgos/ da ring nas nyin gsum gyi ring la rten mchog khyad par can la 'dir yod khyed rang mi mang tshos thod pa gtugs smon lam gang thub brgyab ste bsod nams gsog pa'i rten khyad par can yod pa dang / bsod nams gsog rgyu'i go skabs yod pa 'di chud zos ma song ba byed dgos/ zhes bka' stsal// //350

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1967 zla 5 tshes 11 nyin don grub gling gzhis chags su chos 'brel yon tan gzhi gyur ma dang / ma ṇi'i ljags lung bcas stsal smin grub rjes bka' slob stsal don/gzhis chags 'dir da ring thengs gnyis pa 'byor skabs ser skya rgan byis tshang mas dga' bsu sne len gang gzab gnang ba la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/'di gar tshul khrims nas lam tsam brjod pa ltar dang / lhag par da lta dngos su lta skor zin pa bcas gnas stangs tshang ma ha cang yag po 'dug pas dga' po byung / 'di dag ni khyed rang tshos ca dengag dka' las rgyab pa'i lag rjes mig mthong lag zin bstan rgyu yod pa zhig yin stabs khyed rang tshor ched du thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/nga tsho spyi'i gnas tshul cha nas bshad na/ bar skabs rgya na ga nang shes rig gsar brje zhes pa'i las 'gul zhig byung / des rkyen pas rgya mi'i mtho rim 'go 'khrid gathos nga tsho'i bar la mi mthun pa'i gnas tshul rgya che byung stabs 'dzam gling mi mang tsho'i bsam khra'i nang rgya mi'i bya spyod ni khungs lung rtsa ba nas med pa'i shes rtogs gsal po yong gi yod pa dang / des rkyen byas te rang re bod kyi gnad don skor la yang sems khur byed mkhan mang du 'gro bzhin pa dang / lhag par rgya gar gzhung nas nga tshor ha cang thugs khur bka' drin chen po gnang bzhin pa sogs rgyal spyi'i thog gzhi rtsa'i bod kyi gnas stangs je legs je bzang du 'gro bzhin pa red/ de 'dra'i dus skabs 'dir nga rang tsho bod mi rnams nas phan tshunayid ches blos 'gel yong ba'i chig sgril dang / hur 351

brtson byed dgos/ nga tsho stend nas yong skabs bod du yod pa'i gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs de mnyam du rgya gar nang slebs yod/ sgrig 'dzugs de'i ngo i cha nas dus tshod dang bstun nas sgyur bcos mang po zhig btang zin la/ da dung dus skabs dang bstun pa'i gtong 'os pa gang yod gtong dgos/ 'on kyang bod gzhung ngam/ de'i sgrig 'dzugs de gnas yod/ de gnas dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nga tshos sgrub dgos pa'i dmigs yul bod rang dbang zer ba de sgrub pa'i ched dang / gzhis lus rgya che'i bod mi mang rgya mi'i btsan gnon 'og tu gnas pa de rnams kyi ched du yin pa las/ mi nyung shas shig gi khe phan sgrub pa'i ched du ga la yin/ ma 'ongs pa'i dmigs yul de'i ched du nga tshos dmangs gatho'i rtsa khrims khyab bsgrags byas yod/ dmangs gtso'i 'gro lugs de ni rang re'i ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang mthun la deng dus 'dzam gling rgyal spyi'i 'gro lugs dang mthun pa zhig red/ nga tshos lam de 'dra zhig la 'gro dgos pa las gzhan zhig tu 'gro mi thub/ 'on kyang de'i skor gzhi rtsa'i thag gcod gzhis lus rgya che'i bod mi mang gis byed dgos pa las nga tsho btsan byol ba stong phrag bdun cu brgyad cu skor gyis byed mi thub/ nga tsho'i gzhung la mi mang nas gces bkur bya dgos pa las/ de la dogs pa rnam rtog byas na mi 'grigs/ sngar rang re'i gtam dper rgya dogs pas phung / bod re bas phung zer ba ltar/ nga tsho re bas phung zin pas/ da brtan po ma byas na dogs pas phung nyen yod/ skabs re chos lugs dang / chol kha'i bar skad cha 'dra min sna phyogs yong gi 'dug de tsho ni gzugs med grib chags lta bu 352

dgos don med pa sha stag red/ nga tshos bod mi rigs spyi'i dmigs yul don gal chen po zhig sgrub dgos pa'i dus skabs 'dir de 'dra'i gtam 'chal la bden 'dzin dang / dogs pa ma byas par brjed du 'jug 'os pa yin/ gang yin zer na/ des nga tshor phan thogs med pa'i khar/ phan tshun shog 'then du gyur nas grong spyi don la phog gi red/ der brten tshang mas gcig yid gcig ches thub pa'i mthun sgril bya rgyu gal chen po 'dug rtsa ba'i lhag bsam 'khyer phyogs ma nor bar 'phral phugs bod spyi don bsam pa zhig yod phyin chad/thabs shes lag len sprod phyogs dang / lta tshul phra mo mthun mi mthun gyi rkyen pas zang zing phyogs 'then rigs mi byed par khog yangs spyi bsam ma dor ba byed dgos/ngas gong du zhus pa ltar/ 'di ga'i gzhis chags kyi gnas tshul gang legs 'dug pa'i khar/ da gin sa khrar zhib 'jug skabs/ da dung rgya bskyed bya yul yod 'dug par ltar/ 'di gar da yod bod mi drug brgya skor gyi thogakha longs dang bcas bod mi chig stong tsam gzhis chags byed thub pa byung na gang legs sku(nga nges/ de min gzhan zhu rgyu mi 'dug cing / da phan tshang mas hur thag byas 'dug pa ltar/ da dung sngar bzhin hur thag byed rogs zhes re 'dun zhu rgyu dang / 'dir phebs sku mgron khongs nas 'ga' shas kyis rogs ram byas/ 'ga' shas sger nas slob ston tshun byas te nga tsho bod mir phan grogs rgya che gnang ba la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ zhes bka' 455// //353

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1969 zla 10 tshes 3 nyin/ bzhugs sgar dzña sa gangs skyid du/ 'tshe med zhi ba'i slob dpon mes po chen po lhan rdi 'khrungs nas lo brgya 'khor ba'i rjes dran mdzad sgor stsal ba'i bka' slob/bdag nyid chen po lhan rdi la 'dzam gling nang mtshan snyan ji yod dang /khong la skye bos dga' bkur ji zhus khong gi mdzad rnam la bltas na ha las pa dang / ngo mtshar du gyur pa zhig yin/bdag nyid chen 17 de rgya gar nub phyogs por ban dar zhes pa'i sa gnas su 'khrungs/ dgung grangs bcu gsum la phebs pa dang 'jig rten khyim thabs kyi rten 'brel gnang / dgung grangs bco brgyad thog dbyin yul du khrims kyi slob sbyong du phebs/ dam pa de rgya gar dang / dbyin khrul nang slob sbyong du bzhugs skabs gzhan gyi mthong tshul la/ khong slob sbyong nang dmigs bsal gyi shes rab can zhig dang / ma 'ongs par yul gyi dbu 'khrid byed thub mkhan gyi ngo mtshar chen po zhig sus kyang mthong med pa dang / ing lan nas rgya gar du phyir phebs kyis khrims khang zhig du khrims rtsod pa'i las don gnang skabs 'jigs snang dang tshab tshub kyis khrims rtsod mjug skyong ma thub par da phyin gdeng 'khel gyi nyams myong dang spobs pa ma byung bar 'di rigs gnang gi min zhes dam bca' gnang dgos byung / apha ri ka nang khong me 'khora.ang dang wa'i nang phebs skabs dbyin ji'i mi zhig nas khong la mthong chung gis ngal rtsol pa mnyam du 'grul bzhud byed 'dod med pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan te/ me 'khor nang gi las byed pa dang / srung dmag bcas nas khong bzhugs gnas nas 354

phyir 'bud byas/ dam pa de mtshan gang me 'khor babs tshugs der gzim chas sogs med par 'khyag bzhin du bzhugs dgos byung / dus ske bas de tsam nas khong 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam du zhugs rgyu'i 'go tshugs pa yin zhes gsungs 'dug bdag nyid chen po des4pha ri ka nang bca' sdod rgya gar mi mang gi thob thang skor 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam nas 'thab rtsod rgol 'dzings gnang bar brten/ apha ri ka nang khong gi mdzad pa rgya che gting zab la skye bos bsngags brjod zhu ba'i dbu brnyes pa yin/ de nas rgya gar la phebs te mi dkyus ma bgrod yul glang 'khor dang / me 'khor tha ma nang phebs bzhugs gnang rkyen yul gyi mi mang nyam thag tsho'i gnas stangs dka' ngal can dag dngos hūṃ gzigs te rgya gar rang dbang rtsod len byed dgos pa'i slob ston rgya che gnang yod/ a mata ba da la khongagi grogs po zhig gi bzo grwa gcig yod cing / de'i las byed tshor 'tsho phogs nyung ngu zhig las med stabs khong tshor 'tsho phogs spar ched zas bcad ngo rgol las 'gul nang zhugs dgos pa'i slob ston gnang zhing /khong tsho mnyam du bdag nyid chen po des gdung sems mnyam bskyed kyis zas bcad ngo rgol nang zhugatsu 'dug amri sar du dbyin ji'i khrims 'khyog la ngo rgol ched rgya gar mi mang khri phrag lhag 'dus tshogs byas par dbyin ji'i dmag mis drag gnon byas te mi bzhi brgya skor dmar gsod dang / mi chig stong skor rmas skyon btang na yang / bdag nyid chen pos dbyin ji'i drag spyod kyi lan du rgya gar mi mang tshos 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam nas bden pa mtha' skyel gyi las 'gul byed dgos pa'i slob ston dang / sne 'khrid gnang ste dbyin ji 355

dang 'brel lam bcad/ yul bzos ras cha gyon dgos pa dang / phyi rgyal gyi ras cha gyon rgyur ngo rgol byed dgos pa'i slob ston gnang / mes po chen po de nyid nas mdzad seng skabs ras rgyu skud pa 'khel bzo'i phyag las gnang zhing / rang nyid nas rgyun du yul bzos ras cha 'ba' zhig spyod bzhes gnang gi yod pa red/ 1930 lor dbyin jis rgya gar gyi tshong pas tshwa 'don mi chog pa'i khrims gzhi bzos par ngo rgol ched rgya gar gyi zhing pa 'bum gcig mtsho khar 'khrid nas tshwa len du 'jug pa gnang / skabs der rgya gar nang yul gyi rang btsan lam ston mdzad po'i dbu 'khrid mtshan snyan dang gzi brjid can mang po yod rung / mi mang tshos gzhan dag la dga' mos zhu stangs dang /bdag nyid chen wa der dga' mos zhu stangs gnyis dbar mdza' sems che chung gi khyad par shin tu chen po yod pa red/bdag nyid chen po des yul gyi 'go 'khrid dang / mi mang tshor dbyin ji'i dbang 'og nas rgya gar rang btsan len thabs gcig pus mi 'grigs par nang khul chos lugs dang / rigs rus/ dpal 'byor bzang zhan gyi khyad par chen po mu 'byams su gnas pa 'di gtan med gtsang ma bzo dgos pa'i 'bod bskul slob ston gnang zhing / yul nang rigs ngan tha shal ba'i lus kyi grib ma phog na yang mi gtsang bar brtsi ba'i rigs zhan tshor dkon mchog gi mi mang zhes ming 'dogs gnang ste thugs brtse chen po gnang gi yod pa red/ de rjes bdag nyid chen po des kong re si'i tshogs pa'i dbu 'khrid gnang ba dang / yul gyi rang btsan ched btson du lan mang bzhugs dgos byung / rang 356

btsan rtsod len skabs nang khul khrag sbyor zing 'khrug mtshams 'jog ched zas bcad kyi brtul zhugs gnang / rjes su hin rdu'i chos lugs la sdang 'dzin chen po yod pa'i grong khyer khag tu phyag rogs gcig gnyis las med par bzhugs pa dang / mi mang tsho khrag rjodar gyi lam du ma zhugs par zhi lam du bskyod dgos pa'i 'bod skul slob ston ched sa gnas mang por zhabs thang gis phebs kyi yod pa red/de lta bu'i dbu 'khrid mdzad rjes can der 'kho ra ba'i chos nyid dus su babs te 1942 phyi zla 1 tshes 30 nyin yul gnyis so sor gyes pa'i skyon 'dzugs dang bcas rgya gar yul mi gcig gis me mda' brgyab ste bkrongs/'on kyang dam pa des bkrong mkhan der snying rjes blta dgos pa'i brda mtshon zhig gnang nas rgya gar mi mang tsho'i dkyil nas gzugs sku'i rnam pa de bsdus gnang ba red/'dzam gling 'di'i nang dpal 'byor dang / rigs rus/ drag stobs sogs las snyan grags byung ba ji snyed yod kyang / bdag nyid chen wa de'i snyan grags ni de dag dang mi 'dra bar skye bo tshang mas dga' bkur mu mthud zhu don ni khong gi mdzad rjes bzang po ngo mtshar can rnams la brten nas byung ba yin/rgya gar nang chos lugs dang / skad yig mi 'dra ba ji snyed yod pa dang / mtha' mayul gnyis su kha gyes dbo|sa pa'i gnas tshul zhig byung yod/ hob kyis bltas na rgya gar bzhin bod nang la yang chos lugs mi 'dra ba mang po mthong yang /de dag la zhib tu dpyad na/ bod nang chos lugs tshang ma nang pa sangs rgyas 357

pa'i chos lugs gcig gi ngo bor gnas yod pa red/ bdag nyid chen po de da lta 'tsho gzhes yod na nga tsho bod kyi gnas stangs 'di'i bzo dbyibs mi 'dra ba zhig yong srid/ nga tshos khong la brtsi bkur zhu 'dod na/ khong gi dgongs bzhes bzhin rgya che'i nyam thag mi mang gi bde sdug la blta dgos pa dang / drang bden la brtsi bkur/ dka' ngal rtsod rnyog mtha' dag 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam nas sel dgos pa bcas la slob sbyong thog lag len 'bad brtson gang thub byas na/ gan dhi'i dus dran legs shos de yin/ zhes 455// //(lhan zhi'i gshegs tshes dngos gzhi tshes 2nyin yin kyang / ghan rdi dus dran tshogs pas gdan zhus ltar 7gong sa mchog de nyin snga dro ldi lir ghan zhi'i dus dran mdzad sgor zhabs sor bkod de dgong dro dha sar phebs zhabs 'khod par brten/ dha sar dus dran tshes 3 nyin gnang don de ltar yin/)358

pa'i chos lugs gcig gi ngo bor gnas yod pa red/ bdag nyid chen po de da lta 'tsho gzhes yod na nga tsho bod kyi gnas stangs 'di'i bzo dbyibs mi 'dra ba zhig yong srid/ nga tshos khong la brtsi bkur zhu 'dod na/ khong gi dgongs bzhes bzhin rgya che'i nyam thag mi mang gi bde sdug la blta dgos pa dang / drang bden la brtsi bkur/ dka' ngal rtsod rnyog mtha' dag 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam nas sel dgos pa bcas la slob sbyong thog lag len 'bad brtson gang thub byas na/ gan dhi'i dus dran legs shos de yin/ zhes 455// //(lhan zhi'i gshegs tshes dngos gzhi tshes 2nyin yin kyang / ghan rdi dus dran tshogs pas gdan zhus ltar 7gong sa mchog de nyin snga dro ldi lir ghan zhi'i dus dran mdzad sgor zhabs sor bkod de dgong dro dha sar phebs zhabs 'khod par brten/ dha sar dus dran tshes 3 nyin gnang don de ltar yin/)358

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1971 zla 1 tshes 8 nyin/ ma ye sor gzhis chags gsar rnying ser skya mang tshogs thog bka' slob stsal ba/de ring 'dir gar gzhis chags gsar rnying gi mi mang tsho dang / las ka byed mkhan tsho/ de bzhin spag sa nas phebs pa'i dge 'dun pa tsho bcas tshang mar zhu rgyu la/ nga gzhis chags 'dir tshar mang po zhig slebs pa red/da res 'dir 'byor skabs sngon dang mi 'dra bar/ gang ci'i thad nas yar rgyas chen po phyin pa'i rnam 'gyur thon 'dug 'di ni 'go mang tshang mas hur thag byas pa'i lag rjes grub 'bros bzang po zhig red/ de 'dra yin tsang khyed rang tsho 'go mang tshang mar ngas bkra shis bde legs dang / snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang chabs cig sa gnas gzhung gi las byed pa tsho dang /de bzhin rogs ram tshogs pa khag gtso che shos rgya gar dbus gzhung bcas tshang mar yang skabs 'dir ngas thugs rje che zhu gi yod/da gzhan dag zhu rgyu mang po med/ gang yin ze ra na/ gzhis chags 'dir tshar mang shos slebs pa red la/ skad cha yang mang shos bshad yod/da cha mang po shod dgos e yod bsam pa 'dug rtsa don da lta yar rgyas gang la gang 'tshams shig phyin yod/ da dung yang shes yon gyi skor dang / thon skyed kyi skor sogs mang po zhig nas yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i gzhi rten yang yod pa red la/ de don yar rgyas nges pare du gtong dgos/gtso che shos/ gzhis chags zer ba de dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi bsti gnas lta bu yin tsang thon skyed thog la shugs bskyed dgos pa de ha cang gal 359

chen po red/ de la deng dus dang mthun pa'i 'phrul 'khor yo byad bed spyod byas nas shugs rgyag dgos pa de gal chen po chags kyi yod/ zhing las yin yang 'phrul 'khor jog nas shugs rgyag dgos pa dang / de min sa zhing gcig pu ma yin par nga rang tsho'i ma rtsa dang / shes yon gyi nus pa la gzhigs pa'i bzo tshong las rigs gzhan dag gi jog nas thon skyed kyi las ka byed thub na yag po red/ byed rgyu'i go skabs yong gi red la/ nges par du byed dgos pa zhig kyang chags kyi yod pa red/ gang yin zer na/ nga tsho 'dir gzhis chags kyi las 'gan de khyim tshang nang gi mi so so'i grod khog rgyangs thub tsam zhig ma yin par/ bod mi spyi'i don la bsam blo gtong dgos pa yin tsang /gang ci'i thad nas dpal 'byor gyi nus pa zhig bzo thub pa yin na/ phyogs mang po zhig la phan yong gi red/ dpal 'byor gyi nus pa da dung yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i thog la tshang mas bsam blo gtong dgos pa dang / lhag par du na gzhon deng dus kyi shes yon sbyangs pa tshos rim pas rim pas khur blangs nas shugs skyed dgos pa de gal chen po red/ nga chos 'char can de rang la mgo 'khor ma bsdad par/ yar rgyashā gtong dgos pa yin/nga rang tsho 'di gar mi ngo yod 'di rnams la dgos nges ldeng tsam gyis ma 'grigs par/ da dung yar rgyas mu med pa gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re red zer na/ nga rang tsho 'di khul btsan byol ba chags pa 'di bod lung pa nas rgya gar la gnas bskor du yong ste de nas rim pas gzhis chags byas pa zhig ma red pa/ nga rang tsho srid don gyi gnas tshul zhig la thug ste so i lung 360

pa nas mi'i lung par gyar ba red/ de 'dra yin tsang nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i na tsha 'byung sa de srid don gyi gnas tshul zhig gi thog nas byung ba yin stabs/ rtsa ba'i yong rkyen gnas tshul de brjed thabs med pa zhig chags bsdad yod pa red/nga rang tsho btsan byol ba chags pa 'di srid don gyi gnas tshul zhig gi thog nas chags pa yin tsang / btsan byol byas te sdod pa'i ring la'ang nga tshos las ka byed rgyu gang 'dra zhig yin yang rtsa ba'i gnas tshul de dang 'brel ba'i bsam blo btang ste 'char gzhi 'god dgos par brten/ gzhis chags khag 'di dag la nga rang tsho bod pa grangs 'bor gang 'tshams mnyam sdod thub pa'i 'char gzhi bting pa red/ de bzhin shes yon gyi skor la yin na yang / bod pa'i slob grwa zhes zur du btsugs te bod phrug tshor slob sbyong gi go skabs thob thub pa'i 'char gzhi bting yod/ phyogs mang po zhig gi thog nas las ka go sgrig byed dgos pa tshang ma rtsa ba'i nga tsho'i chab srid kyi gnas tshul dang sbrel nas 'char gzhi gting gi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin tsang gzhis chags byed mkhan tshos thon skyed thog tu nus pa bton nas/ 'di gar yod pa'i mi rnams la ldeng tsam zhig ma yin par/ da gin las bsdoms nang bkod pa bzhin snga lo spyi pa'i 'gro song gi thog la zhal 'debs phul yod pa de bka' drin chen po red la/ da dung yin yang 'di ltar spyi pa'i don la bsam blo gtong dgos pa de gal chen po red/ rtsa ba nga tsho srid don gyi gnas tshul zhig la thug pa yin tsang /de gzhi bzung gi bsam blo gtong dgos pa gal chen po red zer ba'i don dag de red/361

srid don gyi gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig la thug bsdad yod dam zer na/nga tsho rang btsan zer ba de la thug bsdad yod pa red/ rang btsan zer ba de yang lung pa zhig rang btsan dang / mi rigs shig rang btsan gyi skad cha red ma gtogs/ dgon pa gcig rang btsan zer ba dang / bla ma gcig rang btsan zer ba/ mi tshang gcig gnyis rang btsan zer ba de 'dra'i skad cha zhig ma red/de 'dra'i thog la rang btsan zer ba'i skad cha rtsa ba nas 'jug thabs/ med/ nga rang tsho bod kyi rang btsan de gang 'dra zhig red zer na/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi cha nas rtsis na'ang nga rang tsho rang btsan yin pa de ni bkrus phyis ma dag pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags bsdad yod/ skabs re bod pa ha cang nyams dma' 11 chags/ rgya nag drag rtsub chen po chags te bod pa'i las ku'i thog la rgya nag nas the byus byas pa'ang byung sku(da/ yang bod pa 41bas shugs chen po yod pa'i skabs la rgya nag gi sa sde mang po zos te bod pas rgya nag gi thog la dbang shugs byas pa'ang byung yod/ 'di ni gnas tshul khag khag cig red/ rtsa ba'i bdag jo(ba kyi skad cha bshad pa yin na/ bod kyi shes rig cha nasa.e yin/ gzhan dag phyogs mang po zhig gi cha nas dngos 'brel drang bden gyi bod rgya tha dad chags nas bsdad yod la/ bod rang btsan chags nas bsdad yod/ 'di dag ni 'das pa'i lo rgyus shig red/ yin na yang 'das pa'i lo rgyus ni 'das pa rang red/ rang btsan zer ba de ni snying po mi rigs shig gi don dag red/de yang mi rigs kyi khe phan 'ba' zhig gi don red ma gtogs/ mi rigs shig sdug po myong ba'i don ma red/ der brten rang btsan zer ba'i ming tsam min 362

par nga tshor phan thogs yod med la blta dathongs pa yin/ phan thogs med pa zhig yin na mtha' gcig tu rang btsan dgos don mi 'dug phan thogs yod pa zhig yin tsang / nga tshor de dgos kyi yod pa red/ 'dod pa bskyed pa yin tsang de bsgrub dgos pa yin/mi rigs skor bshad pa de mi mang che bar brtsi dgos/ bar skabs nga tsho bod gzhung gi khyab khongs su yod pa de tsam ma yin par/ bod rigs mchis so cog tshang ma gcig tu bsgril ba yin na mi grangs sa ya drug tsam sku(da pa red/ bal yul dang / 'brug 'bras ljongs/ sud dzar lan kri sogs la yod pa tshang ma bsdoms dus grangs 'bor stong phrag brgyad cu skor tsam zhig rang red/ mi sa ya drug gi grangs 'bor nang la stong phrag brgyad cu zer ba de nyung shas shig red/ nga sto bod spyi pa'i don dag de mang ba de rnams kyi 'dod par bstun nas 'gro dgos/ gal te bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang mang che ba kho tshos kha yod lag yod kyi gnas tshul du rgya mi'i 'og la bsdad nas phan thogs yod pa zhig mthong / de snga 'khor lam med sar 'khor lam byung / de snga slob grwa med sar slob grwa tshugs/ de snga 'phrod bsten med sar 'phrod bsten byung / de snga thon skyed med sar thon skyed tshugs/ de snga bzo las la sogs pa'i yar rgyas med sar da cha yar rgyas phyin nas/ bod mi mang tsho la shes yon dang / lto gos longs spyod thog la'ang tshad longs nges kyi yag po zhig byung ba yin na/ bod nang sku(da pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tshos kyang dge mtshan mthong sku(nga gi red/ khong tshos de 'dra'i dge mtshan gyi gnas tshul mthong yong dus rim 363

par nga tshor phan thogs yod med la blta dathongs pa yin/ phan thogs med pa zhig yin na mtha' gcig tu rang btsan dgos don mi 'dug phan thogs yod pa zhig yin tsang / nga tshor de dgos kyi yod pa red/ 'dod pa bskyed pa yin tsang de bsgrub dgos pa yin/mi rigs skor bshad pa de mi mang che bar brtsi dgos/ bar skabs nga tsho bod gzhung gi khyab khongs su yod pa de tsam ma yin par/ bod rigs mchis so cog tshang ma gcig tu bsgril ba yin na mi grangs sa ya drug tsam sku(da pa red/ bal yul dang / 'brug 'bras ljongs/ sud dzar lan kri sogs la yod pa tshang ma bsdoms dus grangs 'bor stong phrag brgyad cu skor tsam zhig rang red/ mi sa ya drug gi grangs 'bor nang la stong phrag brgyad cu zer ba de nyung shas shig red/ nga sto bod spyi pa'i don dag de mang ba de rnams kyi 'dod par bstun nas 'gro dgos/ gal te bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang mang che ba kho tshos kha yod lag yod kyi gnas tshul du rgya mi'i 'og la bsdad nas phan thogs yod pa zhig mthong / de snga 'khor lam med sar 'khor lam byung / de snga slob grwa med sar slob grwa tshugs/ de snga 'phrod bsten med sar 'phrod bsten byung / de snga thon skyed med sar thon skyed tshugs/ de snga bzo las la sogs pa'i yar rgyas med sar da cha yar rgyas phyin nas/ bod mi mang tsho la shes yon dang / lto gos longs spyod thog la'ang tshad longs nges kyi yag po zhig byung ba yin na/ bod nang sku(da pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tshos kyang dge mtshan mthong sku(nga gi red/ khong tshos de 'dra'i dge mtshan gyi gnas tshul mthong yong dus rim 363

pas rim pas snga mo nga tsho rang btsan red de/ da cha snga mo rang btsan yod pa'i skabs las lhag pa'i bde skyid cig rgya mi'i 'og la tshud nas byung song / da yin na nga tsho rgya mi'i 'og la bsdad na ma 'grigs pa mi 'dug bsam pa'i bsam blo 'khor gyi red/ red dam/ bsam sbru de 'dra zhig 'khor ba yin na/ nga rang tshos 'di khul bod mi nyung shas stong phrag brgyad cu skor zhig gis bod mi sa ya drug gi mang che ba'i re 'dod dang ma mthun pa'i logs su rang btsan gyi skad cha zhig bshad pa yin na/ nga tsho'i skad cha de ham pa'i skad cha dang / ma dag yud che'i skad cha red ma gtogs/ bden pa'i skad cha ma red/ rang btsan zer ba de bod mi spyi'i don dag red/ bod mi spyi de bod mi mang che ba rnams la brtsi dgos pa red/ bod mi mang che ba de tsho'i 'dod pa de 'dra zhig yod pa yin na/ nga ra nga tsho 'dir bod mi nyung shas shig gis de'i skor la las ka byed dgos don med/ yin na yang / da lta dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig yod pa red ces zer na/ bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de rnams kyis dngos gnas drang gnas ha las pa'i sems shugs chen wa zhig dang /ha las pa'i snying stobs bskyed nas rgya mi'i dbang bsgyur de la ma 'dod pa chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra byed dgos don ni/ dngos yod gnas tshul la rgya mi'i dbang sgyur 'og la bsdad nas dka' ngal chen po yod pa dang / de snga lto gos ldeng sar deng sang ma ldeng pa/ de snga rang dbang yod sar deng sang mdor na skad cha tshig gcig gnyis kyang shod sa yod med 'dra po/ dbugs ring zhig btang ba la yang lam seng rgyu rkyen dri ba byed pa lta bu phyogs mang po 364

zhig gi thog la de 'dra'i dka' ngal chags bsdad yod pa red/ de 'dra'i dza drag po dang / thabs sdug po'i gnas tshul zhig chags yod pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ ngas bskyar zlos zhu dgos pa mi 'dug da lta kha yod lag yod la bod mi tsho dngos gnas drang gnas kyi dka' ngal dang / sdug bsngal chen po myong gi yod pa yin tsang / rgya mi'i 'og la bsdad nas nga tshor phan thogs mi 'dug lung pa yar rgyas phyin pa red de/ lung pa yar rgyas phyin pa'i dgos don des rgya mir phan pa ma gtogs/ nga chos ngad par phan gyi mi 'dug bsam pa de dngos yod gnas tshul chags bsdad yod pa red/ mang che ba tsho'i bsam blo'i nang la da lta rgya mis dbang bsgyur byed bzhin yod pa 'di'i 'og la sdod 'dod rtsab nas med pa'i bsam tshur+sha ha cang gi shugs chen po yod pa red/ bod yongs rdzogs rgya mi'i drag 'og la bcug nas lo bcu gnyis tsam 'gro gi yod na yang / bod mi tsho da dung dpe ma srid pa'i sems shugs chen po byas te bsdad yod pa red/ lhag don bod rigs na gzhon de snga chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga grangs la rgya nag la mar 'khrid phyin/ pe cing mi rigs slob grwa chen mo la e yin/ drin tu'i mi rigs slob grwar e yin/ lan kru'i mi rigs slob grwa dang / de rjes zhan yang mi rigs slob grwa zer ba la sogs pa'i slob grwa khag gi nang bod phrug na gzhon mang po zhig la slob sbyong sprad yod pa red/ khong tshos slob sbyong byas nas rim pas lo na yar son te so so'i lta ba 'khyer stangs dmar po'i lta ba chags yod pa de tsho'i gras rgya nag nas bod du yar slebs/ sa gnas sa thog gi dngos yod gnas tshul la bod rgya che'i mang tshogs rgya mi'i 365

btsan dbang 'og tu dngos gnas drang gnas dka' ngal chen po myong gi yod pa de tsho shes rtogs byung ste gzhi nas rgya mi la ngo rgol byed rgyu'i bsam blo gtong mkhan mang po byung 'dug bod mi rgan pa cho lta ci smos/ gzhon pa yang mang ba tsho rgya mi la ma dga' ba byed pa'i bsam tshul de 'dra zhig chags yod pa red/rgan pa tsho she gtsang yin na/ dpal 'byor longs spyod sogs lung pa yar rgyas kyi thog la grub 'bras bzang po zhig yod na yang / chos dad dang rmongs zhen lta bu'i thog nas rgya mi la ma dga' ba byed srid kyi red/ na gzhon chos dad med pa/ gung bran tang mi yin pa/ chos khas mi len mkhan/ mi tshe gcig 'di ga'i mkhe phan 'ba' zhig la bsam blo gtong mkhan gyi na gzhon tshos kyang ma 'dod pa byed dgos pa 'di gnas tshul ga re'i thog nas byung ba red dam zer na/ kha yod lag yod/ mig mthong lag zin gyi gnas tshul la rgya mi'i 'og la bsdad nas nga tshor mkhe phan med pa/ nga tshor gyong gun chen po yod pa de 'dra zhig mthong ste/ sngar srol chos dang / rig gzhung de 'dra'i rmongs zhen la rgya'i skad cha min par/ dngos yod gnas tshul thog la bod mi rnams rgya mi'i g.yog rgyugs mkhan lta bu zhig chags yod pa yin tsang / khong tshos rgya mir ma dga' ba byed kyi yod pa red/ de yin min bar skabs bod nas 'byor ba'i mi kha shas 'di gar slebs bsdad yod pa rnams dang / khyed rang tsho skad cha byung yod 'gro/ da lta thug med na khyed rang tshos skad cha dris chog gi red/ bod nang rgya che'i mi mang gi bsam tshul de 'dra zhig dang / re 'dun de 'dra zhig yod pa yin stabs/ de nga tshos sgrub 'osaṃ pa chags song ngam/366

nga tshos sgrub dgos pa chags song ngam/ nga tshos sgrub dgos pa de rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa chags song ngam/ bod nang yoged pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams la re 'dun de 'dra zhig med par/ nga tsho rgya mi'i 'og la bsdad nas 'grigs kyi 'dug bsam pa zhig sku da na/ nga tshos 'dir rang btsan sgrub dgos don mi 'dug rang btsan zer ba de bod mi rigs kyi don dag red/ bod mi rigs mang che ba de rnams kyis rang btsan dathoges gnad mi 'dug bsam pa'i bsam blo zhig 'khor sku nga na/ nga tshos 'dir rang btsan dgos zhes lab na de la snying po med/ de 'grub thabs med pa zhig red/ rang btsan su la dgos kyi yod dam zer na/ rang btsan bod mi rigs la dgos kyi yod pa red/ bod mi rigs mang che ba de bod nang yod pa red/ khong tshos 'dod pa med na nga tshos 'di khul dgos dang dgos zhes lab kyin bsdad na/ skad cha de gzhi med pa'i skad cha red/ red dam/gnas tshul de 'dra zhig chags yod stabs nga tshos 'di khul bod rang btsan skor la thabs shes gang mo nga de byed 'os pa dang / byed dgos pa rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa zhig dngos yod gnas tshul thog chags 'dug gam/ da lta phan lo bcu gnyis tsam phyin pa de'i ring la gang las med pa'i thabs shes byas pa red la/ da dung yin yang ji srid bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de rnams kyi sems shugs da lta'i 'di 'dra zhig yod phyin chad kyi bar der/ gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig thug pa yin na yang / nga tshos 'bad rtsol byed dgos pa zhig red/ chos kyi thog nas bshad na/ dngos gnas las rgyu 'bras dpang 'pher gyi las 367

ka yin pa red/ 'jig rten gyi skad cha'i thog nas bshad pa yin yang / ya rabs dang / rgya che'i mi mang gi re 'dun sgrub pa'i las 'gan zhig chags yod pa red/ rang btsan rang btsan zer ba de mi nyung shas shig gi mkhe phan gyi don la skad cha shod kyi yod pa zhig rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ ma gzhi 'di 'dra'i go ba log sgrub byed mkhan yod kyi lta ma red/ dper na/ ngos rang la cha bzhag na rgyal ba rin po che'i ming 'thogs yod pa red/ yin na yang / rgyal ba rin po che'i mkhe phan don la rang btsan sgrub kyi yod pa zhig rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ de bzhin bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs mi nyung shas shig gi mkhe phan gyi don la bod rang btsan sgrub kyi yod pa zhig kyang rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ dper na/ ngos rang sger la cha bzhag na/ bod rang btsan gyi las ka sgrub mi dgos pa byung na/ nga la de las dga' ba ga re yod/ nga dge slong zhig red/ lo sum cu so drug la slebs song / tshe lhag 'di don nyung bya nyung zhig byas te/ chos shig byas nas sdus 'dul rgyu zhig byung na bsam pa dran gyi 'dug ma gtogs/ las ka yong la ma yong mang po zhig byed rgyu'i 'dod pa yang mi 'dug la/ shes kyi yang mi 'dug 'di 'dra'i las ka byed mi dgos pa zhig byung na/ nga de las dga' ba mi 'dug de las dga' ba ga re yod/ dngos gnas drang gnas yin/ ngas drang 11 bshad pa yin/ kha shas kyis go ba log sgrub rgyag gi yod 'gro/ mang che ba lta de 'dra dran mkhan yod kyi ma red de/ gcig byas na 'ga' shas de 'dra yod shas che/ med na yang phyogs snga blangs nas zhus par skyon gang yang mi 'dug gcig byas na phyogs snga'i nam ma langs par/ dgag sgrub 368

kyi nyi ma shar zer ba de 'dra chags kyi yod 'gro ste/ gang ltar thal cha gang yang mi 'dug gnas tshul de 'dra red/ nga tshos rang btsan rang btsan zer ba de bod spyi pa'i don dag red/ bod spyi pa'i don dag de bod rgya che'i mi mang gi re 'dun la bstun nas bsam blo gtong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus nga tshos las ka de sgrub 'os pa dang / sgrub dgos pa/ rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yin pas/ phyi nang su la gshad dgos byung yang bshad chog gi red/ dper na/nga tshos rgya gar gzhung la zhu dgos byung yang nga tshos spobs pa chen wa'i thog nas zhus chog gi red/ nga tshos bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams kyi re 'dun de'i tshab byas te nga tshos zhu gi sku(da pa red/ nga tshos 'dzam gling mnyam sprel rgyal tshogs la yang / bod rgya che'i mi mang gi re 'dun de'i tshab byas nas nga tshos zhu gi yod pa red/ nga sto bod pa nang tshags la skad cha shod dus yin yang / bod rgya che'i mi mang de rnams kyi re 'dun gyi tshab byas nas nga tshos lab kyi yod pa red/ gal srid bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams kyi re 'dun de 'gyur 'dug na/ nga tshos las ka 'di byed dgos don mi 'dug mkhyen song ngam/gnas tshul de 'dra red/ de ltar bod kyi rang btsan de nga tshos sgrub 'os pa dang / sgrub dgos pa zhig yin na/ de nga cho'i dmigs yul la bzhag nas gang 'dra byas nas sgrub dgos zer na/ rang btsan zer ba de don dag chung chung min par shin tu chen po red/ chen po yin tsang / de la dpags pa'i dka' ngal mang po zhig khyad gsod byas nas sgrub dgos/ 'dzam bu gling gi 'gyur ba de gang 'dra zhig gi 369

kyi nyi ma shar zer ba de 'dra chags kyi yod 'gro ste/ gang ltar thal cha gang yang mi 'dug gnas tshul de 'dra red/ nga tshos rang btsan rang btsan zer ba de bod spyi pa'i don dag red/ bod spyi pa'i don dag de bod rgya che'i mi mang gi re 'dun la bstun nas bsam blo gtong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus nga tshos las ka de sgrub 'os pa dang / sgrub dgos pa/ rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yin pas/ phyi nang su la gshad dgos byung yang bshad chog gi red/ dper na/nga tshos rgya gar gzhung la zhu dgos byung yang nga tshos spobs pa chen wa'i thog nas zhus chog gi red/ nga tshos bod rgya che'i mi mang rnams kyi re 'dun de'i tshab byas te nga tshos zhu gi sku(da pa red/ nga tshos 'dzam gling mnyam sprel rgyal tshogs la yang / bod rgya che'i mi mang gi re 'dun de'i tshab byas nas nga tshos zhu gi yod pa red/ nga sto bod pa nang tshags la skad cha shod dus yin yang / bod rgya che'i mi mang de rnams kyi re 'dun gyi tshab byas nas nga tshos lab kyi yod pa red/ gal srid bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams kyi re 'dun de 'gyur 'dug na/ nga tshos las ka 'di byed dgos don mi 'dug mkhyen song ngam/gnas tshul de 'dra red/ de ltar bod kyi rang btsan de nga tshos sgrub 'os pa dang / sgrub dgos pa zhig yin na/ de nga cho'i dmigs yul la bzhag nas gang 'dra byas nas sgrub dgos zer na/ rang btsan zer ba de don dag chung chung min par shin tu chen po red/ chen po yin tsang / de la dpags pa'i dka' ngal mang po zhig khyad gsod byas nas sgrub dgos/ 'dzam bu gling gi 'gyur ba de gang 'dra zhig gi 369

thog nas yong gi yod med shes rgyu khag po red/ nga rang tsho'i rang btsan gyi gnas tshul de 'dzam gling gi 'gyur ba yin yang rung / yang min na rgya nag rang gi 'gyur ba yin yang rung / de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul dang bstun nas phyi nang gi rten 'brel mang po zhig 'dzoms pa'i thog nas sgrub dgos pa ma gtogs/ las sla po zhig thog la nga tshos bde sdug gi skad cha bshad shag shag dang / khrims rtsod rgyag shag shag thog nas byed thub pa khag po red/ deng sang 'dzam bu gling gi skang la bden pa yod na yang / las ka tshang ma bden pa'i chogeg la 'gro thub kyi med/ mi tshang mas kha nas bden pa dang bden pa zhes bshad kyi yod na yang dngos su lag lten bstar ba'i skabs la dngos yod gnas tshul stobs dang nus pa'i thog nas 'gro gi yod pa ma gtogs/ bden pa bden rkyang gi thog nas 'gro thub pa khag po red/ sngon ma 'dir maye sor la dang sngoge 'byor ba'i skabs/ 'di gar gzhis chags rgan pa tshos shes gsal ltar nga tsho skad cha byung / nga tsho de ring sang nyin lam sang bod la log thub pa khag 〈sna red/ gcig byas na lo kha shas 'gor srid kyi red zer rgyu byung / da cha lo bcu gnyis tsam phyin pa red/ da dung yin yang rtsa ba'i nga tsho'i las ka 'di dngos yod gnas tshul gyi thog nas rgya che'i mi mang gi re 'dun yin tsang mu mthud yun bsrings te sgrub dgos/ 'dzam bu gling gi gnas tshul la mtshon na/ da lta bar du lo bcu gnyis 'di'i ring la de snga lo bcu gnyis kyi gong du 'di 'dra zhig yong gi red bsam pa snang ba'i yul la med pa'i gnas tshul mang po zhig 'gyur 'gro gi 'dug rgya nag rang gi gnas tshul la cha bzhag kyang 'gyur 370

ba chen po phyin yod/ nga tshos bod rgya che'i mi mang gi re 'dun rang btsan gyi las 'gul de thog mu mthud nas lan dgu chad mthud kyis 'bad rtsol byed 'os pa zhig dang / byed dgos pa zhig chags yod/ de ltar byas pa yin na bden pa'i mtha' zhig gsal nas gzhis byes rgya che'i mi mang tshang ma gdan 'dzoms nas bkra shis lo legs shig sku(nga rgyu yin pa thag chod pa zhig red la/nga tshos yid ches gtsang ma byas chog pa zhig red/da lta nga tshos mi'i lung par sdod ring la so so'e 'tsho ba ra nga 'tsho gdengs 'khel ba zhig dang / so so dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi thog nas rkang pa 'dzugs thub pa zhig ma byung na/ phyogs gzhan dag gi thog la bsam lho gtong rgyu khag po red/ gnas tshul de'i chogeg nas ga zhis chags byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de sngon ma nas mang po zhus tshar ba tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ da dung yang /nga chos dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi thog nas nus pa zhig bskyed ma thub na/ nga tshor gang ci'i thad nas dka' ngal yong rgyu yin stabs/ da dung nga tsho tshang mas 'bad brtson bskyed de/ yar rgyas thog shugs bskyed dgos kyi 'dug zhu rgyu de yin/ nga tshos spyi dngul gsog 'jog byas nas spyi pa'i don dag la phan pa byed dgos pa yin tsang / nga tshos dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi cha nas mtha' ma 'gag pa'i yar rgyas gtong dgos kyi red/ nga tshos rtsa ba'i gnas tshul la blta dgos/ 'di gzhis chags kyi bsti gnas che ba zhig yin pas khyed rang tshos sems shugs bskyed dgos/ go skabs sku(da pa dang / mthun rkyen 'dzoms nas yod pa yin stabs shugs bskyed dgos kyi 'dug ces zhu dgos 371

ba chen po phyin yod/ nga tshos bod rgya che'i mi mang gi re 'dun rang btsan gyi las 'gul de thog mu mthud nas lan dgu chad mthud kyis 'bad rtsol byed 'os pa zhig dang / byed dgos pa zhig chags yod/ de ltar byas pa yin na bden pa'i mtha' zhig gsal nas gzhis byes rgya che'i mi mang tshang ma gdan 'dzoms nas bkra shis lo legs shig sku(nga rgyu yin pa thag chod pa zhig red la/nga tshos yid ches gtsang ma byas chog pa zhig red/da lta nga tshos mi'i lung par sdod ring la so so'e 'tsho ba ra nga 'tsho gdengs 'khel ba zhig dang / so so dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi thog nas rkang pa 'dzugs thub pa zhig ma byung na/ phyogs gzhan dag gi thog la bsam lho gtong rgyu khag po red/ gnas tshul de'i chogeg nas ga zhis chags byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de sngon ma nas mang po zhus tshar ba tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ da dung yang /nga chos dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi thog nas nus pa zhig bskyed ma thub na/ nga tshor gang ci'i thad nas dka' ngal yong rgyu yin stabs/ da dung nga tsho tshang mas 'bad brtson bskyed de/ yar rgyas thog shugs bskyed dgos kyi 'dug zhu rgyu de yin/ nga tshos spyi dngul gsog 'jog byas nas spyi pa'i don dag la phan pa byed dgos pa yin tsang / nga tshos dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi cha nas mtha' ma 'gag pa'i yar rgyas gtong dgos kyi red/ nga tshos rtsa ba'i gnas tshul la blta dgos/ 'di gzhis chags kyi bsti gnas che ba zhig yin pas khyed rang tshos sems shugs bskyed dgos/ go skabs sku(da pa dang / mthun rkyen 'dzoms nas yod pa yin stabs shugs bskyed dgos kyi 'dug ces zhu dgos 371

don de yin/ gzhan dag zhu rgyu mi 'dug tshang mas mkhyen mkhyen pa red/ sngon ma yang mang po zhus tshar ba red/ da lta dbang rdor lags nas gnas lugs zhib pa gsung rgyu yod pa red/de nas 'dir sbag sa nas phebs pa'i dge 'dun pa tsho bar lam sbag sar dngos gnas sku mnyel po byung 'dug ngas de ring ngo sprod cig zhus na yag po 'dug sbag sa nas phebs pa'i dge 'dun snur gnas tshul dmigs bsal can chags bsdad yod/ bod nas rgya gar la phebs pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag lnga drug bar yod/ de tsho tshang mar dmigs bsal gyi thob thang dgos pa'i skor rgya gar gzhung gis mtshon pas rogs ram tshogs pa khag la zhus pa yang med la/ zhus pas la dag gi ma red/ nga snubarno grwa pa tshos sa zhing gi las byed rgyu 'di 'os po mi 'dug 'bu srin mang po shi 'gro gi 'dug zer ba de red lta red de deng sang dngos yod kyi gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig la gyar yod pa yin tsang gang 'dra byed dgos red/ ma 'os pa dang / mi bzod pa gcig mthong gi 'dug ste mthong na'ang gnas skabs cig byed thabs mi 'dug nga tsho'i dge 'dun pa stong phrag lnga drug tsam yod pa de tsho'i nang nas mang che ba lam bzo 'a 'gro mkhan lam bzor phyin/ gzhis chags la 'gro mkhan gzhis chags 'a/ phyin te de snga 'di ga ma ye sor gzhis sgar thog mar chags pa'i skabs su 'di'i nang la dge 'dun pa yod/ de bzhin o ri sa sogs ga sa ga la dge 'dun pa mang po slebs yod/ cam pa dang / ku lu sogs kyi khul la dge 'dun pa mang po lam bzor phebs yod/ sbag sa'i dge 'dun pa rnams gang 'dra red 372

zer na/ bod la nga rang cho'i sku da na med na gcig sangs rgyas kyi chos/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de red/ chos de spus dag po yod thag chod red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la nang pa sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi rjes 'brangs spyir btang sa ya lnga brgya tsam yod pa red/ de'i nang nas sangs rgyas kyi chos spus dag shos cha tshang ba yod pa ni bod gcig pu yin pa lta bu red/ de dag bod pas gsar du bzos pa min par/ rgya gar nas tshur bsgyur ba sha stag red/ bka' 'gyur pod brgya tsam zhig dang / bstan 'gyur pod nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam zhig yo/nga pa red/ tsa ba'i khungs de rnams la gtugs te bshad sgrub nyams len byed kyi yod pa yin tsang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'dzam bu gling 'di'i snang la spus dag shos dang / cha tshang shos de bod la yod pa nang bzhin/ gzhan dag la phal cher med pa lta bu red/ des na nga tshos de srung skyob byed 'os pa dang / byed dgos pa gcig chags yod/ de srung skyob byed pa la dpe cha yod pa gcig pus 'grigs thabs med/ dpe cha zer mkhan de phyi'i dngos po zhig red/ dpe cha yod kyang de'i don 'grel bshad rgyag shes pa gcig dang / de'i don dag go thub pa gcig ma byung na/ dpe cha yod pa gcig pus phan thogs de tsam med/ dper na/ dpe mdzod khang nang la dpe cha 'dzoms po yod na yang de ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos shi ro lta bu red ma gtogs phan thogs chen po sku da pa ma red/ da nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos gson pa gang du dgos zer na mi'i klad pa'i nang la yod dgos/ mi'i klad pa'i nang la nyar tshags (5ga po byas/ don dag shes thub pa zhig dang / shes nas lag len du bkal 373

nas 'bo thub mkhan zhig byung na phun sum tshogs pa red/ dgos rgyu de red/de 'dra'i gnas tshul cha tshang ba de bod la ma gtogs med pa lta bu yin dus nga tshos srung skyob byed dgos pa de bod mi rigs kyi 'os 'gan lta bu chags yod/chos skad thog nas bshad na/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i bde skyid kyi 'byung khungs dang / spyir btang thog nas bshad na/ chos zer ba de shes bya'i rnam grangs kyi khongs gtogs yin pa red/ shes bya'i rnam grangs shig la ngos bzung ba yin na yang / shes bya'i rnam grangs rnams 'dzam bu gling spyi la dbang ba zhig red/ mi rigs so so'i khyad chos 'dra mi 'dra'i shes rig gang 'dra zhig yin na'ang 'dzam gling spyi'i khyad nor lta bu chags yod pa red/ mi rigs su dang su 'dra zhig yin rung rang gi shes rig srung skyob byed rgyu dang / nyar tshags bya rgyu de 'os pa dang / drang bden gyi las ka zhig chags yod/ dper na/ 'dzam glikhro rgyal spyi'i nang la yang shes rig srung skyob slor las ka mang po zhig byed kyi 'dug nga skru'ire shes rig drag shos nang pa sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di yin pas/de nga tshos srung skyob byed pa ni 'os shing 'tshams pa yin/ de ni bod mi rigs gcig pu'i don tsam min par/ 'dzam gling spyi'i shes rig srung skyob byed pa'i las ga'i cha shas shig red/ gnyis nas rgya gar nang du cha bzhag na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di rgya gar nas byung ba yin pas/ 'di rgya gar gyi shes rig gi cha shas shig red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyi thog nas lnga bcu nga dgu'i lo nga tsho ma su rir yod pa'i skabs rgya gar gyi srid blon zhe ru dam pa de la bod nas sku nga ba'i gra pa spyi byings lam bzo sogs la ma phyin thabs med kyang /374

de'i nang mkhas pa dang / mkhas pa'i slob gnyer mu mthud nas byed mkhan nyung shos la'ang stong phrag gnyis tsam zhig yod pa de dag dmigs bsal byas nas slob gnyer mu mthud byed rgyu yong ba zhig ma byas par thabs mi 'dug ces bka' mol zhus nas mtha' ma chig stong lnga brgya la gtan 'khel/ de yang sa dge bka' rnying bzhi nas rgya gar nang du slebs pa'i mi 'bo ra mang shos dge lugs yin stabs/ mang shos dge lugs chags/ de'i 'og tu sa skya/ de nas bka' rgyud rnying ma gnyis yin pa yod/ nga tsho'i bsam blo la sbag sar slob gnyer byed mkhan khe gtsang gi ris med chos sgar slob gnyer khang yag po zhig bzos/ de la mthun rkyen yang dmigs bsal gyi thog nas bsgrub rgyu'i bsam blo 'khor ba red/ yin na yang sbag sar sa gnas chags babs kyis tsha ba che zhing / gang ci'i mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i dbang gis dge 'dun mang po 'das grongs gyur/ mang po zhig nad pa chags/ dge 'dun mang po thugs sems mi bde ba sogs dka' ngal chen po byung bar brten/ chos sgar de rgya gar nang spo thabs byas kyang / war ṇar nyis brgya lhag tsam zhig ma gtogs yongs rdzogs ma tshud stabs dge 'dun byings rnams kyi 'tsho thabs brtan pa zhig rang gal che bar bsam nas bod mi gzhis chags kyi sa cha'i sgang la spo rgyu dang / bod mi spyi 'gre'i sa khang skal thob len rgyur gtan 'khel ba red/sbag sa'i dge 'dun rnams rgya gar lho phyogs su spo stangs de ltar red/ sbag sa nas phebs pa'i dge 'dun rnams gnas tshul dmigs bsal can zhig yin lugs gtso bo rgya gar gzhung dang / rogs ram tshogs pa khag la'ang gnas 375

tshul 'grel bshad de ltar zhu dus/ gnas tshul de yang dag pa dang / rgyu mtshan ldan par gzigs nas dmigs bsal gyi thugs snang dang / dmigs bsal gyi rogs ram thob pa byung ba red/ da lta las ka 'go 'dzugs skabs yin tsang las ka mang po zhig chags bsdad yod pa red de/ rim pas rim pas gnas tshul yag po zhig chags thub pa'i re ba yod/ yag po yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug de chags pa'i mtshams la dge 'dun pa tsho nas kyang dang po'i dmigs yul gzhir bzungs tshang mas slob gnyer gyi thog la shugs rgyab na sa dngos gnas drang gnas mkhas pa mang ngo ngan thub pa'i las 'gan khur dgos kyi red/de bzhin gzhis chags mi mang spyi byings tsho'i thog nas kyang dge 'dun pa 'di dag gi 'gro stangs mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug gang 'dra yin nam bsam pa yong gi ma red la/ gnas tshul de ltar yin/ bar lam dge 'dun pa tsho'i 'gro stangs skor la rgyal spyi'i rogs ram tshogs pa'i 'go byed mkhan zhig rgya gar la lta bskor du slebs pa de'i las bsdoms nang la/ rgya gar nang bod mi btsan byol ba'i nang la rnyog khra tsha shos thon skyed med pa'i mi gra pa stong phrag brgyad 'dug de rnams kyi 'gro stangs bzo rgyu khag po 'dug ces bris yod/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul de 'dra ma red/ gra pa spyi byings tshang ma bod mi spyi mtshungs byas nas lam bzo dang / gzhis chags la phyin yod pa ma gtogs dmigs bsal gang yang yod pa ma red/ sbag sa'i de rnams gnas tshul dmigs bsal can zhig yin pa'i 'grel bshad gong du zhus pa ltar red/ gnas tshul de rnams ngo sprod kyi tshul du zhus pa yin/ da gzhan dag zhu rgyu gang yang mi 'dug tshang 376

mas da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red/ da dung yang shugs bskyed nas so so'i skabs su babs pa'i las 'gan gang yod pa de so so'i nus pa gang yod pa bton pa'i thog nas yar rgyas gtong rgyu gal chen po red/nga tsho 'dir mi sde zhig gzhis chags dgos/ de 'dra'i mi sde de deng dus dang mthun pa'i thog nas chags dgos dus de la las rigs mang po dgos kyi 'dug dper na sman khang / slob grwa/ thon skyed skor la cha bzhag na/ da lta'i gnas skabs la 'thag las/ 'brog las sog sa 'dra mi 'dra mang po yod/'khor lo mang po zhig bed spyod dgos kyi yod pa yin tsang 'khor lo nyams gso byed sa'i bzo las khang chung chung (70125602)zer ba lta bu mang po chags yong gi red/ mi sde yar rgyas gtong ba la de dag tshang ma med du mi rung ba'i gnas tshul sha stag red/ de dag tshang ma mi gcig gis byed mi thub la/ mi tshang mas mnyam du byed thabs kyang med/ las rigs gang dang gang yin pa de ga de ga'i slob sbyong byas pa'i mi tshos shugs bskyed nas nus pa 'don dgos/nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul mi sde zhig yar rgyas gtong rgyu yin na yang / yar rgyas gtong ba'i thabs shes kyi rnam pa dang / sde tshan mang po zhig yod pa yin tsang / yan lag sde tshan so so'i nang gi las rigs slob sbyong dmigs bkar byas pa tshos sde tshan so so'i nang la shugs rgyab/ phyogs mang spro zhig nas phyar ba gru 'degs byas te phyogs so so nas yar rgyas btang / nus pa bskyed na/nus pa tshur bsags yong dus nga tsho'i mi sde yongs rdzogs yar rgyas nagro gi red/ des na phyogs so so'i las rigs mi re ngo re'i nang la yod mkhan tshos da bar 377

du hur thag byas yod la/ da dung yang tshang mas hur thag byas nas shugs rgyag dgos zhes zhu rgyu'i snying wang de yin/lhag don na gzhon bar lam slob grwa khag la phyin/ gzhi rim gyi 'dzin gra thon/ mtho rim 〈(ba grwa sogs la 'gro bzhin pa dang / 'gro mkhan pho mo ji snyed yod pa tshos rim pa rim pas so so'i nus pa dang 'tshams pa so so'i shes yon dang ran pa'i las rigs gang 'dra zhig yar rgyas gtong thub pa dang /'gan khur byed thub pa zhig yod na tshang mas nus pa bskyed nas 'gan khur byed thub pa byung na yag po red/ da lta bar tshang mas hur thag byed kyi 'dug par dga' po byung / slob sbyong byas pa'i dgos don rang gi spyi tshogs de yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de gal che shos red/ de'i thog la dngos su so so'i shes skusgon bed spyod byed sa'i mtshams su slebs na tshang mas shugs skyes hur thag gnang shog a/rtag par zhu mus ltar tshang ma dam tshig mthun po dgos pa de gal chen po red/ dam tshig mthun na yid ches yong gi red/ yid che sa byung na nga tshos las ka gang yang sgrub thub kyi red/ dam tshig mthun po ma byung na yid ches yong gi ma red/ yid ches med na/ ngas skad cha zhig bshad dgos byung na yang khag po red/ de bzhin su dang sus skad cha bshad dgos byung na khag po red/ so sos bsam pa rnam dag gi skad cha bshad pa yin na yang phar phyogs des go ba gang 'dra zhig rgyab yong cha ma mchis pa red/ go ba log sgrub chags yong dus/ dge gcig thon na bsam ste bshad pa yin na yang skyon la 'gro rgyu'i 378

nyen kha yong gi red/ de ga res lan pa red zer na yid ches yod med la thug yod/ yid ches yod na skad cha bshad rgyu yong gi red la/ go bsdur byed rgyu yong gi red/ rtsa ba dam tshig la thug pa red/ dam tshig dgos kyi red/ nga rang tsho bod rigs nang khul dam tshig dang mthun bsgril byed rgyu gal chen po yin pa ma zad/ yul 'di'i mi tsho la mthun bsgril byed rgyu yang gal chen po red/ ma gzhi da lta yag po yod pa 'dra/ da dung yin na yang tshang mas do snang byed dgos/ nga rang tsho'i dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi gnas stangs thog nas kyang yul mi tsho dang 'brel ba yod/ da lta nga tsho thog ma'i 'go 'dzugs tsam yin rung / rim pas nga tsho'i dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi gnas tshul shugs che ru phyin mtshams g.yas gasku(na gyi rgya gar yul pa tsho dang / nga tsho phan tshun rogs ram gyi thog nas nga tsho'i nus pa 'don dgos kyi red/ yul mi tsho dang mthun po byed rgyu de ha cang gi gal chen po red/ gzhi nas nga tsho bsam blo thongs dang / yul mi tsho ha cang gi bka' drin chen po red/ gtso bo rgya gar gzhung bka' drin chen po red/ yang sgos ma ye sor mnga' sde'i gzhung dpe mi srid pa'i bka' drin chen po red/ mnga' sde 'di'i nang la da lta slebs tshar bod mi phal cher stong phrag bcu brgal ba yod/ da dung yang nga tshosa.u tshugs byas nas ma ye sor la bod mi stong phrag kha shas len thub na yag sngo 'dug ces zhu gi yod/ re ba yang yod red/ rgya gar gyi mnga' sde 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i ngodi mi la dmigs bsal gyi gzigs rtogs gnang yod pa yin tsang /de'i cha nas nga tshor bka' drin chen po red/ rgya gar yul pa 'di rnams la 379

'brel ba yas/ po dang / mthun bsgril yag po byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red /tshang mas dam tshig gtsang ma byas/ yul pa tshor cha bzhag na spyir btang nga rang tsho mi gcig pa red/ bde ba chung chung zhig yin na yang 'dod pa/ sdug bsngal chung chung zhig yin na yang mi 'dod pa/ phran bu phran bu mdog dbyibs mi 'dra ba dang / za lugs/ 'thung lugs mi 'dra tsam zhig ma gtogs tshang ma bde skyid 'dod mnyam red/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i thog nas kyang tshang ma 'cham po byed dgos/ mthun po byung na ha cang yag po red/ de gal chen po red/ shes song ngam/ da gzhan zhu rgyu med/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes 35pa// // 380

'brel ba yas/ po dang / mthun bsgril yag po byed rgyu shin tu gal chen po red /tshang mas dam tshig gtsang ma byas/ yul pa tshor cha bzhag na spyir btang nga rang tsho mi gcig pa red/ bde ba chung chung zhig yin na yang 'dod pa/ sdug bsngal chung chung zhig yin na yang mi 'dod pa/ phran bu phran bu mdog dbyibs mi 'dra ba dang / za lugs/ 'thung lugs mi 'dra tsam zhig ma gtogs tshang ma bde skyid 'dod mnyam red/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i thog nas kyang tshang ma 'cham po byed dgos/ mthun po byung na ha cang yag po red/ de gal chen po red/ shes song ngam/ da gzhan zhu rgyu med/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes 35pa// // 380

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1973 zla 1 tshes 15 nyin/ ma ye sor lugs zung bsam gling gzhis chags gsar rnying ser skya mi mang yongs rdzogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags 'di gzhis sgar che shos shig red/ bar lam yar rgyas/ chen po phyin/ na ning da lta'i bar la yang 'gyur ba thebs/ gang nas yar rgyas 'gro gi yod pa red/ sho rwanan phyi la khra khra zing zing ga re yod da ma med kyang / khyed rang tsho'i ngo gdong rang nas shes kyi 'dug thog mar yong mkhan gyi mi tshang mar rgyus yod red/ sngon ma 'go stod 'dir slebs ma thag gi skabs la ha cang khag po byung ngam/ mi tshang ma'i gdong gshis log tshang mar yul log gang la gang 'tshams thebs pa red/ dngos gnas dka' las khag po byung ba red/ yin na yang khyed rang tshos dka' ngal khyad bsad byas/nga tsho thug dus gang yang byed kyi ma red/ dka' las rgyob cig rjes su gcig yong gi red ces re ba bskul gyin bskul gyin byas/ khyed rang tshos kha la nyan po bya sa te hur thag byas pa'i lag rjes la da cha gzhi nas rnam 'gyur rbad de 'gyur/ phyi'i rnam 'gyur tsam ma zad mi'i ngo gdong tshun chad bzo lta thon/ tshang ma'i gyon gos e yin/ gang ci'i gnas stangs yag thag chod chags 'dugadangos gnas dga' po byung / tshang mas lo mang dka' las rgyab pa'i lag rjes red/ gzhis sgar gyi mi spyi dang / lhag par 'go stod 'byor mkhan khyed rang tshos dka' las rgyab ste thog ma'i srol btod pa yin dus dmigs bsal gyi thugs rje che zer gyi yod/ ha cang gi yag po red/ de ga nang bzhin las ka 381

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1973 zla 1 tshes 15 nyin/ ma ye sor lugs zung bsam gling gzhis chags gsar rnying ser skya mi mang yongs rdzogs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/nga rang tsho'i gzhis chags 'di gzhis sgar che shos shig red/ bar lam yar rgyas/ chen po phyin/ na ning da lta'i bar la yang 'gyur ba thebs/ gang nas yar rgyas 'gro gi yod pa red/ sho rwanan phyi la khra khra zing zing ga re yod da ma med kyang / khyed rang tsho'i ngo gdong rang nas shes kyi 'dug thog mar yong mkhan gyi mi tshang mar rgyus yod red/ sngon ma 'go stod 'dir slebs ma thag gi skabs la ha cang khag po byung ngam/ mi tshang ma'i gdong gshis log tshang mar yul log gang la gang 'tshams thebs pa red/ dngos gnas dka' las khag po byung ba red/ yin na yang khyed rang tshos dka' ngal khyad bsad byas/nga tsho thug dus gang yang byed kyi ma red/ dka' las rgyob cig rjes su gcig yong gi red ces re ba bskul gyin bskul gyin byas/ khyed rang tshos kha la nyan po bya sa te hur thag byas pa'i lag rjes la da cha gzhi nas rnam 'gyur rbad de 'gyur/ phyi'i rnam 'gyur tsam ma zad mi'i ngo gdong tshun chad bzo lta thon/ tshang ma'i gyon gos e yin/ gang ci'i gnas stangs yag thag chod chags 'dugadangos gnas dga' po byung / tshang mas lo mang dka' las rgyab pa'i lag rjes red/ gzhis sgar gyi mi spyi dang / lhag par 'go stod 'byor mkhan khyed rang tshos dka' las rgyab ste thog ma'i srol btod pa yin dus dmigs bsal gyi thugs rje che zer gyi yod/ ha cang gi yag po red/ de ga nang bzhin las ka 381

byed mkhan tsho yin na yang lo mang sbrel te dka' las rgyab yod/ las ku'i 'go 'khrid byed mkhan de rna ba 'jam po yod pa ma red/ mi mang po zhig gi 'dod pa bstun dgos kyi yod pa song tsang / gcig gi 'dod par phyin na/ gcig gi 'dod par 'gro gi ma red/ gcig gi 'dod par phyin rung gcig gi 'dod par ma phyin pa byas nas yag dang nyes zer nas dngos gan sa rna bar na zug skye ba'i skad cha rtag tu thos dgos pa de 'dra'i dka' ngal chen po red/ phyogs gcig nas mi mang po'i 'go 'khrid byed dgos pa dang / gnyis nas nga tsho mi'i lung par gyar te bde sdug blta rtogs tshang ma mi la re nas byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ so sos lam seng byed chog chog yod pa ma red/ 'on kyang khyi kha rdo len so so'i mis byed dgos kyi yod pa yin dus dka' ngal ston ma zhig chags bsdad yod/ yin na yang snyugs bsrings lo nas lo bstud de lo mang gzhung dang mi mang gi zhabs 'degs hur thag zhus pa red/ de byas rjes chen po red/ khyed rang 'go 'khrid kyis gtsos pa'i las ka byed mkhan sto la'ang dmigs bsal gyi thugs rje che zer gyi yod/ sngon ma nas ma gzhi skad cha rim pa byung ba ltar/ skyar zlos/ yang zlos/ gsal skyor byas nas dgos pa mi 'dug ste tshang mas da dung yin nayang yar rgyas 'gro ba'i thabs shes byed dgos/gzhis sgar 'di gras nga rang tsho'i dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi gzhi rtsa 'dra po chags nas bsdad yod pa yin dus/ dpal 'byor longs spyod yar rgyas 'gro ba'i thabs shes/ de yang so so so so'i khyim tshang tsam du ma zad/ bod mi btsan byol ba spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di bzang du 'gro ba'i don du dpal 'byor gyi thog 382

nas shugs rgyag thub thabs skor la na ning skad cha byung ngam/ de tsho bsam blo btang na yag po red/ da dung yin na yang yar rgyas gtong dgos/de dang chabs cig mi'i spyi tshogs zhig gi nang la za rgyu 'thung rgyu gcig pos mi 'grigs par/ shes rig gi 'tsho ba yod dgos/ za rgyu 'thung rgyu'i 'tsho ba yang dgos la/ bag phebs po'i gnas yid du 'ong ba'i 'tsho ba yang dgos kyi red/ de 'dra yin dus zhar dang zhor la so so'i nang khyim gyi sgo 'gram la me tog 'dra btsugs/ 'ga' shas nas phran bu btsugs 'dug pa de tsho yag po red/ me tog dang / shing snas mtshon pa'i 'dzugs bskrun byed dgos/ za rgyu 'thung rgyu gcig po'i don du min par blta snang la babs chags po/ 'dra chags po/ sdum ra'i rnam pa lta bu chags thub na/ de yang mi'i 'tsho ba la dgos pa zhig red/ thog mar nga tsho za rgyu 'thung rgyu gcig po'i dngangs skrag yod pa'i skabs la me tog gi skad cha bshad na/ des gang yong / grod pa rgyag pa la phan gyi ni ma red bsam pa blo la dran gyi yod pa red de/ da cha mi'i gnas tshad dang 'tsho ba drag tu phyin pa'i skabs la de tsho yang dgos kyi red/ phun sum tshogs pa'i cha rkyen zhig red/de nang bzhin mi'i shes rig gi 'tsho ba de gal chen po red/ shes rig gi 'tsho ba'i nang la gzhon skyes tsho la slob sbyong sprod rgyu de smos med red/ de la tshang mas do snang byed mus yin la/ da dung yin na yang do snang byas/ ma 'ongs par 'tshar longs byed mkhan phru gu de tsho dus tshod dang mthun pa'i shes yon cha tshang ba zhig dgos kyi yod pa yin tsang / pha ma so so dang / phyogs 383
