nas shugs rgyag thub thabs skor la na ning skad cha byung ngam/ de tsho bsam blo btang na yag po red/ da dung yin na yang yar rgyas gtong dgos/de dang chabs cig mi'i spyi tshogs zhig gi nang la za rgyu 'thung rgyu gcig pos mi 'grigs par/ shes rig gi 'tsho ba yod dgos/ za rgyu 'thung rgyu'i 'tsho ba yang dgos la/ bag phebs po'i gnas yid du 'ong ba'i 'tsho ba yang dgos kyi red/ de 'dra yin dus zhar dang zhor la so so'i nang khyim gyi sgo 'gram la me tog 'dra btsugs/ 'ga' shas nas phran bu btsugs 'dug pa de tsho yag po red/ me tog dang / shing snas mtshon pa'i 'dzugs bskrun byed dgos/ za rgyu 'thung rgyu gcig po'i don du min par blta snang la babs chags po/ 'dra chags po/ sdum ra'i rnam pa lta bu chags thub na/ de yang mi'i 'tsho ba la dgos pa zhig red/ thog mar nga tsho za rgyu 'thung rgyu gcig po'i dngangs skrag yod pa'i skabs la me tog gi skad cha bshad na/ des gang yong / grod pa rgyag pa la phan gyi ni ma red bsam pa blo la dran gyi yod pa red de/ da cha mi'i gnas tshad dang 'tsho ba drag tu phyin pa'i skabs la de tsho yang dgos kyi red/ phun sum tshogs pa'i cha rkyen zhig red/de nang bzhin mi'i shes rig gi 'tsho ba de gal chen po red/ shes rig gi 'tsho ba'i nang la gzhon skyes tsho la slob sbyong sprod rgyu de smos med red/ de la tshang mas do snang byed mus yin la/ da dung yin na yang do snang byas/ ma 'ongs par 'tshar longs byed mkhan phru gu de tsho dus tshod dang mthun pa'i shes yon cha tshang ba zhig dgos kyi yod pa yin tsang / pha ma so so dang / phyogs 383

tshang ma nas do snang zhen bskul byas/ gzab gzab byed dgos/ de min shes yon gyi rigs gcig la nga cho'i bod gzhas/ bod pa'i glu gar gyi rigs/ dga' dga' skyid skyid rdzod ltod yod pa'i skabs la/ ya rabs kyi tshul dang mthun pa'i bag phebs po'i rkang bro glu gzhas zer ba de tsho'i gras kyang / mi'i 'tsho ba'i nang la dgos mkho yod/ de 'dra yin dus so so so so'i yul gzhas/ sgor gzhas sogs yod pa de tsho'i gras snying rje po 'dug gam/ de tsho'i gras de 'phel rgyas dang / dar so chen po byung na yag po red/ de min mi'i 'tsho ba'i nang la gzhas rnam thar 'dra gtong dgos mkhan/ rkang bro glu gzhas gcig kyang dgos mkhan zhig la so so'i de yang brlag mi'i gzhas shig gi lad zlos byas/gzhi rtsa gzhas kyi rnam 'gyur yang 'gyur lta 'gyur 'gro gi red de/ so so'i de rang byung na yag po red/ de yang mi'i 'tsho ba'i nang du dgos kyi red/ sngon ma'i skabs la yin na skad cha de tsho res ma'i skad cha red/ da cha de tshor gzhi nas do snang byed dgos pa'i dus skabs yin pas/ do snang byed dgos/ yang /chang tshod med ra bzi bzi 'thung ba dang / sho sbag rgyan chen po btsugs te gang byung byed pa de tsho ma rabs red/ de tsho la dge mtshan med/ ya rabs dang bag phebs po'i thog nas snang ba skyid po gang yang byed rgyu yod/ chos pa dngos gnas drang gnas sgo gsum chos la bsgril mkhan zhig gi gnas tshul tha dad red/ nga rang tsho bod mi mang che ba de 'dra'i tshe blos btang gi chos shig kyang mi yong / 'on kyang 'jig rten mi chos ya rabs dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba bzang po'i mi tshe skyel stangs zhig dgos kyi red/ nga tsho bod pa'i khyim tshang gi sde/ge+orkaka 384

chags yod pa yin tsang / tshang ma dgos kyi red/ de 'dra'i rigs la do snang byas/ gzhan zer rgyu mi 'dug tshang ma da lta nang bzhin 'cham 11 byas/ mthun po byas/ rdog la 'gril po byung na bde skyid yong gi red/ spyir btang shes yon spel rgyu gal chen po red/ shes yon spel zer nas yi ge bri rgyu 11 na min par sku( 16) bsam blo gtong rgyu mang du dang / mthong rgya/ thos rgya ga tshod mang du phyin na yang de'i tshod kyis phan gyi red/ yi ge bris shes pa zer ba de gnas tshul tha dad red/ khyed rang tsho rgan pa tshos do snang byed dgos/ so so do snang byas na spyir btang gi 'dzam bu gling gi gnas tshul skor dang / rgya dkar nag gi gnas tshul sogs shes rtogs thub rgyur phan thogs yong rgyu yin tsang gsar shog sogs la do snang byed rgyu gal chen po red/ so sos yi ge bris ma shes kyang blta klog de 'dra byed thub na/ de sto yang mi'i 'tsho ba'i nang la dgos mkho chen po chags yod/ de 'dra'i thog nas so so'i shes yon rgya che ru dang / yar rgyas 'gro ba'i thabs shes byed dgos/yang bsam blo mang du phyin pa'i tshod kyis sdod ma tshugs mang po byas na dge mtshan med pas sdod tshugs zin po byed dgos/ bsam blo mang po 'khor thub pa la sdod tshugs zin po byung na yag po red/ go song ngam/ 'di ga'i las ka byed mkhan dang / 'go 'khrid mkhan tshos da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red la da dung yin na yang hur thag byed kyi red/ dngos gnas rgyu 'bras dpang 'pher gyi 'go 'don 'tsho skyong byed kyi red la/ spyi byings nas ngag bkod dang len byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ spyi'i sgrig dang khrims zer ba 'di btsan dbang 385

bshad pa'i sgrig khrims ma red/ ya rabs kyi sgrig khrims shig yod na yag po 'dug de'i skor la sngon ma nas mang po bshad tshar ba yin/nga rang tsho bod spyi'i rtsa don gyi sdug bsngal de da dung nga tshos sel thub yod pa ma red/ ngas rogs ram tshogs mi 'dra 'phrad dus 'di 'dra bshad kyi yod/ dka' ngal 'dra ga re 'dug gam zer dus/ nga tsho'i btsan byol ba'i dka' ngal sel dgos mi 'dug phal che ba 'grigs bsdad yod/ yin na yang rtsa ba'i bod spyi'i don dag gi dka' ngal de sel ma thub bar du nga tshor dka' ngal mu mthud yong rgyu red/ rtsa ba'i dka' ngal de nga tshos gzhi nas sel rgyur bsdad yod/ ces shod kyi yod/ nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i bsgrub bya de gzhi nas bsdad yod/ 'di'i don la tshang mas sems khur yod spos ltar/ da dung yin na yang sems/ zur byed rgyu gal chen po red/ nga tsho bod spyi pa'i don dag 'di la bden mtha' gsal rgyu med pa ma red/ bden mtha' ga sal rgyu yod nges can red/ lhag par du yang na ning 'dir 'byor ba nas da lta'i bar du 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la 'gyur ba mang po phyin pa red/ rgya nag gzhung 'dzam gling rgyal tshogs la tshud/ a mi ri gas mtshon pa'i rgyal khab mang po zhig dang 'brel ba chags pa sogs/ de 'dra'i 'gyur ldog mang po phyin pa red/ sngon ma lo bcu bco lnga'i gong la nga tsho rgya gar du 'byor ba'i skabs su bsam blo'i nang du med mkhan gyi 'gyur ba ha cang chen spro zhig na ning da lo'i bar la thebs nas da cha nga tsho phar bzhag 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi rgyal khab chen po de tsho'i gras kyang da ga 'dra zhig gi skang la 'gro dgos yin nam snyam du tshod mi thig 386

par sdod dgos pa'i 'gyur ba chen po bas pa red/ 'gyur ba phyin pa de dag gi rkyen las nga tsho bod pa'i don dag rigs 'ga' shas la skabs re phran bu'i byed mi bde ba dang / khag tu phyin pa lta bu'i gnas tshul tan tan byung yod/yin na yang bsam blo zhib tu btang na/ de sngon nga tsho'i bden mtha' nam zhig na gsal gyi red bsam pa tsam ma gtogs kha yod lag yod kyi lam seng 'di 'dra zhig yong gi red bsam pa'i chod thig rgyu yod pa ma red/ 'on kyang na ning da lo'i bar la 'gyur ba 'di ltar 'gro dus phal cher nam zhig na nga tsho'i bden mtha' gsal gyi red zer ba tsam ma yin par dngos gnas lo gcig gnyis gsum de 'dra'i nang la 'gyur ba kha yod lag yod mi yong ngam bsam pa'i dus tshod shig tu slebs pa red/ 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod pa'i rigs 'ga' shas nga tsho'i 'gal rkyen gyi bzo 'dra po yod pa red de/ spyi yongs kyi gnas tshul tshur bsgril na nga tshor mthun pa'i rkyen ma gtogs 'gal rkyen e yin bsam pa 'dug de 'dra yin dus lo gsum bzhi lnga drug gi bar la phal cher gcig byas na 'gyur ba 'dra phyin mi yong ngam/ da re ba'i nang la slebs yod la/ re ba thag nye ru phyin pa lta bu red/ da dung sems shugs ma chag par 'bad brtson bya rgyu'i blo skyed rgyu gal chen po red/ bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rgan pa de tsho lta ci smos/ gzhon skyes so so'i lta ba'i thog nas dmar po'i lta ba yod mkhan/ spyod pa'i thog nas dmar po'i bya spyod yod mkhan de tshos kyang dpe 'dra po'i sems shugs 'khyer nas gang ltar yang snying bod lung pa bod mir dbang ba zhig dgos kyi yod zer ba de la rgan byis tshang ma sems 387

shugs gcig gyur chags te bsdad yod/ de 'dra zhig gi ngang nas nga tshor re ba rgyag gi yod pa yin tsang / nga tshos don de dag ma brjed snying la bcangs te/ so sor skabs su babs pa'i las 'gan ga re yin na yang hur thag bsgrub ste rtsa ba'i nga tsho'i bod spyi'i don dag de bsgrub dgos yod bsam pa'i sems shugs ma chag pa dang / ma brlag pa/ ma brjed pa bya da gos/ skabs dang sbyar ba'i de'i tshe de'i dus kyi 'gyur ba gang 'dra zhig 'gro gi yod dam/ 'gyur ba de la gzhigs paci'i nga tshos bsam cho'i gra sgrig gang 'dra zhig byed dgos kyi yod dam/ de la gzhigs pa'i lag len gang 'dra zhig gi sgang la 'gro dgos kyi yod de/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi thad ka thad ga'i gnas tshul la gzhigs pas 'gro rgyu red/ ngas da lta bshad thub thabs med la bshad rgyu gang yang mi 'dugatshang mas 'di dag nges pa byed dgos/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes stsal//388

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1973 zla 1 tshes 25 dgong dro'i chu tshod 2 thoga.o ri sa phun tshugs gling gzhis sgar ser skya mi mang 'du 'dzoms sar/ chos 'brel stsal skabs kyi gsung bshad bka' slob/da ring 'di ga'i gzhis sgar gyi ser skya thun mong nas chos 'brel zhus ba ltar/ da lta lung kha shas shig 'bul rgyu yin/ nga rang tsho rang gzhan su dang su yin yang bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa tshang ma gcig gyur red/ rgyu dngos po'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms po/ dbang yod pa/ mi drag shos shig yin yang dgos pa de bde skyid dang / mi dgos pa de sdug bsngal yin/ che ba gcig yin yang dgos pa de bde skyid dang / mi ha cang gi kha thabs skyo po ya nga po'i thog la sdod mkhan gcig yin na'ang 'dod pa de bde ba dang /mi 'dod pa de sdug bsngal red/ de ni nga rang tsho mchog dman thams cad 'gro stangs gcig gyur chags bsdad yod/ de tsam du ma zad srog chags 'bu srin tshun chad bde ba 'dod pa sha stag dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sha stag red/ nga rang sto tshang mas bde skyid gcig 'dod nas 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la mi'i rigs kyis mi'i rigs la dpag pa'i thabs shes gcig byed kyi yod pa dang / 'bu srin tha na sbrang bu tshun gyis kyang so so so so'i nus pas cogs tshod kyis bde ba sgrub pa dang / sdug bsngal sel ba'i thabs shes tshang mas byed kyi yod pa red/ mi'i rigs la srog chags gzhan las shugs che ba'i bsam blo gtong ba'i nus pa yod pa yin dus chos zer ba de ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rig gi gras/ gang ltar yang snying bde ba sgrub pa dang / sdug bsngal sel 389

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1973 zla 1 tshes 25 dgong dro'i chu tshod 2 thoga.o ri sa phun tshugs gling gzhis sgar ser skya mi mang 'du 'dzoms sar/ chos 'brel stsal skabs kyi gsung bshad bka' slob/da ring 'di ga'i gzhis sgar gyi ser skya thun mong nas chos 'brel zhus ba ltar/ da lta lung kha shas shig 'bul rgyu yin/ nga rang tsho rang gzhan su dang su yin yang bde ba 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa tshang ma gcig gyur red/ rgyu dngos po'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms po/ dbang yod pa/ mi drag shos shig yin yang dgos pa de bde skyid dang / mi dgos pa de sdug bsngal yin/ che ba gcig yin yang dgos pa de bde skyid dang / mi ha cang gi kha thabs skyo po ya nga po'i thog la sdod mkhan gcig yin na'ang 'dod pa de bde ba dang /mi 'dod pa de sdug bsngal red/ de ni nga rang tsho mchog dman thams cad 'gro stangs gcig gyur chags bsdad yod/ de tsam du ma zad srog chags 'bu srin tshun chad bde ba 'dod pa sha stag dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sha stag red/ nga rang sto tshang mas bde skyid gcig 'dod nas 'dzam gling 'di'i sgang la mi'i rigs kyis mi'i rigs la dpag pa'i thabs shes gcig byed kyi yod pa dang / 'bu srin tha na sbrang bu tshun gyis kyang so so so so'i nus pas cogs tshod kyis bde ba sgrub pa dang / sdug bsngal sel ba'i thabs shes tshang mas byed kyi yod pa red/ mi'i rigs la srog chags gzhan las shugs che ba'i bsam blo gtong ba'i nus pa yod pa yin dus chos zer ba de ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rig gi gras/ gang ltar yang snying bde ba sgrub pa dang / sdug bsngal sel 389

ba'i thabs shes gcig red/ bde skyid yong ba dang / sdug bsngal mi yong ba'i thabs shes gang 'dra zhig gi thog nas byed kyi yod dam zer na/ bza' rgyu'i lto chas dang / gyon rgyu'i gyon chas/ 'thung rgyu'i ja chang la sogs pa ni/phyi'i lus la brten pa'i 'phral sel gyi sdug bsngal sel ba dang / lus la brten pa'i 'phral sel gyi bde ba sgrub pa gcig yin ci nga / de 'dra'i lus kyi sdug bsngal sel ba dang / bde ba sgrub pa des mi chog par/ nga rang tsho sems can zer mkhan 'dir bsam blo cig yod pa yin tsang / bsam blos sdug bsngal sel ba dang / bde ba sgrub thub cing / bsam blo gtong phyogs yag po ma byung na/ phyi'i lto gos 'grigs na yang / bde skyid med mkhan cig yong gi yod pa dang / bsam blo gtong ༷rtogs mkhas po dang / yag po byung na phyi'i lto gos jog la dka' ngal phran bu yod kyang / de lta'i bzod glags mi thub pa'i sdug bsngal mi yong / dper na/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi lto gos bzang 11 dang / gtam snyan grags chen po/ mi chen 11 gang ci nas phun sum tshogs pa yod na'ang / rang shi rgyag gi yod pa lta bu/ yang sems mi bde ba byas nas smyon pa'ang byed kyi yod pa lta bu/ gang ltar mi tshe 'dir sdug bsngal dang /dngangs skrag mi skyid pa'i gnas tshul mang po yong gi yod pa red/ de'i rtsa ba gang la thug bsam blo thongs dang / dper na/ nga rang tsho bod rigs rnams spyir btang rang gi lung pa dang bral/ mi yi lung par gyar bas tsha grang ngal dub dang / lto gos thog dka' ngal mang po yod na yang rang sems bag phebs 11/ kha chag sna ral gang 'dra zhig byung ba yin na'ang de tsam gyis sems nang 390

dza drag po rang med mkhan/ da dung yang gshis ka ngang rgyud dal por gnas thub mkhan cig yod pa red/ de ga re'i khyad par byung ba red zer na/ bsam blo gtong phyogs kyi khyad par byung ba yin/ bsam blo gtong phyogs dbang gis mi'i bde sdug la khyad par chen po yong gi yod pa red/ bsam blo gtong rgyu med mkhan cig yin na de gnas tshul tha dad red/ de 'dra min par bsam blo gtong rgyu sku(da mkhan/ bsam blo gtong thub mkhan zhig nas bsam blo gtong phyogs yag po ma byung na so so so sos sems ma skyid pa btsā gi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus chos chos zer ba 'di yang snying sems la brten pa'i sdug bsngal sel thabs gcig dang / bde ba sgrub thabs gcig gi don du yin/ de phugs rgyangs ring po'i cha nas bsam cho'i nang gi skyon tshang ma rim pas dag pa bzos nas sems gtsang ma bzo dgos/ don snying chos chos zer ba 'di sems gtsang ma bzo rgyu'i thabs shes shig red/ dper na/ mi zhig nad na tsha tshabs ches mnar ba'am/ glo bur du mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal kha nyes god kha lta bu zhig byung song na/ chos med pa'i mi des gzhan la kha g.yog byed pa'am/ rang srog gcod pa lta bu'i spyod lam byed legs nyes kyi thog nas gnas tshul byung ba yin na/ de lus la lta bzo med pa'i thog la sems ma skyid pa chags/ don med mi la kha rtsod 'khrug pa slong ba 'dra po/ mi la bsnyon 'dzugs pa la sogs pa de 'dra chags 'gro gi yod pa dang / de 'dras rkyen pas mi 'dod pa de ma bzod par dngangs skrag chen po skyes/ da gang drag bsam pa dang / da lta ra nga gcig byung na bsam pa lta bu sems ha cang gi ma skyid pa dang / dngangs skrag 391

can chags kyi red/ cesasalend mkhan chos kyi bsam blo gtong shes mkhan gcig la de 'dra'i na tsha dang kha nyes god kha 'dra po 'phral du khag po gang 'dra zhig byung na'ang so sos sngon bsags las yin bsam pa dang / las de dag rang nyid nas sngar bsags pa'i 'bras bu red/ de bzlog tu med/ bcos su med bsam pa byas nas sdug bsngal de bzod bsran byed thub pa'i shugs skye thub kyi red/rtsa ba'i nga rang tsho'i lus 'di zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po gcig dang / nye bar len pa'i phung po 'di las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can yin dus/las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can gyi phung po yin phyin sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa red/ skyes sa kho rang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la skyes pa song tsang sdug bsngal dang sdug pa cig las yong rgyu med bsam pa gcig gi bsam blo 'khor ba yin na/ de'i tshod kyis sems bag phebs po yong gi yod/ de la tan tan khyad par cig 'dug dper na/ nga rang tsho bod riganas rgya gar la gyar/ shin tu thabs sdug po byung ba red/ de nga rang chos sngon ma nas bsags pa'i las red bsam pa dang / sems can spyi mthun gyi las red/ de la bzo thabs yog ma red bsam pa cig dang / de ga nang bzhin nga tsho bod pa la cha bzhag na yang 'khor ba'i gnas la 'khor ba'i sems can/de 'dra'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po yod mkhan yin pas kho rang rang gshis 'dra po sdug bsngal gyi phung po las ma 'das pa red bsam pa dang / de snga'i phun sum tshogs pa ji 'dra yod pa rnams 'khor ba'i phun tshogs red bsam/ de 'jig pa'i chos can red / de 'gyur 'gro gi red/ mi la dga' ba cig dang /392

legs pa cig byung na so so gang byas rung 'grigs bsam pa 'dra po/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas so so mi gcig yin bsams te so so yongs su blos gtong ba'i bsam blo 'khor ba yin na/ de'i tshod kyis so so'i thog ma skyid pa dang /kha chag sna ral gang byung yang bzod thub pa dang / ma skyid pa med mkhan zhig shugs kyis chags 'gro gi red/ gang ltar bsam blo gtong stangs kyi thog nas khyad par chen po 'gro gi 'dug de 'dra yin dus sems gtsang ma bzo ba zer ba de la chos zer ba red/ sems la bcos bsgyur btang na sems bzo bcos thebs kyi 'dug ji tsam sems la bzo bcos thebs pa'i tshod kyis ngag gi spyod lam dang / lus kyi spyod lam de khyod po dang / bzang du 'gro gi yod pa red/dper na/ mi ha cang gi khong khro za po/ sems rtsub po yod pa zhig yin na min tshod sems rtsub pa yod pa'i rigs de la kha nas skad cha bshad na'i rtsub po/ lus kyi spyod lam byas na'ang 'bu gsod pa dang / nya gsod pa/ khyi la rdo gzhu ba la 11gas pa'i rnam 'gyur rtsub po thon/ sems dul du phyin pa yin na sems zhi ru zhi ru ga stod phyin pa tsam gyis ngag gi spyod lam dul du phyin/ lus kyi spyod lam dul du phyin/ dper na/ skyid sdug mang spro zhig myong nas yong dus ma gzhi tsha grang ngal dub la sogs pa 'di 'dra'i skyid sdug lus kyi myong ba dngos su lus kyi myong / de nyams myong bsags sa 'di lus kyi nyams myong red de gtso bo sems la cha bzhag na/ sems bzang po dang yag po byas/ skyid sdug legs nyes mang po myong / sems la nyams myong bsags// de nas gom pa na rim pas dus snga ma khag po 'di 'dra zhig byung / da lta 'di 'dra zhig 'dug 393

bsam pa de lus kyi dran gyi yog ma red de de sems kyis dran gyi yod pa red/de 'dra'i nyams khyosteng de sems kyis bsags pa red/ de 'dra yin dus skyid sdug mang po myong ba'i mjug la mi lhings po chags/ sngar skad cha gang byung dran tshad shod mkhan cig yin yang mjug tu skad cha nyung du phyin/ snga mo spyod lam ngan pa byed mkhan cigayin na'ang phyis su lus kyi rnam 'gyur bstan stangs tshun chad 'gyur te yag po ston pa de sems la bzo bcos thebs/ rkyen lus ngag gi spyod lam zhi dul du 'gro gi yog red/ sems dul ba cig byung na lus ngag gi spyod lam yang dul du phyin/ sems dul dus bde skyid yang mang po sku da mkhan/ sems ga tshod ma dul ba'i tshod kyi bde skyid nyung ba yin/nga rang tsho bde skyid yong ba'i don la chos byed kyi yod pa red/ mi 'dod pa de sdug bsngal red/ bde ba sgrub pa dang / sdug bsngal sel ba'i thabs shes zab shos/ dang / gting ring shos/ bsam blor bzo bcos byed rgyu'i thabs shes de la chos zer ba yin/ nga rang tsho bod pas nyams len byed pa 'di nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos yin pa dang / bod du yang phyi nang gi chos mang po yod kyang / rtsa ba mang che nang pa red/ spyir btang nang pa'i nang la'ang theg pa chen po dang / theg pa chung ngu zer ba gnyis bshad pa las/ nga tsho ༄ga chen pa yin/theg dman pa nyan thos sde ba'i gzhung nas gsungs pa'i dge tshul slong gi sdom pa nas bzung pa'i gang ltar 'dul khrims kyi bslab bya 'di rnams gzhir byas/de'i thog la theg pa chen po'i gzhung nas bshad pa'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems zer ba 'di rtsa ba byas/ pha rol phyin pa drug la sogs pa rnams nyams 394

len gyi mthi'/ du byas/ de'i steng du theg pa chen po gsang sngags bla med kyi gzhung rnams bsnan te de 'dra'i mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi chos shig chags bsdad yod pa red/ de lta bu'i mdo sngags zung 'brel chos gcig gyur la dus snga phyi dang / ston mkhan rnam pa 'dra min gyi khyad par las/ gtso che shos sa dge bka' rnying bzhi dar yod/ nga rang tsho so so so sos sems la bzo bcos rgyab nas chos cig byas na tshong rgyab pa nang bzhin red/ tshong pa ma rtsa chen poyod mkhan rnams ma mchen po yod pa la dpag pas tshong gcig rgyag gi red/ma rtsa 'bring po tsam mam/ ma rtsa chung chung cig ma gtogs med na yang dpag chod kyis tshong 'khos thabs len byed rgyu yod pa red/ de bzhin du nga rang tshos chos byas nas sems la bzo bcos byed pa'i thabs shes la bsam blo gtong rgyu mang po spongad mkhan yin na/ de la brten pa'i bsam blo rgya chen 11 btang nas sems la bzo bcos byed thabs yod/ yang de tsam gyis bsam blo phu thag ring po dang / bsam blo rgya chen po gtong mi thub mkhan yin na/ de la dpag pa'i khya 'dus po'i thog nas sems la bzo bcos rgyag lugs shig yod/ gang ltar mkhas pa yin na'ang 'dra/ de tsam gyis mi mkhas pa cig yin na'ang red/ rdo don yang snying tshang ma'i las 'gan ni sems 'dul rgyu 'di rang red/ rang rang so so'i 'khos dpag gis chos la slob gnyer byas/ chos kyi don dag de shes pa byas/ shes pa'i thog nas nyams len byed rgyu'i rtsa ba thug sa ni sems bzang po byed rgyu 'di red/ nga rang tsho sems bzang po byas/ sems bzang po byas na so so yang skyid po dang bag phebs po/ rogs pa tsho la'ang phan po/395

so so mi tshe 'di sems bzang po'i thog la skyel thub pa yin na/ shi khar yang 'gyod pa med pa/ skyid po yong gi red/ sems bzang po ma byas na/ mi tshe gcig gi ring la mi gzhan dag dang / mi mthun pa'i dgra chags/ nang gi sems de nag po dang ngan pa cig yin na/ phyi ru kha mkhas po snyan po cig byas na'ang / gdengs 'pher ba'i dngos gnas drang gnas dga' po byed rgyu dang /gcig gis gcig la yid ches blos 'gel thog nas grogs po grogs mched byed rgyu khag po red/ rang nyid sems ngan pa cig yod na rogs pa tsho dang ma 'grigs pa/ so so gang 'dra zhig byed du phyin yang sems ma skyid pa/ don mi 'grub pa/ phrag dog 'gran sems sogs nyon mongs dug gsum shas chen po yin na/ gzhan dag la so sos dngos su rnam 'gyur bstan pa min yang /so so'i rnam rtog dgra la langs te so so ma skyid pa chags/ mi gcig gi skad cha tshig kha mtho dman la'ang so so ma skyid pa chags/ mi gcig gi rnam 'gyur bstan stangs la'ang so so ma skyid pa chen po chags/ khos nga la rnam 'gyur bstan byung / khos nga la rgyag gtam bshad byung bsam pa sogs sems ma skyid pa chags yong gi red/ sems bzang po byas pa yin na tshang ma la dgos pa'i bsam pa de red/ de 'dra'i sems bzang po dang / rang bzhin bzang po bag phebs po yod pa'i tshod kyis gzhan dag gi rnam 'gyur 'dra min dang / skad cha tshig kha mtho dman phran bur snang med byas/ rang nyid skyid pa/ mi la don med rgyag res ma shor ba/ phrag dog 'gran sems kyi mi la zhe 'khon mi dgos pa/ so so kha khu sim po byas/ so so'i rna ba ltab brtsigs brgyabs/ skad cha 396

'dra min sna tshogs bshad mkhan med pa/ de 'dra'i thog la mi tshe skyel thub pa zhig byung na/ mi tshang mas mi de bzang po red/ mi de gshis ka 'jam po red/ mi de gshis rgyud dul po red zer cing / tshang mas dga' po byas/ tshang mas brtsi 'jo ga byas/ so sor kha chag sna ral 'dra po dang / to gos thog la dka' ngal 'dra po/ lus la na tsha phog pa 'dra po/ mdor na rang gzhan su yin yang shi rgyu red/ de skyid po byung yang shi rgyu red/ rgan pa yin na'ang shi rgyu red/ gzhon pa gcig yin na'ang shi rgyu red/ mdang nub dgong dro skyes pa'i phru gu cig yin na'ang shi rgyu red/ snga phyi ma gtogs shi rgyu red/ ga dus shi yong nges pa gang yang med/ dngos gnas drang gnas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi la yong rgyu'i sdug bsngal che shos shig dang / thabs sdug shos shi rgyu de yong ba'i skabs la yang nam rgyun ngo shes pa dang / spun mched/ pha ma grogs po bo(gas mched yin min la ma ltos par grong pa khyim mtshes tshang mas rogs byas/ mi de yag po yod ces tshang mas blta rtogs byed kyi red/ shi tshar ba'i mjug la yang tshang mas mi de yag po yod zer ba dang / mi de snying rje zer ba/ mi tshang mas bstod bsngags byed kyi red/ mi sems ngan pa mi tshang mar rgyag res rgyag mkhan/ mi tshor bsnyad dmod byed mkhan/ rang las mtho ba yin na phrag dog dang / rang las dma' bar khyad gsod/ rang mnyam la 'gran sems byed pa sogs kyi thog nas mi tshe skyel mkhan cig yin na bza' rgyu gyon rgyu/ 'thung rgyu 'bal po yod na yang mi de la tshang mas kog lab rgyag sa/ mi tshang mas g.yol dgos pa/ thug mi dgos pa gtso 'don 397

'dra min sna tshogs bshad mkhan med pa/ de 'dra'i thog la mi tshe skyel thub pa zhig byung na/ mi tshang mas mi de bzang po red/ mi de gshis ka 'jam po red/ mi de gshis rgyud dul po red zer cing / tshang mas dga' po byas/ tshang mas brtsi 'jo ga byas/ so sor kha chag sna ral 'dra po dang / to gos thog la dka' ngal 'dra po/ lus la na tsha phog pa 'dra po/ mdor na rang gzhan su yin yang shi rgyu red/ de skyid po byung yang shi rgyu red/ rgan pa yin na'ang shi rgyu red/ gzhon pa gcig yin na'ang shi rgyu red/ mdang nub dgong dro skyes pa'i phru gu cig yin na'ang shi rgyu red/ snga phyi ma gtogs shi rgyu red/ ga dus shi yong nges pa gang yang med/ dngos gnas drang gnas 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi la yong rgyu'i sdug bsngal che shos shig dang / thabs sdug shos shi rgyu de yong ba'i skabs la yang nam rgyun ngo shes pa dang / spun mched/ pha ma grogs po bo(gas mched yin min la ma ltos par grong pa khyim mtshes tshang mas rogs byas/ mi de yag po yod ces tshang mas blta rtogs byed kyi red/ shi tshar ba'i mjug la yang tshang mas mi de yag po yod zer ba dang / mi de snying rje zer ba/ mi tshang mas bstod bsngags byed kyi red/ mi sems ngan pa mi tshang mar rgyag res rgyag mkhan/ mi tshor bsnyad dmod byed mkhan/ rang las mtho ba yin na phrag dog dang / rang las dma' bar khyad gsod/ rang mnyam la 'gran sems byed pa sogs kyi thog nas mi tshe skyel mkhan cig yin na bza' rgyu gyon rgyu/ 'thung rgyu 'bal po yod na yang mi de la tshang mas kog lab rgyag sa/ mi tshang mas g.yol dgos pa/ thug mi dgos pa gtso 'don 397

byed pa/ skad cha shod dgos na'ang g.yol te bshad pa 'dra po/ gnas skabs 'phral sel yin na'ang de 'dra 'dra po byas/ mtha' ma shi ba'i nyin yang mi tshos kho sdug shi rgyag rgyu phan po byung zer rgyu red/skye ba phyi ma'i skad cha bshad na'ang dngos gnas mi tshe 'di ga tshod kyis sems bzang po yod pa de'i tshod kyis las bzang po bsags/ las bzang po ga tshod bsags pa'i tshod kyis skye ba phyi mar phan rgyu dang blta rgyu yod pa/ sems ngan pa cig byas pa yin na las ngan pa mang ba bsags/ las ngan pa mang ba'i tshod kyis skye ba phyi mar 'gro sa dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro ༄ra ba ngan song gi gnas la skye gi red/ de 'dra song tsang 'phral dang / phugs/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gang la bltas na yang / sems bzang dze do shin tu gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho tshang mas 'bad brtson byas te sems bzang du gtong thabs byed dgos/ 'di ga'i gzhis sgar la cha bzhag na'ang / nga rang tsho mi gcig pa red/ tshang ma bod pa yin pa gcig pa red/ thams cad bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa mnyam pa red/ rang gi lung pa bral te mi'i lung par gyar ba gcig pa red/ de 'dra'i jog nas tshang ma 'cham po byas/gcig gi sa gcig la phan thogs byas/ gcig gis cig la blta ther+shags byas/gcig gis gcig la sems bzang po bsten/ de 'dra'i thog nas mi tshe bskyal ba yin na/ nga rang tsho yin na yang bag phebs po/ sems skyid po/ mi'i blta snang dang mthong tshul 'dra chags po/ 'jug po/snarang gzhan sems can thams cad bde ba 'dod cing / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sha stag red bsam pa gcig 398

byed pa/ skad cha shod dgos na'ang g.yol te bshad pa 'dra po/ gnas skabs 'phral sel yin na'ang de 'dra 'dra po byas/ mtha' ma shi ba'i nyin yang mi tshos kho sdug shi rgyag rgyu phan po byung zer rgyu red/skye ba phyi ma'i skad cha bshad na'ang dngos gnas mi tshe 'di ga tshod kyis sems bzang po yod pa de'i tshod kyis las bzang po bsags/ las bzang po ga tshod bsags pa'i tshod kyis skye ba phyi mar phan rgyu dang blta rgyu yod pa/ sems ngan pa cig byas pa yin na las ngan pa mang ba bsags/ las ngan pa mang ba'i tshod kyis skye ba phyi mar 'gro sa dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro ༄ra ba ngan song gi gnas la skye gi red/ de 'dra song tsang 'phral dang / phugs/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gang la bltas na yang / sems bzang dze do shin tu gal chen po red/ nga rang tsho tshang mas 'bad brtson byas te sems bzang du gtong thabs byed dgos/ 'di ga'i gzhis sgar la cha bzhag na'ang / nga rang tsho mi gcig pa red/ tshang ma bod pa yin pa gcig pa red/ thams cad bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa mnyam pa red/ rang gi lung pa bral te mi'i lung par gyar ba gcig pa red/ de 'dra'i jog nas tshang ma 'cham po byas/gcig gi sa gcig la phan thogs byas/ gcig gis cig la blta ther+shags byas/gcig gis gcig la sems bzang po bsten/ de 'dra'i thog nas mi tshe bskyal ba yin na/ nga rang tsho yin na yang bag phebs po/ sems skyid po/ mi'i blta snang dang mthong tshul 'dra chags po/ 'jug po/snarang gzhan sems can thams cad bde ba 'dod cing / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sha stag red bsam pa gcig 398

thog nas blo rgya chen po 'khor thub pa cig byung na/ khyim mtshes rgya gar yul mi tso la'ang 'cham po yong thub pa dang / mthun po byed thub cing / kha mkhas po dang / 'dra chags po'i 'cham po de min par dngos gnas pha gi yang mi red/gdong mi 'dra ba dang / skra bzhag stangs mi 'dra ba/ mgo zing zing 'dra po/gos gyon stangs mi 'dra ba tsam las bde skyid byung na bsam pa dang / ga tshod thub thub kyi sdug bsngal ma byung na bsam pa/ rang gzhan tshang ma gcig pa red bsam pa'i bsam blo 'khor thub pa byed dgos/chos kyi snying po byang chub kyi sems gsung ba red/ rgyun gyi sems bzang po byas na byang chub kyi sems skye ba'i thabs shes yod/ sems bzang po byed pa de gzhi la bzhag nas/ de'i steng nas skyabs 'gro/ las 'bras gnyis po de la lag len bkal/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum nga rang tsho'i skyabs su 'gro yul de yin/ de la nga rang tshos dngos gnas drang gnas snying khong rus pa'i gting nas blos bkal/yid ches byas/ nga rang tsho'i skyabs dngos ni chos zer ba 'di red/ chos zer rgyu 'di lag len thog la 'gro dgos pas las rgyu 'bras la yid ches byas nas/ ga tshod thub thub kyi sgo gsum spyod lam ya rabs byas/ mi tshe ya rabs la bskyal/ de'i steng nas ma ṇi 'dra bgrangs/ skyabs 'gro 'dra bton/ sgrol ma 'dra skyor de ga nang bzhin slob dpon pad+ma'i gsol 'debs de ha cang rtsa chen po red/ da lta lung bklag rgyu'i sgrol bstod dang / bsam pa lhun 'grub ma dang / bar chad lam sel de 'dra'i gsol 'debs 'dra bton/ gtso che shos 399

las sla ba dang / 'dus che ba ma ṇi gang mang bgrangs/ badz+ra gu ru dang / dmigs brtse ma sogs so so rang gi lha gang la mos pa dang / bla ma gang la mos pa yod na'i de dang mthun pa'i kha 'don dge sbyor bya rgyu mang po yong gi red/ sems bzang po byas te mi tshe ya rabs kyi thog la bskyal ma thub na kha 'don byed kyi yod zer ba 'dra po/ lus la chos gos rnam spyar gyon pa 'dra po byas na yang /de la ha las rgyu gang yang med/ sems bzang po byas te dngos gnas ma ṇi tshig rkang gcig bgrangs pa yin na yang bgrangs go chod pa red/ de yag po red/ de 'dra yin dus sems bzang po ga tshod thub thub byas/ de ye steng nas mi tshe ya rabs ngang bskyal thub thabs byas/ nga rang tsho gzhis chags shig nang la bsdad thog so nam gyi las ka byed dgos/ so nam gyi las ka byed dus 'bu srin shi rkyen yong gi red/ de shes bzhin du dgos don gang yang med par sdig pa mig btsum byas te bsad na yag po ma red/ de 'dra min par ga stod thub thub kyi zon skyor dang / srog skyob thub thabs gang yong byas/ bod la cha bzhag na bod gangs can jongs la chos dar so chen po yod/ gzhung gi bka' rgya rtsa tshig nang la'ang byi spyang gnyis phud zhes 'khod yod pa red/ de dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun te lung pa gcig gi don la bshad pa'i skad cha red/ chos de dngos yod gnas tshul la bstun dgos kyi yod tsang / 'bru rigs 'o denag la gnod skyon yong ba'i byi ba dang / phyugs rigs la gnod pa'i spyang ki ste/ byi spyang gnyis phud gzhan ga tshod thub thub kyi srog chags la zon skyor byas/ de min ldog thabs med pa zhig yin na gnas tshul zur pa red/400

dper na/ tshal zhing gras la 'bu skyon sel thabs la mtshon na/ 'bu chags tshar rjes ched mngags bsad na de thabs sdug po 'dug dang po nas gang thub thub kyi sngon 'gog byed rgyu dang / sgo nga lta bu ma btang gong nas sngon 'gog thabs shes gang thub ci nus kyi zon skyor byed rgyu yag po red/ de bzang po red/de chos yin pa red/ sngon lo nyis stong lnga brgya'i gong du thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la byon pa red/ dngos gnas drang gnas chos rgya chen po dang / gting zab po cig smu khesang nas slob sbyong gnang / nyams len mthil phyin pa gnang ba la brten nas/ mtha' mar rang nyid skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun ldan du gyur nas rang gi don mthar phyin pa ma zad/ gzhan gyi chasanayang mthar phyin pa gcig byung ba red/ nga rang tsho da lta thabs skyo po dang / kha thabs zhan po red de/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi ji ltar thugs bskyed cing bslab pa la bslabs pa de bzhin du ngas kyang rim pas rim pas sems bzang po cig bskyed/ bslab bya la bslabs pa'i chogeg nas sangs rgyas kyi wakhe 'phang thob pa zhig cis kyang bya/ de'i phyir du chos 'di nyan bsam pa byas nas nyan rgyu byung na yag po yod pa red/ de lta bu'i sems kyis nyan dgos/ khar sang khyed rang tsho'i snyan seng nang la dus 'khor dbang chen dang / de min thugs rje chen po'i dbang dgos gsal 'du ga kyang / da res stabs ma 'grigs/ rjes su yang yang 'byor rgyur khyad par mi 'dug gang ltar yang snying dus rgyun du sems bzang po byas/ spyod lam yag po byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ chos pa yin na'ang 'dra/ grwa pa yin na'ang 401

'dra/ skya bo yin na'ang 'dra/ ser skya rgan gzhon su dang su yin yang mi tshe bzang por skyel rgyu de gal chen po red/ mi tshe bzang po cig la bskyal ba yin na de la snying po byung ba red/ mi tshe bzang po cig la bskyal ma thub na snying po ma byung ba red/ srog 'tsho dgos pa dang de 'tsho ba'i don du tshang mas 'bad brtson byed kyi yod pa ltar/ srog 'tsho ba'i rjes la 'tsho gos chod pa zhig byed dgos/ da gzhan dag dmigs bsal bshad rgyu med/ ces bka' stsal rjes/sgrol ma/ bsam lhun/ bar chad lam sel/ ma ṇi bcas kyi ljags lung sdigs// // 402

'dra/ skya bo yin na'ang 'dra/ ser skya rgan gzhon su dang su yin yang mi tshe bzang por skyel rgyu de gal chen po red/ mi tshe bzang po cig la bskyal ba yin na de la snying po byung ba red/ mi tshe bzang po cig la bskyal ma thub na snying po ma byung ba red/ srog 'tsho dgos pa dang de 'tsho ba'i don du tshang mas 'bad brtson byed kyi yod pa ltar/ srog 'tsho ba'i rjes la 'tsho gos chod pa zhig byed dgos/ da gzhan dag dmigs bsal bshad rgyu med/ ces bka' stsal rjes/sgrol ma/ bsam lhun/ bar chad lam sel/ ma ṇi bcas kyi ljags lung sdigs// // 402

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1973 zla 1 tshes 25 dgong dro'i chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog zho ri sa phun tshogs gling gzhis sgar gyi ser skya 'go mang tshang 'dzoms sar stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring 'di gar gzhis skar nang gi ser skya mi mang dang / de bzhin las byed 'go 'dzin tsho bcas par zhu rgyu la/ 'di ga'i gzhis chags kyi gnas tshul yang yang go thos yong gi yod na'ang / bar lam lo shas ring la dngos su 'byor ma thub/ da lam 'dir 'byor ba'i skabs la gang ci nas yar rgyas phyin 'dug dgun zhing btab pa tshor da rang zhogs pa dang / kha sa blta bskor la phyin par de rnams sngo thing thing 'dug da ring yang gzhis chags kyi nang la zhing kha skya ther ther thal ba phyur phyur ma yin par phyug mdog kha po/ gsos ril ril yod pas gzhis chags kyi dgos don gcig 'grub kyi yod pa yin tsang dngos gnas dga' po byung / khyed rang tsho las ka byed mkhan tshos hur thag byas/ 'go 'khrid mkhan tsho dang / slob ston byed mkhan tshos hur thag byas/ rdo don tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs byas pa'i grub 'bras thon yong gi yod pa yin tsang dngos gnas dga' po byung / khyed rang sto tshang ma la thugs rje che zer gyi yod/ sa zhing gi nang la lo nas lo sbrel nas dka' las rgyag rgyu dang / bsam blosku/da tshad sa zhing sgang la btang nas dka' las rgyag pa'i skabs su char chu dus su ma babs pa dang / yang na char pa ches drags pa lta bu'i dka' ngal/ de bzhin mthun rkyen 'dzoms ma 'dzoms kyi gnas tshul yong dus sems la dka' ngal yong gi red/ rtsa ba nga rang tsho rang gi lung pa bral/ mi'i lung 403

par gyar nas nyams thag pa'i thog la dka' ngal de 'dra'i rigs 'phrad de lo dang lo sbrel snyugs bsring rgyu dngos gnas khag po red/ yin na'ang phyogs gcig nas tshang mas rang don rang gces byas/ gnyis nas tshang mas nga rang tsho spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs thog la bsdad nas da bar lo mang ring la dka' ngal khyad du bsad nas hur thag byas pa red/ ha cang dga' po byung / ngas tshang ma la dmigs bsal gyi thugs rje che zhes zer gyi yod/ da dung yin na yang tshang mas hur thag byas/ gzab gzab byas nas gtso che shos dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi thon skyed yag po yong thub pa'i 'bad rtsol byed dgos/ ngas zhib pa zer dgos mi 'dug gzhan dag gis gsungs pa bzhin red/de nas gnyis la nga rang tshor lto chas bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu yod pa tsam gyis mi 'grigs par/ bsam blo phyug po bzo dgos/ de la rim pa gnyis 'dug rgan pa tsho bsam blo phyug po bzo rgyu'i thabs shes gcig dang / gzhon pa rnams bsam blo phyug po bzo rgyu'i thabs shes gcig red/ gzhon pa mos bsam blo phyug po bzo ba'i thabs shes ni/ slob gra khag btsugs pa 'di rnams yin/ 'di dag ma 'ongs pa'i mi tshe'i mdun lam bzang po gcig yong thabs drag shos de yin/ rgya gar nang la thog mar nga tsho'i slob gra 'dzugs pa'i skabs la sku zhabs niha ru bzhugs yod/ bod phrug tsho la deng dus kyi shes yon dgos kyi yod la/ bod pa'i dri ma de yang ma brlag pa dgos kyi yod pa ltar/ don snying bod pa'i shes yon dang / deng dus kyi shes yon chabs cig yong thub pa'i thabs shes la bod pa'i slob gra zur du btsugs nayag po 'dug ces bka' mol 404

byung / tha ma rgya gar gzhung nas dgongs bzhes gnang / rtsa ba'i 'gro song rnams rgya gar gzhung nas 'gan len gnang ste/ rgya gar nang la slob gra khag rnams btsugs pa red/ bod phrug tshor shes yon slob sbyong sprod pa dang chabs cig bod pa'i rnam 'gyur ma brlag pa dgos kyi yod tsang / bod pa'i slob gra logs su btsugs nas bod pa'i skad yig cha tshang slob rgyu yod pa dang / chos dge 'dra btsugs byed pa'i dgos don de ltar red/ gzhis chags khag gi nang la legs nyes la ma ltos pa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig tshugs/ bar lam yar rgyas kyang phyin yod/ da dung ma 'ongs pa'i bod phrug tsho'i shes yon yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i skor la slob gra'i dge rgan las byed tshos hur thag byed dgos/ de dang chabs cig phru gu so so'i pha ma tshos kyang gzab gzab byed dgos/ phru gu'i shes yod zer ba 'di ha cang gal chen po red/ dper na/ pha ma so so 'brog pa 'am/ yang na spyir btang khral pa gang yang mi shes pa/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i kha rgyun la yod pa nang bzhin/ yi ge ka bong bu'i mgo tsam yang shes kyi med zer ba ltar/ yi ge klog mi shes mkhan pha ma gcig yin na yang / so so'i phru gu de so so nang bzhin ma yin par/ so so las shes yon drag pa gcig dang /so so las nam 'phang mang ba gcod thub pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ phru gur shes yon 'jags pa'i don la pha ma chos do snang byas/ khur len byed dgos/ phru gu'i slob sbyong gi zhor la nang las phran bu bskul na phru gu la'ang phan/ nyams myong bsags/ yag po red de/ slob sbyong la 'thus shor 'gro nyen yod pa'i slob gra'i 'dzin grar 'gro mtshams bcad nas las ka bskul 405

ba lta bu byas na phyags kyi phru gu la gnod tshabs chen po yong rgyu yin pas/ pha ma phos de 'dra byed mi rung /de nas rgan pa tsho'i shes yon skor la/ dus rgyun du slob gra la phyin /'dzin gra tshugs pa lta bu bya dgos pa min yang / rgyun du rang gis do snang byas/tshags par 'dra thabs shes byas/ tshags dpar 'dra klog yi ge ma shes mkhan tsho yin kyang do snang byas/ kha shas la klog bcug so sos do snang byas nas nyan/ gzhan dag med na chos tshan 'dra yin na'ang phran bu phran bu klog shes thub pa'i thabs shes byed kyi yin na rang bzhin gyis bsam lha'i gnas tshad mtho ru phyin/ shes rgya mthong rgya mang du phyin te phan tshod cig phan gyi red/ chos kyi thog la bsam blo gtong rgyur yang phan gyi red la/ 'jig rten gyi thog 2 bsam blo gtong rgyur yang phan gyi red/ chos dang / 'jig rten gang yin kyang yi ge gcig shes/ bsam blo phran bu mang du phyin pa yin na/ de ga'i tshod kyis rlabs che ru phyin na sa phan thogs yong gi red/ gzhis sgar gzhan dag gi nang la shes yon tshogs chung zer ba yod pa ltar/ khyed rang tshos kyang de bzhin byeng dgos/ slob gra 'grims pa'i shes yon min na yang / rang bzhin gyis shes yon yar rgyas 'gro rgyur do snang byed pa de ni nga rang tsho mi'i mi d+ku nang la gal che shos gcig red/ 'di la tshang mas do snang byed dgos/ de snga 'bros pa 'dra po/ a cor ba 'dra po gang la'ang do snang med mkhan/ gang yang mi shes mkhan gcig yin na yang / de mur g.yugs ma bzhag par 'bad rtsol byed dgos/ dper na/ sa paṇa gyis gsungs pa bzhin/ /rig pa nangs/ rma ra 406

ba lta bu byas na phyags kyi phru gu la gnod tshabs chen po yong rgyu yin pas/ pha ma phos de 'dra byed mi rung /de nas rgan pa tsho'i shes yon skor la/ dus rgyun du slob gra la phyin /'dzin gra tshugs pa lta bu bya dgos pa min yang / rgyun du rang gis do snang byas/tshags par 'dra thabs shes byas/ tshags dpar 'dra klog yi ge ma shes mkhan tsho yin kyang do snang byas/ kha shas la klog bcug so sos do snang byas nas nyan/ gzhan dag med na chos tshan 'dra yin na'ang phran bu phran bu klog shes thub pa'i thabs shes byed kyi yin na rang bzhin gyis bsam lha'i gnas tshad mtho ru phyin/ shes rgya mthong rgya mang du phyin te phan tshod cig phan gyi red/ chos kyi thog la bsam blo gtong rgyur yang phan gyi red la/ 'jig rten gyi thog 2 bsam blo gtong rgyur yang phan gyi red/ chos dang / 'jig rten gang yin kyang yi ge gcig shes/ bsam blo phran bu mang du phyin pa yin na/ de ga'i tshod kyis rlabs che ru phyin na sa phan thogs yong gi red/ gzhis sgar gzhan dag gi nang la shes yon tshogs chung zer ba yod pa ltar/ khyed rang tshos kyang de bzhin byeng dgos/ slob gra 'grims pa'i shes yon min na yang / rang bzhin gyis shes yon yar rgyas 'gro rgyur do snang byed pa de ni nga rang tsho mi'i mi d+ku nang la gal che shos gcig red/ 'di la tshang mas do snang byed dgos/ de snga 'bros pa 'dra po/ a cor ba 'dra po gang la'ang do snang med mkhan/ gang yang mi shes mkhan gcig yin na yang / de mur g.yugs ma bzhag par 'bad rtsol byed dgos/ dper na/ sa paṇa gyis gsungs pa bzhin/ /rig pa nangs/ rma ra 406

'chi yang bslab/ /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / /skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ /nor la rang gis len pa 'dra/ zhes gsungs pa red/ sang nyin shi rgyu yin kyang da ring slob sbyong byed dgos gsungs pa de bzhin bya dgos/ ji tsam gyis so so shes rab che ru 'phel ba'i stod kyis 'phral dang phyags la phan gyi red/ rgyu mtshan de 'dra yin dus shes yon la do snang che tsam byed dgos/dpal 'byor k+kor dang / shes yon skor de ltar byas/de nas sgrig 'dzugs skor la/ 'di skor da lta dbang rdor lags kyis gsungs pa nang bzhin red/ da dung 'di ni gal chen po red/ nang la dam tshig mthun po yod na gang 'dra yin yang bkra shis pa yong gi red/ gnyis nas nga rang tsho rtsa ba'i srid don gyi gnas tshul thog nas yin na yang gal chen po red /tshang mas dam tshig mthun po byas/ chos lugs kyi bar la yin yang rung / nga rang sto dam tshig sel lhad byed dgos pa'i gzhi rtsa nam yang med pas tshang mas dam tshig gong bu gcig gyur byas/ da lta yag po 'dug da dung yin na yang de bzhin du gnas thub pa byas/ de bzhin lo rgan gzhon gyi bar la mtshon na yang 'dzam bu gling gi skang la lo rgan pa dang gzhon pa'i bar la bsam blo ma mthun pa/ lta tshul mthong tshul ma mthun pa yong gi yod pa red/ lhag don las byed pa'i nang la yong srid kyi red/ da lta de 'dra'i skyon yod kyi ma red la/ da dung de 'dra mi yong ba'i thabs shes dang / gzab gzab byed dgos/tshang mas go bsdur gsal po byas/ go bsdur 'khrol po byas/ so so so so'i dge skyon mthong ba de gsal po bya sa te bshad res btang / nga tsho spyi pa'i don 407

dag red ma gtogs/ sger gyi na rgyu tsha rgyu shod dgos med/ spyi pa'i don dag gcig gi thog la bsam 'char mi mthun pa dang / bsam tshul ring thung yong gi 'dug na thad ka thad yar 'grel bshad gsal po byas na de gas 'grigs 'gro gi red/ yang skad cha gsal po ma bshad par sdug sbug byas/ sgam po byas/ gang tsam song nas phar mthong phyogs gcig chags/ tshur yang mthong phyogs chags/ rim pas rgan gzhon bar la mthong tshul mi mthun pa byung na yag po yong gi ma red/ lo rgan gzhon bar la mthong tshul mthun po yag po yong ba de yang gal chen po red/ gang ltar tshang ma sgrig 'dzugs yag po dang /dam tshig mthun po byung na gang ci'i cha nas dge mtshan yod pas/ nang khul chos lugs khag lung tshan khag lo rgan gzhon bar bcas tshang mar 'brel ba bzang po yong bar do snang dang / tshang mas gzab gzab byed dgos/de nas nga mo sdod sa sa gnas 'di 'dra zhig gi nang la bsdad yod/'di'i g.yas g.yon la rgya gar yul pa 'di rnams gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i skyo po/ klo pa'i rigs 'dra po yar rgyas gtan nas ma phyin pa'i ha cang skyod nga chags bsdad yod pa yin tsang / gnas tshul 'di la yang nga tshos gzab gzab byed gal chen po 'dug dper na/ 'di'i g.yas g.yon nas sa cha phran bu thob thub nayag po misku1nga ngam snyam pa'i bsam tshul byung / nga tsho rtsa ba gzhis chags gcig chags tshar dus da dung bod mi gzhis chags byed rgyu stong phrag brgyad dgu tsam lhag bsdad yod pa yin tsang / bod mi gzhis chags yod sa de tsho'i thog la da dung sa cha phran bu thob na yag po yong gi red bsam nas ma'i so ra 408

phyogs la yang thabs shes byed kyi yod/ de bzhin sa gnas 'di'i khul nas kyang sa cha phran bu thob pa'i re ba yod dam med bsam nas da rang zhogs pa sa gnas kyi las ka byed mkhan snur dang skad cha byung / kheng tsho sa gnas kyi las ka byed mkhan tshos da khag po red/ 'di'i yul mi sto la yang blta dgos/ yul pa tsho gnas stangs 'di 'dra zhig sgang la gnas bsdad yod/ spyir btang yul pa mos rgya gar las byed pa'i thog la yid ches med pa dang / sems la dwogs pa lta bu byed kyi 'dug nga tshos yar rgyas gtong gi yod pa dang / phugs la drin 'jags pa'i las ka dang thabs shes byed kyi yod pa de kho tshos ma shes par mi kha shas kyis brdabs gsig 'awa1 gzhi red bsam pa sogs kyi blta tshul ma11nga tshul mi 'dra ba phran bu phran bu yong srid pa/ de 'dra byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis las/ byed pas 'char gzhi bkod par dogs pa dang / ma dga' ba byed kyi 'dugad phan yul mi gzhis chags pa sa gnas gzhan du spo ru bcug pa'ang byung yod/'di 'dra'i mur sa cha thabs shes gleng slong bya rgyu da lta'i char shin tu khag po red ces zer gyi 'dug de 'dra yin dus bod pa tsho'i thog la'ang de bzhin du lung pa'i nang la mi gsar pa slebs/ 'di rnams 'khrug po dang grung po byas/ 'di chos nga stor mgo bskor gtong ba dang / nga tshor phugs la bsam gnag ga re byas yong bsam pa lta bu'i mthong tshul yong srid kyi red/ der brten yul pa tsho la 'brel ba legs po byed rgyu de ni ha cang gal chen po 'dug rgya gar ba tshor stabs bzo po bya dgos/ mi re zung gi byed las kyi rkyen pas las ka legs pa dang / bzang po zhig byung na de mngon gsal dod po dang / shugs 409

chen po de tsam mi yong ba dang / skad cha sdug pa zhig byung na gnas tshul de chung chung yin yang de khyab gdal phyin nas mi mang pos do snang yong ba dang lam seng chen po bzos nas mi tshang ma'i mig dgrar gzan po de 'dra yong gi 'dugaganas lugs de 'drar brten yul pa tshor gzab gzab byed dgos/ yul pa tsho mthong tshul yag po yong ba dang / yul pa tsho dga' po yong ba nga rang tshor kha blta dus ga tshod thub thub kyi rogs ram byas pa yin na 'phral sel phar phyogs kyang mi rang yin tsang phar phyogs la'ang phan/ de brgyud nas nga rang tsho 'dir gzhis chags su yod mus tsho la yang phyin chad yun ring po'i cha nas dka' ngal med pa yong rgyu dang / rim pas rgya bskyed phran bu bya rgyu'i go skabs 'dra byung ba yin na'ang / de'i mthun rkyen gtso che shos yul pa'i bsam tshul la bstun dgos yod tsang de gal chen po 'du ga 'di la khyed rang phyo gzab gzab byas/ yul pa tsho dang 'brel ba bzang po yong thabs la do snang byed dgos/kha sa da ring lha khang dang / dgon pa mang po zhig la phyin pa yin/ rtsa ba nga rang cho rwa1da pa rnams chos dad chen po yin tsang / tshang mas dkon mchog mchod pa'i yul zer nas/ dge 'dun 'dra btsugs/ lha khang 'dra bzos bya rgyur tshang mas dga' po byas pa red/ ha cang yag po red/ yin na yang de dang chabs cig deng sang gi dus stod 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi yod pas/ de snga bod la yod pa dang khyon nas 'dra gi ma red/ phyin chad bod rigs gzhon nu gzhi nas 'tshar longs yong mkhan tsho'i bsam tshul de ni de snga'i bod pa rgan pa tsho'i bsam tshul dang phran bu mi 'dra ba chags mdog kha po red/ nga tshos 410

skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog ces pa'i skor dpe cha'i nang la skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid bshad yod la/ rnam gzhag bshad yod/ de dang mthun pa gcig byung na phyi nang gi mi sus bltas na yang dngos gnas drang gnas kyi skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mdzadag chags pa red/ mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig byung na ming dang / tha snyad ga re btags rung ma btags rung / rdo don yang snying / mi tshad ldan/ mi ya rabs/ spyi tshogs nang gi mi drag shos/'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi dpe blta sa legs po zhig byung na phyi nang sus bltas kyang mthong gi red/ yang / phyi'i rnam 'gyur rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs can skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog gi gras yin mdog mdog don dag ngo ma'i thog la skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid ma tshang ba dang / tshad ma longs pa gcig byas pa yin na/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ skya min ser min mgo ril ril 'di tshos skye ba phyi ma nyo cha bzed kyi 'dug ces gsungs pa'i lo rgyus yod/ bza' sa/ 'thung sa dgos pa la/ las ka bya mi dgos pa de 'dra deng sang yog ma red de/ de 'dra'i rigs byung srid pa yin na yag po ma red ces zhu gi yod/ bza' rgyu dang / 'thung rgyu'i thog la de snga bod la dbon ser gzugs zer mkhan zhig yod pa de 'dra byung na yag po ma red/ 'di gar yod pa'i bla ma dge bshes dang / sprul sku/ khyed rang tshos chos la thugs snang yag po gnang / spus dag po gcig gnang dgos/ mkhyen song ngam rab tu byung ba yin na rabatu byung ba rang la spusadag po byed lugs 'gro stangs shig yod/ sngags pa gos dkar gyi sde yin na de ga de ga'i lugs kyi 'gro stangs 411

shig yod pa ltar/ dngos gnas drang gnas spus dag po zhig yong ba bya dgos/so so'i dgon pa yin rung / lha khang yin rung / de ga de ga'i 'go byed mkhan/khur len mkhan tshos sangs rgyas bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren dang / bstan pa'i mtshan shas la mi 'gro bar dngos gnas bstan pa'i mtshan la dgung 'degs yong thub pa zhig dang / de ga'i ser skya mi mang byings/cho kyi skyabs gnas dang /mchod gnas ming don gnyis mtshungs yong thub pa'i khur blangs/ blta rtogs byed rgyu de gal chen po red/ 'dir yod sprul sku bla ma rgan pa rnam pa tsho la ngas 'di zhu gi yod/ khyed rang tshos gzab gzab gnang shog de byung na dngos gnas drang gnas lha khang btsugs pa'i dgos don tshang ba red/ mchod khang bzos pa'i dgos don tshang ba red/ gzhan de min dngos gnas dkor gyi phung po spungs sa gcig dang / mi gzhan dag mgo bskor gtong sa lta bu/ bslu 'khrid byed sa lta bu byung na/ so so'i dad pa mos pa'i dbang gis bsod nams phran bu yod kyi red ma gtogs/ gzhan leg sa rgyu gang yang med/ dper na/ zhabs brtan bsgrub pa yin rung tshad longs pa ma byung ba yin na gzhan la'ang phan pa ma byung / dkor za mkhan so sor cha bzhag na ni/ tshe phyi ma dkor lan so so'i lus thog nas 'jal dgos byung na shin tu nyen kha chen po red/ sngon ma kong po'e nang la lo rgyus shig byung yod/ lo rgyus de wo rgyus gsos pa red/ la phar phyogs la mi tshang gcig dang / la tshur phyogs la mi tshang gcig byas/ mi tshang de gnyis la macesad gnas rgyugs mkhan gyis ma mchod gcig yod pa red/ am mchod des phar phyogs kyi mi tshang de nas 412

ya dang / tshur phyogs de nas zho dang / 'o ma blangs nas bzas bsdad pa yin pa red/ rdo don yang snying zhabs brtan sgrub dgos khag dang / shi gson gyi dge 'jug byed sgo rnams tshad dang mthun pa gcig ma byung ba'i mus la mchod gnas de grongs nas snga ma zho dang / 'o ma len sa'i sbyin bdag de'i nang du mdzo mo gcig la skyes/ mi tshang de yis dkar chu bod spyod byas te lo mang po'i ring la nyar/ tha ma mdzo mo des nyin gcig ri de'i sgang la phyin rbab ril thebs te snga mo sha len sa'i mi tshang de'i sgo 'gram du shi ba yin pa red/ de ltar mdzo mo de ma shi bar du zho dang / 'o ma rnams snga ma zho 'o ma spyad pa'i mi tshang de la sprad/ tha ma rang gi gzugs po rbab la ril pa'i sha de mi tshang gcig po de la sprad pa'i lo rgyus yod red/ de ni skabs der mkhas grub tshad ldan de 'dra'i mngon shes kyis mkhyen te lo rgyus ngag rgyun la 'jags pa red/ de 'dra tan tan yong srid kyi red/ snga mo rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs la yang de 'dra'i lo rgyus mang po byung yod/ mngon shes yod med dbang gis nga tshos shes dang / ma shes kyi gnas tshul red ma gtogs de 'dra byung ba thag chod pa red/ 'phags pa ka ta ya na bsod snyoms la phebs pa'i skabs kyi lo rgyus la/ /pha sha za zhing ma la 'tshogs/ /lan chags dgra bo pang du 'khyer/ /chung mas khyo yi rus pa 'cha'/ gsungs pa bzhin red/ de 'dra yin dus dkor sa dge khungs zer ba 'di la gzab gzab ma bya sa na yag po yog ma red/ gzhis sgar so so'i nang gi gtsug lag khang dang / mchod gnas yod sa 'di rnams spus dag po yong thabs la khyed rang dbu gnang 413

mkhan tshos gzab gzab gnang ste bya spu gnon yag po byas/ spus dag po bzo thub pa'i dgongs bzhes nges par du gnang dgos/ de byung na dngos 'brel bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan la phan pa red/ khyed rang tsho spyi byings la yang phan gyi red/ gcig byed dus mis hob ste blta dus zhabs brtan sgrub pa zer ba 'di don med chud zos gtong mkhan lta bur mthong srid kyi red de tshad ldan dang /gnad smin byung na dngos gnas smin pospend/ gnyis nas mi'i bsam lhu'i khyad gcig yod/ dper na/ nad na tsha byung skudzi/nga na sman yang bzas/ de dang chabs cig zhabs brtan kyang sgrub pa yin na nad ma drag na yang 'gyod pa med snyam pa'i bsam blo'i nang la khyad gcig yong gi red/ yag po byung na gnyis kur phan gyi red/ yag po ma byung na da gin zhus pa bzhin skyon cha chen po yod/'gan chen po red/ byas tsang tshang mas gzab gzab gan nga dgos/de nas lha khang / mchod khang 'dra po dkon gnyer gcig tsam las med pa yin na ni gnas tshul tha dad red/ de min sgrub gra bzhi gra/ brgyad gra lta bu tshugs yod na/ nga rang tsho'i gzhis grong mi re ngo re'i ngo gdong gi gnas tshul 'di gcig pu la ma gzigs par/ rgya gar nang khul du nga tsho spyi yongs kyi mchod gnas dge 'dun gyi sde yod pa de rnams dang phyogs mthun pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos kyi med dam bsam gyi 'dug de gang 'dra red zer na/ dper na/ ma'e sor la cha bzhag na dge lugs nang gtso che dogos ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi dge 'dun rnams gzhis chags nang la slebs bsdad yod/ 'di rnams mtshan nyid bdagad gra red/ b.rigad gra 'di dag nang nas de snga yin gi 414

mkhan tshos gzab gzab gnang ste bya spu gnon yag po byas/ spus dag po bzo thub pa'i dgongs bzhes nges par du gnang dgos/ de byung na dngos 'brel bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan la phan pa red/ khyed rang tsho spyi byings la yang phan gyi red/ gcig byed dus mis hob ste blta dus zhabs brtan sgrub pa zer ba 'di don med chud zos gtong mkhan lta bur mthong srid kyi red de tshad ldan dang /gnad smin byung na dngos gnas smin pospend/ gnyis nas mi'i bsam lhu'i khyad gcig yod/ dper na/ nad na tsha byung skudzi/nga na sman yang bzas/ de dang chabs cig zhabs brtan kyang sgrub pa yin na nad ma drag na yang 'gyod pa med snyam pa'i bsam blo'i nang la khyad gcig yong gi red/ yag po byung na gnyis kur phan gyi red/ yag po ma byung na da gin zhus pa bzhin skyon cha chen po yod/'gan chen po red/ byas tsang tshang mas gzab gzab gan nga dgos/de nas lha khang / mchod khang 'dra po dkon gnyer gcig tsam las med pa yin na ni gnas tshul tha dad red/ de min sgrub gra bzhi gra/ brgyad gra lta bu tshugs yod na/ nga rang tsho'i gzhis grong mi re ngo re'i ngo gdong gi gnas tshul 'di gcig pu la ma gzigs par/ rgya gar nang khul du nga tsho spyi yongs kyi mchod gnas dge 'dun gyi sde yod pa de rnams dang phyogs mthun pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos kyi med dam bsam gyi 'dug de gang 'dra red zer na/ dper na/ ma'e sor la cha bzhag na dge lugs nang gtso che dogos ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi dge 'dun rnams gzhis chags nang la slebs bsdad yod/ 'di rnams mtshan nyid bdagad gra red/ b.rigad gra 'di dag nang nas de snga yin gi 414

rgyan drug mchog gnyis la 'gran bzod pa'i mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta mang po byung yod/de 'dra'i bshad gra'i rgyun ma nyams par mu mthud nas 'dzin thub pa'i 'bad rtsol byed kyi yod pa red/ de bzhin du 'di gar cha bzhag na/ snga ma bdud 'joms rin po ches phugs rgyangs ring wa'i dgongs pa bzhes/ thugs khur rkang bzhes gnang nas rnying ma'i sngags 'chang drag gras rnams 'dir nub nub bzos te da ring 'dir sngags 'chang mang po zhig chags bsdad yod/ kha sa ngas khyed rang 'go byed mkhan tsho la sgrub mchod 'dra ga re yod/ phur sgrub 'dra ga re byed kyi yod/ bsnyen pa gang 'dra gang 'dra phyin song zhes skad cha dri rgyu byung / de tsho ha cang gal chen po red/ snga 'gyur rnying mar cha bzhag na rang lugs bka' gter khag gi 'chad nyan dang / sgrub pa nyams len/ bsnyen sgrub byed sgo sogs gang dang gang yod pa de dag gzab gzab byas nas ga tshod thub thub kyi spus dag po zhig yong ba byas/ de nas 'dir dge luganu/ pa tsho bzhugs sa'i lha khang gcig dang / khyed rang tsho gra pa kha shas yod pa red/ 'dir skabs re bla ma mchod pa 'dra bton/ dus dus su gcig byas na bdag 'jug 'dra gtong mkhan yode shas che/ de 'dra'i mur bsdad pa las/ dper na kun rig gi cho ga lta bu zhig 'dzugs thub na de yag po mi yong ngam bsam pa dran byung / phyin chad gzhis snar mi re ngo re'i gnas tshul ma yin par/ rgya gar nang la yod pa'i nga rang tsho spyi yongs kyi gnas tshul dang sbrel nas blta dus gzhis sgar 'di 'dra gcig gi nang la dgon pa de 'dra zhig yod/ dgon pa de'i nang la lha 'di lta bu dang / lha de dang 'brel ba'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum 415

gyi cho ga cha lag cha tshang spus dag po tshad ldan da lta yod mus yin/ zhes zer rgyu yod pa zhig byung na yag po red/ dper na/ 'dir kun rig gi cho ga yag po gcig btsugs/ kun rig gi bsnyen pa gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin spus dag po btang kun rig gi sgrub mchod sogs cho ga phyag len tshad ldan gyi rgyun zhig tshugs pa yin na/ gal te nyin ma gcig kun rig gi cho ga gtong dgos pa zhig byung song na/ de sa gnas 'di 'dra zhig na yod/ der gtong shog ces bshad chog yong gi red/ bde gsang skor lta bu yin na bla ma rgyud pa yod ces mdzub mo btsugs chog chog yod/ de min kun rig skor gleng sgros byung na de snga bod la yod kyang / deng sang ni med ces kun rig mdzub mo 'dzugs sa khyon nas med pa chags kyi red/ dper na/ da lta 'di ga'i dgon pa'i nang la gzhan dag gi cho ga btang chog gi ma red zer ba min yang / dmigs bsal gyi mdzub mo 'dzugs sa zhig phyogs gcig la bzo gi yin na phan thogs mi yong ngam bsam pa byung / kun rig zer ba 'di ni sdig spyong la shin tu gal chen po red/ spyir btang cho ga de tsam gyi dar so chen po rang med pa zhig yin tsang /'dir kun rig gi cho ga gcig 'dzugs kyi yin na yag po red bsam dran song /rdo don yang snying mchod gnas rang rang so so'i bod kyi spyi pa'i spyi chos byed rgyu yong gi red la/ de'i thog la so so'i sgos chos nga chos 'di bton gyi yod/ 'di'i thog la bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi 'gro stangs cho ga phyag len cha tshang ba gcig nga tshor yod/ 'gan theg pa gcig byed thub kyi yod snyam du mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes gang yod spus dag po byed thub na thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan 416

nyid tshang ba gcig byung ba red/ de yag po ma red dam/ ngas 'di 'dra dran gyi 'dug 'dir khyed rang tsho sngags 'chang gi sde phran bu dang / de bzhin dge 'dun pa phran bu yod pa tshang mas gang 'dra zhig byed thub pa 'dug dgongs pa yag po bzhes nas gang ltar spus dag po byung na/ mi mang spyi byings la yang phan/ tshang mar phan thogs sku(nga gi red bsam gyi 'dugang rang tsho spyi pa'i spyi don de tshang mas ma brjed pa byas nas sems la nyar dgos pa de shin tu gal chen po red/ nga tsho'i lung pa'i nang la rang bzhin 'byung ba 'khrug pa'i rkyen byas nas rang gi lung pa bral/ mi'i lung par gyar ba ma yin par/ nga tsho srid don gyi gnas tshul thog nas 11da rgya mis 'bu ches chung zos byas nas rang gi lung pa dang bral/ mi'i lung bar gyar ba'i gnas tshul 'di chags pa red/ de ltar nga rang tsho mi'i lung par gyar nas dka' ngal chen po byung yod na yang / bod kyi nang la bde skyid yod pa yin na khyad par gang yang med/ de 'dra min par bod kyi nang la da lta lhags nas sdod mkhan rgya che'i mi mang de rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang / nga tsho btsan byol ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis po bsdur na/ bod nang gi sdug bsngal dang / nga tsho'i 'phral sel sdug bsngal gnyis bsdur sa med/ de yang kha nas 'ur shob bshad pa tsam min par /da ngos yod rang gi gnas tshul thog la bod nang dka' ngal shin tu chen po zhig yod nges can red/ de ni lo gcig gnyis ma red/ thog ma'i zang zing phyi lo 1955 lo mjug la byung nas bzung bod rgya khyab yongs rdzogs la gnas tshul thabs sdug shos de phyi lo 1959 byung ba red/ da lta 1973 gyi 417

mtshams la slebs yod/ shin tu thabs sdug po red/ dngos gnas drang gnas sems skyo po red/ dper na/ rang gi lung pa'i nang la bod pa'i mi grangs sa ya drug tsam yod pa red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba mi stong phrag brgyad cu skor cig red/ rgya che'i mi mang mang che ba bod kyi nang la lhag bsdad yod/ bod nang dngos gnas lung pa yar rgyas phyin yod la/ slob grwa mang du phyin yod/slob gra mang du phyin nas dgos don ga re byed kyi yod dam zer na/ slob gra zer dus ha lam ngal rtsol gyi sgrig 'dzugs lta bu dang / ngal rtsol ru khag lta bu zhig ma gtogs shes yon 'dod pa khengs pa'i slob sbyong byed rgyu zhig yod tshod mi 'dug nye char rang lha sa nas gnas tshul 'byor bar gzhi bzhag na/slob gra mang du phyin pa'i nang yod pa'i phru gu tsho la bod yig phran bu phran bu dang /rgya yig 'dra bslabasdo / spyir btang shes yon phran bu 'dra las gzhan dus tshod mang ba ni ngal rtsol kho na rgyugs dgos kyi 'dug nga tsho 'di khul la da lta skad cha byung ba ltar/ phru gu tsho slob grar gtong dgos/ ngal rtsol bskul drags na shes yon la 'thus shor byed kyi red ces shod dgos kyi yod pa red/ bod mi sa ya drug lhag yod pa'i bod kyi lung pa'i nang la phru gu tshor shes yon slob mkhan slob phrug gi ming btags pa tsam las/ don dag ngo ma nyin zhag gcig gi dus tshod mang ba de ngal rtsol la bskul 'ded byed kyi 'dug slob gra mang du phyin pa'i kha thabs dang / gnas stangs de red/ de bzhin sman khang mang du phyin yod la/ sman bcos 'phrod bsten yar rgyas phyin yod pa red/ de dag dge bed gang 'dra byas nas spyod kyi yod dam zer na/ bed spyod gtso che 418

shos ni sa gnas de dang / de la yod pa'i rgya mi rigs kyis bed spyod byed kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ rgya che'i mi mang nyam thag bod pa tsho la phan thogs rgya chen po yog ma red/ des ma tshad bod pa sman khang la phyin na bod mi'i lus nas zungs khrag 'don gyi 'dug ces shod kyi 'dug btson pa kha shas nas kyang kho rang tsho'i lus nas zungs khrag bton pa'i lo rgyus shod rgyu yod mkhan 'dug phyi nas gnas tshul hob ste bltas na sman khang yar rgyas phyin pa red/ des bod rgya che'i mi mang gi 'phrod bsten la dngos gnas kha yod lag yod kyi phan thogs byung yod dam zer na de 'dra tsam red/ de ga nang bzhin thon skyed yag tu phyin pa red/ bod nang la dngos gnas snga mo sa cha tha gog tu lus bsdad pa de tsho'i gras la zhing kha 'khru 'dul byas/ tshal zhing rigs med sar tshal zhing btab/'bru rigs med sar 'bru rigs btab nas dngos gnas bon skyed yag tu phyin pa red/ bon 'bab che ru phyin yod/ des bod pa tshor phan thogs byung e yod zer na/ na ning lho kha khul la than pa byung skabs rtsa ba'i bza' 'bru gsog 'jog med pa'i thog 'phral sel than pa'i dka' ngal chags/ grong gseb pa'i mi mang po lto chas bza' rgyu med par grod pa ltogs tsang sngo rigs gang byung zas pa'i rkyen gyis lus dang / gdong skrangs pa dang / bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu med ces slong du phyin pa yin na yang gshe gshe dang 'thab 'dzings gang 'dra zhig yong ngam snyam nas skrag snang byed pa dang / zas bcu/ kyis phongs pa'i grong gseb pa kha shas 'u thug nas lha sa khul phran bu'i bza' rgyu dang / 'thung rgyu thabs shes byed sa e yod bsam nas yong gi 'dug khong cho mug shi thebs 419

grabs byas nas yong pa red ces nye char 'byor pa'i mi tshos de 'dra shod rgyu 'dus/gnas tshul de 'dra red/ bza' bca' 'bal du phyin/ thon skyed che ru phyin pa red de bed spyod rgya mis byas pa red/ sa gnas de dang de la yod pa'i rgya mi zhi drag las byed tsho sa gnas de ga rang nas rang kha rang gso thub pa'i srid byus kyi thog nas gang ltar rgya mi mang du phyin pa yin tsang rgya mi'i bed spyod byed yag gi rgyur phyin pa red/ bod pa rang la so so'i yul la btab pa'i lo tog yul de'i mi yis bza' rgyu med pa 'di sems skyo po red/ de 'dra'i thog nas rdo don yang snying dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi thon 'bab che ru phyin pa red de pod pa mug shi thebs dgos pa de 'dra zhig chags 'dug de 'dra nga tsho'i sngar gyi lo rgyus nang la ha lam byung yod pa ma red/ de bzhin bod la 'grims 'grul yar rgyas phyin na'i phan chogegs med/ dper na/ gzhan dag phar bzhag lha sa grong khyer gcig gi nang la dum bu khag bzhi tsam zhig bgos/ de snga yin na gra sa gra tshang gi nang la khang tshan mi tshan yod pa lta bur bgos nas/ lha sa byang brgyud la yod mkhan lha sa lho brgyud la 'gro dgos na bka' 'khrol ma zhus par bskyod mi chog lha sa byang brgyud la sdod mkhan mi gcig lha sa shar brgyud la zhag gcig bsdad pa yin na lam seng sang nyin brtsad gcod thon yong gi yod/ gnas tshul de 'dra zhig gi sgang la bsdad yod/ lha sa nas grong gseb gzhan dag gcig la phyin pa dang / grong gseb gzhan dag gcig nas lha sa la yong ba yin na brtsad gcod dang / do dam chen po yod pa lta ci smos/'grims 'grul yar rgyas phyin pa des mi 'gro rgyur phan thogs gcig dgos 420

kyi red de mi dam bsgrags chen po de 'dra zhig gi 'og la sdod dgos na 'grims 'grul gyis phan thogs ga re 'dug gam/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i thog nas dgongs pa bzhes pa yin na/ dngos gnas bod nang la bsdad pa'i bod rgya che'i mi mang de rnams dpe mi srid pa'i dka' ngal dang / dpe mi srid pa'i dngangs skrag thabs sdug po gcig gi 'og la da lta bar lo mang de'i ring la gnas bsdad yod na yang / tshang ma sems shugs dpe mi srid pa'i chen po dang / lhag don lo gzhon pa de rnams kyis de snga'i spyi tshogs rnying pa'i gnas tshul la skyon cha mang po yod kyang / dngos yod gnas tshul la bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu ma phongs pa yod pa dang / spyir btang lung pa'i nang la rgya mis bcos sgyur btang ba'i rjes la nga tshor kha yod lag yod kyi khe phan med khar/ kha yod zlog yod kyi bod pa tshor grong yod pa'i gnas tshul mthong ba yin tsang / rgya mi la mi dga' ba byed rgyu dang / nga rang tsho bod pa rang gi thob thang rtsod gleng byed rgyu'i sems shugs gzhon nu tsho'i nang la ha cang chen po red/ rgya mir rnam 'gyur bstan rgyu dang / rgya mi'i kha 'og la mi 'gro ba byed mkhan sdug shos/ shugs che shos shig chags yong gi 'dug de snga lha sa khul dang / bod kyi btson khang khag gi nang la btson pa mang che ba bod pa rgan pa tsho yin kyang / deng sang btson pa rgan pa rdzogs pa'ang red la/ btson pa gsar pa gzhon skyes tsho slebs nas deng sang btson khang khag gi nang la btson pa mang che gzhon nu yin tshod 'dug gzhon nu tshos rnam 'gyur ga re bstan gyi yod dam zer na/ mi rigs kyi sha zhen la brten nas rang btsan rtsod gleng byed kyi yod pa red/ rtsa ba'i don dag nga rang tsho'i 421

rang btsan zer ba de lung pa gcig la brten nas len dgos la/ lung pa de la brten nas rgya che'i mi mang zer ba yang nges par du yod dgos/ nga rang tsho'i rang btsan len pa la bod rgya che'i mi mang nges par du yod dgos/ nga tsho mi rigs gcig gis sgrub bya'i las don de nga rang tsho mi rigs rang nyid kyis sgrub dgos/ des na rtsa ba'i sgrub bya rang btsan de dmigs yul du bzhag rtsa ba'i dmigs yul de dang bstun nas las rigs so so'i nang dang / sde tshan so so'i nang gi las don rnams 'thus shor ma song bar tshul bzhin sgrub dgos/da lta bar du yang de bzhin byas yod la/ da dung yin na yang bod rgya che'i mi mang gi gnas stangs gzhi rtsa de sems la bzhag nas da lta da lta'i bsam blo ma btang bar khyed rang tshos hur thag byed dgos/ tshang mar bkra shis bde legs yod/ ces 355// //422

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1975 zla 4 tshes 12 nyin/ ku lu ma na lir bod mi'i 'du 'dzoms sar stsal ba'i bka' slob/tshang mas shes gsal nga tshos dka' las ga re'i don du rgyag gi yod red zer na/ bod kyi don la dka' las rgyab kyi yod red/ da cha khyed rang tsho ku lu khul slebs te lo mang po zhig phyin/ 1959 nas da bar lo 16 tsam 'gro gi yod red/ 'ga' shas kyis bsam blo'i nang da phal cher re ba.e yod bsam pa tan tan yong srid kyi red/ de 'dras rkyen pas sems shugs chag pa rtsa ba nyid nas bya rgyu yod ma red/ rtsa ba nga chos dka' las rgyag sa'i don rtsa de'i ngo bo drang bden dang / rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yin pas de dus tshod song ste yal nas 'gro mi thub/ lar nas bya ba gang yang las sla wa'i thog nas 'grub rgyuyod na sems shugs skye rgyu dang / las sla wa'i thog nas 'grub kyi med na sems shugs chag pa'i rigs byed mi rung / nga rang tshos dka' las rgyag dgos pa'i don dag 'di spyir btang rgya mi'i 'og la sdod mkhan bod nang rgya che'i mi mang tsho gra 'grigs po dang yag po yod bzhin du nga sto btsan byol pa nyung shas 'di dag gi don du rang btsan dgos zhes bshad pa rtsa ba nyid nas ma yin par/ bod nang la yod pa 'i rgya che'i mi mang sa ya drug yod pa'i mi rigs gcig gi khe phan don du nga tshos 'thab rtsod byed pa zhig red/ de snga bod lung pa yar rgyas med par rjes lus thebs pa zhig red de mi grangs nyung nyung dang / sa cha rgya khyon chen po yod pa'i dbang gis bod nang de dus kyi lto gos gnas stangs de dang / deng sang thon skyed yar rgyas phyin/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms su phyin pa'i 'og gi bod mi 423

mi re jo re'i bde sdug gnas stangs bsdur na deng sang gnas tshad shinatu skyo ru phyin pa dang / thabs sdug tu phyin pa de dngos yod gnas tshul chags yod/ de snga nga rang i lung pa'i nangayul tshosul tshor lto chas kyis ma ldeng par mug shi'i dka' ngal byung ba nga tsho'i lo rgyus nang la rtsa ba nyid nas med pa zhig red/ deng sang gi dus stod la grong pa phan tshun thug 'phrad skabs rang bzhin 'tshams 'dri byed rgyu'i tshab la deng sang grog khog rgyag gi 'dug gam/ rang btsan skor go rgyu ga re 'dug gam zhes zer ba'i dus stod la slebs yod/ yar rgyas kyi ming dang / dril bsgrags 'dra chags po mang po zhig yod red de/ don ngo ༄nag bod mi mi re ngo re'i dngos 'brel 'tsho ba skyel stangs shin tu khag po dang / thabs sdug po'i gnas tshul lung pa gcig tsam min par bod rgya khyab rang la chags bsdad yod/ dngos yod gnas tshul la mi la mi'i thob thang med par bod mi'i nyin re nyin re'i mi tshe skyel stangs dka' ngal bzod thabs med pa zhig yod pa yin tsang bod rgya che'i mi mang spyi dang / lhag par bod mi gzhon nu tsho'i nang la chos dad yod med dang / so so sger gyi lta ba ga re yin rung min rung / rdo don dngos yod gnas stangs de nad ma theg pa'i gnas tshul chen po zhig tu mthong gi yod pa red/ bar lam rgya nag nang slob sbyong byas pa'i phru gu bod du log ste las lnga'i nang zhugs pa tshos rgya nag nas slebs ma thag pa'i bsam tshul dang /mthong tshul ga re yod rung med rung / rim pas sa gnas kyi dngos yod gnas tshul mthong yong dus rtsa ba nas nad ma theg pa'i gnas tshul chen po chags te/deng sang bod nang yod pa'i mi thog rgan pa tsho'i sems shugs las gshod pa tsho'i 424

sems shugs che ba/ dper na/ gzhan dag phar bzhag khong tshos nga rang tsho bod pa'i gyon chas la dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed pa dang / skad cha shod skabs kyang / rgya mis kung hri zer ba lta bu'i rgya skad lab pa yin na ngon dag ga re yin min shes kyi yod red de/ rang skad stong khang zer ba dang / spyi stong khang zer ba lta stse bod skad ma gyeb na go brda mi 'phrod pa lta stse rnam 'gyur bstan te gang ltar so so'i skad yig dang / so so'i mi rigs kyi khyad chos la chung sa de 'dra'i thog nas yin kyang gces 'dzin sems shugs sgril te bsdad 'dugajo༄ dun snying po thod dbus gtsang mdo stod smad rgya khyab yongs su rdzogs par dngosayod gnas tshul la nga tsho rgya mi'i 'og tu bsdad de khe phan med pa dang / nga tshor gyong gun yod pa zhig yin tsang / de gzhi la bzhag ste bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de dag gi bde ba sdug bsngal gyi don du nga tshos skad rgyag gi yod pa ma gtogs/nga rang tsho mi nyung shas shig bod nang bsdad ma thub pa dang / nga tsho nyung shas shig bod nang la log rgyu'i don la skad rgyag gi yod pa rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/yang rtsa ba'i gnas tshul gsal po shes dgos pa zhig la/ nga tshos srid don gyi 'gro lugs shig thog nas rgya mi la ngo rgol byas pa yang ma red/ rgya mis chos med pa bzos pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig pus rgya mir 'thab rtsod byas pa yang ma red/ nga tsho lta ba 'dra mi 'dra yod pa'i thog nas rgya mir 'thab rtsod byas pa yang ma red/ nga tshos rgya mir ga re'i don du 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod red ces lab na/ lam lugs 'dra mi 'dra dang / lta ba 'dra mi 'dra ga re yin rung min rung /mi la dgos rgyu bde skyid red/ de med na/ ming gsar brje btags pas 'grigs 425

ma song / ming gsar brjes grod khog rgyag gi ma red/ ming yar bon gyis khrod khog rgyag gi ma red/ gsar brje dang yar thon byas te za rgyu 'thung rgyu 'bal po zhig dang / lung pa'i nang la sngon ma las mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa dang / bde skyid che ba zhig yod na de yang nga tshor dgos pa zhig red/ dmar po yin kyang yin khyad par gang yang mi 'dug ste/ dngos yod gnas tshul la bod mi tsho grod khog ma 'grangs par ltogs rid shi ba'i gnas tshul 'og la sdod dgos kyi yod pa yin tsang / nga tshos skad rgyag don de red/ phyin chad nga rang tsho'i lung pa so sos bdag dbang byed rgyu'i dus tshod cig byung song na/ lam lugs ga 'dra byed dang mi byed/ lta ba ga 'dra 'khyer dang mi 'khyer nga rang tsho so so'i lag pa red/ rgya mis nga tsho'i tshab byas te dngos yod gnas tshul la bod du bde skyid che ru 'gro ba dang / bod la dka' ngal nyung du 'gro ba/ yar thon che ba yong rgyu zhig yod na nga tshos 'dir skad rgyag don med/ de snga'i lo rgyus la bltas na rgya mi dar dus bod la dbang shugs slebs pa dang / bod dar ba'i skabs la bod pa'i dbang shugs rgya nag la slebs pa'i dus stod nges med byung yod/ rtsa ba bod rang btsan red/ de snga rang btsan yin pa'i cha nas nga tshor rang btsan dgos zhes lab pa yang ma red/ yag rung nyes rung bod pa rnams 'gro ba mi yi rigs gcig gyur yin tsang / mi la mi spyi mtshungs kyi thob thang 'dra mtshungs yong dgos rgyu/ yong thub rgyu dang / yong chog rgyu bcas yin pa la bod mir mi'i thob thang bral te/ dngos gnas rgya mi zer dus dpon po byas te sdod chog pa gcig dang / mi rigs grangs nyung gzhan dag dang / lhag par bod pa rnams 426

rgya mis thub tshod gtong sa dang / rgya mis bed pyod byed sa'i dngos spyad lta bur sdod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gtan nas med/ nga tshos rgya mi la 'thab rtsod byed pa'i rtsa don snying po bod pa mi yin pa'i cha nas mi la dgos pa'i thob thang rnams bral te/ dka' ngal 'og la gyar ba'i rgyu mtshan de yi cha nas nga tsho rgya mi'i 'og la sdod kyi min zhes skad rgyag gi yod pa ma gtogs gzhan dag lta ba'i thog nas ma red/ lam lugs kyi thog nas ma red/ de snga'i lo rgyus rkyang rkyang gi thog nas ma red/ dga' min dga' dogs kyi thog nas ma red/ rgyu mtshan de 'dra yin tsang / nga rang tshos bod rang btsan gyi don la skad rgyab ste 'bad rtsol byed rgyu'i don dag 'di drang bden red/ dngos gnas chos dang mthun pa/ las rgyu 'bras dang mthun pa red 'dug gam/ gal te rgya mi'i 'og la bde skyid yag po yod na de ga rang gis 'grigs kyi 'dug 59 60 tham pa'i lo la 'dzam gling rgyal tshogs nang bod pa'i skor zhus yod na yang / da cha dngos yod gnas tshul la de dus kyi gnas tshul rnams 'gyur te de ring kha sa bod nang bde skyid chen po yod pa da nga / bod nang yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang mang che ba chos rgya mi'i 'og la bsdad de yag thag chod 'dug nga tsho skyid thag chod 'dug zer ba'i nyi ma zhig shar song na/ de'i nyin mo de rang nas nga tshos bod rang btsan gyi don la skad rgyag rgyu'i las ka de ma thag tu bzhag ste da cha dngos yod gnas tshul la rgya mi'i 'og tu nga tsho'i bde sdug gnas tshul 'grigs thag chod 'dug bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tsho rgya mi'i 'og tu sdod rgyur ma 'dod pa mi 'dug kho tsho 'grigs kyi 'dug de 'dra yin tsang nga tsho rang btsan don la 'bad rtsol byed

dgos mi 'dug ces lab rgyu lasang bsar byas te bsdadaskudad ma gtogs gzhan gang yang med/ nga tshos lta ba de 'dra zhig bzungs yod pa yin tsang / bsam blo ga nas btang yang nga rang tsho'i rtsod gleng bya rgyu 'di 'gro ba mi sa ya drug gi khe phan la thug pa dang / drang po drang bzhag rgyab mdun ngo lkog byed ma dgos pa'i las ka zhig red/ nga tsho'i rtsa don drang /den de 'dra zhig yin tsang / dus yun ring po phyin pa dang / mgyogs myur 'grub dang ma 'grub kyi rkyen pas zhe lhod byed rgyu dang / sems shugs chag rgyu rtsa ba nyid nas med/ dper na/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la las ka byas rjes chen po 'jog mkhan dang / rlabs chen gyi srol btod mkhan gras mag se la cha mtshon na/ kho rang gi mi thog de ga'i thog tu 'dzam gling yongs rdzogs la gsar brje chen po zhig yong gi red bsam pa'i yid ches kyi thog nas las ka brtsams pa zhig ma red/ kho rang gi mi thog der 'grub rung ma 'grub rung / rtsa ba'i gnad don la rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas dpyad pa byas/ bsam blo btang / dmigs yul de yang dag pa zhig yin par sems shugs bsgril te thag bcad nas 'bad brtson byas pa zhig red/ de bzhin lhan di la cha bzhag na rgya gar rang btsan kho rang gi mi thog 'dir yong rgyu'i yid ches gdengs 'khel yod nas dka' las rgyab rgyu dang / gal te kho rang gi mi thog de la rgya gar rang btsan yong gi med na khong gis dka' las ma rgyag rgyu de 'dra ma red/ rtsa ba rgya gar dbyin ji'i 'og la bsdad na rgya gar la gyong yod pa dang / dbyin ji'i 'og la bsdad pa las rgya gar rang btsan byas na rgya gar la khe phan che ba yod pa/ rang btsan gyi don du 'thab rtsod byed rgyu de drang bden zhig 428

yin par ngos 'dzin pa'i thog nas/ kho rang gi mi tshe de la grub 'bras yong min la ma ltos par sems thag bcad/ de lag len bstar ba zhig red/ de bzhin du nga rang tsho bod par cha bzhag na yang da lta zhus pa bzhin rtsa ba drang bden gyi gnas tshul zhig dang / rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i gnas tshul zhig yin tsang / lo shas shig gi nang la 'grub kyi yod pa yin na las ka bya rgyu zhig dang / lo 10 15nang la 'grub rgyu med na las ka byas ma byas yod ma red ces lab rgyu rtsa ba nyid nas bsdad med/ lo 15 16 phyin pa tsam la sems shugs chag na nam yang mi 'grigs/ sems la zhum pa skyes te zhum nas bsdad na sgrub thub pa zhig yin kyang 'grub mi thub/ zhum pa spangs te 'bad rtsol byas na da lta de 'dra 'grub thub e yong bsam pa zhig yin yang / ga ler ga ler sgrub thub pa zhig tan tan yong gi red/ nga snu rangad pa'i gnas tshul 'di sa cha'i gnas stangs nas lung pa mang po dang 'brel ba yod pa dang / deng sang 'dzam gling rgyal spyi'i srid byus dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnas tshul yin tsang / bod pa'i gnas tshul da lta nang bzhin la rtsa ba nyid nas sdod kyi ma red/ tan tan 'gyur ba 'gro gi red/ gtso che shos don gyi bdag po nga tsho bod pa yin tsang bod don sgrub rgyur zhum pa med par snying stobs bskyed/ sems thag gcod dgos pa ma gtogs/ nga rang tsho don gyi bdag po'i bsam blo'i nang zhum pa skyes na nang gi dgra'i dwang ma chags pa red/ zhum pa gtan nas skye mi rung / spyi pa'i don dag la zhum pa skyes pa'i dbang gis rdzod yangs rigs rtsa ba nyid nas byed mi rung /de nas don tshan gnyis pa de/ ma 'ongs par bod 'gyur ba byung ba'i 429

mtshams la/ nga tsho'i bod gang 'dra zhig yong gi red ces zer na/ da lta lab pa nang bzhin kha yod lag yod kyi bde ba sdug bsngal dang 'brel ba yod pa yin tsang skabs de'i dngos yod gnas tshul 'og nas nga rang tsho la khe phan gang che ba dang / nga tshor gang ran pa'i lta ba dang / srid don gyi lam lugs shig gi thog nas 'gro rgyu red ma gtogs de snga'i lam dang lugs srol la skad cha shod rgyu bsdad med/ bshad de dgos pa yang med/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi 'gro stangs skor la ston ma lo bcu grangs gong la nga rang tshos ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi mkhrims shig bzos yod/ rtsa khrims de skabs de'i gnas tshul dang bstun te bzos pa red/de'i nang layang bod kyi srid don gyi 'gro stangs mang po zhig bsgyur bcos btang yod/ de rjes gsum bcu'i dus dran skabs kyi gsung bshad snang la ma 'ongs par rgyal ba rin po che'i gnas stangs de da lta nang bzhin gnas dgos pa'i rgyu mtshanaspend ma red ces bshad yode/ de ga nang bzhin ma 'ongs pa'i bod de dmar po'i rgyal khab kyang chags srid kyi red ces bshad yod/ gnas tshul de tsho ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi rtsa khrims khyab bsgrags byas te lo kha shas phyin pa'i rjes kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun te bo phran bu 'gyur gyi yod pa red/ da cha ma 'ongs par bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs gang 'dra zhig la 'gro gi red/ lta ba'i lam lugs gang 'dra zhig la 'gro gi red ces lab na/ bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang gis thag bcad pa de'i thog la 'gro dgos/ nga rang tsho'i lung pa'i gnas stangs/ lhag par gzhon nu tsho'i bsam khra'i nang la slob gso thebs stangs sogs gnas tshul mang po zhig gi thog la bltas na/ ma 'ongs par bod kyi dpal 'byor 430
