ba yod red de/ yin na yang rtsa ba'i sha rus gcig gyur gyi mi zhig yin tsang tshang ma'i snying stobs dang / sems shugs chig sgril mu mthud de byed rogs zhes zhu rgyu yin/gzhan dag rgya che ba zhu rgyu mi 'dug gtso che shos sems shugs ma chag par hur thag byed rgyu gcig dang / de nas nga rang tsho nang khul gong bu gcig gyur yong ba gcig dang / gong bu gcig gyur yong ba'i cha rkyen la gcig gis gcig la chung tsag thog nas dga' min dga' dwogs dang / shog shog bsgril rigs ma byed rogs gyis/ de byab chung ba red/ de khyon nas byed rgyu mi 'dugache sa'i thog la bsam blo btang na nga tsho ma 'grigs rgyu'i rgyu mtshan gang yang med/gnyis la skad cha bden mi bden ri gas la ri bong cal 'drog ma byed rogs zer rgyu yin/ de min gzhan dag rgya che ba zhu rgyu mi 'dugade nas nga tshos ngos 'dzin gsal po byed dgos pa zhig la/ nga chos bod rang btsan la 'thab rtsod byed pa 'di nga tshos dmar po'i lta ba la ngo rgol byas te bod rang btsan dgos yod zer ba min la/ nga tshos gsar brje la ngo rgol byas te rang btsan dgos zer ba yang ma yin/ da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul la bod rgya mi'i 'og tu bsdad de nga tshor khe phan med pa yin tsang nga tsho rgya mi'i 'og la sdod kyi min zer gyi yod pa red/ 'di gsal por shes dgos pa gcig red/ de nas so so'i rang yul de so so'i lag par slebs pa'i mjug tu 'dzin skyong byed stangs ga 'dra byed mi byed nga rang tsho'i lag pa red/ de'i nang tshan nas bod la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de dag gis thag gcod byed kyi 522

red/ gtso che ba gzhis la yod pa'i mi mang de dag dang / nga rang tsho phan tshun go bsdur/ skad cha bshad/ gros bsdur byas pa'i thog nas nga rang tsho dngos yod gnas tshul la ran pa/ nga rang tshor phugs la drin che ba/ 'phral du yin kyang tshags tshud pa de 'dra zhig yong ba la/ dmar po'i rgyal khab chags dgos kyiye 'dug spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rgyal khab chags dgos kyiye 'dugag 'dra zhig chags dgos kyi 'dug kyang nga rang tshos bsam blo btang / nga rang tshor ran pa zhig nga rang tshos thag gcod byed rgyu red ma gtogs/ nga rang tshos dmar por ngo rgol byed kyi yang med/ nga tshos lam lugs shig la ngo rgol byas pa yang min/ nga tshos chos gcig bu'i rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas rgya mi'i 'og la sdod kyi min zhes lab pa yang rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ shes song ngam nga tsho mi rigs gcig gi khe gyong gi don dang / mi sa ya drug gi khe gyong don la shod kyi yod/ nga tsho'i langs phyogs dang / nga tsho'i lta ba 'khyer stangs 'di tshang mas gsal po shes dgos kyi 'dug yang kha shas kyis bod pa chos byed kyi yod pa la/ rgya mis chos med pa bzos tsang bod pas rgya mir ma dga' ba byas pa red ces zer gyi 'dug de byab chung ba red/ de 'dra ma red/ yang kha shas kyis bod par chos dad yod pas dmar por dga' gi yod ma red/ rgya mi dmar po yin tsang rgya mir ngo rgol byed kyi yod red zer/ de yang ma red/ gal te nga tsho go ming tang gi 'og la sdod rgyur dga' mos yod la/ gung bran gyi 'og la sdod rgyur nga tsho ma dga' bayod pa yin na/ gong gi gnas tshul de bzhin yin pa red de/ de yang ma red/ da lta ngas zhus pa bzhin/ rgya mi gung bran yin na 523

yang red/ rgya mi go ming tang yin na yang red/ gang ltar bod rgya 'og red ces pa'i lta ba zin mkhan zhig dang / ham pa shod mkhan gyi mi der nga tsho rwarngo dal byed kyi yod pa red/ gnas tshul 'di tshang mas gsal po shes dgos pa red /'das pa'i lo'i nang / bod rang btsan gyi don dag nas rtsis na don dag chung chung red de/ yin na yang bal yul nang 'phral sel kha tsha po'i gnas tshul gcig byung ba red/ de ga nang bzhin 'brug nang la gnas tshul gcig byung ba red/ dus skabs der mi tshang ma'i sems nang phran bu ma bde ba yong rgyu'i gnas tshul byung song / 'brug nang gi gnas tshul la cha mtshon na/ 'brug rgyal po zhing gshegs kyis dbu 'khrid pa'i 'brug gzhung gi thog nas dngos 'brel bod par sha tsha byams gzigs rnam dag gnang ste bod mi stong phrag bzhi tsam zhig 'brug nang bsdad yod pa red/ rdo rje gdan la dus 'khor dbang chen skabs la 'brug nas bod pa mang po slebs pa tshor skad cha dri rgyu byung / tshang mas 'brug nang bde skyid yag po yod ces dga' po byed kyi 'dug rgyal po zhing gshegs kyi thog nas bka' drin chen po yin la/ da lta'i rgyal sras kyang tshugs chen po yag po 'dug ces tshang mas bstod ra gtong mkhan sha stag ma gtogs skad rgyag mkhan su gcig ma byung / tshang mas dga' po byed kyi 'dugade 'dra'i dngos yod gnas tshul 'og la bod mi mchog dman su 'dra zhig gis 'brug rgyal po'i sku srog la bdo ba dang / 'brug rgyal khab la gnod pa gcig nga tsho bod mi sus byed kyi red/ bod mi drag zhan mchog dman su 'dra zhig gi thog nas 'brug rgyal 'bangs la gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa dang sbyor ba bsten 524

dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rtsa ba nyid nas yod pa ma red/ med thag chod yin/ gal te bod mi'i khrod nas de lta'i bsam sbyor ngan gshoms bya mkhan dngos gnas yod pa zhig yin na 'brug gzhung gis bka' dpyad nan po ga 'dra zhig gnang rung / nga tshos rjes su yi rangs zhu rgyu dang / rgyab skyor zhu rgyu ma gtogs gang yang bsdad yod ma red/ 'brug rgyal blon gyi thog la nga tsho bsam 'char byas te blo pham ste sdod dgos pa rtsa ba nyid nas med pa'i skabs la gnas tshul de 'dra chags song / nga tshor lam 'gro med pa'i gnas tshul de 'dra zhig chags pa red/ yin na yang / 'brug gzhung la nga rang chos snga phyi'i rgyu rkyen yin lugs min lugs skabs de nas bzung da lta bar mu mthud de zhus pa red la/ bden pa'i gnas tshul de la nga tsho gnong byed dgos pa dang / rgyab mdun ngo slog byed dgos pa'i las ka til 'bru tsam med pa yin tsang / da dung yin kyang zhu sa yong gi red snyam pa dang / rim pas gnas tshul yag po chags kyi red bsam pa'i nga la re ba yod/ gang ltar bar lam 'brug gi nang la gnas tshul byung ba 'dis rkyen pas 'brug pa dang / bod pa'i dbar mthong phyogs skye rgyu'i bzo 'dra po byas na yag po khyon nas yod ma red/ nga rang tsho bod pa'i dkyil nas de 'dra ma byed rogs gyis/ tshang mas ma dga' 'khon 'dzin rigs ma byed rogs zhes ngas zer rgyu de yin/ lhag don ka rdor khul 'di 'brug dang phan tshun sa mtshams 'brel ba chags te 'grims 'grul mang po yong gi yod pa yin tsang sems kyi nang ma bde ba'i 'khon 'dzin dang / blo bde ma bde byas na yag po yod pa ma red/ dgos pa khyon nas yod ma red/ da res kyi gnas 525

tshul 'di 'phral sel slo bur gyi gnas tshul zhig red ma gtogs rtsa ba nga tsho bod 'brug gnyis kyi 'brel ba bzang po de nam yang 'gyur gyi ma red bsam pa'i nga la yid ches brtan po yod/ shes song ngam/de nas bal yul nang gi gnas tshul de de las phran bu gzhi rgya che ba'i gnas tshul zhig red/ bal yul rgyal po sku gshegs de dang / da lta'i rgyal sras gnyis ga'i 1geg la rgya mi'i shugs rkyen chen po zhig thebs pa'i dbang gis sku ngal chen po zhig chags/ gnas tshul de'i 'og nas bar lam 'gyur ba de 'dra zhig phyin pa red ma gtogs/ rtsa ba bal yul gzhung nas bod par sha tsha brlag pa dang / bod pa spyi yongs la bal yul gzhung nas dgongs pa 'gal ba lta bu rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ de yin tsang / bal yul nang gi gnas tshul de yang rim pas yag po zhig chags thub kyi red bsam pa'i re ba rgyag gi yod/lam sang lam sang thag choged thub kyi mi 'dug ste rim pas yag po chags kyi red bsam pa'i re ba yod/ khyed rang tsho tshang ma blo bde po byed rogs gyis/de bzhin 'bras ljongs nas bar lam 'dir bod mi gang 'tshams shig slebs 'dug pa khyed rang tsho bar lam lam bzo 'dra rgyugs/ 'ga' shas ja zhing gi las ka 'dra byed bzhin yod kyang / de tsam gyis phugs re che ba zhig med pa 'dra/ de min gzhis chags kyi 'char gzhi brtan po zhig kyang gtan 'khel ma thub par da phan lo mang dka' ngal nang sdod dgos byung song ba de la nga rang tsho yang blo g.yeng chen po 'dug rim pas rim pas rgya gar gzhis chags khag gi nang la khyed rang so so 'gro 'dod yod pa dang / so so 'gro mos 526

yod pa yin na tan tan 'gro thub kyi red/ bar lam khag kha shas phyin zin pa red/ khyed rang tsho lo mang lam bzo'i dka' ngal ngang la sdod dgos byung ba red/ da dung lam bzo byas te sdod mkhan ku lu khul la yang stong phrag kha shas shig yod/ lo mang ring la lam bzor dka' las khag po byas te sdod mkhan tsho la nga rang tsho yin kyang gang drag bsam pa dang / nyi ma gcig yin kyang snga ba gcig gi gzhis chags yag po gcig byed thub na bsam pa'i re ba dang /bsam sdus de 'dra yod de/ yin na jigang lam sang lam sang lag len 'khel thub pa khag po 'dug de 'dra yin tsang da lta bar du 'gyangs pa red/ rtsa ba gzhis chags byas pa tsho'i gnas stangs dang / 'phral phyags rgyang gsum gyi don la phan gnod gang 'dra yod med khyed rang tshos go gi red/ rgya gar rdzo phyogs gzhis chags khag de tsho bod pa'i shes rig gi bsti gnas dang / mi rigs kyi bsti gnas/ bod pa'i rnam 'gyur zin te bod pa'i grong gseb lta bu yag po chags yod/ rim pas rim pas gzhis chags de 'dra zhig gi thog la 'gro thub kyi red/ khyed rang tsho g.yeng ba ma byed rogs gyis/ 'phral sel 'bras ljongs la sdod pa'i ring la yang tshul mthun gzab gzab byas te sdod dgos/ bar lam 'bras ljongs nang la gnas tshul 'gyur ba mang po zhig byung yod/ 'bras ljongs chos rgyal la cha bzhag na ni nga tsho lo mang ring ngo shes pa'i ngo shes rnying pa red/ tshur tsam 'dir da ring kha sa'i dngos yod gnas tshul gyis srid gzhung zhig chags yong gi yod pa red/ nga sto bod mi rnams ni rang gi lung pa bral nas mi'i lung par gyar ba zhig yin pas/ lung pa gzhan dag 527

gi srid don la byus gtogs byed rgyu'i spobs pa gang yang med/ da shin zhus pa nang bzhin nga tshos 'brug gi nang srid la 'brel lhad byed don med la/ 'bras ljongs nang la yang de de bzhin yin/ nga rang tsho bod mi'i srid byus ni yul chu btung nas yul khrims 'khur te sdod rgyu de red/ 'bras ljongs gzhung gsar pa'i thog nas bod mi 'ga' shas kyis gang byung mang byung byed kyi 'dug ces nga tshor nan po gsung gi 'dug nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba chags te mi'i lung par gyar te sdod mkhan zhig gis lung pa gzhan dag zhig gi nang srid la nga tshos byus gtogs byed rgyu'i spobs pa med/ lar nas nga tsho btsan byol ba chags pa'i nyi ma dang wa de nas yul chu btung na yul khrims 'khur zhes nga cho dad pa'i gtam dper yod pa ltar/ nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i srid byus gcig bod mi sa khul gang du bsdad yod kyang sa khul de'i khrims khur shes byed dgos pa de yin/ rgya gar lto phyogs sogs lung pa mnga' sde 'dra min gang du yin kyang lung pa de ga'i gnas tshul dang bstun te byed kyi yod pa yin tsang / 'bras jongs khul la yod pa'i bod pa tsho yin kyang / lung pa 'dzin skyong byed mkhan gyi sgrig 'dzugs de'i khrims lugs dang bstun te 'gro rgyu red ces skabs der gsal po zhu rgyu byung / srid don gyi 'pho 'gyur phyin pa'i skabs la don med nga tsho dka' ngal nang tshud grabs byed kyi 'dug pas khyed tshos gzab gzab byed rogs gyis/ shes song ngam/ gnas tshul de yin/ gzhan zhu rgyu mi 'dug tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin// // 528

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1975 zla 12 tshes 24 nyin/ lhan rda ra nor rgyas gling gzhis chags su mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da res nga tsho'i gzhis chags gra 'grigs res yin tsang mang po bshad dgos pa med pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zer rgyu yin/ sngon ma yin na khyed rang tsho mi'i ngo gdong la bltas nas bsam blo 'khor yong dus tsha ba'i dka' ngal sel thabs shig byung na bsam pa dang / spyi'i cha nas bsam blo btang yong dus sa cha drag pa thob rgyu ni shin tu khag po yin pas/ sa cha 'di phran bu blos ma thongs pa zhig dang / the tshom/ stod ma thig pa'i ngang nas lhan rda ra gzhis chags zer dus sems nang blo g.yengs byas nas sdod dgos pa zhig yod de/ da cha khyed rang las ka byed mkhan tshos kyang gdeng 'khel po'i thog nas rim pas yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i rtsa ba tshug sa nas yod zer ba dang / mi mang tsho nas kyang da yag thag chod yod/ na ning las da lo drag pa byung zer zhes mi tshang 'ga' shas kyi nang la 'gro dus skad cha byung / gzhis mi'i ngo gdong gi mdog kyang khug yag po byung 'dug de 'dra yin tsang nga rang yang sems nang la bsil sang sang chags nas da yin na blos 'khel gyi 'dug gdeng 'khel gyi 'dug bsam nas dog khres yang du phyin pa lta bur sems skyid po byung / 'dra chags chags min par dngos gnas sems kyi gting nas dga' spro chen po'i thog nas bkra shis bde legs zer rgyu yin/ mi'i 'dod pa zer ba 'di la mtha' med pa zhig red/ 'go stod khul 'dir sa cha e kur stong phrag gsum bzhi zhig nga tshor thob rgyu dang / bod mi stong phrag gsum bzhi 529

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1975 zla 12 tshes 24 nyin/ lhan rda ra nor rgyas gling gzhis chags su mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da res nga tsho'i gzhis chags gra 'grigs res yin tsang mang po bshad dgos pa med pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zer rgyu yin/ sngon ma yin na khyed rang tsho mi'i ngo gdong la bltas nas bsam blo 'khor yong dus tsha ba'i dka' ngal sel thabs shig byung na bsam pa dang / spyi'i cha nas bsam blo btang yong dus sa cha drag pa thob rgyu ni shin tu khag po yin pas/ sa cha 'di phran bu blos ma thongs pa zhig dang / the tshom/ stod ma thig pa'i ngang nas lhan rda ra gzhis chags zer dus sems nang blo g.yengs byas nas sdod dgos pa zhig yod de/ da cha khyed rang las ka byed mkhan tshos kyang gdeng 'khel po'i thog nas rim pas yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i rtsa ba tshug sa nas yod zer ba dang / mi mang tsho nas kyang da yag thag chod yod/ na ning las da lo drag pa byung zer zhes mi tshang 'ga' shas kyi nang la 'gro dus skad cha byung / gzhis mi'i ngo gdong gi mdog kyang khug yag po byung 'dug de 'dra yin tsang nga rang yang sems nang la bsil sang sang chags nas da yin na blos 'khel gyi 'dug gdeng 'khel gyi 'dug bsam nas dog khres yang du phyin pa lta bur sems skyid po byung / 'dra chags chags min par dngos gnas sems kyi gting nas dga' spro chen po'i thog nas bkra shis bde legs zer rgyu yin/ mi'i 'dod pa zer ba 'di la mtha' med pa zhig red/ 'go stod khul 'dir sa cha e kur stong phrag gsum bzhi zhig nga tshor thob rgyu dang / bod mi stong phrag gsum bzhi 529

tshud pa'i re ba byung ba red/ 'on kyang skabs der tsha ba'i dka' ngal sdug skad tsha thag chod pa yin tsang / rjes su bod mi gzhis chags kha ston gtong rgyu la gzhis chags las khungs nas bkag 'gog byung nas bsgyur bcos phyin pa red/da cha tsha ba'i dka' ngal goms/ thon skyed gang 'tshams yong dus sa cha phangs po chags pa red de/ da cha phangs kyang byed thabs med/ tshar ba red/ gang ltar da cha dngos yod gnas tshul la khul 'dir bod mi brgyad brgya skor zhig sra thag thag byas nas bsdad yod/ da cha lo nas lo rer las ku'i nyams myong gsog gi yod tsang rim pas gnad 'gag gang yod shes/ byed stangs stod thig nas yag tu yag tu 'gro gi red/ de 'dra yin dus da dung las ka 'di tsho'i thog la tshang mas hur brtson dang gzab gzab byed dgos/ da lta'i char sman khang gcig dang / slob grwa gnyis po de da lta tshags tshud po byung med/ da cha rtsa ba'i gzhis chags dacadas gzhi gtan 'jags sra thag thag chags pa yin tsang rogs ram byed mkhan 'dra yong gi red la/ rogs ram byed mkhan yong min la ma tos par gra 'grigs 'gro gi red/ rjes la thengs gsum pa 'dir yong pa'i skabs la da res 'di las kyang yar rgyas mang ba dang / khyed rang tsho'i gdong gi 'dzum bag 'di las lhag pa byas nas nga tsho thug 'phrad byed rgyu yin/ shes song ngam/ tshang mas gzab gzab byas/ hur thag gyis/'dir las ka byed mkhan la mtshon na/ ma gzhi gzhis sgar khad 'chud cig gi nang la lo sbrel nas sdod pa'i skabs la dka' ngal nges par yong gi red de/ yin na yang dka' ngal gang che sa zhig la las sha'i byas rjes 'don thub 530

pa byung na/ de dngos gnas drang gnas ngoms 'os pa'i gnas tshul zhig yin tsang de la zhum pa ma byas par/ da lta phan la hur thag byas pa nang bzhin da dung yang hur thag byed dgos/ de ga nang bzhin mi mang chos kyang 'go khrid mkhan gyis lam ston byas pa la khyed rang tshos nyan 'jog yag po byas/ nyan pa'i thog nas spyi pa'i las don thog tshang mas mnyam rub nus pa 'don thub pa byung na grub 'bras thon yong gi red/yang / las byed pas ma drang ma 'thus pa'i skyon dang nor 'khrul phyogs ris byas pa 'dra po/ dgos dbang byas pa lta bu khyed rang tsho nad mi theg pa'i gnas tshul rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i thog nas bshad rgyu yod pa yin na/ dus dus la gong rim las byed pa dang / de ga nang bzhin spyi 'thus gras kyang blta bskor la yong gi yod stabs/ de tshor bshad na yang 'grigs/ dper na/ da res cha bzhag na nga tsho 'di gar slebs bsdad pa'i skabs 'dir bshad na yang 'grigs/ ngag 11ga nas bshad kyang 'grigs la/ yig 11ga nas shod kyi yin na'ang 'grigs/ bshad chog gi red/ nga tshos 'dir sgrig 'dzugs bzos nas las ka byed pa 'di dag dngos gnas mi mang spyi'i don dag la bsam blo gtong gi yod pa ma gtogs/ mi nyung shas kyi rang don khog tu bcug pa'i las ma'i rigs dang / dga' nye phyogs lhung lta bu'i las ka nam yang byed kyi yog ma red/ dngos gnas rang rgyab dang / mdun/ ngo kog gang du yin kyang bstan 'pher ba 'ig dang / 'grel bshad rgyag 'pher ba zhig gi las ka byed kyi yod pa yin dus/ sbyangs bshad btang chog gi red/ da lta sa gnas kyi las ka 531

byed mkhan tshos kyang gnad don 'di gzhi la bzhag pa'i las ka lhag bsam rnam dag byed kyi red/ gal te nges med mi re zung gis thog nas nor 'khrul gyi las ka byas na/ khyed rang tshos skad cha shod pa dang / rgyu mtshan shod sa yog red ma gtogs/ shod sa med pa gtan nas ma red/ shes song ngam/de 'dra'i rgyu mtshan med phyin chad la 'go khrid las ka byed mkhan tshos lam ston/ mdzub ston byas pa de'i thog la khyod rang chos shar bskyod byed rgyu gal chen po red/ las ka gang 'dra zhig yin kyang / spyi'i nus shugs ston thub pa byung na de ga'i tshod kyis lag rjes thon thub pa yong gi red/ de 'dra yin dus/ 'dir las ka byed mkhan tshos hur thag byas nas 'go 'khrid yong gi red la/ khyed rang tshos kyang de'i kha la nyan po byas na yag po yong gi red/de nas gzhis sgar 'di'i nang la de tsam gyi mi mang ba'ang med la/ yod pa rnams kha khu sim po byas sdod pa ma gtogs bsam tshul 'dra mi 'dra'i gnas tshul med pa 'dra/ de yag po red/ nga rang tsho bod rigs nang skabs re chol kha'i 'then 'khyer dang / chos lugs kyi 'then 'khyer phran bu yong gi yod pa red/ khag yod ma red/ de yong srid pa cig red/ yong srid pa'i gnas tshul zhig nga tsho bod rigs kyi nang la byung ba red ma gtogs/ yong ma srid pa'i gnas tshul zhig nga tshor byung ba ma red/ yin kyang de tsho'i gras nga stor mi dgos pa zhig rang red/ de 'dra'i 'then 'khyer gyi skad cha byung ba yin na des dza drag dang / thal lus chen por 'gro gzhi lta yod pa ma red de/ yin kyang nang khul gcig gi gcig la blo ma bde ba dang / sems ma skyid pa zhig 532

byed mkhan tshos kyang gnad don 'di gzhi la bzhag pa'i las ka lhag bsam rnam dag byed kyi red/ gal te nges med mi re zung gis thog nas nor 'khrul gyi las ka byas na/ khyed rang tshos skad cha shod pa dang / rgyu mtshan shod sa yog red ma gtogs/ shod sa med pa gtan nas ma red/ shes song ngam/de 'dra'i rgyu mtshan med phyin chad la 'go khrid las ka byed mkhan tshos lam ston/ mdzub ston byas pa de'i thog la khyod rang chos shar bskyod byed rgyu gal chen po red/ las ka gang 'dra zhig yin kyang / spyi'i nus shugs ston thub pa byung na de ga'i tshod kyis lag rjes thon thub pa yong gi red/ de 'dra yin dus/ 'dir las ka byed mkhan tshos hur thag byas nas 'go 'khrid yong gi red la/ khyed rang tshos kyang de'i kha la nyan po byas na yag po yong gi red/de nas gzhis sgar 'di'i nang la de tsam gyi mi mang ba'ang med la/ yod pa rnams kha khu sim po byas sdod pa ma gtogs bsam tshul 'dra mi 'dra'i gnas tshul med pa 'dra/ de yag po red/ nga rang tsho bod rigs nang skabs re chol kha'i 'then 'khyer dang / chos lugs kyi 'then 'khyer phran bu yong gi yod pa red/ khag yod ma red/ de yong srid pa cig red/ yong srid pa'i gnas tshul zhig nga tsho bod rigs kyi nang la byung ba red ma gtogs/ yong ma srid pa'i gnas tshul zhig nga tshor byung ba ma red/ yin kyang de tsho'i gras nga stor mi dgos pa zhig rang red/ de 'dra'i 'then 'khyer gyi skad cha byung ba yin na des dza drag dang / thal lus chen por 'gro gzhi lta yod pa ma red de/ yin kyang nang khul gcig gi gcig la blo ma bde ba dang / sems ma skyid pa zhig 532

chags kyi red/ de tsho'i gras mi dgos pa rang red/nga tsho sngon ma thug nas da lta'i bar la 'a brug gi nang rnyog khra zhig dang /bal yul nang la rnyog khra zhig byung ba red/ de tsho'i skor tshang mas lam tsam ha go gi red/ 'brug nang gi gnas tshul la mtshon na/ nga rang cho rwand mi mchog dman su 'dra zhig gi thog nas 'brug gzhung 'bangs la gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor ngan gshom byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yang med la/ nga tshos de 'dra rtsa ba nyid nas byas yog ma red/ 'on kyang don dag med par 'brug gzhung nas thugs dogs chen po zhig chags/ thugs dogs chen po chags pa de la yid ches chen po zhig gnang / phar rgyu rkyen sel dkrol ga stod zhus kyang gsan dgongs med par thugs yid ma ches pa'i gnas tshul zhig chags nas/ gnas tshul thabs sdug po 'di byung ba red/ da cha 'brug gzhung nas gsung don la/'brug nang yod pa'i bod mi tsho 'brug mi byed dgos zhes dang / 'brug nang bod mi rnams da lta'i gzhis chags khag tu mnyam rub bsdad na 'grigs min la/ 'brug gi grong gseb khag nang kha bkrams nas sdod dgos zhes dang / phyin chad rgya gar nang dang 'brel ba byas na mi 'grigs zhes sogs de 'dra'i bka' mol gnang nas da lta de 'dra zhig gi ngang la bsdad yod/ 'on kyang rim pas mtha' gsal mdog kha po red/ ga'i byed kyi ma red bsam pa dran gyi 'dugabal yul nang gi gnas tshul de phran bu gzhi rgya che ba zhig red/ de 'dra'i thog nas da phan gnas tshul rnyog khra mang po zhig byung / da dung yang thag chod gtsang ma zhig byung med/ 'on kyang rim pas rim pas 'grigs 'gro gi red bsam 533

gyi 'dug gang ltar phyogs mang po zhig nas bltas na/ da lta 'brug dang / bal yul nang gi gnas tshul gnyis ka rgya mi'i 11ga nas shugs rkyen thebs pa zhig yin pa gsal po 'dug gnas tshul 'di rnams 'brug gzhung dang / bal yul mi mang thabs sdug drags nas nga tshor gnas tshul 'di 'dra byung ba zhig ma red/ rtsa ba rgya mi'i thog nas g.yo byus gting ring po zhig gi thog nas shugs rkyen thebs yong ba yin tsang / 'di la blo g.yeng dang / sems pham byed dgos don med pa zhig red/ nges song ngam/bar lam bod nang gi gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig yod dam zer na/ na ning nga tsho thug pa'i skabs la skad cha byung ba nang bzhin red/ bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams dpe 'dra po'i sems shugs chen 11 ha las pa zhig da lta'ang mu mthud nas yod dang yod mus red/ khong tshos mi rigs kyi zhen ma dor ba'i sems shugs chen po yod pa'i rkyen gyis rgya mi'i thog nas bod don zer ba'i gleng zur phra mo tsam langs nayang de rdog rol gtong ma thub bar lam seng skyag gnong ngos len byas nas skad rgyag dgos pa zhig chags yod/ bod mi dmangs nas rgya mir mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur shugs chen po med pa dang /bod nang la rgya mis rkang brkyangs lag brkyangs rang 'dod ltar byas chog pa/rgya mis gang bshad de nyan byed kyi yod pa/ blos gang 'tshams 'khel thub pa lta bu'i gnas tshul yag po zhig yod pa yin na/ bod kyi gnas tshul thog la rgya mis 'di 'dra'i dza drag dang / zhe bsun do snang byed dgos don yod pa ma red/ bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang gi sems shugs dngos gnas 534

rang ha las pa zhig dang / 'gran zla bral ba zhig 'dug de yang bod mi rgan gzhon thams cad dang / lhag par gzhon skyes tsho'i nang la sems shugs che thag chod 'dug nyin re nyin re'i to gos kyi dka' ngal de bar lam zhig nas phran bu drag tu phyin pa'i gnas tshul go rgyu 'dugabod kyi phyi la nga tsho'i bod mi btsan byol ba khri brgyad dgu zhig yod pa'i nang nas/ rgya gar nang khri drug tsam zhig yod pa dang / bod mi'i tsho khag che shos yod sa de rgya gar red/ bod mi btsan byol ba'i gzhung dang / spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs yod sa de yang rgya gar red/ de bzhin nga rang tsho'i khyim mtshes rgyal khab nang nas stobs shugs che shos de yang rgya gar red/ e sha ya shar phyogs kyi lung pa'i nang nas rgya mi la dpung pa brdar na bsam pa'i rgyal khab gcig rang yod pa de rgya gar red/ gnas tshul mang po zhig gi thog nas rgya gar gal che shos red/ gal che shos kyi lung pa rgya gar nas nga sto bod pa'i thog la rnam 'gyur gang 'dra zhig bstan gyi yod dam zer na/ gnas tshul ha cang yag po red/ nga tsho bod mi'i thog la rgya gar gzhung gis don dam pa'i sha tsha rgyab skyor gyi rnam 'gyur ha cang yag po yod/ phyogs gcig nasatwa ru su'i gnas stangs de'ang bar lam 'gyur ba phyin nas bod par sha tsha yod pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa dang / bod kyi lnga bcu nga dgu'i zing 'khrug de rgya mi'i btsan dbang ma bzod nas bod mi mang gis sgor langs byas pa'i gnas tshul zhig red ces ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ rgya nag gi gnas tshul la cha bzhag na/ phyogs gcig nas dngos gnas lung pa kho rang che thag chod pa yin tsang / stobs shugs yod 535

rang ha las pa zhig dang / 'gran zla bral ba zhig 'dug de yang bod mi rgan gzhon thams cad dang / lhag par gzhon skyes tsho'i nang la sems shugs che thag chod 'dug nyin re nyin re'i to gos kyi dka' ngal de bar lam zhig nas phran bu drag tu phyin pa'i gnas tshul go rgyu 'dugabod kyi phyi la nga tsho'i bod mi btsan byol ba khri brgyad dgu zhig yod pa'i nang nas/ rgya gar nang khri drug tsam zhig yod pa dang / bod mi'i tsho khag che shos yod sa de rgya gar red/ bod mi btsan byol ba'i gzhung dang / spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs yod sa de yang rgya gar red/ de bzhin nga rang tsho'i khyim mtshes rgyal khab nang nas stobs shugs che shos de yang rgya gar red/ e sha ya shar phyogs kyi lung pa'i nang nas rgya mi la dpung pa brdar na bsam pa'i rgyal khab gcig rang yod pa de rgya gar red/ gnas tshul mang po zhig gi thog nas rgya gar gal che shos red/ gal che shos kyi lung pa rgya gar nas nga sto bod pa'i thog la rnam 'gyur gang 'dra zhig bstan gyi yod dam zer na/ gnas tshul ha cang yag po red/ nga tsho bod mi'i thog la rgya gar gzhung gis don dam pa'i sha tsha rgyab skyor gyi rnam 'gyur ha cang yag po yod/ phyogs gcig nasatwa ru su'i gnas stangs de'ang bar lam 'gyur ba phyin nas bod par sha tsha yod pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa dang / bod kyi lnga bcu nga dgu'i zing 'khrug de rgya mi'i btsan dbang ma bzod nas bod mi mang gis sgor langs byas pa'i gnas tshul zhig red ces ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ rgya nag gi gnas tshul la cha bzhag na/ phyogs gcig nas dngos gnas lung pa kho rang che thag chod pa yin tsang / stobs shugs yod 535

pa lta bu dang / phyogs 'ga' shas nas bltas yong dus rgya che khu ma 'dus gzi brjid khog stong lta bu zhig red/ gang ltar gtso che shos shig kho rang tsho nang khul 'go 'khrid mkhan gyi mi rnams gcig 'og gcig la ma 'dus pa'i dka' ngal yod bsdad pa zhig dang / kra'u an len ni 'chi la nye ba dang / ma'o tshe tung yang zla ba kha shas kyi mi'i bzo 'dra po zhig red/ byas tsang mi rgan pa rnams rdzogs pa'i rjes la gzhon skyes kyi nang nas sra thag thag cig yong thub min nyis bzo red/ de 'dra yin dus 'gyur ba gang 'dra zhig 'gro gi yod med tshod ma thig pa'i gnas tshul red/ nga rang tsho'i bod don la yang 'gyur ba chen po zhig yong rgyu'i re ba chen po'i ngang la bsdad yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus nga rang tsho bod rang btsan gyi bden pa'i nyi ma de shar gyi red bsam pa'i yid ches kyi sems shugs de ma brlag pa byed dgos/ de'i don la tshang mas hur thag byed dbo(sa/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes 455// // 536

༄༅// phyi lo 1977 zla 2 tshes 5 snga dror bor ṇa'i mchod rten drung du byang chub lam sgron gsung chos kyi mjug tu mang tshogs la bka' slob stsal ba/'di yan rnams nga tsho mi yin pa dang / chos pa yin pa'i cha nas bshad kyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pa yin pa'i cha nas tshig 'ga' shas shig lab na bsam pa dran byung / nga rang tsho tshang ma da res sa cha 'dir thug 'phrad byung bar nga rang yang dga' po byung / khyed rang tsho yang dag 'a po yong gi red/ gtso che shos nga rang tsho dus rgyun gtan nas 'cham po byed dgos/ 'cham po byed rgyu zer ba de chos dang mthun pa red/ nga rang tsho bod mi rigs kyi don dag la phan yong mkhan zhig red/ lung tshan gyi 'then 'khyer dang / chos lugs kyi 'then 'khyer de 'dra ma byas par gcig gis gcig la rogs yag po byed dgos/ nga rang tsho rang gi lung pa dang bral/ mi'i lung par gyar te ngo shes pa gnam dang sa ma gtogs med pa'i bzo 'dra po zhig chags nas bsdad yod/de'i skabs la gcig gis gcig la rogs yag po byas/ mdor na me 'khor nang la 'gro skabs dang / snum 'khor nang la 'gro skabs tshun chad la gcig gis gcig la rogs yag po byas/ phan sems yag po byed dgos/ nga rang tsho mthun sgril dam tshi ga gong bu gcig gyur zer ba de gal che shos shig yin pas tshang mas mthun po byed dgos/ gang byung mang byung dkrog gtam zer skad kyi rjes su 'brangs mi rung / gnas tshul 'dra mi 'dra bshad mkhan da bar lo bco brgyad kyi ring la mang po byung ba red/ da dung yin na'ang yong gi red/537

de 'dra'i dkrog gtam yong ba'i skabs la rtsad gcod yag po byas/ khungs thug sa gcig la brtsad zhib byas nas bden pa zhig dang / nad ma theg pa zhig 'dug na rgyu mtshan bshad sa yod pa red/ brtsad gcod yag po ma byas/ bden pa'i dag 'bud byed sar khungs yag po zhig ma skyal/ skad cha phyed bden byed mi bden pa'i dkrog gtam thos pa bed spyod byas nas yas 'dra 'dug mas 'dra 'dug zer lab na nga rang tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi nang la zos mi bde ba/ bag mi phebs pa/ dam tshig sel lhad yong mkhan/ dam tshig sel lhad byung ba'i rkyen byas nas nga chos ngag ma 'gril ba/ gcig gis dka' las rgyab pa'i skabs la gcig gis ltad mo bltas nas sdod pa'i bzo 'dra po de 'dra'i gnas tshul yong dus thabs sdug po dang blo pham po/ nga rang tsho bod pa mi yul rang dbang lung par gyar bsdad pa'i mi khri brgyad tsam zhig yod pa red/ de tsho ga stod thabs sdug na yang rang dbang lung par bsdad yod pa red/ so so'i dbugs gtong yag nyes dang / rnam 'gyur bstan yag nyes kyis srog la nyen kha byed dgos pa de 'dra gtan nas yod pa ma red/ bod lung pa'i nang la nga tsho'i rgya che'i mi mang saya drug tsam zhig yod pa khong tsho dngos gnas drang gnas dbugs gtong yag nyes dang / rnam 'gyur bstan yag nyes la'ang srog gi nyen kha yod pa'i gnas tshul dus da lta yang yod bzhin pa zhig red ma gtogs 'gyur ba phyin mi 'dug nga rang tsho 'phral sela'igrigs kyi yod na yang bod nang la bod pa'i rtsa ba'i gnas stangs de kha thabs ga 'dra zhig la bsdad yod pa de nga chos ma brjed pa byed dgos/ so so mi'i lung par to gos thabs 'tshol 'dra byas 538

nas khungs 'khyol tsam yod na yang des 'grigs kyi yod pa ma red/ nga rang tso dang sha rus gcig gyur gyi bod gangs can gyi ljongs la yod bsdad pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de tsho'i kha thabs ga 'dra zhig la bsdad yod pa de nges par du dran pa byed dgos/ a rtsi ngas rang mgo gang thon byas pa yin na las rgyu 'bras la ltos kyi ma red bsam pa de ma brjed pa bya dgos/ gal srid bod nang la dngos gnas gnas tshul 'gyur ba zhig phyin/ bod nang la bde skyid yag po zhig byung / rgya mis bod la kha yod lag yod kyi byams po byas/ dril bsgrags byas pa nang bzhin dngos gnas bod par mi mthong cha 'jog byas/ bod pa yin na yang rgya mis nga tshor dmigs bsal sdang po gang yang byerdo kyi mi 'dugang tsho to gos kyang yag thag chod 'dug da phal cher 'di 'dra zhig yin pa 'dra bsam pa zhig gi bod mi mang che ba de tshos nga tsho skyid thag chod yod bsam pa'i gnas tshul zhig byung song na/ nga tshos rang btsan thog la skad rgyag gi yang ma red la/ skad rgyab nas dgos pa yang yod pa ma red/ nga tshos bde skyid kyi rtsa ba la rtsod kyi yod pa red/ rang gis sgrub ma thub pa'i bde skyid gcig mis sprad mkhan byung na dgos rgyu de red/ khyad gang yang mi 'dug rang nyid la rang btsan yod pa las lhag tsam zhig gi bde skyidayod na/ rang btsan bshad dgos don gang yang med/ da lta dngos yod gnas tshul la nga tshor mi'i thob thang dang / rang dbang med pa'i thog la 'phral sel lto gos kyi thog la yin na yang lto phyed 'grangs/ gos ma las lhan pa mang ba zhig gyon nas sdod dgos pa/ dus rtag tu kha brdung bzed dgos pa/ dma' 'bebs dang mthong chung 539

nas khungs 'khyol tsam yod na yang des 'grigs kyi yod pa ma red/ nga rang tso dang sha rus gcig gyur gyi bod gangs can gyi ljongs la yod bsdad pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de tsho'i kha thabs ga 'dra zhig la bsdad yod pa de nges par du dran pa byed dgos/ a rtsi ngas rang mgo gang thon byas pa yin na las rgyu 'bras la ltos kyi ma red bsam pa de ma brjed pa bya dgos/ gal srid bod nang la dngos gnas gnas tshul 'gyur ba zhig phyin/ bod nang la bde skyid yag po zhig byung / rgya mis bod la kha yod lag yod kyi byams po byas/ dril bsgrags byas pa nang bzhin dngos gnas bod par mi mthong cha 'jog byas/ bod pa yin na yang rgya mis nga tshor dmigs bsal sdang po gang yang byerdo kyi mi 'dugang tsho to gos kyang yag thag chod 'dug da phal cher 'di 'dra zhig yin pa 'dra bsam pa zhig gi bod mi mang che ba de tshos nga tsho skyid thag chod yod bsam pa'i gnas tshul zhig byung song na/ nga tshos rang btsan thog la skad rgyag gi yang ma red la/ skad rgyab nas dgos pa yang yod pa ma red/ nga tshos bde skyid kyi rtsa ba la rtsod kyi yod pa red/ rang gis sgrub ma thub pa'i bde skyid gcig mis sprad mkhan byung na dgos rgyu de red/ khyad gang yang mi 'dug rang nyid la rang btsan yod pa las lhag tsam zhig gi bde skyidayod na/ rang btsan bshad dgos don gang yang med/ da lta dngos yod gnas tshul la nga tshor mi'i thob thang dang / rang dbang med pa'i thog la 'phral sel lto gos kyi thog la yin na yang lto phyed 'grangs/ gos ma las lhan pa mang ba zhig gyon nas sdod dgos pa/ dus rtag tu kha brdung bzed dgos pa/ dma' 'bebs dang mthong chung 539

myong dgos pa/ tshad las brgal ba'i ngal rtsol byed dgos pa/ las ka zhig yin na yang bod rgya mi rigs gnyis 'dra mnyam med pa/ las ka yag sa dang /gnad che sa la rgya mi rigs sha stag slebs bsdad mkhan/ slob phrug cig yin na'ang rgya phrug tshor to gos yag pa/ bod phrug sto la lto chas skyo ba/ slob gra thon pa'i rjes la bod phrug tsho la las ka rag rgyu khag pa/ rgya phrug tsho la las ka rag las sla ba/ de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul 'og la bsdad dgos kyi yod pa red/ bod nang gi mi de tsho yang bsam blo gtong shes mkhan zhig yin dus rgya mis kha nas ga tshod mkhas po snyan po bshad na yang lag len ngo ma'i thog la mi rigs kyi dbye ba phyes/ nga tsho la khyad gsod byas/ nga stor mthong chung byas pa der nad ma theg par rang rang so so'i sger gyi lta ba nang pa yin na'ang 'dra/ nang pa min na'ang 'dra/ dmar po yin na'ang 'dra/ dmar po min na'ang 'dra/ rang rang so so'i lta ba ga re yin rung min rung bod mi rigs kyi bsam blo'i jog la gcig gyur gyi dka' las rgyag gi yod pa red/ 'bad rtsol byed kyi yod pa red/ snying stobs zhum pa med par bsdad yod pa red/ de 'dra yin tsang / nga rang tsho mi'i lung par sdod mkhan tshos ji srid bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang gi sems shugs dang snying stobs 'di ma chag pa'i ring la nga tsho rang dbang lung par yod pa'i mi tshos brjed thabs khyon nas yod pa ma red/ nga tshos 'di brjed na las rgyu 'bras la tos kyi ma red/ ya rabs gzhung bzang gi khrims la ltos kyi ma red/ de 'dra yin dus bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang gi snying stobs de ma brjed pa byas te tshang mas hur thag byed rogs gyis/540

myong dgos pa/ tshad las brgal ba'i ngal rtsol byed dgos pa/ las ka zhig yin na yang bod rgya mi rigs gnyis 'dra mnyam med pa/ las ka yag sa dang /gnad che sa la rgya mi rigs sha stag slebs bsdad mkhan/ slob phrug cig yin na'ang rgya phrug tshor to gos yag pa/ bod phrug sto la lto chas skyo ba/ slob gra thon pa'i rjes la bod phrug tsho la las ka rag rgyu khag pa/ rgya phrug tsho la las ka rag las sla ba/ de 'dra zhig gi gnas tshul 'og la bsdad dgos kyi yod pa red/ bod nang gi mi de tsho yang bsam blo gtong shes mkhan zhig yin dus rgya mis kha nas ga tshod mkhas po snyan po bshad na yang lag len ngo ma'i thog la mi rigs kyi dbye ba phyes/ nga tsho la khyad gsod byas/ nga stor mthong chung byas pa der nad ma theg par rang rang so so'i sger gyi lta ba nang pa yin na'ang 'dra/ nang pa min na'ang 'dra/ dmar po yin na'ang 'dra/ dmar po min na'ang 'dra/ rang rang so so'i lta ba ga re yin rung min rung bod mi rigs kyi bsam blo'i jog la gcig gyur gyi dka' las rgyag gi yod pa red/ 'bad rtsol byed kyi yod pa red/ snying stobs zhum pa med par bsdad yod pa red/ de 'dra yin tsang / nga rang tsho mi'i lung par sdod mkhan tshos ji srid bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang gi sems shugs dang snying stobs 'di ma chag pa'i ring la nga tsho rang dbang lung par yod pa'i mi tshos brjed thabs khyon nas yod pa ma red/ nga tshos 'di brjed na las rgyu 'bras la tos kyi ma red/ ya rabs gzhung bzang gi khrims la ltos kyi ma red/ de 'dra yin dus bod nang gi rgya che'i mi mang gi snying stobs de ma brjed pa byas te tshang mas hur thag byed rogs gyis/540

da phan nga tsho mi'i lung par gyar ba rnams phyogs gcig nas bltas na nga tsho thabs sdug po'i gnas tshul zhig red de/ phyogs gcig nas nga sto btsan byol ba 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra tsam zhig dang mchod rten mgo mjug log kyang bang rim sked par gnas zer ba bzhin yod pa dang / rgya mi la cha bzhag na dus gtan du bod ces lab dus zon byed dgos pa zhig dang / dran shes brten dgos pa zhig da dung yin na yang chags bsdad kyi yod pa red/ de ni nga tsho mi mang ba'i cha nas ma red/ nga snu'i lung pa rgya che drags pa gcig pus ma red/nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di bsreg gtub 'pher ba'i gyong poyod pa la brten nas byung ba red/ rgya mis bod zas te khyur mid btang tshar ba red de 'ju thub yod pa ma red/ 'ju ma thub par skyug pa'i thabs shes zhig nga tshos byed dgos kyi yod red la/ byed pa'i go skabs kyangayod pas tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/ snying la rus pa bcug nas sems shugs ma chag pa byed dgos/bar lam bal yul nang dang / 'brug nang la nga tshor ma nyes kha g.yog gi gnas tshul kha shas byung ba red/ yong gi ma red bsam pa zhig nas de 'dra zhig byung ba blo pham po red de/ gnad 'gag gang yang yod pa ma red/ bal yul nang gi gnas tshul dka' ngal de tsho rim pas sel mdog kha po red/ de bzhin 'brug gzhung 'bangs kyi thog la gnod gzhi'i bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan pa zhig nga tshos byas yod na sdig bsags rang 'khur red/ bshags pa dang sdom pa ga 'dra zhig zhu dgos kyi yod kyang zhus chog gi red/ rang gis nor 'khrul byas pa'i rjes su de la nga sto ngo tsha rgyu dang spam shor dgos don gang yang 541

med/ yin na yang nga rang tshos de 'dra rtsa ba nyid nas byas yod pa ma red/ so lung pa'i don dag la bod nang gi gnas tshul sgrub rgyu la sogs pa de tsho ni nga rang tsho'i rang don la thug pa'i cha nas byung ba red ma gtogs/ nga chos 'brug gzhung 'bangs la bsam sbyor ngan pa bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yang yod pa ma red/ da dung 'brug gzhung 'bangs nas nga tshor gzhis chags kyi sa cha rogs ram gnang / mthun rkyen rogs ram gnang / gang ci'i thog la gzigs rtogs chen po gnang ba 'di dag bka' drin chen po yin bsam nas 'brug nang yod pas gtsos bod pa tshang mas bka' drin rjes dran gyi sems shugs yod pa'i dus tshod de 'dra zhig la dpe ma srid pa'i khyad mtshar 'di chags pa red/ nga rang tsho'i ngos nas de lta'i bsam sbyor ngan pa rtsa ba nyid nasayod pa ma red/ med bzhin du de 'dra'i gnas tshul byung ba thabs sdug po red de/ yin na yang nga rang tsho'i dpe la yod pa bzhin/ nyi ma sprin pa'i 'og nas thon pa'i dus shig tan tan yong gi red/ thugs dwogs gtsang ma sel nas nga rang tshos rgyu rkyen zhus par thugs yid ches pa zhig tan tan yong gi red bsam pa'i nga la re ba yod la yid ches kyang yod/ 'grigs 'gro gi red bsam gyi 'dug nga rang tsho zhum dgos don mi 'dug gnas tshul chung tsag red/gtso che shos nga rang tshos kha gtad gcog sa de rgya mi sa ya brgyad brgya skor zhig yod pa de red/ nga tsho mi sa ya drug red/ las sla po ma red/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi mang po zhig gi bsam tshul la bod kyi gnas tshul 'di ha lam re ba med pa'i bzo 'dra po bshad kyi yod pa red/ hob ste bltas pa yin na/ de 542

'dra'i bzo 'dra po zhig red de/ nga rang tsho la rgyu mtshan mang po zhig yod pa red/ mig gi mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan zhig kyang yod la/ mig gi ma mthong ba'i bsod nams zer rgyu gnad 'gag chen po zhig kyang yod/ deng sang nga rang tsho'i bsod nams de gzhi nas yar skyed yong gi yod pa'i bzo 'dra po zhig 'dugad dung tshang mas sems shugs ma chag par hur thag byed rogs gyis/da ring nga rang sto 'dir thug pa tshos da lta ngas lab pa 'di dag sems la nges pa byas/ khyed tsho sa gnas so sor log pa'i rjes la 'dir ma slebs pa tsho la slob gso yag po rgyab/ ngas 'di 'dra 'di 'dra zer gyi 'dug 'cham po gyis zer gyi 'dug sems shugs ma chag pa gyis zer gyi 'dug ces ngas lab pa 'di tsho lan 'khyol ba byed dgos/ gang yong yong tshang mas gyis shog a/ byed kyi red bsam gyi yod/ shes song ngam/ zhes stsal// //543

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1977 zla 3 tshes 19 nyin/ bzhugs sgar theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du sems bskyed smon lam gyi tshul du stsal skabs kyi gsung bshad bka' slob/na ning nasa.u tshugs byed yag gi brtan bzhugs de sang nyin bka' chos kyi mjug der mthud de byas na stabs cig don gnyis yag wa mi yong ngam snyam pa dran byung / 'das pa'i lo de la phran bu 'tshub cha yod pa zhig gnas chung chos rgyal chen pos gsungs pa red/ nged rang gi rmi lam la'ang phran bu 'tshub cha yod pa lta bu byung / yin na yang skabs der tshang mas sems khur chen po blangs/ ma ṇi dung phyur brgya tham pa hur thag gis bsags pa yin dus nga'i srog char phan pa lta zhor red/ gtso che shos bsod nams kyi mthu dpung rgyas pa yin dus bod spyi don la'ang phan thogs yong gi red/ ngos rang gis kyang na ning zla ba bzhi tsam zhig gi ring mtshams la bsdad pa des kyang bar chad 'dra sel nas yag po byung song / de 'dra yin tsang sang nyin brtan bzhugs bya rgyu byas/ brtan bzhugs byas nas khyed rang tshos gsol ba btab chog chog 'dra po zhig dang / ngas khyed rang tsho la khas len byas chog chog ga la yod/ rang la skye 'chi rang dbang med pa la gcig gis bskul ma byas/ gcig gis khas len bya khul byas na rdzun red ma gtogs de la snying po khyon nas yod pa ma red /de las nga rang tsho rang gzhan tshang mas bsod nams yag po bsags/ dngos gnas drang gnas kyi lhag bsam gyi kun nas blangs te chos dang 'jig rten gyi las ka gang gi thog la yin kyang rgyab mdun ngo lkog med pa'i spus dag po zhig 544

༄༅༅// phyi lo 1977 zla 3 tshes 19 nyin/ bzhugs sgar theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du sems bskyed smon lam gyi tshul du stsal skabs kyi gsung bshad bka' slob/na ning nasa.u tshugs byed yag gi brtan bzhugs de sang nyin bka' chos kyi mjug der mthud de byas na stabs cig don gnyis yag wa mi yong ngam snyam pa dran byung / 'das pa'i lo de la phran bu 'tshub cha yod pa zhig gnas chung chos rgyal chen pos gsungs pa red/ nged rang gi rmi lam la'ang phran bu 'tshub cha yod pa lta bu byung / yin na yang skabs der tshang mas sems khur chen po blangs/ ma ṇi dung phyur brgya tham pa hur thag gis bsags pa yin dus nga'i srog char phan pa lta zhor red/ gtso che shos bsod nams kyi mthu dpung rgyas pa yin dus bod spyi don la'ang phan thogs yong gi red/ ngos rang gis kyang na ning zla ba bzhi tsam zhig gi ring mtshams la bsdad pa des kyang bar chad 'dra sel nas yag po byung song / de 'dra yin tsang sang nyin brtan bzhugs bya rgyu byas/ brtan bzhugs byas nas khyed rang tshos gsol ba btab chog chog 'dra po zhig dang / ngas khyed rang tsho la khas len byas chog chog ga la yod/ rang la skye 'chi rang dbang med pa la gcig gis bskul ma byas/ gcig gis khas len bya khul byas na rdzun red ma gtogs de la snying po khyon nas yod pa ma red /de las nga rang tsho rang gzhan tshang mas bsod nams yag po bsags/ dngos gnas drang gnas kyi lhag bsam gyi kun nas blangs te chos dang 'jig rten gyi las ka gang gi thog la yin kyang rgyab mdun ngo lkog med pa'i spus dag po zhig 544

byed kyi yin na des phan gyi red/ chos byed mkhan zhig yin na yang kha'i chos la ma phyin par lag len ngo ma'i thog nas chos byed dgos/ rdo don yang snying rang gi sems rgyud 'dul ba'i chos bya rgyu gcig dang / lag len bstan 'pher ba zhig dgos pa red/ nga rang tsho las ka byed mkhan zhig yin yang kha nas spyi don zer ba nang bzhin lag len gyi thog nas kyang spyi don la 'gel thub pa zhig dgos pa red/ ngas nam rgyun nas bshad mus bzhin/ gzhan don smin ma zing zing / rang don kha yod lag yod chags na nor 'khrul red/ kha nas sangs rgyas chos cesags ma zhig bton/ smin ma zing tsam zing tsam byas/ lag len ngo ma'i thog nas gzhan don gyi thog la rang gi lus srog longs spyod gtong rgyu phar bzhag gtam gyi thog nas ming tshig skam po zhig blos gtong dgos pa zhig byung na'ang ha cang khag po red/ rang don gyi thog la kha yod lag yod du phyin nas chung tsag zhig yinayang gyong 'khyer dwogs dang / pham 'khyer dogs med pa nga rang tshos mthong chod 'di red/de bzhin spyi don gyi las ka byed pa'i skabs la mtshon na spyi don smin ma zing zing kha nas stong bshad 'brug ltar grags nas 'byon mdog mdzes bcos mang tsam bshad pa ma gtogs lag len gang yang med mkhan/ sger don thog la mgo skor btang nas e drag kha bslus rgyab nas e drag ngo kog byas nasa.e drag tam pa bshad nasalge drag gang 'dra byas nas byung na'ang sger don de kha yod lag yod byas nas sgrub bsdad mkhan zhig chags yong dus spyi don tshags tshud pa zhig yong gi ma red/ de la snying po khyon nas ma byung ba red/545

nga rang the bas rang gzhan rogs gsum tshang mas de 'dra min pa zhig nges par byed dgos/ chos shig byas pa yin na'ang gzhan don smin ma zing zing tsam du ma song bar gzhan don kha yod lag yod kyi bsam sbyor bsten thub pa zhig dang / rang don blos gtong ma thub na yang ham pa ma bshad pa'i thog nas tshu la mthun ya rabs kyi lam nas rang don sgrub pa zhig dang / spyi don gyi las ka byed pa de yang gzhan don smin ma zing zing tsam du ma lus par spyi don 'di nga tsho bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs rdzogs kyi khur du 'khri ba dang / bde don la thug bsdad pa zhigayin dus phyar ba gru 'degs ngo lkog med pa zhig byas/ sgor don da lta lab pa bzhin blos btang rgyu khag po red/ mi tshang ngo re mi re'i 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs gang ci'i thog nas tshags tshud pa/ mi rigs kyi mtshan lar phan pa zhig sgrub dawatos kyi red de/ yin na yang da gin lab pa bzhin ham pa ma yin par tshul mthun ya rabs spyod bzang gi sgo nas sgrub pa de 'dra zhig byung na yag po red/ nga rang tsho dus rgyun ldan nas rang rang so so'i bsam blo'i nang nas gcun te ngas ma rabs byas na yag po ma red/ ngas ya rabs byed dgos kyi red bsam dgos/ mi gzhan pa zhig gis mthong yod med la ma tos par rang ngos nas/ dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bor bzung / zhes pa bzhin nga rang 'gyod pa bya ma dgos pa zhig dang / nga rang ngo zhum ma dgos pa zhig byed bsam pa'i thog nas bag yod bzang spyod dang mthun pa zhig byas na dngos gnas drang gnas mi'i spyi tshogs nang yin yang rung / so so'i yul sde khyim tshang nang la yin na yang / bde skyid yong yong ba red/ brda 'ded gtong mkhan zhig 546

ma byung bar la ngo lkog rgyab mdun gyi sgo nas tshul min sha stag byas na yag po min/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la rgyal khab 'dra mi 'dra la/ lugs srol 'dra mi 'dra'i sgrig 'dzugs bya spu gnon gyi thog nas tshags tshud po 'di 'dra zhig byed kyi yod pa red de/ da dung mi bsad/ ham 'phrog khram pa/ mgo bskor bslu 'khrid/ btsan bshed kyi thog nas rang don 'ba' zhig gi ched du tshul min khrims 'gal byed mkhan gang sar mthong chos su yod pa red/ mi zer mkhan de la rang rang so so'i bsam blo'i nang nas rang gis rang la lcag bskul te ya rabs kyi tshul la so sos 'jug dgos pa 'di gal che shos red/lhag par nga rang tsho bod par cha bzhag na rang gi lung pa bral/ mi'i lung par gyar nas yod dus phyi logs nas brda 'ded gtong mkhan zhig yod rung med rung / rang rang so so'i ngos nas ya rabs drang bden/ 'di phyi rgyu 'bras dpang 'pher zhig byas pa yin na gnas skabs skyid pa/ so so'i mi tshe'i nyin mtha' ma de shar ba'i skabs la blo bde'i ngang nas 'gro rgyu yod pa gcig dang /spyi tshogs la yang phan thogs yong rgyu red/ gang ltar yang snying nga rang tsho bod mi'i bya spyod rnams ya rabs dang mthun pa zhig byed rgyu gal chen po red/ de byung na 'grigs pa red/ de'i thog la nga rang chos bsod nams gsogs thabs byed kyi yin na der dpag pa'i phan yon chen po zhig yong gi red/ bsod nams 'gran yong dus bsod nams kyi rgyal kha thob pa yin na de dang 'brel ba'i las don thog lam 'gro che chung gi khyad par yong rgyu yin pas na bsod nams gsog rgyu gal chen po red/ bsod nams gsog pa de yang / kha sa kha nyin nga rang 547

tsho 'dir spyod 'jug 'chad nyan skabs gsungs pa bzhin/ sems bzang po bskyed thub pa zhig byung na de las lhag pa'i bsod nams gsog pa'i thabs dang /de las rmad du byung ba'i bsod nams gcig sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pas bskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar dgongs pas dpyad de btsal nayang rnyed rgyu med pa zhig yin pas na/ nga rang tsho byang chub kyi sems 'dun pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bzang po zhig gang thub ci thub bskyed kyi yin na ba11da nams kyi mthu chen po thob rgyu red/ de yang nga rang sto rang gzhan rogs gsum su dang su 'dra zhig yin yang bde ba 'dod pa sha stag sdug bsngal mi 'dod mkhan sha stag red/'dod pa'i bde ba sgrub pa dang / mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal sgong ba'i thob thang yang nga rang tsho rang gzhan rogs gsum tshang mar 'dra mnyam du yod pa red /mthar thug bde ba kun dang ldan pa dang / sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral rgyu sku(da payang nga rang tsho rang gzhan rogs gsum tshang ma ༄rte kun nas mtshungs pa yin/ gnas tshul 'dra 'dra de lta bu zhig gi 'og la gal che chung zhig bsdur gyi yin na/ dacadas gnas drang gnas ra nga ga snurd kyi rtsa ba che na yang sems can srog gcig yin pa dang / gzhan zer dus nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can mtha' dang mu med pa zhig chags yong dus/ de gnyis gal che chung bsdur dgos/ deng sang mang gtso ༄ra ba 'di chos kyi skad cha red ces shod kyi med na yang / don dag ngo ma'i thog la mang ba'i don la nyung ba blos btang ba yin na ya rabs kyi tshul dang mthun pa/ 'os pa zhig red/ spyir btang dud 'gro zhig yin na'ang kho rang da pag tshod kyi gshis spyod dul ba/ gzhan 548

dag la 'tshe ba mi byed mkhan zhig byung ba yin na de'i sar rogs pa tshang ma 'dus pa dang / der dga' ba/ de la mos pa/ de la snying nye ba byed pa nga rang tsho tshang mas mthong chos la yod pa de red/ nga rang tsho mi la cha bzhag na de de bzhin gyi ga tshad thub thub kyi gzhan don la bsam blo btang / rang don khog bcug ma byas par/ sems bzang po'i sgo nas mi la phan sems byed rgyu gcig byung na/ de yi tshod kyis mi tshang mas mi de spyi sems chen po/ mi de yag po red ces bsngags brjod byed pa dang / tshang mas dga' zhing mgu ba'i ngang nas de la brtsi bkur byed pa nga rang tsho 'dzam bu gling gi sgang 'dir mthong chos su yod pa 'di red/ 'di chos red ces nga rang tshos bshad kyi yod pa ma red de gang ltar yang snying rang nyid bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa bzhin du/ gzhan gyi bde ba la rtse gcig tu sems khur len mkhan zhig byung na/ de ni rin thang bral ba'i rtsa ba chen po zhig yin pa dang / de dgos mkho yod pa/ de la brtsi bkur byed 'os pa/ de rlabs chen yin pa bcas rang gzhan rogs gsum tshang mas ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang gi mi grags can rgya gar lung pa'i nang la lhan di lta bur mtshon na rang gis khur gtso bor blangs te gzhan don sgrub pa'i bsam blo btang ba yin dus de la mi tshang mas rang bzhin gyis dga' ba skye ba zhig yong gi yod pa red/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa chen wa'i chos kyi nang nas gang gsung gi yod dam zer na/ rang gi lus srog longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa sems can thams cad la zhe thag pa nas gtong ba'i blo bzung dgos par gsungasayod/ spyod 549

'jug nang / gang tshe bdag dang gzhan gnyis ka/ /bde ba 'dod du mtshungs pa la/ /bdag dang khyad par ci yod na/ /gang zhig bdag gcig bde bar brtson/ /gang tshe bdag dang gzhan gnyis ka/ /sdug bsngal mi 'dod mtshungs pa la/ /bdag dang khyad par ci yod na/ /gang phyir gzhan min bdag srung byed/ ces rang gzhan gnyis ka bde ba 'dod pa sgo kun nas mtshungs pa la/gzhan mi bsam par rang gcig pu'i bde ba sgrub thabs la brtson pa dang / rang gzhan gnyis ka sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mtshungs pa la/ ra nga gcig pu'i sdug bsngal sel thabs byed pa de rgyu mtshan khungs lung gang yang med par gsungs pa ltar yin pa red/ gzhan yang / /gal te byin na ci spyod ces//bdag don sems pa 'dre yi tshul/ /gal te spyad na ci spyin zhes/ /gzhan don sems pa lha yi chos/ gsungs pa bzhin/ dngos po 'di gzhan la spyin na bdag gis ci rjodad ces rang lngardzon sems pa de 'dre yi tshul te/ bsam tshul dman pa dor byar gsungs/ gal te bdag gis 'di longs su spyad na/ gzhan la ci zhig spyin snyam du gzhan ྅rten bsam pa zhig byung na de ni lha'i choges te nyams su blangs byar gsungs pa red/ gang ltar yang snying bdag gi ched du gzhan bkol na dngos gnas drang gnas bsam blo ma rung ba/ ma rung ba de'i dbang gis 'bras bu yang ngan sku nga ngan 'bo1 la 'khyams pa/ gzhan gyi bran g.yog tu 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i 'bras bu ngan pa smin rgyu dang / gzhan gyi ched du bdag bkol na 'bras bu thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rnyed thub par gsungs pa yin/ rimador bsdu na/ 'jig rten rgyud pa ji snyed pa/ /de 550

kun bdag bde 'dod las byung / /'jig rten bde ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung / zhes dang / /mang du bshad lta ci zhig dgos//byis pa rang gi don byed dang / /thub pa gzhan gyi don mdzad pa/ /de gnyis kyi ni khyad par tos/ gsungs pa ltar red/ nga rang tshos da lta phyag mchod pa'i yul du byed pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhu mkhan 'di sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su nga rang tsho dang 'dra bar nyon mongs dug gsum yod mkhan 'dra 'dra yin pa la/ khong da lta skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun ldan byung ba de dang / nga rang tsho da lta nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du 'khyams nas yod pa 'di gang gi dbang gis byung ba red zer na/ thub pas gzhan don kho na la 'bad de rang gi don cung zad kyang ma mdzad par brten skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan/ sangs rgyas su grub pa red/ nged sto bde ba 'dod la sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa red de/ da dung yang dug gsum gyi dbang du shor nas rang mgo ma thon/ gzhan mgo mi thon/ kha thabs gang yang med pa 'di rang gcig pu bsam nas bsdad pas lan pa yin pas/ nga rang snur rang gzhan 1dugs gsum tshang mas gzhan don gyi blo bzang po zhig ci nas kyang skye thabs byed dgos/gzhan phan sgrub pa zer ba de la skyon til 'bru tsam yang med pa red/ de la mdun dang / lkog thog ma dang / bar dang / mtha' ma/ 'phral dang phugs/rang dang gzhan gang 'dra zhig la bltas na yang gzhan phan sgrub pa'i blo bzang po zhig skyes thub na/ de la nyes pa dang skyon zer mkhan de sgo kun dang cha thams cad nas med pas ma tshad/ phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa red/ des 551

na nga rang tshos gzhan phan gyi sems bzang po de bskyed dgos/ de lta bu'i gzhan phan gyi sems bzang po bskyed thub pa zhig byung na/ tshe 'di yin yang rang rang so so bde ba/ so so bde ba'i thog la rogs pa shag mtshes pa dang / grong pa khyim mtshes tshun chad tshang ma gnas zos bde ba yong rgyu red/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can zer dus rang gi kha rtsa nye skor la yod pa'i pha ma span nye/ grong pa shag mtshes de tsho phar bzhag nas/ de min rgyang thag ring po jog nayod pa'i gzhan sems can tsho gcig pur zer rgyu min pa red/ gzhan sems can zer mkhan de rang gi kha rtsarayod pa/ rgyun du gshibs nas 'grogs 'dris byed pa'i mi dang / srog chags de dag gis mtshon pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la bsam dbe|sa pa yin dus sems can gzhan gyi don la sems bzang po byed pa dang gzhan phan sgrub thub pa zhig byung na/ so so skyid pa/ shag mtshes khyim mtshes kun la bag phebs pa/ zos bde ba sto chas skyo po zhig las za rgyu med na yang bag phebs wa'i thog la za rgyu yod mkhan/dus tshod khag po zhig byung na yang phan tshun blo gtad bcol nas gcig rogs gcig gis byed kyi red bsam pa'i blo bde po dang / bag phebs po byas nas bsdad rgyu yong gi red/ de 'dra min par rang don khog la bcangs/ gzhan la phrag dog 'gran sems/ g.yo sgyu gnod 'tshe'i bsam blo 'khor nas bsdad pa yin na khyim gcig gi nang la bajed yod pa yin na yang rung / shag gcig gi nang la bsdad pa yin na yang gcig gis gcig mgo bskor btang gi dogs/bslu 'khrid byas kyi dogs/ gyong btang gi dogs/ dgra la bag zon byas 552

pa nang bzhin byas nas sdod dgos byung ba yin na/ de 'dra'i mi tshang de'i nang dang / de 'dra'i khyim mtshes phan tshun nang la don dam pa'i sems skyid po dang /don dam pa'i bag phebs po/ don dam pa'i bde 'jags yong thabs med pa red/ gzhan phan gyi sems bzang po zhig 'khyer/ ya rabs byas/ ga dus yin kyang gzhan gyi don dag ang dang por bzhag rang gi don dag de ang gnyis par bzhag pa zhig byung na spyi dang sger/ 'phral dang phugs gang gi skabs su yin na yang rang gzhan tshang mar phan thogs mthong chos la yod bsdad pa 'di red/ skye ba phyi ma rnams su mngon mtho'i phun tshogs dang / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur 'gro ba lta ci smos/ nga rang tsho'i tshe lhag ji tsam bsdad pa 'di'i ring la yang bag phebs pa zhig dang / skyid pa/ rang gzhan tshang ma nyon mongs 'phel ba'i rkyen du mi 'gro ba/ dge ba sgrub rgyu'i mthun rkyen la 'gro rgyu gcig yong gi red/ tshul de las ldog ste rang don gyi bsam pa kho na ma galta gas gzhan sngasan bsam thub pa zhig ma byung na/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob rgyu par bzhag 'phral la yin na yang bde skyid yong gi ma red ces spyod 'jug nas thag bcad de gsungs yod/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ ces bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal brje ba'i sems shugs skyes thub pa zhig ma byung na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob rgyu phar bzhag srid pa 'khor ba la 'khor ba'i gnas skabs la yang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig ma gtogs yong gi ma red ces gsungs pa red/ gzhan phan gyi 553

pa nang bzhin byas nas sdod dgos byung ba yin na/ de 'dra'i mi tshang de'i nang dang / de 'dra'i khyim mtshes phan tshun nang la don dam pa'i sems skyid po dang /don dam pa'i bag phebs po/ don dam pa'i bde 'jags yong thabs med pa red/ gzhan phan gyi sems bzang po zhig 'khyer/ ya rabs byas/ ga dus yin kyang gzhan gyi don dag ang dang por bzhag rang gi don dag de ang gnyis par bzhag pa zhig byung na spyi dang sger/ 'phral dang phugs gang gi skabs su yin na yang rang gzhan tshang mar phan thogs mthong chos la yod bsdad pa 'di red/ skye ba phyi ma rnams su mngon mtho'i phun tshogs dang / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur 'gro ba lta ci smos/ nga rang tsho'i tshe lhag ji tsam bsdad pa 'di'i ring la yang bag phebs pa zhig dang / skyid pa/ rang gzhan tshang ma nyon mongs 'phel ba'i rkyen du mi 'gro ba/ dge ba sgrub rgyu'i mthun rkyen la 'gro rgyu gcig yong gi red/ tshul de las ldog ste rang don gyi bsam pa kho na ma galta gas gzhan sngasan bsam thub pa zhig ma byung na/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob rgyu par bzhag 'phral la yin na yang bde skyid yong gi ma red ces spyod 'jug nas thag bcad de gsungs yod/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ ces bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal brje ba'i sems shugs skyes thub pa zhig ma byung na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob rgyu phar bzhag srid pa 'khor ba la 'khor ba'i gnas skabs la yang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig ma gtogs yong gi ma red ces gsungs pa red/ gzhan phan gyi 553

blo skyes pa'i phan yon dang / rang bde khog la bcug nas bsdad pa'i skyon dpe dang / lung dang rigs pas sgrub nas skad cha skor kyog mang po'i thog nas bshad ma dgos par nga rang tsho'i mthong chos rig chos 'di red/ bla ma gra pa zhig yin na'ang gzhan phan gyi sems bzang po skye ba zhig byung na dad pa skye ba dang /tshang mas spyi mos byed rgyu zhig yong gi red/ rang don khog la bcug pa'i bla ma gra pa dge bshes su yin kyang mdun la zhum zhum byed mdog kha po red de/rgyab la bla ma des gang yong zhes rang gzhan sus kyang bshad kyi red/ de bshad pa la rang dbang yod pa red/ thob thang yod pa red/ bshad 'os pa red/ de bzhin dpon po 'go khrid pa zhig yin na yang rang don khog la bcug nas bsdad pa yin na mdun la dbang shugs yod pa'i ring la bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'dra gang yong yong 'thor gyi red de/ rgyab la kog bshad tshun chad byas nas de 'dra'i bla ma dpon wa der sdug pa zhig byung song na tshang mas dga' bzhin spro bzhin du yi rangs byed rgyu yin pa thag chod pa red/ gnas lugs 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mthong chos su yod pa 'di red/ de 'dra yin dus nga rang tsho rang gzhan rogs gsum su yin na yang ga stod thub thub kyis gzhan phan sgrub rgyu dang / ga tsho da thub thub kyi rang don khog bcug sgong thabs byed kyi yin na de ni dngos gnas drang gnas kyi chos dang mthun pa red/ 'jig rten ya rabs dang mthun pa red/ rang skyid pa gzhan bde ba/ 'phral la phan pa/ phugs su bde ba/ 'di las lhag pa zhig med/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku ngo ma'i zhabs la mgo bos btud de zhus na'ang bslab bya 'di ma 554

blo skyes pa'i phan yon dang / rang bde khog la bcug nas bsdad pa'i skyon dpe dang / lung dang rigs pas sgrub nas skad cha skor kyog mang po'i thog nas bshad ma dgos par nga rang tsho'i mthong chos rig chos 'di red/ bla ma gra pa zhig yin na'ang gzhan phan gyi sems bzang po skye ba zhig byung na dad pa skye ba dang /tshang mas spyi mos byed rgyu zhig yong gi red/ rang don khog la bcug pa'i bla ma gra pa dge bshes su yin kyang mdun la zhum zhum byed mdog kha po red de/rgyab la bla ma des gang yong zhes rang gzhan sus kyang bshad kyi red/ de bshad pa la rang dbang yod pa red/ thob thang yod pa red/ bshad 'os pa red/ de bzhin dpon po 'go khrid pa zhig yin na yang rang don khog la bcug nas bsdad pa yin na mdun la dbang shugs yod pa'i ring la bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'dra gang yong yong 'thor gyi red de/ rgyab la kog bshad tshun chad byas nas de 'dra'i bla ma dpon wa der sdug pa zhig byung song na tshang mas dga' bzhin spro bzhin du yi rangs byed rgyu yin pa thag chod pa red/ gnas lugs 'di 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mthong chos su yod pa 'di red/ de 'dra yin dus nga rang tsho rang gzhan rogs gsum su yin na yang ga stod thub thub kyis gzhan phan sgrub rgyu dang / ga tsho da thub thub kyi rang don khog bcug sgong thabs byed kyi yin na de ni dngos gnas drang gnas kyi chos dang mthun pa red/ 'jig rten ya rabs dang mthun pa red/ rang skyid pa gzhan bde ba/ 'phral la phan pa/ phugs su bde ba/ 'di las lhag pa zhig med/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku ngo ma'i zhabs la mgo bos btud de zhus na'ang bslab bya 'di ma 554

gtogs gnang rgyu yod med bka' bstan 'gyur gsung rab 'di tsho mjal na shes rgyu red/ theg pa chen wa'i chos kyi don dag tshur bsdus na gzhan la rogs byed dgos zer ba dang / theg pa dman pa'i chos kyi don dag tshur bsdus na gzhan la gnod pa ma byed zer ba 'di yin/ byung na gzhan la rogs byas/ gal te gzhan la rogs byed ma thub na yang gzhan la gnod ma skyel zer ba'i tshig gnyis po de'i nang la chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi don thams cad 'dusayod pa red/ chos khas len mkhan zhig yin na ni dus da res rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi rten bzang rnyed/ mjal dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ de yi nang nas kyang theg pa chen wa'i chos dang mjal/ de'i nang nas kyang mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi chos dang mjal/ nga rang tsho bod kha ba gangs can gyi ljongs la yod pa'i sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad pa tshang ma mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi chos sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe gcig la ster bar byed pa'i chos sha stag yin pa red/ chos kyi ngo sgrod byed mkhan bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid ldan pa zhig kyang 'phrad pa bcas de 'dra'i dus skabs 'dir/theg pa chen po'i chos lam yongs su rdzogs pa rgyud la skye thub pa zhig ma byung na yang / da lta nas rten 'brel 'go nas ma 'phyug pa zhig bsgrigs/ gang yong ci yong gi bag chags zhig bzhag skye ba rim gyi brgyud nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du sgrub thub pa zhig cis kyang bya dgos/ de 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du bya snyam/ pa de yang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rang dang rang 'dra ba bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa/ de 555

ltan yang bde bas phongs/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar nas yod bsdad pa de rnams kyi don du gang yong ci yong zhig gi gzhan phan cis kyang byed/ de sgrub pa la yang / rang la gzhan phan sgrub pa'i cha rkyen dang nus pa zhig med na sems bzang po skye ba tsam ma gtogs gzhan don sgrub thub pa khag po red/ sems can sdug bsngal de dag las bskyab pa'i slad du gzhan phan mthar thug bla na med pa'i sa la 'gro ba'i lam ma nor ba zhig ston dgos/ de lta bu'i lam rang la kog tu gyur na gzhan la ston mi nus/ de 'dra'i lam phyin ci ma log pa'i mngon rtogs rang gi rgyud la skyes/ de la goms nas rang gi nyams myong gi thog nas gzhan la ston thub pa dang / 'khrid thub pa zhig yong ba la de lta bu'i lam rang nyid kyis mngon du byed dgos pa red/ sems can rnams kyi don nyi tshe ba dang / dus nges pa can de 'dra ma yin par/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa zhig sus nus snyam na/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig thob na des nus pa yin/ mdor na gzhan don mtha' cig tu sgrub mkhan 'di sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi yon tan yin pas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang cis kyang thob pa bya snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bzang po bskyed dgos/de 'dra ba'i sems bzang po bskyed pa'i cha rkyen du da lta phan chad rang gi lus kyi thog nas bsags pa'i dge ba/ ngag gi thog nas bsags pa'i dge ba/ yid kyi thog nas bsags pa'i dge ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig sgrub pa de thams cad bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru 'gro ba shog snyam pa'i smon lam 556

gyi thog nas sems bskyed pa yin na spyod 'jug nas gsung ba bzhin phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa red/ des na phan yon khyad par can gyi sems bskyed smon lam gyi tshul du bya ba la/ thog mar nga rang tsho yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas phyogs gsog dgos/ de'i nang na bshags pa'i yan lag yod na yang /bshags pa gnad du smin pa'i don du sngon gyi mkhas pa 'gas gsung rab kyi dgongs pa blangs te ltung bshags kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba gsungs yod/ de yag po 'dug spyod 'jug nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems pa kun/ /kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan/ gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thogs pa med pa'i gzigs pa mnga' ba de dag gi spyan sngar bdag cag yod bsam pa dang / ltung bshags kyi sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga yang mngon sum du mdun gyi nam mkhar yod bsam pa byas/ nga 'dir zhu sna 'dren mkhan gyi tshul du yod bsam pa byas nas/ khyed rang tshos stung bshags kyi don blo la gsal po dran pa'i ngang nas/ ltung bshags 'don gyin 'don gyin ga ler ga ler phyag 'tshal dgos/ da lta phan chad la rang dang sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi 〈( nas bsags pa'i nyes pa/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i nyes pa/yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nyes pa ci bgyis pa/ mdor na sems bzang po skyed pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig pa dang / ltung ba dang / nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa de thams cad sngar byas la 'gyod sems/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems brtan po'i thog nas ltung bshags rgyud dang 'dres nges kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal gnang shoga.ang / de nas dngos gzhi sems 557

bskyed smon lam gyi tshul du bskyed pa la sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma rjes zlos kyi sgo nas bya rgyur/ 'di yi rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba yin/ de yang sangs rgyas skyon kun zad/yon tan kun ldan/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas de nga sto la blang dor ston mkhan gyi skyabs ston pa po dang / de'i thugs rgyud layod pa'i 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos des nga cho khes pa las rim gyis grol te mthar skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan gyi go 'phang thob thabs su byed pa'i skyabs dngos/de lta bu'i 'gog lam gyi chos dngos thugs rgyud la yod mkhan gyi byang chub sems dpa' sa dang po ba yan chad theg chen 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams nga rang tsho kha mig yar blta byed sa dang / blo gtad bcol sa'i zla grogs su bltas te/ sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun de gsum la snying khong nus pa'i gting nas skyabs 'gro rnam par dag pa zhig byas/ rkang pa gnyis pa gnyis kyi skabs su/ bdag gis da lta phan la tshe rabs mang por bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa de dag thams cad kyi mthu la brten nas/ da res sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nang tshan mdo sngags zung 'brel theg pa chen po'i bstan pa 'di 'dra dang mjal yod pa'i skabs 'dir bdag las gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i blo sbyangs te bla med byang chub thob pa zhig cis kyang bya/ des na bdag gis deng phan chad rang gi sgo gsum gyi nus pa ci yod thams cad jo bo sems can rnams kyi don dag la bkol thub pa zhig cis kyang bya/ mdor na mgon po klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ /sa dang chu dang med dang rlung /558

/sman dang dgon pa'i shing bzhin du/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyi/ /rang dgar dgag med spyad byar shog /ces dang / /sems can rnams la srog bzhin phangs/ /bdag las de dag ches phangs shog /bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ji srid sems can 'ba' zhig kyang / gang du ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /ces ji ltar gsungs pa ltar/ de bzhin du zhi ba lhas kyang spyod 'jug las/ /rtag tu 'byung ba chen po dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang / /sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ /rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir smin shog /ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa dang / /'gro ba ji srid gnas gyur pa/ /de srid bdag ni gnas gyur nas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog /ces gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi nam mkha' ma zad kyi bar du sems can gyi don la brtson pa'i snying stobs rmad du byung ba'i sems dpa' chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs lta bur 'gyur ba dang / de 'dra po zhig yong ba shog snyam pa dang / de 'dra byed kyi yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa skyed/ da lta phan chad la rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bsags nas yod pa 'di thams cad chud zos bar ma dor ma song bar de lta bu'i bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang job pa'i rgyu ru cis kyang 'gyur bar shog snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang / smon lam shugs drag gi sgo nas sems bzang po bskyed pa yin pas/ da lta yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas tshogs ga11ga pa'i yul sdudags bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa la ngas zhu ngo 'bul ba'i tshul du byas 559

nas sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ de ltar nga ra nga tsho da ring tshogs gnyis bsags pa mngon du 'gro ba'i thog nas sems bskyed smon lam gyi tshul du byas nas sems bzang po bskyed pa 'di la spyod 'jug nas gsungs pa bzhin phan sku(na bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa red/ da lta nga tshos sems bzang po bskyed pa bzhin dus rgyun gtan nas gong du zhus pa ltar rang gis ga stod thub thub kyi gzhan phan sgrub thabs cis kyang byed dgos/ mtha' ma gzhan phan yag po sgrub ma thub na'ang gzhan la gnod mi skyel ba ni srog 'tsho ba'i dgos don snying wa de yin pas/ de dang mi 'gal ba zhig cis kyang bya dgos pa red/ spyod 'jug nas/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar da res rnyed pa mchog 'di 'dra'i sems bzang po zhig skyed rgyu byung ba 'di ni shin tu skal ba bzang po yin/ tshe 'bras bu dang bcas pa don ldan byung ba red/ de ring sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang ma/thun pa'i sems bzang po bskyed de/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dgongs sgrub mkhan gyi sras sam/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skyes pa yin dus rang gi rigasadang mthun pa'i las la brtson dgos/ las ga re byed dgos snyam na/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams la dgongs rgyu sems can dang / mdzad rgyu sems can gyi don ma gtogs med pa ltar nga tshos kyang phyin chad bsam rgyu sems can dang /560

bya rgyu sems can gyi don ma gtogs gzhan med pa zhig cis kyang bya snyam pa byas te/ de lta bu'i tshul dang ma 'gal ba zhig nges par du byed dgos pa red/nga rang tshor thob pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dbyangs dang / kun tu bzang po dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa de dag gis bsngo ba ji ltar mdzad pa nang bzhin bdag gis kyang bsngo bar bgyi'o/ snyam pa dang bcas te bsngo ba'i rgyal po tshig rkang gnyis po 'di mnyam du 'don shog /'jam dpal dpa' pos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo / dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa der//bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ zhes bsngo smon bka' drin bskyangs// //561

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1977 zla 7 tshes 31 nyin/ mon go ṭa 'dod rgu gling gzhis sgar du ser skya mi mang tshor bka' slob stsal ba/da res sdod sgar 'dir 'byor te khyed rang tsho dga' po yong gi red la/nga rang yang dga' po byung / bar lam lo bstud nas lo nyes byung ste dka' ngal byung yod pa red de/ yin na yang tshang mas sems 'dir babs pa'i thog nas sa cha 'di ga'i sgang la dka' las brgyabs/ sra thag thagaskusang ba byed dgos bsam pa'i sems thag bcad nas bsdad pa yag po byung / sems thag bcad nas yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i sems shugs bsgril yong dus rim pas rim pas yar rgyas yong gi red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug yag po byung 'dug tshang mas hur thag byas pa la thugs rje che zer rgyu yin/ de nas da lta gzhis 'go'i thog nas lab pa ltar sa chas ma ldeng pa'i dka' ngal yod dus to gos sra thag thag yong ba'i don dag la lag shes dang de 'dra'i thog nas thabs shes gzhan dag byed dgos/ rgya che'i thabs shes gzhan dag nga tshos byed thub rgyu khag po red/nga tshos thub pa dang 'grub tshod lag shes chung tsag rigs gang 'tshams bed spyod byed thub na sa zhing thon skyed kyi zhor la lag shes thog nas nus pa bton thub rgyu yin tsang yag po red/de nas 'di gar yod pa'i slob grwar da lta mthun rkyen 'dzoms po med pa skyo po red de yin na'ang med pa zhig la tos te yod pa tsam gyis yag po red/da lta slob gra'i gzhi 'dra po tshugs yod pa de da dung yar rgyas 'gro ba zhig dang /slob gra'i ming yod pa tsam gyis mi 'grigs par slob sbyong yag po yong thub pa 562

zhig yod dgos/ dbus shes rig tshogs pa'i lta rtog khyab khongs su yod pa'i slob gra tshang mar slob sbyong sprod stangs gang cir spus dag tu gtong ba'i don la rgya gar gzhung gi shes rig las khungs la da res ldi lir bka' mol zhu rgyu byung / nga rang tsho'i shes rig las khungs kyi thog nas kyang thabs shes ga re byed rgyu yod pa de dag tshad tshad bsdur bsdur sgo gang sa nas byed kyi yod/ ga ler ga ler yar rgyas tan tan 'gro thub kyi red/ phyi nas rogs byed rgyu dang /'char gzhi bkod de do snang byed rgyu de dag ga stod thub thub nga chos byed kyi red la rgya gar gzhung gi thog nas kyang tan tan dgongs bzhes gnang gi red/ gal che shos nga tshor chos kyi thog nas yag po yod pa ma gtogs/ spyir btang shes yon gyi thog la nga tsho bod pa dpe mi srid pa'i skyo po red/ ngo tsha dgos pa lta bu 'dug so so'i yi ge yang shes kyi med na/ gnas lugs gzhan dag ga nas shes/ so so sdod sa'i grong gseb nang gi khyim tshang kha shas kyi gnas tshul 'dra shes kyi sku(da 'gro/ de nas phar nyin mtshan kha shas sbrel nas phyin pa'i sa la ga re ga re yod med/ 'dzam bu gling gi rgya mtsho'i mtha' la ga re ga re yod med phar bzhag so so yod sa'i grong gseb g.yas g.yon la ga re ga re yod med kyang ma shes pa byas te sdod kyi yod pa red/ dpe ma srid pa'i shes tshad skyo po/ bsam blo sbug srub dog po/ bsam blo rgya chung chung red/ nga rang tsho'i dus tshod la 'gyur ba chen po phyin te da lta rgya gar lung pa'i nang la sdod pa'i skabs su nga tsho mi gral du tshud par byas nas lto gos 'tshol dgos kyi red ma gtogs/ rgya gar lung pa'i nang la glen pa gang yang mi shes mkhan zhig 563

zhig yod dgos/ dbus shes rig tshogs pa'i lta rtog khyab khongs su yod pa'i slob gra tshang mar slob sbyong sprod stangs gang cir spus dag tu gtong ba'i don la rgya gar gzhung gi shes rig las khungs la da res ldi lir bka' mol zhu rgyu byung / nga rang tsho'i shes rig las khungs kyi thog nas kyang thabs shes ga re byed rgyu yod pa de dag tshad tshad bsdur bsdur sgo gang sa nas byed kyi yod/ ga ler ga ler yar rgyas tan tan 'gro thub kyi red/ phyi nas rogs byed rgyu dang /'char gzhi bkod de do snang byed rgyu de dag ga stod thub thub nga chos byed kyi red la rgya gar gzhung gi thog nas kyang tan tan dgongs bzhes gnang gi red/ gal che shos nga tshor chos kyi thog nas yag po yod pa ma gtogs/ spyir btang shes yon gyi thog la nga tsho bod pa dpe mi srid pa'i skyo po red/ ngo tsha dgos pa lta bu 'dug so so'i yi ge yang shes kyi med na/ gnas lugs gzhan dag ga nas shes/ so so sdod sa'i grong gseb nang gi khyim tshang kha shas kyi gnas tshul 'dra shes kyi sku(da 'gro/ de nas phar nyin mtshan kha shas sbrel nas phyin pa'i sa la ga re ga re yod med/ 'dzam bu gling gi rgya mtsho'i mtha' la ga re ga re yod med phar bzhag so so yod sa'i grong gseb g.yas g.yon la ga re ga re yod med kyang ma shes pa byas te sdod kyi yod pa red/ dpe ma srid pa'i shes tshad skyo po/ bsam blo sbug srub dog po/ bsam blo rgya chung chung red/ nga rang tsho'i dus tshod la 'gyur ba chen po phyin te da lta rgya gar lung pa'i nang la sdod pa'i skabs su nga tsho mi gral du tshud par byas nas lto gos 'tshol dgos kyi red ma gtogs/ rgya gar lung pa'i nang la glen pa gang yang mi shes mkhan zhig 563

byas te sdod dgos byung na lto tshe 'phyis kyi ma red/ nga rang tsho bod mi rigs spyir btang gi cha nas bsam blo btang na yang zhabs 'dren dang / ngo tsha ba'i rang bzhin red ma gtogs gzi brjid gang yang ma red/ da lta 'phral sel so so mi'i lung par bsdad pa'i ring la mi gral du tshud pa gcig dang / nga rang tsho bod mi rigs spyi'i mtshan mthong lar rgya'i cha nas yin na yang tshad longs pa zhig dgos pa yin dus shes bya yon tan dgos kyi sku da pa red/ de bzhin ma 'ongs pa la nga rang tsho bod rang dbang byung ste bod lung par log pa'i skabs su yang nga tsho mi'i lung par bsdad pa'i ring la chos dang shes rig gang ci'i cha nas nga tsho yar rgyas sam/ mi nyams gong 'phel gyi rgyun 'dzin ga tshad thub thub byas pa'i grub 'bras ston rgyu yod pa zhig dang / spyir btang 'dzam bu gling gi shes yon gyi cha nas kyang nga tsho mi gral la tshud tsam zhig ma byung na skyo po red/bod nang la yod pa'i slob gra de dag gnas tshad longs po zhig dang / spus dag po rang lta yod pa ma red de/ yin na yang / bod yig gis mtshon pa'i slob sbyong gang la gang 'tshams 〈snad kyi 'dug ma gzhi rgya mis rgya yig dang rgya mi'i lta spyod thog la shugs rgyag gi yod pa red/ bod rang gi rgyal rabs dang /bod rang gi khungs 'brel dngos rjen gyi lo rgyus de tsho'i gras slob kyi yod pa ma red la/ bslab chog gi yang yod pa ma red/ de 'dra yin dus ma gzhi phyogs gcig gi bzo 'dra zhig red de/ gzhi rtsa yar rgyas 'gro gi yod pa red/ lhag don bod nang la sku/da pa'i mi mang tsho rgya mi'i tshogs 'du tshogs rgyus macesan pa'i ha cang bi/ bsun po bzo gi yod pa yin tsang chab srid kyi bsam blo'i thog la nga 564

tsho mi'i lung par slebs pa'i bod pa tsho las bod nang la yod pa'i bod pa tsho bsam blo tan tan grung ba dang / sems shugs kyang che ba/ gang 'tshams gyong po yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug 'di phyogs 'byor ba'i btsan byol ba kha shas thug dus kyang de 'dra yod pa'i bzo 'dra po 'dug nga rang tsho'i phru gu'i shes yon gyi thog la nges par du pha ma tsho'i thog nas do khur yag po len dgos/ phru gur shes yon yag po 'jags pa'i don dag la do khur dang / do snang chen po byed rgyu 'di ha cang gal chen po 'dug pa pha a ma tshos shes kyi 'dug gam/sngon ma yang lab pa yin/ nga tsho'i spyi 'thus dang / dril bsgrags byed mkhan/ bka' blon tsho bcas yong ba'i skabs su yang rtag par bshad kyi yod pa red la/sa gnas gzhis 'tho'i thog nas yin na'ang gzhen bskul rtag par byed kyi yod pa red/ da dung yang gal che nan tan yin dus shes yon gyi thog la yin gcig min gcig gi do snang yag po byed dgos/de nas gra pa phru gu chung chung 'di tsho'i gras la da lta gra tshang kha shas nas 'dzin gra btsugs te 'bad brtson byed kyi yod pa red/ 'di tshor bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug phru gu chung chung gra pa byed mkhan de tsho'i gras brgya cha brgya tham pa thag chod pa'i kho'i mi tshe hril po chos kyi slob gnyer dang / sgrub pa nyams len la bsgril thub pa zhig yong gi red dam zer na the tshom red/ kha shas chos mtha' 'khyongs mdog kha po red/ kha shas chos mtha' 'khyongs mdog kha po ma red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul chags yong dus slob sbyong byed pa'i dus yun de gra sa gra tshang zhig gi nang la bsdad/ gra pa khungs ma 'khyol bar mar 565

log yong ba'i skabs la gang yang mi shes pa bong bu lta bu zhig byed dgos byung na do bdag kho rang gi bsam blo'i nang la'ang ma skyid pa/ mtshan shas zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan gyi bzo 'dra po tan tan yong gi red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug de 'dra yin dus dpe cha bslab pa dang chabs cig spyir btang shes yon thog la'ang do snang byed dgos/ ma gzhi chos don las khungs dang yang skad cha yong gi yod pa ltar/ khyed rang tshos 'dir dngos su 'go btsugs nas lag len bkal gyi yod pa red/ nga rang tsho de snga phan chad nyams myong dang cha rgyus med pa'i las ka gsar pa zhig byed dus ran dang ma ran/ tshad tshad bsdur bsdur mang po zhig byed dgos/ skabs re pham nyes yong gi red/ 'on kyang pham nyes 'gro gin 'gro shin da dung tshad tshad bsdur bsdur byed kyin byed kyin byas pa yin na gang 'tshams yong stod gcig nas dngos gnas 'dod pa khengs pa spus dag po zhig tan tan chags thub kyi red/ mi cho'i lung pa'i yar rgyas zer mkhan de yang tshad tshad bsdur bsdur sgo gang sa nas gtong gin gtong shin byas nas mi thog gcig gis khungs ma 'khyol ba de/ mi thog rjes ma gcig gis mjug bskyangs te gzhi nas tshags tshud byung ba zhig red ma gtogs/ 'char gzhi dang po bkod ma thag nas gra 'grigs po zhig dang / byas chog chog gcig su gcig la yang yod kyi ma red/ nga rang tsho yin na'ang de snga phan chad la ma byung ba'i lam srol gsar pa zhig btod yong dus tshad tshad bsdur bsdur sgo gang sa nas nges par du byed dgos pa zhig red/ pham nyes re re byung ba dang g.yugs ma bzhag par lan dgu chad mthud ces dpe la yod pa bzhin byas te nges par 566
