du shugs rgyab na yag po red bsam pa dran byung /de nas da lta slob gra'i 'dzin gra'i nang la nga rang tsho bod pa'i phru gu slob sbyong thon te deng dge rgan byed mkhan kha shas 'dug pa de la ha cang dga' po byung / sa cha gzhan dag la yang bod rigs phru gu ma su ri slob gras mtshon pa'i slob gra khag nas thon/ dge rgan 'os sbyong byas nas slob gra khag la dge rgan gyi las ka byed mkhan yong gi yod pa red/ de sto yag po red/ slob tshan gyi don dag ga re yin na'ang so so'i skad kyi thog nas 'grel bshad rgyab nas go brda sbrad thub kyi yod pa yin dus/ de la dge mtshan chen po yod pa red/dge rgan dang dge phrug gi dbar la gcig gis gcig la sems thag nye po dang /brtse ba slebs thub pa zhig byung na des bshad pa'i bslab bya de yang sems la 'jags po yong gi red/ bod rigs dge rgan da lta kha shas yod pa tsho 'dir gzhis chags kyi mthun rkyen 'dzoms ma 'dzoms kyi dka' ngal tan tan yong mdog kha po red de yin gcig min gcig sems shugs yag po zhig 'khyer nas hur thag byed rogs/ de la dga' po byung /de nas 'phrul 'khor bcos sgrig khang gi nang la yang las ka byed mkhan tshang ma bod pa sha stag yin pa yag po red/ kha sa nga'i mthong snang yag po byung /da dung dngul dang / las byed pa'i bskor ba 'khor tshod gcig yong gi 'dug na yar rgyas gtong rgyu ga re ga re 'dug gam/ de la nges par du bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug de ga nang bzhin bzo las gzhi rtsa phran bu tshugs nas yod bsdad pa 'di tsho yang yar rgyas ga 'dra gtong dgos kyi 'dug gam/ gcig 567

'grub tshar ba na de nas 'char can 'di ltar yin zer ba lta bu byas/ thebs chags shig 'grub pa de la chog shes byas te g.yugs bzhag gi 'dug de 'drar ma bzhag par da dung yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang / da dung tshags su tshud pa yong thabs ga re ga re byed rgyu 'dug gzhi rtsa tshugs tshar ba de da dung babs nying brtan wa'i thog nas yar rgyas 'gro thub pa'i bsam blo yin gcig min gcig gtong dgos kyi 'dugade nas sman khang da lta yag thag chod 'dug las ka byed mkhan bod rigs gang la gang 'tshams shig yod pa red/ da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red/ da dung yin kyang hur thag byed rogs/ gal chen po red/ nad pa sman khang nang la yong dus skyid po gtong bar yong ba zhig rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/sman khang nang la yong ba'i nyin mo de 'a chad 'u thug gis sman khang la yong gi yod pa red/ so so'i shag gi nang la byed thabs med pa gcig dang / rogs pa tshor brtse ba yod na yang byed thabs med mkhan/ dpag tshod zhig gi skyabs med mgon med 'dra po chags yong dus sman khang la skyabs su re nas phan thogs shig e yong bsam nas yong gi yod pa red/ sman khang la yong mkhan rnams 'u thug nas yong mkhan sha stag yin dus/ em rje dang / de bzhin sman rogs byed mkhan khyed rang tsho tshang mas sems bzang po 'khyer dgos/ ma gzhi na tshas gdungs pa'i mi la skyug bro po zhig dang / thabs rdug po zhig ma gtogs med/ yin na yang skyug waṃ snang ma byas par lta rtog byed rgyu dang / byams po byed rgyu/ da ring༄ sang nyin shi grab yod pa zhig yin na yang khyed rang gang 568

'grub tshar ba na de nas 'char can 'di ltar yin zer ba lta bu byas/ thebs chags shig 'grub pa de la chog shes byas te g.yugs bzhag gi 'dug de 'drar ma bzhag par da dung yar rgyas gtong rgyu dang / da dung tshags su tshud pa yong thabs ga re ga re byed rgyu 'dug gzhi rtsa tshugs tshar ba de da dung babs nying brtan wa'i thog nas yar rgyas 'gro thub pa'i bsam blo yin gcig min gcig gtong dgos kyi 'dugade nas sman khang da lta yag thag chod 'dug las ka byed mkhan bod rigs gang la gang 'tshams shig yod pa red/ da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red/ da dung yin kyang hur thag byed rogs/ gal chen po red/ nad pa sman khang nang la yong dus skyid po gtong bar yong ba zhig rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/sman khang nang la yong ba'i nyin mo de 'a chad 'u thug gis sman khang la yong gi yod pa red/ so so'i shag gi nang la byed thabs med pa gcig dang / rogs pa tshor brtse ba yod na yang byed thabs med mkhan/ dpag tshod zhig gi skyabs med mgon med 'dra po chags yong dus sman khang la skyabs su re nas phan thogs shig e yong bsam nas yong gi yod pa red/ sman khang la yong mkhan rnams 'u thug nas yong mkhan sha stag yin dus/ em rje dang / de bzhin sman rogs byed mkhan khyed rang tsho tshang mas sems bzang po 'khyer dgos/ ma gzhi na tshas gdungs pa'i mi la skyug bro po zhig dang / thabs rdug po zhig ma gtogs med/ yin na yang skyug waṃ snang ma byas par lta rtog byed rgyu dang / byams po byed rgyu/ da ring༄ sang nyin shi grab yod pa zhig yin na yang khyed rang gang 568

yang byed kyi ma red ces sems gso btang nas sems skyid po bzo thabs byas na'ang phan gyi red/ de bzhin nga rang tsho bod mi nang khul nges med kyi shi rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa'i bzo 'dra wa de tsho'i gras la sman bcos byed pa dang chabs cigachos kyi bslab bya 'dra rgyag rgyu dang / ma ṇi 'dra bgrang du bcug na phan gyi red/chos dad med mkhan gcig yin na ni kho'i rna bar ma ṇi blug dgos don yod pa ma red/ yang sman khang nang gyon chas mi 'dra ba zhig gyon tshar ba'i rjes la ma ṇi bgrang mi chog pa'i bzo 'dra po byas na dgos pa gang yang yod pa ma red/ sman khang skor de 'dra zhig dran byung /de nas 'phrod bsten gyi skor la/ na tsha sdug po zhig ma byung gi bar du ltod yangs byas/ na tsha tshabs cher song zin rjes sman khang la phyin na'ang phyis drags pa red/ na tsha tshabs cher song zin pa'i dbang gis lam seng sman gyis ma phan par sdug skad rgyagagin bsdad nas cho yod pa ma red/ nam rgyun nas gzugs po phran bu ma bde ba yong gi 'dug na lam seng em rje'i sar phyin te bsun po bzo gi yin na yag po yod pa red/ nyin ma kha shas mgo na ba'i bzo 'dra po/ nyin ma kha shas khams nyog pa 'dra po/ gzugs po ma gzhi bde po yod na yang grod khog bshal ba'i bzo 'dra po 'dug na lam seng sman khang la phyin/ mgo na nas nyin ma 'di 'dra zhig phyin song / grod khog bshal nas nyin ma 'di 'dra phyin song zer lam seng em rjer gsal po lab dgos/ grod khog bshal ba 'dra po dang / mgo na ba'i bzo 'dra po byung ba'i skabs su 'tsher snang byas te sman khang la ma phyin bar so so'i nang du bsdad/ na tsha babs lcir 569

song nas g.yas skyor gasku(na skyodar byas nas ma gtogs ma 'khyol ba'i mtshams la gzhi nas sman khang du phyin rung phal cher dus tshod chud zos phyin te re ba rdzogs tshar ba red/ de 'dra nga tsho bod pas yang yang byed kyi 'dug de 'dra byed rgyu mi 'dug 'phrod bsten la nam rgyun nas do snang byed dgos/ lto chas yag nyes ga re yin rung min rung / lto chas gsos pa gsos par za ba las tam spu rgyab pa'i bzo 'dra po/ rnying pa chags pa'i bzo 'dra po de 'dra za mi rung /de snga bod la yin na sa mtho po dang / skam po/ sa grang mo yin tsang lto chas nyin ma kha shas bzhag kyang 'grigs kyi yod pa red/ 'di khul de 'dra ma red/ma gzhi 'di tsho'i skor sngon ma yang nga tsho skad cha byung ba ltar/ da dung yin na'ang yin gcig min gcig gzab gzab byed dgos/ skra lcang lo de tsho'i gras bzhar na 'grigs kyi red/ tsha ba dang rngul nag gi rlon pas mgo phying pa'i bzo 'dra po zhig chags na dgos pa 'dug gam/ so sku( 11 sor dri ma ma kha na yang / nga tshos blta dus dri ma kha mkhan 'dra po zhig 'dug de yang mi dgos pa red/ rjes su bod la skra bzhag chog gi red/ lcang lo rgyab snying 'dod kyi 'dug na ga ler ga ler lcang lo rgyab chog gi red/ 'phrod bsten zer ba 'di dus rgyun gtan nas byed rgyu ha cang gal chen 11 'dug yin gcig min gcig gzab gzab byed dgos/ de snga bod la yod pa'i skabs nang bzhin byas nas lhod yangs dang / phran bu na yang mkhregs po'i khur byas te sdug gyong gtong ba khyon nas byed rgyu mi 'dugade nas rtsa ba'i gzhis chags spyi'i 'dzugs bskrun skor la/ nga rang tshor 570

sa cha sprod mkhan gyis sa cha sprad/ rogs ram byed mkhan gyis rogs ram byas te da cha rogs ram byed mkhan tsho'i las mjug bsgril tsha ra ba yin dus/nga tsho sngon ma 'go stod kyi skabs nang bzhin byas nas slong sa gcig la slong chog chog dang / rogs ram zhiga.e rag mi rag byed pa'i dus tshod ha lam yol 'gro gi yod pa red/ spyi yongs kyi cha nas bshad pa yin na so sor sa cha zhig dang / mthun rkyen rogs ram gang la gang 'tshams shig thob tshar ba de gzhi la bzhag nas so so rang gis 'bad rtsol byas nas yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i thabs shes byed pa'i dus tshod la slebs pa ma gtogs/ mi gzhan dag gcig la skyabs 'jug zhus nas rogs ram zhig rag na las 'gul byed rgyu yod pa dang / de ma rag na byed rgyu gang yang med pa'i bzo 'dra po zhig byed pa'i dus tshod ma red/ gnad don 'di gzhis chags 'digacig pu'i skad cha ma red/gzhis chags yongs rdzogs kyi gnas tshul gcig gyur red/ khul 'dir blta bskor yong mkhan kha shas kyis dgon pa chen po 'di tsho'i gras mthong / bla brang tsho mthong ba'i skabs bod pa tsho phyug po 'dug ces bshad kyi 'dug dgon pa rang lta rgyu mtshan phran bu shod rgyu yong gi red/ nga la yang rogs ram tshogs pa kha shas kyis bshad byung / da bod pa tsho ha cang yag po 'dug lhag par pon go ṭa la dgon pa chen po mchor po de 'dra rgyab 'dug bla brang tsho yang ha cang mchor po 'dug bod pa phyug po 'dug da nga tshos rogs ram byed dgos mi 'dug ces bshad mkhan byung / dgongs dag zer rgyu ma gtogs de la bshad rgyu gang yang mi 'dug571

gzhis chags 'di'i nang la gzhis chags gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar bshad gra yod pa'i dgon pa gnyis chags te bsdad yod/ 'di tsho de snga bod nang la'ang skad grags yod pa'i dgon pa red/ deng sang rgya gar nang la'ang che shos kyi gras shig red/ 'gyed len thub tsam zhig/ min par dngos gnas bshad gra slob gnyer spus dag po yod pa yin dus rtsa ba chen po red/ mi mang tsho yin na yang tshad longs ba'i dgon pa 'di tshor dad gus dag snang byed rgyu gal chen po red/ so so'i skyabs 'jug zhu rgyu 'dra yod na bla ma skad grags che ba zhig gi rtsar 'bul gyin bsdad na sger pa zhig la babs pa red/ nga drang po yin/ de las sgor mo lnga las 'bul rgyu med kyang dgon pa zhig la phul na de yag gi red/ dgon pa de'i gra pa brgya nyis brgya zhig gi don dag la phan 'gro gi red/ ngas bla ma la sdang po byas nas bshad pa min/ nga rang yang bla ma yin pa'i skad cha red/ rgyal ba rin po che grod khog rgyags tsang bla ma tshor sdang po byas byung bsam pa dran gyi 'dug gam/ bsam blo yag po byas nas thongs dang / rgyud nas bshad pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid tshang ba tan tan yong gi red de/ spyir btang bla ma la phul ba de phyag mdzod des zas/ rjes su phyag mdzod de gra pa log bla brang bla brang zer na'ang khyim tshang gcig gi bzo 'dra po zhig chags kyi 'dug de zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan ma red dam/ bla ma'i rtsog rtse'i sgang la bzhag pa'i dngos wa des phyag mdzod de'i khyim tshang gso byed cig chags na ngo tsha ba'i gnas ma red dam/ drang po yin/ de las dgon pa zhig la phul na yag gi red/ mi mang tsho yin na'ang so sor phran bu 'bul rgyu yod pa de gang 572

gzhis chags 'di'i nang la gzhis chags gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar bshad gra yod pa'i dgon pa gnyis chags te bsdad yod/ 'di tsho de snga bod nang la'ang skad grags yod pa'i dgon pa red/ deng sang rgya gar nang la'ang che shos kyi gras shig red/ 'gyed len thub tsam zhig/ min par dngos gnas bshad gra slob gnyer spus dag po yod pa yin dus rtsa ba chen po red/ mi mang tsho yin na yang tshad longs ba'i dgon pa 'di tshor dad gus dag snang byed rgyu gal chen po red/ so so'i skyabs 'jug zhu rgyu 'dra yod na bla ma skad grags che ba zhig gi rtsar 'bul gyin bsdad na sger pa zhig la babs pa red/ nga drang po yin/ de las sgor mo lnga las 'bul rgyu med kyang dgon pa zhig la phul na de yag gi red/ dgon pa de'i gra pa brgya nyis brgya zhig gi don dag la phan 'gro gi red/ ngas bla ma la sdang po byas nas bshad pa min/ nga rang yang bla ma yin pa'i skad cha red/ rgyal ba rin po che grod khog rgyags tsang bla ma tshor sdang po byas byung bsam pa dran gyi 'dug gam/ bsam blo yag po byas nas thongs dang / rgyud nas bshad pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid tshang ba tan tan yong gi red de/ spyir btang bla ma la phul ba de phyag mdzod des zas/ rjes su phyag mdzod de gra pa log bla brang bla brang zer na'ang khyim tshang gcig gi bzo 'dra po zhig chags kyi 'dug de zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan ma red dam/ bla ma'i rtsog rtse'i sgang la bzhag pa'i dngos wa des phyag mdzod de'i khyim tshang gso byed cig chags na ngo tsha ba'i gnas ma red dam/ drang po yin/ de las dgon pa zhig la phul na yag gi red/ mi mang tsho yin na'ang so sor phran bu 'bul rgyu yod pa de gang 572

byung ma byung la ma gtor ba byas/ da lta 'dir yod pa'i dgon pa gra tshang dngos gnas drang gnas tshad yongs pa zhig yin dus de la phul/yang dgon pa'i las ka byed mkhan tsho yin na yang don dag med par za bed brdabs gsigs 'dra po btang nas rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba lta bu'i za brngams rtsa ba nas byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ da lta skyon med tsam red la/ da dung yang bod kyi mig ltos 'jags pa'i bzo 'dra wab de 'dra nam yang byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ de snga bod kyi dgon pa gra tshang gi 'dzin skyong byed stangs la ci mdzad legs mthong byed rgyu yod pa ma red do/ de snga bod kyi dgon pa gra tshang gi las ka byed stangs kyi thog la dngos gnas drang gnas spyi tshogs rnying pa'i 'gro stangs sdug chags/ gdug pa can gyi byed stangs mang pozhig tan tan yod pa red bsam gyi 'dug dgon pa grwa tshang gi bslab pa slob gnyer rgyag rgyu'i thog la de snga bod kyi mkhas pa dang grub pa de dag gis go rim bsgrigs/'char gzhi bkod bzhag pa de stodangos gnas drang gnas bsregs bcad brdar gsum byas pa zhig yin pa dang / nyams cartong bsags bzhag pa zhig yin pa red/ nor 'khrul spa rtse tsam phal cher yod pa ma red/ de tshor gces spras dang nyams len yagado nga byed dgos/ de min dgon pa gra tshang 'dzin skyong byed stangs kyi las rka'inang la bshu gzhog gi ring lugs tan tanaskusad pa red/ khyed rang tsho phyag mdzod yin na'ang rung / gnyer pa yin na'ang rung / ming ga re btags rung ma btags rung nges par du gzab gzab byed dgos/ de snga bod kyi mig ltos ngan pa de 'khyer/ der dag snang sbyangs/ do snang ma byung 573

byung ma byung la ma gtor ba byas/ da lta 'dir yod pa'i dgon pa gra tshang dngos gnas drang gnas tshad yongs pa zhig yin dus de la phul/yang dgon pa'i las ka byed mkhan tsho yin na yang don dag med par za bed brdabs gsigs 'dra po btang nas rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba lta bu'i za brngams rtsa ba nas byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ da lta skyon med tsam red la/ da dung yang bod kyi mig ltos 'jags pa'i bzo 'dra wab de 'dra nam yang byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ de snga bod kyi dgon pa gra tshang gi 'dzin skyong byed stangs la ci mdzad legs mthong byed rgyu yod pa ma red do/ de snga bod kyi dgon pa gra tshang gi las ka byed stangs kyi thog la dngos gnas drang gnas spyi tshogs rnying pa'i 'gro stangs sdug chags/ gdug pa can gyi byed stangs mang pozhig tan tan yod pa red bsam gyi 'dug dgon pa grwa tshang gi bslab pa slob gnyer rgyag rgyu'i thog la de snga bod kyi mkhas pa dang grub pa de dag gis go rim bsgrigs/'char gzhi bkod bzhag pa de stodangos gnas drang gnas bsregs bcad brdar gsum byas pa zhig yin pa dang / nyams cartong bsags bzhag pa zhig yin pa red/ nor 'khrul spa rtse tsam phal cher yod pa ma red/ de tshor gces spras dang nyams len yagado nga byed dgos/ de min dgon pa gra tshang 'dzin skyong byed stangs kyi las rka'inang la bshu gzhog gi ring lugs tan tanaskusad pa red/ khyed rang tsho phyag mdzod yin na'ang rung / gnyer pa yin na'ang rung / ming ga re btags rung ma btags rung nges par du gzab gzab byed dgos/ de snga bod kyi mig ltos ngan pa de 'khyer/ der dag snang sbyangs/ do snang ma byung 573

ba byas/ deng sang gi dus tshod gsar pa 'di'i nang bu lon dang gta' ma la bsnyad nas mi 'das grongs phyin pa'i sa khang la lag pa rgyag pa'i bzo 'dra po de 'dra byung na zhabs 'dren red/ da lta 'di khul de 'drayod pa go bos ma byung ste yang sa cha kha shas la de 'dra yong grabs byed kyi 'dug de 'dra rtsa ba nyid nas byed rgyu yod pa ma red/ dge 'dun tsho'i ngos nasayin na'ang rung / gra sa gra tshang gi ngos nas yin na'ang rtsa ba chos kyi cha nas ko thag slod yod pa ma red de/ chos byed mkhan nga rang tsho kha thabs skyo drags/ byed stangs de nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song nas zhabs 'dren zhu gi yod pa red/ de 'drar ma song ba'i gzab gzab byed dgos pa red / yul sde tshos dgon pa la skyabs bcol/ dad pa dag snang sbyangs/ dgon pa tshos kyang dngos gnas drang gnas chos dang mthun pa'i thog nas 'tsho ba bskyal nas mi mang la byamasaskyong rogs phan byed thub pa 'dra byung na dngos gnas drang gnas yag po byung ba red/ de 'dra'i 'brel ba yag po zhig byung rogs byas na yag po red bsam pa dran gyi 'dugade nas deng sang bod spyi'i gnas stangs ni/ da lta tshod mi thig pa'i bzo 'dra zhig red/ gzhi rtsa nga rang tsho tshang mar sems shugs gang la gang 'tshams shig yod pa red la/ bod nang nas da lta phan la gnas tshul khag 'dra mi 'dra thos pa de tsho tshang ma go bsdur ba'i skabs su bod nangayod pa'i rgya che'i mi rnams sems shugs chen po tan tan yod bzo 'dug so so sger gyi lta ba'i ngos nas dmar po'i lta ba 'khyer mkhan tan tan mang po yod pa red de/ rtsa ba bod mi 574

rigs kyi cha nas dngos gnas drang gnas kyi sems shugs yod pa dang / rgya mi'i gdug rtsub kyi byed stangs de'i jog la ma dga' ba byed mkhan shugs chen po yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug mi mang gi sems shugs de 'gyur ba med pa zhig yod phyin chad la bden pa'i mtha' gsal rgyur nga tshos yid ches chog pa zhig red/ de bzhin nga rang tsho chos khas len mkhanayin dus mo lung brtag dpyad byed rgyu'i rigs yong gi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i brtag dpyad skabs su yang 'gyur ba zhig yong gi yod pa brgya cha brgya tham pa tshod thig rgyu 'dug rtsa ba nga rang sto tshang mas sems shugs bskyed dgos pa red/ phyogs gcig nas rgya mi'i ngos nas bshad na/ 1959 lor lha sar zing 'khrug langs pa nas bzung rgya nag pe cing gzhung gi mtho rim mi sna tsho gcig 'og gcig la ma 'dus pa'i gnas tshul lo nas lo bstud da lta bar du byung ba red/ ha lam lo bcu dgu nyi shu tsam song na yang da dung kho tsho snyingasag po zhig rtsa ba nas ma 'jags par rtag par rnyog khra'i dkyil la bsdad yod pa red/ na ning ma'o tse tung gshegs pa nas da bar lo gcig 'khorayod ma red de/ de'i ring la'ang zang nge zing nge'i ngang da lta lhing 'jags med par bsdad yod pa red/ yang phyogs gcig nas snying ma 'jags pa'i rnam 'gyur ga 'dra zhig yong gi yod pa red zer na/ bar lam mi gang byung mang byung de 'dras dbang cha zin nas yod pa de tsho 'gyur ba phyin te gzhi snying zhig gi sgang la 'gro gi yod pa'i bzo 'dra po zhig yod pa red/ gzhi rtsa 'gan khur mkhan gyi mi gtan 'khel la ma 'khel dang / gcig sog gcig la ma 'dus pa'i rnam pa yod pa gang zhig la/ da 575

cha snying 'jags po zhig gi sgog la phyin nas rtsa ba nas brtan spro zhig tshugs mi yong ngam bsam pa'i bzo 'dra wa de 'dra zhig chags yong gi yod pa red/ bod don skor la pe cing nang zhi 'jam gyi srid byus 'khyer mkhan gyi mi de tsho shugs che ba 'dra po zhig chags yong giyod pa red/ de dang chabs cig bod nang la'ang nye char zla ba kha shas nang tshud nas rgya mis 'jam po 'dra zhig byed kyi yod pa'i bzo 'dug yang deng sang lha sar rgya mis 'di 'dra yang bshad 'dug bar lam bod khul gdug rtsub dang / gang byung mang byung gtor bshige gtong ba'i bzo 'dra po/ shes rig gsar brje sogs kyi skabs zang nge zing nge byung ba de ༄6) gras bar lam nag chen mi bzhis 'go 'khrid pa'i shog khag des byas pa red ma gtogs/ rtsa ba pe cing rang gi yang dag pa'i srid byus la de 'dra yod pa ma red/ chos da da la brtsi srung dang / gus zhabs byed rgyu ma gtogs gtor bshig gtong rgyu'i srid byus yod pa ma red ces bshad kyi yod 'dug lha sa khul la phran bu gu yang du dang / lto gos cung zad 'bal du phyin yod tshod/ grong gseb khag dang bod yongs rdzogs la da lta de 'dra rang yod bzo mi 'dug gal srid rgya mis 'jam po zhig byas pa yin na bod nang la yod bsdad pa'i rgya che'i mi mang de dag gis lo gcig song gnyis song gis lo bcu bco lnga nyi shu phyin pa'i rjes la rnam 'gyur gang 'dra zhig bstan grab yod med de yang stod mi thig pa red/ deng sang gi dus tshod gnam gshis ltar 'gyur ba 'gro ba'i mtshams shig la slebs bsdad yod dus nga tshos do snang chen po byed kyi yod la/ mi mang tsho yin na'ang gnas tshul shes dgos pa red/ gang ltar dus tshod gnyan 'phrang 576

dang / 'gag 'dra po zhig gi sgang la slebs yod pas nga rang tsho bod mi nang khul du chos lugs dang / lung tshan gyi 'then 'khyer med par tshang mas 'cham po byas/ dog la bsgril po byas nas sdod rgyu gcig dang / gnyis nas nga rang tsho btsan byol bar bod gzhung zer mkhan gyi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa yin dus sgrig 'dzugs de la yid ches byed rgyu gal chen po red/ bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'di nga tsho mi kha shas shig 'byon drags pa dang / rgod drags nas glo bur du gsar du chags pa zhig ma red/ de snga bod nang bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa dang / twa la'i bla ma zer ba'i ming de'i thog nas rgya gar la rang bzhin gyi bod gzhung gi rnam pa zhig dngos su chags pa red/ rgyal khab su gcig gis khas len med na yang / don gyis bod pa'i gzhung zhig yin pa'i nus pa tshang bsdad mkhan zhig chags yod/ da lta sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'dis nga tshor phan thogs yod pa zhig dang / gal chen po zhig chags bsdad yod pa red/ rgya gar gzhung gis kyang sku ngas grags khrims jogeg nas ngos len byas pa'i gzhung ma red de/ yin na'ang bod pa spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs shig la ngos 'dzin dang / cha 'jog yode dang yod mus red/ da dung yin na'ang rgya gar gzhung gis mtshon pa'i gzhan dag bod par do snang byed mkhan tshos nang ltar du sgrig 'dzugs dang gzhung gi rnam pa 'dra po zhig la ngos 'dzin cha 'jog yod pa 'di ma brlag pa byed rgyu gcig dang / de'i nus pa da dung shugs che ru ma phyin na yang sdug tu ma 'gro ba zhig byed rgyu gal chen po red/ de la ga re byed dgos zer na/ mi mang gis mgo ma 'tshos kyi skad cha'i rjes su 'brangs nas bod 577

gzhung la cho yod pa ma red zer ba 'dra po bshad pa yin nasag po ma red/ da lta'i gnas skabs la bod gzhung ngas 'go 'khrid nas bsdad yod pa red/ da lta bod gzhung gi bka' blon mi kha shas shigayod pa de tsho ngas brgya cha brgya tham pa blos 'khel nas bzhag pa yin ma gtogs/ nga la 'dod pa med bzhin du btsugs pa'i mi gcig kyang med/ bka' blon ngo yod de tsho ngas dog sgrub rgyab nas btsugs pa yin/ gal srid da lta'i bka' blon tshos 'grigs kyi med na ngas ma 'grigs pa red/ da lta bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs yod pa 'dis dngos gnas drang gnas khyed rang tsho'i 'dod pa ma khengs pa zhig dang / 'grigs kyi med pa zhig 'dug na rgyal ba rin po che dgongs pa zhus zer rgyu de red ma gtogs/ gzhan dag skad cha rnyag ge rnyog ge shod rgyu bsdad yod pa ma red/rgyal ba rin po ches 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces khyed rang tshos lab pa yin na 'grigs pa red/ ngas dgongs pa zhus chog skad cha mang po gangasang med/'dum bde po red/ da lta'i bod gzhung la spyi mos yod pa dang / nga la rgyal ba rin po che'i ming zhig yod pa'i gnas tshul gyi cha nas ngas da lta las ka byed kyi yod pa ma gtogs/ nga ma shi bar du bod gzhung gi 'go 'khrid dgos don rtsab nyid nasayod pa ma red/ nga rang gis gtsodathub thub byed 'dod yod pa dang / byed rgyu'i go skabs yod pa'i ring der ngas byed kyi red/ ran po med pa zhig dang / nga rang ngos nas brgya cha brgyawarmi par byed 'dod med pa/byas nas phan thogs med pa'i gnas tshul mthong song na ngas de'i nyin mo der las ka bzhag gi red/ mi 'byon wakhe ngan mkhan yong gi red/ mi rgod po thon 578

mkhan yong gi red/ de'i thog la bsod nams yod pa zhig dgos kyi red/'byon po sgod po bsod nams yod mkhan gyi mi zhig byung song na bod gzhung gi las ka byed rgyu sgo phye phye pa rang red ma gtogs/ de la khyi kha rus bzung byas te sgo bkag mkhan su gcig yong gi ma red la/ nga'i ngos nas brgya cha brgya tham pa med/ da lta rgyal ba rin po cher yid ches yod na ngas btsugs pa'i bod gzhung de la yid ches dgos pa zhig red/ bar lam lhag bsam yin rung min rung / don ma go dang / gang ltar byed thabs ma mkhas pa'i thog nas skad cha mang po lhags byung / rda ram sa la'i gzhung gis yag po byed kyi mi 'dugabyas yod pa ma red ces don dag med pa'i skad cha mang po lhags byung / dngos gnas drang gnas nga rang tsho'i 'dod pa khengs pa zhig 'grub yod pa ma red/ ma 'grub thag chod red/ byed ma thub pa red ma gtogs/ thub bzhin du'am/ 'grub nus bzhin du ma byas pa rtsa ba nyid nas ma red/ bar lam skad cha mang po byung ba'i skor la bod gzhung rgyun las kyi thog nas gsal bsgrags kyi yi ge bkrams yode/ gsal bsgrags kyiyi ge de la ngas tshig gcig dang gnyis kyis zhib 'jug byas/ snon 'khri byed dgos pa byas te nga'i lag bstar ma'i bzo bcos brgyabs te gtan la phab pa'i yi ge yin/ nga la yid ches yod na bod gzhung rgyun las kyi thog nas gsal bsgrags byas pa'i yi ge de la khyed rang tshos brgya cha brgya tham pa yid ches byed dgos pa zhig red/ bod gzhung rgyun las nas gsal bsgrags byas pa'i yi ge de la khyed rang tsho yid ches med na/ nga la yid ches ma byas na 'grigs kyi red/ shes song ngam/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes stsal// //579

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1977 zla 8 tshes 2 nyin ko li gar don ldan gling gzhis sgar du ser skya mi mang yongs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/da ring gzhis chags 'dir 'byor ba dang po red/ de'i sar khyed rang tsho tshang mas dga' wa'i thog nas dga' bsu zhu rgyu dang / khyed rang tsho rgan gzhon mang po zhig gis da lta ched du 'khrab ston byas par dga' po byung / tshang mar thugs rje che zhes zhu gi yod/gzhis chags 'dir rang bzhin gyi sa chasag po yod pa'i thog la rogs ram mthun rkyen yag po yod pa yin dus thog mar 'go tshugs pa'i skabs nas yin mdog kha po chags 'dug da lta mdzad sgo'i sa la khyed rang tsho phru gu 'khrab ston byed mkhan tshang ma grung tog tog yin mdog kha po 'dug dga' po byung /de bzhin lus rtsal gyi sgrig 'dzugs bzos sbyong bdar sprad de da gin ru sgrig byed mkhan pho mo tsho yang yin mdog kha wa'i sgrig 'dzugs dang ldan pa der dga' po byung / lus po bde thang yong thabs su lus po'i rtsal shugs sbyong rgyu des so so sger gyi mi tshe ring po yong ba dang / mi tshe de'i ring gzugs po bde yi thog nas so so sger gyi chos dang 'jig rten gyi las ka gang 'dra zhig yin kyang ci bder byed thub pa dang / gnyis nas rang gi mi rigs kyi don du skabs su babs pa'i las 'gan ga 'dra zhig sgrub dgos byung yang gzugs po bde thang yod na so so'i 'dod pa ltar sgrub thub rgyu yin dus gzugs po bde thang zer ba de ha cang gi gal chen po red/ dmigs bsal gyis lus po'i rtsal sbyong gi thog tu khyed rang tshos rgyun du do snang byas te/ da res nga yong ba'i skabs 580

la 'dra chags po yong ba'i ched tsam ma yin par dus rgyun gtan nas do snang dang mu mthud nas lus po bde thang yong thabs su rtsal sbyong bya rgyu ha cang gal chen po 'dug de ring khyed rang tshos rtsal sbyong byas pa der dga' po byung / phyin chad kyang yag po 'byung thub pa'i re ba yod/de nas da lta 'dir yul pa'i gzhas sna 'khrab ston bya rgyu'i nang gzhis sgar 'dir yod pa'i nga rang tsho bod chol kha yas mas tshang ma'i lung tshomakhag mang po zhig nas rang rang so so'i lung pa'i yul gzhas 'khrab pa der ha cang dga' po byung / nga rang tsho'i bod lung pa zer ba de dngos gnas drang gnas kyi lung pa chen po zhig yin pa dang / de'i nang du mi'i 'tsho ba spyod stangs/ to chas za stangs/ gzhas dang zhabs bros mtshon pas spyir btang gi mi chos yong stangs de tsho'i gras la khyad par phran bu phran bu yod pa red/ de ltar phran bu phran bu'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba yod pa thams cad gcig tu bsgril dus bod rgyal khab ces pa de'i khongs su sle bas bsdad yod pa red/ nga rang tsho bod pa tshang ma de'i thog tu gcig gyur chags bsdad yod/ nga rang mo+othams cad bod rigs rtsam zan gcig gyur yin pa'i rtags mtshan gsal po yod/ nga rang tsho bod chol kha gsum po yongs su rdzogs pa gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa des 'das pa'i lo rgyus thog la yin na'ang byas rjes chen po bzhag yod la/ da lta'i dus stod la yang byas rjes bzhag dang zhog mus red/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus tshod la yin kyang nga rang tsho gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa des byas rjes chen po zhig bzhag thub kyi red bsam pa'i nga la yid ches yod/ de gang 'dra yin zer na/ 'das 581

pa'i lo rgyus nang bod rgyal khab kyi chab srid kha bral du phyin/ sil bu dang / dum bur phyin pas rkyen gyis 'thus shor chen po phyin yod na yang / rtsa ba bod mi rigs gcig gyur yin pa'i rtsa don ma brlag par nga rang tshos dam 'dzin thub pa'i rkyen gyis lo stong phrag gi ring la bod mi rigs chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa'i thog nas bod lung pa'i nang la gtso che shos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos sngar med gsar du btod pa de dag mi nyams rgyun 'dzin gong nas gong mthor spel thub pa zhig byung yod/ de bzhin bod mi rigs spyi'i lag rtsal gyi thog nas e yin/ bod mi rigs spyi'i shes yon gyi thog nasalge yin/gzhi rtsa mang po zhig gi nang nga rang tsho chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i thog nas dngos gnas drang gnas kyi byas rjes chen po bzhag yod bsam pa dran gyi 'dug srid don gyi 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs shig byung nas bod sil bur 'gro ba'i gnas tshul zhig byung yod na yang / rtsa ba'i gcig gyur gyi nus pa des bod mi rigs ma brlag pa zhig dang / rgya gar gyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos blangs pa dang chabs cig rgya gar gyi shes rig mang po zhig bod la slebs yod pa red/rgya nag dang bod kyi chos rgyal tsho gnyen sgrig byas te rgya nag nas kyang shes rig mang po zhig bod la blangasaspend/ g.yas g.yon nas chos dang shes rig gi legs cha mang po blangs pa gang zhig la rtsa ba mi rigs rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa ma nyams par nga tshos lo brgya phrag mang po'i ring la zin te bsdad yod pa red/ de 'dra'i bod mi rigs de shar phyogs rgya nag rgyal khab dang / sgo phyogs rgya gar rgyal khab dang mi 'dra ba khungs ldan gyi bod mi rigs rang nyid 582

rang tshugs bzungs nas bsdad thub pa de yang nga rang tsho chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa des byas rjes chen po bzhag yod pa red bsam gyi 'dugad lta'i gnas skabs la cha mtshon na yang rgya mi'i dbang bsgyur bod la slebs nas dus da lta bar du rgya mi kho rang tsho'i 'dod pa khengs pa'i dbang sgyur byed mi thub pa dang / to chas kha la zas/ mid 'khyur btang rung 'ju ma thub par bsdad pa 'di'i thog la bod chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa 'dis byas rjes da lta bzhag bzhin pa yin pa la the tshom yod pa ma red/ dbus gtsang khul la yin na'ang rung / khams khul la yin na'ang rung / a mdo khul la yin na'ang rung / gang ltar sa khul de dag gi bod mi rigs mchis so cog tshang mas phyi rgyal gyi btsan dbang dang / dbang shugs de la ma dga' ba byas te ngo grol gyi rnam pa de gzhan dag gis bskul ba la ma ltos par rang rang yul tsho so so'i nang nas rang mos dang blangs kyis ngo rgol byed pa'i sems shugs kyi me lce chen po zhig 'bar bzhin pa de'i rkyen gyis da dung yin na yang rgya nag gi thog la mi bde ba yod pa zhi ga dang / da dung yin na'ang bod don de thag chod byung med pa'i rtsa don zhig tu lhag bsdad pa 'di yang bod chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa'i byas rjes shig yin pa la yid ches skusted/ ma 'ongs par cha bzhag na yang / nga rang tsho bod de 'dzam bu gling 'di'i mi gral du tshud pa zhig dang / de'i thog la rang rang so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la ngoms chog pa zhig dang / 'dzam bu gling gzhan dag la bstan chog pa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i mi rigs shig yong thub par nga tshos 583

re ba rgyag gi yod la/ 'bad rtsol yang byed kyi yod pa red/ ma 'ongs par nga tshos byas rjes bzhag rgyu'i gzhi rtsa de nga rang tsho tshang ma gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa de la rag lus pa red/ ma 'ongs par bod spyi'i bde skyid de ga 'dra chags dang mi chags/ bsam blo nang bzhin 'grub dang mi 'grub zer ba de bod chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i gong bu'i nus pa de ji srid gnas pa'i ring la nga rang tsho'i don dag rgyal kha che tsam 'grub rgyu zhig dang / chig sgril gyi nus pa de nyams pa yin na nga tsho spyi pa'i don dag de nyams rgud 'gro rgyu yin par 'brel ba chen po yod pa zhig red/ de 'dra yin tsang de ring 'dir nga rang sbyo chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i rnam 'gyur gsal por thon pa 'di la nga rang yang sems dga' po byung / khyed rang tshor dmigs bsal thugs rje che zhe zhu rgyu yin/da lta 'dir gzhas sna mnyam du 'khrab pa tsam ma yin par ngas rtag tu snga rjes mang po lab pa bzhin/ chol kha'i thog nas 'then 'khyer byed mi rung /bar lam gnas tshul ngo ma shes rtogs yong ba'i skabs la yid ches je che dang /nges pa je rnyed du phyin te bzang du bzang du 'gro gi yod pa la dga' po byung / da dung yin na'ang chol kha'i 'then 'khyer rigs rtsa ba nas med pa yag po zhig yong thub par tshang mas 'bad rtsol byed dgos kyi 'dug de dang chabs cig chos kyi ming gi cha nas 'dra min yong gi yod na yang / don ngo ma'i thog la rnam 'dren shakyu thub pa gcig gi rjes 'brangs/ mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi chos tshul/ tshe gcig la zung 'jug gi go 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs tshul ma nor 584

ba sha stag yin dus/ nga rang tshos che sa dang / gting zab sa gcig nas bsam blo btang ste phran bu mi mthun pa dang / tshig gis bed spyod byed stangs 'dra mi 'dra/ sgom sgrub kyi nyams len byed stangs 'dra mi 'dra rgyu mtshan du byas te phyi nang thug pa lta bu'i bsam tshul gtan nas med pa byed dgos/ nga rang tsho tshang ma stone pa gcig gi rjes 'brangs/ chos pa gcig gyurayin pa'i ngos 'dzin gsal po byas pa'i thog nas phan tshun ris su ma chad par dad pa dag snang bya gal chen po red/ da lta 'dir yag thag chod yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dugad dung yang yag po yong ba'i 'bad rtsol bya rgyu gal chen po red/ de nas chos dang 'brel ba'i gnas tshul ngas dran jog 'dir zhus na/da lta 'dir sdod sgar 'go tshugs tsam red/ dgon pa rgyag rgyu'i 'dod pa yod pa'i skad cha phran bu yong gi yod pa red de/ yin na yang sngon la mi mang gi gzhis chags sra thag thag bya rgyu de rim pa dang por bzhag mi mang rang kha rang gso'i 'char gzhi de tsho tshags su tshud pa zhig byung ba'i mtshams su gzhi nas rang rang so so'i dad mos dang / gtso che shos dad mos gcig pus ma phan par rgyu shugs la rag lus kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas 'grub tshod dpag tshod cig ga ler ga ler bsam blo gtang chog gi red/ da lta gzhis chags kyi rtsa ba'i las ka tshags tshud mjug bsgril ma byung gong du/ dgon pa gra tshang gi zhen gogayin pa'i khul byas te mang po rgyag rgyu de'ang nga tshor sdod sgar gzhan dag gi thog nas nyams myong mang po byung yod/ de skor kha sngon nang srid bka' blon yong skabs la skad cha zhib phra byung yod pa red/ gang ltar lha khang dang /585

dgon pa bzhengs rgyu de brel ba ma byas par ga ler ga ler byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi'i rim pa de 'dra red/ rim pas yag po yong thub kyi red/ sa gnas 'di'i sgang la snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rdzogs chen dgon pa yag po zhig chags thub rogs byas na snyam pa nga rang sger gyi re 'dun de 'dra zhig yod/yang dgon pa rgyag 'dod yod mkhan tshos sbug srub dog po'i bsam blo btang ste sa cha gcig ma gtogs ma mthong bar sdod rgyu mi 'dug nga rang tshor rgya gar nang la sdod sgar mang po zhig yod pa red/ sdod sgar re re'i nang du dgon pa dang / bla gra khag ga 'dra ga 'dra yod med de dag la bsam blo btang nas sdod sgar spyi yongs kyi thog nas cha snyoms 'gro thub pa zhig bsam blo gtong dgos pa ma gtogs/ sdod sgar gcig pu de'i ngo gdong gi gnas tshul ma gtogs gzhan dag ma mthong bar gcig pu der tshang ga rgyag mkhan lta bu byas na dgos pa mi 'dug gang ltar dgon gnas yod pa de dpal 'byor gyi thog nasayin na'ang rung / bslab pa slob gnyer gyi thog nasayin na'ang rung / sgom sgrub nyams len gyi thog nas yin na'ang rung / gang ltar chos dad yod mkhan tsho skyabs su mchi 'os pa zhig dang / skyabs gnas dkon mchog gi gras su tshad longs par slebs thub pa zhig yin gcig min gcig bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug da lta chos kyi thog nas 'phros pa'i gnas tshul de yin/ ༄ ༄nan da lta ngas lab pa nang bzhin bod chol kha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa de 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gang gi gnas skabs la yang gal chen po zhig chags nas bsdad yod pa yin dus tshang mas sngar bzhin 586

sems la rgyun bcangs byed dgos/de nas da lta 'di ga'i sdod sgar gyi gnas tshul stor la tshig kha shas shig bshad na/ nga rang gzhis sgar 'di'i nang slebs pa da res dang po red/ 'go stod gzhis sgar tshugs tsam gyi skabs su dpal 'byor bka' blon tshar gcig slebs te skabs de'i gnas tshul de tsho skad cha zhib phra byung / de mjug nang srid bka' blon thengs gcig gnyis shig slebs pa red/ de thog nas kyang gnas tshul zhib phra shes rtogs byung / de bzhin tshogs gtsos mtshon pas spyi 'thus khag gis lta skor byas pa dang / dus rgyun gtan nas las khungs brgyud gnas tshul snyan seng yong gi yod pa yin dus/ nga rang sa cha'i sgang la dngos su slebs pa da res dang po red de/ gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul rgyus yod pa lta bu red/ da ring 'di gar nga rang dngos su slebs te so so'i mig gis mthong thub pa'i skabs la rna bar gnas tshul thos pa bzhin gra 'grigs po dang / yag po zhig yod pa yin dus dga' po byung / spyir btang gzhis chags sogs las ka ga 'dra zhig gi thog la yin na yang / thog mar gzhi med pa gcig gsar du btsugs nas las ka byed dgos dus dka' ngal mang tsam zhig tan tan yod red/ 'on kyang da lta 'dir gzhis sgar gzhan dag gi nyams myong dang / de bzhin rogs ram tshogs pa'i las ka byed mkhan tsho yin na yang sa gnas gzhan dag gi nyams myong bsags tshar ba yin tsang de lta'i nyams myong sngon song de dang /mthun rkyen sa cha 11gas gang ci nas sa khul gzhan dag gi gzhis chags ces dang mi 'dra bar ga re byas kyang gra 'grigs pa zhig chags bsdad yod pa red/ yin 587

na yang 'go 'dzugs skabs la dka' ngal phran bu yong rgyu yin dus dka' ngal de tshor gdong len byed dgos/ dka' ngal la bzod bsran byas na rim pas rim pas lo gcig song gnyis song mtshams su sngon ma dka' las khag po byung ste da cha yag po byung zhes tshang mas blo bde bde byed rgyu zhig dang / bag phebs po dang / skyid po zhig tan tan yong thub kyi red/ de 'dra yin dus khyed rang tsho tshang ma sems bag phebs po byas/ bod lung par log rgyu ma byung bar du sa cha 'dir bsdad de so so'i to gos thog la lta rgyu yod pa zhig dang / bod mi rigs spyi'i zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu'i thog la lta rgyu yod pa zhig sa cha 'di'i sgang nas sgrub bsam pa zhig byed dathoges/ dka' ngal sel thabs su sa cha 'di nas sa cha gzhan dag la byol bskyod byas pas dka' ngal sel thub pa yong gi ma red/yang dka' ngal gsar pa zhig 'phrad de dka' ngal gsar pa de sel ba'i 'bad rtsol byed dgos pa zhig chags na nyis las red/ de las dka' ngal 'phrad nayang sa cha 'di ga'i sgang la bsdad de dka' ngal sel thabs kyi bsam blo btang na yag gi red/ dang po 'go 'dzugs skabs la nges par dka' ngal yong rgyu yin dus dka' ngal la bzod bsran gyi thog nas da lta'i bar du hur thag byas 'dug la/ da dung yang hur thag byed rogs zer rgyu yin/de nas slob sbyong skor la phru gu tshor rogs ram tshogs pa'i thog nas dmigs bsal do snang byas te slob sbyong gi gzhi rtsa tshugs yod pa red/ gzhi rtsa tshugs bsdad pa 'di dngos gnas gdengs 'khel ba'i yag po yong thabs su shes yon gyi thog la 'brel yod tshang mas nges par do snang byed kyi red/ gtso 588

che shos nang khyim so so'i pha ma dang / spun nye'i thog nas rang gi bu phrug la slob sbyong yag po yong thub thabs su dmigs bsal gyi do snang dang / sems khur nges par du len dgos kyi 'dug de bzhin pho gsar mo gsar gzhon skyes tsho yin na'ang rung / spyir btang rgan pa'i nang la yin na'ang slob gra'i 'dzin gra 'grim nas shes yon slob sbyong bya rgyu da cha lo na chod yol te yong thub pa ma byung rung / shes yon zer ba de spyir btang mi zhig yin phyin chad la dgos pa zhig dang / lhag par nga tsho bod mi rigs rnams deng sang dka' sdug gi 'phrang chen po cig 'grim pa'i skabs yin pas nges par so so'i shes yon gyi thog la do snang chen po byed dgos/ bod yigaye shes mi shes lta rgyu dang / mtha' ma bod yig 'bri klog ma shes na yang spyir btang gi gnas tshul do snang byas te shes mkhan gyi sa nas 'grel bshad nyan rgyu dang / gsar 'gyur tshags par khagade bzhin nga tsho'i tshogs 'du yas mas la skad cha go bsdur byung ba de tsho dang /gros chod bzhag pa/ gzhen bskul yod pa de tsho'i gras nges par du shes thabs byed dgos/ nga rang tsho 'dir btsan po byas te slob sbyong bskul mkhan yong gi ma red la de 'dra byed dgos don med na yang / rtsa ba shes bya yon tan zer ba de gal chen po zhig yin pa dang / des rang gi to gos kyi don dag dang /rang gi tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i khe phan sgrub pa'i bsam blo yar rgyas 'gro ba'i don dag la phan thogs yod pa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin thub pa'i sgo nas slob sbyong la do snang byas/ shes bya yonatan gyi thog nas bsam blo gsar pa 'khor thabs dang / gnas tshul mang tsam shes pa'i don du rgan gzhon tshang mas nges par 589

du do snang yag po byed dgos/ bod yig thog la rang rang so so nus pa bton thub pa 'dug na ni lhag par du nus pa bton/ de mtshungs khyed rang tsho shes pa tshos ma shes pa tshor 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu dang / slob ston byed rgyu gang yong ci yong byas te/ rdo don yang snying sdod sgar gcig gi nang yod pa dang / mi rigs gcig gyur yin dus gcig gis gcig la nang khyim gcig pa'i 'du shes bzhag ste par rogs tshur rogs byed kyiyin na nga rang tsho'i las ka tshags tshud pa dang / don dag 'grub pa zhig yong gi red/ de tshang ma'i sems la 'jog rogs zer rgyu yin/de nas nga tsho 'phrod bsten skor shin tu gal chen po 'dug ngas da gin lab pa nang bzhin phyogs gcig nas gzugs wa'i brdabs gsigs dang / sbyong bdar gyi sgo nas lus po bde thang yong ba'i thabs shes gcig dang / sman bcos 'phrod bsten zer ba de nad na tsha chen po zhig byung tshar te 'a 'ub ma 'dus pa'i mtshams la gzhi nasa.em rje dran pa'i bzo 'dra po nga rang cho gangad pa'i nang la mang po yong gi 'dug mgo phran bu na ba dang / grod khog bshal ba lta bu phran bu bde min byung skabs lam senga.em rje bsten rgyu de gal chen po 'dug na tsha thog mar yong pa'i skabs nas lam seng tod yang ma btang b.ra.em rje'i sar phyin/ brtag dpyad byed kyi yin na sman thun kha shas zas te drag thub pa'i nad gzhi de lam seng sman bcos byed ma thub par dus 'gyangs phyin na zla ba sbrel nas sman khang du sdod dgos pa 'dra po/ sdug shos byung na tshe srog mthar ma phyin par dus min 'chi rkyen la 'gro ba yong gi yod pa red/ dus rgyun nas 590

lus por bdag gces bya rgyu dang / na tsha chung chung skabs la lam seng sman bcos bya rgyu gal chen po red/ de tshang mas sems la zhog shes song ngam/dus rgyun gtan nas lto chas kyi thog 'phrod bsten la do snang chen po byed dgos/ bod la yin na sa gtsang ma/ mtho po/ sa skam po/ bsil po yin dus lto chas lam seng rnying rul 'gro rgyu med na yang / bod dang 'di khul gtan nas 'dra gi ma red/ ma gzhi sngon ma nas gzhis 'go khag dang / spyi 'thus dril bsgrags yong mkhan tsho'i thog nas skad cha lan mang byung tshar ba red/'phrod bsten byed rgyu dang / na tsha yong grabs byed pa'i skabs la lam seng sman bcos bya rgyu de khyed rang tshos sems la bcang ste gzab gzab byed rogs/ nad pa nyam thag de 'dra thugaspedang dus ga re byed dgos bsam pa'i sems la ma bzod pa chen po yong gi 'dug ste/ byed thabs ni gang yang mi 'dug dngos su nad na tsha dza drag po zhig gis zin tshar dus smon lam 'dra rgyag rgyu ma gtogs bya thabs gang yang mi 'dug de 'dra ma yong gong du dang po nas sngon 'gog bya rgyu gal chen po red/ nad na tsha sngon 'gog byed pa'i don du khyed rang tsho mi re ngo re'i cha nas dmigs bsal gyi do snang bya rgyu dang / 'go byed mkhan tshos gzhen bskul bya rgyu ltod yangs ma shor ba bya dgos/nga rang tsho mi'i lung par slebs te 'gro stangs gsar pa zhig gi sgang la slebs yod pa red/ de bzhin nga rang tsho rang mgo gang thon tsam byas te sdod rgyu nga rang tsho'i dmigs yul ma red/ nga tsho btsan byol ba byas nas bsdad pa'i ring la mi'i lung par so so'i lto gos so sos mgo thon pa'i las 'gan sgrub 591

pa dang chabs cig rtsa ba nga rang tsho rang gi lung par skyar du log rgyu'i dmigs yul bzhag nas de thog tshang mas las ka byas dang byed mus red/ nga rang tsho'i rtsa ba'i don dag 'grub rgyu la phyi dang / nang gi rkyen mang po zhig 'phrad pa'i sgo nas smin dgos kyi red la/ rkyen 'phrad pa'i go skabs nges par du yong gi red/ nga rang tshos yid ches byed chog pa red/ nga rang tsho'i gnas stangs de phyogs gcig nas nga tsho btsan byol ba byas nas bsdad pa'i skabs yin dus rang kha rang gso'i gdengs 'khel yong ba zhig dang / phyogs gcig nas bod spyi pa'i don dag la nga chos da lta 'thab rtsod byas dang byed mus kyi don dag 'grub rgyu bsdad yod pa yin dus gnas tshul de gnyis kyi 'og nas nga rang tsho rang mgo gang thon dang / nus pa kha 'thor du ma song ba byas te/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog tu gnas rgyu bang / sgrig 'dzugs de tshags su tshud pa dgos rgyu zer ba de ha cang gal chen po red/ da lta nga tsho sgrig 'dzugs shig chags te bsdad yod pa 'dir gtso che shos bod mis yid ches dang / bod mis cha 'jog yod phyin chad la 'grigs pa red/ da lta nga rang tsho btsan byol ba tsam ma tshad/ bod nang la yin na'ang rgya gar dha ram sa la zhes rna bar thos rgyu yod bsdad pa zhig dang / de la spyir btang bod rang btsan gyi don la las 'gul byed mkhan gyi bsti gnas shig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ spyi pa'i don la las ka byed mkhan gyi sgrig 'dzugs de 'dra zhig yod pa de nus pa che ru 'gro ba dang /tshags tshud du 'gro ba'i thog la tshang mas sems khur len dgos/ de yang nga tsho'i las ka nor 'khrul zhig yod pa yin na yang bzhag dgos zer ba de 'dra 592

pa dang chabs cig rtsa ba nga rang tsho rang gi lung par skyar du log rgyu'i dmigs yul bzhag nas de thog tshang mas las ka byas dang byed mus red/ nga rang tsho'i rtsa ba'i don dag 'grub rgyu la phyi dang / nang gi rkyen mang po zhig 'phrad pa'i sgo nas smin dgos kyi red la/ rkyen 'phrad pa'i go skabs nges par du yong gi red/ nga rang tshos yid ches byed chog pa red/ nga rang tsho'i gnas stangs de phyogs gcig nas nga tsho btsan byol ba byas nas bsdad pa'i skabs yin dus rang kha rang gso'i gdengs 'khel yong ba zhig dang / phyogs gcig nas bod spyi pa'i don dag la nga chos da lta 'thab rtsod byas dang byed mus kyi don dag 'grub rgyu bsdad yod pa yin dus gnas tshul de gnyis kyi 'og nas nga rang tsho rang mgo gang thon dang / nus pa kha 'thor du ma song ba byas te/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog tu gnas rgyu bang / sgrig 'dzugs de tshags su tshud pa dgos rgyu zer ba de ha cang gal chen po red/ da lta nga tsho sgrig 'dzugs shig chags te bsdad yod pa 'dir gtso che shos bod mis yid ches dang / bod mis cha 'jog yod phyin chad la 'grigs pa red/ da lta nga rang tsho btsan byol ba tsam ma tshad/ bod nang la yin na'ang rgya gar dha ram sa la zhes rna bar thos rgyu yod bsdad pa zhig dang / de la spyir btang bod rang btsan gyi don la las 'gul byed mkhan gyi bsti gnas shig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ spyi pa'i don la las ka byed mkhan gyi sgrig 'dzugs de 'dra zhig yod pa de nus pa che ru 'gro ba dang /tshags tshud du 'gro ba'i thog la tshang mas sems khur len dgos/ de yang nga tsho'i las ka nor 'khrul zhig yod pa yin na yang bzhag dgos zer ba de 'dra 592

ma red/ rtsa ba bod spyi pa'i don dag la rang tshos re ba rgyag pa nang bzhin sgrub thub mkhan gyi sgrig 'dzugs shig nga tshor dgos kyi yod pa red/ sgrig 'dzugs de'i thog nas 'grub thub dang ma thub zer ba de mi la rag lus pa red/ nga rang mo btsan byol ba'i khrod nas chol kha dang / chos lugs dbye ba med pa'i thog nas 'brel ba yod pa dang / rgyus skusgod pa'i khrod nas mi gdam gdam sgrug sgrug byas nas btsugs skusgod pa red/ yin na yang nga rang tsho mi tha mal pa'i blo gros kyis ma ldeng pa dang / lhag par shes bya yon tan gyi tshad ma longs pa'i dka' ngal tan tan yong gi red/ nor ba 'khrul pa yang yong srid kyi red/ de 'dra'i nor ba 'khrul pa mi yong ba'i ched du da lta phan nga tsho btsan byol ba chags nas lo bco brgyad tsam de'i ring la lan dgu chad mthud kyi thabs shes tshad tshad bsdur bsdur sgo mang po nas rab dang rim pa byas pa red/ las don sgrub mkhan tshags tshud po zhig dang / 'dod pa yod pa nang bzhin byed thub pa'i sgrig 'dzugs yong ba'i don du nga'i ngos nas da dung yang tshad tshad bsdur bsdur sgo kun nas byed kyi red/ sa gan/sa mi mang dang / bod mi mang gi khesad nas legs spel nyes 'gog gi bsam 'char gang 'dra zhig shod rgyu yod kyang / der nga tshos dga' bsu zhu gi yin/ nges par bsam 'char shod dgos pa zhig red/bsam 'char shod rgyu'i rnam pa de nga tsho'i las ka gzhi rtsa yod bsdad pa de tshags su tshud po yong ba/ shugs nus gong mthor gtong rgyu'i don du red ma gtogs gtor bshig gtong rgyu dang / dkrog rkyen bzo rgyu'i don du ma song ba zhig dgos pa red/ de 'dra yin dus nges par du bsam 'char ji 'dra zhig yod kyang shod 593

dgos/ gzhi nas bsam 'char de yang go bsdur yag po byas nas shod dgos pa dang / bsam 'char shod sa'i go skabs yod sa der ngo kog med pa dang /mdzes zol med pa'i thog nas shod rgyu yod pa zhig dgos pa ma gtogs/ phan med gnod 'gal dkrog rkyen 'gro gzhi'i thog la phyin pa yin na/ kun slong dge ba yin na yang / rjodar ba ma dag pas rkyen gyis phan las gnod 'tshe che ba'i blo chung phan btags kyi byed stangs la 'gro srid kyi red/ bar lam de'adra phran bu phran bu yong gi 'dug de 'drar ma song ba zhig nges par du dgos kyi red/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs de da dung tshags su tshud pa dang / sdig po yong ba'i don du nga rang tsho tshang mas 'bad rtsol byed pa dang / sems shugs 'khyer dgos pa zhig red/bye brag tu dzod sgar gcig gi nang la'ang 'go 'dzin dang bcas sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa red/ sgrig 'dzugs 'di tsho rtsa ba chen po red/ nga rang tsho 'dir mi rigs gcig gyur spyi tshogs kyi mi sde'i sgrig 'dzugs shig chags nas yong dus mi sger so so dang khyim tshang sger so sos 'grub ma thub pa dang /sel ma thub pa'i dka' ngal mang po dang / gnad don mang po zhig gong bu'i nus pa bsgril ba'i sgrig 'dzugs nas sgrub thub pa dang / sel thub pa tan tan yong gi red/ de 'dra yin dus sger so so'i khe phan gyi cha nas yin na yang sdod sgar mi re ngo re'i sgrig 'dzugs de ha cang gal chen po red/ gnyis nas bod spyi ba'i don dag dang 'brel ba'i cha nas yin na yang spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzug sa de ha cang gal chen po red/ der brten sa gnas so so'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi rim 594

pa yod pa 'di tsho spyi pa'i don du thug pa dang / sdod sgar spyi pa de ga'i khe phan don du thug pa zhig yin dus de la tshang mas brtsi bkur dang sha tsha rgyab skyor bya rgyu gal chen po red/ spyi pa'i 'go 'dzin gyi sgog nas las ka byed stangs ma 'grigs pa dang / ma shes pa/ nor ba 'khrul pa byung ba'i rigs dus dus la brgya dpon tsho yin na'ang rung / 'go byed hrag bsdus rgyas bsdus ga 'dra zhig byas kyang skabs dang sbyar ba'i tshogs 'du 'dra tshogs/ de 'dra'i sa la legs spel nyes 'gog dge 'don skyon sel gyi bsam 'char ga 'dra zhig yin kyang bshad chog gi red la/ go bsdur byas chog gi red/ go bsdur byas/ sbyang bshad btang ste gtan 'khel ba'i mtshams su sgrig 'dzugs nang skad cha gcig bshad/ rgyab la skad cha gzhan gcig bshad pa de 'dra min par tshang mas nga rang tsho bod spyi pa'i don la bsam blo gtong gi yod pa dang / spyi pa'i don dag sgrub kyi yod pa de la ngo kog byed dgos don yod pa ma red/ de la rgyab mdun byed dgos don yod pa ma red/ sgrig 'dzugs zer ba 'di spyi dang sger gnyis ga'i khe phan la thug bsdad pa zhig yin dus de'i dgos pa dge mtshan de ngos 'dzin gsal po byed dgos pa dang / ngos 'dzin byas pa'i thog nas de la brtsi bkur byed rgyu dang / rgyab skyor byed rgyu gal chen po 'dugade nas da lta nga rang tsho bod mi gzhis chags kyi sa cha dang / sa 'dres rgya gar grong gseb pa g.yas g.yon du yod pa tshor rtag tu 'brel ba bzang po bya rgyu gal chen po red/ yul chu btung nas yul khrims 'khur zhes pa ltar/sa gnas gang du yin kyang sa gnas yul pa dang 'brel ba yag po byed dgos/595

da phan gzhis chags zin pa'i sa gnas phal che bar yul pa dang 'brel ba yag thag chod yod pa red/ sa gnas 'di ga'i thog la yang da phan bsam 'char ring thung sbrang sgra tsam thos rgyu mi 'dug pa yag po red/ da dung yin na yang rgyun du gshibs te bsdad dgos dus gcig byas na de 'dra yong srid kyi red/gal srid nges med phran bu phran bu shod res 'dra byung ba yin na yang lam seng chung thog la sel thabs byed pa ma gtogs/ de 'dras rkyen pa'i phyogs 'then byed pa'i bzo 'dra po byung na yag po yong gi ma red/ yul pa tsho dang mthun lam bya rgyu de nga rang tso'i rtsa don zhig yin pas yag po sems la nges pa byas/hur thag byed rogs zer rgyu de yin/rtsa ba bod spyi pa'i don dag la da gin lab pa bzhin yid ches chog pa zhig red ces zer don de/ gtso che shos bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang rnams da dung yin na yang dngos gnas sems shugs chen po zhig dang / rgya mis dbang bsgyur byas par ma dga' ba shugs chen po yod pa'i gnas tshul de 'dra zhig 'dreg phyogs gnyis nas rgya nag gi nang la yang mtho rim 'go khrid na nga khul dbang 'dzin thog la 'thab rtsod rgyun ma chad pa yod mus red/da lta'i gnas stangs la bltas na/ rgya nag gi phyi 'brel dang / nang srid kyi srid byus 'khyer stangs de phal cher rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig dang / 'jam po'i thog la phyin mi yong ngam snyam pa'i babs de 'dra chags yong gi 'dug da lta ga 'dra zhig yong grabs yod med thag chod pa'i tshod mi thig pa red/ ci ste nges med rgya nag gi gnas stangs de ha cang gi zhi 'jam dang / rig pa dang 596

ldan pa gcig gi thog la phyin/ phyin pa de yang dus yun gang la gang 'tshams gnas pa 'dra byung ba yin na spyi yongs kyi gnas tshul mang po zhig 'gyur ba 'gro srid kyi red/ da lta'i dus tshod 'gyur ba 'gro bzhin pa'i gnas skabs shig yin dus rgya che'i mi mang tshang mas bod spyi don la dmigs bsal gyi do snang dang / sems khur yag po len dgos/ da lta gzhis spyi'i thog nas bshad pa bzhin/ skabs su babs pa'i nga rang tshos las 'gan sgrub thub pa dang / sgrub 'os pa'i dus tshod cig slebs song na las ka ga 'dra zhig byed dgos na yang /sems thag bcad thub pa'i sems khur rgyun du bya rgyu de ha cang gal chen po red/bod spyi pa'i don dag la ngas zer rgyu de 'dra zhig yin/mtha' don 'dir rogs ram byed mkhan tshos dmigs bsal sha tsha'i thog nas do snang dang / rogs byed kyi yod pa yin dus thugs rje che zhes zer rgyu yin/ ma'e sor mnga' sde'i nang la bod mi stong phrag nyi shu brgal ba zhig la gzhis chags kyi sa cha thob yod/ rtsa ba rgya gar nang sa cha thob rgyu dkon po dang / dka' ngal chen po red/ rgya gar rang gi yul mi'i nang la sa cha ma thob pa'i mi mang po yod/ da gin rang lam khar 'bras zhing nang las ka bya mkhan skyes dman skyo po tsho khag cig 'dug khong tsho sa cha med pa'i mi red zer gyi 'dug 'di khul g.yas g.yon rang la sa cha ma thob pa'i yul mi stong phrag yod lugs da gin rang skad cha byung / de dang de 'dra'i rgya gar yul mi tshor dngos gnas sa cha med pa'i dka' ngal de 'dra zhig gi sgang la yod kyin yod kyin la nga tshor dmigs bsal gyis mthun rkyen dang / dmigs bsal 597

gyis go skabs 'di 'dra gcig thob pa 'di dag rtsa ba chen po ma red dam/ de 'dra yin dus gatho rwang rgya gar gzhung dang / yang sgos sa gnas gzhung gi thog la de ring go skabs 'dir ched du thugs rje che zhu gi yod la/ nga rang tsho tshang mas bka' drin dran dgos pa zhig red/ rgya gar lung pa skyo po dang / dka' ngal sne mang yod pa gcig red de/ yin na yang nga rang tsho bod pa'i jog la dmigs bsal gyi rogs ram dang skyabs 'jug chen po gnang yod/ nga rang tsho tshang mas rgya gar gyi bka' drin dran pa'i thog nas yul mir mthun lamasag po byas/ gzab gzab byed dgos/ nga rang tshor go skabs thob pa 'di chud zos ma phyin par bed spyod yag po zhig byed thub pa byung na bsam pa'i nga'i re ba de 'dra yin/ gzhan dag zer rgyu cang mi 'dug yang dus dus la rda sa nas bka' blon tsho yin na'ang rung / spyi 'thus tsho dus dus la yong gi red/'di ga'i gzhis spyi dang las byed kyang dus dus layarayong g.yod pa red/ rtag tu 'brel ba yod dang yod mus yin dus nga'i ngos nas 'go mang tshang mar gang rgyas pa zhig dang / gang yag pa zhig byung na bsam pa'i sems khur rtag tu bcang mus yin/ nga rang tsho yang yang thug rgyuyong gi yod pa ma red de/ gnas tshul gyi thog nas 'brel ba rtag tu yod pa yin dus khyed rang tshang ma blo bde po byas nas sdod rogs gyis/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes stsal// //598

༄༅// phyi lo 1977 zla 8 tshes 9 nyin/ hon sur rab rgyas gling gi gzhis skar ser skya mi mang yongs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/'dir khyed rang tshor zhu rgyu la/ da lta las bsdoms nang gnas tshul bshad pa nang bzhin red/ na ning dbang 'dud rdo rje 'di gar blta bskor la yong ba'i gnas lugs skad cha zhib phra byung / bar lam than skyon la sogs pas hon sur la dka' las khag shos shig chags te kha shas ha lam za rgyu dkon po'i gnas tshul 'dra po byung ba red/ yin na yang / da lta las bsdoms nang bkod pa bzhin/ dka' ngal sel rgyu'i thabs shes sgo rnam pa mang po zhig gang yong ci yong tshad tshad bsdur bsdur byas dang byed mus red/ lo gcig gnyis nang la than pas rkyen pas dka' ngal byung ba red de/ yin na'ang nga rang tshor sa cha rtsa ba nas med pa dang yod pa byas na/ yod pa de phyags la drin che ba dang /sgrig 'dzugs gcig gi thog la gong bu byas nas bsdad pa de ga re byas kyang khe phan che ba yod pa sngon ma skad cha rim pa mang po byung ba bzhin red/ rtsa ba rten gzhi gcig zin tshar ba 'di/ rten gzhi med pa las drin che ba yin pas/ thabs shes sgo gang sa nas tshad tshad bsdur bsdur bya rgyu de gal chen po red/ da lta bar du 'bad brtson byas pa yag po byung 'dug las ka byed mkhan tshang mar thugs rje che zer rgyu yin/ mi mang tsho'i thog nas kyang rang don rang gces kyis gang yong ci yong gi sems shugs 'khyer te byed kyi yod pa yag po byung 'dugathugs rje che zer rgyu yin/de nas don sur du da res nga yong thengs gsum pa yin/ nga tsho sngon 599

༄༅// phyi lo 1977 zla 8 tshes 9 nyin/ hon sur rab rgyas gling gi gzhis skar ser skya mi mang yongs la stsal ba'i bka' slob/'dir khyed rang tshor zhu rgyu la/ da lta las bsdoms nang gnas tshul bshad pa nang bzhin red/ na ning dbang 'dud rdo rje 'di gar blta bskor la yong ba'i gnas lugs skad cha zhib phra byung / bar lam than skyon la sogs pas hon sur la dka' las khag shos shig chags te kha shas ha lam za rgyu dkon po'i gnas tshul 'dra po byung ba red/ yin na yang / da lta las bsdoms nang bkod pa bzhin/ dka' ngal sel rgyu'i thabs shes sgo rnam pa mang po zhig gang yong ci yong tshad tshad bsdur bsdur byas dang byed mus red/ lo gcig gnyis nang la than pas rkyen pas dka' ngal byung ba red de/ yin na'ang nga rang tshor sa cha rtsa ba nas med pa dang yod pa byas na/ yod pa de phyags la drin che ba dang /sgrig 'dzugs gcig gi thog la gong bu byas nas bsdad pa de ga re byas kyang khe phan che ba yod pa sngon ma skad cha rim pa mang po byung ba bzhin red/ rtsa ba rten gzhi gcig zin tshar ba 'di/ rten gzhi med pa las drin che ba yin pas/ thabs shes sgo gang sa nas tshad tshad bsdur bsdur bya rgyu de gal chen po red/ da lta bar du 'bad brtson byas pa yag po byung 'dug las ka byed mkhan tshang mar thugs rje che zer rgyu yin/ mi mang tsho'i thog nas kyang rang don rang gces kyis gang yong ci yong gi sems shugs 'khyer te byed kyi yod pa yag po byung 'dugathugs rje che zer rgyu yin/de nas don sur du da res nga yong thengs gsum pa yin/ nga tsho sngon 599

ma nas skad cha mang po byung tshar ba red/ gzhis chags kyi bsti gnas 'di tsho bod mi'i rnam pa ma yal bar gces skyong bya rgyu dang / bod mi'i chos dang rig gzhung gces skyong byed rgyu/ mi rigs gces skyong / nga tsho rwaped mi'i dpal 'byor thog la nus pa 'don rgyu bcas gang ci'i gnad 'gag dang dge mtshan yod mkhan/ dngos su srid don dang 'brel ba med par 'gro ba mi'i thob thang gi thog nas gzhis chags byas pa zhig la/ rgyud nas bod pa'i srid don thog la 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad 'gag chen po zhig chags yod pa red/ 'phral sel so so'i don dag la yin kyang gzhis chags gcig gi nang yod na phugs su drin che ba zhig red la/ gtso che shos bod mi spyi'i gnas stangs kyi cha nas gal chen po yin stabs tshang mas da lta phan la byas pa bzhin dka' ngal byung ba'i skabs su gdong len dang / bzod bsran byas te gang ltar yang snying sa cha 'di rang la bsdad de dka' ngal sel thub pa'i bsam blo gtong rgyu de tshang ma'i sems la bcang rogs gyis/gzhan dag gal che ba zer yag mi 'dug 'phrod bsten ni yag po yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug ma gzhi sdod skar 'di nang mi phran bu nyung gi red/kha sa sman khang nang phyin pa'i skabs su nad pa kha shas ma gtogs mi 'dug sem rje dang skad cha byung bas drag tu drag tu phyin te skyon mi 'edug ces zer gyi 'dugade la dga' po byung / 'phrod bsten yag po byung rogs byas na sger so so dang /spyi pa'i don dag tshang mar gnad 'gag chen po red/ bod mi gcig gi tshe srog chud zos phyin pa yin na so so sdug pa/ bod pa spyi'i cha nas yin kyang gyong rag 600

rgyu red/ phangs po red/ dus rgyun du gzugs po bde thang yag po zhig ma byung na rang don sgrub rgyu yin kyang tshags su ma tshud pa/ spyi pa'i don dag gcig yin kyang 'thus shor yong gzhi yin dus gzugs po'i 'phrod bsten gal chen po red/ dus kun tu bod mi tsho'i 'phrod bsten gyi thog la do snang byas te na tsha ma byung sngon 'gog byed dgos/ na tsha byung tshar rjes sman bcos thabs shes chen po bya rgyu dus tshod 'gor rgyu zhig dang / 'gro gron sogs gang ci'i thog nas dka' ngal yong gi red/ de las dang po nas na tsha sngon 'gog byed thub na dus tshod gtong ma dgos pa dang / 'gro song gzhan dag thog nas dka' ngal med pa yong rgyuyin dus sngon 'gog gi don du nang khyim so so'i nang dmigs bsal gyi do snang bya rgyu dang / 'phrod bsten gyi las ka byed mkhan tsho yin yang dmigs bsal do snang byas te sngon 'gog gi las don de gal chen por brtsis dgos kyi 'dug de dang 'brel ba'i lus rtsal sbyong bdar gyis kha sa ru sgrig byas pa yin mdog kha po mthong song / yag po 'dug khyed rang tsho gzhis sgar nang nas lus rtsal sbyong bdar byed rgyu 'di la dmigs bsal do snang chen po byas ba 'dra/ gzhi rtsa sdod sgar 'di mi mang ba zhig ma red de/ yin na'ang lus rtsal byed pa'i skabs la hrag po dang / yin mdog kha po mthong song bar lam zla shas shig phyin pa de'i ring lus rtsal thog do snang byas pa'i lag rjes la gzugs po la'ang phan thogs yong gi 'dug ces kha sa don gcod dang skad cha byung / lus wa'i bde 'jags sam/ lus po bde thang yong ba'i don du dmigs bsal dus rgyun gtan nas lus rtsal sbyong bdar bya rgyu de gal chen po yin pa 601

'dra/ gzugs po sra thag thag byung na ngal rtsol gyi las ka ga 'dra zhig byed dgos byung yang thang ma chad pa dang / las ka nu sa thon yong ba/ bod mi rigs spyi pa'i don du skabs su babs pa'i las ka ga 'dra zhig bya dgos byung yang phan thogasayod payin dusayag po byung 'dug da dung mu mthud shugs bskyed dgos/thog mar 'go 'dzugs skabs la a sar byas/ gang 'tshams nas yal 'gro ba'i bzo 'dra po min pa da lta nang bzhin rgyun 'khyongs nas byed thub pa byung na yag po yong ba 'dugaslob sbyong skor kha sa 'dzin gra'i nang mthong ba de red/ dmigs bsal slob sbyong thog la slob gra'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms po med pa dang gcig dge rgan gyi gnas tshad yag po med pa dang gnyis/ de tsho'i gras ni rim pas rim pas drag tu 'gro rgyu'i thabs shes da lta rgya gar dbus shes rig tshogs pa'i thog la snga phyi rim pa byas te skad cha yong dang yong mus red/ de bzhin bod kyi shes rig las khungs kyi thog nas kyang gang yong ci yong gis dus tshod dang mthun pa'i bod pa'i phru gur slob sbyong rag thub pa gcig dang / slob sbyong spus dag po yong ba/ slob gra khag gi 'dzin skyong tshags su tshud po yong ba'i don du thabs shes lo sbrel nas gang yong ci yong gi bsam blo btang / 'char gzhi bkod/'grub tshod dpag tshod kyis 'bad rtsol byed mus red/ de 'dra yin dus tan tan rim pas rim pas yar rgyas 'gro gi red bsam pa dran gyi 'dug gal che ba gcig la pha ma so so'i ngos nas phru gu'i shes yon gyi don du dmigs bsal gyi do snang byas nas phru gur shes yon yag po 'jags thabs dang / phyags nas 602

nga rang tsho'i mi rigs kyi cha nas yin na'ang rung / 'phral sel phru gu mi re ngo re'i mi tshe skyel rgyu'i cha nas yin na'ang rung / slob sbyong de gal chen po zhig la ngos 'dzin gsal po byas te slob sbyong rbog la pha ma so sos kyang dmigs bsal do snang yag po byas na bsam pa 'di ngas re bskul zhu rgyu yin/de nas don sur gzhis sgar 'di'i nang du dgon pa re zung zhig yod pa red/ gtso che shos rgyud smad gra tshang red/ sngon ma nas nga tsho skad cha byung ba bzhin rgyud smad gra tshang 'di bod lung par yod pa'i skabs la yin na'ang tshad yongs pa gcig dang / cha 'jog 'pher ba'i dgon pa zhig yin dus/ da lta 'dir yin na'ang yag thag chod chags bsdad 'dug dgon pa dang / yul pa'i dbar la phan tshun 'brel ba yag po zhig dgos kyi red/ yul pas yin kyang tshad longs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin dus de la mthong dang cha 'jog brtsi bkur yod mkhan/ dgon pa'i thog nas kyang dngos gnas chos dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba skyel ba ma gtogs/ don dag med pa'i mi la bshu gzhog gi rnam pa thon pa'i bzo 'dra po/ dgon pa dgon pa zer na yang dpal 'byor 'du 'god byed sa'i bsti gnas kyi bzo 'dra po chags na yag po yod pa ma red/ mi'i lung pa la 'tsho ba bsod snyoms dang / mi'i bsnyen bkur kho nar bsten te bsdad thub yag med pa yin dus so so'i sa skal de yi thog nas spyi pa'i 'tsho ren gyi dpal 'byor 'du 'god byed dgos kyi red/ de snga bod la skabs re tshad las brgal ba'i skyon gyi rnam pa bon gyi yod pa de 'drar ma song ba byed dgos/ gzab gzab bya dgos/ gzhan dag shod rgyu gang yang mi 'dug 603

nga rang tsho'i mi rigs kyi cha nas yin na'ang rung / 'phral sel phru gu mi re ngo re'i mi tshe skyel rgyu'i cha nas yin na'ang rung / slob sbyong de gal chen po zhig la ngos 'dzin gsal po byas te slob sbyong rbog la pha ma so sos kyang dmigs bsal do snang yag po byas na bsam pa 'di ngas re bskul zhu rgyu yin/de nas don sur gzhis sgar 'di'i nang du dgon pa re zung zhig yod pa red/ gtso che shos rgyud smad gra tshang red/ sngon ma nas nga tsho skad cha byung ba bzhin rgyud smad gra tshang 'di bod lung par yod pa'i skabs la yin na'ang tshad yongs pa gcig dang / cha 'jog 'pher ba'i dgon pa zhig yin dus/ da lta 'dir yin na'ang yag thag chod chags bsdad 'dug dgon pa dang / yul pa'i dbar la phan tshun 'brel ba yag po zhig dgos kyi red/ yul pas yin kyang tshad longs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin dus de la mthong dang cha 'jog brtsi bkur yod mkhan/ dgon pa'i thog nas kyang dngos gnas chos dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba skyel ba ma gtogs/ don dag med pa'i mi la bshu gzhog gi rnam pa thon pa'i bzo 'dra po/ dgon pa dgon pa zer na yang dpal 'byor 'du 'god byed sa'i bsti gnas kyi bzo 'dra po chags na yag po yod pa ma red/ mi'i lung pa la 'tsho ba bsod snyoms dang / mi'i bsnyen bkur kho nar bsten te bsdad thub yag med pa yin dus so so'i sa skal de yi thog nas spyi pa'i 'tsho ren gyi dpal 'byor 'du 'god byed dgos kyi red/ de snga bod la skabs re tshad las brgal ba'i skyon gyi rnam pa bon gyi yod pa de 'drar ma song ba byed dgos/ gzab gzab bya dgos/ gzhan dag shod rgyu gang yang mi 'dug 603

bod spyi pa'i don dag nas bshad na/ nga tsho mi'i lung par slebs nas lo bcu dgu la phyogs pa zhig 'gro gi yod pa red/ dus yun gang la gang 'tshams phyin pa red/ 59 rjes la skyes pa'i phru gu tsho lo bco brgyad bcu dgur slebs kyi yod pa red/ yin na'ang rtsa ba bod nang layod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tsho sems shugs ha cang chen po gcig dang / rgya mi la ma dga' ba'i rnam pa shugs chen po zhig da lta'ang yod dang yod bzhin pa red/ bod shar brgyud khams khul dang / a mdo khul gyi gnas tshul gsal po yong rgyu khag po red de/ yin na yang gcig la gnyis brgyud kyi gnas tshul thos gsal ltar byas na/ sa khul de tshor sngon ma zing 'khrug langs pa'i skabs la lung tsho lung tsho bsdebs gsod btang ba'i gnas tshul byung yod pa ma gtogs/ yongs grags kyi zing 'khrug chen 1— de 'jags tshar ba'i rjes la yul pa ga la 'gril po dang / mkhregs 11 byas nas bsdad pa'i rkyen gyis rgya mis bstun mkhas ma byas rang byas lta bu zhig chags nas lung pa'i nang la gang la gang 'tshams kyi rang dbang dang / gnas stangs de.a'u tsam yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug bar lam shes rig gsar brje'i skabs dbus gtsang khul gyi dgon khag mang po gtor bshig btang ba dang / mdor na/ lha sa gtsug lag khang la'ang nyams chag chen po byung yod pa red de/ khams dang / a mdo khul la phran bu drag tsam byung ba'i gnas tshul thos rgyu 'dug ji ma ji bzhin gcig bshad thub pa mi 'dug ste/ gzhi rtsa'i gnas stangs de 'dra 'dug des ga re rtags bstan gyi yod pa red ces zer na/ chol kha gsum gyi dbye ba med par bod mi rigs 604

yin phyin chad la sa khul ga sa ga nas rgya mi rigs la mi dga' ba byed mkhan gcig dang / so so'i mi rigs la gces zhen byed pa/ so so'i shes rig dang /so so'i goms gshis la dga' zhen byed mkhan gcig gyurayin pa'i rang rtags gsal por bstan pa red/ rgya mis de 'dra byed chog ṅge ma red ces bshad nas de 'dra byed mkhan la ma dga' ba byas pa yin na yang / de rdog rol btang nas so so'i mi rigs kyi rnam pa nyams med zin rgyu la dpe 'dra wa'i sems shugs dang / snying stobs bcangs nas da lta bar lo 'di tsam zhig mkhregs po byas nas bsdad pa 'di dngos gnas ha las pa'i gnas tshul zhig red/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi'i sems shugs yod pa yin na dus yun ring thung la ma ltos par tha ma mi'i sems shugs la rgyal kha thob pa'i gnas tshul mang po zhig yong gi yod pa red/ 'dzam bu gling gi lo rgyus nang la 'di 'dra mang po zhig byung yod pa yin dus nga rang tsho bod mi rigs thog la yin na yang / da lta rgya nag stobs chen rgyal khab lta bu zhig chags nas gnam gyis sa brdungs pa'i bzo 'dra po zhig chags nas bsdad yod pa red de/ yin na yang / rtsa ba nga rang cho dud mi rigs la sems shugs shig yod pa yin na rim pas bden pa'i mtha' tan tan gsal gyi red bsam pa'i yid ches byas chog pa zhig red/ de dang chabs cig nga rang tsho chos khas len mkhan red/ chos kyi jog nas brtag dpyad byed pa'i thabs dang rnam pa mang po yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thog nas bltas na yang / nga rang tsho'i bden pa'i mtha' gsal thub pa zhig dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rtsa med shul med 'gro ba'i dus shig la ma slebs pa lta bu zhig yod 605

pa red/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas nga tsho spyi pa'i don la sems shugs bskyed kyi yod pa red la/ da dung yin na yang sems shugs ma chag pa bya dgos/sems shugs bskyed nas las ka byed stangs thad/ sems shugs yin khul gyis lam seng srid don gyi thog la zang nge zing nge byed rgyu yod pa ma red/rang rang so so'i ngo gdong la las lnga'i khur babs bsdad pa de tshags tshud po zhig dang / dngos gnas drang gnas spyi sger gnyis kur phan thogs yag po sgrub thub pa zhig byung na/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i thog nas bod spyi pa'i don dag la phan pa dang / bod rang btsan don dag la phan gyi yod pa red/ bod rang btsan sgrub pa'i cha rkyen zhig yin pa red/ rang rang so so'i skabs su babs pa'i las ka de tshags tshud po zhig byed dgos/ kha nas bod rang btsan dang /spyi don zhes skad cha sbar mo gang bshad/ lag len la so so'i khur du babs pa'i las ka de 'thus sgo ma tshang ba/ the gu sne shor phyin bsdad pa byung na snying po gang yang yod pa ma red/ byed stangs des don la rang btsan la gnod pa ma gtogs/ rang btsan la phan gyi ma red/ nyin re nyin re so so'i las 'gan de tshags su tshud pa zhig byas pa'i thog la rtsa ba bod rang btsan gyi sems shugs da lta phan la yod pa nang bzhin tshang mas sems shugs ma chag pa byed rgyu de gal chen po red/phar phyogs rgya mi'i cha nas bshad na/ kho rang tsho nang khul mthun ma mthun/ gcig 'og gcig la ma 'dus pa'i gnas tshul de 1959 nas bzung rgyun mthud nas byung ba red/ rgya nag nang du srid don gyi 'pho 'gyur 606

chen po zhig da dung yang 'gro bzhin pa red/ da cha ga 'dra zhig tu 'gro thabs yod dam/ lo lnga/ bcu'i mtshams la ga 'dra zhig yong grabs yod dam/ da lta tshod mi thig pa lta bu zhig red/ gcig byas na rgya nag gi srid byus 'jam po zhig dang / rgyu mtshan ldan pa lta bu'i rnam pa gsar pa ga 'dra zhig chags grabs yod med da lta'i gnas skabs 'dir cha ma mchis pa'i bzo 'dra po zhig 'dug yang gdug rtsub chen po zhig gi thog la 'gro grabs yod med kyang cha ma mchis pa red/ de 'dra yin dus dgra phyogs kyi gdong ston stangs dang /srid byus 'khyer stangs rtsub po zhig byas pa yin na/ de la gzhigs pa'i nga rang tsho bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig dang / yang / dgra phyogs nas 'jam po zhig dang / rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig gi sgang la phyin pa yin na de la gzhigs pa'i nga rang tsho'i ngos nas bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig yong gi red/ yong srid kyi red/ byas tsang da lta thag chod pa zhig dang / gsal po zhig shod thub rgyu mi 'dug 'di nga rang tsho bod pa gcig pu ma red/ rdo don snying po bod nang la yod pa'i rgya che'i mi mang tsho sems shugs dngos gnasa.ang ki dang posku1da pa yin dus nga rang tsho mi'i lung par sdod mkhan tshos kyang sngar bzhin sems shugs ma chag pa gcig dang / nga rang tsho nang khul las ka tshags tshud po zhigardog la 'gril po zhig nges par byed dgos kyi 'dug so sos kyang don dag med pa'i skad cha cho yod la med la de 'dra'i rigs ma bshad pa byas/ mis gang byung mang byung bshad mkhan byung na yang de tshor mgo ma 'khor ba byas/ mi mang gi nang la de 'dra'i skad cha yong ba'i skabs la mi mang rang tshugs zin po 607

byas nas sdod rgyu gal chen po red/ brtan po byas te sdod rgyu gal chen po red/da lta nga rang tshor bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs shig yod pa red/ sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i thog nas da lta phan lo bcu dgu la phyogs pa'i dus yun 'di'i ring la gang yong ci yong byas pa red/ da dung ma 'ongs pa la yang ngas 'go 'khrid pa'i nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i thog nas gang yong ci yong byed kyi red/ ngas khyed rang tsho'i mdun la 'dra chags po'i skad cha bshad nas ma yong ba la yong mdog dang / ma byas pa la byas tshul brdzun bshad pas la dag gi ma red/lus la bcom ldan 'das kyi na bza' gyon pa gcig gis rdzun dang / ngo lkog gi skad cha bshad na 'grigs kyi ma red/ da lta bar du hur thag byas pa red/da dung yin yang hur thag byed kyi red/ de la khyed rang tshos yid ches dang /brtsi bkur/ rgyab skyor byed rgyu gal chen po red/ nga tshos mang gtso'i gzhung bshad kyi yod pa 'di yi ge'i thog gi skad cha tsam min par/ lag len thog gi skad cha yin dus dmangs gtso'i gzhung la mi mang gi thog nas rgyab skyor dgos kyi red/ mi mang gis rgyab skyor byung na gzhung spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs la nus pa thon gyi red/ mi mang gi rgyab skyor da nga / yid ches med na spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi nus pa thon thub kyi ma red/ rtsa ba spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di dgos dang mi dgos/phan thogs yod dang med zer ba de dngos gnas drang gnas gzu bor gnas pa'i mi mang gi thog nas brtag dpyad byed dgos pa zhig red/ dgos mkho med pa zhig dang / 'di la snying po mi 'dug bsam pa gcig de la yid ches 7 brlag pa zhig byung song na btsugs dgos don yod pa ma red/ sgo rgyab chog 608

gi red/ las sla po red/ da lta nga rang tsho bod spyi'i gnas stangs kyi cha nas bltas pa yin na/ spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'dis nga tsho bod mi btsan byol ba'i srid don gyi 'thab rtsod byed pa'i las don 'di'i thog la bod spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di dpe 'dra po'i gal chen po zhig chags nas bsdad yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus spyi pa'i sgrig 'dzugs 'di dgos kyi yod pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug des nus pa thon pa zhig yong ba la de la mi mang gi yid ches dang / rgyab skyor byed dgos/ don dag med pa'i skad cha 'dra mi 'dra lhags pa'i skabs la mi mang mgo ma 'khor bar rang tshugs brtan por 'dzin rgyu gal chen po red bsam pa dran gyi 'du ga gzhan dag zer rgyu mi 'duga'adi phyogs yang yang slebs thub yag yod pa ma red de/ yin na yang skabs re skabs re yong thub kyi red/ yang yang slebs thub min la ma tos par tshang mas hur thag byed rogs/ bkra shis bde legs/ zhes stsal// //609

ra༅༅// phyi lo 1977 zla 8 tshes 22 nyin/ lugs zung bsam gling dang / bde skyid slar gso'i gzhis chags ser skya mi mang la stsal ba'i bka' slob/ rtsa ba gzhis chags 'di sa cha che shos dang drag shos shig red/ de ring tshang ma gyon chas kyang gang la gang 'tshams kyi gtsang ma/ spas dag po/ gdong gi mdog kyang yag po/ gzhis chags nang rang 'tsho gde(lha 'khel ba chags pa'i rtags mtshan lta bu phyi'i cha lugs dang / gdong mdog gi thog nas mthong rgyu yod dus nga rang dga' po byung / de bzhin khyed rang tsho yang nga tsho thug ste dga' po byung yod kyi red/ khyed rang tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zer rgyu yin /gnas lugs gal che ba de tsam shod rgyu mi 'dug tshang mas shes gsal red/ gzhis chags 'di'i nang rjes su 'byor ba tsho la do snang byung yod kyi ma red/ thog mar 'go stod la 'byor pa tshos shes gsal red/ thog mar gzhis chags 'di tshugs pa'i skabs la gzhi nas shing rtsa bkog rgyu dang / khang pa rgyag pa'i dus nga yong ba'i skabs shig tsha bas gdong gi mdog log lus kyi shed mo shor/ nad pa mang po thon pa'i skabs su rgya gar lto phyogs tsha ba'i lung pa 'i nang bod mi gzhis chags bya rgyu de nor 'khrul byung ba min nam snyam ste sems shugs chag dgos pa lta bu byung / khyed rang tsho mi mang tsho yang gang 'tshams 'u thug nas glang chen sdang ba zhig 'dug phag pa sdang ba gcig 'dug ces skad rgyag dgos pa zhig byung ba khyed rang tsho rgan pa tshos shes gsal red/ de 610

dus 'di nas yul byol 'gro mkhan yang gang 'tshams byung / yin na yang /'dir nga tshos 'go btsugs tshar ba red/ sems shugs ma chag pa byed dgos kyi 'dug ces ngas blo bag spros khul byas/ mi mang tshos kyang ngas lab pa'i kha la nyan/ snyugs bsrings nas sems shugs bsgril ba'i lag rjes la da cha gzhis chags drag shos shig chags pa red/ sdod sgar 'di'i sgang la nga tsho skad cha snga rjes mang po byung yod pa yin dus ngas skyar zlosayang zlos bshad nas dgos pa mi 'dug da cha sa cha 'di'i sgang la sa cha skyar du rgya che ru gtong thub pa dang / sa ston gsar pa thob rgyu'i re ba med pa dang / sa cha 'di'i sgang la grod khog btsugs nas zas sdod mkhan de lo re nas lo re 'phel te mang du 'gro gi yod pa red/ da gang byed dbos zer na/ gzhis chags 'di tsam min par gzhis chags tshang mar do snang da nga / dmigs bsal gyi bsam blo gsar pa gtong dgos pa de sa cha'i dge bed gcig pur re bcol byed pa min par lag shes sna tshogs kyi thog nas yong 'bab bzo thabs byed dgos kyi 'dugadaper na/ rum 'thag gi bzo gra gzhis chags gang sar btsugs yod pa ltar/'dir yang gzhi rtsa yag po tshugs te bsdad yod pa 'di 'dra'i thog nas shugs rgyag rgyu daji / yang / phyugs gso byas te da lta'i char khe bzang mi 'dug zer gyi yod na yang / gang ltar lto gos 'tshol ba'i thabs shes rim pa gcig red/da lta nang bzhin 'bad tsol byas na yar rgyas yong gi red/ grub 'bras yong gi red/ 'di tshor 'bad rtsol byed rgyu yod pa zhig red/ da res khyug tsam blta bskor byas pa'i nang nas 'phrul 'khor khang de yin mdog kha shos shig 611

mthong byung / kha sngon gsum bcu'i dus dran gyi lo 'khor las bsdoms kyi thog nas kyang do snang byung / da ring dngos su mthong ba'i skabs su 'grel bshad kyang byung / de'i nang nas 'phral sel nga tshos 'khor lo thed spyod byed bzhin pa tsho la bzo bcos bya rgyu tsam ma zad/ dngos po'i rigs kha shas 'di nas bzos te rgya gar ba'i tshong khang nang slebs thub pa yong gi yod pa red/ spyir btang bod mi'i nang bzo las rtsa ba chen po red/ ha cang yag po mthong byung /bod mi'i nang bzo tshong gi las ka bya rgyu da lta phan la phyogs gcig nas nyams myong dang / ma rtsas ma ldengs pa'i thog nas nga tshor pham nyes mang po zhig byung stabs/ bzo las kyi thog nas shugs rgyag rgyu bsam blo'i nang ha lam re ba bral ba lta bu zhig red de/ da lta nga tshor 'phrul bzo khang chung chung zhig yod pa 'di rtsa ba brtan po tshugs te so so'i skabs su babs pa'i las 'gan cha tshang sgrub pa'i thog la yar rgyas kyi rnam pa gsal po zhig thon yong ba yin dus 'di la shugs rgyab nas khe 'bab kyi las ka shugs chen po zhig ga ler ga ler yong thub thabs med dam snyam pa'i re ba zhig byung / gtso che shos khyed rang tshor nyams myong yod pa dang / sa cha 'di ga'i gnas stangs cha rgyus yod pa tshos rim pas bsam blo btang / go bsdur yag po byed kyi yin na rig pa gsar pa thon/ khrom ra gsar pa de 'dra da dung rnyed yong mdog kha po red/ rgya gar ba'i bzo gra che sa tsho dang phan tshun 'brel ba byas/ khong tshor dgos mkho'i dngos po kha shas gzhis chags kyi bzo gra 'di nas bzo 'don tshong rgyu yod pa de 'dra byung ba yin na/ 'phral sel 'khor lo bzo bcos gcig pu min par tshong las 612

kyi bzo gra zhig ga ler ga ler chags thub pa'i re ba med dam snyam pa dran byung / de 'dra byung ba yin na zhing las dang mi 'dra bar bzo las kyi thog nas rim pas rim pas khe slebs chen po yong ba'i re ba yod pa red/ zhing las kyi khe thon ni tshad gzhi nges can zhig red/ bzo las yag po byung ba yin na tshad med pa'i khe thon yong rgyu yin dus da res re ba byung la/ spobs pa phran bu rnyed song /bzo las khang 'di'i nang rgya gar las byed re zung yod pa de chor spyi 'gre'i gla cha sprad de las ka byed kyi yod red/ rtsa ba'i bzo gra'i 'dzin skyong dang / bsam blo gtongargyu/ 'char gzhi bkod rgyu'i las 'gan tshang ma nga tsho bod mi rang gis byed kyi yod pa de ha cang yag po mthong byung / slob ston len pa dang go bsdur byed sa ni ga dus yin kyang yong gi yod pa red/ byas chog gi red/ gzhi rtsa yag po tshugs zin pa'i bzo gra 'di nyams chags mi 'a11 ba'i thog la gom bgrod brtan po'i thog nas bzo las rang gi thon skyed byed sa zhig yong thub pa'i ngas smon lam yang rgyag gi yin/ khyed rang tshos kyang hur thag byed dgos/ de rtsa ba chen po mthong byung /de nas don tshan gcig la/ dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs yar rgyas phyin/ to gos phran bu 'bal du phyin pa'i skabs la rang don thog la shugs bsgril nas spyi don la de tsam do snang mi byed pa dang / yang / srid don mgo 'tshos la ma 'chos kyi shog shog 'then byed pa 'dra po/ yang sho spag gi rtsed mo rtsed pa 'dra po/ spyod lam 'chal spyod byed pa lta bu de 'dra tan tan yong srid kyi red/ de 'dra'i rigs la dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed dgos/ rgyan po 'gyed 613
